༄༅/ /rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI032_mus pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar sarga gsum gyi bdag nyid can/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa sarga gsum gyi bdag nyid can dad pa rgya mtsho spel ba'i chu rgyun ngo mtshar don gnyis phun tshogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ dzā kri pa shak+ṣeḥpra bhu dza ya pu tra tsa shiṣ+ya sa s+yot+sarka sad dhu sa trai yā dh+wi ka na bṛ tau pa sh+ya s+ya bha ṭ+ṭaṣa kā ra sad+ya ma hā bud+dha dh+wa dza s+ya bi mok+ta dhiṣ+ṭha na s+ya bṛṣ+ṭi pra yā ta a tsar+ya sarga trī tī ya nā ma shrī dhar+m+ma swā mi sa de wa dza saṅgu ru tri dhā tu dharma rā dza bhaṭ+ṭa ra kā ma hā badz+ra dha ra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyi gzugs dam pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs ngo mtshar sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba dpal chos kyi rje lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i bgrod pa gcig gis mtha' dag sa gsum yud kyis mnan/ /g.yo med rdo rje'i skyil krung gcig gis bdud sde'i snying dbugs lkog mar drangs/ /bsam gtan la chags zim bu'i spyan gyis 'gro bar rjes chags skye dgu'i mgon/ /shākya'i gtso bo chos dang dge 'dun bcas pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /'khor 'das bdag po he ru ka dpal thugs rje'i rang gzugs nam yang 'gog med rol pa'i gar/ /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i khyams su rnam par rtsen zhes dus 'dir rnam 'dren dam pa'i gzugs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog gi rnam par legs bstan pa'i/ /'brel tshad don ldan skyabs gnas bslu med rje btsun gang des thugs rje'i spyan zur rol pas skyongs/

/gang gi sku ni nyin byed bye ba'i mdangs kyis lan brgyar byugs pa'i kha ba'i lhun po bzhin/ /gang gi gsung ni legs bshad char gyis dge legs lo tog ci yang bskrun pa'i rdzogs ldan sprin/ /gang gi thugs ni gting mtha' mi mngon lung rtogs rin chen bye bas yongs gang yid bzhin mtsho/ /gang gi mtshan tsam gyis kyang srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las nye bar skyobs der bdag yid rang / /snyan pa'i grags dkar sa gsum rna ba'i rgyan du gyur kyang dregs pa'i dri ma ring du spangs/ /zhabs sen zla ba gangs can mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug na mdzes kyang kun gyi bran bzhin rgyu/ /shes bya kun la 'jam pa'i dbyangs ltar rnam dpyod dkar yangs khengs pa'i skyon bral dul bar gnas/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las ring nas brgal yang dmigs med thugs rjes bsam bzhin srid par 'khor 'di rmad/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma srid gsum 'od 'bar yang / /'od zer 'bab stegs bla ma'i me shel la/ /brten pa med par rgyal kun byin rlabs kyang / /'jug pa med pa'i tshul la nges pa rnyed/ /stong gsum ma lus rin chen gyis bkang nas/ /nyin bzhin rgyal la phul bas bla ma yi/ /ba spur snum gyis byugs pa lhag go zhes/ /thub dbang bden pa'i gtam gyis bdag yid drangs/ /rgyal kun yon tan bskal brgyar lce stong gis/ /brjod las bla ma'i ba spu'i nyag gcig la/ /bstod pa mchog ces rgyal bas bden gsungs pas/ /bdag gi yid ni rang dbang med par phrogs/ /khron par gnas pa'i rus pa'i gos can gyis/ /mtha' gru yangs pa'i rgya mtsho'i tshad 'jal ltar/ /dam pa'i spyod tshul mkha' 'dra mtha' yas pa/ /byis blos 'jal ba'i yul du lta ga la/ /de bzhin 'dab bzang dbang pos kun gsal mtha'/ /blta ba'i gshog rlabs brtson yang rang gi stobs/ /zad pas ldog bzhin dam pa'i yon tan kun/ /brjod la rgyal kun skrag na bdag gis ci/ /de lta na yang dad pa'i nyi bdun gyis/

/snying gi chu gter khol ba'i gdung sel thabs/ /thun mong gdul byar snang ba las brtsams te/ /mdo tsam 'chad kyis skal bzang kun dgar byos/ /'dir bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa khams gsum gyi mgon po/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas/ srid pa gsum gyi bla ma/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mig gcig pu/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes grags pa 'di ni/ nges pa kho nar bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro mnyam pa'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du mdzad zin kyang / gdul bya gzhan gyi ngor nam yang zab mo chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du de'i gzugs kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa mchog dang mchog ma yin pa'i sgo nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing las 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'byung ba'am/ nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa tshon sna tshogs pa dang 'phrad na de dang de'i kha dog mdzes pa 'dzin pa ji lta ba bzhin/ gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang / bsam pa dang / dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i gang zag tu nges pa las/ 'dir ni so so skye bo'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul bzung bar snang ste/ de ltar yang rje sa paṇa gyis/ khyod ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /rab byung dge bsnyen khyim pa sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi gzugs mdzad nas/ /gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad/ /ces dang / mdo las kyang / rgyal pos 'dul ba la rgyal por/ dge sbyong gis 'dul ba la dge sbyong / bram zes 'dul ba la bram ze/ dri zas 'dul ba la dri za rgan po'i gzugs su sprul to/

/zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ res 'ga' zhi la res 'ga' khro/ /res 'ga' bgegs chen don mdzad cing / /skye dang ri bo thams cad do/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ gang du snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /seng ger snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /chang tshong ma dang smad 'tshong mar snang yang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pas mtshon nas zhing khams dag pa la lar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo/ la lar ni 'khor/ la lar ni sdud pa po la sogs pa'i snang brnyan dang / la lar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang / grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa dang / a wa dhu ti dang / bhu su ku dang / ku sā li dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i rgyal po dang / khams kyi rgyal phran dang / blon po dang / bram ze dang / dge sbyong dang / khyim bdag dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / gru gzings dang / zam pa dang / sman dang / zas dang / gos dang / ri bo dang / bya dang / ri dwags la sogs pa mdor na snod bcud kyi rnam pa thams cad pa 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyi rnam rol du mas 'gro ba rnams rang rang gi bskal ba dang 'tshams pa'i spyod pa dang gtam gyis mtshams sbyar te/ mthar nges par zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i sar dkri bar mdzad pa kho na las mi 'da' bar gsungs pas/ de dag gi nang nas kyang ches cher rab mchog yul du byung ba gtso bo'i dam par gyur pa ni/ thar 'dod rnams la ma nor ba'i lam tshul bzhin du 'dom par mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang / de las kyang zab mo'i smin grol gyi bka' drin stsol ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs kyi rnam par sprul pa dag yin te/ ba tshwa can chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/

/nga nyid slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa skyed/ /ces dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu yis/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su bzung dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis bdag cag rnams la rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa po rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyi yon tan rtogs pa brjod pa la phan yon gzhal du med de/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad mchod pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig mchod pa bsod nams che ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis bden pa'i tshig gis dus gcig ma yin par lan grangs du mar bka' stsal ba'i phyir te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad mchod pa'i bsod nams ni bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig ma mthong ba de'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod pa byed pa mthong ngo / /zhes dang / a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ rdo rje 'chang la bskal pa brgyar/ /mchod cing bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga la/ /snum thigs gcig bskus bsod nams ni/ /brgya yi char yang mi phod do/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang dam pa dang po la sogs pa'i rgyud sde rnams las de kho na ltar gsungs la/ rdo rje gur las kyang / slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /de nyid yin par bsam par bya/ /zhes dang / gang phyir ye shes rdo rje ni/ /mnyes pas myur du thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir slob dpon drung gshegs te/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams phyag mdzad do/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma'i mchod pa yang dag brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/

/zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ dbang bskur mchog thob rdo rje yi/ /slob dpon la ni de bzhin gshegs/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pas/ /dus gsum du ni mngon phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rdo rje dril bu yang / bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin/ /'khor lo sdom par sbas pa yi/ /byin rlabs rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad par ni mi sems te/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas/ /kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis/ /brten bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub rgya che'i snod du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bsnyen bkur ba bas ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byugs pa bsod nams ches khyad par du 'phags so/ /zhes dang / lha sku bye ba stong bsgoms pas/ /bla ma dran pa bsod nams che/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan brjod pa bas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi yon tan gyi cha shas tsam brjod pa'ang bsod nams ches che bar grub pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar brjod pa ni gleng bar bya ba'i 'os mchog dam pa yin pa'i tshul ni/ mdo las/ 'di ltar 'jig rten na rigs thams cad kyi bla mar gyur pa shākya rnams kyi skyes pa'i rabs bzung zhing kun chub par byas nas gzhan la yang rgya cher bsnyad na/

chos dang mthun pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa 'byung la/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgyud las kyang / slob dpon yon tan gleng bya yi/ /skyon rnams nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes dang / skyon brjod pas ni dngos grub med/ /chu la 'o mar rang zhugs pa/ /de bton nas ni ngang pas btung / /de ltar bla ma'i yon tan bzung / /til dang gseg ma 'dres pa las/ /gseg ma dag ma dro med dang / /til bsdus nas ni khu byug za/ /de ltar bla ma'i yon tan bzung / /ji ltar kha mkhan mkhas pa yis/ /til sogs mar khur 'jur ba bzhin/ /bla ma'i yon tan gzhung la bzung / /skyar mos mtsho las nya len bzhin/ /bla ma'i yon tan rnam par bzung / /zhes so/ /des na phan yon dpag tu med cing gleng ba dang brjod pa don dang ldan pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar ba cung zad tsam brjod pa 'di la don gsum ste/ dang por rigs can gsum sogs kyi snang ngor 'o skol gyi ston pa mchog gi rnam par bstan tshul/ bar du 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams la sa bcu'i byang sems chen po'i sprul skur snang tshul/ tha mar bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs mgon dam par slar yang 'das te byon pa'i tshul gyi rnam thar bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di ni 'khor 'das brtan g.yo kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa de'i phyir/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'dus sku dang sprul gzhi dam par gyur pa yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /'di yi gzugs kyi phung po ni/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/

/ces sogs gsungs pa dang / dpal dam pa dang po dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud chen po las/ slob dpon sangs rgyas nyid de rab mchog sa yi gzhi la chos ni de yis bstan pa'o/ /zhes dang / don dam bsnyen pa las/ de ni dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /de nyid 'jig rten mgon dang dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /de ni thugs kyi rdo rje rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpal/ /de ni mi 'gyur 'gyur med rnal 'byor gyis ni bsgrod/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa nas brtsams te/ bla ma dam pa bsten pa rnams la yid bzhin nor/ /zhes bya ba'i bar du gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang / bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /dpal ldan bla ma he ru ka /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing de dag gi don thugs la bzhag nas/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang / /me shel med par me mi 'byung / /de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang / /bla ma med par 'byung mi nus/ /des na khyod nyid mnyes pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par 'gyur/ /dkon mchog gsum po gcig bsdus pa'i/ /bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rin chen gter/ /dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni gdul bya smin bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga/ /khyod kyi phung po rnam lngar ston/ /spyan sogs khyod kyi 'byung ba bzhi/ /sa yi snying po rdo rje 'chang / /nam mkha'i snying po spyan ras gzigs/ /'jam dbyangs sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /byams pa kun tu bzang po rnams/ /mgon po khyod kyi dbang po sogs/ /gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo bcu/

/dpal ldan khyod kyi sku yi cha/ /gzugs sogs rdo rje lha mor ston/ /nyon mongs ye shes gnas gyur pa/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod kyis mkhyen/ /thams cad spro ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprul/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rdo rje 'chang / /bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib kun spangs/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las ngo mtshar rmad/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /des na bdag cag gi rnam 'dren rje btsun mus pa chen po 'dis thog mar rigs can gsum sogs rjes su gzung ba'i slad du lha mi'i ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa zas gtsang sras po'i tshul bzung nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs kyi sgo nas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ de yang rang re'i ston pa 'di gang du byon pa'i zhing ni mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams yin la/ mi mjed ces pa yang bzod pa dang don gcig ste/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi mi 'phrogs shing bzod pa ste sems sran thub pas na mi mjed ces bya ste/ snying rje pad dkar las/ ci'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de ni mi mjed ces bya zhe na/ sems can de dag 'dod chags las mi mjed pa dang / zhe sdang la mi mjed pa dang / gti mug la mi mjed pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba rnams la mi mjed pas de'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams de ni mi mjed ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i zhing khams 'dir ston pa thub pa'i dbang po ji ltar byon pa'i tshul la/ klu sgrub kyis mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod par/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed de/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed tshul/

/bar du tshogs gnyis ji ltar bsags pa'i tshul/ mthar mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'di dag la theg pa che chung gi bshad tshul mi 'dra ba mang na yang / 'dir theg pa chen po'i lugs ltar bshad na mdo drin lan bsab pa las/ ston pa 'di rigs la gnas kyang las kyi nus pas lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la me'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ zla bo stobs chung pa la dmyal ba'i bsrung ma a wang bya bas yang yang bsnun pas shin tu brtse ba skyes te/ de'i rkyen gyis byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / 'di la snying rje'i sems cung zad skyed cig ces smras pas/ de nyid rab tu khros nas mdung rtse gsum pa bsnun pas tshe'i dus byas/ me'i shing rta'i dmyal ba las thar te bskal pa brgyad kyi sdig pa byang bar gyur to/ /zhes 'byung la/ phung po gsum pa las/ ston pa 'di tshong dpon gyi bu mngon dgar gyur pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes phyin gyi drung du dang por thugs bskyed par bshad cing / bskal bzang du/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la/ /'jam gang zhig gi dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni thugs bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs/ yang snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/ gong du bshad pa ltar bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa zhes pa la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyi mdun na 'don gyi gtso bo bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul du gyur pa'i tshe/ zhing khams 'dir 'gro ba'i don mdzad par smon lam btab ste thugs kyang bskyed par bshad do/ /yang ston pa 'di rdza mkhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa chen po la khams pa'i bum pa gcig mgron bu lnga/ mchil lham zung gcig gdugs gcig rnams phul te/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang /

/de bzhin mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /ces smon lam btab ste sems bskyed cing / shākya thub pa zhes pa'i mtshan can du gyur pa yang smon lam de'i stobs las byung ba yin par bshad do/ /gnyis pa bar du tshogs gnyis ji ltar bsags pa'i tshul la/ bsag bya'i tshogs ngos bzung ba/ ji tsam gsog pa'i dus/ ji ltar gsog pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs/ /bsod nams ye shes mtshungs pa med/ /gcig gis 'khor bar mngon mtho byed/ /gzhan gyis nyon mongs med par 'khor/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi rgyur gyur pa'i zag bcas kyi dge bas dang zag med kyi dge ba'i bsdus pa'i las rnams la tshogs zhes bya la/ tshogs zhes pa'i nges tshig kyang / rgyun du bsgom pa thob nas ni/ /dge ba yang dang yang du sgrub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ saṃ kṛ ta'i skad du saṃ bha ra zhes 'byung / de bod skad du tshogs yin zhing / de yang sa ta na rgyun du/ bha na bsgom pa/ ra ti ni yang yang ste rgyun mi 'chad par yang yang bsgom pas thob pas na tshogs zhes bya'o/ /de la phye na/ mtshan 'dzin gcod pas shes rab dang / /dge rtsa bsdus pas thabs te thabs shes gnyis su dbye ba dang / theg chen gyi lam thams cad phyin drug gis bsdus pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu dbye ba dang / sa bcu po re rer rgyu'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la rim pa bzhin gtso bor spyod pas phar phyin bcu'am sa mtshan nyid pa bcu dang / dad pa'i sa dang / mos pas spyod pa'i sa ste sa phal pa'am btags pa ba tshogs sbyor gnyis rnams su dbye ba dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyin mtshungs de ston legs 'jug dang / /bdag nyid rjes su 'jug rnams kyis/ /snyan par smra dang don spyod dang / /don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang mtshungs pa'i sbyin pa dang /

gzhan la phar phyin drug ston pa'i snyan par smra ba dang / gzhan dag phyin drug nyams su len du 'jug pas don spyod pa dang / rang nyid kyang phyin drug la 'jug pa don mthun pa ste bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhir dbye ba dang / byang sa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'di bzhis ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad bsdus par rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i spyod pa bzhi ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ lus can theg pa chen po dang / /theg pa dman la mos pa dang / /gnyis ka 'dun par bya ba dang / /gdul bya'i phyir na brtan rnams kyi/ /spyod pa bzhi po mdo bzhin du/ /rjes su 'brangs nas bshad pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar te/ theg chen la mos pa rnams kyi phyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa/ theg pa dman la mos pa rnams kyi phyir byang chub phyogs mthun gyi spyod pa/ gnyis ka 'dun par bya ba'i phyir mngon shes kyi spyod pa/ theg pa gsum ga'i gdul bya smin pa'i phyir sems can yongs su smin pa'i spyod pa ste spyod pa bzhir dbye ba dang / slob dpon shān+ti pas mdzad pa'i nyi khri'i 'grel pa dag ldan las/ sems bskyed bsam sbyor lhag bsam dang / /pha rol phyin drug tshad med dag /mngon par shes dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ /byang chub phyogs mthun zhi gnas sogs/ /gzungs sogs chos kyi mdo bshad dang / /bgrod cig thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems bskyed dang / bsam pa/ sbyor ba/ lhag pa'i bsam pa/ phar phyin drug tshad med bzhi/ mngon shes lnga/ bsdu dngos bzhi/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ chos la rton gyi gang zag la mi rton/ don la rton gyi tshig la mi ston/ nges don la rton gyi drang don la mi rton/ ye shes la rton gyi rnam shes la mi ston pa ste rton pa bzhi dang / tshogs gnyis dang / byang phyogs so bdun dang / zhi lhag gnyis dang / gzungs spobs gnyis dang / chos kyi sdom bzhi dang / bgrod pa gcig dang /

thabs la mkhas pa ste brgyad bcu pos theg chen gyi lam thams cad bsdus pas mi zad pa brgyad cur dbye ba dang / mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyi/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes pa ltar/ dpe de dag gis mtshon pa'i don nyer gnyis kyis theg chen gyi lam thams cad bsdus pas sems bskyed nyer gnyis su dbye ba dang / yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu/ /sbyor ba bzhi yis bdag nyid dang / /zhes pa ltar/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ rtse sbyor/ mthar bgyis pa'i sbyor ba/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ste sbyor ba bzhi'am/ go sgrub/ 'jug sgrub/ tshogs sgrub/ nges 'byung sgrub pa ste sgrub pa bzhir dbye ba dang / theg pa thun mong ba dang sgo bstun nas tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam ste slob pa'i lam bzhir dbye ba dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /tha ma gnyis kyi rnam pa gnyis/ /gcig ni gsum car la yang gtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ste bslab pa gsum du dbye ba dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lta bu'i sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / tshul khrims kyi phar phyin lta bu tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po dang / bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi phar phyin lta bu bsgom pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ste bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum du dbye ba dang / byang phyogs so bdun du dbye ba la sogs pa dbye sgo bcu gnyis tsam gsungs shing /

'di dag kyang rnam grangs dang gtso che ba sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba yin gyis/ grangs nges kyi dbye ba ni ma yin te/ mi zad pa brgyad cur dbye ba lta bu mang po'i dbye sgo ni mi dgos shing / bsdu dngos bzhir dbye ba lta bu la mi 'du ba'i skyon yang yod pas so/ /de ltar bsag bya'i tshogs la rnam grangs shin tu mang ba zhig gsungs mod kyang / slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs kyi tshogs thams cad bsdu na pha rol tu phyin pa bcur 'dus/ de dag phar phyin drug tu 'dus/ de dag bslab pa gsum mam/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum du 'dus/ de dag bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis sam thabs dang shes rab gnyis su 'dus/ de yang stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin du 'dus pa yin la/ des na nyams su len pa'i tshe thabs shes zung 'jug gam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su len dgos shing / de ltar blangs pas 'thob bya sku gnyis zung 'jug thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ rin chen phreng bar/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs sku ni/ /bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs pa ste/ /chos kyi sku ni mdor bsdu na/ /rgyal po ye shes tshogs las 'khrungs/ /zhes dang / rigs pa drug cu pa las/ bsod nams ye shes las byung pa'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /ces gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa ji tsam gsog pa'i dus ni/ seng ge bzang po'i brgyad stong 'grel chen dang / dbyig gnyen gyi mdzod rang 'grel gnyis mthun par/ grangs med gsum zhes pa drang don yin gyi/ nges don du grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bar du tshogs bsog dgos par gsungs shing / de yang tshogs lam la gcig sbyor lam la gnyis/ sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams rdzogs nas kun tu 'od sangs rgyas kyi sa bsgrub par bzhed de/ slob dpon dul ba'i lhas sde pa tha dad bklags par grangs med bcur bshad/

'phags pa rgya chen rol par/ bskal pa grangs med bdun du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par sgrub pa zhes grangs med bdun du bshad la/ dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i dbang gis grangs med gsum gyi nges pa med ces grangs med gsum las nyung bas chog pa dang / grangs med mtha' yas pa dgos pa yang yod par bzhed pa sogs lugs srol shin tu mang na yang / mkhas pa mang pos bzhed cing thams cad la grags che ba dang / byams pa mgon pos/ sa ni dang po yin par 'dod/ /'di de bskal pa dpag med kyi/ /zhes pa dang / grangs med gsum ni rdzogs pa yi/ sgom pa'i lam ni mthar phyin to/ /zhes mthong lam la gcig sgom lam ma dag sa bdun la gcig dag pa sa gsum la gcig ste grangs med gsum gyi bar du tshogs bsags pa 'di nyid gtso bor gzung bar bya'o/ /de ltar grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa las 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs pa'i grangs med ni/ mdzod rang 'grel dang / thub pa dgongs rgyan sogs las grangs kyis bgrang du med pa'i grangs med ma yin par/ grangs kyi gnas gzhan drug cur phyin pa'i grangs med la bshad pa ltar 'thad pa yin zhing / de gang zhe na/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang / /sa ya bye ba dung phyur rnams/ /rkyang pa yin pa shes par bya/ /ther 'bum phrag khrig rab bkrams dang / /gtam dkrigs mi 'khrug khyad phyin dang / /spang rten ded 'dren mtha' snang dang / /rgyu rig 'od mdzes dbang po dang / /legs phyin rtogs 'gro 'bying rdul dang / /brgya rtags stobs 'khor brda shes dang / /rnam 'byung stobs mig nyal nyul dang / /wal wol khyad khyud phyan phyin rnams/ /chen por byas te bgrang bar bya/ /grangs med pa ni tha ma yin/ /gnas gzhan drug cu par ni grags pa ltar/ gcig nas dung phyur gyi bar rkyang par bgrangs/

de nas ther 'bum ther 'bum chen po nas/ phyan phyin phyan phyin chen po'i bar bgrangs pas lnga bcu nga dgu/ de nas grangs med pa bsnan pas drug cur bgrangs pa'i grangs med ces pa de yin la/ drangs ma thag pa'i grangs kyi sdom de mdzod 'grel las 'byung yang / grangs med kyi gong gi nyal nyul nyal nyul chen po sogs brgyad ni mdzod 'grel nyid du mi gsal ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrīs gsil bu'i mdo nas kha bskangs pa yin par bshad do/ /'o na de lta bu'i grangs med kyi mgo gang nas 'dzin pa yin snyam na/ dang po byang chub tu sems bskyed ma thag pa nas mgo brtsams pa ma yin te/ dkon mchog sprin las/ nam byang chub sems dpa' chos mnyam pa nyid du zhugs par gyur pa de'i tshe nas brtsams te bskal pa rnams bgrang bar bya yi/ thog ma'i sems nas brtsams te ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na theg bsdus las/ bzang dang smon pa'i stobs can dang / /sems brtan khyad par 'gro ba yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med gsum/ /kun tu rtsom par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par gsungs pa ltar bzang ni dge ba dang / smon pa ni smon lam/ de gnyis kyi stobs can te dge ba'i stobs dang ldan pas dge ba'i mi mthun phyogs zil gyi gnon nus pa/ smon lam gyi stobs can yin pas rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa/ mi dge ba'i grogs pos mos pa bzlogs kyang byang chub kyi sems mi gtong bas sems brtan pa/ khyad par 'gro ba ste mthong chos tshe 'di nas/ ma mthong ba tshe rabs phyi ma la dge ba'i chos 'phel zhing mi nyams par yon tan cung zad tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin pa ste/ mdor na tshogs lam du dge ba'i stobs can dang / smon lam gyi stobs can dang / rkyen dbang gis byang sems mi gtong ba'i sems brtan pa dang / yon tan cung zad tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin pa ste/ yon tan bzhi po de dag dang nam ldan pa nas grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog pa'i mgo brtsams pa yin no/

/gsum pa ji ltar gsog pa'i tshul ni/ grags med dang po ni/ ston pa 'di rgyal po'i pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan du rgyal po tshe rnam par rgyal ba'i sras gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod ces bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro'i phung po chen po 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur cing dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa nas brtsams te/ bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa dang po thob par gyur to/ /grangs med gnyis pa ni/ de nas grong khyer 'jam bu chu bo'i gser du ston pa 'di rgyal po mdzes par snang ba'i gnang chen po tshong dpon shes rab bzang por gyur pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag 'jig rten du byon pa la bsnyen bkur cing rjes su bstan pa nos pa nas bzung ste/ grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bdun pa non par gyur to/ /de nas grangs med gsum pa ni/ ston pa 'di bram ze'i khye'u gzhon nu sprin du gyur pa na/ bram ze rin po che la rig byed bslabs nas/ de la bsnyen bkur gyi rgyu btsal ba'i phyir yul dbus kyi grong khyer dag tu ljongs rgyur song ste/ mthar gyis rgyal po dgra 'dul gyi pho brang pad+mo can zhes bya ba'i tshong 'dus kyi dbus su phyin te/ de'i tshe bram ze mar me'i bdag po'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad 'jig rten du byon pa la/ lha rnams kyis me tog dang sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bcas pas mchod pa mthong nas/ khyed ci zhig byed dris pas/ khyed kyis mi shes sam 'di na sangs rgyas mar me mdzad bzhugs zer ba na/ bram ze de skyi bung byed cing sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni rnyed par dka' bas/ bdag gi slob dpon gyi yon phyis btsal bar byas la/ kar sha pa ni lnga brgya po 'di sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i rgyu bya'o snyam du dgongs nas byon pas bram ze'i bu mo bzang lan ldan ma me tog ut+pal bdun khyer nas 'ongs pa dang 'phrad de/

bram ze'i khye'u des bu mo me tog 'di dag nga la tshongs zhig sangs rgyas la mchod pa bya'o gsungs pas/ des gal te khyed skye ba thams cad du bdag gi khyim thab tu dam 'cha' na sbyin no zer ba la/ khye'us bu mo khyod de skad ma zer/ khyed ni g.yeng zhing rgod la/ kho bo sangs rgyas kyi chos dka' ba dpag tu med pa sgrub pa'i bar chad ma byed cig gsungs pas/ des gal te khyed kyi lus kyi sha yungs 'bru tsam du bcad de ster yang sbyin pa'i bar chad mi byed do zer bas/ 'o na de ltar bya'o gsungs te/ bram ze'i bu mo bzang lan ldan mas me tog btsongs pa'i drin lan du skye ba thams cad du khyim thab du khas blangs shing / ut+pal lnga nyos nas sangs rgyas la gtor te/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa btings nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen par mdzod la/ ri dwags kyi pags pa 'di la zhabs bzhag par mdzod cig ces bskul ba na/ sangs rgyas der byon pas dges par byas te/ ral pa gser gyi mdog can gdan du bting nas/ mar me mdzad kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan 'di la zhabs mi 'jog gam/ lung mi ston na/ 'di nyid du lus 'gum par bya'o zhes yid dam brtan por bcas pa dang / ston pas zhabs bzhag ste/ dge slong dag khyed kyis khye'u 'di'i skra la rdog pa ma 'jog cig de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mchod gnas yin te/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su shākya thub pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa dang / bram ze'i khye'u de dga' ches te shing ta la bdun srid du nam mkha' la 'phags te/ ting nge 'dzin brgya stong yang mngon du byas sa brgyad pa thob pa yin te/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad la ut+pal lnga/ /gtor te ral pa gdan du bting byas pas/ /mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob gyur nas/ /shākya'i rgyal por 'gyur zhes nga lung bstan/ /ces dang lung las kyang /

gang tshe mar me mdzad kyis nga / /lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe/ /sa brgyad pa ni thob gyur te/ /dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de nas bzung ste brgya byin mig bzang la sogs pa'i skye ba mang du bzhes nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i mthar/ bskal pa 'di'i tshe lo nyi khri pa la grong khyer nyer ldan du sangs rgyas 'od srung byon pa'i tshe/ bram ze'i khye'u bla mar gyur pa'i bar la bskal pa grangs med gcig tu tshogs bsags pas sa bcu rdzogs/ de ltar grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'i gnas skabs dag tu sangs rgyas bye ba dur ma bsnyen bkur cing chos gsan pa yin te/ zla ba sgron mar/ sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba khrag khrig dang / /de las lhag pa'i gaṅgā'i bye snyed/ /kun kyang bya rgod phung 'dir bzhugs te/ /mi dbang de kun nga yis bkur bsti byas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gsum pa mthar sangs rgyas pa'i tshul la/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin bshad pa/ nges don du sangs rgyas pa'i tshul/ drang don du mdzad pa rnams mdzad pa'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin la/ rten sku/ brten pa ye shes/ mdzad pa 'phrin las dang gsum du bshad pa dang / sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las lngar 'chad pa dang / spangs rtogs 'phrin las gsum du 'chad pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa gnyis sam gsum du 'chad pa la sogs pa bshad tshul ches mang ba zhig yod na yang / sku gsum mam bzhi dang / ye shes lnga po rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan nam rang bzhin thams cad bsdus par bshad pa yin zhing / de'i dang po sku la yang chos sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku/ mdzad pa 'phrin las dang bzhir yod de/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ngo bo nyid longs rdzogs bcas dang / /de bzhin gzhan pa sprul pa ni/ /chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod/ /ces gsungs pas so/

/yang bsdu na sku dang po gsum po der nges pa yin te/ sku gsum dag gis sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku bsdus par ni shes par bya/ /sku gsum dag gi rang gzhan gyi/ /don ni rten dang bcas par bstan/ /ces longs sku rang don dang / sprul sku gzhan don/ de gnyis ka'i rten chos kyi sku dang gsum du nges pas so/ /'o na ci'i phyir chos sku dang / longs sku dang / sprul sku zhes bya zhe na/ zag med kyi chos bsags pas chos sku'am/ yang na bden gnyis las/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir/ /yon tan bsam yas kun rten phyir/ /rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs ngo bo'i phyir/ /skyobs pa rnams ni chos sku yin/ /zhes pa ltar chos thams cad la gdod ma nas khyab pa dang / yon tan bsam yas kyi rten byed pa dang / ngo bo nyid du grub pas chos sku zhes bya la/ theg pa chen po'i chos la yongs su rdzogs par longs spyod pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya ste/ sna tshogs chos la rdzogs longs spyod/ /ces pa dang / 'di de chos rdzogs longs spyod pas/ /zhes dang / chos la rdzogs longs spyod ston phyir/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /nges par 'gyur ba'am rgyun mi brtan pa'am nges par gzhan du sprul zhing bsgyur bas sprul sku ste/ dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis/ /sems can don kun sgrub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brten pa'i ye shes ni lnga ste/ sangs rgyas pa'i mdo las/ chos lngas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams bsdus te/ lnga gang zhes na/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang / bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes dang / zhes pa ltar ro/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ni dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag pa glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral zhing / rnam par mi rtog bzhin du mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don 'bad med 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi sku ste/

sku gsum grub pa las/ dri med de bzhin nyid dang ni/ /mi rtog ye shes ma gtogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos gzhan ni/ /'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid zag med kyi yon tan dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du gyur pa'i cha nas ngo bo nyid sku ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /zhes sogs sa 'di nyid 'og min chen por rgyal sras 'phags pa rnams la mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i skur bstan nas theg pa chen po'i chos la rgyun mi 'chad par longs spyod pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad bcu'i bdag nyid 'di/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de nyid gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i bsam pa dang mthun par rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa ni sprul pa'i sku ste/ gang gi srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i chos sku de la dbye na chos can dang chos nyid kyi chos sku'am/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos sku gnyis sam ngo bo nyid sku dang / rtogs pa ye shes chos sku gnyis su yod de/ gser 'od dam pa las/ de kho na nyid dang yang dag pa'i ye shes nyid tsam du gnas pa de ni chos kyi sku zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /longs sku la sa bcu pa yan chad thob pa kho na'i yul gyi longs sku dang / sa thob pa thams cad kyi yul du gyur pa'i longs sku gnyis su yod mod kyang / dang po mtshan nyid pa dang / phyi ma btags pa bar dbu ma pa chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis bshad pa ltar don la gnas so/

/sprul sku ni/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pa/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ mchog gi sprul sku ni/ theg pa chen po'i sbyor lam drod yan chad nas nam 'dod du mthong zhing / tshogs lam chen po nas kyang phal cher mthong zhes bu ston gyis bshad la/ skye ba sprul sku sogs ni gang la gang 'dul la snang ste/ gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur pa/ /de dang de la de snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa nges don du sangs rgyas pa'i tshul ni/ de lta bu'i sku gsum mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas rnams thog mar nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgya ba yin zhing / sangs rgya ba'i rgyu ni/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ yan lag bdun ldan las/ tshogs gnyis dag ni rdzogs pa las/ /byang chub rgyu gzhan yod ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /sangs rgyas pa'i dus ni bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas nas/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan cing / slar yang ston par 'gyur ba ste/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ sems can rnams la thugs brtse zhing / /sems can yongs la smin mdzad phyir/ /dpa' bo chen po rnam par 'phrul/ /bye ba brgyad bcur rgyal ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung chog pa'i 'du shes bsal/ /zhes dang / da dung dang por thugs bskyed par/ /de dang der ni yongs bstan te/ /da dung yang ni 'dren pa khyod/ /sangs rgyas mang po ston par mdzad/ /ces so/ /sangs rgyas pa'i gnas ni/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rten la don dam chos sku mngon du mdzad cing / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rnams su sprul pa'i skus cig car byang chub pa la sogs pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa ste/

ngag dbang grags pas/ dpal ldan stug po bkod pa nyid du don dam thugs chud cing / /dga' ldan skye bo'i phyir ni dam pa tog dkar gyur/ /de nas 'dir ni 'gro ba'i don du shākya'i tog gyur gang / /'chi bdag las rgyal sgyu ma kun ston de ni rgyal gyur cig /ces so/ /tshul ji ltar du sangs rgyas pa yin zhe na/ sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma shin tu phra ba rnams kyang slar mi ldog pa'i tshul du sbyangs pas spangs pa mthar phyin pa dang / shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i don ma lus pa mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes pas rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i byang chub chen po thob pa ste/ dper na rin chen rang bzhin dag pa snod kyi sgrib byed bsal nas mngon sum du gyur pa lta bu ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dka' spyod dpag med brgya phrag dang / /dpag med dge ba bsags pa dang / /dpag tu med pa'i dus dang ni/ /dpag med sgrib pa zad pa'i phyir/ /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid thob/ /rin chen snod ni phye ba ltar/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni yang dag bsten/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar nges don du sangs rgyas thams cad chos kyi sku ro gcig cing / drang don du gzugs kyi sku sngon gyi smon lam gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas rnams gcig kyang ma yin la/ mang po'ang ma yin zhing / gcig dang tha dad gang du'ang ma grub ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ zag med dbyings las sangs rgyas rnams/ /mkha' ltar lus ni med phyir dang / /sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang ba'i phyir/ /gcig min mang po nyid ma yin/ /zhes pa dang / tha dad rigs don med phyir dang / /rdzogs dang thog ma med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gcig min dri med gnas/ /tha dad min phyir mang po'ang min/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar sangs rgyas rnams thog mar 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su sangs rgyas par bshad pa'i 'og min de/

kha cig langs kar gshegs pa las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs med du/ /sangs rgyas rnam par 'tshang mi rgya/ /gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes dang / slob dpon ka ma la shi las/ 'og min zhes bya ba ni lha dag ste/ de dag gi phyogs gcig na gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha rnams yod de/ der 'phags pa nyid 'ba' zhig gnas so/ /de'i steng na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba yod de/ der sa bcu la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma kho na skye ba bzhes pa yin la/ 'dir ni de lta bu'i sprul pa dmigs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ ston pa 'di longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas pa'i gnas kyi 'og min ni/ gzugs khams kyi 'og min 'di'i steng na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba'i gnas shig yod pa de yin no/ /zhes 'dod/ de la slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i rgyud sde spyi rnam las/ de ni ma yin te/ de ltar bshad pa'i gzhung yang ma mthong la/ de'i steng na gnas gzhan yod kyang / sa bcu pa rnams kyi gnas su bshad kyi/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bzhugs gnas su ma bshad do/ /des na de dag 'jig rten gyi khams chung ngu yin no/ /yang de dag 'jig pa la brten pas 'jig rten gyi khams zhes pa mi rtag pa yin la/ stug po bkod pa ni mi 'jig ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ 'og min stug po nyams dga' 'dir/ /stug po'i zhing khams 'jig med pa/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /rdzogs par longs spyod tshul 'di 'byung / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes bshad cing / rang gi bzhed pa 'god pa na/ 'o na gang yin zhe na/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las 'byung ba ste/ de'ang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nang du chud pa ni/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa zhes bya ba yin no/

/de lta bu du ma nang du chud pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho zhes bya ba yin la/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ye shes gangs can mtsho'i phyag gi mthil na gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das de byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas te gang na bzhugs pa'i gnas de ni/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i gnas yin la/ de'i nang na gnas pa'i dum bu thams cad ni sprul pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gnas yin te/ de yang blo gros kyi rim pas/ kha cig la ni 'jam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas par snang la/ kha cig la gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min du sangs rgyas nas mdzad pa mdzad par snang la/ byang chub sems dpa' kha cig la ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar sangs rgyas par mngon no/ /kha cig la ni gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa mtha' dag gi sangs rgyas gcig tu bstan te/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud dang / 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa chen po las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten gyi khams gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di thams cad 'od kyis khyab par mdzad de zhes bya ba la sogs pa lta bu ste/ de bas na blo gros rgya che chung gi dbye bas sna tshogs su snang ba ni sprul pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gnas gtsang ma'i gzugs khams ni longs sku'i zhing 'og min du mdo sngags gang gi lugs la yang mi 'thad de/ langs gshegs las gtsang ma'i rigs dag spangs pa yis/ /'og min zhes bya nyams dga' 'di/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon kun snying gi de nyid 'dus pa'i gleng gzhir/ bcom ldan 'das 'og min gyi lha'i rgyal po'i gnas na bzhugs te/

zhes pa'i 'grel par/ 'og min gyi lha zhes pa ni thog ma'i lha ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sras kyi thu bo ste sa bcu pa'i byang chub sems dpa'o/ /de'i gnas ni thog mar sangs rgyas pa'i gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang stug po bkod pa'i zhing ni mi 'jig par rdo rje rtse mo'i lung gong du drangs pa des legs par grub cing gzugs khams kyi 'og min ni 'jig par bshad de/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ bzhi pa na med mi g.yo phyir/ /zhes bsam gtan bzhi pa'i gnas brgyad po de mi g.yo bar bshad pa'i dogs spong du/ mi rtag de yi gzhal yas khang / /sems can bcas pa 'byung 'jig phyir/ /zhes bsam gtan gsum pa man chad ltar/ me chu rlung gsum gyis mi 'jig kyang / mthar 'jig par bshad pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /'dod chags bral khyod sangs rgya'o/ /zhes pa dang / gong gi ka ma la shi la'i lung de'i don gang zhe na/ rgyud sde spyi rnam las gsungs pa ltar/ de dag ni sprul sku'i gnas la dgongs pa yin te/ spyir sprul sku'i gnas de la gdul bya rnams kyi blo gros kyi rim pas/ 'jam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas par snang ba dang / gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min du sangs rgyas par snang ba dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas par snang ba dang / gzhi dang snying po'i me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sangs rgyas gcig tu gyur par bstan pa sogs gdul bya la snang tshul mang du yod pa las/ byang sems kha cig la gzugs khams kyi 'og min du sprul pa'i sku de nyid sangs rgyas par snang ba la dgongs nas/ gzugs kyi khams kyi 'og min du/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa yin par bshad do/ /gsum pa drang don du mdzad pa rnams mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'og min du/

/sangs rgyas ma gyur 'dod khams su/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mi mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar 'og min du sangs rgyas nas/ gzod 'dod pa'i khams su mdzad pa rnams ston par bshad pa yin zhing / de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la spyir bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / grangs la dga' ba'i gdul bya rnams rjes su gzung ba dang / gtso bo'i mdzad pa nye bar bzung nas/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ 'di rnams sgrol ba'i slad du sras dang rgyal ba'i bdag po las kyi sar ni rab bzhugs te/ /mngal ni rab tu bzung bar mdzad cing mchog gi thugs rje dag gi byang chub bskyed par mdzad nas ni/ /nyon mongs dang ni bdud rnams bcom nas sa yi steng du chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor te/ /sprul pa sgyu ma mdzad nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das ni dag pa'i sku can de nyid kho na'o/ /zhes mdzad pa drug tsam gsungs shing / rdo rje gur las/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /rigs dang byang chub byed pa dang / /de bzhin du ni lhar gshegs dang / /khyim nas byung bar byed pa dang / /rab tu byung ba 'dzin pa dang / /skye ba yongs su len pa dang / /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa ston/ /zhes mdzad pa brgyad du gsungs la/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla mar/ skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde gzhom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes pa dang / pad+ma'i ngang tshul gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'am mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa bsam la bying ba gsal bar bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / gzhan yang 'phags pa klu sgrub/ chos kyi bshes gnyen sogs pa mang po dgongs pa mthun par mdzad pa bcu gnyis su gsungs pa yin no/

/'o na mdzad pa bcu gnyis po sangs rgyas dang byang sems gang gi mdzad pa yin snyam na/ nyan thos pa rnams ni rgyal bu don grub yan chad du so so skye bo rang rgyud pa zhig gis bskal pa grangs med gsum du thar pa cha mthun gyis dge ba bsags nas mthar rdo rje'i gdan du srod la bdud btul/ gung la bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas sbyor lam yan chad rgyud la bskyed de/ tho rangs skya rengs 'char ga'i skad cig cig yan chad la phar phyin drug rdzogs nas mngon par byang chub par 'dod de/ mdzod las/ ston dang bse ru byang chub par/ /bsam gtan mthar rten gcig la kun/ /de yi sngon du thar cha mthun/ /zhes dang / de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar sangs rgyas nas chos dang gzugs kyi sku'i bdag nyid can du gyur nas/ kun shes nas rab bzang gi bar la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te lhag med du mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa gnyis su mdzad kyang / 'dir ni theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs ltar bcu gnyis po thams cad sangs rgyas kho na'i mdzad pa yin te/ thub pa'i dbang po 'di bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog ces bya bar sangs rgyas zin kyang / da dung yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung nas de dag gi mdzad pa rnams mdzad par yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang mdo de nyid las/ bye ba brgyad bcu sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang / /da dung chog pa'i 'du shes bsal/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing / dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las kyang / bskal pa bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /de yi tshad ni nam yang med pa nas/ /byang chub mchog rab 'di ni ngas thob bo/ /nga ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i mdzad pa de dag theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma nas ji skad gsungs pa dang mthun par bshad na/

gong du bstan pa ltar/ bram ze'i khye'u bla ma de tshe 'phos nas lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar po zhes bya bar gyur te/ lha rnams la chos bstan pas lha'i tshogs mang po smin grol la bkad do/ /de'i tshe 'jam bu gling pa rnams 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa na/ nyid kyi bsod nams kyi mthu dang sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis rol mo'i sgra las/ bsod nams rgya chen tshogs mang dran rtogs dang / /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med stobs mnga' sgyu rtsal rgya che ba/ /mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /skyes mchog khyod kyi bsod nams dpal gyis ni/ /dga' ldan pho brang shin tu mdzes mod kyi/ /'on kyang thugs rje'i thugs dang ldan pas na/ /'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan du ni char pa phob/ /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad byung bas yang nas yang du bskul lo/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu rnams bram ze'i cha byad du sprul nas 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams rig byed slob tu bcug ste/ 'di ltar mtshan dpe dang ldan na 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal lam sangs rgyas su 'gyur zhes 'don du bcug cing / yang da de lo bcu gnyis na byang chub sems dpa' lhums su 'jug go zhes bsgrags pas/ de rang rgyal rnams kyi thos pas/ rgyal po'i khab kyi mjug ma bsgyur ba'i ri la gnas pa'i rang rgyal glang po zhes pas rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag ste 'das so/ /gzhan yang wa ra na ser rang rgyal lnga brgyas me'i khams la zhugs te 'das nas ring bsrel rnams sa la lhung bas yul de la drang srong lhung bar grags/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs par dgongs nas gzigs pa lnga la gzigs te/ dus tshe lo brgya pa/ gling 'dzam bu gling / yul dbus/ rigs rgyal rigs/ bud med yon tan dang ldan pa ste/ de lta bu 'dzoms pa'i dus su lha rnams la 'chi 'pho sbyong bar byed pa'i chos bstan cing / gang gi tshe na dga' ldan gnas mchog nas/

/'dren pa skyes bu seng ge 'chi 'pho'i tshe/ /lha rnams dag la tshig tu smras pa ni/ /grogs dag bag med spyod pa spang bar gyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs te rin po che'i cod paṇa ma pham pa'i dbu la bcings nas/ grogs po dag khyed rnams la ma pham pas chos ston gyis/ kho bo ni sems can gyi don du 'dzam bu gling du 'gro'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lha rnams yid ma dga' nas/ skyes bu dam pa khyed ni ma bzhugs na/ /dga' ldan gnas ni mdzes par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'dzam bu gling de ni deng sang 'od srung rdzogs byed la sogs pa rtog ge drug dang / bram ze rgyu rgyal la sogs pa rjes su sgrog pa drug dang / rang byed kyi bu lhag spyod la sogs pa snyoms par 'jug pa drug ste/ ston pa drug gsum bco brgyad kyis ma rung par byas pas gshegs pa'i skabs ma lags so/ /zhes gsol pas/ de dag nga nyid kyis zil gyis gnon nus te/ seng ge gcig gis gcan gzan tshogs rnams du ma rnam par skrag /rdo rje gcig gi brag gis rtse mo du ma rnam par 'jig /brgya byin gcig gis lha ma yin dbang du ma rnam par 'joms/ /nyi ma gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams du ma rnam par sel/ /zhes gsungs shing / kho bo ji lta bu'i gzugs kyis 'gro bar rigs gsungs pas/ la las tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis rigs zer/ 'ga' zhig brgya byin la sogs pa'i rnam pas rigs zer yang / lha'i bu gzi brjid dam pa na re/ rig byed nas 'byung ba bzhin glang po che'i gzugs kyis 'gro bar rigs zer ba ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'byon par chas pa na/ rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i khab tu/ khang pa dga' dang bya mang byung / /shing bu me tog kha bye dang / /longs spyod 'phel zhing sgra rang 'khrol/ /gter mang kha bye 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyi ltas bzang po brgyad byung / de nas dpyid zla tha chung skar ma sa ga la babs pa tshes bco lnga'i rgyal nam gyi gung la dar ba'i dus su yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i tshe glo g.yas pa nas glang po che'i rnam pas lhums su zhugs te/

de'i tshe yum gyi rmi ltas su/ gser gyi dra bas legs g.yogs spyi gtsug dmar/ /thal dkar mche ba drug dang rab ldan zhing / /dung dang kha ba dngul mdog lta bu yi/ /glang po'i mchog gcig khong du song snyam byed/ /de zhugs nas ni bdag gi lus dang sems/ /sngon chad mthong thos myong bar ma gyur pa'i/ /gya nom bde bas shin tu bder gyur te/ /bsam gtan mnyam par bzhag pa bzhin du gyur/ /ces pa ltar byung ste/ rmi lam de rgyal po la smras pas/ rgyal pos kyang bram ze rnams la dris pa na/ sras khyad par can zhig 'byung ste/ khab tu bzhugs pa na 'khor lo bsgyur ba dang / rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan to/ /de nas yum gyi lhums rgyal sras kyis nye bar spyad pa rin po che'i bkod pa zhes bya bar byin gyis brlabs nas phyi nang thams cad phan tshun gsal ba la bzhugs te/ de yang sum cu rtsa gsum pa la sogs pa'i lha dang mi'i skye dgu bye ba khrag khrig sum cu rtsa drug smin par mdzad nas/ zla ba bcur zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod cing bzhugs/ de nas zla ba bcu rdzogs pa na me tog kha 'bus pa la sogs pa ltas sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ba dang / yum lum+bi ni'i tshal du byon nas shing pa la sha'i sdong po la phyag gis 'jus te/ glo g.yas pa nas mngal gyi dri mas ma gos shing yum la gnod pa med par rgyan dang na bza' dang bcas te sku bltams pa na/ lhas me tog gtor/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis ka shi ka'i ras kyis blangs/ dga' bo dang nyer dga' gnyis kyis sku khrus gsol ba na/ ko'u shi ka nga thongs gsungs/ shar phyogs su gom pa bdun gshegs te/ dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro bar bya'o gsungs/ de bzhin du lhor lha dang mi'i sbyin gnas su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /nub tu/ 'di ni nga'i skye ba tha ma ste/ skye rgas na 'chi med par bya'o/ /byang du/ sems can gyi nang na bla na med par bya'o/

/'og tu/ sems can dmyal ba'i me bsad pa dang bdud gzhom par bya'o/ /steng du gshegs te/ sems can thams cad gyen du lta bar 'gyur bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyogs drug po der gom pa bdun bdun gshegs pa'i shul thams cad du pad+ma re re byung zhing / de'i tshe bkra shis pa'i ltas/ phyogs thams cad 'od kyis khyab pa dang / yul chen po bzhi'i rgyal po bzhi la sras bzhi yang btsas/ ya rab kyi rigs lnga brgya/ grags 'dzin ma la sogs pa brgyad brgya/ 'dun pa la sogs bran lnga brgya/ mngal ldan la sogs pa'i rte'u khri dang / rte'u mo khri/ ba glang khri yang btsas/ gling gi dbus su byang chub shing skyes/ skyed tshal lnga brgya dang / gter kha lnga brgya yang byung bas/ rgyal bu'i ming don thams cad grub par btags/ 'od de byung pas rgyal po bzhi'i bu'i ming yang 'od la gras nas btags te/ rgyal po'i khab kyi rgyal po pad+ma chen po'i bu gzugs can snying po/ mnyan yod kyi rgyal po tshangs byin gyi bu gsal rgyal/ ko'u sham+ba'i rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i bu shar ba pa/ 'phags rgyal gyi rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu rab snang zhes btags so/ /gzhan yang 'od de ri bo kun 'dzin na drang srong nyon mongs med bya ba tsha bo mes byin dang bcas yod pas mthong ste/ tsha bos mkhan po/ 'dir ni nyi ma thams cad dag /cig car 'byung par 'gyur ram ci/ /'di ltar ri dang phug bcas pa/ /'od gcig gis ni gsal bar gyur/ /ces smras pa dang / drang srong gis/ nyi ma'i 'od tsha 'od 'di bsil/ /kun tu 'jug pas thub chen 'od/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'od po che/ /lhums nas byung bar gdon mi za/ /zhes smras pa na/ tsha bos/ 'o na de lta ba'i phyir 'gro 'o zer ba la/ drang srong gis de da lta lha thu bo che dag gis bskor bas lta dka'/ phyis grong khyer du gshegs te ming 'dogs pa'i tshe lta'o smras so/ /de nas bram ze mtshan mkhan la bstan pas/

khyim du bzhugs na 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dang / rab tu byung na sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ rigs kyi lha mchod pa'i sar byon pas/ shākya rnams kyi lha gnod sbyin shākya 'phel bya bas/ gzhon nu'i zhabs la phyag byas pas/ lha'i lha zhes dang / shākya mu cor smra ba rnams thub pa bzhin du 'dug pas shākya thub pa zhes kyang btags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'khrungs nas zhag bdun 'das pa na yum 'das te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su skyes so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan na bzhugs pa'i dus su yum gyi tshe tshad brtags nas gshegs pas sras mngon par 'byung ba gzigs na yum snying 'gas par 'gyur bas/ yum gyi tshe tshad mthar phyin par bya ba'i ched du yin no/ /de nas gzhon nu skye dgu'i bdag mo la gtad de/ pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma brgyad la sogs pas bskyed bsrings so/ /de nas sngar gyi drang srong de tsha bo dang bcas pas byang chub sems dpa' blta bar sems te rdzu 'phrul gyis chas pa na/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthus rdzu 'phrul nyams te rkang pas phyin nas/ grong khyer ser skya'i sgor song ste 'phrin springs pa na/ rgyal pos don ci la 'ongs gsungs pa dang / drang srong na re/ rgyal chen bdag ni 'dir 'ongs pa/ /khyod kyi sras nyid blta phyir te/ /'jig rten 'dul ba gtso bo yi/ /thub pa de ni blta bar 'dod/ /zer ba la/ rgyal pos/ de ltar na gzhon nu nyal gyi/ ma sad kyi bar du sdod cig gsungs pas/ mnal ba nyid blta'o zer/ bltar bcug pas/ mig mi 'dzum par lta ba mthong nas/ rigs dang ldan pa'i rta rnams ni/ /mtshan mo'i bzhi cha nyal ba ltar/ /dgos pa don gnyer rnams kyi gnyid/ /mig la yun ring mi gnas so/ /zer zhing / lha bram ze la bstan nam zer/ bstan gsungs pas/ ji skad lung bstan zer/ 'di ni gnyis su 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ /khyim du gnas na 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal lam/

/khyim nas khyim med rab tu byung gyur na/ /'dren pa gzhan gyi drings la mi 'jog par/ /'jig rten 'dir ni mngon rdzogs rgyal bar 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan gsungs pas/ drang srong des legs par brtags nas/ sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo 'khrul te/ /rtsod pa'i dus na 'khor lo bsgyur mi 'byung / /bsod nams mchog gi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni/ /nyes las rnam par rgyal nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /mi gsal mtshan dang ldan na mi'i dbang po/ /gling bzhi rnams kyi bdag po'i dbang phyug 'gyur/ /shin tu mtshan gsal thub dbang rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'di ni mi mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas yar skyes te shākya'i khye'u stong phrag bcu dang lhan cig tu byis pa kun gyi bshes gnyen gyi drung du yi ge slob pa'i grwar byon te/ kye slob dpon tshangs pa'i yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi las/ bdag gang la bslab ces gsungs pas/ slob dpon ngo mtshar skyes te/ sems can dag pa ngo mtshar skyes/ /bstan bcos kun la bslabs gyur kyang / /'jig rten 'jig rten rjes bsnyegs phyir/ /yi ge'i grwar ni byon par gyur/ /yi ge gang gi ming dag kyang / /bdag gis shes par ma gyur pa/ /de la 'di ni byang gyur kyang / /yi ge slob pa'i grwar byon to/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas yi ge'i ma mo la slob pa ltar mdzad pas/ a zhes brjod pa na 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o zhes pa dang / ā ring po brjod pa'i tshe chos thams cad bdag med pa'o/ /zhes pa'i sgra byung zhing / lha klu dri za la sogs pa'i yig rigs thams cad mngon du gyur pa'i tshul mdzad/ rtsis pa shākya srid sgrub kyi drung du/ rtsis dang / 'phong dang / gyad kyi 'dzings stangs la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i bslab par bya ba thams cad kyang slob pa ltar mdzad do/ /de nas shākya rgan rabs dag 'dus te/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gdung mi bcad pa'i phyir/

khab mdzad par zhus pas/ byang chub sems dpas/ 'dod pa'i skyon ni bdag gis mtha' yas rig /'thab mo 'khon bcas mya ngan sdug bsngal rtsa/ /'dzin byed dug gi lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /me dang 'dra zhing ral gri'i so dang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bdag 'dod ma yin te/ /bdag ni bud med tshogs dang mdzes ma yin/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde bas zhi sems su/ /bdag ni mi smra nags tshal gnas par bya/ /zhes gsungs te ma gnang / phyis brtags nas/ 'dam dang ljan ljin khrod na pad+mo rnam par 'phel/ /mi rnams gang gi nang na rgyal po'i mchod pa thob/ /gang tshe byang chub sems dpa' 'khor mchog thob gyur pa/ /de tshe sems can bye ba khrag khrig 'chi med 'dul/ /sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' mkhas par gang gyur pa/ /de dag kun gyis btsun mo sras dang slas kyang bsten/ /'on kyang 'dod pas chags med bsam gtan bde ma nyams/ /bdag kyang de dag yon tan rjes su bslab par bya/ /zhes gsungs te gnang ba na/ rgyal pos bud med ci lta bu zhig blang gsungs pas/ gzhon nus bud med kyi yon tan yi ger bris/ yon tan sum cu rtsa gnyis po 'di dag dang ldan par bsngags so/ /rgyal pos 'dun na 'don la/ khyod song la gang na yon tan 'di dang ldan pa'i bud med tshol cig gsungs/ rgyal rigs bram ze'i bu mo dang / /rje'u rigs dmangs rigs de bzhin te/ /su la yon tan 'di yod pa'i/ /bu mo de ni 'dir 'on cig /nga yi bu 'di rigs dag dang / /rus la ngo mtshar 'dzin ma yin/ /yon tan bden pa chos kyi rnams/ /de la 'di ni yid dga'o/ /zhes smras pa dang / 'dun na 'don des yul kun tu song bas/ shākya lag na be con gyi bu mo sa mtsho ma mthong nas yi ge de byin pas/ bu mo de bzhin 'dzum ste/ bram ze/ yon tan 'di dag bdag la kun tshang gi /des pa'i gzugs can de ni bdag gi khyim thab bo/ /gal te gzhon nu bzhed na phyi bshol ma mdzad gsungs/

/brgya la skye bo phal dang bzhugs par gyur kyang gda'/ /zhes zer ba de bram zes rgyal po la gsol pas/ bud med 'di rdzun che bas rgyal po yid ma ches par/ zhag bdun na bu mo thams cad 'dun khang du shog cig gzhon nus yid du 'ong ba'i yo byad dag sbyin no/ /zhes smras pas/ bu mo dag byung ba na ji ltar 'ongs ba bzhin yo byad dag byin pas/ de dag gis kyang gzhon nu'i gzi brjid ma bzod par myur du song ngo / /de nas sa mtsho ma 'ongs pa na yo byad zad de/ des 'dzum dmul te/ bdag gis nongs pa ci bgyis nas/ /bdag la thugs sngan sdang ba mdzad/ /byas pas gzhon nus sngan gdangs min gyis khyed 'phyis pas lan no gsungs nas/ sor gdub srang stong re ba de sbyin no/ /de song ba na bya ra ba dag gis gzhon nu sa mtsho ma la spyan chags te bka' mchid kyang cung zad bgyi'o zhes smra'o/ /de nas rgyal pos shākya lag na be con la/ khyod kyi bu mo gzhon nu la byin cig gsungs pas/ des bdag gi rigs chos la bu mo sgyu rtsal shes pa la gtong ba lags na/ mi shes pa la ji ltar sbyin zer ba thos pas/ rgyal po yid ma dga' bar sems shing 'dug pa gzhon nus mthong nas/ yab kyis nongs bka' bstsal bar rigs so smras pas/ yab kyis tshul de bsnyad pas/ gzhon nus sgyu rtsal 'gran par khas blangs pas/ rgyal po mnyes te sgyu rtsal 'gran par dril bsgrags so/ /de nas shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya tsam 'tshogs te/ ral gri'i thabs dang / 'phongs dang / gyad kyi 'dzings stangs sogs su rgyal ba des sa mtsho ma 'khyer bar dam bcas pa na/ thog mar lhas sbyin byung ste/ glang po che khrid pa dang 'phrad nas phrag dog dang nga rgyal gyis kun nas bslangs te/ thal mo lan gcig bsnun nas bsad/ mdzes dga' bos re de grong khyer gyi pha rol tu bskyur ba na/ gzhon nus zhabs kyi mthe bong gis blangs te ra ba bdun/ 'obs bdun gyi phyi rgyang grags gcig tsam gyi sar 'phangs te gshongs chen por gyur par glang po'i gshongs zhes grags so/

/de nas yi ge dang rtsis 'gran pas kyang gzhon nu rgyal lo/ /de nas dga' bo dang kun dga' bo gnyis kyis stobs brgal ba'i phyir drung du phyin pas des lag pa reg ma thag 'gyel/ de nas lhas sbyin byung ba na byang chub sems dpas phyag g.yas kyis btegs te nam mkha' la bskor nas sa la bor/ yang lus la mi gnod par byas so/ /de nas 'phongs 'gran pa na/ kun dga' bos rgyang grags gnyis/ lhas sbyin gyis rgyang grags bzhi/ mdzes dga' bos rgyang grags drug be con can gyis dpag tshad gnyis kyi pha rol rnams su lcags rnga re 'ben du btsugs pas/ rang rang gi 'ben la phog de nas pha rol tu ma son/ gzhon nus rgyang grags bcu'i pha rol tu lcags rnga gcig shing ta la bdun/ de'i pha rol tu lcags kyi phag rgod gcig rnams btsugs te/ lha khang nas mes seng gi za 'grams kyi gnam ru blangs nas phyed krung du 'dug ste/ brdungs nas mda' 'phangs pas/ sngar gyi 'ben de dag thams cad phug ste sa la zug nas mi snang bar gyur te khron pa lta bu byung bas mda'i khron pa zhes grags/ gzhan yang bang dang mchong la sogs pa sgyu rtsal thams cad la gzhon nu lhag nas/ shākya lag na be con gyis sa mtsho ma phul te/ byang chub sems dpas kyang 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir/ sa mtsho ma dang / grags 'dzin ma dang / ri dwags 'dzin ma rnams 'khor mang po dang bcas khab tu bzhes pa'i tshul mdzad de dgung lo nyer dgu'i bar du de dag dang rtse dga' la yongs su spyod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dam bca' dus las mi 'da' yang / sangs rgyas kyis bskul ba chos nyid yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sil snyan gyi sgra las/ sdug bsngal brgyas gang sems can mthong nas ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon dang skyabs dang gnas gyur cing / /phan byed mgon dang dpung gnyen gyur cig ces/ /khyod kyis sngon gyi smon lam de skad btab/

/dge ba dpa' bo sngon gyi spyod pa dang / /'gro phan bya zhes smon lam dran par byos/ /'di ni khyod kyi tshod dang dus yin gyis/ /drang srong mchog rab khyim nas 'byung bar byos/ /zhes sogs kyis bskul cing / btsun mo dag gi rol mo'i sgra las kyang / srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar/ /'chi med rab 'bar 'di ni mgon med pa/ /srid las 'byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs/ /bum par tshud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin/ /srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs/ /skyes bu'i tshe 'phro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu lta bu myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes sogs nas/ sngon gyi spyod de rjes su dran gyis la/ /gti mug rab rib mun pas sgrib pa yi/ /'gro la shes rab dam pa 'od bzang ba/ /chos mig dri med nyon mongs med pa byin/ /ces pa'i sgra byung bas/ byang chub sems dpa' yang rgyags pa'i sems spangs te byang chub tu sems btang / de bzhin du lha'i bu 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis kyang tshigs su bcad pas bskul cing / de'i tshe rgyal bu'i rmi lam du byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba rmis pas de yid chags pa'i phyir dpyid bsil/ dbyar ran/ dgun dro ba'i khang bzang gsum byas pa'i tshe/ gzhon nu sus kyang ma tshor bar mngon par 'byung du 'ong ngo zhes pa'i sgra dpag tshad phyed kyi bar du byung zhing / ltas mkhan rnams kyis kyang gzhon nu bkra shis kyi sgo nas mngon par 'byung par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pas/ rgyal pos sgo 'phar chen po sgra dpag tshad du grags pa mi lnga brgyas 'byed cing gcod par byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal du 'byon par dgongs te/ 'dun pa la shing rta sbyor cig gsungs pas/ 'dun pas kyang rgyal po la gsol pas/ rgyal pos gzhon nus yid du mi 'ong ba mi mthong bar bya ba'i phyir/

phyogs thams cad nyams dga' bar byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' shar sgo nas thon pa dang / nyid kyi mthus lha'i sprul pa'i rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa'i mi zhig 'dug pa gzigs te/ 'dun pa la/ kha lo bsgyur ba mi rid nyam chung zhing / /sha lpags skam la rus lpags nyi tshes dkris/ /mgo dkar so rnal lus ni rab skem la/ /'khar ba brten zhing mi bde 'khyor 'gro su/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dun pas lha/ mi 'di rgas pas zil gyis non pa ste/ /dbang po nyams shing sdug bsngal brtson stobs nyams/ /gnyen gyi skye bos brnyas shing mgon med gyur/ /don bgyid mi nus nags khrod shing ltar bor/ /zhes gsol pas/ yang byang chub sems dpas/ 'di ni 'di yi rigs kyi chos yin nam/ /'on te 'gro ba 'di kun la yang 'byung / /tshig 'di yang dag ji bzhin myur du smros/ /thos nas de don 'dir ni tshul bzhin bsam/ /gsungs pas/ des lha/ 'di ni rigs chos yul 'khor chos ma lags/ /dar la babs pa'i skye bo rgas pas 'joms/ /khyed kyi yab yum nye du gnyen tshogs kyang / /rgas las ma thar gzhan du 'gro thabs med/ /ces smras pas na/ byang chub sems dpas/ kha lo bsgyur ba byis pa mi mkhas 'gro/ /gzhon pas rgyags myos blo ngan rgas ma mthong / /nga ni slar 'gro shing rta myur du sgyur/ /nga ni rgas 'gyur rtse dgas ci zhig bya/ /zhes gsungs nas nang du log go /yang lho sgor byon pas na ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs te/ kha lo bsgyur ba nyam chung lus mdog ngan/ /dbang po kun nyam dbugs dbyung rab tu dka'/ /yan lag kun skam lto bkru nyam thag gyur/ /rang gi gcin rtug smad pa'i nang 'dug su/ /gsungs pas/ des lha/ mi 'di shin tu nad kyis btab pa ste/ /nad kyi nye 'tshe ches pas 'gul ma thub/ /gzi brjid ma mchis stobs kyang rnam par nyams/ /mgon skyabs gling dang dpung gnyen ma mchis lags/ /zhes smras so/

/byang chub sems dpas/ nad med pa yang rmi lam rtse dang mtshungs/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa 'di ltar mi zad pa'i/ /gnas 'di mthong nas skyes bu mkhas pa rnams/ /rtse dgas sdug pa'i 'du shes ji ltar skyes/ /zhes gsungs/ nub tu shi ba gzigs nas/ kha lo bsgyur ba mi 'di khyog btegs nas/ /mi dag skra bshig mgo la sas 'thor zhing / /sna tshogs tshig dag brjod cing brang rdung bas/ /kun nas bskor te khyer ba 'di su zhig /gsungs pa dang / yang des lha/ mi 'di 'dzam bu gling du gums pa ste/ /pha ma mchis 'brangs bu rnams slar mi mthong / /longs spyod khyim dang mdza' bshes gnyen tshogs rnams/ /spangs nas 'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro/ zhes zer ba la/ byang chub sems dpas/ rgas pas gnod 'gyur gzhon yang cir mi rung / /nad kyis gnod 'gyur nad med cir mi rung / /ring du mi gnas gson yang cir mi rung / /dga' ba la chags mkhas kyang cir mi rung / /da lta na rgas 'chi ba med gyur kyang / /sdug bsngal chen po phung po lnga 'dzin na/ /na rgas 'chi ba rtag 'brangs smos ci dgos/ /slar log rab tu thar par bya ba bsam/ /zhes gsungs shing / yang byang sgor dge slong gzigs te/ kha lo bsgyur ba sems zhi rab zhi zhing / /mig phab 'gro la gnya' shing gang tsam lta/ /ngur smrig gos gyon spyod zhi lhung bzed thogs/ /mi rgod mi khengs skyes bu 'di su zhig /gsungs pa na/ des smras pa/ lha mi 'di dge slong zhes ni bgyi ba lags/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba spangs shing dul bar spyod/ /bdag nyid rab tu byung zhing zhi ba 'tshol/ /chags sdang bral bar bsod snyoms spyod cing rgyu/ /zer ba dang / byang chub sems dpas/ dge ba legs smras 'di ni nga 'dod de/ /rab byung mkhas pa rnams kyis rtag tu bsngags/ /de ni bdag dang sems can gzhan la'ang phan/ /'tsho bde nyams mthun 'chi med 'bras bur 'gyur/ /gsungs shing / de nas byang chub sems dpas nang du log ste bzhugs so/

/rgyal pos de dag mthong zhing thos pas bsrung ba'i phyir/ ra ba dang / 'obs dang / sgo brtan po bcug grong khyer gyi bzhi mdor bsrung ba'i mi bzhag btsun mo rnams glu dbyangs dang rtse dga' sbyor du bcug de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' khab nas gshegs pa'i ltas su/ bya skad mi 'byin/ pad+ma rnying / shing la me tog mi chags/ gling bu dang pi wang sogs rgyud chad/ rdza rnga brdungs kyang skad med par gyur te/ de dag mthong bas rgyal po sems khong du chud cing sa mtsho ma la sa g.yo ba sogs rmi/ byang chub sems dpa'i rmi lam du/ rkang lag gis rgya mtsho dkrugs/ sa mal char byas/ ri rab sngas su bcug 'od kyis mun pa gsal/ gdugs gcig gis 'jig rten gsum khyab pa la sogs pa rmis so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas yab kyis ma gnang bar rab tu 'byung bar mi rigs dgongs nas yab kyi drung du song ste/ bdag mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la babs kyi/ gegs dang mi dges pa ma mdzad cig gsungs pas/ yab kyis khyed ci 'dod pa'i mchog sbyin gyis khab tu bzhugs shig gsungs pa dang / byang chub sems dpas/ rga nad 'chi rgud bzhi med pa 'tshal lo/ /gsungs pas/ yab kyis de sbyin pa'i thabs med/ gzhan gang 'dod pa slongs shig zer ba la/ yang byang chub sems dpas rga nad 'chi ba'i 'jigs dang rgud par mi 'gyur ba/ /lha gcig gal te mchog bzhi 'di dag mi stsol na/ /gzhan yang mchog gcig gsol gyi rgyal po gsan du gsol/ /'di nas shi 'phos nying mtshams sbyor bar mi 'gyur mdzod/ /ces gsungs pas/ rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ de ni bdag gis sbyin par mi nus/ 'di btsas pa'i tshe yang / srid pa tha ma pa bya'o/ /zhes smras la/ bram ze rnams kyis kyang mngon par 'byung bar lung bstan pas/ 'di nges par 'gro snyam nas skad chung ngus/ /khyod kyis bsam pa rdzogs par gyur cig /ces smras so/ /rgyal pos don de shākya rnams la bsnyad pas/

bsrung bar rigs zhes thams cad bgros te/ sgo bzhir shākya gzhon nu lnga brgya re/ shing rta lnga brgya re dpung bu chung lnga brgya re dang bcas bkod/ shākya rgan rabs pa rnams lam gyi bzhi mdo dang gsum mdor 'khod/ rgyal po'ang mel tshe byed do/ /de'i tshe gnod sbyin rnams dang 'phrog ma'i bu rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams mchod pa'i las byed do/ /lha'i bu chos spyod la sogs pas btsun mo'i 'khor mi sdug par bsgyur/ de la gzigs pas dur khrod kyi 'du shes skyes te/ e ma skye dgu dag ni sdug bsngal gyur/ /srin mo'i tshogs la dga' ba ji ltar rnyed/ /'dod pa yon tan med la yon tan 'dzin/ /gti mug mun pas rab bsgribs blo gros ngan/ /dper na bya ni bya rgyar chud pa bzhin/ /nam yang 'byung ba rnyed par 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te mi sdug pa sgom mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas smon lam 'di skad btab ste/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi sgra bsgrag par bya'o/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bya'o/ /nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bya'o/ /srid pa'i mdud pa dgrol bar bya'o/ /zhes dgongs te nam phyed kyi dus khang bzang gi steng du song ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag btsal nas bltas pas/ brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / nyi zla gnyis kyang phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pa dang / skar ma rgyal shar ba yang mthong ste/ 'dun pa la/ nga yis bkra shis 'di ni don kun 'grub/ /do nub gdon mi za bar don 'grub kyi/ /'dun pa phyi bshol ma byed ma gor du/ /rta rgyal rgyan gyis brgyan pa nga la byin/ /gsungs pa na/ 'dun pas/ gang du bzhud zhus pas/ mngon par 'byung ngo gsungs/ 'dun pas yang yang ldog kyang ma gnang bar/ dus ma lags so zhus pas/ sems can rnams kyi don ni 'tshol ba na/ /byang chub rga shi med pa'i gnas thob nas/ /'gro ba 'dren zhes nga yis yun ring nas/ /smon lam btab pa de yi dus la babs/

/zhes gsungs shing / lha'i bu mang dag bskul ba bos kyang / da ni mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab bo zhes bskul/ lha'i bu kha cig gis bsrung mi rnams myos par byas/ de nas brgya byin gyis bkra shis kyi sgo dbye/ rta mnga' ldan la chibs pa/ rgyal chen bzhis btegs te nam mkha' la byon pas/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis lam bstan/ 'od kyis mun pa bsal/ mchod pa dang rol mo bcas te gyad kyi yul 'das nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du phyin te/ rta dang rgyan 'dun pa la byin nas/ 'di dag khyer la ser skyar song zhig gsungs/ 'dun pas bdag la chad pas gcod du 'chi'o byas pas/ nga la byams pa bzhin khyod la byams par 'gyur gyi ma 'jigs shig gsungs pa bzhin/ des kyang log ste bkod pa'i gtam rnams rgyal po sogs la smras pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar skyes/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthus mya ngan yang med par gyur to/ /der mchod rten zhig brtsigs pas/ 'dun pa slar log gi mchod rten du grags/ de nas mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bzhar ba lha rnams kyis gdan drangs te/ mchod rten brtsigs pas gtsug phud kyi mchod rten du grags/ der rab byung gi tshul dang mthun pa'i gos shig rnyed na rung snyam pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha rngon pa'i gzugs su sprul pas na bza' ngur smrig phul ba bzhes te/ sa der mchod rten brtsigs pas ngur smrig blangs pa'i mchod rten zhes kyang grags/ de ltar gtsug phud bcad ngur smrig bgos te rang byung gi rab tu byung bar mdzad pas/ don grub rab tu byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra 'og min gyi bar du grags so/ /de nas bram ze rigs ldan gyi gnas su bsod snyoms la byon nas/ yangs pa can na sgyu rtsal shes kyi bu ring 'phur slob ma mang po la ci yang med kyi skye mched ston pa nyan pas tshegs med du mkhyen nas/ de bas lhag pa'i chos shig btsal lo snyam du dgongs te/

ma ga dha dang / rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer sogs su byon/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po grong khyer ba dang bcas pa dad par byas/ rgyal po'i khab de nyid na rang byed kyi bu lhag spyod slob ma mang po la srid rtse'i sems ston pa'i sar phyin te bslabs pas khong du chud de/ 'di ni myang 'das su 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /zhes sun phyung ste song ngo / /de'i tshe lnga sde yang byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /de nas brtul zhugs ngan pas dag par 'dzin pa sun byung ba'i phyir/ chu bo na rañdza na'i 'gram du til 'bru gcig dang 'bras 'bru gcig rgya shug 'bru gcig la brten nas lo drug tu dka' ba spyad de mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ lha kha cig lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma la/ gzhon nu shi'o zhes smras pas/ lha mo bltar 'ong ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus skam pa shi ba dang 'dra ba mthong nas/ nga'i skye ba'i tha ma 'di'o zhes pa'i dam bca' yang ma rdzogs/ bram ze dag gi lung bstan kyang mi bden zer zhing smre sngags 'don pa na/ byang chub sems dpas/ nyi zla skar tshogs sa la lhung 'gyur srid/ /so so skye bo yin yang nga mi 'chi/ /de phyir 'di la mya ngan khyod ma byed/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub sangs rgyas mthong / /zhes gsungs pas dga' ste rang gnas su song ngo / /de'i tshe ba glang rdzi rnams kyis rna bar shing bal bcug nas snar 'byin pa la sogs pa byed cing / bdud kyis glags btsal kyang glags ma rnyed do/ /de nas dka' thub kyi grol bar 'dzin pa dgag pa'i phyir/ kha zas rags pa gsol bas/ lnga sdes/ 'di ni lhod pa/ mang du za ba/ dka' thub las nyams pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing ma dad par gzhan du song ngo / /der lha rnams kyis gos ngur smrig phul ba bzhes te/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' lus mdzes pas dge sbyong mdzes pa zhes grags/ de nas zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas ba stong gi zho'i nying khu phul ba de gsol bas mtshan dpe mchog tu gsal zhing 'od 'dom gang gis brgyan par gyur to/

/de nas byang chub sems dpa' bdud las rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs pas/ lha'i mthus rlung dang char gyis lam phyags shing chag chag btab/ ri dang shing dang byis pa btsas ma thag pa thams cad kyang mgo de phyogs su ston zhing / stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pas rang gi 'khor rnams la/ do nub byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por gshegs kyi/ mchod pa'i las gyis shig ces bsgos nas mchod pa'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul lo/ /byang chub sems dpas 'od bkye ba de phog pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing / snod kyi skyon thams cad sbyangs so/ /de nas rtswa 'tshong bkra shis la/ bkra shis rtswa 'di nga la myur du byin/ /de ring nga la rtswa yis don chen 'gyur/ /dpung dang bcas pa'i bdud rnams bcom nas su/ /byang chub dam pa zhi ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / des kyang rtswa ku sha sngo 'jam yid du 'ong ba phul ba bzhes te/ byang chub kyi shing la lan gsum bskor nas/ rtswa'i rtse mo nang du bstan/ rtsa ba phyir bstan pa la zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs te/ sku drang por bsrangs nas dgongs pa mngon du bzhag ste/ stan 'dir bdag gi lus 'di skam gyur ram/ /sha rus lpags pa'i tshogs rnams zhig kyang rung / /bskal mang brnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob par/ /stan 'di las ni lus bskyed mi bya'o/ /zhes yid dam brtan po mdzad pas/ lha rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' bsrung ba'i phyir phyogs bcur 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas smin mtshams nas 'od bkye bas zhing khams dpag med snang bar byas nas byang chub sems dpa' mang po 'dus te mchod pa byed cing / slar yang bdud 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye bas bdud gnas thams cad snang zhing g.yos/ slar mog mog por byas te/ sems can shin tu dag pa bskal mang spyod spyad pa/
