/zas gtsang sras pos rgyal srid dag ni rab spangs te/ /phan byed de ni bdud rtsi mngon par 'dod pas 'byung / /byang chub shing drung 'ongs kyi de ring bsgrin par gyis/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i sgra yang byung zhing / bdud sdig can la rang gnas mun pas khyab pa sogs rmis nas rang gi 'khor rnams sbran pa na/ bu ded dpon gyis ldog kyang ma bzlog par/ gnod sbyin grul bum lto 'phye chen po'i gzugs/ /srin po yi dwags sha za'i gzugs dang bcas/ /'jig rten mi sdug drag gzugs ji snyed pa/ /thams cad rgyu yi der ni sprul pa bya/ /zhes pa ltar sgyu ma lta bu'i blo can ma yin pa rnams kyis mthong ba tsam gyis snying 'gas par 'gyur ba/ kha bzhin dmar la lus po ser ba dang / /lus po dmar la kha bzhin ser ba dang / /mgo gcig mgo gnyis mgo gsum ldan pa dang / /mgo stong bye ba'i bar ldan rab tu mang / /zhes pa ltar lus can mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa'i dmag sa ya stong phrag sum cu lhags te/ g.yas phyogs nas byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba rnams kyis bzlog g.yon nas mi dga' ba rnams kyis bskul te/ phyogs rnams kun nas ri yi phreng ba dang / /mkha' las brag dang mtshon gyi char pa dang / /rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs char 'bab pa yis/ /shākya'i bu de thal bar brlag par bya/ /zhes zer zhing mtshon cha sogs char bzhin du bar mtshams mer par babs kyang / shākya'i sras pos chos rnams rten 'byung ba/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems dang rab tu ldan/ /dpung bcas g.yo sgyu mthong yang nyes pa med/ /ces pa ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus gnod pa med cing mtshon cha rnams me tog gi char du gyur pa dang / bdud na re/ khyod kyis bsod nams de tsam gyis thar pa ga la thob zer ba la/ byang chub sems dpas/ khyod kyi gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gcig byas pas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa yin/

ngas gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin du ma byas so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bdud kyis/ sngon chad kho bos mchod sbyin kha na ma tho med/ /gtan pa med pa byas pa'i dpang du khyod 'dir yod/ /'dir ni khyod la dpang po gang yang yod min pas/ /smras kyang phan pa ci yod khyod ni pham par gyur/ /zer ba na/ byang chub sems dpas/ phyag g.yas pa sa la brdabs te/ sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi gnas yin te/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu snyoms shing nye 'khon med/ /'di ni bdag gi dpang ste bdag rdzun med/ /'di la khyod kyis bdag gi dpang byos shig /ces gsungs pas/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa'i gseb nas sa'i lha mo lus phyed phyung nas thal mo sbyar te/ skyes bu chen po de de bzhin no/ /khyod kyis ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ /'di ni bdag la mngon sum mo/ /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi dpang du gyur pa lags so/ /zhes smras nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas/ g.yon can dpung bcas sa sgra de thos pas/ /nags su seng ge'i sgra bsgrags was thos dang / /bya rog rdo 'phangs mod la byer ba bzhin/ /dngangs skrag snying gas thams cad rab tu byer/ /zhes pa ltar phyogs su byer ro/ /de nas sdig can yid ma dga' nas bdud kyi bu mo rnams nyams sad du btang pas de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa'i mdun du phyin te g.yo sgyu sna tshogs bstan kyang bslu ma nus pas/ sdig can shin tu yid ma dga' ba na/ shing gi lha dpal ldan sogs kyis/ khyod ni dgung zla yar gyi ngo ltar mdzes pa'o/ /zhes sogs kyis byang chub sems dpa' la bstod pa dang / gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha dag gis/ /sdig can khyod ni glang rgan 'dam du bying ba ltar nyam chung ba'o/ /zhes sogs kyis smad cing bzlogs kyang bdud kyi dmag grangs ji snyed yod do cog sbran te song nas mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phangs shing cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan kyang glags ma rnyed par thams cad 'thor nas zhag bdun du ma 'phrad/

de'i tshe bdud mang pos byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas nam gyi stod la bsam gtan bzhi mngon du mdzad/ gung la mngon shes rnams bskyed nas/ nam gyi cha smad skya rangs 'char ga'i tshe zag med kyi ye shes mngon du byas te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas shing rta la bdun tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags te lam gyi rgyud ni chad do zhes ched du brjod/ lha rnams kyis me tog pus nub tsam du gtor te mchod/ lha'i bu mo rnams kyis bstod/ 'od kyis 'jig rten snang bar byas/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang / bdag cag ji ltar sangs rgyas pa/ /de ltar kho nar khyod sangs rgyas/ /dper na mar dang mar nyid kyi/ /nying khu mtshungs pa bzhin du gyur/ /ces gsungs shing / nyid kyi gsung gis kyang / bsod nams rnam smin bde zhing sdug bsngal sel/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa 'grub/ /bdud bcom nas ni byang chub mngon sangs rgyas/ /mya ngan 'das shing bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ /ces ched du brjod do/ /zhag bdun phrag dang po la skyil krung ma bshigs par byang chub kyi shing la gzigs/ gnyis pa la stong gsum ring du 'chag gsum pa la byang chub kyi snying po la spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs/ bzhi pa la shar nub kyi bar du rgyang mi ring bar 'chag bdud kyis mya ngan las 'da' bar zhus kyang gdul bya'i don ma zin gyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar zhal gyi bzhes/ bdud kyi bu mo dga' ma sogs bslur byung pa na rgan mor mdzad/ bdun phrag lnga pa la klu gtang bzung gi gnas su bzhugs so/ /drug pa la shing n+ya gro dha skyong du bzhugs te kun tu rgyu rnams la/ chos thos pa dang mthong ba dang / /dben par dga' ba bde ba yin/ /srog chags 'byung po rnams la gdams/ /gnod pa mi byed 'jig rten bde/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ bdun pa la shing sgrol rgyu'i drung du bzhugs te/

tshong pa ga gon dang bzang pos sbrang rtsi dang / skyo ma dang / bu ram shing bshus pa dag phul ba na/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dag gis snod ji ltar bur bzhes dgongs pa na/ rgyal chen bzhis gser la sogs pa'i lhung bzed phul ba ma bzhes/ rnam sras la rdo rje'i lhung bzed bzhi yod pa rgyal chen bzhis re re bzung rin po ches bkangs nas phul bas/ bde bar gshegs la lhung bzed phul cig dang / /khyed ni theg pa mchog gi snod du 'gyur/ /nga 'dra dag la lhung bzed phul ba yis/ /dran dang blo gros nam yang nyams mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te bzhes nas bzhi cha gcig tu byin gyis brlabs pa blangs so/ /de nas ga gon dang bzang pos ba stong gi 'o ma'i spris ma bzham nas rin po che'i gzhong par blugs te phul ba gsol nas gzhong pa bor ba tshangs pas khyer/ de nas ston pas lha yi bkra shis don 'grub cing / /phyogs rnams bkra shis byed pa des/ /khyed kyi don rnams 'grub gyur cig /thams cad myur du mthun par shog /ces sogs kyi shis pa brjod de/ sbrang rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyal bar lung bstan to/ /de nas ston pa thugs las chung ngur bzhugs te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags 'dabs gnas par bya ba snyam/ /zhes dgongs shing / 'jig rten kun la snying brtse mtha' yas nga / /gzhan gyis gsol ba btab la nga mi ston/ /skye bo 'di dag tshangs la dad pa ste/ /de yis gsol ba btab na 'khor lo bskor/ /snyam du dgongs nas 'od zer bkye bas/ stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyi grogs sbran te tshangs pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ ye shes chen po mchog gi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas ni/ /phyogs bcu dag tu 'od zer rnam par bkye mdzad de/ /ye shes zer gyis mi yi pad+ma kha 'byed pa/

/smra ba'i nyi ma de ring ci slad btang snyoms bzhugs/ /zhes sogs kyis bskul bas cang mi gsung bar snang ngo / /slar yang chos la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir yang yang gsol ba gdab pa'i slad du thugs las chung ngu la gzhol bar mdzad do/ /de tshangs pas shes nas brgya byin sbran te/ brgya byin gyis/ zla ba nya ba gza' las thar ba ltar/ /khyod kyi thugs ni shin tu rnam par grol/ /g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba bzhengs su gsol/ /'jig rten mun par shes rab 'od byung gsol/ /zhes pa dang / tshangs pas kyang / kun tu 'tshal bar 'gyur ba mchis lags kyi/ /thub pa khyod kyis chos ni bstan du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa na/ ston pas/ skye dgu 'dod pa rnams kyis bcings/ /rgyun gyis rab tu bdas pa yin/ /ngas ni tshogs chen po yis rnyed/ /de lta bas na bstan mi phan/ /zhes gsungs pa na/ slar yang tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul te/ ma ga dha yi yul 'dir sngon chad chos/ /ma dag dri ma'i rjes su 'brel ba 'byung / /bdud rtsi sgo mo dbye bar mdzod cig chos/ /rdul bral dri ma med pa bstan du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten la gzigs nas ma nges pa dang / log par nges pa dang / yang dag par nges pa ste gsum du gnas pa las/ ma nges pa la gzigs te/ tshangs pa ma ga dha yi sems can gang dag su/ /skal bar ldan zhing rigs dang ldan gyur pa/ /mi tshe 'du shes rtag tu chos nyan pa/ /de dag la ni bdud rtsi'i sgo dbye'o/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas byang chub kyi shing gi lha bzhis/ chos kyi 'khor lo gang du bskor zhus pas/ wa ra na sir bskor gsungs pa na/ de dag gis de ni skye bo nyung zhing grib ma chung bas gzhan du rigs so zer ba la/ ston pas/ bzhin bzang dag de skad ma zer cig wa ra na si de ni sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyi gnas sa ste/ /lha dang klu yis mngon bstod rtag tu chos ni rnam par gzhol/

/ngas ni sngon chad sangs rgyas bye ba dgu bcu rtsa gcig dran/ /de dag drang srong zhes bya nags mchog dam pa der ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /ces gsungs shing / de nas su la chos bstan dgongs pa dang / lhag spyod 'das nas zhag bdun dang / ring 'phur 'das nas zhag gsum lon par dgongs nas lnga sde la gzigs pas/ de dag skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas gsal ldan du byon pas/ 'tsho ba pa nyer 'gro dang 'phrad de/ khyed dbang po ni gsal/ lpags pa ni dag na/ su las tshangs par spyad zhus pa na/ ston pas/ nga la slob dpon gang yang med/ /nga dang 'dra ba yod ma yin/ /nga ni gcig pu rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsil gyur zag pa med pa yin/ /gsungs pas/ de na re/ dgra bcom par zhal gyis 'che'am zer ba dang / ston pas/ nga ni 'jig rten dgra bcom pa/ /nga ni ston pa bla na med/ /lha dang lha min dri zar bcas/ /nga yi do zla'i gang zag med/ /gsungs pas/ des rgyal bar zhal gyis bzhes zer ba la/ ston pas/ gang dag zag pa zad brnyes pa/ /nga 'dra rgyal bar shes par bya/ /nga ni sdig pa'i chos las rgyal/ /de bas nyer 'gro nga rgyal yin/ /gsungs pas/ des 'o na gar bzhud zer/ nga ni wa ra na sir 'gro/ /grong khyer gsal ldan song nas ni/ /long ba lta bu'i 'jig rten la/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas de bzhin du 'gyur ro zer te lho phyogs su song / ston pas byang phyogs su steng rgyas sogs nas rim gyis gshegs/ gaṅgā'i 'gram du byon te gru la sgrol gsungs pas/ gnyan pas gru btsas dgos zer ba la/ nga la gru btsas med gsungs nas nam mkha' la 'phur nas gshegs pas/ gnyan pa dag 'gyod pa skyes shing ngo mtshar nas rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de phyin chad rab byung la gru btsas mi len par byas so/ /de nas 'khor mo 'jig tu gshegs pa lnga sdes rgyang ring po nas mthong ste/ dge sbyong go'u ta ma lhod pa mang du za ba/

spong ba las nyams pa de 'ong gi 'di la sngon du ldang ba dang / phyag kyang mi bya/ stan lhag ma 'di la 'dug na 'dug tu chug zer ba'i 'go khrims bcas te/ kun shes kyis sems kyis khas ma blangs/ de nas ston pas byon pas/ lnga sdes 'go khrims de rang zhig tu song ste/ stan las langs nas la las bsu/ la las gdan btings/ la las zhabs bkru ba'i chu bshams nas/ khyed legs par byon nam/ stan 'di la bzhugs su gsol/ zhes zhus pa na/ ston pas stan la bzhugs nas lnga sde mgu bar bya ba'i gtam mang po mdzad pa na/ lnga sdes/ tshe dang ldan pa go'u ta ma/ dbang po ni gsal/ lpags pa'i mdog ni yongs su dag na/ ye shes mthong ba'i khyad par mngon du mdzad dam zer ba la/ ston pas/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa la tshe dang ldan pa zhes ma zer zhig khyed rang dag yun ring por mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /ngas ni bdud rtsi thob bo/ /sangs rgyas so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /sngar khyed rnams kyi 'go khrims 'di ltar ma bcas sam/ dge slong dag ngas khyed rnams la chos bshad kyis tshur nyon cig nan tan gyis shig rna ba lhogs shig dang / /ngas gdams shing rjes su bstan no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de'i mod la de dag gi mu stegs kyi rtags rnams med par gyur nas dge slong bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pa lta bur gyur te/ de dag gis kyang nyes pa bshags nas gus pa yang bskyed do/ /de nas ston pas sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams gang du bzhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor snyam pa dang / sa phyogs der rin po che'i khri stong byung bar gyur to/ /der khri snga ma gsum la bskor ba mdzad de/ bzhi pa la skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so/ /lnga sdes kyang / ston pa'i zhabs la phyag btsal te spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las 'od zer bkye nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par byas nas/ 'od de las/ de ni thugs dam brtan pa ste/

/wa ra na si ri dwags nags/ gshegs te 'khor lo bla med pa/ /shin tu rmad byung dpal ldan bskor/ /rgyal las bskal pa khrag khrig bsgrubs/ /chos de nyan par gang 'dod pa/ /de ni rings par la gor du/ /chos nyan pa yi phyir shog cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i sgra grags pas/ byang chub sems dpa' dang lha'i 'khor dpag tu med pa 'dus so/ /de nas ston pa 'dis 'khor gyi thog ma kun shes kau dh+ya n+ya/ rta thul/ rlangs pa/ ming chen/ bzang ldan te lnga sde bzang po la/ dge slong dag mtha' gnyis po 'di dag ni rab tu byung ba 'jug par bya ba ma yin te/ 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' 'o/ /de bas na mtha' gnyis spangs nas dbu ma'i lam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston to/ /de ni 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad do/ /dge slong dag bzhi po 'di dag ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ste/ gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam mo/ /zhes sogs lan dang po'i bden pa bzhi'i ngo bo dang / yang / dge slong dag sdug bsngal yongs su shes par bya'o/ /kun 'byung spang nga ོ/ /zhes sogs lan gsum pas bden pa bzhi mthar phyin par bzlas pa ste/ de ltar rnam pa bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ lan gnyis pa la kun shes kyis dgra bcom pa thob/ gzhan bzhi la mthong lam skyes/ gsum pa'i tshe bzhi pos kyang dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /'o na lnga sde 'di dag ston pa 'di'i 'khor gyi thog mar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ ston pa 'di sngon rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa na/ de'i tshe gnod sbyin mig dmar zhes pa lngas nyin re la sems can du ma srog gcod cing za bar byed pa las/ rgyal po 'di 'khrungs pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin de dag la sems can gyi srog gcod pa'i skal ba med par gyur nas/ lus shin tu rid par gyur pa nags gseb cig tu gnas pa las/

rgyal po de nags su byon pa dang de dag mthong nas/ lus 'di lta bur gyur pa ci yin gsungs pas/ gnod sbyin rnams kyis gong gi rgyu mtshan zhus pa na/ rgyal po snying rje dpag tu med pa skyes te rang gi mgrin pa'i rtsa bcad de khrag dang / lus kyi sha bcad nas de rnams la byin pas/ de dag na re/ 'di ltar byas nas khyed ci 'dod zer ba na/ rgyal pos/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog ces gsungs pas/ de dag gis de'i tshe nged rnams kyang khyed kyi 'khor gyi thog mar skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa la brten nas gnod sbyin de dag rgyal po de sangs rgyas nas ston pa 'dir gyur pa'i tshe/ 'khor 'dus pa dang por byung ba yin par bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar chos 'khor bskor nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa ni/ de nas mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba na/ ston pas kun dga' bo la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar bskul ba'i phyir du/ kun dga' bo su gang yang rung rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten sgom mang du byas pa de 'dod na/ bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag gi bar du 'dug go /de bzhin gshegs pas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la brten sgom mang du byas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhed na bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag pa'i bar du yang bzhugs so/ /zhes lan du mar bskul yang / kun dga' bo bdud kyis khebs pas cang mi zer ro/ /de'i tshe bdud sdig can gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar gsol ba btab pas/ zla ba gsum nas 'da' bar zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas ston pa'i 'tsho ba'i 'du byed ni byin gyis brlabs/ tshe'i 'du byed ni spangs so/ /de'i tshe sa g.yos/ skar mda' ltung / phyogs tshig bar snang gi lha rnams rnga brdungs par gyur pa na/ de'i rgyu zhus pas/

sa g.yo ba'i rgyu brgyad gsungs pas/ kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe'i 'du phyed btang par rig nas gsol ba btab pas ma gnang ngo / /de nas kyang yul yangs pa can la sogs pa du mar gdul bya mang po'i don mdzad de/ rim gyis grong khyer rtswa can gyad kyi yul dang nye ba shing sā la zung gi tshal ga la ba der gshegs pas/ der grong khyer ba rnams kyis lam thams cad mdzes par byas/ sā la zung gi dbus su khri bcas/ 'phong byang du bstan pa la glo g.yas sa la phab/ zhabs kyi steng du zhabs bzhag ste mya ngan la 'da' ba'i 'du shes mdzad nas gzims so/ /der kun dga' bo ni khri la 'jus nas ngus shing smre sngags 'don pa la/ ston pas kun dga' bo khyod mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don par ma byed cig de ci'i phyir na/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i nye gnas byas pa ni/ byams pa'i lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyis las kyis phan pa dang bde ba dang / gnyis su med pa dang tshad med pa byas so/ /zhes gsungs shing / ngo mtshar ba'i chos bzhi gsungs nas mya ngan bsal lo/ /de nas ston pa'i sku dngos kyis gdul bya rab dga' dang / rab bzang / 'dun pa rnams la chos bstan pas/ de rnams kyis kyang bden pa mthong / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mu stegs can shākya dang / mes ba ral pa ma gtogs rab tu mi dbyung / 'khor rnam bzhir phan bder 'gyur ba'i gsung rab bcu gnyis bklag ston pa so thar la gyis/ rgan pas gzhon pa rnams yo byad kyis bsdu/ gzhon pas rgan pa la ming 'bod mi bya/ dad pa can la ston pa 'khrungs pa/ sangs rgyas pa/ chos gsungs pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyogs bzhi bstan par bya'o/ /dge slong dag dkon mchog gsum dang bden pa bzhi la the tshom yod na zhus shig ces sogs gsungs nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to/ /de'i tshe sa g.yos/ skar mda' ltung / phyogs tshig lha'i rol mo'i sgra che cher bsgrags so/

/dge slong kha cig sa la 'gre ldog la las ku co 'don/ kha cig sdug bsngal gyis gzir/ 'ga' zhig chos nyid la rtog cing gnas/ dge slong kha cig gis sā la zung ni rab mdzes pa'i/ /ljon shing mchog gi tshal du 'dir/ /ston pa mya ngan 'das pa la/ /me tog dag ni rab tu gtor/ /zhes zer/ brgya byin gyis/ kye ma 'dus byas rnams mi rtag /skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /skyes nas 'jig par 'gyur ba ste/ /de dag nye bar zhi ba bde/ /zhes dang / tshangs pas/ 'byung po kun gyi 'jig rten 'dir ni bsags pa'i mtha'/ /'dod 'gyur 'jig rten 'di na gang zag bla med gcig /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs rnams brnyes pa spyan ldan pa/ /ston pa 'di lta bu yang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /zhes pa dang / ma 'gags pas/ brtan pa'i thugs kyi skyobs mdzad pa/ /mi g.yo zhi ba brnyes gyur pa/ /dbugs dbyung ba dang rngub 'gags nas/ /spyan ldan yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas nyan thos chen po kun shes/ skul byed/ stobs bcu 'od srung / 'od srung chen po ste bzhi la sogs pas/ sku gdung shing bal gyi la ba dang / ras zung lnga brgyas dkris/ lcags kyi sgrom du bcug 'bru mar gyis bkangs/ lcags khab gnyis kyis bkab ste/ dri zhim po'i shing mang po spungs pas me rang 'bar du gyur te zhag bdun du me ma shi ba na/ gyad rnams kyis bsad do/ /'o ma las me tog ser can/ ser skya/ rta don/ u dum wa ra ste bzhi skyes/ sku gdung rnams gser gyi bum par bcug mchod pa byas so/ /de nas yul sdig pa can gyi gyad rnams dang / yul rtog pa g.yo ba'i rgyal rigs bu lu ka sgra sgrogs kyi kro bha ba/ khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze/ ser skya'i shākya/ yangs pa can gyi li tsa byi/ ma ga dha'i ma skyes dgra rnams kyis rtsa can gyi gyad rnams la/ ston pa ni nged rnams la yun ring po nas phan zhing bla mar gyur pa yin pas/

khyed kyi yul gyi nye skor du 'das pa zhig na/ gdung gi skal ba byin cig so so'i yul du mchod rten byas te dus ston byed do/ /mi ster na dmag gis 'phrog go zer ba la/ gyad dag gis kyang / de bzhin nged kyang byed do zer nas gdung gi phyir 'thab par brtsams pa na/ bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pas/ rtsa can gyi gyad rnams dang / sku gdung slong ba po rnams la/ ston pa ni yun ring po nas bzod pa dang ldan pas/ bzod pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa yin pa la/ sku gdung gi phyir gcig gis gcig gsod par mi rigs kyi/ kho bos sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos la so sor sbyin/ bum pa la kho bos mchod pa bya'o/ /zhes smras pas/ de la kun mthun te de bzhin byas pas/ rang rang gi skal ba yul du khyer te mchod rten brtsigs nas mchod pa dang dus ston byed cing / sgra sgrogs pa'i bskal ba klus phrogs te klus mchod do/ /de bzhin du gdung bcug pa'i bum pa bram ze'i rigs bre bo dang mnyam pa la byung ba de dang / gdung gi sol ba n+ya gro dha la byung ba gnyis la yang mchod rten brtsigs pas mchod rten bcu/ tshems mche ba bzhi la mchod rten re re ste bcu bzhi byon pa yin no/ /de ltar mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul 'di la/ nyan thos pa dag bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du bem rig rgyun chad par 'dod/ theg chen ltar na/ sprul pa'i sku ni mya ngan las/ /'da' bar brjod kyis cig shos min/ /gtan du gnas pa'i rgyu ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'da' bar yang mi rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar longs sku ni mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul yang mi ston la/ sprul sku gdul bya'i dbang gi mya ngan las 'das ba'i tshul ston yang / rgyun chad pa de mi 'dod de/ dper na sman pa mkhas pa'i bu sman mi 'thung pa la/ phas 'di thungs shig ma 'thung na nga 'chi'o zhes smras pa dang / bu des pha ni 'chi/ gzhan sman ster ba ni med snyam du sman 'thung nad sos pa na/

pha shi ba min par shes kyang brdzun gyi nyes par mi 'gyur ba bzhin zhing 'dir sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i gdul bya med pa dang / rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir yin gyis/ brgya byin sogs su sprul nas 'gro ba'i don rgyun 'chad med par mdzad pa yang yod cing / zhing khams gzhan na mya ngan las ma 'das par yang bzhugs te/ da lta shar phyogs kyi zhing khams rnam par spud pa zhes pa na/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'od zer gyis brgyan pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba sku tshe bskal pa grangs med bdun brgya thub pa zhig bzhugs te/ de bdag cag gi ston pa 'di yin par bshad do/ /de ltar yang mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar me ni gzhan du 'bar/ /gzhan du zhi bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la/ /snang dang mi snang shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i ston pa zas gtsang gi sras po shākya thub pa de nyid kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul la/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams ston pa 'dis bzlas te gsungs pa/ bzlas te ma gsungs pa/ de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis gsungs pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas thun mong ba dang / lnga sde bzang po sogs 'khor thun mong ba smos pa'i rgyud rnams ni gsung gi bkod pas bzlas te gsungs pa yin la/ gnas thun mong ma yin pa dpal 'bras spung gi mchod rten dang / 'khor thun mong ma yin pa rgyal po zla ba bzang po sogs smos pa ni sku'i bkod pas bzlas te gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni de nyid 'dus pa dang bde mchog lta bu yin te/ de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud thog mar gsungs nas rdzogs ma thag mi'i nang du babs nas kyang zhes ston pa 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs par bshad cing / slob dpon skal ldan grags pas bde mchog gi 'grel pa las/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ni thog ma med pa'i rgyud can yin te/

bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa las snga ba nyid du gnas so/ /dus kyi dbang gis bsreg pa'i bskal pa la sogs pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa nub pa na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas slar yang gsungs pa yin no/ /dpal bde mchog ni de lta ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa na dpa' bo dang / dpa' mo la sogs pas nyams su blangs te gnas pa'i phyir ma nub ces bshad pa lta bu'o/ /'di nyid kyi rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis gsungs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud sogs phal che ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de nyid kyi rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis bzlas te gsungs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur bstan nas gsang 'dus kyi rgyud gsungs/ gshin rje gshed kyi skur bstan nas gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ de nas phyag na rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sngon byung ba brjod kyis mi lang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i bskal pa'ang 'das/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad 'das nas/ thub pa chen po 'od srung sangs rgyas pa'i bar ma gsungs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba chen po'i gnad kyi don bshad pa/ de'i dus su sems can rnams la skal ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud ni dang por longs sku/ bar du sprul pa mchog kyai rdo rje/ tha mar shākya thub pa nyid kyis 'dzam bu gling du bzlas te gsungs pa yin te/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i 'grel pa las/ de'i rjes su 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid du bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i don du dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud bstan pa chen po dang /

chung ngu'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud dang bcas pa bstan par mdzad de zhes dang / slob dpon ka ma dh+ya nus/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis lo brgyad bcur 'dzam bu'i gling du bzhugs pa de srid la rgyud rin po che 'di yang dang yang du ma gsungs kyi/ dus gcig na lan gcig gsungs pa kho na ste/ de bas na 'di'i dus ni dus gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bzlas te gsungs tshul ni/ bcom ldan 'das grong khyer mnyan yod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de nas nub phyogs su dpag tshad sum brgya na o rgyan gyi yul zhes bya ba yod la/ de na rgyal po in+ḍa bhū ti zhes bya ba zhig yod pa des snga dro'i dus shig gi tshe/ dge slong gi gzugs du ma nam mkha' la 'gro ba mthong ste/ de dag ci yin ma shes par blon po rnams la dris pas/ de dag gis kyang ma shes par grong khyer ba la dris pas/ gcig na re/ 'di nas shar phyogs su dpag tshad sum brgya na mnyan yod ces bya bar rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i sras sangs rgyas nas bzhugs pa de'i 'khor yin no/ /zhes smras pas/ rgyal po rab tu dad de/ de'i phyogs su phyag btsal me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te 'dug pas/ mnyan yod na ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa mthong / der dad pa skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa thugs rje can rdzu 'phrul gyi zhabs mnga' ba sang gi gdugs tshod la 'dir gshegs par gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sang gi gdugs tshod la bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa byon te/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas mchod nas gsol pa/ bdag cag srid pa'i sdug bsngal las thar par mdzad du gsol zhes zhus so/ /bka' stsal pa/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung zhig dang / thabs yod do/ /gsol pa/ bdag cag ni 'dod pa'i yon tan gyis gdung pa che bas/ 'di ma spangs pa nyid du thar pa'i thabs zhu'o/ /zhes gsol pa dang /

de nyid kyi tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo 'dod chags can de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs nas btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus su in+ḍa bhū ti la dbang bskur bas de dbang dus su grol cing / rdo rje theg pa'i chos gsungs te 'khor rnams kyang grol bar mdzad ces grags so/ /'o na mtshan brjod las dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas kyis gsang sngags gsungs par bshad pa dang / gsang 'dus las mar me mdzad nas 'od srung gis bar gyi gsang sngags ma gsungs par bshad pa 'gal lo zhes na/ de'i lan la slob dpon zla ba grags pa ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs par bshad pa ni nges don yin la/ ma gsungs pa ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i che ba brjod pa tsam yin zhes bzhed la/ slob dpon ar+ya de was spyod bsdus sgron ma las/ rdzogs ldan dang / gsum ldan dang / gnyis ldan gyi dus na bstan bcos med cing / rgyud yod par bshad pas gsang sngags kyi theg pa shākya thub pa'i snga rol tu yod par bzhed cing / 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs par bshad pa ni gdul bya mchog la dgongs la/ ma gsungs par bshad pa ni thun mong gi gdul bya la dgongs pa yin no/ /zhes bzhed do/ /de lta bu'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi ston pa mchog tu gyur pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs mgon mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid la sogs te dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyang / bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa rdo rje'i slob dpon rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par sprul pa las gzhan du go bar mi bya ba'i tshul rgyal ba'i bka' dang / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad ldan rnams las 'byung tshul gyi lung dang sbyar ba gong du brjod zin pa de dag gi don la blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis zhib tu brtags la khong du chud par bya'o/

/'dir smras pa/ ngo mtshar skal bzang las 'phro mchog rnams dgra bcom 'phags pa'i sar bkod cing / /dman 'gro rnams kyang dal ba don yod dkar po'i las la rab bcug ste/ /rgyun chad med par dge la sbyor ba'i 'gro ba'i rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras/ /ston mchog bla na med pa de yang rje btsun bla ma'i rnam 'phrul te/ /thun mong ma yin nye ba'i lam mchog rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnams/ /gang gis gsungs pa'i ston pa rnams kyang gzhan min bdag gi yongs 'dzin 'di/ /gcig nyid thugs kyi rnam 'phrul lags te mdor na dus gsum rgyal ba rnams/ /slob mar bcas pa'i sprul gzhi dam pa dpal ldan bla ma bsngags par 'os/ /sangs rgyas sku gcig zhi khro du ma'i tshul/ /tha dad gar mkhan zlos gar rnam rtsen pa/ /dwangs pa'i shel la tshon gyis kha bsgyur ltar/ /ma 'dres nam mkha'i 'ja' 'od ji bzhin snang / /rigs can gsum gyi snang ngor zas gtsang sras/ /skal bzang rnams la gsang rgyud ston pa po/ /dus mthar dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che'i/ /rnam par byon 'di bdag sogs 'gro ba'i dpal/ /e ma rgyal ba rnams ni dus drug tu/ /dmigs med thugs rjes 'gro ba la gzigs pas/ /gang la gang 'dul tshul gyis skye dgu rnams/ /thar pa'i lam la 'god 'di bka' drin rmad/ /rje btsun khyed dang zas gtsang sras/ /gcig min gcig gi rnam rol te/ /rgyal de 'phags yul 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon khyod snyigs dus skye dgu'i skyabs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo yi/ /rigs kyi bdag por khyed bskur na/ /mchod 'os kun gyi mchod yul khyod/ /bla ma'i nang nas bla ma lags/ /zhes mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyi gzugs dam pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs ngo mtshar sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba las/

dang por rigs can gsum sogs kyi snang ngor 'o skol gyi ston pa mchog gi rnam par bstan tshul legs par bshad pa rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che'i dpag bsam gyi ljon shing zhes bya ba rim par phye ba ste dang po'o// //gnyis pa 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams la sa bcu'i byang sems chen po'i sprul skur ji ltar snang ba'i tshul ni/ bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin bslu ba med pa rje bla ma 'di nyid ni/ gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par yang nas yang du bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul 'di ltar thos te/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi thugs kyi sras mchog rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa'i skyes bu chen po de yang rje btsun mus pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can 'di nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul pa gdon mi za ba yin pas/ de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i cha shas rnams cung zad brjod na/ de yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'phrin las dam pa'i mnga' bdag byang chub kyi sems gnyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches lus can ma lus pa'i dgos 'dod yid bzhin du stsol bar mdzad pa'i thugs rje can/ chen po'i yang chen por gyur pa dag gi cod pan gyi nor bus zhabs kyi pad+mo la mngon par mchod pa/ dus de tsam gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes chen ma lus pa'i gtsug gi rgyan du bkur ba'i mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin chen 'di nyid nges pa'i don du na/ 'og min stug po'i zhing du bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pas rnam par rol pas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma rnams kyi don du dkyil 'khor bdag po'i skur bstan nas mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje can du tshul ston pa snang ba nyid las/

'dul ba'i zhing 'dir ni 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi ngor/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i dbon gyi cha 'dzin pa'i bla ma'i thugs rje yongs su skong ba'i rigs can dam par sku bltams pa'i tshul bstan to/ /de ltar bsam bzhin skye ba'i gnas la mngon par byang chub pa'i dbang las dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar skyongs ba'i smon gnas dang 'brel bar rjes su ston par mdzad de/ byang phyogs mus kyi lung pa'i stod sta mo gling skyar grags pa rgyab ri glang po che 'dra ba'i g.yas 'dabs nas dwangs shing bsil ba'i chu klung 'babs pa/ g.yu skra ma zhes bya ba'i brag ri po sti brtsigs pa 'dra ba yod pa/ ra zhags ma zhes bya ba dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra ba'i sa bkra lhag par bzang ba/ sngon 'phrang brag dmar gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya 'phrang ba dang / de'i gdan sa pa mkhas pa byang chub dar ma zhes pas bstan pa bskyangs pa'i sa cha'i gtsug lag khang dang gsung rab mang po bzhugs pa'i shar phyogs su/ yab sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi lcam mo dkon mchog bzang mo'i sras dkon mchog legs pa zhes bya ba/ yum rje spyan tshab pa tshul khrims bzang po'i a ce chos skyong rgyal mo zhes bya ba'i sras su chu mo bya'i lo karma me bzhi gza' nyi ma dang bcas pa'i 'grub sbyor dge ba la sku bltams shing / gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas gtsug lag gi bkod pa dang / dge 'dun gyi chos grwa /gzhan la chos 'chad pa sogs kyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / dkon mchog gi rten rnams yum la bslangs nas mar me 'bul ba/ phyag dang bskor ba mdzad pa sogs dge ba'i las kho na las gzhan pa'i tha mal gyi rnam g.yengs skad cig kyang mi mdzad ces grags la/ gzhon nu'i skabs kyi mtshan dkon mchog rin chen du gsol/ der skabs sems dpa' chen po'i spyan sngar phyag stobs pa la byon pas/ bka' stsal la/ nged ngor na yod pa'i skabs shig rmi lam du/

chu mig dkar po zhig lha brag lcog po'i shar ldebs su brdol nas rgya je che je cher song ba'i mthar rgyal khams thams cad khyab pa zhig byung ba'i skabs/ byis pa 'di btsas par snang bas rten 'brel legs zhes pa'i lung bstan mdzad/ 'di skabs sta mo stod kyi sras mkhar dgon par gsang sngags rnying ma ba skye med mol gdong sngon po'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang nam mkha' bsod nams pa'i drung la rnying ma'i tshe rta sbrags ma'i dbang gsan skad cing / slar sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs pad la gtugs te spyan sngar 'bral med bzhugs/ rje sems dpa' chen po sku bgres pa'i mthar phyin pa'i skabs zhabs skor nam gnang dus/ phyag g.yas pa rje 'di nyid kyi dbu la bzhag g.yon pas phyag phreng la grangs su gnang nas bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs ring brgya rtsa'i ring zhabs skor gnang ba la nyin gcig bka' lung la/ kho de sngon grwa pa'i dus 'thab mo ba rang zhig yod nas zangs ldan du grwa tshang gnyis 'thabs pa'i gcig shos kyi khang pa'i rgya skar nas rdo zhig 'phangs pas ka ba'i logs la shing la bcos pa'i 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi sku zhig yod pa'i zhal gdong la phog pa zhig byung 'dug pa la/ phyis nyan por mtshams bcad rgya dam po zhig gi dus rmi lam du spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal zhig dang mjal bas/ zhal ras la rma khrag yod pa zhig byung ba/ ci lags zhus pas/ 'di khyod kyis zangs ldan du lag pas brgyab pa min nam gsungs bas yid skrag nas/ 'o na ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ de'i sgrib sbyong la gzungs ring brgya rtsa re sgrongs gsungs pa byung man ma chag par bzlas pa yin gsungs zhes thos shing / de skabs klog dang bya cha chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams rim gyis thugs su chud par mdzad skabs/ de dus mus pa'i dge slong rnam gnyis kyi blo rin pas/ phyogs nas 'dus pa'i khams pa'i grwa pa gtso bor gyur pa la/

dbang rdor phreng / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang bgyis na chog mi chog gi bka' gnang zhu ba la byon byung bas/ rje mus chen drung gis de ltar byas chog pa'i bka' gnang mdzad rjes/ 'o na dbon chung 'di la yang dbang bskur bas chog lags sam zhu ba la/ de ka bgyis/ sang dus tshod gcig na ngor pa'i rdor phreng dang / sbyong dkyil gyi brgyud pa kho la thug pa zhig yong gsungs pa'i ma 'ong lung bstan kyang byon pa yin zhes kyang thos so/ /skabs der kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi 'chad nyan la kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bskos nas/ mus su rje sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs drung du chos zhu ba la rkang gtad byon dus/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa'i tshe/ rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la mkhan po zhus/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel bas slob dpon mdzad/ zhwa lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas grib tshod pa gnang / grub chen dkon mchog blo gros pas grogs ldan/ chos rje blo gros rin chen pa dang bcas pa zhal 'dzoms pa'i dbus su bslab tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes shing / sangs rgyas rin chen zhes rnam par dkar ba'i lam nas mtshan gsol zhing / de'i tshe rje sems dpa' chen po'i gsungs nas bu gcig po chos kyi sgo zhes pa chos pa khyad par can yong gsungs pa'i lung bstan dang / de'i phyi lo dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes skabs sems dpa' chen po'i drung du shog gsungs nas byon pas/ spe'i chos grwa'i sku mdun na rje grub chen yang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ sems dpa' chen po'i gsungs nas/ sngon gnyan rtsa'i lha god ri khrod du ma ṇi bye bsnyen byed dus dung so 'di skyes pa yin pa re zhig mgul du thogs/ de nas rten gsum gyi nang du bzhugs su chug gsung ba'i lung bstan stsal cing / de dus rje sems dpa' chen po dgung lo don bdun pa yin pas/

da lta ngas lon pa'i lo grangs 'di tsam gyi tshe thub pa yin zhes bka' stsal gnang ba la tshems de thugs gnyer skabs mnga' ris ba dbon po nam blos nan bskyed zhus nas phyed bcag nas gnang dgos byung / phyed lhag de sku 'brum bsnyel skabs de dbu sngas kyi rtsig srubs su bzhag pa byi bas khyer nas phyag tu ma byung ba la thugs las gnang zhing / nub gcig mnal lam du rje sems dpa' chen po dang mjal ba la/ sngon lung bstan dang bcas gnang ba'i tshems de bdag gis bor ba zhig byung / tshab tu rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ring nyer gcig dang / tshe gzungs brgya rtsa re byas pas khyab lags sam zhus pas/ de kas yong gsungs pa'i bka' stsal byung gsungs shing / gzungs gnyis po'i grangs btab nyin re bzhin phyag rtse skor la rnam rgyal dang / thugs dam brgya rtsa ma tshe gzungs chag med du gnang bar nges la/ dge tshul gyi slob dpon zhus pa'i kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la sher phyin sum brgya pa/ rdo rje gcod pa'i lung / grib tshod pa zhwa lu pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhig gsan ces grag go /dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa shing mo bya lo'i dbyar de gling kha bde ba can du byams chen sku skye rin po che sku 'khor dang bcas pa gsung ngag zhu ba la zhabs gtad phebs pa'i skabs/ byams chen sku skye rin po che kun dga' chos kyi bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang / kun mkhyen rin po che bsod nams seng ges gtso mdzad nyung bsdus la gsung ngag rin po che zab bshad gnang ba'i chos grwar phebs te/ gsung ngag gi thog ma der gsan cing / 'di skabs byams chen rin po che'i gsung nas/ rje sems dpa' chen po srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi thugs can de yang / dbon chung dgung lo bcu gsum tsam bzhes pa zhig gnang ba de la gzhan ngor thugs rnam par brtse bas khong nam 'byon gzigs rtog gnang rjes chos gral la bzhugs song ba dang /

spyan btsum nas bka' chos 'dzugs par mdzad kyin 'dug pa/ bla ma de dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan can nyid yin pas/ dbon chung de kun la bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu khyad par can zhig yong nges yang yang gsungs par grags shing / de skabs rje 'di'i mnal lam du gling skya'i skya ra zhig gi dbus na khri chen po gcig la sems dpa' chen po sku gzi mdangs dang ldan par bzhugs shing / sku 'khor mang pos bskor 'dug pa la/ nged gzhan rnams kyis 'phur phyin/ gcig 'phur ma thub pa u u zer sdug skad kyi rnam pa dang bcas te bsdad 'dug pa zhig rmis pa'i sang / rje sems dpa' chen po la zhus pas/ 'phur ma thub pa de sgrib pa shas che ba yin gsungs shing / gsung ngag rin po che legs par grol ba'i rjes su yang mnal lam zhig la gle lung nas rje nyid gling zhal yar 'byon gyi 'dug pa'i phar gyi chu kha ru sleb tsa na/ rje grub chen gyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba zhig bsnams byon nas 'di rje sems dpa' chen pos khyod la byin gsung gi 'dug zer gnang byung ba thod pa'i bdud rtsi ma lus par bzhes shing / lhag ma rnams kyang chus bkrus nas bzhes pa'i ngang la mnal sad byung rjes dgongs pa la/ ngas gsung ngag cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa zhig sems dpa' chen po la thob par 'dug chos kyi lhag rnams rje grub chen la zhu dgos pa yong ba snang dgongs pa byung ba/ phyis ji lta ba bzhin mngon sum du gyur to/ /de ltar gsung ngag gnang rjes ston ser rje sems dpa' chen pos bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams dam par mdzad pa grol 'phral/ kun mkhyen rin po che dang / grub chen/ rje nyid gsum gyis gtso mdzad dbang mi nyer gcig la grub gnas de nyid du 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang bskur ba stsal/ de'i dgun khyi lo shar ba rje nyid dgung lo bcu bzhi'i steng du sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen rin po che dang yab sras lhan cig byang ngam ring gi chos sder gsung ngag gnang ba la phebs pa'i phyag phyir dkris nas phebs te/

lam 'bras bar ma gsan cing / de dus rje 'di nyid kyis bka' bcu ba rdor rgyal ba la nged la tshe dbang gcig kyang bskur dgos/ khyed kyi phyag na 'dug pa'i thub pa'i sku 'di yang ster dgos gsungs pas/ khong gis gsungs nas tshe dbang phul chog thub pa'i sku de 'chi dus khyed la 'bul/ de dus khyed kyis nged la dbang bskur zhig cis kyang byed dgos gsungs so/ /phyis de bzhin rang byung gsungs shing / rje nyid dgung lo bco lnga bcu drug bzhes pa'i skabs rnams su rje sems dpa' chen po la bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / lam zab/ bir srung / bde mchog lū dril gyi dbang / rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang dril bu rim lnga/ lū nag dril gsum gyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa'i mtha' bcad/ nā ro mkha' spyod/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / spros med kyi khrid/ kun rig 'chi 'joms/ tshe dbang / don zhags gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang / thugs rje chen po'i rig gtad skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ mgon po lcam dral/ kye rdor rnam bshad/ dbang chu'i bshad pa/ rab gnas don gsal/ 'jam sdud bzang gsum/ ltung bshags/ sgrol ma nyer gcig rnams kyi lung / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed chen mo/ thub pa dgongs gsal/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid/ mus chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong lhan thabs kyi lung / rten 'brel snying po'i khrid rnams gsan cing / rje nyid dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i steng glang lo'i dpyid chos la lam 'bras gsum pa de nyid gsan/ skabs der bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug pa'i drung sems dpa' chen po mjal ba la phebs skabs/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/sems dpa' chen po'i gsung 'bum/ bdag chen de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa thub bstan gser khang ma'i lung rnams gsan to/ /dus der gung ru shes rab bzang po yang sems dpa' chen po mjal ba la byon byung dus/

kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad/ bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer gyi rgyas bshad/ gung ru de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje sems dpa' chen po'i bstod pa dkon mchog gsum dngos ma'i lung gsan/ rje dbon shes rab blo gros ba'i bkas bskul nas sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar rgyas pa rang zhig gi thugs rtsom yang gung rus mdzad cing / dbyar de rje sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams gnang bzhed la/ glang thang nas spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje'i drung dpon slob drag bsdus phebs pa'i zhal ngor/ shar phyogs nas byon pa'i dpon slob rnams la gsung ngag rin po che rdzogs pa shin tu myur ba bka' drin du mdzad rjes smin drug zla ba snga ma'i tshes gsum la/ rje sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams la phebs pa'i/ zla ba phyi ma'i tshes brgyad la zhing brjes pa'i tshul bstan cing / der ngor nas 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho dpon slob rnams gdung mjal dang / gdung 'bul la zhabs gtad phebs byung skabs/ chos 'brel du bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / rdo rje 'chang gi bstod pa 'jam dbyangs chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dad pa'i rba rlabs ma'i lung gsan ces gleng ngo / /der rje nyid dgung lo bco brgyad du phebs skabs stag lo kun mkhyen rin po che'i drung du mdo sngags kyi gsan sbyong mdzad par dgongs nas/ rta nag gser gling bshad grwa btsugs nas lo nga lnga tsam song ba'i 'chad nyan smar ba'i skabs der phebs te bsdus sbyor/ thun mong zin thun sogs la rim gyis thugs sbyong mdzad/ zur chos bka' bcu pa drung nas bsod nams rgya mtsho ba la brten cing rim gyis phar tshad/ sdom rigs sogs gzhung chen rnams la sbyangs brdar gnang ba'i mu nas/ dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa yos lo mdo mkhar du chos dbar mdzad/ nyi shu bzhes pa'i 'brug lo kun mkhyen rin po che la rin spung nas rin chen rtse'i dgon pa phul ba/

zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la rtsis bzhes tsam mdzad/ de'i phyis lo shar ba sbrul gyi lo kun mkhyen rin po che dgung lo zhe lnga'i steng / rje nyid dgung lo nyer gcig tu phebs pa'i zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du rin chen rtser yab sras lhan du phebs nas dgon pa'i gzhi 'dings par mdzad/ thub bstan rnam rgyal du mtshan gsol/ spyi khang sgos khang so so'i las grwa btsugs skabs rje nyid kyis kyang gnas rnying sogs nas shing cha sgrub pa gnang nas mus pa'i spyi khang de nyid 'debs pa gnang zhing / 'di skabs rje nyid kyi yum de nyid kyis gcung ri bo cher thang stong rgyal por mjal ba la byon nas/ bdag gi bu gcig po zhig yod pa de shar phyogs la slob gnyer la song ba/ kho la tshe ring thung ci yong lags zhus pas/ thang stong pa'i zhal nas khyod kyi bu la tshe ring po yong / 'gro phan rgya chen po yong gsungs phyag na nas 'bru kha yar 'dug pa yum gyi sku la gtor byung zer ro/ /dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes pa rta lo nas lo re bzhin gsung ngag lan gsum gyi bar la sgrub pa lung sbyin mthar thug pa'i lam 'bras cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gur sam̐/ kye rdor bka' babs bzhi/ brtag gnyis dag ldan/ gur gur rgyan/ sam̐ pu ṭa gnad kyi gsal byed steng nas rgyud gsum mthil phyin du gsan cing / dag ljon skor gsum la zab bshad nan tan che ba dang / bde mchog lū dril gyi dbang khrid/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud mu tig 'phreng ba/ mkha' 'gro kun spyod rje btsun gyi 'grel ba'i steng nas mdzub khrid legs par stsal cing / gsang 'dus rigs gsum gyi dbang / rim lnga'i dbang khrid/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ 'grel pa sgron gsal/ mtha' drug rab gsal dang bcas pa'i lung bshad/ sbyong rgyud kun mkhyen nyid kyi ṭīk+ka'i steng nas mtha' gcod rgya cher bkral nas gsungs shing / zur bka'i dbang la/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/

sangs rgyas thod pa/ sgrol ma bla med/ a ra pa tsa lha lnga/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod sogs thugs dam rgyun bzhes mtha' dag dang / dmar po skor gsum/ rnam rgyal 'joms sogs rjes gnang zur bka' du ma/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i phyed tsam/ mgon po'i srung 'khor/ kun mkhyen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sngags 'bum phal cher gyi lung / blo sbyong dpal me ma/ do pa'i gcod skor gsum/ sman bla'i mdo chog dang bcas pa gnas nges med du rim can gsan cing rje dgung lo nyer gsum bzhi'i skabs/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i phyag phyir dkris nas shab smad du bdag chen chu mig pa'i drung la/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa ṇa'i bstod pa sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i lung tshogs chos su gsan nas rim gyis khro phu'i byams chen mjal ba gnang nas/ e wam̐ du rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug drung la dpon slob lhan cig don zhags gtso rkyang / dpal mo lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal/ mi g.yo ba sngon po rnams kyi rjes gnang / mi g.yo ba'i chu bsrung rtse mos mdzad pa'i yig skor rnams gsan nas/ dpal ldan sa skyar dpon slob 'khor bcas phebs skabs/ rten mjal zhib rgyas/ rje 'di nyid kyis gnam khu'u'i brgyud pa bla ma mgon bzang pa la zhal bzhi pa dang las mgon gyi rjes gnang / lung 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa gsan gsungs/ de skabs dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du/ tshogs pa kun khyab dang lhan cig dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ srod la grwa pa slob gnyer ba sha stag rnams la 'jam dbyangs kyi sku drung du a ra pa tsa'i rjes gnang gnang nas/ mang mkhar mu gu lung dang / lha rtse'i ga ya dha ra'i sgrub phug rnams kyi gnas mjal gnang rjes/ mdog brgya mkhar du spyan drangs pa'i ser chos kyi lhag ma lus pa tshang bar stsal cing / ga ya dha ra'i mgon rkyang yang gnas de nyid du bstsal ces de dus kyi kun mkhyen zhabs zin dge bshes bgres po dag bsgros shing zhes thos la/

de nas thub bstan rnam rgyal bar phyag phyir phebs/ lo ngo brgyad du nye tsam zhabs pad brtan par mdzad skabs/ rta nag phyogs na 'brum nad 'dug pa la 'dzem nas mus la log byon pas/ 'brum pas 'brangs nas lam du sku 'brum gyis bsnyungs nas gru gu 'phrang gi 'og rngas lung du bzhugs dgos pa byung zhing / der sku 'brum legs par dwangs nas mus su byon cing / de'i phyis lo rje nyid dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i skabs de nas bzung ste lo bco brgyad kyi bar du rje grub chen dkon mchog blo gros nyid la gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa ma lus pa'i bka' drin nod par mdzad/ de yang gtso bor gsung ngag rin po che bzlas pa lan drug tu nan chags su gsan cing / glegs bam dkar chag tu thebs pa'i yig sna drug cu dang / po sti dmar chung dkar chag nang ltar cha lag ma lus pa'i dbang byin rlabs/ rgyu lam/ bdag med ma phyi nang / lam zab thun mong / thun mong ma yin pa/ bir srung yang de bzhin du thun mong thun mong ma yin pa/ lam sbas bshad/ brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud/ sgrub pa lung sbyin pa'i bar yang dang yang du nod par mdzad cing / de las gzhan gzhung bshad sras don ma/ dmar ma/ pod nag la sogs kyis mtshon pa'i yig lung rnams dang / bde mchog nag po pa'i rdul tshon la brten pa'i dbang rgyun ma nyams pa dang / lū dril gnyis kyi dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu/ rnam rgyal 'joms kyi rjes gnang / mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad sogs rjes gnang sgo du ma dang / do gcod skor gsum gyi khrid tshang ma/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ rje rdo rje 'chang dang sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi rnams dang / gzhan yang spyod 'jug 'jam bsdud bzang gsum sogs lung phran du ma yang dang yang du gsan cing / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang yi ge drug pa'i bzlas lung gis mtshon pa'i nyer mkho phran bu rnams ni lan grangs brgya phrag du ma nod par mdzad gsungs shing /

dge slong rnam gnyis kyi dpal mgon pa'i drung du yang / bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang / phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs khrid bcas/ mchod rten drung thob kyi khrid/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ma dang / grub pa'i rgyal mo'i dbang / de la brten pa'i tshe khrid/ do gcod lugs kyi nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang / phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rjes gnang rnams gsan skad do/ /de nas rje nyid dgung lo nyer bdun du phebs sa phag lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i gnam gang la/ rje zhwa lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang byang ngam ring gi pho brang gi rtse mor gshegs pa la brten/ de'i phyi lo byi ba lor bde ldan phug tu rje grub chen lam 'bras gsung ba la spyan drangs skabs/ rje nyid kyis kyang phyag phyir phebs te/ dus der dgung lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa'i steng rje grub chen dkon mchog blo gros kyis mkhan po gnang / drung btsun dpal ldan rgyal po bas las kyi slob dpon mdzad/ grub chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan pas gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon dang / chos rje byams pa chos legs pas grib tshod/ gzhan yang kha skong dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa legs par bzhes te/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa 'bum phrag gi mkhan po'i gnas su mnga' gsol ba'i bkra shis dge mtshan du ma'i dpal dang ldan par gyur cing / sngon rje sems dpa' chen po sta te lung du bzhugs dus nye gnas phyag g.yog mdzad cing / bde mchog rin chen bzhi yi bsnyen pa thog mar mdzad pa po/ gsang ston du gyur pa'i grub chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa la'ang bde mchog nag po pa dang / kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang yang gsan/ de nas dgung lo sum cu so gnyis la phebs skabs/ 'brug lo bde ba can gyi gzim khang sgor mo na bzhugs skabs dad ldan 'ga' zhig gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/

lam 'bras shig gnang bzhed mdzad dus/ rje grub chen bsam gtan phug na bzhugs yod pas/ rje 'di la yar spyan drongs gsungs/ mjal dus bka' zhal la/ da res lam 'bras ma gsung bar thugs dam bcad rgya dam pa cig mdzod/ 'tshub cha en tsam gda' gsungs/ ji ltar gda' zhus pas/ nyid kyi chos gos de nga la yang yang skyel du byung ba rmis gsungs/ de nas gzim khang sgor mor mgon po che ba'i bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i mnal lam du bzhugs khri rgya che la dpang mtho ba zhig gi steng na rje nyid bzhugs pa la/ na bza' snam sbyar bzang la grangs mang ba gsol ba'i mnal lam byung bas/ da 'tshub cha sangs pa 'dra dgongs pa byung zhing / rje grub chen dang mjal nas zhus pas/ legs gda'/ da lam 'bras gsung ba zhu gsungs nas bka' legs par gnang ste gzim khang sgor mo nyid du/ skal ldan 'khor gyi thog mar gyur pa chos 'phel rgyal mtshan/ rgyal bzang gnyan rtse ba/ slob dpon bsod shes/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba/ dge slong dkon mchog dpal/ slas pa 'phags smyon/ dbon po dpal 'byor rgyal mtshan te bdun la/ sngon ston pas yul wa rā ṇa ser 'khor lnga sde bzang po la bka' dang po'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang tshul mtshungs par gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba'i thog ma de nyid bar chad med par legs par mthar phyin to/ /de skabs sngon rje sems dpa' chen po'i gsungs nas/ khyod kyis smyung gnas dkar po mchog brgyad kyi bsnyen pa yang yang 'khyol ba yin pas/ lus reg pa'i chu tsam gyis kyang sems can rnams ngan song las 'dren thub pa yin pas/ khong pa chu bshan gyis gsungs/ stod ras dkar po yug kyis sku lus bcings nas/ gzhung chu la drud ma bshal gyi sku rtsed gnang ba'i spyan ras gzigs byams pa chos 'od pa'i drung las bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / smyung gnas brgyud pa'i rnam thar cho ga'i lung / don yod zhags pa'i rgyud chung rnams kyi lung gsan cing /

rje 'di nyid zhing ba rjes dus yu mo dgon par phebs nas sku gdung zhugs la 'bul ba sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams legs par mdzad ces gleng ngo / /rje byams pa chos 'od pa 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis yang yang zhal ston pa'i dbang phyug cig yin te/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen nyid sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po yin par yang / rje byams pa chos 'od de nyid la 'phags pas dngos su lung bstan pa yin te/ de'i tshul rnams rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do/ /skabs shig gdong yangs kyi phur dben pa bsten nas/ yig brgya/ bde dges/ gshed 'jigs/ kun rig 'chi 'joms/ tshe dpag med lugs gnyis/ seng ge sgra ku ru kul+le/ chos skyong che chung rnams kyi bsnyen sgrub rim gyis gnang zhing / de dag gi kha gso'i sbyin sreg mtha' dag kyang lha bsnyen gang dang gang gi zhabs la thogs par mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi sbyin bsreg skabs/ mar gling kha nas len mi ma 'byor bar gsol ja rdor yang chad pa'i skabs der/ gsol dpon thugs rje ba la sbyin sreg gi sta gon gyis bka' stsal gnang ba la/ rgyu mtshan phul bas/ ster mkhan yong ba dag kyang srid gsungs pa'i sang de zhal mi 'tshon pa'i 'brog mo gzhon nu zhig gis mar khal gsum tsam dang / zho thud mang po phul/ de skabs mar me'i kong bu chung du zhig gis nyin gang thub pa dang / nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi ri mo rnam par bkra ba/ sbyin sreg gi me lce lha'i phyag mtshan gyi rnam par 'bar ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung rjes/ sa de nyid du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas bde mchog gi dbang thog ma dbon po dpal 'byor ba dang / gsol dpon thugs rje sogs la gnang bar grags shing / gdong yangs su bzhugs ring nor 'dzin gyi bcud len kho na'i bka' thub la brten par mdzad ces kyang sgrog la/ sku mtshams kyi mu yang snga rting lo drug tsam gyi ring mdzad par mngon zhing /

gnas der lho pa dbon po dang / ne ring sems ma sogs kyis zhus nas gsung ngag tshar gnyis kyang gnang skad do/ /dgung lo so bzhir phebs pa rta lo gling kha bde ba can gyi khri thog tu phebs te/ dus der rje grub chen gyis sems dpa' chen po la ting dkrol gnas su mkha' 'gro mas phul ba'i thub pa'i gser sku de yang bstsal nas bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur bar mdzad/ de'i phyi lo rje nyid gle lung du gdan drangs te gsung ngag gnang skabs/ gle lung nang pa'i dgon chung na sngags 'chang mchog rgyal ba bzhugs 'dug pa la/ mus lugs kyi dud sol lha mo'i rjes gnang gsan cing rje mus rab 'byams pa dpon slob rnams dga' ldan rtser chos dbar la phebs 'dug pas/ zhu ba'i gtso bo mdzad nas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bskur tshar gcig dang / blo sbyong gcod khrid la sogs pa'i bka' chos mang du gnang zhes thos so/ /de nas dgung lo so bdun du phebs pa bya lo cho 'phrul chen po'i nyer gcig la sngon mo rdzong du chos dbar steng du byes lam de nyid du kun mkhyen rin po che gshegs pa'i skad cha rim gyis snyan du dgongs pas thog mar thos mchod kyi rim pa rnams dgon pa so sor sgrub pa mdzad rjes/ gdung mjal dang dgongs rdzogs sgrub pa la rta mo gtsang brgyud la byas byon pas/ lam du chibs pa nyal ba sogs thugs dam gyi ltas cung zad rtsub pa byung nas tshur chibs kha bsgyur te/ rje grub chen gle lung chos sde na bzhugs pa'i drung du byon cing / thub bstan rnam rgyal du mang ja 'gyed bcas gdung 'bul bsgrub mi rdzong ba gnang / rje nyid kyis de bzhugs kyi dge 'dun kun la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid dang / thub pa dgongs gsal gyi lung zhig gnang / lo de'i dbyar gsos sha dug gis rkyen byas te rje nyid kyi yab gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rnams legs par grub skabs/

rje shes rab blo gros pa'i gsung gis/ dkon mchog legs pa kho byang 'brog pha gir song yod ces lung bstan pa ltar/ dge ru nag tshangs pa'i khrod du yab la sku skye byung ba rje nyid dang mjal lo/ /gnas skabs de dag tu yang gtso bor grub chen nyid kyi spyan sngar 'bral ba med par bzhugs te/ sngar brjod pa'i chos kyi sgo mtha' dag yang yang du bzlas nas gsan par mdzad cing / gzhan du chos don du gnyer ba'i dad 'dus ma lus pa'i re ba yid bzhin du bskong ba'i dbang lung byin rlabs rjes gnang gang la gang 'dod kyi chos kyi char chen po phab cing / yang gtso bor gyur pa thugs dam nyams bzhes nyid la nan tan rjes sgrub khor mor gnang zhing / rje shes rab blo gros pa la nan bskyed gsol ba btab pas gzim khang gi sgo bar du bcug pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig stsal ces sgrog cing / slar yang kyai rdo rje gzhi'i bsnyen pa kha gso'i sbyin sreg dang bcas zhib len du mdzad pas thugs tshim pa'i ngang nas mnal lam du/ me long rab tu dwangs pa lta bu'i dkyil na ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i sku mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs shin tu phra zhing brjid pa'i rnam par gzigs pa dang / mnal lam du rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa a tsa ra'i cha byad can du mjal ba sogs thugs dam gyi 'char sgo gong 'phel gyi ngang nas/ res 'ga' chos gsung res 'ga' thugs dam bcad rgya la bzhugs shing / nyin zhag phrugs rer rnal 'byor dgus dus 'da' bar mdzad de/ gtso bor lam dus sogs 'chag med bzhi thun bzhir bzhag nas/ de las gzhan bir srung thun mong ma yin pa/ bla ma rin 'byung / bde mchog nag dril/ gshed 'jigs/ 'dod lha rnam grangs mang ba/ tshe sgrub srung zlog sbyin sreg phyi gtor nang gtor sogs khor mar gnang zhing / mdor na sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las ma lus pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa kho na'i rnam rol las skad cig kyang 'da' ba med pa'i ngang tshul ston par mdzad pa zhig go

/de nas rje nyid dgung lo zhe gsum du phebs pa yos lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu la rje grub chen bsam gtan phug tu bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gdung gi phyag g.yog sreg blugs 'bul ba/ dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya che ba dang / nang rten rje grub chen nyid kyi sku gser zangs las grub pa mda' gang pa gcig dang / phyi rten khang bu brtsegs pa gnyis bzhengs par mdzad nas/ sku gdung gi tsha tsha rnams nang bzhugs su mdzad cing / nas khal brgyas mtshon pa'i gzhi rten bzang po sbyor bar mdzad nas/ dus mchod la gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i bsgrub mchod 'dzugs pa gnang zhing / de mthun kun mkhyen rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs ched/ gser zangs las grub pa'i sku mda' gang pa zhig dang / gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub mchod kyang 'dzugs pa gnang rjes/ dgung lo zhe bzhi bzhes pa 'brug lo lha sar jo skor la zhabs btsugs phebs skabs/ jo bo rnam gnyis drung du dkar me rgya cher phul cing / smon lam dgongs bzhed ltar tshims par mdzad nas/ gtsang phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur ba'i yar lam 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang gis gtso mdzad sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu la/ gsung ngag lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang / lung / gdams pa'i sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos kyi char chen po phab cing / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug drung btsun rin chen rnam rgyal la snying por gyur pa'i dbang lung gdams pa'i bcud mang du gsan cing / drung btsun pa nyid la/ rje drung gis 'jigs byed rwa lugs bcu gsum ma dang / ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang / las gshin bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang / dug dbang rma bya rgyas pa/ ra pod kyi lung / gur mgon bcu gcig ma'i rjes gnang / gdong gnyan can gyi rjes gnang / chos skyong che ba'i yig cha rnam grangs mang po'i lung /

grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe dbang khrid dang bcas pa/ tshe 'phel dkar po'i lung rnams gsan cing / de skabs na len+d+ra nas spyan 'dren byung ba la zhal bzhes kyi sgo yod tsam gnang nas/ yar lam e wam̐ chos ldan du rje yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba mjal ba la phebs dus/ yongs 'dzin gyi bka' zhal la/ skyed tshal tshor bka' chos sgo du mas bstan pa'i rgyun spel ba gnang ba yid bde zhing / drung btsun rin rnam pa la 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang 'ga' re gsan zer ba thos byung pa/ lung phan tshun gsan pa la nged dran pa la/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho glo bo nas 'dir phebs skabs/ snga chos la tshogs kyi bzhugs khri'i mdun du 'bol grum re'i steng du 'jam dbyangs chos rje bzhugs nas/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa mtshams kyi lung sogs gsan pa gnang zhing / dgong chos la bzhugs khri khar 'jam dbyangs chos rje bzhugs/ 'bol grum steng du rje mus chen bzhugs nas bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo sogs kyi lung gsan pa dngos su mthong / dbang phan tshun bskur ba 'di/ khyod dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ zer bar su dmyal bar 'gro rgyu snang gsungs pa la/ rje nyid kyis su yang dmyal bar mi 'gro lags zhus pas/ gral bzhugs rnams bzhad gad dir ba byung zhes grags shing / skabs der yongs 'dzin drung du dbu sems lugs gnyis kyi sems bskyed/ rgyu lam/ lam zab/ tshar gsum khug pa/ lam skor bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs/ chos skyong lcam dral gyi rjes gnang rnams gsan cing / snga phyir 'jam dkar rjes gnang / nag po gzhung drug gi rgya gzhung / sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i nag 'bum/ bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i gshed dmar lha lnga la brten pa'i rgya gzhung brgyad/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i spros med stong thun rnams kyi lung gsan ces thos so/ /de skabs mus nang gi dgon pa so sor sku 'khyos kyi mang ja 'gyed bcas dang /

mkhyen rtogs kyi mnga' bdag drung btsun dpal ldan rgyal po'i drung du sku chos kyis thog drangs/ na bza' cha tshang skyer kha grabs cig sgrub pa rnams dang / ja gos dar sogs 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul ba gnang zhing / bdag med ma phyi dkyil nang dkyil/ kye rdor lus dkyil rnams kyi dbang dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu/ bde mchog lū nag gi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa spyi dang / khyad par dpal mngon par rtogs pa gnyan phul byung pa'i 'bru 'bum dang sbyar ba'i zab bshad mthil phyin pa gsan cing / sngon dge slong dpal mgon pa la gsan lhag gi lam skor phyi ma/ bsam mi khyab byin rlabs khrid bcas/ gzhan lhan cig skyes grub/ zab pa'i tshul dgu/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po bsrang ba/ in+d+ra bhu ti'i phyag rgya'i lam khrid sogs kyi lung rnams dang / bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs khrid bcas/ pu tra ming sring gi rjes gnang / mgon po'i srung 'khor brag rdzong ma zhal shes kyis brgyan pa/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i nang khrid/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang rnams gsan cing / gtso bor dben gnas rnams su thugs dam gong 'phel gyi ngang nyid nas/ thun mtshams rnams su gsung gi bdud rtsis skal ldan gyi re ba tshul bzhin du bskong ba'i skabs nyid du bzhugs pa las/ dgung lo zhe brgyad steng du nā len+d+ra nas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya/ rje ngor chen gyi phyag dam nan bskyed dang bcas dben gnas gdong yangs su bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar son pa na/ sngon rje mus chen gyi gsung gis/ sa skya pa'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i ming en tsam 'di rje rdo rje 'chang dang kun mkhyen rong ston kho na'i phyag rjes su bzhag pa yin yang yang gsungs pa thugs la gsal bar bzhugs pa'i tshul dgongs te/ chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur nas phebs skabs/ de lo dbus gtsang kun na char shin tu dkon par 'dug pa la/ rje nyid gang phebs kyi sar thub pa'i gser sku ting dkrol ma la sku khrus gsol bar mdzad ma thag char rgyun snyoms par phebs pas skye 'gro'i re ba gang bar mdzad bzhin du rim gyis gshegs/

lam bde bar nā len+d+ra'i chos grwa chen por phebs te/ 'dus pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pas spyan drangs te/ rong ston smra ba'i seng ge'i chos kyi khri la bkra shis mnga' gsol legs par phul te/ de nas bzung nas lo bcu drug tsam gyis bar zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rim par bskor cing / rje nyid bzhugs pa'i ring dus bde zhing phan tshun 'khrug long sogs kyi g.yeng ba gtan nas med pa dang / 'phan yul spyi khyab tu nad yams sogs yod kyang / dgon par grwa pa gcig la'ang nyer 'tshes ma gtan ma gos pa dang / mig mthong pa rnams kyis sgrog pa la nā len+d+ra'i mtha' me 'od kyis bskor nas/ nad bdag rnams kyis mig lta mi nus pa 'dug ces phyogs kun tu khyab cing / gnas de nyid du kun rig gi dkyil 'khor blos bslangs gtsang khang dang bcas pa bzhengs par mdzad cing / bya lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin rje shes rab blo gros pas sku 'khris na rgyun sdod nye gnas la/ byin rlabs thel 'byar dang / rten mchod 'di rnams chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen la 'phrod nges dang / bor zags med pa gyis kyi bka' lung stsal pas/ khos drung pa gar 'byon pa lags zhus pas/ sdug ge khyod kyis mi go ya gi na bde ba can zer ba na rje sems dpa' chen po bzhugs pa de'i drung du 'gro gsungs/ 'o na nga yang phyag phyir 'khrid dgos zhus pas/ dngos spyad 'di rnams 'phrod nges gyis dang / ngas bsu bar yong gis gsung bzhin pa'i ngang nas bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul rnams sgrog cing / kho rang yang myur du bsu mkhan yong ba yod zer dga' dga' las/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa mi byed pa byung zhes grags shing / de mthun gling kha nas rgyu mtshan 'bul ba dang spyan 'dren zhu mi sku mdun du son 'phral chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur nas/ ston btsas chod tsam la phebs 'phral rang / rje sher blo'i nye gnas des byin rlabs rten sogs ma lus pa phyag tu phul nas/

de nub rang skas them gsum la brdabs tshul gyis gum pa la/ me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od sogs ltas dpag med byung ba bdag gi bla ma rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid gsung chos gnang ba'i skabs mtshams rnams la yang yang du bka' stsol ba thos pa lags shing / der dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs/ nang rten sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sku mtho gsum lhag pa zhig dang / phyi rten khang bu brtsegs pa mtshar ba zhig bzhengs rjes/ lo de nyid la gtsang bsam 'grub rdzong du byang pa bdag po kun dga' legs pa sku mched kyis spyan drangs/ tshe dbang sogs bka' 'brel thog mar gsan cing / de'i dgun gling kha nyid du gsung ngag tshar gcig gnang nas/ khyi lo shar tsam la slar yang shar phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur te phebs skabs/ smyug la paṇa chen dang / rje karma 'phrin las pas zhu ba'i gtso mdzad de/ rin chen gling du gsung ngag tshar gcig gnang zhing / gzhan nā lan+d+ra nyid du gtso bor bzhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / byang rwa sgreng gi gnas mjal la yud tsam phebs pa mdzad/ skabs shig tshar pa sna'i g.yas ngos kyi rdzong chung der sku mtshams bcad rgya ma zhig gnang bar grags shing / gnas de nyid du mus rab 'byams pa dkon mchog grags pa sogs kyi bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang yang thob ces sgrog la/ 'jun pa mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog pas spyan drangs te/ srin po rir phebs pa'i mtshan mo bde mchog gi drung du bzhugs pas thugs spro ba rgya cher 'phel zhing / sku de yang res 'ga' a tsa ra'i rnam pa rib rib ston pa zhig byung gsungs zhes grags shing / glang lo dbur stod lo dgon par spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas spyan drangs te gsung ngag gis gtsos pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ches cher bskor ba mdzad nas gtsang phyogs la phebs pa'i dus/ rong chung gi g.yung mda' mkhar du phebs/ gsol ran nas gsol ja sun gnyis song nas phebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas/

da dung ja sbyor gcig thob mi 'gro gsungs/ de ma khad mi gcig byung pa la ma 'gro gsungs pas/ khos bka' la ma nyan par phyin pas/ 'phrang dkyil du rbab phog ste bsad/ de'i phyed gtsang po'i dkyil du lhung ba dpon slob rnams kyi gzigs pas/ da ci ma phyin na yong ba yod gsungs/ kho'i don du smon lam mdzad ces grag la/ snga gong ngor nas mus la phebs skabs shig rub ma'i thad la kha dar srab po zhig chags 'dug pa'i steng la dpon slob dres khal kun phebs 'phral dar zhig ces kyang gleng ngo / /de ltar lam la bar chad kyis ma gos shing / mngon par shes pa'i rnam par rol pas brtsen bzhin du gling kha nyid du bde bar phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med pa bskor ba'i ngang nyid nas gser zangs las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang mtho bzhi'i khyon dang / sems dpa' chen po'i sku 'dra rgyab mtho lnga yod pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku rkang gang pa zhig sogs 'bur sku rnam grangs du ma/ bris sku lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bla sku brgyad/ yi dam chos skyong gnyis dang gras 'grig bcus mtshon pa'i rgyu gos dar ras gzhi sogs du ma la bzhengs pa gnang zhing / skabs der ngor e wam̐ nas rje ngor chen gyis gtso bor bka' stsal gnang zhing / khyad par mnga' ris bzhi sde ba chos rje rnam rgyal bas bzang sman ltos che ba 'bul ba dang bcas bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub dgos pa'i gsol btab nan cher mdzad nas/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga lngar phebs pa me mo yos lo sa ga zla ba la sgrub par dgongs pa'i mnal lam du bkris pa'i mtshan ltas khyad par can byung zhing / de'i sang bla ma dben po ba grogs mched bskyar zhus kyi gsol btab la phebs pa rten 'brel 'grig par dgongs nas/ dben gnas bsam gtan phug tu kha gso'i bsnyen pa zhag bdun ma zhig gnang rjes/ sgrub pa'i phyag g.yog gnang dgos rje spyan tshab pa tshul khrims bzang po/

bla ma dbon po ba/ dge slong dpal 'byor ba/ dge slong dkon mchog dar/ sgrub chen byang chub dpal bzang / dbon po thugs rje dpal bzang rnams la dam tshig gso ba'i dbang bskur zhig gnang rjes/ nyer gsum nas gnam gang bar la tshul bzhin sgrub par mdzad pas/ phyi rol tu 'ja' 'od/ me tog gi char/ dri bzang po'i ngad/ rol mo'i sgra snyan sogs kun khyab tu byung zhing / rje spyan tshab pa sogs kyi mnal lam du mkha' 'gro mas shing 'bras sman sna tshogs 'bul mi yang yang byung ba'i dge mtshan dang bcas sgrub pa mthar phyin te/ ril bu 'phel cha blo 'das/ sman pa rnams na re/ nged kyi sman phye ma tshod de tsam la ril bu byas na/ 'di'i phyogs tsam yang mi yong zhu bas mtshon zhing / de nas thog mar phud e wam̐ du 'bul mi dang / sman gyi sbyin bdag chos rje rnam rgyal ba la karma gan dkar btad nas gnang bar grags shing / gzhan skal ldan ma lus pa'i dam tshig gi rten byar sa steng yongs su khyab par mdzad do/ /der skabs gser mdog can nas paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyis zhu yig ja sigs kyi rten bcas 'bul ba gnang nas/ 'dir lam 'bras brgyud pa zhig bzhengs yod pa'i spyan sngar/ mus rdo las grub pa'i ka pā la lam 'bras brgyud pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa zhig thugs la 'dogs dgos zhu ba byung ba la/ rdo rgyus kyi thod pa kha gcod dang bcas pa zab brkos bdud rtsi ril bu thum dang bcas pa 'bul ba gnang bas mchog tu dges pa 'khrungs shing / bdud rtsi ril bu zhig ljags steng du bzhag nas/ 'di lta bu'i dri ro blo'i yul las 'das sman phal pa'i rnam cha las khyad par du 'phags pa ngo mtshar zhes bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad ces thos shing / de nas gling khar mgon khang gsar pa zhig sgrub pa gnang ba'i rten gtsor rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku mi tshad las che ba dang / mgon po'i zhal 'bag shin tu gnyan pa zhig bzo ba gnang zhing /

'brug lo rje nyid kyi yum bde bar gshegs pa la dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa cho ga lam ston sogs rgya cher gnang bas/ sku'i skye ba gsal bar byon zhing / rje nyid kyis bka' stsal la/ rang re'i lhag bsam/ cho ga bsngo ba smon lam sogs kyi nus mthu ni cang min nam/ pha ma gnyis kyis mi lus gtsang ma thob gsungs dgyes dgyes gnang zhes grags so/ /slar yang shar phyogs la phebs skabs/ lha sar jo mjal dang / rje karma chos grags rgya mtsho mjal ba la phebs te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ ma ṇi'i lung / sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid rnams gsan nas/ nā len+d+ra sogs su bka' chos rim can rgya cher gsungs rjes/ slar gtsang phyogs la phebs pa'i sgro dbyer gsol ran nas/ phyag g.yog pa rnams kyis bzhugs grabs byas pas da lta rang 'gro gsungs/ myur thabs phebs pa gnang bas/ dpon slob rnams kyis 'phrang sgrol nas lag rgyang gang tsam song ba dang / 'phrang zhig ste zhag mang po'i bar du 'grul chad ces yongs la grags shing / rta lo dga' ba gdong du lam 'bras sogs chos 'khor bskor skabs/ 'ba' ra nas sprul sku nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan pa yang bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub pa la phebs/ de'i dbyar thub bstan yangs pa can du gsung ngag rin po che 'dus pa'i dge 'dun yongs la bka' drin du mdzad nas phyi lo lug gi lo la bzang ldan chos sder gsung ngag gnang skabs/ sa skya dang nye ba'i dgon chos 'khor lhun po nas chos rje dngos grub dpal 'bar ba phebs pa la/ kye rdor bka' babs bzhi sogs zur bka' dpag med stsal cing / lo de nyid kyi zla ba brgyad pa la sa skya nas brgyud de nā len+d+rar phebs nas dus chos khor mar gnang ste/ sprel lo dbyar sos gtsang la phebs dus/ yar lam 'bras yul skyed tshal du rje nor bu phun tshogs kyis gtso mdzad mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa la gsung ngag rin po che'i zab rgyas stsal nas zla ba brgyad pa la thub bstan yangs pa can du phebs/

gdung brgyud rin po che bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched la rab byung gnang zhing / rje mus pa thugs rje dpal bzang po'i nang rten gser sku'i rab gnas mnga' gsol yang mdzad de/ gling khar phebs nas bzhugs skabs/ e wam̐ nas rje ngor chen gyi bka' shog nan bskyed phebs te/ chibs kha bsgyur nas byon pa'i mar lam/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gnyis la dngul chu chos rdzong gi zhal bdag dang / rgyal sras pa'i khri thog nas bka' chos kyi 'brel tsam mdzad nas myur stabs lam spyod gnang / e wam̐ du phebs pa'i rje nyid dgung lo re gcig tu son pa na/ bya lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i 'grub sbyor la/ bla ma dam pa'i rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur te/ de'i nyin nas tshogs la lam 'bras gsungs/ sgrub mchod grol 'phral yar la chibs kha bsgyur te gling khar phebs nas lam 'bras tshar gcig gsungs 'phral/ ston ya ma bde ldan phug tu thub pa'i lugs sku rgyab mtho bzhi pa zhig bzhengs pa gnang ba'i rab gnas nub mnal lam du rje sems dpa' chen po dang mjal ba'i dge mtshan khyad par can byung zhing / lo de'i zla ba bcu pa la ngor du phebs nas yab sras zhal rgyas pa'i mnyes tshor dpag tu med pa'i ngang nas/ gtso bor sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i zhal snga nas la/ gur bsam gyi dbang bskur bka' 'brel gyi thog mar stsal cing / gzhan yang gdul bya so so'i re ba bskong ba'i dbang chos rgya cher gsungs/ khyi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes lnga la rje ngor chen bla brang nas thar pa rtser phebs/ tshes drug la rje 'di nyid kyis tshogs su dus chos 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyi shar la rje ngor chen gzhan don la dgongs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa mthil phyin pa sgrub par mdzad nas/ sgrub mchod grol rjes/ zla ba lnga pa la mus/ ngam ring / sa skya/ gting skyes/

chu 'dus rnams su rang rang gi bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi bdud rtsis smin grol la bkod/ slar e wam̐ du lo de nyid kyi zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer lnga la phebs nas/ rje ngor chen gyi dgongs pa rdzogs ched/ bzo phud sems dpa' chen po'i dngul sku chung ba gcig kun mkhyen rin po che dang / rje yongs 'dzin gyi sku/ lam zab brgyud pa'i kha skong chung ba re dang / lam 'bras lha khang du sku 'dra che ba gser zangs las grub pa re re/ gtsang khang du rnam rgyal mchod rten gser zangs las grub pa rnams mthar phyin cing / de mthun lam 'bras brgyud pa'i kha skong du sman ldig la mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku zhig dang / thar pa rtser bzhugs rgyu'i rje ngor chen gyi gzim mal sku 'dra zhig kyang sgrub pa gnang nas/ phag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gcig la rab gnas lhan cig gnang ba'i bco lnga man dus chos kyi gsung ngag 'dzugs par mdzad nas sa ga'i sgrub mchod grol rjes khams 'gros pa rnams la bsnyen rdzogs stsal nas/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bdun la dpal nams dga' ba gdong du spyan drangs/ der lhun grub rtse nas sde pa'i drung yang phebs pa la dbang rjes gnang sogs gang la gang 'dod kyi bdud rtsi stsol bar mdzad pas re ba yongs su bskangs nas/ zla ba dgu pa'i sa mchod la ngor du phebs/ de nas yar phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur ba gnang nas mjad du phebs skabs/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis sku mched kyis gsung chos dgos pa'i gsol btab nan bskyed gnang ba la/ de ltar na mus rang la 'byon pa 'thad gsungs dpon slob lhan du gling khar phebs te/ zla ba dgu pa phyi ma'i tshes gnyis gza' skar shin tu bzang ba'i steng du sku mtshams dam pa gnang ngos bdag chen sku mched dang phyag g.yog bzhi la gsung ngag gi dbu 'dzugs pa gnang zhing / skabs der 'du khang du bzhugs rgyu'i sems dpa' chen po'i sku 'dra sku tshad ma legs par bsgrub pa gnang nas/

zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi dus chen steng du rab gnas dga' ston rgya cher stsal cing / byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rnam 'phrul bstan/ de nas ngam ring du phebs te byang pa'i bdag po dpon blon rnams la chos kyi rnyed pa stsal nas/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gsum la dngul chu chos rdzong du phebs/ der zhag 'ga' yar gtor 'bul brgya rtsa cher gtad gnang nas/ e wam̐ du phebs rjes byi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la dus chos 'dzugs pa gnang ba legs par grol rjes/ sa ga'i tshes gsum gyi 'grub sbyor steng du rje lha mchog seng ge pa sku'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol gnang ba'i/ tshes brgyad la shar phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur te/ dbyar chos nā len+d+rar bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas gtso mdzad pa'i tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la gsung ngag gnang rjes nged na so rgas/ gtsang dbus kyi bar lam bgrod dka' ba nas nā len+d+ra'i khur 'bogs bzhi sde chos rje rnam rgyal ba la byas pa yin kyang / zla ba gcig las ma bzhugs pa'i bskyar log dgos pa 'di byung / da gser ga bdag po'i dper 'dug cing / dbus phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa bar gnang bas 'di nas khur bzhes gnang ba zhu zhes sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa la dgon pa'i rtsis 'bul gnang nas/ glang lo gtsang la phebs res yar lam gting skyes phyogs la mdzad skabs thub bstan rin chen gling du bya btang rjes lam zab kyi yon du gser zho sum cu tham pas mtshon pa'i dngos po dpag tu med pa 'bul ba gnang ba rnams tshur lam sa skyar tshogs 'gyed gnang zhing / zla ba lnga pa la gling khar phebs nas en tsam bzhugs rjes/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug la mjad mthong smon du byang pa bdag po yab sras kyis spyan 'dren zhu ba gnang / bka' dbang du ma gsan cing / lhag par sku rim la dmigs pa'i chos skyong gi bskang gso zhag bdun pa zhig mdzad nas dngul chur phebs te/

zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la chos rje 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis pa la gdan sa'i bsko bzhag gnang nas/ tshes bcu gsum la chibs kha bsgyur ba'i bcu gcig snga phyed tsam la gling khar phebs mtshams gsol ja zhig grol rjes/ de ring rang gza' skar bzang ba yod gsungs gzim khang thar pa rtse'i gzhi bting / zla ba dgu pa'i sa mchod la thog phub kyi dga' ston rgya cher gnang / nang bzhugs byin rlabs rten dpag med bzhugs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten gser zangs las grub pa/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i lugs sku grub chen gyi sku 'dra dang mnyam pa gcig bzhengs pa gnang / stag lo'i dgun chos la thar pa rtser bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis sku mched dang / bya btang chos rjes gtso mdzad tshogs shin tu che ba la gsung ngag rin po che sogs zab chos dpag med gsungs/ de'i dpyid lha bris pa lha btsun pas rgyal ba rigs lnga re re la gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba'i bris sku thog tshad ma lnga/ dpon rgyal rtse bas sa skya pa chen po'i sku 'dra se'u ma/ khams pa chos rgyal bas gser gyi glegs bam/ byang chub chen po'i mchod rten sngar gyi rnam rgyal dang mnyam pa/ sems dpa' chen po'i sku rkang gang pa gcig rnams sgrub par mdzad/ de'i lo rje rdo rje 'chang gi dus mchod la gur rigs bsdus dang / hor bzlog la dmigs pa'i sa phur btsugs pa gnang ba la rgyu rkyen nas khal brgya phrag re sbyor ba gnang / yos lo dgun chos la gling kha dang / dbyar chos la ya mar gsung ngag zhig gnang rjes 'brug lo bzang ldan chos sder/ gzhir bzhugs phyogs 'dus dang bcas pa'i tshogs shin tu che ba la gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba'i/ sngags lam skabs zhag 'ga' mgul shab pa'i tshul ston pa gnang ba la gsol sman thang thun 'ga' bzhes pa sogs 'phrod rten gnang yang dwangs bskyed cher ma byung bas/ de dus kyi mchod g.yog la dge slong shāka ye ba yod pa la/
