rigs ldan ma'i mchod chog cig dgos pa 'dug gsungs/ gnang nub rang mgul sngar mal du sor chud cing / gsung ngag legs par grol rjes/ rgyu dngos po'i gnang sbyin stobs che ba gnang nas kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod kyi rgyun yang gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ 'di skabs bdag chen shar nas mjal ba la phebs dus/ bdud rtsi ril bu zhig sgrub pa gnang dgos shing / bla brang shar na yod pa'i rje btsun grags pa'i stong rdo'i lhag ma lus pa 'bul lags zhu ba gnang ba la/ 'o na sems can la phan pa rgya che ba yong ba 'dug pas lta dgos pa yin nam gsungs pa'i zhol bzhes kyi sne yod tsam gyi bka' lung gnang zhes grags la/ gnas der gzhi bdag mas ma ṇi'i lung zhus pa'i yid ches kyang gsal bar snang ngo / /bzang ldan nas phebs 'phral zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la bsam gtan phug gi dben gnas su/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa sku mched gnyis/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge mus dbon chen po dkon mchog rin chen/ drung nas grags rgyal pa dang lnga la dbang bskur rdo rje phreng ba/ kri ya'i kha skong dang bcas pa stsal te/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la grol bar mdzad nas/ rje mus chen la lam 'bras brgyud pa dang / grub chen la bka' chos kyi 'brel ba'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba'i thang ga thog tshad ma gnyis kyang de skabs bzhengs par mdzad/ snga gong sa ga la bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i dgongs pa gnang yang / bzang ldan nas ngam rings su spyan 'dren zhus pa'i stabs nas/ sa ga'i nyer bdun la gling khar phebs pa las ma byung bas dus 'gyangs shing / de stabs bla brang shar nas bdud rtsi ril bu'i rta ma 'bul mi yang / rong chab tshan la bzhugs dus sa ga'i gnam gang la sleb pa tsam las zhabs drung du ma 'byor ba nas/ smin drug zla ba gnyis byung ba'i dang po'i tshes brgyad la gling kha nas bsam gtan phug tu phebs te bsnyen pa kha gso'i thugs dam gnang rjes nyer gsum gyi gsol thon 'phral la/

bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis sku mched drung / rje lha mchog seng ge mus dbon chen po dkon mchog rin chen/ snga sor bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i phyag phyir yod pa'i dge slong dpal 'byor ba dang byang dpal ba gnyis/ chos sgo'i bla ma byams pa shes rab/ drung nas grags rgyam pa/ shar pa rab 'byams pa bkra shis dpal ldan/ mchod g.yog pa nam mkha' dpal bzang rnams dang / gsol dpon thugs rje bzang po ba dang / nam mkha' dar po gnyis/ sman 'thag pa la lus stobs che ba mdzad pa chos mdzad gzhis ka ba dang / tshul khrims dpal bzang ste bcu gsum la dam tshig gso ba'i dbang gnang rjes/ dgong ja man bcad rgya shin tu dam pa'i sku mtshams dang 'brel bar gnam gang bar bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa gnang bas/ khyad par gyi ltas ngo mtshar ba sngar dang mtshungs pa la/ lhag par nyer lnga man me tog gi char kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa lta bu kun gyi dngos mthong du legs par babs shing / de dus rje'i gsung las/ lha rnams dgyes zer ba'i brda' ru 'dug me tog sa la babs pa 'di rnams 'dod khams pa'i lha'i me tog dang / sa la 'bab mi thub par nam mkha' la yal 'gro ba rnams gzugs khams pa'i lha'i me tog yin par byed/ 'u cag la me tog gi char las ril bu sgril ba'i grogs byas na phan par 'dug ces kyang gsungs par grags so/ /tshes gcig nas sgrub pa mthar phyin gyi gtang rag mkha' 'gro chos skyong la 'bul ba/ phyag g.yog pa rnams la gnas der ril bu'i bgo skal stsal cing / byang du bdag chen yab sras la sman skyin gyi bdud rtsi ril bu'i gnang sbyin phyag dam rdzong ba gnang nas/ dpon slob rnams gling khar phebs/ tshes brgyad mchod steng du tshogs pa la bdud rtsi ril bu'i 'gyed stsal cing / gzhan yang skal ldan yongs kyi dam tshig gi nyer spyad du re ba yongs su gang ba mdzad rjes/ ngam ring chos sde nas lo mang po'i bar du gsol ba btab don/

khyad par bdag chen ta'i bswe tu nam mkha' legs pas nan bskyed gsol ba btab nas/ sbrul lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi 'grub sbyor dge ba la 'dus pa'i dge 'dun che rags rnams kyis ser phreng gi bkod pa/ gdugs rgyal mtshan/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs dang bcas spyan 'dren zhus te/ bzhugs pa steng nang sor gnang nas/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang pos gtso mdzad tshogs pa brgyad brgya lhag la gsung ngag rin po che zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor cing / de skabs gsol dpon rnam gnyis la/ dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams la nas 'bo re'i 'gyed gyis gsungs pa la/ nas kyis tshogs pa'i phyed kyang mi ldang ba'i tshul zhus kyang / slar bka' nan che ba stsal nas bkye bas/ lhag kyang nas phul dgu tsam byung bas kun ya mtshan gyi gnas su gyur pa'i grub rtags gnang zhes thos shing / skabs der yang bla ma rnam gsum la/ bde kye'i brgyud pas bskor ba'i bris sku thog tshad ma dang / yi dam chos skyong ba'i bris sku gcig kyang lhan cig bzhengs/ kye rdor mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa mus chen gyis mdzad pa'i bar yang bzhengs nas par khang du bzhugs su gsol zhing / gsung ngag grol rjes mus su phebs nas sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ bsam gtan phug tu lo sgrub gnang ba'i sku chas thams cad phyag nas gnang ste/ rje nyid e waṃ chos ldan du gsung ngag gnang ba la phebs te/ rgyu dus skabs rje yab sras gnyis kas kye rdor bdag med ma'i rdul tshon dbang khang dang / ka drug mar bzhengs pa gnang nas/ yab bka' yum bka' zung 'brel du tshogs pa yongs kyis thob par mdzad cing / gsung ngag grol rjes ston yar phebs nas/ dgun chos gling kha nyid du bdag chen a tshe ba'i drung dang / bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis sku mched rnams kyis gtso mdzad tshogs pa lnga brgya tsam la gsung ngag grol 'phral/ cho 'phrul la rtsa rgyud kyi bsgrigs 'don cha rkyen gser zho drug cu/

nas khal brgya dang brgyad cu btsugs pa gnang rjes/ sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug bdag chen a tshe'i drung dang sku mched gsum la dbang rdor phreng / kri ya kha skong dang bcas pa dang / bdag chen sku mched drug la lhan cig bde mchog nag po pa'i rdul mtshon la brten pa'i dbang bskur yang mdzad ces grags shing / dbyar ya ma bde ldan phug tu bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis sku mched kyis gtso mdzad la gsung ngag gnang skabs/ dngul gar lugs gnang ba'i sa chen gyi sku dang / kun mkhyen dang grub chen gyi sku sngar gyi sems dpa' chen po'i dngul sku dang mnyam pa/ dngul gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten rnams kyi nang bzhugs rab gnas mdzad dus me tog gi char chen po babs pa yongs la gsal zhing / de lo rje bya btang pa zhing brjes pa'i phyag rdzas gser g.yu sogs dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa rje rang gi zhal chems ltar zhabs drung du phul ba/ gang la gang 'os dge phyogs su thong pa'i phyag len gnang zhing / mang dkar phu rdzong du zhabs gtad phebs nas bya btang rje'i sku gdung yang / rje nyid kyis 'od bzhu gnang rjes/ phyag tshas gdung rus rnams chos skur sgrub pa gnang nas/ thub bstan rnam rgyal nas spyan 'dren zhu mi dang lhan cig gtsang gzhung la phebs lam bsgyur te/ lug lo zla ba dang po'i nyer gcig nyin kun mkhyen rin po che'i dus chen nas dbu 'dzugs pa gnang / chos rje chos grags pa dang / gdan sa pa blo gros rab yangs pas gtso mdzad tshogs pa stong phrag tsam la gsung ngag rin po che gsungs pa'i/ sems bskyed skabs bla brang gi zhing gshongs ma'i khar bzhugs khri brtsigs nas gnang dgos pa byung zhing / rgyu dus la dbang mi kun la bdud rtsi ril bu yang gnang zhes gleng la/ gsung ngag grol rjes nyer gcig mchod pa'i rgyur gser srang gsum dang / sgrub mchod rgyun gtan btsugs pa la cha rkyen dpag med sbyor ba gnang nas/

yar phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur te/ thub bstan yangs pa can du zhag 'ga' sku bsnyel gnang dus/ bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa lo tsā ba chen po dang / rje lha mchog seng ge bdag chen shar pas gtso mdzad/ gtsang stod kyi snar thang pa sogs dpon rnam pa tha dad mjal ba la byon pa'i gur dkar nag gis sa gzhi kheb pa tsam byung zhes sgrog cing / 'di skabs ngor du mus chen gyi tshes brgyad dus chen la dmigs pa'i gser zho bzhi bcu sbyor ba gnang nas/ gling khar phebs pa'i mtshams lho rtsa'i jo bo'i drung du dkar me'i rgyun dang / mchod rdzas mang du 'dzugs pa mdzad/ dbyar chos la ngan song sbyong rgyud/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i ḍīk+ka'i steng nas stsal cing / blo sbyong / gcod khrid rnams gsungs/ bya btang rje'i nang rten du sems dpa' chen po'i sman sku mda' gang pa gcig dang / phyi rten gdung tsha bzhugs pa'i khang brtsegs/ yig mkhan bzhis kye rdor rgyud gsum/ lam 'bras glegs bam/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum rnams gser rkyang las bzhengs pa mdzad/ ya ma bde ldan phug pa la cho 'phrul zla ba la rgyud tshugs gsungs/ gser srang gsum/ nas khal brgya/ ja sdum gcig rnams gnang zhing / hor bzlog la dmigs pa'i gu ru'i 'bum pa rnying pa gang 'dug gso ba dang / klas pa byes mdo/ bang shod kyi lung bzang gi mdo/ mang tsho sum mdo/ lha mdo drag po che/ skye dge la rtse rnams su nang bzhugs byin rlabs dpag med bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gsal pa re brtsig pa la mus dbon chen po dkon mchog rin chen pa dpon slob rnams rdzong ba gnang / de mthun sa skyar dbu rtse rnying ma sogs mchod khang rnams su dkar me dang / sgo rum/ kha'u/ pu tra nang so sogs su gtor gsos hor bzlog la dmigs pa yang sgrub pa gnang zhing / dbyar smad ngam rings su bzhugs skabs ngor nas rje lha mchog seng ge glo bor chibs kha bsgyur ba'i yar lam yab sras gdan 'dzoms gnang zhing /

lug lo zla ba bcu gcig pa la gling kha nyid du bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis sku mched dang / gling dbon ting nge 'dzin 'od zer bas gtso mdzad la gsung ngag gnang skabs/ rje'i gsung chos kyi thun grol 'phral rang bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pa'i drung bzhugs khri de nyid kyi steng du phebs nas/ rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum dkar chag tu 'khod pa ma lus pa'i lung der 'tshogs la gnang du 'jug par mdzad pa ni sku'i rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa rmad du byung ba nyid do/ /mdor na dgung lo so gcig nas bdun cu don gnyis bar du bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge tshul dge slong gi bslab pa gnang ba/ dbu sems lugs gnyis kyi sems bskyed 'bogs pa/ rdor 'phreng kṛ ya'i kha skong dang bcas pa tshar gsum/ zur bka' kye rdor bka' babs bzhi/ bdag med ma/ gur sam̐/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ gsang 'dus rigs gsum/ 'jigs byed sa lugs dang rwa lugs sgo gnyis/ gshed dmar/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis sogs rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi dbang rnams dang / rjes gnang rigs gtad/ sgom lung sgo mtha' yas pa/ gsung ngag tshar lnga bcu nga gcig de dang 'brel ba'i cha lag gi dbang byin rlabs so/ /bde mchog gi rtsa dbu ma/ nag po rim bzhi/ dril bu rim lnga/ bde mchog dkar po/ gshed dmar spros med/ 'jigs byed rnal 'byor/ chos skyong gi nang khrid/ blo sbyong / rten 'brel snying po/ gcod yul/ zhen pa bzhi bral sogs zab khrid dpag tu med pa dang / 'dul ba lung sde bzhis mtshon pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' dang / kye rdor rgyud gsum sogs rgyud sde du ma/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ rdo rje 'chang / sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen rin po che/ rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum gyis mtshon pa'i lung gzhal du med pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char chen po dus rgyun chad med par stsol bar mdzad pa'i mthu las slob ma'i tshogs kyis sa steng ma lus par khyab pa'i rnam grangs tsam gyi mtshon byed/

gdung brgyud rin po che/ bdag chen shākya rgyal mtshan/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug bdag chen a 'jam pa/ bdag chen nam mkha' 'dod sgrub/ bdag chen don grub rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis/ bdag chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen kun dga' snying po ste 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud bcu phrag gcig nyid kyi rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur ba rje btsun lha mchog seng ge smra ba'i dbang phyug dkon mchog lhun grub/ dam pa'i thugs sras sangs rgyas seng ge ste e waṃ gdan rabs gsum dang / gting skyes chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje dbon shākya rgyal mtshan/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ lcang ra ba blo gros bzang po ste gser mdog can gyi gdan sa pa bzhi/ chos rje chos grags rgya mtsho pa nas thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa pa na rim bzhi/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / chos rje chos grags pa/ chos rje nor bu phun tshogs/ chos rje chos kyi bshes gnyen/ chos rje lha dbang blo gros te skyed tshal gyi gdan sa pa lnga/ chos rje mus rab 'byams pa/ chos rje gzhon nu blo gros/ chos rje grags pa rgyal mtshan yangs pa can gyi gdan sa pa gsum/ spyan tshab tshul khrims bzang po/ chos rje shes rab bzang po/ chos rje thugs rje dpal ba sogs gling kha'i gdan sa pa rnams dang / chos rje nam mkha' bsod nams/ mus dbon chen po dkon mchog rin chen sogs gle lung chos sde'i mkhan po bzhi/ chos rje nam mkha' dpal bzang po sogs bde ldan phug dang / dga' ldan rtser/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / chos rje dpal ldan shes rab/ gsang sngags rdo rje gling du chos rje bzang po dpal ba/ zhe dgon du chos rje dkon mchog rdo rje/ chos rje dpal ldan dar po sogs gdan rab 'ga' re dang / mkhan chen bde legs bkra shis/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/

mkhan chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ lcags thang rab 'byams pa dang ngam ring mkhan po bzhi/ snar thang mkhan po shes rab dpal ldan/ dga' gdong mkhan po rin chen dpal bzang / jo nang mkhan po kun dga' legs pa/ gting skyes bya btang pa chen po/ de'i gcung gser gling pa kun dga' bkra shis dang / kun dga' legs grub pa gnyis/ mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo ring kun spangs pa/chos rje dngos grub dpal 'bar ba/ nyi lde ba dpal ldan rgyal mtshan/ dngul chu ba dpal ldan bkra shis/ chos sgo ba byams pa shes rab/ bu le ba byams pa phun tshogs/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / shes rab bkra shis sku mched gnyis/ lo chen rat+na bha dra rnams dang / dbus phyogs su smyug la paṇa chen/ karma 'phrin las par grags pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ gsang phu gling smad mkhan po kun dga' dpal 'byor/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ rmor pa chos rje grags 'byor shes rab/ 'jun pa mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog mnga' ris bzhi sde pa chos rje nam mkha' brtan pa dang / rnam rgyal bzang po sku mched gnyis kyis mtshon pa dang / khams phyogs su chos rje sangs rgyas dpal ba/ chos rje bsam 'phel rgyal mtshan/ chos rje nor bzang pa/ chos rje dge 'dun dpal bzang / ting 'dzin 'od zer la sogs te dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi bstan 'dzin dngos su mtshan smos pa de dag dang / yang slob brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pas bstan pa 'phel rgyas su gyur cing / sprel lo shar 'phral gsang sngags rdo rje gling du sang phod bya lo cho 'phrul man rgyud tshugs gsungs gser zho nyi shu dang / nas khal brgya'i gnang sbyin mdzad cing / 'di skabs dge slong bsod mchog pas sa chen gyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma thugs kar bzhugs pa'i sems dpa' chen po'i sman sku mda' gang tsam bzhengs shing / sprel lo zla ba bzhi pa nas brtsams te/ sa skya/ e waṃ/ nā len+d+ra/ bzang ldan/ skyed tshal/

thub bstan gong 'og chos 'khor lhun po/ mus nang gi dgon pa lnga dang bcas par ja sigs brgyad kyi mang ja 'gyed chas gser zho phyed dang bzhi brgya/ dngul dam gnyis/ karma gan dkar gnyis/ snam sbyar gser ma/ hor chol gcig rgya'i dgang gzar blugs/ gos dar spus dag dpag med stsal nas/ da lan gyi mang ja 'gyed bcas rnams rim gro min/ nged rang gi sngon 'gro'i dge rtsa la dmigs pa yin pas/ so so nas kun rig cho ga bzang spyod smon lam sogs dmigs su 'gyur ba mdzod gsungs pa'i bka' lung nges gsal dang / sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga'i rje rdo rje 'chang gi dus chen steng du/ sngar bde ba can gyi zhing bkod gnyis lag tu byung / da gcig bris pas gsum yong ba 'dug gsungs skya ris dbu btsugs shing / 'od dpag med kyi mdun du nga rang gi gzugs gcig kyang pad+ma'i steng du yong ba bris gsungs shing / zam sner rta mo lung gang gi skya ser rnams la sems bskyed/ ma ṇi'i lung gnang rjes/ pha dam pa'i skye bdun re phyag gis stsal bar mdzad nas/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bdun la gling kha'i tshogs su/ bya btang rje'i na bzas gtsos pa'i gral 'gyed rgya cher gnang nas bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs dang / bzang spyod cig gi dbu rje nyid kyis drangs nas bzhugs khri kha nas bzhengs phebs pa'i tshul bstan cing / dbyar chos la ya ma bde ldan phug tu gsung gi tha ma de gsungs pa la phebs shing / khong rnam pa la/ sngar gyi rgyud sgrigs 'don gyi 'thud du gser srang do gnang / de skabs zla ba bdun pa'i bcu bzhi la sa nag brag lung pa yin pa'i bud med skal dman gcig gis sku gzan zhig phul ba'i rkyen byas bsnyel tshul bstan zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin gsung ngag gi dmigs pa'i 'phro rnams shar pa zhig gsungs nas/ chos 'phro de tsam gyis rdzogs pa gyis la/ so sor gyes gsungs pa'i bka' lung gnang rjes sku mtshams se'i ngang nas/

dge slong bsod mchog pa la/ sems dpa' chen po'i sman sku mkhyid gang tsam mnyam gzhag mdzad pa cig bzos gsungs pa la/ khong gis phyag gi dbus su nor bu gcig bzos nas gzigs 'bul byas pas/ nor bu sol la lhung bzed cig zhog sems dpa' chen po 'od dpag med kyi sku 'dra byed pa yin gsungs/ zla ba de nyid kyi nyer bzhi la mus dbon chen po dkon mchog rin chen pas mdzad nas/ sems dpa' chen po'i dgung lo tsam bzhugs dgos zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nged skye 'chi la dbang thob pa ma yin zhing / 'on kyang las bsags pa med gsungs/ de'i don gdul bya'i mgon du bzhugs pa'i sems can spyi mthun gyi las la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin zhing /gsol dpon rnam gnyis kyis gling khar phebs dgos pa'i nan bskyed zhus pa la/ zla gsham 'di mi 'gro/ tshes nas bde ba can du 'gro bka' lung phebs pa la/ khong rnams bsam gling kha bde ba can du phebs gsungs par go na'ang / zhing khams bde ba can du gshegs gsung pa yin snang zhing / zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la 'do li'i steng du gzim gur phub nas gdan drangs/ stag lung mdo dang / klas mdo ru bar zhag re mdzad/ tshes gsum gyi snga dro'i cha la gling khar phebs shing / de nas tshes lnga'i bar sku khams bde bar mngon pa dang / zhabs skor yang ma chag par gnang / tshes lnga'i dgong nas slar yangs snyung tshul bstan pas/ sku rim la dmigs pa'i mang ja/ na bza'i 'gyed sogs sgrubs/ gsol dpon pas tas pa'i tshul gyis sku khams ci 'dra yong mi shes pa gda' bas bslab cha bya zhus pas/ lab rgyu tsam med/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus mchod la dmigs pa'i gzhi rten/ dkar me cha rkyen rnams dmigs su 'khyol ba dang / pha ma'i zhing khang mtshon pa 'di/ sngar dus mchod dkar me gang la yang bsngos pa med pas/ nga rang gi dus mchod sogs la sbyor ba dang / pur zla ba gcig ma zhu bar bzhog gsungs shing /

tshes drug gi nyin khang gsar ba'i bdag mo sogs gshin po 'ga'i ming byang kun rig gi cho ga dag gsal dang bcas lho sgo/ byang bu bsreg pa/ 'jim pa byin rlabs/ tsha tsha rab gnas kyi bar gnang nas/ de tshar bas blo bde gsung zhing / tshes bdun/ brgyad/ dgu rnams la yang sku khams 'khyud de rang byung zhing / tshes bcu'i tho rangs thugs dam gyi rim pa/ dkar cha bzhi/ za byed mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg rnams rdzogs rjes phyag phreng ring ba phud nas sku 'khris su bzhag phyag rtse skor phyag la rgyus bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bcos/ spyan bar snang la khrol gzigs pa dang / phyag gnyis nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dbu dpral du 'jog pa gnang nas/ yid 'byung gi mchod pa tshar gcig mdzad rjes/ phyag mnyam gzhag gnang 'phral 'od gsal chos kyi skur thim zhing / tshes bcu gnyis kyi tho rangs 'od gsal las bzhengs nas/ sems dpa' chen po yab sras rnams gang du bzhugs pa'i zhing khams der/ thogs pa med par thal gyis gshegs pa nyid do/ /sku mya ngan la 'das pa nas bzung ste/ gdung khang zhal ma phye'i bar nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa kho na dang / sprin thor pa byung ba rnams kyang 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par 'char ba dang / me tog gi char khor yug tu 'bab pa dang / dri bzang po'i ngad kun tu ldang ba byung zhing / tshes bcu bdun nyin man bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung gis bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub mchod dang / bde mchog bla ma mchod chog bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis pas gtso mdzad pa'i kye rdor gyi sgrub mchod dang lam 'bras bla mchod bcas pa/ nyer bzhi nas zhag bdun gyi bar dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi la dge 'dun drug brgya tsam gyis snga dro kun rig bdag bskyed bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub mchod/ dgong phyogs bdag chen sku mched kyis tshogs dbu gnang nas kye rdor gyi sgrub mchod dang /

rje nyid kyis nyin zhag phrugs gcig la gnang ba'i thugs dam zhal 'don rnams grangs ma lus pa/ cha so sor bgos nas bsgrub par mdzad cing / de dag gi skabs su sku gdung las tshul khrims yongs su dag pa'i dri bsung bzang po yang yang byung ba ya mtshan gyi gnas su gyur cing / tshes bcu gcig la sku gdung zhugs 'bul gnang ba'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gdung khang zhal phye bas/ sku gdung phal cher ring bsrel kha dog dkar po dang ljang gus gang bar gyur ces grags shing / mus nang gi dgon pa so sos mtshon pa'i byang phyogs kyi dgon gnas/ chos sde sgo gnyis/ e wam̐ chos ldan/ nā len+d+ra sogs mtha' dag tu dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya cher bsgrubs pa dang / skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtong dang / thog mar gzim mal sku 'dra mda' gang lhag tsam sman skur bzhengs shing / bya lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la bdag chen kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ nang rten stag rtse thar pa dpon g.yog drug gis/ lugs phud rje rang gi sku 'dra mda' gang tsam dang / nang rten dngos la thub pa'i sku rgyab mtho bcu yod pa zhig bsgrubs shing / de'i 'khor ldem rnams dge slong bsod mchog pas bcos/ phyi rten bya lo zla ba lnga pa'i skar ma bya la rje nyid kyi 'khrungs skar steng du rmangs bting nub/ me tog 'dab lnga dang 'dab brgyad la sogs pa'i char dgon pa'i khong thams cad khyab par babs shing / thig tshad zhal bkod rnams chos rje byams pa phun tshogs pa dang / dge slong shākya ye bas do dam bgyis nas mthar phyin cing / de ltar gzim mal sku 'dra/ phyi rten nang rten ma lus pa la nang bzhugs rab gnas legs par bsgrubs te/ dad ldan ma lus pa'i phyag dang mchod pa'i yul du gyur to/ /de dag gis ni bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa rje btsun mus pa chen po budha'i mtshan can de nyid kyis/ bar du 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams la sa bcu'i byang sems chen po'i sprul skur snang tshul de nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i cha shas rnams cung zad brjod pa bstan zin pa yin no/

/'dir smras pa/ ji snyed skye zhing skye bar bstan dang 'gro ba'i don bsgrub phyir/ /sa bcu'i byang sems che sogs gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis/ /ci mdzad gzhan gyi don du 'gyur ba'i mdzad bzang rmad byung 'di/ /blo ldan rnams kyis thos shing bsam na dad pa cis mi 'phel/ /dngos min dngos dang 'dra ba'i lung rtogs mdzod bzung nas/ /yongs 'dzin yongs kyi rgyan du yang yang sprul pa'i tshul/ /tshad med tshad kyis gzhal ba'i yul las 'das pas na/ /blo chung blo dman bdag gis mtshon pa tsam 'di spel/ /bslu ba med pa'i skyabs yul ma lus pa/ /khyod nyid kho na'i rang bzhin nyid yin phyir/ /de phyir mos pa'i rjes 'brang skal bzang bdag /mang po'i bsam gtan g.yeng bas ci zhig bya/ /rje btsun khyod kyi ba spu'i khung gcig na'ang / /rab bkrams dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor nyer ston gang / /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas kyis/ /rang snang phan tshun dag pas dngos su gzigs/ /thog med las kyi sgrib pa shas che bas/ /rgyal rnams dngos su mthong ba'i skal med la/ /bshes gnyen zol gyis lam sna 'dren mdzad pa/ /'di 'dra'i bka' drin bsam bzhin spro ba 'phel/ /e ma rnam pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol rtsed can/ /gcig min du ma min pa'i tshul/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i snang ba mtshar/ /yang srid du mar bshes gnyen mchog /mchog gi zol gyi rang gzhan don/ /don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub tshul/ /tshul 'di thos kun skal ba bzang / /zhes mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyi gzugs dam pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs ngo mtshar sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba las/ bar du 'os su gyur ba'i gdul bya rnams la sa bcu'i byang sems chen po'i sprul skur snang ba'i tshul legs par bshad pa mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon nyid gzhan ngor bshes gnyen dam pa'i zol gyis bstan 'gro'i don la yang srid du mar ston par mdzad pa'i mtshon byed gtam du bya ba 'od gsal nyi ma'i snang ba dad pa'i pad tshal rgyas byed ces bya ba rim par phye ba ste gnyis pa'o//

//gsum pa tha mar bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs mgon dam par slar yang bzlas te byon pa'i tshul gyi rnam thar bshad pa ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /mkhas btsun bzang po'i gtsug rgyan mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'am/ yang na/ rje 'og min gnas su rdo rje 'chang / /gnas 'phags pa'i yul du zas gtsang sras/ /ljongs gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mus pa rje/ /rje btsun sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul dam pa gyur pa 'dir bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa 'gro ba mtha' dag gi las nyon gyi nad do cog sel ba'i sman pa chen po/ skal bzang gi 'gro ba nor 'dzin gyi rdul dang mnyam pa smin grol mchog gi lam la 'god pa thub pa chen po'i rgyal tshab/ 'gro ba kun la rgyu med par mnyes bzhin pa'i thugs rje chen pos 'khor ba ji srid par 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i sa gsum gyi bla ma/ mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i dgongs don tshul bzhin du smra ba'i gad rgyangs mthon pas log par smra ba'i skye bo mtha' dag gi snying lkog mar 'byin pa'i ri dwags kyi dbang po sha ram pa/ bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bka'i springs yig rna ba'i rgyan du bzung ji ltar bsgo ba'i las thams cad thogs med du bsgrubs pa'i mthu stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mgon po/ tshogs gnyis kyi lam rlabs po che gzhan gyis bya dka' ba dag sngon rabs du mar lan gcig ma yin par goms pa'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung bas ji ltar bzhed pa'i don gnyis 'bad rtsol gyi sbyor ba drag po la ma ltos par rang gi ngang gis grub pa'i 'gran zla med pa'i rnam 'dren dam pa/ mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa'i 'brel tshad don ldan gyi skyes bu chen po rje btsun mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs su grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyi sku'i skye ba 'dir/

gdul bya rnams kyi dbang po dang 'tshams par ji ltar ston par mdzad pa'i rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa la don gnyis te/ gzhan don du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul dang / mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ de'i dang po la bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i gnas ni/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma las/ bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyis dam pa'i chos byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i sa'i thig le kha ba'i sman ljongs/ ku mu da rnam par bzhad pa'i dga' tshal ltar ches dkar zhing / bsil ba'i chu klung dri ma med pa'i rgyun 'bab pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas bod ces grags pa 'dir/ sngon gyi dus su byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi ring la dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ rgyal sras zla ba'i gtsug phud can/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus thon mi sam+bho ṭas bod kyi yi ge bcos nas chos kyi srol gtod/ rje btsun ngag gi dbang po'i rnam 'phrul chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang / o drwi ya na'i slob dpon pad+ma ka ra la sogs pa spyan drangs/ ka lcog zhang gsum la sogs pa lo tsā ba rnams kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ dam pa'i chos rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de/ de'i rjes su sa bcu'i dbang phyug rdo rje snying po khri ral pa can gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i dpal la 'gran pa bzhin shin tu dar rgyas su gyur te/ 'di yan chad la bstan pa snga dar zhes grags/ de nas rgyal po dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa cung zad nyams par byas pa la/ smad du gtsang rab gsal ba/ g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya pun+ya/

bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal rnams dang / stod du lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ bar du rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ 'brog 'gos mar gsum la sogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyis 'chad nyan sgom sgrub dri ma med pa'i gzhung btsugs/ mkhas shing grub pa'i sa brnyes pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'khrul pa med pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pas dge legs su mdzad pa'i bod kha ba can nam gangs can gyi khrod ces grags pa'i zhing khams dag pa 'di nyid kyi gnas rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni 'di yin te/ dbus 'gyur gyi tshal byang chub snying po rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i gnas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag legs par sbyar ba'i skad du gsungs pa'i yon tan rin po che'i 'byung khungs/ rgya gar gyi yul dang 'dabs 'byor du gnas pa/ 'phags pa'i gang zag nyon mongs pa'i bud shing zad cing dben pa la gcig tu gzhol ba dbang po zhi ba rnams kyi bsti gnas/ lha rnams kyi dbang po mchod sbyin brgya pa'i zhon pa sa srung gi bus nye bar brten pa/ 'byung po'i bdag po dpal mgrin gtsug na zla ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i ri bo gangs can gyi 'dabs/ sprul pa'i rgyal po seng ge'i khri la gnas te dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos ston pa'i gnas chen sham+bha la dang nye ba'i chu bo si ta'i lho phyogs kyi rgyud/ u ma'i bdag po'i gnas gzhan gnyis par grags shing mi'am ci sprin gyi phreng ba can gyis nye bar brten pa'i te se gangs kyi shar phyogs/ kha ba can gyi rgyud du dam pa'i chos rgyas pa'i gzhi sprul pa'i rgyal pos nye bar bsgrubs pa/ shākya'i rgyal po'i gtsug lag khang lha sa dang / bsam yas kyi nub phyogs kyi ljongs/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgron me bsil zer can babs pa ltar sa'i phyogs kun nas gsal zhing mdzes la/

'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa'i gtsang la stod grom pa dpal ldan sa skya zhes grags pa'i gnas mchog dam pa de nyid nas byang phyogs su ha cang mi ring ba zhig bgrod pa'i sa/ bod 'di sa'i cha gsum du gnas pa las/ de la yang stod mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing dang 'dra ba/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba dang 'dra/ smad mdo khams sgang gsum zhing dang 'dra ba ste yul gru chen po gsum las/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i bye brag gi g.yas ru'i khongs su gtogs pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug rnam par 'phrul pa'i skyes bu dam pa du mas nye bar brten zhing / lhag par las dang po rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa smyung bar gnas pa'i lag len gyi cho ga thugs nyams su bzhes shing gzhan la ston pa'i bla ma zhang ston dgra 'jigs pa dang / rtsi 'dul ba 'dzin pa bla ma chu bzang pa la sogs pa du ma dang / mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ rin po che shes rab 'bum/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ ma cig chos sgron la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu khyad par can du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i grub pa'i gnas mchog mus zhes bya ba rgya nag stong 'khun yan chad du grags pa'i sa'i cha/ rta mo gling skya zhes bya ba'i snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang / grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin po chen/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho sogs rim par byon pa'i gnas mchog de nyid dang nye bar gnas pa'i gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon zhes yongs su grags shing 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mkhas grub rgyun ma chad par byon nas/ bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la rtse gcig tu mdzad pa la brten rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed gzhung dri ma med pa mtha' dag dang /

lhag par bde kye gsang gsum/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud dang bcas pa'i dbang khrid byin rlabs/ man ngag rgyud bshad/ rjes gnang / bka' gtad/ lung rab 'byams la sogs pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i chos brgyud dri ma med pa rnams kyi rgyun deng sang gi bar du ma nyams par bzhugs pa'i nges don gyi chos grwa chen po de nyid dang 'dabs nye ba'i dol smad ces bya ba'i ru sde chen po/ der gnas pa'i skye bo kun kyang myur 'gro rlung gi gshog pa can gyi steng nas lus 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i dpa' bo 'bum phrag du mas pha rol gyi dgra sde zil gyis gnon cing / mi bsrun pa dag gi glo snying mgrin pa'i lam du 'dren nus pa'i stobs ldan hor gyi rgyal khams la 'gran bzod pa/ rta pa'i tshogs srid sgrub ltar 'phongs rkyen pa du mas 'brong la sogs pa ri dwags che dgu dang / shwa na rlung gi shugs can rol tu khrid pa'i rkang thang gi tshogs du mas ri dwags chung dgu'i srog dbugs blangs ste sha'i phung po ri ltar brtsigs shing / khrag gi rgyun rgya mtsho ltar bskyil ba'i longs spyod kyis srin yul laṅga pu ri'i longs spyod kyi dpal 'gog pa/ rkang bzhi'i 'byor pa rtswa ljang gi myu gu ltar mod cing dkar gsum gyi longs spyod dbyar mtsho ltar 'khyil bas rnam thos bu'i dpal la 'gran bzod pa/ rje rigs dge phyogs la dkar bas gtong phod che zhing ya rabs kyi ngang tshul gces par 'dzin pa/ dmangs rigs dge ba la gnag cing gsod gcod la rngams pa'i gshin rje'i las mkhan lta bu/ gtsug lag gnyis la blo gros rab tu byang ba'i rje bo 'jig rten gyi mes por gyur pa dag gis bskyangs pas bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin dar ba'i 'brog sde chen po de nyid du/ mi'u rigs bzhi las ldong gi rus 'dzin pa/ yab shangs pa chos skyong bkra shis zhes bya ba g.yo sgyu dang bral ba gsong por smra ba/

nu ma'i steng na sme ba skar ma smin drug lta bu'i gzugs yod cing / dpral ba'i dkyil na sme ba dkar pos mtshan pa/ dpa' bo'i mtshan rtags dang ldan zhing sku tshe la mnga' brnyes pas dgung lo dgu bcu'i bar bzhugs pas bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad cing / sems can la snying rje che ba lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa rgyas pa zhig dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags dang ldan pa'i stod mtsho ma rtog gzungs skyabs ma zhes bya ba dad pa dang snying rje che zhing dkon mchog gi zhabs tog la brtson pa zhig gi sras su 'dren pa dam pa 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan pa yin la/ shangs pa gong ma de dag kyang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu'i zhabs tog sogs bstan pa'i bya ba la brtson pa'i gang zag dam pa sha stag byon pa yin te/ sngon grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor pas bon chos la yid ma ches par/ rgya gar du chos slob pa la rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du phebs par chas pa'i tshe/ sru mo bza' mi la gser g.yu bskyis pas/ rgad po na re/ khyod mi ngan yin/ dang po bon dang rdzogs chen gyi grwa pa zhabs tog can de rnams bskyur/ da 'khor dang longs spyod gnyis ka med pa gcig byung 'dug khyod kyi gser g.yu'i skyin pa nam yong zer nas ma gnang / sru mo na re/ khyod la skyin pa yang mi 'dod cing / g.yu zho bcu gcig po 'di 'bul/ nged bza' mi gnyis la rgas khar phan thogs pa'i chos zhig rgya gar nas skyol cig zer ro/ /de nas rang gzhis rnams btsongs pa'i rin gyi gser g.yu rnams dang bcas khyer nas rgya gar la byon pas chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram na rgyal sras mai tri pa'i slob ma zhing gi rdo rje/ mi nyams rdo rje/ rin chen rdo rje dang gsum gshin rje gshed bsgrubs nas las sbyor byed pa dang mjal bas gser srang re re phul nas gshin rje gshed kyi dbang dang chos rnams zhus pas zhal dngos su gzigs/

de nas bram ze rat+na pha la dang mjal nas sru mos byin pa'i g.yu phul te gshin rje nag po'i dbang zhus pas/ khyod la g.yu 'bul ba'i sru mo bza' mi la med 'tshol dang / lte bsgyur 'di skyol/ bu gsum 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan nas bod du byon/ sru mo bza' mi gnyis la med 'tshol dang lte bsgyur bslabs pa'i tho rangs lha mo dkar mo gcig byon nas/ khyod kyi med 'tshol dang lte bsgyur 'dis bu gsum 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bu che ba la shang pa mgon/ bar pa la shang pa dar/ chung ba la shang chung du ming thogs shig khyod bla ma shang par grags pa'i yon bdag tu gyur nas lo re la nas khal stong tsho gsum gsum dang / gser g.yu rta khrab la sogs pa'i zhabs tog mang po byed par 'gyur zhing / phyis su yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan nas nam mkha' la yal song bas/ de nas lo de'i dus su bu gsum byung ba'i/ spyir shang pa bka' rgyud kyi bka' srol 'dzin pa shang ston tshul khrims 'bum la sogs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen mang du byon nas/ nai gu chos drug gi bstan pa bod gangs can gyi khrod 'dir gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /bar pa shang pa dar gyi bu la a ya gyer pa/ gyer rdo rje don yod sogs gsum byung ba las gyer rdo rje don yod kyi bu stod du 'chugs pa la/ shang pa a pad/ rtags dpon shang skyes/ shang pa mgon bsam dang gsum byung pa las/ che ba shang pa a pad kyi bu brgyud rje 'di'i yab mes rnams yin pa las/ shang pa dol pa zhes grags shing / de lta bu'i rigs brgyud khyad par can las byon pa'i rje 'di'i dngos kyi yab yum gyi mtshan ni gong du brjod zin pa ltar yin la/ de rnams kyi bla ma dam pa de nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i gnas dang / rigs rus khyad par can las byon pa'i tshul legs par bshad nas/ dus nam gyi tshe byon snyam na/

'o skol rnams kyi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po 'di nyid kyi bstan pa ji tsam gnas pa'i tshad kyi bstan rtsis la mi mthun pa'i tshul rnam pa mang yang / nges pa'i don du lo lnga stong du gnas pa nyid 'thad par gsungs pa las/ de la yang lnga brgya pa phrag gsum pa gsum las/ dang po la 'bras dus dang / gnyis pa la sgrub dus dang / gsum pa la lung gi dus dang / lnga brgya tha ma rtags tsam 'dzin pa zhes gsungs pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di ni lnga brgya pa phrag bdun 'das pa'i lung dus/ mdo sde spyod pa'i dus su snang ste/ de yang snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i sgron me rje btsun sa skya pa'i rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan rtsis/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs te brjod na/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po nyid sa pho 'brug la sku bltams te/ brgyad cu bzhes pa me mo phag la chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'das pa me mo yos kyi lo la bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa yin la/ de nas lo brgya dang dgu 'das pa me mo glang la chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs shing / de nas lo brgya don gsum 'das pa lcags pho rta la chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs so/ /de nas lo don drug 'das pa me pho khyi la mnga' bdag khri ral can byon pa yin la/ de nas lo nyis brgya bcu gnyis 'das pa me pho 'brug la lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis gu ge kha char du brtsis pa'i tshe/ ston pa nyid gshegs nas lo sum stong chig brgya zhe dgu 'das shing / bod du bstan pa dbu brnyes pa 'di 'phro nas lo bdun brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gsum lon pa lcags pho stag gi lo rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab gshegs pa'i dus zhang tshe spong bla mas brtsis pa na/ de yan chad la sum stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gsum 'das par bshad/

lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis brtsis pa'i 'phro nas lo nga bdun 'das pa chu mo glang lo 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dgung lo zhe bdun bzhes dus dpal sa skya'i dgon pa btab/ de nas lo bcu dgu 'das pa chu pho sprel la bla chen sa skya pa 'khrungs/ de nas nga gcig 'das pa chu pho khyi la slob dpon rtse mo 'khrungs shing / de nas lo lnga 'das pa me mo yos la rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ de nas sum cu so lnga 'das pa chu pho stag la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta byon pa yin la/ de nas lo nga gnyis 'das pa shing mo lug la chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa 'khrungs/ rngog lo gshegs dus brtsis pa'i 'phros nas lnga bcu rtsa bdun lon pa me pho phag gi lo rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos gung thang na la rtse gnas gsar du chos la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po brtsams pa'i dus brtsis pa na/ de yan lo sum stong sum brgya 'das par bzhed/ de nas lnga bcu 'das pa me pho byi ba'i lo rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan bde bar gshegs pa'i dus dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos brtsis pa na/ de yan la lo sum stong sum brgya lnga bcu 'das par bzhed/ de'i 'phro nas drug cu rtsa gcig song ba me mo glang gi lo chos rgyal 'phags pas chu mig tu chos 'khor chen po mdzad pa'i dus brtsis pa na/ de yan la lo sum stong bzhi brgya dang bcu gcig 'das par bzhed/ de'i 'phro nas lo sum cu rtsa drug song ba chu pho byi ba'i lo bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po byon la/ drug cu rtsa bzhi shing mo yos la gshegs/ de nas lo bdun 'das pa chu pho khyi'i lo la rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po 'khrungs so/ /chos rgyal 'phags pas brtsis pa'i 'phro nas bzhi bcu zhe lnga 'das pa chu pho khyi lo ti shrī kun blo bsnyen par rdzogs dus brtsis pas sum stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga 'das par bzhed/

de nas lo lnga bcu 'das pa chu pho byi lo bo dong du dpal ldan bla ma dam pas brtsis pa'i tshe/ sum stong lnga brgya dang nyag ma lnga 'das par bshad do/ /rje rdo rje 'chang 'khrungs nas lo drug 'das pa sa pho 'brug la snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan byon pa yin la/ de nas lo zhe gcig 'das pa sa mo bya la kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'khrungs shing / de nas lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'das pa chu mo bya la rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen 'khrungs so/ /de nas lo so gnyis 'das pa shing mo sbrul la sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'khrungs shing / de nas lo bcu gnyis 'das pa me mo sbrul la rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub 'khrungs pa yin no/ /dpal ldan bla mas brtsis pa'i 'phro nas lo lnga bcu rtsa bdun 'das pa'i sa mo bya la e waṃ chos ldan btab cing / de nas lo bdun 'das pa me pho 'brug la kha char du gu ge lha btsun pa rab byung mdzad dus rje kun dga' bzang pos brtsis tshe sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu rtsa dgu 'das pa yin la/ lo 'di la nā lan+d+ra btab cing / de'i phyis lo me sbrul la gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon gnas chen po byon pa yin no/ /rje dkon mchog lhun grub dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi bzhes pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo e wam̐ chos ldan du brtsis tshe/ sum stong drug brgya don gsum 'das par bshad do/ /rje lhun grub kyi zhabs can 'khrungs nas lo bcu gsum 'das pa lcags pho rta'i lo 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa yin zhing / de nas lo so gnyis 'das pa'i so gsum pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa lung gi dus/ mdo sde spyod pa nas lo brgya phrag gcig dang bcu phrag brgyad dang nyag ma bzhi 'das pa'i lnga pa'i steng du slebs pa dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la/

skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i tshes bzang po'i nyin/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di nyid bkra shis shing dge mtshan gyi ltas du ma dang bcas mngal gyi dri mas ma gos bzhin du phru ma sgom thag gi tshul du byas nas yum la gnod pa med par bde bar bltams shing / lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe na yang yum la nyi zla 'char ba sogs rmi ltas bzang po du ma dang / nyin bar gyi tshe yang shes pa gsal zhing bde bas brgyan pa dang / lus ldang ba yangs shing zo mdog bde ba la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rtags khyad par can du ma byung bar grags so/ /de lta bu'i dam pa'i skyes bu gzhon nu des ni sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams la bya ba rgya chen po byas shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba khyad par can bskrun pas/ gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar zhing zlum la shangs gzengs mtho ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing / spyan ut+pal ltar bkra ba/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ba ste skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan zhing / khyad par dbu'i gtsug na rme ba dkar po che ba zhig dang / sku stod la sme ba'i do shal gyis mtshan pa/ sku smad la stag sham gyi ri mos spras pa sogs rmad du byung ba'i mtshan ma du ma dang ldan pa zhig go /zhes thos la/ de nas yab yum rnams kyis dga' mgu yid rang ba dang bcas mtshan khro bo rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar btags so/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal dbang rnams kyi mkhyen brtse'i gzugs gsar pa/ /mes dbon rnam gsum zhes grags chos rgyal ches/ /bdag gir mdzad pa'i kha ba'i sman ljongs la/ /yul gru gsum las dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing / /g.yas ru'i khongs gtogs chos ldan rgyal po yis/ /nye bar rgyun du skyong ba'i nor 'dzin dbus/ /dri bzhon mgyogs pa 'gog pa'i gyer brling steng / /'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i lus kyi zlos gar mkhan/ /'bum phrag rta pa'i dpung gis gzhan srid kyi/ /glo snying dbugs dang lhan cig mgrin 'jug cing /

/sha khrag longs spyod ri mtsho ltar 'khyil bas/ /mgrin bcu'i grong gi dpal yang zil gnon te/ /rkang bzhi'i 'byor pa nor ldan ma'i lto bar/ /rtswa ljang myu gu ji bzhin khyab pa bres/ /dkar gsum longs spyod dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pas/ /rnam thos bu yis dpal yang 'gog pa bzhin/ /rdzogs ldan bde skyid mgron du bos pa yis/ /shang pa dol par grags pa'i 'brog sde cher/ /gzhung bzang rgyud drang 'dzom pa'i yab nyid dang / /bud med yon tan kun ldan yum gnyis kyi/ /sras su chu stag hor zla drug pa yi/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad lha'i bla ma/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po 'di/ /sngon med dge mtshan du ma dang bcas bltams/ /yon tan dpag yas srid 'dir shong min yang / /zla grangs rdzogs pa mngal du 'dzin nus pa'i/ /e ma skal bzang 'dren pa'i yum de ni/ /rgyal ba rnams la bya ba byas par nges/ /blang dor gnas la lug ltar rmongs pa yis/ /yid kyi mun pa stug po sel ba la/ /nyi tshe'i 'od ltar rgyu skar bye ba brgyas/ /byed pa 'jug pa'i nus pa 'dra gzigs nas/ /rtsod dus mtshan mo'i mgon du 'di 'os zhes/ /rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis/ /lung rtogs 'od dkar stong gi dra ba can/ /'chad rtsom shing rta'i khri la bskos pa snyam/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ye shes nyid/ /lha mi'i bsod nams mgron du nyer 'phos te/ /ngo mtshar yon tan zer gyi dra ba can/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog 'di shar bar gyur/ /snyigs dus sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa ltar grags pa'i/ /mtshan tsam thos pas srid zhi yi/ /rgud pa sel 'di e ma mtshar/ /gnyis pa mchog gi spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rgyas par bshad pa la/ de yang / gang gi ngo mtshar rnam thar mdzad pa'i tshul/ /cung zad dran la'ang byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char/ /rgyun chad med par stsol ba'i mus pa rje/

/sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar/ rje bla ma gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i cha shas phra mo dag dran pa'i mod la yang de nyid kyi rjes su slob par 'dun pas/ lus lha skur gsal ba/ ngag bzlas brjod kyis brel ba/ sems kyis ting nge 'dzin sgom pa sogs ngam ngam shugs kyi 'byung zhing / des mtshon te dad gus kyi zhing sa gshin po dang ldan pa'i rjes 'jug rnams la/ rnam thar gyi tshul gang la bsams kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pa rab tu g.yos te/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun rtag par stsal bas/ don gnyis kyi 'bras bu 'bad med lhun grub tu smin pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa 'di 'chad pa la don bcu gsum gyi sgo nas bstan par bya ste/ byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das shing theg chen gyi rigs sad pa sogs chos kyi bag chags bzang po mngon du gyur pa'i tshul/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs shing bstan de la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa'i tshul/ mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma las gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i tshul/ thos bsam sgom pa la gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor ba gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgo nas nan tan snying por mdzad pa'i tshul/ dben par sgom sgrub la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul/ bzang po'i yon tan las 'phros te sa bcu'i byang sems chen po'i bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul par gdon mi za ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan pa'i tshul/ 'dren pa dam pa'i bka' bzhin bstan pa dang sems can gyi don ci rigs su mdzad pa'i tshul/ slar yang zab mo sgom sgrub la g.yeng med du bzhugs pa'i tshul/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa kun gyi rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba'i tshul/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ spros pa thams cad bcad de gcig tu dben pa la gzhol ba'i tshul/

bgrang ba las 'das pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi slob bu'i tshogs bskrun te 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i legs lam la mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams bkod pa'i tshul/ thun mong du snang ba'i gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul gyi 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /de'i dang po byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das shing chos kyi bag chags bzang po sad pa'i tshul ni/ gzhon nu de nyid sku cher 'khrungs nas kyang sku gsung thugs kyi rtsal stobs che zhing spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ bkur 'os kun la zhe sa mkhas shing mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa'i mnga' bdag tu bzhugs pa yin te/ sku shin tu gzhon nu'i dus 'brog ris gzhan gyis ra lug bsad pa gzigs pa na/ thugs mi bzod pa chen pos yang yang du spyan chab mdzad pa dang / rgyun par dmar ma sogs pa ye mi dges shing / gzhan gyis 'bul mkhan byung ba rnams kyang na bzas lcibs nas yum la 'bul ba sogs mdzad pas yul mi rnams na re/ bu tsha 'di 'brog pa mi 'dra zhing / chos kyi bag chags shin tu bzang ba zhig 'dug ces mgrin gcig tu gleng bar byed cing / skye bo 'ga' zhig gi sna khyis ri dwags ded pa gad sler 'chur ba gzigs pa na/ zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams la a ma ma/ ri dwags ya gi snying re rje zhes gsungs pa sogs theg chen gyi rigs sad pa'i rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas shing / dgung lo brgyad dgu'i bar zhang po'i sar bzhugs shing / de dag gi skabs kyang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la yang thugs ye mi 'jug par chos mdzad rgyu zhig nam yong dgongs pa dang / skabs shig yum gyi sar gros stabs kyis byon nas nged btsun pa byed yang yang gsungs pas/ yum na re/ zhang po la bu med pas/ khyod chos byas na zhang po sems 'pham dogs 'dug pas bu tshab byed dgos zer yang /

nged cis kyang bu tshab mi byed gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa na shang pa dkar rgyal zer ba zhig 'das pa'i de'i rjes sgrub la gling kha dgon pa nas dge slong rin chen 'od 'phro ba grogs mched gnyis byung ba'i khong rnams cho ga dang gtor ma sogs gtong tsa na/ rje 'di'i thugs la nged rang yang btsun pa zhig byed dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i thugs 'dun drag po yang yang du 'khrungs shing / dge slong gnyis po'i rtsar byon nas nga yang chos la 'gro gsungs pas/ dge slong pa na re/ khyed rang yab yum sogs kyis gtong na/ nged gnyis pos mthun 'gyur gang yong rang byed zer bas/ thugs la dges tshor dpag med 'khrungs te yab yum sogs la nga chos la 'gro gsungs pas/ yum gyis zhang po'i bu tshab mdzad dgos tshul gyis sngar bzhin bkag pas/ nga btsun pa byed du mi ster na a mas nga la gang ngan byed par 'dug gsungs/ spyan chab mang po bsil bas/ yab na re/ 'di skyes nas 'u rang yang dar rgyas che bar byung bas chos la btang na mi yong ba 'dra zer ba la/ nga ci byas kyang chos la 'gro gsungs pas/ yab yum sku mched rnams bka' bgros nas bu tsha 'di dang po skyes man nas dmar la mi dga' ba dang / snying rje che ba chos pa'i 'os shig 'dug pas gtong ba las 'os mi 'dug zer kun gros mthun pas rje nyid kyi thugs la dges tshor chen po 'khrungs shing / de nas yun mi ring bar shang pa dkar rgyal gyi dge rtsa grol nas gong gi dge slong pa grogs mched gnyis dang / rje rang gi yab dang bcas sku chos mdzad par phebs pas/ gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon gnas chen po gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs la dges tshor tshad med pa sa dang po thob pa tsam byung nas dgon pa la phyag mang po mdzad gsungs pa la/ gzhan yang bdag med kyi lta ba la sku skye ba yang yang du goms pa'i dbang gis sku gzhon nu'i skabs der ri ra ba khang khyim la sogs pa 'di rnams rtag brtan ther zug tu snang ba 'di 'dra ba ya mtshan che ba la dgongs nas/

yab yum rnams la 'di rnams gang gis byas gsungs pas/ khong rnams na re/ sangs rgyas skam po bya bas byas pa yin zhus pa la phyis rje nyid kyi zhal nas sngon nged kyi pha ma tsho de bzhin zer yang / sangs rgyas skam po bya zer ba de yang bdag med kyi gtan la 'bebs rgyu gcig ka yin pa 'dug gsungs shing / gzhan yang gling khar byon nas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs te mi ring ba zhig lon pa'i dgung lo bcu gsum tsam bzhes pa'i tshe/ gang zag cig gis tshogs su dpe 'gyed byung ba na rje 'di'i phyag tu yang dpe zhig byung ba slob dpon gyi drung du bsnams te gzigs phul bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas dpe 'di bdag med bstod 'grel yin pa 'dug gsungs shing / 'grel pa'i 'og na gzhung yang bris 'dug pas 'og nas slob dpon gyis sgrog par mdzad de/ rang bzhin dri med blo gros glo bur gyi/ /dri mas sgrib pa gsal bar mdzad pa yis/ /zhes pa'i mchod brjod kyi tshig 'di nyid rje 'dis gsan ma thag thugs rgyud la rtog pa phra rags thams cad 'gags pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'khrungs te de'i ngang la rgyun ring du 'byams par grags shing / phyis byang nas sa skyong mi'i dbang po sogs dad ldan gyi slob ma mang po'i dbus su/ rje'i zhal nas/ nged gzhon nu'i dus bdag med bstod pa'i tshig la brten nas skyes pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la yun ring du lus shing / ting nge 'dzin kho rang la 'char rgyu gcig gda' zhes yang yang gsungs so/ /zhes thos la/ de ltar skyes bu dam pa'i bag chags sad pa'i mdzad 'phrin rmad du byung ba dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ pad+ma 'dam na gnas kyang 'dam gyi dri mas ma gos pa ltar khyim du bzhugs kyang khyim gyi 'ching bas nam yang gos pa mi mnga' ba yin no/ /don gyi dbang de dag gi phyir/ 'khrungs ma thag nas rgyal sras rigs sad cing /

/bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes rang mtshang rig /ngo mtshar gzhon nu'i sar bzhugs mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ dus der rim gyis gang sku'i zla ba ni/ /lang tsho yar ngo'i dpal la 'gran pa bzhin/ /gyur tshe gzhon nu'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa de/ /nam yang byis pa'i spyod pas gos ma gyur/ /rgyal ba'i sras rnams byang chen spyod tshul la/ /ring nas goms pas ched du slob pa gang / /dper na ngang pa'i tshogs rnams pad mtsho la/ khrus byed tshe na ngang gis mkhas pa bzhin/ /khyim kyi bde ba dug mtsho ltar gzigs nas/ /rgyal ba'i lam gcig yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /tshangs spyod khrims kyi bdud rtsi len pa la/ /rab tu dga' ba'i thugs kyis rings par chas/ /e ma 'di ni byis pa'i dus nyid nas/ /chos kyi de nyid ngo bo mngon gyur kyang / /da dung lam la 'bad pa'i sgyu 'phrul can/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin de dam pa'i srol/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i mdzad pa'i cha/ /ma lus gcig tu legs bsdus kyang / /dam pa 'di yi rnam thar la/ /'gran pa'i char yang mi phod do/ /gnyis pa bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs shing bstan de la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ dgung lo bcu gnyis su phebs pa bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo gong du bshad pa ltar yab dang bcas gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon par phebs te/ de dus gling kha'i mkhan po paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug bstan 'gro'i don la dbus phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur nas mi bzhugs pas/ chos kyi rje dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa mdog lho mkhan po dpal ldan rin chen pa'i zhal snga nas la bstan pa'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes te mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba gsol zhing / rab tu byung ba'i brtul zhugs la'ang gnas par mdzad la/ bstan de la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa'i tshul ni rje 'di'i dgung lo bcu gsum nas bcu bdun bzhes pa yan gyi bar la rje dpal 'byor rin chen pa nyid gnas kyi slob dpon dam par bsten te klog yig sogs brda bstan pa tsam gyis mkhyen cing /

dus der slob dpon gyi phyag gi gsang sngags kyi sgrub dkyil mang po'i dpe dang / bde kye'i rgyud rnams gzigs pa'i tshe/ rje 'di'i thugs la dang 'dod kyi dad pa lhag par 'khrungs nas phyag dpe rnams la phyag mang du mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi gsungs gis khyod ni na tshod gzhon nu la spyod tshul la ya mtshan can kho nas dus 'da' ba'i dam pa'i skyes bu las 'phro can zhig yin par gdon mi za'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / de nas gling kha dgon pa'i sgrigs dang mthun pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung / sa skya pa gong ma lnga dang / rje btsun ngor pa yab sras la sogs pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bstod tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / bzang spyod/ byams smon sogs smon lam gyi rigs mang po dang / kye rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod mtshan yang dag pa brjod pa sogs dang / sgrub dkyil gyi skor la bde mchog nag po pa/ bde mchog lū hi pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa ste bde mchog skor gsum/ kye rdor man ngag lugs/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gur rigs bsdus/ rdo rje phur pa/ de'i gtor bzlog bde kye gnyis kyi bla mchod/ kun rig bsnyen pa rgyas pa dang / gzhan phan mtha' yas/ tshe dpag lha dgu sogs dang / sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i spyi don/ ṭik+ka gsung rab dgongs gsal/ man ngag rnam bshad zla zer rtsod spong / thub pa dgongs gsal/ kun rig rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa/ sdom gsum kha skong / rgyud sde spyi rnam/ mngon rtogs ljon shing / dag ldan ma bu sogs gsung rab dri ma med pa de rnams la bslab sbyangs mdzad pa na/ sku tshe du mar goms pa lhur mdzad pa'i bag chags sad pas brda bstan pa tsam gyis tshig don gnyis ka thogs med du mkhyen cing / mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa gzhan las phul du byung bas skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur pa yin te/

rje'i gsung las kyang / nged lo bco lnga tsam lon skabs shes rab che zhing slob gnyer smar bas bshad pa dang 'brel gtam sogs la thogs med cig byung bas/ shang pa'i chos mdzad slob gnyer smar zer grags chen po byung la/ de dus byang nas dpon sa hor mos mtha' gong du mus kyi dgon gsum gyi grwa pa drag pa rnams spyan drangs/ kun rig stong tshar mdzad skabs nged kyang 'gro dgos byung nas/ nga lo gzhon pas gling kha'i grwa pa rnams kyi gral mtha' na yod pas/ de dus lung chung pas dbu mdzad tshe chos pa/ chos rje las chen pa sogs sku yon can shin tu mang ba rang 'dug pas/ de skabs dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams re mos kyis bshad pa mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ thangs shig ya ma ba'i dge bshes zhig gis brtag gnyis la bshad pa byed kyin 'dug pa'i tshe/ ngas khong gi bshad pa'i 'phro bcad nas brtag gnyis la khyed ya ma bas mi shes/ nga'i bla ma paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug gi lugs la 'di 'dra yong zer bshad pa byas pas/ khong kha skyengs/ ya ma ba'i grwa pa chos mdzad nam bzang zer ba zhig 'dug pa tshig pa zos nas/ nangs par da gzod tshun chad brtag gnyis la bal dug sed sed byed pa zhig ma byung na/ nga nam mkha' bzang po mi mi byed gsungs mna' bskyal song ba/ rting sor dbu mdzad nam bzang zer ba yon tan shin tu che ba zhig byung bas/ dbu mdzad nam bzang gi yon tan 'di nga'i drin yin gsungs shing / de dus mtha' gong pa dbu mdzad tshul khrims dpal bas rje nyid kyi dbu la phyag gis byil byil yang yang mdzad cing / btsun chung khyod la yon tan gyi gzhi chags 'dug pas/ da mthar thon pa shig gyis shig gsungs dges dges gnang ba yang byung gsung ngo / /'dir smras pa/ sdug bsngal kun gyi 'byung gnas 'khor ba las/ /gtan du thar pa'i don la thugs gzhol te/ /bstan rtsa 'dul ba'i bslab tshigs dang po yis/ /dam pa gang gi thugs brgyud btams par gyur/

/de tshe ma rig gnyid las rnam sangs shing / /thob bya 'bras bu'i yon tan cher rgyas te/ /nyon mongs bdud las rgyal ba'i dge mtshan gyis/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa sel ba'i dpal du gyur/ /de lta'i rten la skyon med kyi/ /brgyud pa las 'ongs gsung rab don/ /bde blag rtogs pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /snyan grags kun gyi kha na rgyu/ /gsum pa mkhas grub kyi bla ma tu ma las son pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du gson pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje 'chang dngos yongs 'dzin du ma las/ /skyon med sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin sogs/ /gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar las/ 'di la don gnyis te/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom gsum tshang la ma nor ba mkhan slob tshad ldan las mnos pa'i tshul dang / gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i tshul mdo tsam smos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid dgung lo yongs su grags pa la bcu dgu dang / 'dul ba pa'i lugs kyi nyi shur phebs pa 'phags pa'i yul na drag po zhes grags pa lcags pho spre'u lor/ dam pa 'dis srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad rmi lam gyi yul gyi dga' skyid dang 'dra bar snying po med cing nges par bslu ba'i chos can kho nar sku tshe dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas gzigs te/ don gnyis mthar phyin gyi 'bras bu mngon du mdzad zin kyang / gzhan gyi snang ngor nges par legs pa'i lam don du gnyer ba rnams kyis 'byung gnas khyim gyi 'ching ba mtha' dag dug can gyi zas bzhin du spong dgos zhes shes par bya ba dang / bstan pa'i rtsa ba lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che mi nyams shing dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i slad du byang grol thar pa'i yon tan gyis thugs legs par drangs pas rab tu byung bar bzhed cing / de yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni dge slong nyid yin par dgongs nas bsnyen par rdzogs par bzhed pa na/

de dang dus mtshungs par rje dam pa 'di nyid ma 'ong pa'i dus su 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs mgon dam par 'gyur bar dgongs te/ rje btsun bla ma 'dren mchog dam pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bkas/ da lo gling kha dgon pa 'dir las gral zhig bsgrig rgyu yin pas/ khyod kyang bsnyen rdzogs gyis gsungs pa la/ rje 'dis bdag lo nyi shu ma lon pas mi rung lags sam zhus pas/ rje'i gsung gis/ khyed kyis mi rung na sus rung mngal du lo gcig brtsis pas da nyi shu par 'gro ba yin/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis dgung lo bcu gsum pa la yang bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad pa yin/ khyed dgon pa'i slob gnyer ba drag shos yin pas cis kyang bsgrub dgos gsungs byung ba la rje 'di'i thugs la dges spro dpag med 'khrungs shing / de bzhin du rje dam pa 'dis rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu 'dzin pa'i snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can rje btsun chos dbang phyug pas kyang bsnyen par rdzogs na legs pa'i bka' gnang ba la brten/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dren mchog dam pa mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje chen po dang ldan zhing / sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun 'dren mchog dam pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba'i drung du mkhan po zhus shing / las kyi slob dpon rgyal ba'i chos tshul rab 'byams la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu gsal zhing dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos skal bar 'tshams pa'i gdul bya rnams la mchog tu brtse ba'i bdag nyid pa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa dang / gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan du ma la mnga' brnyes pa grub chen rin chen bzang po ba dang / grib tshod pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab can rje tshul khrims 'od zer ba dang /

grogs dan pa gsung rab dri ma med pa'i tshig don la mkhas shing btsun pa'i mchog dang ldan pa dge slong nam mkha' rnam rgyal bas mdzad de dge 'dun bcu phrag phyed kyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob par mdzad de/ de dus nam mkha' shin tu 'thib pas grib tshod gzhal ba dka' mo byung dogs pa la/ skabs su babs pa na glo bur du nam mkha' dwangs pa'i nyi ma shin tu gsal ba zhig byung pa na/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gsung gis/ 'di bzhin 'ong pa chos mdzad shang pa la rten 'brel shin tu bzang pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan yang stsal cing / de nas bzung ste tshul khrims kyi phung po mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par bzung nas dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa'i bzhi lnga/ dge tshul gyi spang bya bcu/ dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum rnams kyi dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bslab par bya ba'i cha phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang gzhan gyis tshegs chen pos sgrub pa la mi ltos pa sku gsung thugs kyi dbang po dul zhing zhi la spyod lam bag dang ldan pa'i kun spyod dri ma med pa 'phags pa rta thul grong khyer du bsod snyoms la rgyu ba'i rnam par thar pa ltar tshul khrims kyi dri bsung rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi mtha' klas par bzhugs shing / mdor na so thar gyi bslab tshigs gsum gyis rim pa bzhin thugs rgyud btams pa nas bzung / nyes ltung rags pa rnams kyi lta ci smos skye bcad kyi nyes pa tsam gyis kyang ma gos par mdzad pa yin te/ bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub pa gnang ba'i lo de'i khongs su rje btsun bla ma 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho bas gling kha bde ba can gyi gtsug lag khang gi zhabs tog la dmigs pa'i spen pad gsar sgron gnang ba'i tshe/ dge 'dun pa rnams bsags sbyang gi phyir las bskul gnang skabs/ rje 'dis rang gi tshab tu grwa pa gzhan zhig la gnang byin dang bcas nged kyis bsnyen rdzogs bsgrubs pas rtswa shing sogs bcad tshe nyes par 'gyur ba 'dul ba las gsungs pa dang 'gal ba 'dug pas/

khyod kyis nged kyi dod po gyis la dge ba'i las la spro ba dang bcas 'bad pa chen pos gyis shig ces gsungs 'dug pa 'di sogs kyis mtshon pa yin no/ /de ltar ngur smrig gi bla gos 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang nas ches mchog tu gsal zhing mdzes pa lha dang mi thams cad kyi mchod pa'i gnas dam par gyur pa'i bdag nyid chen po gzhan la phan par gzhol ba'i brtse ba can 'di ni thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i dbang gis byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyis thugs rgyud yongs su gang zhing / bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che dang ldan la/nges pa'i don du bde ba dang stong pa zung du chug pa'i lam mngon du mdzad zin kyang / mkhan slob tshad ldan de dag las so so'i cho ga las thob pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin nod par bzhed nas/ snga phyir brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed sogs dri ma med pa'i brgyud pa las 'ongs pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa rnam par dag pas thugs rgyud btams par mdzad de/ byang sems kyi bslab bya pham 'dra bzhi dang nyes byas la sogs pa gang gis kyang ma gos pa'i sems dpa' chen por bzhugs pa yin te/ gzhan la phar gnod pa dang ga la zhig ste/ tshur gnod pa chung ngu la khong khro ba cung zad tsam yang mi mnga' zhing / gnod lan du phan par sgrub pa mdzad la/ bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gis rje'i sku la brdeg pa dang / tshig ngan gyi mtshon gyi char chen po phab pa la'ang / thugs bzod pa chen pos de ma thag bshags pa bzhes pa dang / slar sdang shugs can de dag gi byed pas nged la yang khong khro skyes nas dge sbyor gyi rgyun la gnod par byung bas/ rang gzhan kun las ngan la sbyar bas shin tu ma legs zhes thugs la khro ba cung zad tsam 'khrungs pa la'ang 'gyod pa bzod glags med pa lta bu mdzad cing / zhal nas kyang /

sngon gyi bris sku rnams kyi rgyab yig la/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la 'tshe ba dang / /gzhan la gnod pa dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes bris pa 'di chos pa rnams kyis blo la 'jog dgos zhes yang yang gsungs so/ /rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sdom pa gong gi mkhan slob de sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du ma las byung rgyud sde dri ma med pa las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab par dbang dus su thob par gsung pa'i bka' drin mang du nos nas/ de'i sdom pa'i snying por rim pa gnyis la lam dus su gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor bas nan tan du srung sdom mdzad pa la brten/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos shing / tha mal gyi rtog pa gang gis kyang brdzi bar mi nus pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la dbang 'byor ba yin te/ de'i tshul ni rje rang gi gsung las kyang / sngon rje btsun sa skya pa'i gong ma na rim byon pa rnams dang / mar pa lho brag pa sogs kyis pan chen nā ro ta pa'i drung du dbang bskur ba thob phyin chad nas tha mal rnam rtog gis rdzi ma myong gsungs pa ltar/ nged kyis kyang rje chos dbang phyug pa sogs la dbang thob dus zhag 'ga' tha mal rnam rtog 'gag myong zhes gsungs shing nyams len gyi chos thams cad sems dang 'dres dgos pa yin pas/ gang nyams su len yang sems dang bsres nas byed dgos zhes yang yang du gsungs la/ dus phyis bdag sogs dad ldan gyi bu slob grangs mi nyung tsam zhabs drung na yod pa'i skabs 'ga' rer yang spyan 'bras shangs kyi rtser zim bur gzigs shing ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun bzang po la mnyam par 'jog par mdzad pa'i tshe/ de'i ngang la rgyun ring po'i bar 'byams 'gro ba mthong zhing / snga gong nas kyang 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams pa la/ slar gzim sgo phye ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis ting nge 'dzin de las sad pa na/

zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams la khyed kyis sgo ga le byas mi 'byed pa/ nged kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnod pa byung zhes yang yang gsungs so zhes thos la/ bu slob 'ga' zhig la nged la nyams rtogs chen po med kyang / lam 'bras nas bshad pa'i ye shes 'jug ldog dum tsam yong gin 'dug ces kyang gsungs 'dug cing / rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gu ru drag po'i dbang gsan dus de'i dbang chog gi dpe phyogs nas btsal ba rje'i phyag tu byung 'phral dbang gnang byung pas rje'i thugs dgongs la/ nga'i bla ma 'di 'jam dbyangs dngos su 'dug snyam dad pa bcos min 'khrungs pas/ de'i mod la dbang gral de kar rtog med kyi ting nge 'dzin la yun ring du gnas 'dug ces de dus dbang gral na yod pa'i rgyus can dag gi ngag las thos so/ /de ltar na yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di ni gsum ldan gyi dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur cing bzhugs pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i srog shing sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len nyid kyi bstod bkur bsngags gsum che ba dus kun tu lan gcig lan gnyis ma yin par ched du brjod pa mdzad de/ gsung 'phros thor bu'i zhal 'phros rgyun ldan la yang / sngon gyi dus na 'brog mi lo tsā ba rgya gar la phebs pa'i dus mkhan slob rnams kyi zhal bkod kyi rim pa la/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'dul ba/ bstan pa'i snying po yin pas phar phyin/ bstan pa'i nying khu yin pas gsang sngags/ de dag la mkhas pa'i yan lag sgra sogs tha snyad rnams slobs shog gsungs pa'i don/ gzhung skam re la 'bru 'ga' re thebs pa'i go ba ci skyes pa 'di la shes par ming btags pa'i rlom btang la zer ba ma yin/ sdom pa gsum po de dang de'i khrims kyi bslab pa bla ma la nos/ bsrung bya'i tshogs kyi spang blang gi gnas phra mo tsam la yang ma rmongs par khong du chud nas bcas mtshams la mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung ba'i go cha bgos pa'i bag yod can gcig la zer ba yin/

de lta bu'i skyes bu gcig phyogs gang na yod kyang cho ga'i yan lag sna res kyang bstan pa 'degs nus pa yin/ de la rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dbang gi rab dbyer/ kun nas kun tu zhum pa dang / /snod min tshol ba gnyis ka spang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ deng sang gang zag rigs gcig gis rang gi bla ma las tshul bzhin du thob pa'i dbang lung bsnyen sgrub las gsum mthar phyin spel na bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yod na'ang / blo zhum nas sna re yang byed mi nus pa dang / rigs gcig chos thob tsam nyid nas pher chog byed pa'i ham can zhig yong ba gnyis ka bstan pa la gnod pa yin/ des na thos pa'i don rnams nan tan gyis sgrub pa lta bur byas bstan pa'i mig rkyen la phan pa'i go cha de bgo dgos pa yin no gsungs/ yang skabs 'ga' re'i 'phros la/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ so so thar pa 'dul ba bzhin/ /byang sems sdom pa mdo sde bzhin/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhin ston pa'i/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'di ding sang 'chad pa po kun gyis kha ton du byed pa gcig yod de/ 'dis don phyag bzhes la theb nges pa chos rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras rnams dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po brgyud par bcas pa yin/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang chen po dbus la phebs pa'i skabs su/ dbus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po kun kyang sha chang sna tshogs la 'dzem bag med par longs spyod pa gzigs pas thugs lhag par 'byung ste/ sha chang gi nyes dmigs ston pa'i mdo sde rnams las lung bsdus su gnang ba phyis bstan bcos su bsgrigs pa'i thugs rtsom mdzad pa slob springs 'di yin/ rang re ngor pa'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis slob springs nas bshad pa'i bcas mtshams rnams las mi 'da' ba'i bag yod kyi go cha re bsten dgos/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos ljags thog tu sha chang 'jog ma myong ba dang /

phyag rjen pas bud med la reg ma myong ba sogs bstan pa'i mig rkyen ji ltar bzhed pa'i rnam thar rnams la gzhig pa bcug nas de'i phyogs tsam re'i dgongs pa bsab dgos pa yin te/ slob springs gyi mjug rang na/ kwa ye kho bo'i rjes su slob 'dod na/ /sha chang la sogs ma dag 'tsho ba spongs/ /rmad byung yon tan kun gyi gzhi gcig po/ /tshul khrims rin chen srog las gces par zungs/ /zhes sogs bstan pa'i babs dang bstun pa'i lam rim tshigs bcad du bsgrigs pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rmangs nas bslong ba'i mig rkyen rab cig yin/ gu ge chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos rje rdo rje 'chang la bstod pa mdzad pa'i nang na yang / khyed la brten nas log 'tsho spangs pa yi/ /legs byas phra mor gyur pa gang lags pa/ /mgon gzhan skal brgyar bsten yang ma mchis na/ /de slad gdung ba'i spu long lhag par g.yo/ /zhes pa 'dis kyang shes par nus shing / mdor na sha chang spong ba 'di rang re ngor pa'i phyag bzhes shig yin pas ci nas kyang nan tan du bya dgos pa yin no gsungs shing / yang gsung gi 'phros 'dra la/ ding sang bstan pa'i snyigs mar song bas gsang sngags la ming btags/ log chos la dpung g.yar ba'i bab chol gcig la yid rten du byed pa mang ba 'dug rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i gsang sngags gcig byed na ni/ sdom pa 'og ma gnyis la mi bsten pa'i go skabs med pa lta bu gcig yod de/ rgyud a bhi dha na las/ gong nas gong gi sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsrungs byas te/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa 'di grub chen tha dad kyi dkyil chog tu bris pa 'di yin zhing / mdor na rdo rje theg pa rang gi bla ma'i mtshan nyid 'chad pa'i dus su yang / rgyud dag las/ nyan thos spyod pa srung ba po/ /phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa srung / /nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/

zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod la ras bor du ma song ba'i/ nang rdo rje theg pa'i thabs mkhas la nan tan du byed pa zhig dgos/ de la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi sdom brtson dam pa klu sgrub yab sras/ thogs med sku mched sogs sdom brtson gyi rten la gsang sngags 'dzin pa dag gi phyag bzhes/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi tas bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī'i bar gyis rgyun ma chad par phyag len la btab pa'i don/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta tshogs 'khor gyi yi ger 'debs par mdzad pa ltar/ rab byung sdom brtson rnams kyis tshogs 'khor la sogs pa'i dus su gtor ma la sogs pa la sha chang gis brgyan/ sdom brtson rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gi thigs pa phra mo dang / shin tu cha phra ba'i sha'i zegs ma cung zad tsam ljags thog tu myangs shing / bu ram dang shing 'bras la sogs pa dus rung gi za ma rnams sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyad pas/ ltung ba bcu gsum pa'i nyes pa yang khegs shing / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong rnams mnyes shing srung skyobs mdzad pa la sogs pa'i gtan tshigs du ma 'thad ldan du gsungs pa la/ dngos su bsnyon rigs can 'ga' zhig gis rje btsun gong ma'i phyag bzhes su ming btags nas rang dang slob ma'i spyod pa phyin ci log la 'god pa'i phyag len de dag la snying po ci yod/ rnam pa gcig tu na rje btsun gong ma rnams khyim pa'i rten can du bzhugs pa'i phyag bzhes kyi cha rang re rjes 'jug dge slong gi rten can gyis bsgrub tu ga la rung / de ltar rung na rje sa skya pa chen po dang / gcung dpal chen 'od po/ zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan rnams la btsun mo yod pas/ rjes 'jug gi dge slong rnams kyis tshul de lta bu la 'jug tu rung ngam/ des na chos rje sa skya paṇa chen rten dge slong du bzhugs pa'i phyag bzhes las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis 'khrul med du lag len la 'debs dgos pa yin gsungs/

yang gsung 'phros la/ nang mchod bu ram la bshad pa'i khungs mi dbang in+d+ra bhu tis phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi tshig zin las bshad pa yin/ nang mchod kyi snod bhe ta la gsungs pa sdom 'byung las bshad do/ /ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud du bhe ta'i nang 'bras kyis klad pa'i tshab dang / phyi shun gyis thod pa dang / lkogs kyis skra'i tshab yong bar las tshogs kyi skabs 'ga' nas bshad yod pa'i rigs pas kyang sdom brtson rnams kyi thod pa'i tshab bhe ta la shin tu yang rung ba yin/ mi g.yo ba bla med pa ni rdza'i thod pas kyang yong bar bshad/ spyir yang ngur smrig gi gos gyon pa'i rab tu byung ba rnams kyis mi thod dang / mi rus kyi phreng ba la sogs pa gsang ste bsten pa las/ mi sngun du rgyan char byar mi rung / sangs rgyas kyis bslab pa thams cad 'jig rten ma dad pa dang 'phya ba spangs pa'i tshad kho nar bcas pa mdzad pa yin la/ rdo rje theg pa dang bstun na yang / las dang po pas de ltar byas na gsang sgrogs su 'gyur zhing / mdor na sdom pa gsum ka dang 'gal ba'i char 'gyur bas bag yod la gnas dgos/ de yang rje rdo rje 'chang chen pos rgyun gyi phyag phreng bo dhi tsa ta a ru ra'i mdud 'dzin dang bcas pa mdzad/ lung yang ras bal gyi skud pa ser mo 'ba' zhig las/ 'greng ba sogs la mi mdzad pa yin skad/ chos skyong gi gtor ma de la kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha ba glang la sogs pa shi ba'i shas brgyan par bya dgos pa yin la/ gzhan dag kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha 'di dag la dman par bzung nas dgag pa'i gnas du mas sun 'byin zhing bsad sha kho na nges par dgos pa'i grub mtha' gzhung tshugs su byed pa ni 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i mu stegs byed kyi ring lugs skyong ba yin pas/ snying rje chen po la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas pa dag gis thos par yang mi rung na/ lag len la 'debs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes sngon chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa nyid gsungs par dus mtshungs pa'i slob ma rnams kyis rnam thar sogs kyi yi ger btab 'dug pa 'di rnams shin tu thugs mad pa'i gnas su 'dug ces rje bla ma de nyid yang yang gsungs pa thos so/

/gnyis pa gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i tshul mdo tsam smos pa ni/ bdag cag gi bla ma yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa 'di'i sngar gyi mkhan po chos kyi rje shes bya'i gnas thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab can 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas lam zab dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/ mgon po tshe dpag med pa lha dgu'i dbang mnos nas/ dze tā ris mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog bstod pa rnams dang / tshe dpag tu med pa'i mdo/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i mdo rnams lce dga' ba'i dpal gyi 'gyur/ dkyil chog sru lung pas mdzad pa rnams gsan/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba mnos nas/ bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba rnams chag 'gyur/ 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i mngon rtogs/ de la phan rgyu'i maṇ+ḍal mchod mchog rnam snang srung bas mdzad pa'i dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs/ dus 'khor dang bstun pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'bri thabs/ 'khrul 'khor gyi nges brjod byang chub snying pos mdzad pa rnams chag gi 'gyur gsan/ bod gzhung la sgrub thabs dang drug cu pa'i gtor chog chag los mdzad pas/ dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ de'i lung sbyor dang bcas pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa rnams kyang gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba mnos nas/ ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun bzang / bdag sgrub pa/ grol ba'i thig le/ de'i 'grel pa sman pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal zhal lung lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur rnams gsan/ gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang gsan nas sgrub thabs jo bos mdzad pa rnams gsan/

yang grub chen nā ro pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zab mo mnos nas/ sgrub thabs nā ro pas mdzad pa pradzñā kirtis bsgyur pa dang / bod gzhung sa chen dang chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa rnams gsan/ gzhan yang dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rdzogs rim shin tu spros ba med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag byin rlabs dang bcas pa mnos nas/ spros med rdo rje'i sde'i tshig rkang / 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs rnams shrī bi rū pas mdzad pa/ gzhan yang bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzhung gsum dang / rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum/ las tshogs kyi gzhung gnyis te brgyad/ spros med kyi stong thun glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ spros med mdzes rgyan bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa rnams gsan to/ /yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim zab mo rim lngar grags pa mnos nas/ sgrub thabs mdor byas dang mdo bsre 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ dkyil chog nyi shu pa nag tsho'i 'gyur la chag los bcos pa/ rnam gzhag rim pa klu byang gis mdzad pa nag tsho dang lo chen gyi 'gyur/ klu byang gi dkyil chog nyi shu pa pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'gyur/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog 'gos 'gyur/ rim lnga'i gzhung dang / ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus sgron me lo chen gyi 'gyur/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa 'gos 'gyur/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong nag tsho'i 'gyur/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ de rnams ar+ya de was mdzad pa/ klu byang gi rim pa khongs su bsdu ba pa tshab kyi 'gyur/ des mdzad pa'i las mtha' rab tu dbye ba chag 'gyur/ 'grel chen sgron ma gsal pa 'gos kyi bla ma btsun mo can/ mngon shes can/ nag po pa gsum gyi shog ril gsum du grags/

byang chub sems 'grel gzhon nu 'bum dang 'gos 'gyur/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil yan lag dang bcas pa dang / khrid yig zung 'jug gsal sgron sogs bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung phran mang du mang du gsan to/ /yang 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang bskur so so byin rlabs dang bcas pa nos nas/ dpal mngon par rtogs pa lū hi pas mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur la 'gos dang mar dos bcos pa/ de'i yan lag pradzñā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa la sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa dang / gtor ma'i cho ga rngog 'gyur/ phyi rol mchod chog dang / lag mchod dpyal gyi 'gyur te lū hi pa'i smad lngar grags pa dang / yang nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog lo chen 'gyur la 'gos kyis bcos pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ rdzogs rim dpyid kyi thig le mar do'i 'gyur/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba 'gos 'gyur la mar dos bcos pa/ o la pa ti grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur te nag po gzhung drug tu grags pa dang / dril bu lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil chog rdzogs rim rim lnga'i gzhung rnams rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa dang / de dag gi gsal byed rje btsun sku mched gnyis dang / chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa rnams gsan cing dpyis phyin par mngon sum du mdzad pa yin no/ /yang bde mchog dkar po'i rdzogs rim kha che paṇ+ḍi ta sdom brtson bsod snyoms pa chen po'i thugs dam zab mo byin rlabs dang bcasapa gsan nas/ de'i khrid yig dpyal pad+mo can pa a mo ghas mdzad pa dang / khrid yig brgyud pa gsum pa zhes bya ba dang / byin rlabs kyi cho ga bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa rnams kyang gsan to/ /yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rdzogs rim nag po rim bzhi'i khrid gsan nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i rim bzhi lam slong /
