kun mkhyen gyi khrid yig sogs yig cha gsar rnying du ma'i lung yang gsan to/ /yang kye rdo rje mtsho skyes lugs/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs/ grub chen bir+wa pa'i lugs/ grub chen ḍom+bhi ba'i lugs te bka' babs bzhir grags pa gsan nas/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i rgya bod kyi gzhung du ma'i lung yang nos so/ /gu ru drag dmar nyang lugs kyi dbang gsan nas/ de'i sgrub thabs bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa dang / dbang chog sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa yang gsan to/ /yang rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang / kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams dang / rdo rje gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang yang gsan nas/ de dag gi sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa'i yig cha/ rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams dang / chos rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis mdzad pa du ma'i lung dang bcas pa gsan to/ /yang rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong gnyis pa de nyid kyi drung du gsung ngag rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/ rje btsun dges mdzad rdo rje yab yum kyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa gnyis su so so'i dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas thabs rgyud kyi thog ma rgyu dus kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / ma bcos pa rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / gzhung shing rgyas pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du dkri ba'i gzhung shing gi khrid legs par gsan nas/ thog ma nyid du bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam par thar pa thor bur gnas pa rnams dang / rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang / rnam 'grel gnyag ma/ de'i bar skabs kyi gsal byed la kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ gdan sogs/ lam sogs nyi shu la lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ bum dbang gi 'da' kha ma'i skabs su 'chi ltas 'khrul 'khor 'chi blu dang bcas pa/

bum dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' kha ma/ gsang dbang gi thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ dbang bzhi pa'i 'da' kha ma bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa/ bar do bzhi'i gdams ngag tshad ma bzhi/ gdams ngag drug rten 'brel lnga/ grib sel gyi sbyin sreg dri ma khrus kyis sel ba dang tsha tshas sel ba/ thig le srung ba/ yi ge brgya pa'i 'don thabs/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs su rlung gi sbyor ba bdun/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi/ 'das pa'i lam la gsang dbang gi skabs su/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i skabs su dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum pa'i phyed kyi mngon rtogs te gsal byed nyer gnyis de thams cad kyi don bsdus pa'i tshigs bcad a seng ma ste bstan bcos/ tshad ma la dgos pa'i yig sna nyer bzhi dang de dag las 'phros pa la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'phros nas 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel/ gdan sogs la 'phros nas dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol lam la brten te bskur ba/ lam sogs nyi shu la 'phros nas phyi bskyed rim mdor bsdus pa/ dam tshig la 'phros nas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par bskur ba'i yi ge srung ba sum cu dang man ngag gi gnad bdun cu la 'phros nas gegs sel la bsam gtan mdor ba'i 'phreng bdun/ byung rgyal du mi btang ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyi gsal ba/ rnal 'byor gyi 'phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis te bzhi dang / las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos la dbang gi chu bo'i lag len rgyas pa/ bum dbang gi srung ba'i dam tshig bye brag tu bshad pa 'khrul ba spong ba/ tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga yab kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ yum gyi sgrub thabs/

sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang bdun te 'phros bcu bdun no/ /de dag ni lam rgyas pa'i cha lag go /rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bring po dang / rang gzhung dang bcas pa'i lam bsdus pa/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba/ gnad drug gnad bcu gcig dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyi dkri ba ste gzhung shing bzhi dang / lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag lam bsre ba 'gros bzhi dang bcas pa/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis te rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga dang lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams myong tshad ma la dgos pa'i yig sna nyer dgu dang / bla ma tshad ma la bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar gnyis/ lung tshad ma la lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang / de gnyis dang zhib tu sbyar ba re re ste bzhi dang / man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs te chos sna drug cur grags pa las/ glegs bam 'dir cis kyang dgos pa'i yig sna zhe dgu/ las dang po pa dang thun mong du dgos pa'i chos bdun/ de rnams kyi dkar chag dang bcas pa dang / lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang byin gyis brlabs pa rnams gsan to/ /yang rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa dang / lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang byin rlabs bla ma rin 'byung sogs yan lag phra mo dang bcas pa dang / phyi'i bar chad srung ba'i thabs gtso bor gyur pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi byin rlabs zab mo yan lag dang bcas pa dang / de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs zab mo chig brgyud ma dang / nang gi bar chad srung thabs snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gnad zab mo rnams dang / thun mong gi bar chad srung ba la phan 'dogs rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ gsung ngag gi gnad bsdus te nyams su len tshul ston pa brda' don gsal ba byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ gsung ngag stan thog gcig tu dril nas nyams su len tshul ston pa lam bsdus te sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/

lam sbas bshad kyi khrid 'khrul 'khor rnams kyi lag len dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs tshar gsum khug pa/ de'i yan lag drug dang bcas pa rnams gsan cing dpyis phyin par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang de dag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gsung rab thor bur gnas pa man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs su grags pa rnams bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa po ti dmar chung du mtshan gsol ba kha skong dang bcas pa gsan pa'i rnam grangs ni/ bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ de'i kha skong / sa bir mjal ba'i lo rgyus/ bra ston zhus lan/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor/ rtsa sngags kyi bzlas lung bya tshul/ rtsa sngags kyi gzhi bshad/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ dbang gi rab dbye/ dga' ston la gdams pa/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/ de'i kha skong / lus sbyong nyi shu pa/ lus gnad kyi man ngag bdag med ma'i byin rlabs/ gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyer dgu/ gegs sel gsang bdun ma/ bar chad gsum sel/ bla ma chen po'i nyams che chung gnyis/ gegs sel gces bsdus/ gleng bzhi ma/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs sogs sel ba/ bka' rgya ma/ gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi'i gsal byed/ 'phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom/ de'i zhal shes bris pa/ dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod rtsa 'grel gnyis/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ gsang bcu'i gdams ngag gnad du che ba drug rten 'brel lnga/ lam bsdus pa 'dod pa'i lcags kyu/ phyag chen gyi dbye ba/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ tshogs sbyor mngon rtogs/ lam bsdus pa'i bshad pa/ lung 'di dang zhib tu sbyar ba/ lam zab kyi khrid yig bla ma rin 'byung / lam sbas bshad/ pho brang lnga'i sbas bshad/ de'i 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel/ grub phra rtsa 'grel/ de'i gsal byed/ bir srung gi man ngag rnying pa gsum/ bir srung byin rlabs byed tshul dang bcas pa/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs bya tshul/ gzungs kyi mtshan/ de'i gsal byed/

de'i lag len/ brda don gsal ba rtsa 'grel gnyis/ lho pa'i zin bris/ tshar gsum khug pa/ yig brgya'i gdams ngag rnams dang / shān ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ dzñā na shrī/ rin chen rdo rje gsum gyi bar chad gsum sel/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ nā ro pa'i sdug bsngal gsum sel te 'brog mis bi kra ma la shi la'i mkhas pa sgo drug la chos 'brel du gsan pa rnams te chos kyi rnam grangs drug cu rtsa gsum dang / de rnams kyi kha skong bla ma yab sras kyis mdzad pa la/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ rgyud gsum lam rim gyi sa bcad/ lam zab nang gi bla ma'i nyams len/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi rtogs bskyed/ bir srung bar chad kun sel/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bir srung gi byin rlabs bya tshul/ de'i nyams len/ de dang gsung ngag mtshan mtshon sbyar ba/ bir srung gsar ma sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi yi ge rnams bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal rin chen rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa dang / rje mus pa chen pos mdzad pa'i gsung ngag skor la/ ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog sa chog mdor bsdus/ phyi nang gi bskyed rim gnyis/ gtor ma'i cho ga khrid yig che chung gnyis/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len rnams lan mang du gsan cing / dpyis phyin par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje/ gzhung bshad gsung bgros ma/ lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba'i kha skong rnams dang / bar ston gyi zin bris gnyis/ chos rje dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa'i gsung ngag skor gyi glegs bam/ zhang bya ru ba dang / gnyag nyan/ klan gsum gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig thor bu ba rnams dang / yig brgya'i bzlas lung / rtsa sngags kyi bzlas lung / rtsa sngags la brten pa'i byad bzlog phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa dang /

bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs la sogs pa lam 'bras lam skor zhar byung gi gdams ngag dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs lung man ngag phyag len phra mo tshun chad lan grangs du mar gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar gsan pa de dag kyang thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod nas bsgom pas nyams su bzhes pa la brten tha mal rnam rtog 'gags pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /yang snying rje chen po dang ldan pa ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus par grags pa/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung dgu bcu rtsa drug bzhugs pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa dang / ba ri ba'i gser chos bcu gsum/ rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam chos drug sna tshogs rigs pa'i 'bum che chung du grags pa gnyis dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtshor grags pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa yang gsan to/ /gzhan yang dmar po skor gsum du grags pa'i yi dam khyad par can gyi rjes su gnang ba gsan nas ku ru kul+le'i chos skor la/ thog ma'i lo rgyus/ rjes gnang gi yi ge dga' ldan pas mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag che chung gsum/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ shar pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang bcas pa gsan/ 'dod rgyal gyi chos skor la/ sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor lo rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pas/ sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi rab gnas/ bzlas lung gi man ngag gtor ma'i zhal gdams/ rgyal po sogs dbang du bya ba'i zhal gdams/ pho mo gnad kyi 'khor lo/ yul bdag dbang bsdud/ spogs chog khrom dbang bsdud/ nyin mtshan bsrung ba/ dbang drag gi zhal gdams/ drag po'i las sbyor/ 'khor lo bri ba'i man ngag las bzhi'i zin bris/ gsang sgrub/

rin chen sgrub pa'i man ngag zhi rgyas drag gsum la kha sgyur sbyin sreg bstod pa/ mchod 'bul/ rtags kyi yi ge rten 'brel gyi cho ga brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ rjes gnang gi cho ga sa paṇa gyis mdzad par grags pa/ kag chol gyi sgrub yig man ngag gi gnad phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ sgrub thabs dang bstod pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi mdzad pa rnams gsan/ tshogs bdag gi skor la/ tshogs bdag gi lo rgyus/ sgrub thabs dī pam̐ ka ras mdzad pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi zhal gdams chen mo/ dbang rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg tshogs bdag gi snying po/ rgyud las byung ba'i khro bo chen po dang / bgegs rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ de gnyis sbrags pa'i rjes gnang gi phyag len/ bstod pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa rnams legs par gsan cing nyams bzhes mdzad pa yin no/ /gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang gsan nas/ sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa dang / lo rgyus rjes gnang bstod pa dang bcas pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang yan lag dang bcas pa/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang / 'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i rtogs pa'i sa bcad dang bcas pa/ 'chi med sgrol ma'i rjes gnang 'chi blu yan lag dang bcas pa/ gnyan sgrol gyi rjes gnang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs phyag 'tshal nyer gcig de'i sa bcad/ ṭī ka gsal ba'i 'od zer rnams gsan to/ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang brgyud pa gnyis las 'ongs pa'i sgrub thabs da na shrī las mdzad pa tshigs bcad lhug pa gnyis/ mkhas pa yon tan khris zhal gzigs pa'i lo rgyus/ sgrub thabs man ngag gsum dang bcas pa/ bstod pa yan lag bdun ldan rnams gsan to/ /yang gtum po sngon po'i rjes gnang chu srung dang bcas pa/

'khor lo bri ba'i rgya gzhung / slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub skor dang bcas pa/ sher phyin dkar mo'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma 'phel dang dge 'dun sbyin gyi bus mdzad pa/ bod gzhung bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa bstod pa dang bcas pa/ sa lugs kyi don zhags kyi rigs gtad/ don zhags kyi lo rgyus/ rgyud chung gi sa bcad/ lha lnga'i bstod pa/ mdo'i 'grel pa slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa dang / cho ga'i lag len/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga bstod pa/ srung 'khor 'bri tshul rnams rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs/ gdon sgrol gyis cho ga 'khon rin rgyal gyis mdzad pa rnams gsan/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rig pa gtad pa de'i gzungs 'khon klu dbang pos bsgyur pa/ de lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i rjes gnang gzungs kyi man ngag dang bcas pa/ 'byung 'dul gyi rjes gnang / de'i cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang dpal mo'i lugs kyi jo bo bcu gcig zhal gyi riga~X gtad/ gtso 'khor gsum pa'i riga~X gtad/ gur nas gsungs pa'i so so 'brang ma'i rjes gnang / rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi rjes gnang / tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang / u tsa me dbang mar grags pa/ dzam bha la ser nag gi rjes gnang / tshe dbang grub rgyal mar grags pa dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ de rnams so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa gsan/ ri khrod ma'i rjes gnang gsan nas/ de'i man ngag gi yi ge rnams kyi lung / ba ri ba nas brgyud pa'i seng gdong sngo dmar gyi rjes gnang / de'i las tshogs kyi yi ge gsar rnying rnams dang / sa skya pa'i man ngag khyung nag gi rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa/

khyung khra'i rjes gnang dang / de'i man ngag gi yig skor gyi lung / dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang / de'i rgyud/ las tshogs rnam grangs mang po dpal chen rga lo nas rje sa chen la brgyud pa'i lung dang bcas pa gsan/ grub thob brgyad bcu'i chos skor gsan pa la/ grub thob so so'i lo rgyus dang rnam thar/ rjes gnang / rtogs brjod/ de'i 'grel pa/ tshogs 'khor/ man ngag rin po che'i phreng ba rtsa 'grel/ sku bri thabs/ bstod pa/ chos 'di'i byung tshul rnams gsan to/ /dud gsol lha mo'i rjes gnang dang / de'i man ngag gi yi ge gsar rnying mang po'i lung / phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya'i rjes gnang la sogs pa 'dod lha so so'i sgrub thabs dang / rjes gnang dang / rig gtad la sogs pa gdams ngag phra mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad la/ khyad par bstan srung chen po ma hā kā la lcam dral dang / lha brgyad dang / las kyi mgon po lcam sring rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba bka' bsgo khyad par can gyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa dang / mgon po'i nang khrid rtsa gsum 'khor lo la brten pa/ 'jam sgrub/ rtsub sgrub/ shin tu rtsub par sgrub pa rnams kyi khrid dang / de dag gi chos skor zab mo du ma'i lung dang man ngag phyag khrid dang bcas pa mtha' yas pa legs par gsan cing / bar du gcod pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlabs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang chos kyi rje de nyid las rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/ thog mar mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud rnams dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa bshad rnams dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud rnams rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab dang mthun pa'i lung gi bka' legs par gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/

/yang 'dren pa dam pa de nyid kyi drung du grub pa'i slob dpon chen po khyung po rnal 'byor pa rgya gar shar nub gung gsum du lo bco brgyad kyi bar du btsal ba'i zab chos rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro nai gu ma nas brgyud pa'i man ngag gi srol chen po gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ thog mar rgyud sde gtso bsdus kyi dbang / myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang gtor dbang dang bcas pa/ de nas thabs lam gyi dbang / de'i khrid/ sgyu lus kyi dbang / de'i khrid/ rmi lam gyi dbang / de'i khrid/ 'od gsal gyi dbang / de'i khrid/ bar do'i dbang / de'i khrid/ 'pho ba'i dbang / de'i khrid/ gdan thog gcig ma'i khrid/ lam khyer rnam gsum gyi dbang / de'i khrid/ 'chi med rnam gsum gyi dbang /de'i khrid/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i dbang / de'i khrid/ mkha' spyod dmar mo'i byin rlabs/ dkar mo'i byin rlabs/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med kyi byin rlabs/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang / lung gi skor la/ nai gu ma'i rnam thar rmog cog pas mdzad pa/ khyung po'i rnam thar/ zhang sgom chos bzang / sne'u ston pa/ rmog cog pa/ rin chen rdo rje bzhis bsgrigs pa/ rmog cog pa'i rnam thar/ skyer sgang pa'i rnam thar/ sangs rgyas ston pa'i rnam thar/ chos rje ston pa'i rnam thar chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa/ shang ston gyi rnam thar rgyal mtshan 'bum dang gzhung pa rin chen rdo rje gnyis kyis mdzad pa/ gnyag ston pa'i rnam thar cha rgan gyis mdzad pa/ chos rje rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnam thar tshigs su bcad pa bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam thar drung na yod pa rnams kyis bkod pa/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar dge slong dpal mgon pa dang rje blo rin pas mdzad pa gnyis/

sangs rgyas bzang po'i rnam thar chos rgyal bkra shis kyis mdzad pa/ chos rgyal bkra shis kyis rnam thar rat+na ma tis mdzad pa/ skyer sgang pa'i rnam thar bka' rgya ma gnyan ston pas mdzad pa/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i rnam thar cha rgan gyi mdzad pa'i kha skong ma/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal gyi rnam thar blo gros dpal gyis mdzad pa/ blo gros bzang po'i rnam thar tshigs bcad ma/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho rang nyid kyi rnam thar rje byams pa rab brtan pas mdzad pa rnams gsan cing / man ngag gi yig lung gi skor la/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang / tshig gsal/ thim yig khrid yig rgyal mtshan 'bum gyis mdzad pa/ sgyu ma rab tu gsal byed rin chen 'od 'phreng rmog cog pas mdzad pa/ nyams myong yon tan rgya mtsho/ zhus lan rin chen sgron me/ nyams myong nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ zhus lan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i rten 'brel/ sgyu lus drug ldan khyung pos mdzad pa/ sgyu lus kyi lung dang gtam rgyud/ shang ston pa'i gsung bgros/ lam dri med 'od 'phreng sangs rgyas ston pas mdzad pa/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byams gcod/ khrid kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i gsung bgros drug rgyal mtshan 'bul gyis mdzad pa/ snyan khung gi gdam ngag drug khyung pos mdzad pa/ khyung po'i gnad drug la sogs rgyun gyi nyams len/ khyad 'phags 'pho ba rnam drug 'di sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bgros/ sbyang ba rnam pa gnyis/ sgyu lus kyi sbyang ba rnam pa gsum khyung pos mdzad pa/ sgyu lus gdan thog gcig ma/ sgyu lus 'dzin pa rang grol/ dug gsum dag byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ phyag chen ga'u ma'i rtsa tshig rdo rje'i tshig rkang / bsdus don rlung dang bsre ba/ phyag chen tshad 'dzin/ ga'u ma'i dbang chog lding ston gyi zin bris 'di gnyis cung zad ma gtogs 'dra/ 'chi med sgrub pa'i rgyas 'grel/ 'chi med sgrub pa'i rtsa ba/

lam khyer rnam gsum/ rang sems 'chi med rang grol/ lam khyer gsum gyi sgyu ma lam gyi dbang bka'/ 'chi med rang grol sangs rgyas ston pas mdzad pa/ lam khyer gsum gyi gzhung / 'chi med tshig rkang / de la brten pa'i bla ma rmog cog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston rnams kyi gsung bgros re re/ mkhas btsun rgyan 'bum gyi khrid yig ḍā ki'i zhal gdam/ rang grol gsum gyi khrid/ chos drug 'gag don blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i zhal gdams/ sangs rgyas ston pa'i gcod gdan thog gcig ma/ de'i gegs sel/ nā ro pa'i dbu ma yi ge bdun mas gang ba'i man ngag dbang chog sogs kyi skor la/ dbang bskur sngon 'gro'i cho ga brtson 'grus seng ges mdzad pa/ dbang chog dang po gtum mo'i dbang chog gnyis pa sgyu lus/ gsum pa rmi lam/ bzhi pa 'od gsal/ lnga pa 'pho ba/ drug pa bar do'i dbang chog rnams khyung po'i lugs/ lam khyer gsum gyi chos/ lam khyer gsum gyi bka'/ lus 'chi med kyi dbang bka'/ sems 'chag med kyi dbang bka' khyung pos mdzad pa/ khyad 'phags kyi gdams pa bco lnga/ sku gsum lam khyer/ dgag pa thig le'i 'pho ba ra hu la'i gdams pa/ mkha' spyod dkar mo'i dbang ra hu la'i lugs/ 'pho ba ye shes dkar khung ma rgyas bsdus gnyis/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston gyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs char 'bebs/ sgyu lus rmi lam gyi dbang bka' khyung pos mdzad pa/ nai gu ma'i zhal gdams mu tig gi phreng ba sogs zhal gdams bcu/ ri bong dbab bzung bzlog pa'i dmigs pa rin chen sgrom bu/ gsang sngags rjes su yid rang gi khrid/ rjes su yid rang gi dbang / dug lnga lam khyer/ rtog mi rtog mkha' spyod dkar mo'i bstod pa/ mkha' spyod gsum/ phyag drug pa'i las tshogs tshang ma/ bdag med ma'i khrid/ su kha chos drug gi khrid/ rdo rje phag mo'i gsang sgrub sogs tshan pa brgyad/

bde mchog lha lnga'i mngon rtogs khyung po'i lugs/ sgyu lus stan thog gcig ma mkhas btsun pas mdzad pa sogs mdor na rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba nyid kyis/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags dang / mkhan chen rdo rje rin chen gnyis kyi drung du gsan pa'i zab don nai gu'i chos skor rnams ma tshang ba med pa gsan nas brtson 'grus drag pos thugs nyams su bzhes pa la brten/ rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor la rang dbang thob pa dang / mtshon byed dpa'i ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i tshul sogs ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /gzhan yang rje btsun sa skya pa chen po dang / slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs gyi lung sogs sa skya pa gong ma lnga'i gsung rab phal che ba dang / rje rdo rje 'chang dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyi bka' 'bum phal cher gyi lung yang gsan to/ /de la sogs pa chos kyi rje de nyid la mnga' ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bka' lung mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan cing spyod lam gyi sgo nas kyang yongs su mnyes par mdzad pas thugs kyi sras mchog tu 'dzin pa mdzad do/ /yang bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'dis mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab can mdo rgyud yongs kyi mnga' bdag paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug pa'i drung du bka' gdams lha bzhir grags pa'i rjes gnang gsan nas/ de'i rjes su thub pa'i lha khrid/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi khrid/ mi g.yo ba chos drug gi khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i khrid rnams gsan nas/ de dang rjes su 'brel bar slob dpon 'phags pa zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa chen po/ ma pham byams pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i thub pa chen po'i skyes rabs/

dgra bcom pa chos skyobs kyis mdzad pa'i ched du brjod pa'i tshoms te bka' gdams gzhung drug bka' gdams glegs bam du grags pa gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la byang chub sems dpa' nor bu'i 'phreng ba/ pha chos le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ bu chos le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'brom gyis rang rgyud la bskul ma 'debs pa dad pa'i ljon shing / pha chos kyi ya gyal 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i glu rnams gsan cing / de lta bu'i gsung chos rnams gsan pa'i bar skabs shig la paṇa chen dpon slob rnams nub rong chab tshan la byon nas/ slar dgon par phebs pa'i tshe/ bla brang gi lde mig gzim chung du lus nas phyag g.yog rnams ci bya la thug pa'i tshe/ pan chen gyi gsung gis/ ban chung mang po'i dkyil na 'dug pa'i shang pa'i btsun chung ma gi bos shog la/ sked pa la rngul gzan dkris nas gzim chung mthong ga nas zhugs thag gi tshul du gyis la lde mig longs la sgo phye zhig ces gsungs pa bzhin/ phyag g.yog rnams kyis de bzhin du bgyis 'dug pa de lta bu ni paṇa chen dus gsum mkhyen pa des/ bdag gi rje bla ma 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gling kha bde ba can gyis chos grwa chen po'i bzhugs gdan seng ge'i khri la 'khod nas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs mgon dam par 'gyur ba'i lung bstan de dus nas mdzad pa yin par gdon mi za bar snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so/ /yang bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'dis/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa dharma shwa ra zhes yongs la grags pa'i 'dir snang gi bya ba thams cad ngan skyugs kyi phung po bzhin dor nas gcig tu dben pa la gzhol bas bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob ste/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa dad ldan gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mngon sum du gyur pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug de nyid kyi drung du thog mar 'khor lo bde mchog nag po sa lugs kyi dbang gsan nas de dang 'brel ba'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa rgyas pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa dang /

rdzogs rim dpyid kyi thig le'i khrid gsan cing / yang 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nos nas/ de'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa dang / rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum gyi khrid gsan la/ yang 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang nos nas/ dril bu lus dkyil gyi bshad pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa dang / rdzogs rim rim pa lnga'i khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa gsan nas/ de'i rgyab rten du lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs dpal mngon par rtogs pa lo chen gyi 'gyur la 'gos dang mar dos bcos pa/ de'i 'grel pa rngog gi 'gyur/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga dang lag mchod gnyis dpyal chos bzang gi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga rngog 'gyur te/ phyi ma bzhi pradzñā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa gsan/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa bas mdzad pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog lo chen gyi 'gyur la 'gos kyis bcos pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur/ dpyid kyi thig le mar do'i 'gyur/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba 'gos 'gyur la mar dos bcos pa/ o la pa ti grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur te bskyed rim skor gsum/ rdzogs rim skor gsum dang bcas pa'i gzhung drug ka gsan/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mal 'gyur/ dkyil chog bon chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa blo ldan shes rab kyi 'gyur te/ dril bu skor gsum du grags pa ste lū nag dril gsum gyi gzhung de rnams rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma'i mchan bu dang bcas pa gsan to/ /gzhan yang nyung ngu mtshams sbyor su ma ti kirtis mdzad pa grags mchog shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rgyun bshags bhū ri pas mdzad pa dang / bod gzhung la rje sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi le'u 'grel dang /

dka' 'grel gnyis/ man ngag nag 'bum du grags pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa ba'i lo rgyus/ gzhung drug spyi'i rnam gzhag dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal pa/ o la pa ti/ dpyid thig rnams kyi sa bcad re re/ ras bris la brten pa'i dkyil chog mngon rtogs kyi ṭīk+ka/ de'i lag len/ ro sreg gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba'i ṭīk+ka/ de'i tshig don bsdus pa'i sgo 'byed/ o la pa ti'i rnam bshad/ dpyid thig gi ṭīk+ka ste chos kyi rnam grangs bcu bdun yod pa dang / dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i he ru ka'i byung tshul/ lū hi ba'i mngon rtogs kyi don 'grel chen mo/ nag po'i dkyil chog gi sa bcad 'khrugs can dang 'khrugs med gnyis/ nag po pa'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi sa bcad/ nag po dkyil chog gi 'grel pa bshad sbyor du grags pa/ dkyil chog lag tu blang pa'i rim pa/ dril bu pa'i sgrub thabs/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa bya tshul/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dkar shākya grags dang shar pa rdo rje 'od zer gyis mdzad pa/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i bde mchog bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga chos dang bsod nams rab rgyas/ mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i lū nag dril gsum rim pa bzhin nyams su blang tshul/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ngag 'don/ lū nag dril gsum gyi bum bskyed/ bde gshegs sa gzungs/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i bde mchog chos 'byung / bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad/ lū nag gnyis kyi mngon rtogs/ rje bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad che chung rnams kyi lung bshad shin tu zhib pa dang / bde mchog gi mchod 'phreng rje dkon mchog 'phel bas mdzad pa/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa la 'phags pa rin po ches bcos shing dag par mdzad pa rnams gsan to/

/yang chos kyi rje nyid kyi drung du 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma kirti dang / lo tsā ba mal gyo blo gros grags kyi 'gyur/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i sa bcad dang / ṭīk+ka mu tig phreng ba'i steng nas dang / de'i bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod mal 'gyur/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i sa bcad/ 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas lung bshad mtha' chod par gsan to/ /yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs mnos nas/ de'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim zab mo rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa dang / yang 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor chig brgyud ma/ sgrub thabs rgya gzhung nā ro pas mdzad pa/ rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor bcu gcig bskyed rim la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi ge byin rlabs kyi yi ge tshogs mchod mdor bsdus/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ sbyin sreg gi yi ge mar me'i sbyin sreg rnams dang / lam gyi yan lag skra sen dbab pa/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba/ pad+ma ta'i sgrub thabs/ khol po sa~X ta na'i sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin mo'i bcud len gyi yi ge ste man ngag de rnams yongs su rdzogs pa dang / rje btsun gyi rtsa dbu ma'i khrid yig sogs 'di skor gyi yig cha rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa dang / rjes 'jug mkhas pa so sos mdzad pa ma tshangs ba med pa gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de ltar zab mo'i yang rtse mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab don chos kyi nor bus 'dren pa dam pa 'di'i thugs kyi rgya mtsho yongs su btams te/ zab khrid kyi snying po la rtse gcig tu mdzad pa la brten/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan khyad par can brnyes pa'i tshul dang / sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes mngon du mdzad cing /

ting nge 'dzin sgom pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig gi mngon par mkhyen pa thob nas 'chi 'pho skye ba len pa sogs thogs med du mkhyen pa dang / mkha' spyod ma'i 'da' kha ma zab mo'i rnal 'byor 'byongs pa rab kyi mthar son nas/ de'i rtags ngo mtshar can mig ldan kun gyi mngon du gyur pa'i tshul sogs 'og tu 'chad do/ /yang 'dren pa dam pa de nyid kyi drung du kye rdo rje'i rgyu lam gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang mnos nas/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid mdor bsdus don tshang gi tshul du gsan nas/ de'i cha lag gi nang tshan brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa sogs gzhan la ma grags pa'i zab gnad khyad par can 'ga' zhig dang gzhung bshad sras don ma/ dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje/ gzhung bshad gsung bgros ma/ lugs 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba'i gsal byed rnams dang / bar ston gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma rgya gar ba dang / bod kyi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / gzhung bshad kyi zin bris/ dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba dang / khrid yig sbas don gsal/ zhang bya ru ba ār+ya de wa/ gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ klan dkar ba seng ge rgyal mtshan rnams kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig thor bu pa rnams kyang gsan to/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar thor bur gnas pa rnams gsan pa'i rnam grangs la/ sa chen gyi rnam thar dang / rje btsun rtse mo'i rnam thar bstod pa mchan bu dang bcas pa rje pas mdzad pa/ rje pa'i rnam thar chos rje pas mdzad pa/ rnam thar mnal lam ma sbal ston gyis bris pa/ chos rje pa'i rnam thar lho pa kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa dang / rnam thar gsung bgros ma bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa'i rnam thar ye chen pos mdzad pa/ tshogs nyan gnyis kyi rnam thar bar ston gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa'i lo rgyus las btus pa nyan chen pa'i rnam thar dkar so brag pas mdzad pa/

zhang pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ brag phug pa'i rnam thar ri khrod pas mdzad pa/ chos rje bla ma dang ri khrod pa'i rnam thar dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ dkar so brag pa'i rnam thar khong rang gis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan pa'i rnam thar mus chen gyis mdzad pa/ bud+dha pa'i rnam thar bla ma rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa mus chen gyi mdzad pa/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar kha skong dang bcas pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen/ yongs 'dzin/ grub chen dkon mchog blo gros gsum gyi rnam thar rje sangs rin pas mdzad pa/ rje sangs rin gyi rnam thar sa los mdzad pa rnams gsan cing / yang kun rig sa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang mnos nas/ de'i cho ga'i bshad pa rnam bshad zin bris ma dpag bsam ljon pa'i steng nas phyag len phra mo tshun gyi zhib cha dang bcas legs par gsan nas/ de'i rgyab rten du ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i gzhan phan skor gsum/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i gsung rab rnams dang / kun mkhyen gyi gzhan phan kun khyab dang / gzhan phan gnod 'joms rnams gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /yang rje de nyid kyi drung du mus chen sems dpa' chen po dang / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gnyis kyi bka' 'bum dkar chag nang bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa mnos shing / gzhan yang 'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs pa bar chad zhi ba'i lha rnams dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs pa byang chub kyi sems rgyas pa'i lha du ma dang / sgrol ma dkar mo dang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal la sogs pa tshe rgyas pa'i lha du ma dang / 'jam dpal gyi rigs mang po dang / sher phyin dkar mo dang / mi g.yo ba dkar po la sogs pa blo gros rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / dzam+bha la dang / nor rgyun ma la sogs pa nor rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / phyag rdor dang rta mgrin u tsar+ya la sogs pa bar chad dang gnod pa 'joms pa'i lha rnams dang /

dmar po skor gsum dang / dbyug gu ma mched gsum la sogs pa khams gsum dbang du bsdus pa'i lha rnams dang / nag po chen po lcam dral dang / dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa bstan pa bsrung zhing drag po'i las sgrub pa'i lha rnams sogs mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol ba'i lhag pa'i lha bgrang ba las 'das pa'i rjes gnang / bka' gtad/ man ngag la sogs pa du ma yang zhib tu gsan pa yin no/ /de ltar zab don gyi man ngag rgya mtsho lta bu'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'i rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa nyid la/ bdag cag gi bla ma 'dis rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi nang nas kyang mchog dam par 'dzin pa mdzad pa yin te/ rje'i gsung las/ nged ni chos dbang phyug pa dang mjal res bzhin/ nga'i bla ma 'di 'phags pa'i gnas brtan zhig ma gtogs/ mi phal pa zhig yin snyam pa nam yang yong ma myong / zhes gsungs shing / yang rje'i gsung las/ nged kyis rje chos dbang pa la dbang khrid byin rlabs sogs chos gang zhu yang / de dang 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha gang yin der bsgoms nas zhus pas byin rlabs cung zad zhugs pa yin snyam pa yod ces gsungs la/ dus skabs phal cher du rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod rnam par dag pa'i bka' mchid kho na gsungs par thos shing / yang dus phyis bdag cag don gnyer gyi slob bu rnams la bde mchog gi chos skor rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba'i tshe/ rje'i gsung las/ nged kyis bde mchog gi chos skor rnams rje chos dbang pa'i drung du thob pa la dka' tshegs chen po byung ste/ de yang dril bu pa'i byin rlabs 'di la mtshon na'ang / dang po snga gong zhig rje chos dbang pa slas pa rdzong chung na bzhugs dus zhus pas/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyi bdud rtsi ril bu gcig sgrubs shog gsungs/ bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas phyin pas/ da yang bdud rtsi'i chang zhig med pas mi yong ba 'dug gsungs/

de nas dkon mchog gi thugs rjes de ma thag bdud rtsi bum gang rje'i nye gnas la skyel mi byung bas/ rje chos dbang pa'i gsung gis/ da ni khag dkris pa yang ma byung bas byin rlabs byed dgos pa las ma 'das gsung gnang ba yin/ bla ma gong ma rnams sa skya pa'i yab chos mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba 'di rnams la thugs rtsis shin tu che zhing / bu slob thugs rtsis che che mo su la yang bka' dog po mdzad/ khyed rnams la nga'i zab chos 'di rnams dka' tshegs med pa byin pa la dga' ba sgoms la bshad sgrub 'bad nas gyis shig ces gsungs pa sogs 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor rnams la bsngags brjod du ma gnang ba yin te/ spyir bdag cag gi bla ma 'di la 'dren pa dam pa thams cad kyis/ rje 'di ma 'ongs pa'i dus bstan pa'i srog shing chen por 'gyur bar mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis rtse gcig tu thugs brtse ba chen pos skyong bar mdzad pa yin zhes thos shing / lhag par rje chos dbang phyug pa de nyid kyis bu gcig pa'i ma bzhin brtse ba chen pos sras kyi mchog dam par 'dzin pa mdzad de ces grags so/ /yang bdag cag gi 'dren pa 'dis lo chen rat+na bha dra'i sprul pa'i sku rin po che'i drung du thugs rje chen po'i smrar khrid grub thob tshem bu pa nas brgyud pa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams gsan cing / yang rje nyid kyi gnas kyi slob dpon chos rje dpal 'byor rin chen pa'i drung du tshe dpag med ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi dbang / seng ge gdon grol gyi cho ga'i lung / de'i phyag khrid/ spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig gi rjes gnang / dge slong ma dpal mo nas brgyud pa'i smyung gnas kyi cho ga de'i brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang bcas pa'i lung / jo bo rje'i rnam thar lam yig chen mo/ rnam thar chos kyi 'byung gnas/

lung bstan shel gyi mchod rten/ mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/ bstod pa 'brom ston gyi mdzad pa rnams gsan cing / yang rje nyid kyi drung du blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid mnos nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i lung la theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi man ngag rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i blo sbyong glegs bam du grags pa gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ jo bo rjes rgyal srid spangs te thar pa bsgrubs pa'i rnam thar/ jo bo dang gser gling pa mjal ba'i lo rgyus/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i gzhung mchan yod med gnyis/ de'i 'grel pa/ mtshon cha 'khor lo/ rma bya dug 'joms/ gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i blo sbyong / blo sbyong sems pa'i rim pa/ rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa/ zas dge ba'i stobs bskyed pa/ gser gling pas jo bo la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i ched du gnang ba/ nyon mongs lam du blang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ sdig sbyong / theg chen 'khon sbyong / rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis jo bo la gnang ba'i blo sbyong / ku sa li'i tshogs bsog skyid sdug lam khyer/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud/ kun tu bzang po'i blo sbyong / blo sbyong thun brgyad ma zas la brten pa/ dbugs la brten pa/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang du blang ba/ sha khrag la brten pa/ gtor ma la brten pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa/ lus yid bzhin nor bur bsgyur ba/ 'chi kha ma'i blo sbyong ste brgyad dang / gegs sel blo sbyong / ma 'ongs pa'i 'gal rkyen spong ba/ jo bo'i don bdun ma/ mchims kyi blo sbyong / bir+wa pa'i blo sbyong / rnam dag gtsug nor la gnang ba/ tshig rkang brgyad ma lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ de'i 'grel pa mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i blo sbyong gi nyams len/ theg chen blo sbyong don bdun pa/ rat+na gu ru'i tshogs chos/ yang dgon pa'i blo sbyong / rten 'brel snying po'i 'khrid yig rnams kyi lung dang /

blo sbyong thams cad kyi lus don bdun ma gtso bor byas/ gzhan rnams so so nas dmigs par dril nas nyams su blang tshul dang bcas pa zhib tu gsan cing blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus kyi lung yang mnos so/ /yang skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid/ de'i yig cha gsar rnying du ma'i lung dang bcas pa/ rten 'brel snying po'i khrid/ de'i yig cha rgyal sras pa'i mdzad pas lung sogs dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku rgyal ba'i dbang po thogs med bzang po dpal gyi gsung 'bum thor bu ba dkar chag nang bzhin yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung rnams gsan cing / gzhan yang mdo bsdu pa dang / shes rab snying po/ mtshan brjod/ bzang spyod rnams kyi lung yang mnos so/ /yang bdag cag gi bla ma 'dis lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi mnga' bdag chos kyi rje zhe dgon pa chen po chos rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du skye med do pa chos shes nas brgyud pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len gcod skor gsum gyi khrid nyams khrid du gsan nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i lung gsan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ ma cig gi rnam thar/ bka' brgyud kyi lo rgyus/ ngo sprod lta ba'i skor/ nyams len spyod pa'i skor/ gegs sel bogs 'don gyi skor/ 'di gsum do bas mdzad pa/ thabs shes rab kyi bogs 'don bsdus pa/ lam rim pa bcu gsum pa/ a dang phaṭ kyi gdams pa/ ar+ya de wa'i tshigs bcad che chung gnyis/ tshigs bcad chen mo'i 'grel pa do bas mdzad pa/ pho brgyud brda'i brgyud pa/ sma ra ser po'i bka' brgyud dam bdud rang grol gyi gdams pa/ zhal gdams bcu bzhi pa/ rje btsun gnyan gyi bka' brgyud/ gcod kyi don chings brgyad pa/ gnad thems bdun gyi gdams pa/ mo brgyud byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa/ snying po don gyi gdams pa rgya nag gcer bu'i bka' brgyud/ grwa pa hag gi bka' brgyud/ gang zag dbang po rab la mtshan bstan pa/

'bring don la brten nas mdor bstan pa/ bka' tshoms kyi bsdus don/ bka' tshoms kyi gzhung / bka' tshoms kyi 'grel pa do pas mdzad pa/ le lag brgyad pa/ gsang ba brda chos la la bzla ba'i man ngag gdams pa nyi shu pa/ gnad thems bzhi pa'i man ngag ma'i gdams ngag rtsal sbyong nyi shu pa/ bka' tshoms kyi zhus lan sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ gzhi las brtsams pa'i ma smad kyi zhus lan/ zhus lan gnad 'gag bcu gcig pa/ shes rab spra rtsi/ snying po don gyi man ngag 'khyog med ces bya ba/ bdud rtsi thigs pa/ mkha' 'gro ma'i chos sku cig car ngo sprod gces sgom gyis mdzad pa/ rje glang lung pa'i nyams chos/ gsal byed rin chen phreng ba/ bka' sher phyin gyi gdams ngag snyan brgyud gong khud ma/ bdud kyi spyod yul lag len gyi gdams pa'i dam pa rdo rje zan gyi gcod lugs/ mkha' 'gro ma nang rig pa'i 'khrul gcod de dang mkha' sgo 'byed/ gcod kyi khrid yig chen mo do pa legs rgyal gyis mdzad pa dang / yang dol legs mchog pas mdzad pa rnams gsan cing / brtson 'grus drag pos thugs nyams su bzhes pa la brten/ man ngag zab mo 'di'i sgo nas kyang gzhi bdag gdug pa can dam la btags pa'i tshul sogs 'og tu 'chad do/ /yang bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa 'dis ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sa pa ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge nyid mus kyi nub rong chab tshan la phebs skabs/ thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid tshem bu lugs nyams khrid du gsan nas/ de'i khrid yig brgyud 'debs dang bcas pa rje ngor chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang mnos shing / yang mkhas grub kyi bla ma rje grags pa mtha' yas pa'i drung du kye rdor brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa tshul bzhi sngon 'gro dang bcas pa legs par gsan nas/ de dang 'brel ba rgyud sde spyi rnam/ mngon rtogs ljon shing / dag ldan ma bu rnams kyi lung yang gsan par mdzad do/ /yang sdom brtson rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi rje rin chen chos 'phel ba'i drung du bde mchog nag po pa'i lugs kyi dbang gsan nas/

de'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa paṇa chen nyi zla seng ge'i rnam bshad steng nas gsan cing / rdzogs rim gyi khrid rje sangs 'phel ba'i khrid yig steng nas mnos shing / bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs kyi yi ge de dag sogs paṇa chen nyi zla seng ge dang / rje sangs 'phel ba'i gsung rab du ma'i lung yang mnos shing / yang sa skya pa'i chos skyong che chung gi man ngag gi yig skor du ma phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa mgon po'i gser pod du grags pa dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung yongs rdzogs dang / bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pas bsgrigs pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i man ngag gi yig skor tshan che ba'i lung rnams gsan cing / yang chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang / dud gsol lha mo'i rjes gnang yig skor du ma'i lung dang bcas pa yang mnos so/ /yang gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang mnos nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i gshed dmar gyi bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim shin tu spros med kyi khrid nyams khrid du gsan nas/ bir+wa pa dang dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung rnams yongs rdzogs kyi lung / bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad rje sangs 'phel bas mdzad pa sogs kyang mnos shing / gzhung bshad sras don ma'i bshad pa rgyas shing mtha' chod pa de'i yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa dang / shin tu zab pa zhing skyong tsa turmu kha'i tshe sgrub srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i man ngag zab mo'i sgom khrid yi ge snga phyi du ma'i lung / dpal dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang / de'i rgyud dang man ngag gsar rnying ma lus pa'i lung yang gsan par mdzad cing / bdag gi bla ma 'dis rje rin chen chos 'phel de nyid la gzhung bshad sras don ma'i bshad pa gling kha tshogs chen dang lhan cig tu gsan par mdzad dus grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis rje rin chos pas gsung bshad gnang dus tshig lhad mang po yong ba'i 'phros byed pa bdag gi 'dren pa 'dis gsan pa na/

khyed rnams ci zer/ nged kyis ni rje rin chen chos 'phel bas gsung bshad gnang dus tshig lhad de 'dra gsung ba nam du yang ma go cing / spyir yang bla ma'i yon tan la mi rtog /skyon la rtog pa 'di 'dra rang re slob ma rnams skal ba dman pa'i skyon ma gtogs/ bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la phyin ci log mnga' ba mi srid pas/ khyed rang grwa pa blo dman rnams kyang bla ma la log lta bsgom pa bas/ chos nyan du ma 'dus pa las mi bsog pa khe che bar 'ongs nges pas de bzhin so so nas go bar gyis zhes bka' bkyon pa yang mang du stsol bar mdzad do/ /zhes kyang thos shing / rje bla ma 'dis ni rang gi chos gsan pa'i bla ma rnams lta ci smos/ dus mtshungs pa'i bstan 'dzin su zhig la gzhan dag gis bskur ba byed pa gsan pa na thugs lhag par mi dges pa'i snang tshul ston par mdzad pa zhig ste/ dus phyis bdag cag zhabs drung na yod skabs shig gsung 'phros shig la/ rje dbon lha dbang pa na re/ da lta'i ngor pa gdan sa bdag chen shar pa kun dga' bkra shis 'di chos phyogs ngos nas ngor dgon pa'i zin pher ji ltar yod kyang / 'jig rten lugs kyi sde dpon rnams kyi ngos 'dzin mkhas pa sogs ngor dgon pa'i zin so yag pa yod 'dug ces zur gyis bskur 'debs zhu ba la/ rje nyid thugs 'ur te/ a lha dbang khyod ci zer/ bdag chen shar pa 'jig rten rgod nas btsun mo bsten pa dang / bu dang bu mo skyong ba sogs mdzad 'dug pa e yin/ chos 'chad nyan kyang khong gi 'di tsam las lhag pa gdan sa pa gzhan gyis kyang yong ba dka' 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i sde dpon skyong dar sogs dus skabs dang bstun pa ma mdzad na/ ngor dgon pa 'dzin pa'i thabs e 'dug lha dbang khyod rang tshod mi 'dzin pa gang dran lab pas ci la yong / ngor gdan sa pa bdag chen shar pa 'dir ma zad/ ding sang gangs can gyi khrod na bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin du zhal gyis bzhes pa'i gang zag 'di thams cad sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las par bsam pa'i log lta med par dag snang phyogs med du byas na/

rang gi 'di phyi'i dpal thams cad 'bad med du 'byung ba yin zhing 'on kyang bstan 'dzin so so rnams gdul bya las tha dad pa'i snang bya la ma nges pa du ma'i mdzad pa'i sgo dpag med ston par mdzad pa yang chos nyid yin te/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /stug po bkod par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid yin/ /de yi sprul pa'i sku nyid ni/ /zas gtsang sras su 'khrungs pa yi/ /shākya seng ge 'di yin no/ /'di ni gdul bya smin pa'i phyir/ /gshegs dang bzhugs dang gnal ba dang / /mu ge'i grong du gshegs pa dang / /lhung bzed stong par byon pa dang / /bsod snyoms mang du rnyed pa dang / /dgra dang nye du'i 'brel ba dang / /rad rod can du gzigs pa dang / /res 'ga' snyung bar gshegs pa dang / /gzhan gyi bskur pa sna tshogs dang / /res 'ga' snyan pa'i ba dan dang / /bde dang dges par spyod pa sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa ste/ /sprul pa yin gyi rang rgyud min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di lta bu'i tshul gyi gnad la ma rmongs na/ yul drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las yin la/ de nyid snang cha'i gdul bya dag ma dag gi khyad par las/ dwangs pa'i shel gong / dar kha dog nag po dang / dkar po'i steng du bzhag pa'i mdog gi dbye ba'am/ chu klung dwangs pa dang rnyog pa can la 'char ba'i zla gzugs bzhin du rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa'i nges pa rtogs par 'gyur la/ ma dag pa las snang gis bsdus pa'i kun rtog sna tshogs bskyed pa'i zhing sa las son dman pa'i snye ma las mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ga la 'byung ste/ byams mgon gyis/ lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / /sa bon ma rung mi 'khrungs ltar/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang / /skal ba med na bzang mi myong / /zhes pa'i lung dang / mchog gi sprul sku shākya thub pa nyid la yang /

lha sbyin legs pa'i skar ma la sogs pas/ phyin ci log tu btags pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed cig mdo sde rin po che dag nas 'byung bas/ zhib tu dpyad de khong du chud par bya dgos pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rgyas bshad don bsdus dang bcas yul bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la log lta spangs te gus par bya dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan du ma zhig bka' stsol ba dngos su thos pa 'dis mtshon te/ kho bo cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di ni dus mtshungs pa'i skyes chen dam pa kun gyi bla na bzhugs kyang / kun gyi 'bangs ltar dad pa dang gus pa'i snang tshul ci yang zhig ston par mdzad pa las/ gzhan la phrag dog pa dang / zur gyis 'phog pa'i tshig rigs cung zad tsam yang gsung ba sogs zhabs drung du yun ring bsdad pa sus kyang ma mthong zhing ma thos pa 'di yang gzhan las ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa zhig go /yang rje bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i gsang sngags bde chen gling gi mkhan por phebs skabs snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa lhar bcas 'gro ba'i bla ma yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du sa skya pa'i yab chos lhad med rdo rje phur pa dang / 'khor lo bde mchog grub chen nag po lugs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba lan kha yar dang / yang phur gnyis kyi chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud rgyal thod phreng gnyis kyi rjes gnang kyang gsan cing / gzhan yang zhal bzhi pa gnyan dus kyi rjes gnang man ngag gi yig lung dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ma dzā+e ta ri'i lugs dang / grub rgyal lugs kyi dbang / 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang sogs chos kyi sgo du ma zhig nod par mdzad do/

/yang chos kyi rje grub chen bzang po zhes bya ba'i gnyan mgon chen po bran du 'khol bar grags pa'i skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi drung du dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / tshe dpag med lha dgu ma dang / kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang rnams mnos shing / yang grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i dbon rigs su gyur pa skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba chen po 'gyur med bde chen gyi drung du mgon po phyag drug pa gtso rkyang dang / mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang / bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang rnams gsan cing / snyigs dus sa skya pa'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po go ram bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ge'i bzhugs gdan mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la zhabs zung rnam par brtsen pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan pa'i drung du bdag cag gi bla ma 'dis sa skya pa'i chos skyong skor gyi zab chos rnams gsan par thub bstan rnam rgyal du zhabs gtad byon te/ thog mar gur lcam dral lha gsum/ lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis ma rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / pu tra'i zur bka'/ ber nag dang gcer bu'i rjes gnang / gur mgon lha dgu ma dang / bran bdud/ mgon po khro bcu rnams kyi rjes gnang la thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad sbyar ba mnos nas/ de dang 'brel bar srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i phyi nang gsang ba'i khrid rnams dang mgon po'i nang khrid thun mong pa yar lung pa'i khrid yig nang bzhin dang / thun mong ma yin pa zhal ngo nang brgyud du bzhugs pa'i gsang khrid rnams nyams khrid du gsan nas/ de dag gi rgyab rten du bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pas bsgrigs pa'i mgon pod me 'bar ma dkar chag nang bzhin yongs rdzogs dang / rje tshar chen gyis bsgrigs pa'i snyan brgyud glegs bam/ kha skong glegs bam/ gyi ljang glegs bam gsum gyi khrod nas gal che ba'i yig sna phal che ba'i lung rnams gsan zhing /

yang de dus khams pa grwa tshang gi slob dpon gyi go sa la bzhugs pa lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma la mnga' brnyes pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa chos 'od zer ba'i drung du 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor ra lugs kyi dbang / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / de'i tshe khrid srung 'khor dang bcas pa tshar pa nas brgyud pa sogs zab chos du ma gsan cing / de skabs bdag gi bla ma 'dis rje chos 'od zer ba la/ da rje khyed rang gis thugs nyams su bzhes nas byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma gsal po byung ba'i gdams pa zhig cis kyang dgos tshul nan gyis zhu ba mdzad pas/ rje chos 'od zer ba'i gsung gis/ 'di la rtags re nges par yong gin yod do gsungs nas rong ston nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma de gnang byung ba phyis thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i rje rang nyid kyang sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i rtags mtshan nges pa can byung gsungs shing / bdag sogs dad ldan gyi bu slob rnams la tshe sgrub de nyid stsol ba'i tshe yang rje chos 'od zer nyid dang gdams pa gnyis ka la che brjod du ma mdzad pa yang yang thos so/ /de ltar thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwa chen por mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan dpon slob kyi drung du gong gi zab chos de rnams gsan pa'i skabs su/ bla brang du mkhan chen pa'i drung du rje nyid gsol ja la yang yang byon gsungs nas gsung gleng mang po yong ba zhig yod pas/ lan cig mkhan chen pa'i gsung las/ spyir chos lugs gang la yang kha po med pa mi yong 'dug kyang / sbyor dngos rjes gsum thams cad thun tshags bsdus pa lta bu'am/ gong 'og gi rim log pa lta bu'i skyon gang yang med par man ngag gi 'chad tshul dang / rgyud sde'i 'brel tshul sgo mthun gyi sgo nas dbang byin rlabs lag len phra mo tshun la lhag chad nor ba'i skyon med par slob bu khrid cing / dpyod ldan mgu ba bskyed pa nged rang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rjes 'brangs rnams dang /

khyad par rje btsun kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa 'di rnams las gzhan dka' mo yod/ gzhan yang gang zag dam pa rnams lta ci smos/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs pa'i grub mtha'i rtogs dpyod mdzad pa phra mo tshun la yang log lta dang bskur zhus ga la nus/ 'on kyang dbang byin rlabs/ rjes gnang / rigs gtad sogs la 'di dang 'di'o zhes dbye ba med pa dang / lag len yang phan tshun bsre bslad byas ba'i srab srib re byas nas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gang dang gang yang ye ma 'brel bar/ nged kyi bla ma'i phyag len 'di ka yin zer tom tshol du slob ma de khrid/ slob ma des kyang sngar gyi rgyun de bskyangs pa'i lhad la/ lhad bcos byas pa lta bu'i skyon cung zad yod dogs 'dug bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bzhugs dus kyang 'di rigs byung ba thugs kyis ma bzod par sdom gsum rab dbye rtsom dgos pa yang byung 'dug pa/ de'i rtsis na 'u rang thog ma nas phyin ci ma log pa'i bka' srol bzang po'i rjes su 'jug rgyu yod pa/ thog med nas tshogs bsags pa yin pas dga' ba bsgom zhing brtson 'grus bskyed nas/ thog mar chos thob la ngom pa med pa zhig byas/ de nas bshad sgrub la 'bad rtsol drag po byed pa zhig cis kyang dgos rgyur 'dug pa la/ mus gling dga' dgon pa 'dir bla ma bzang po rgyun ma chad par byon cing / grwa pa rnams kyang thos bsam la sdug bsran che zhing sgrub grwa bzang ba nas/ gling kha'i dge bshes rnams dge bshes gzhan gyis 'gran gyi do med kyang yongs kyi 'dug pa dang / lhag par khyed la snyan grags dang mthun pa'i nged rang dpon slob mjal nas yid ches khyad par can byung bas/ re chen po yod pa bzhin bstan pa la khur bskyed dgos tshul gsungs byung ba la/ rje 'dis/ bdag lta bu skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros dman zhing byang mtha' 'khob tu skyes pa'i mir song /

chos 'jig rten gang yang mi shes pas bstan pa'i khur thegs pa'i re ba med pas/ dben par sgom sgrub la rtse gcig tu 'bungs snyam pa yod lags shing / lhag par lo gzhon nu'i skabs mdo phyogs la sbyangs pa zhig byed snyam pa byung yang / lag tu ma long pa de 'gyod par gda'/ zhes sogs zhu bar mdzad pa na/ yang mkhan chen pa'i gsung gis/ khyed ci gsungs/ la stod byang pa'i rgyus de khyed rang byang pa rang ga los che yang / nged kyis mi gzhan gyi ngag bgros dang / lhag par spyan snga 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gsung las thos tshod la/ zhe dgon pa rje bsod nams rtse mor grags pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshungs med de yang / sku gzhon nu'i skabs bya bral grwa sa zhig la 'byon pa'i thugs 'dun yod stabs/ sngar chos lung lhor bzhugs dus rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel 'dzin pa gnang ba'i 'phro rnams bzung zhing thugs la byang rab yod skabs/ rje grub chen nam mkha' shes rab pa sa dmar chu bzang na bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal bar byon/ sku mdun du dum tsam bzhugs pa'i 'phros gtam tshul du/ khyed thos bsam gcig byed dam/ sgrub pa la mos gsungs pa la/ bdag byung na/ thog mar mtshan nyid grwa sa gcig la phyin pa'i mdo phyogs kyi slob gnyer blo rtse gtad rgyu yod tsam zhig byas/ de mtshams dpal ldan sa skya pa lugs kyi sngags phyogs kyi dbang byin rlabs 'dra dang / gdams ngag zab pa gcig zhus/ sgom rang byed snyam lags zhus pas/ blo'i gtad mtshams yag po yin pa 'dug nga yi bsam tshod/ spyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa la shes bya rab 'byams kyi sgro 'dogs chod pa'i mkhas pa gcig gnad du che zhing / mi dgos kha med yin la/ de la dgongs nas rje btsun byams pa mgon pos kyang / rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /zhes sogs gsungs 'dug cing / thos pas ma zin pa'i sgom byed blo 'di yang /

sa chod chung la/ gol sa che ba gcig snang ba don la gnas mod/ 'on kyang dus phyis grwa sar 'gro ba'i dge 'dun kha shas gcig rang gi rtsa ba'i grwa tshang gang yin gyi drin mi bsam par/ de la gang gnod dang / lhag par grwa sa der slebs nas kyang / blo rnal du phebs pa'i slob gnyer 'di byed kyi bsam pa skad cig kyang med par/ dge rgan ngan pa re'i lab phyogs su btang / nged rang tsho dang / kho'i tsho zhes so sor phye ba'i kha 'dzin gyi dkrug shing gang thub byed cing / mnyom chung gi slob gnyer byed mkhan re tsam byung na/ de la khyer kha dang / tshugs kha gang yang med/ dgra gnyen ngo mi shes zer ba sogs khyad gsod kho na byed pa dang / kho rang bslab sbyang gi bsam pa spu tsam yang blo la mi 'char bar/ ho chod chod/ kha do khyer khyer/ khyi zil pa'i khrod la btang pa lta bu rang shas che ba 'dra zhing / lar yang drag pa re tsam ma gtogs/ grwa sar phyin pa'i grwa rigs 'di rang nyon mongs pa rags shing spyod pa rtsing la phyogs 'dzin dang zhe sdang che ba yong gi 'dug khyad par tshe thung nam 'chi cha med la/ shes bya'i sgro 'dogs chod pa zhig ji ltar/ 'di la dgongs nas jo bo rje lha gcig gis kyang / tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pa chu la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa lags shing / thos pa rgya chen po bsags pa'i mkhas par rlom pa 'ga' yang / chos byas pa nyon mongs pa'i kha snon du btang nas/ nga rgyal gyi sgang bu re byas/ sems la tho reg tsam yang ma mthong pa nas/ 'chi bdag kho gtug te slebs tsa na/ 'di bya'i gtol gang yang med par/ byas pa'i chos thams cad las ror btang / mkhas pa'i mal du blun po'i ro khog cig dri ngan thul le bzhag pa yang mang rab yong gi yod pa 'dra/ gong ma'i lo rgyus rnams na yang / de 'drar tho re ba gsungs 'dug pa/

'u cag log lta che ba rang dag min te/ lo rgyus bsam zhing 'ga' re'i spyod tshul la bltas pas/ sems skyo bo la bzod glags med pa'i rngam thug thug pa de ka yong gin 'dug da khyed rang yang bsam gzhig chug dgos te/ nga ltar na/ chos pa rab 'chi na brod/ 'bring mi 'tsher/ tha ma mi 'gyod zer ba yin pas/ 'chi khar gdengs yod tsam gyi sne kha zin pa re ma byung na/ 'gyod la thabs med par song dogs yod pas thugs gzhig chug lar gang zag gi nyams len byed lugs la brten/ chos la zab khyad yod pa 'dra zhig yong yang / chos la zab khyad de tsam yod las chung mod/ 'on kyang nged rang dpal ldan sa skya pa'i nyams len gyi gnad 'di thams cad la rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa mi dbar du khyi ma shor ba'i snyan brgyud bzhi ldan du bzhugs pa yin pas/ 'chad na nor sa chung / sgom na gol sa med pa'i gdams pa yod pa yin/ des na de ring khyed rang log byon/ snga phyir gang drag gi bsam mno thongs/ myong ba yod pa 'dra la'ang rtsad gcod mdzod/ lar rang dus snyigs ma'i chos byed du rlom pa'i 'di rnams kyi gnas tshul yang ma bshad na mi go bshad na mtshang la 'phog pa las mi gda'/ gang na'ang sems dang chos rgyab logs su ma song ba re cis kyang gal che ba lags/ zhes sogs yid la bcags shing rgyud 'khul che ba'i bka' stsal rnams phebs pa nas/ bsran pas mi tshugs shing / lus zung mi thub pa lta bu'i ngang nas spyan chab kyang mang po shor zhing / thugs kyi rnam par rtog pa'i 'gyu ba la/ ga re sna mang gi chos la 'jug blo byas kyang / rgya chen po shes pa'ang dka'/ cung zad shes kyang / nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por ma song na ni/ ngal ba byas pa don med rang du 'gro ba 'dug da rang bla ma 'di yi dgongs sne khrid cing zhabs la gtugs pa'i chos 'dra zhus ngos/ mi med kyi ri khrod gang dben du phyin/ gyong lto gos gtam gsum la khur ba'i tshe dang sgrub pa bsnyams te/

'chi khar gdeng tshad yod tsam zhig ci nas kyang byed dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i ngang nas/ byin rlabs zhus chos lung gung du log pas/ gong gi rnam par rtog pas drangs pa'i lus kyi gom pa gar 'jog dang / 'di byed med pa'i ngang nas grwa tshang du slebs 'dug cing / de nub bza' btung sogs kyi rtog pa gang yang ma shar bar lhad de chad de mnal du song zhing / de nas sang nyin dgon pa'i phyi logs na grwa pa mang po zhig skyo sang gi tshul du 'tshogs 'dug pa'i khrod du phyin/ rang gi gleng slong dang / tshod gang zer lta ba'i phyir/ nged rang chos pa rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum so sor byed na khye phogs gang che/ 'chug med kyi lam sgrub na gang zab sogs rim gyis dris pas/ 'ga' zhig na re/ thog mar thos pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad/ de nas sgom na chod che zhing legs na yang / shes bya'i mtha' bskal par sbyangs kyang chod dka'/ thos pa phyogs 'gro tsam la yang lo mang po rang dgos kyi 'dug des na sgom rgyu'i chos de la go rgyu chags nges re byas/ gzhan spros pa cher ma byas pa sgom pa rang legs pa 'dra zer zhing 'dug pas kyang blo sna thugs sbud song ste/ da ci la thug kyang rdo rus thub nges pa'i sgom zhig byed snyam pa'i thugs lhad lhad du gnas pa'i skabs nas/ mtshan nyid grwa sar 'byon pa sogs gang gi yang spros pa mtha' dag bcad nas/ bla ma 'dis ci gsungs tshad mar sgrub pa las/ gzhan gang yang mi byed snyam du dgongs/ chu bzang du phebs/ lo gcig gnyis tsam ngam ring chos sde'i dbyar chos dgun chos la khor tsam byon/ de ma gtogs/ rje sgrub chen nyid dang 'bral med du bzhugs shing chos la thugs 'dun cher mdzad nas/ thog mar rje sgrub chen nyid la mnga' ba'i gsung chos rnams dang / de nas mkhas grub kyi bla ma du ma bsten nas chos tshul mtha' yas pa zhig gsan te bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan bzung bas/ byang pa bdag po sogs che dgu kun gyi zhabs la gtugs shing /

bstan 'dzin slob ma du ma la yang shin tu phan par byung ba sogs dus phyis byon pa'i sa skya pa'i dge bshes shig la/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du 'gyur zhing rang nyid sgrub tshugs bzang pa sogs mig ltos la phan pa'i dpe bral de bzhin byung ba khyed rang gi thugs la gsal ba ltar yin pa dang / de lta bu'i zhe dgon pa bsod nams rtse mo de sa skya pa'i chos skyong rnams bran du 'khol nges shig yin pa 'dug ste/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho nyid dgon pa'i spyi don sogs gal che ba 'dra la ngam ring du phebs skabs/ shar res slom por rje zhe dgon pa nyid la mjal du yong na ji ltar khyab kyi dgongs len zhu bar lcags zam kha nas snga 'gros brdzangs pas/ shin tu dges pa'i nyams dang bcas/ nga'i rtsar khong mi 'byon na su 'byon/ da lta phebs gsung ba phebs la/ snga gong gling kha'i spyi rdzas sogs la 'thor gyeg chen po byung 'dug zer ba'i snyan du rim pas son pa'i shis nas/ bka' bkyon zur chags su phebs pa zhig yod 'dug kyang / de skabs byas byung legs nyes kyi sgo mtha' dag zhib par snyan du phul/ dgon pa'i spyi rdzas rnams la yang sde pa nas phebs sgo 'di dang 'di byung zhing / spyir yang dgon gog 'dzin pa'i mi la byed dka' rnam grangs 'jig rten bza' dpon rgan po las zur na mi 'dug lhag par pha bzang po bu'i se thar gyi dpes/ sems dpa' chen po nas bzung skyes bu dam pa kho nas bskyangs shul/ bdag lta bu lugs gnyis gang nas kyang 'chun med pa'i mi la/ mdzo khal ra'i dpe byung bas/ byed dka' ba la tshad mi 'dug kyang / sems dpa' chen po des bstan 'gro la rtse gcig tu dgongs/ yul mtha' 'khob lta bur bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la gnas gzhi bzang po btab nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi grwa 'dzugs pa gnang ba yin pas/ 'di'i ched du lus srog shor kyang 'gyod pa med snyam pa'i zhe khur byas/

sde pa nas dgongs pa khrid pa'i ngos/ dgon pa'i thed du gang che byed snyam pa yod lags kyang / spyir dus kyis ma khyogs pa dang khyim tshes lod grags pa nas byed dka' ma rang 'dug lags zhes yus pa'i tshul gyis zhus pas/ rje nyid thugs yid gting nas ches pa'i tshul dang / thugs rje gting nas g.yos pa'i rtags su 'di phyir dge ba'i snying gtam snying nas bzhar ba dang / sngar ma gsan pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba zab mo chig brgyud du bzhugs pa yang bka' drin du stsal cing / de nas phyi phyag zhus te 'byon par brtsams skabs/ zhabs dbu gtsug tu bkod pa'i brgyud pa'i byin rlabs shin tu mang ba dang / rje btsun sa skya pa'i chos bsrung du gtogs pa ji snyed pa dag gi bka' bsgo byin rlabs nan che ba gnang ba'i rjes su/ gsung dpang gzengs bstod pa'i ngang nas/ 'o da mi rgan rgas nas mi dgos/ khyed dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos srung du gtogs pa rnams/ rig pa 'dzin pa chen po 'di'i rjes su rgyugs la/ lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i ngos nas 'phrin las mtha' dag sgrubs shig gsungs/ dar cig dgongs pa la bzhugs pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin po che yang de ka'i ngang la gtad med kyi shes pa bun long song / sku lus kyi zo mi thub pa lta bu'i rtse zil dang bcas thugs nyams 'ur ba'i rnam pas/ chibs pa la chibs pa yang mi dran pas/ chibs pa shar stabs kyi phyag phyi ba rnams kyis kyang ma zin par lho gong gong khar phebs mtshams/ ser bu zhig gi rkyen byas thugs nyams sad de/ rje nyid chibs pa dang bcas pa las/ phyag phyi ba rnams ma sleb pa nas/ chibs bshol rgyun ring bsgugs te bzhugs dgos pa byung ba yin 'dug cing / spyir 'jam dbyangs rin po che la snga so'i rgyun gyi 'phrin las chen po yod pa'i steng du/ bka' bsgo mdzad pa nas bzung / rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po sku mched tshang ma'i rnam 'dren 'di phyir thugs kyi gtad mtshams kyi yongs 'dzin dam par bskur cing /

dpal sa skya 'khon gyi gdung brgyud gong ma rnams kyi yang phyag mchod gsol 'debs kyi gnas dam par gyur pa sogs 'phrin las kyi sgo rang rdol du bye ba'i legs byas kyi go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa la rang dbang du spyod pa'i skal ba can du gyur pa yin zhes rje spyan snga 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi gsung las yang yang gsungs pa dngos su thos pa yin pas/ des na de lta bu'i skyes bus kyang mdo phyogs la sbyong tshul ma gnang 'dug pa bzhin/ khyed lta bu la yang mdo phyogs la cher gtad sbyangs pa mdzad ci la dgos/ gzhung chen rnams kyi don ni gzhan sbyangs pa byas pa tsho las kyang / khyed rang go rgya che zhing mtha' chod par 'dug des na dus snyigs ma'i skabs 'dir skyes bu dam pa rnams dben par sgom sgrub la brtson pa bas/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i khur bzhes pa 'di rang gzhan kun la sleb che ba yin pas nged kyis zer ba 'di rnams thugs yul du 'jags pa rang cis kyang mdzad dgos so/ /zhes gsungs byung pa na bdag gi bla ma 'di'i thugs dgongs la/ mkhan chen pas nged rang la bstod bkur bsngags pa dang bcas thugs mthong dpe med gnang ba yin 'dug kyang / dus bskal gyi dbang gis bstan 'gro'i don ha cang rgya che ba rang 'grub pa dka' mod/ 'on kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin rang gi gang lcogs kyis bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du ci 'gyur rang zhig bya dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i thugs bskyed bzang po 'khrungs pa yang byung gsungs shing / mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan 'di dang rje chos 'od zer ba dpon slob 'di gnyis mkhas la btsun pa'i yon tan gyis brgyan pa/ thugs bskyed bzang po re yod 'dug pas/ thub bstan rnam rgyal ba khong mkhan slob kyi skabs rang dar rgyas che ba byung yod pa 'dug gsung ba sogs dus rgyun ldan du dad gus dang / dag snang ci yang zhig mdzad par snang ngo /

/de ltar gong du smos pa'i dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs 'di dag kyang / rags pa tsam zhig tu snang gi 'dir ma 'dus pa mang du yod pa shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na skyon thams cad dang bral zhing yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ sa gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba dang / mtshungs med sbas pa'i sangs rgyas chos dbang phyug nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa mang po las/ spyir dam pa'i chos thos pa dang / de yang rnam grangs mang po thos pa dang / de yang lan mang du thos pa ste/ rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas mang du thos pa rnams kyi nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa 'phags pa kun dga' bo lta bu dang / dam pa'i chos zab mo 'tshol ba la skyo ba mi mnga' ba byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu lta bu dang / gsang chen bla na med pa'i gdams pa rgya mtsho la dbang 'byor pa gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje lta bu dang / yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la mchog tu gus pa'i sgo nas bkur bsti dang rim gro phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang lta bu dang tshul mtshungs par/ dam pa'i chos gang ji snyed cig gsan pa de dag kyang thos lo dang nyan lo lta bu ni nam yang ma yin par gzhan dang mi mnyam pa'i brtson 'grus chen pos/ thos byung gi mkhyen rab kyis tshig gi mtha' legs par bcad/ bsam byung gi rnam par dpyod pas don gyi snying po long par byas/ sgom byung blo gros kyis rang gis dus rgyun bsgoms na sa lam chod la/ gzhan la bstan na bdag 'dzin dang / nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gyur nges su mdzad pa yin te/ gsan pa de dag gi tshig don la bsnyel ba med pa'i dran pa dang / gtugs pa med pa'i spobs pa thogs pa med pa thob nas/ sgrub pa dang sun 'byin la sogs pa lung dang rigs pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa mchog tu gsal ba'i sgo nas chos de dang de'i bdag por gyur pa'i tshul du mdzad nas mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son te mkhas mang rnams kyi gang la ci 'dod kyi blo'i re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i gting mtha' mi mngon pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi chu gter chen por bzhugs pa yin no/

/'dir smras pa/ thog med dus nas tshogs gnyis goms pa'i mthus/ /'jigs rung 'khor ba'i nags las rgyang bsrings te/ /thar 'dod gdul bya'i bsti gnas nyams dga' ba/ /gling kha chos kyi pho brang dam par gson/ /dus der mtshan nyid ldan pa'i yongs 'dzin las/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar byang sems dang / /rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa yid bzhin gyi/ /rin chen 'phreng de mgon khyod gus pas blangs/ /so so thar pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /byang chub sems kyi yal 'dab rnam par rgyas/ /rig 'dzin 'bras bu'i khur gyis mngon mtho ba'i/ /gsum ldan dpag bsam dbang po 'di ngo mtshar/ /'phags yul ma dros rgya mtsho chen po las/ /legs 'ongs mdo sngags chu klung bye ba brgya/ /sngon med legs bshad zil dngar 'thor bzhin du/ /gang khyod thugs kyi rgya mtshor dal gyis zhugs/ /rgyal sras rgyal ba dges mdzad rtag tu ngu / /nor bzang nor gyi snying po chos sgrub bzhin/ /yongs 'dzin gzhan las yongs 'dzin mchog khyod kyis/ /zab chos zab mo'i bdud rtsi ci yang gsol/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gter/ /yongs 'dzin gang las dpal ldan bi ru pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung gsung ngag yid bzhin rin chen 'phreng / /'dren mchog khyod kyis mdzes pa'i rgyan du bzhes/ /gzhan yang dam pa de las ches zab pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam dpal ldan nai gu ma'i/ /man ngag ri bong 'dzin pa'i bsil zer gyis/ /gang gi thugs kyi ku mud rab rgyas mdzad/ /yongs 'dzin de las brgyud pa rnam dag las/ /'ongs pa'i dbang dang rjes gnang bka' gtad tshogs/ /man ngag khrid dang mdo rgyud lung rab 'byams/ /bum pa gang byo'i tshul du nod par mdzad/ /chos kyi rgyal po grub pa'i dbang phyug las/ /chos zab rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam gyi srol/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /thugs kyi bum pa yongs su gang bar mdzad/

/gzhan yang chos kyi dbang phyug mgon de las/ /mtha' yas rgyud sde'i zab gnad mang po la/ /dris dang lan gyi mtha' gcod zhib mo dang / /phyag len phra mo kun la'ang byang bar mdzad/ /nam mkha' ltar yangs mkhyen rab dbang phyug dang / /rin chen dam chos 'phel mdzad yongs 'dzin las/ /bka' gdams gzhung dang gdam ngag bde kye dang / /gshin rje gshed skor chos tshul ci yang gsan/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i bla ma dang / /rat+na bha dra gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i gar/ /dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor pa'i rin chen las/ /mdo sngags chos kyi nying khu dpag med mnos/ /sangs rgyas bstan la smra ba'i seng ge dang / /byams pa'i mnga' bdag rab tu brtan pa'i thugs/ /mnga' ba'i mgon dang chos kyi 'od zer las/ /spyan gzigs 'jigs byed chos skyong skor rnams gsan/ /snyan par grags pa nam mkha'i mtha' yas dang / /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rin chen dbang / /bzang po'i zhabs dang skad gnyis smra ba yis/ /lo chen rnams la'ang chos tshul mtha' yas mnos/ /gzhan yang 'gro mgon chos rje slar byon pa/ /sngags 'chang bla ma grags pa'i mtshan can las/ /sa skya'i yab chos lhad med phur pa dang / /dkar bdud rjes gnang bde mchog nag po pa'i/ /lugs kyi dbang sogs zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ /de ltar skyes mchog mkhas grub du ma las/ /dbang khrid rjes gnang bka' gtad lung rab 'byams/ /byin rlabs zab khrid la sogs chos tshul gyi/ /grangs med gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /'di na gzhan gyis yun du 'bad kyang ma thob pa'i/ /mkhas pas bskyed pa'i yid 'ong legs bshad lang tsho ma/ /khyod kyi ngo mtshar rnam dpyod spyan zur lhung tsam gyis/ /zab rgyas tshig don thugs la bcags pa'i rtse dga' thob/ /gang gi gsan pa rgya mtsho las/ /dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /mtshon pa tsam zhig bkod pa 'di/ /blo gsal rnams kyi dga' ston no/ /bzhi pa thos bsam sgom pa la gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor ba gzhan yang las ches khyad du 'phags pa'i sgo nas nan tan snying por mdzad pa'i tshul ni/

ji skad du/ mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos rgya mtsho la/ /brtson pas thos bsam sbyangs pas sgro 'dogs chod/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtsug rgyan mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar/ de yang / bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid dgung lo bco brgyad du son pa don grub ces pa sa mo lug lo nas bzung / dgung gi lo sum cu rtsa bgrang bzhes pa'i bar yan chad du dus skabs phal cher gling kha dgon pa ma dang / bsam gtan phug sogs su gtso bor bzhugs nas thos bsam sgom gsum la rtag 'grus su mdzad pa yin te/ de yang bstan pa'i bya bar thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / sgom pa rim gyis chos la gnas pa yin zhing / sbyor ba gang yang rung ba tsam gyis ma yin gyis/ thos pa dang bsam pa la ma brten par sgom pa 'ba' zhig la zhugs pa de yang chos la gnas pa ma yin par dgongs nas/ gong du bshad pa ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos rgya mtsho lta bus thugs kyi bum pa rim gyis gang bar mdzad pa yin zhing / de ltar zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin nos pa nas bzung / so so'i zab don gyi snying po nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor la thugs rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i tshul ni/ spyir bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid yongs 'dzin gzhan gyi lugs ltar/ dus 'di dang 'dir thugs dam zab mo la brtson par mdzad la/ 'di dang 'di'i gnas skabs su mi brtson no zhes pa'i skabs med par/ dus khor mo yug tu nyams len zab bzhes kyi ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' ba zhig yin mod kyang / 'on kyang lhag pa'i lha du ma'i bzlas brjod kyi rim pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rags pa tsam zhig brjod na/ thog ma sku gzhon nu'i dus bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi bsnyen pa kha bskong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad pas mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes shing /

de nas rje 'di dgung gi lo bco brgyad du son pa na/ dpal kye rdo rje gzhi'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad pas/ sngon rje btsun rin po che la kye rdor rgyud gsum gyi glegs bam gsol ba'i mtshan ltas byung ba dang mthun par/ rje bla ma 'di nyid la'ang mnal lam du pu ti mang po zhal du gsol ba dang / nyi zla gnyis cha lang sdebs mdzad nas phyag gis dkrol ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma mang du brnyes shing / de nas rje nyid dgung lo nyer gcig tu phebs pa rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi lo nas bzung / nyer dgu bzhes pa rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta'i lo'i bar gyi lo dgu'i ring la/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brten nas rin chen bzhi'i bzlas pa gtso bor ston pa'i zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang bcas nas bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa mdzad pa yin te/ de yang gsung bsnyen la zhugs nas zla ba gsum tsam song ba'i tshe/ mnal lam du mon pa nag po gnyis byung nas/ gci ba'i rwa ba chen po gnyis brtsigs song ste/ de gnyis na re/ gci rwa gcig dge slong sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi ja shing dang / gcig sbyin sreg gi shing bu bya rgyu yin zer byung ba/ 'di ni mon bu pu tra ming sring gis/ rje nyid la 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mtshan ma yang dag par nges shing / lung bstan dang mthun par gsung bsnyen gyi bar la gsol ja 'bul mi yang mang du byung zhing / sbyin sreg dang nye ba na/ de'i shing bu 'bul mi yang ched gtad pa mang po byung gsungs shing / sku lus kyi phyi nang gi srin 'bu 'gags pa sogs kyang / dus de tsam nas byung bar mngon no/ /de ltar lo bzhi'i bar la yi dam gyis rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma brnyes bzhin pa dang bcas dang gsung bzlas la rtse gcig tu mdzad pa'i sku mtshams grol ma thag rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa'i drung du mjal ba la phyag phebs te/

sngar gyi sku mtshams kyi bar la 'khrungs pa'i nyams rtogs rnams zhus pas/ rje chos dbang nyid shin tu dges te/ khyod la re chen po yod kyang yod de/ rjes su yi rangs/ zhes sogs thugs nges shes 'grongs pa'i gsung mang du byon cing / de nas rje 'dis da dung bdag bde mchog gi sgrub pa lo lnga pa zhig byed 'dod pa lags zhus pas/ rje chos dbang pas zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas/ de bzhin mdzad thub na shin tu ngo mtshar che ste/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum bya ba rang re sngags pa rnams la dgos pa yin pas/ mdzad lugs kyang 'di ltar gyis shig pa sogs bslab bya mtha' dag lhug stsol du gnang nas/ de 'phral bdag gi bla ma 'dis bsam gtan phug tu phyag phebs te/ sku mtshams bcad rgya shin tu dam pa'i bug sgo can mdzad nas su dang yang mi mjal ba'i ngang nas bde mchog gi rnal 'byor thun bzhi'i nyams len dang bcas rdzogs rim dpyid thig dang / lta ba skyong ba la gtso bor mdzad nas thugs brtson 'grus drag pos nyin mtshan rgyun ma chad par bsgoms pas/ du ba dang / smig sgyu dang / mar me 'bar ba la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim gyi nyams rtags rnams gsal la rdzogs par shar cing / khyad par 'od gsal gyis phyi nang nye ring med par gzigs te/ rje chos dbang pa bzhugs pa'i gzim chung dang sku rten phyag dpe phyag rdzas sogs thams cad gsal bar gzigs pa byung zhing / de ltar lo lnga'i bar gyi sku mtshams gnang ba grol ma thag rje btsun chos dbang phyug nyid mjal du byon pas/ sngar gyi nyams rtags kyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ rje nyid shin tu dges pa'i gsung gis/ a la la/ da khyed la 'od gsal nyin snang mtshan snang 'dre nus pa shar 'dug pas/ nga rgan po gang byed kyang khyed kyis gzigs shig khyed gang mdzad kyang nged kyis blta ba yin no gsungs byung bas/ rje 'dis de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes te/ bsam gtan phug tu phebs nas sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i tshe/

sngar gyi 'od gsal shar ba rgya mched du gyur nas/ rje chos dbang pa'i bzhugs gnas phyag rdzas sogs sngar las kyang gsal ba gzigs byung pas/ de'i gnas tshul rnams zhu yig tu 'bul bar mdzad cing / rje chos dbang pas kyang / rje 'di'i bzhugs gnas/ sku rten/ phyag dpe/ phyag rdzas sogs dang / tha na gsol zhib kyi snod tshun gyi dngos po che phra thams cad gsal bar gzigs nas/ de bzhin gyi gnas tshul thugs dam gsung shog tu mkhyen pa dang / yig chung na/ khyed kyi gzim khang gi gsang spyod de yang yang zhig 'gro ba zhig 'dug pa de spyod kyi 'og thog gi g.yam gdung gtong nyes pa'i skyon du 'dug pas/ da man g.yam gdung shar nub tu btang na/ gsang spyod la 'gyel zhig mi yong ba'i khag 'khur gsungs pa 'dug pas/ rje nyid kyis kyang gsang spyod la zhig gsos de bzhin du mdzad pas/ da lta'i bar du nyams med du yod pa kun gyis mthong ba 'di yin zhing / gang ltar dpon slob gnyis ka'i rnam thar la phan tshun gcig gis gcig la dag snang dang yid ches kyi dad pa gting tshugs pa 'khrungs pa yin no/ /zhes thos la/ de nas rje 'dis 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho mjal ba la phebs pas/ rje'i gsung las/ khyed lo bcu dgu lon pa'i dus/ rgyud sde spyi rnam/ mngon rtogs ljon shing / brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ma bu gnyis/ gzhung bshad dmar ma rnams kyi rgyugs sprod spus gtsang byung ba de bzhin/ dgon pa 'dir bstan pa dang mig ltos la phan pa'i tshad gcig byung / de rjes lo ngo dgu'i bar la bde mchog gi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin byas pa de yang / dus phyis kyi bsnyen mtshams pa rnams la dpe bzhag song ba cis kyang ngo mtshar che zhing / nged kyang blo kha rdzogs par byung / da cha sngar gyi thos bsam gyi 'phro 'di phyag dpe 'dra gzigs dgos tshul gsungs byung pa la/ rje 'dis bdag tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa zhig byed snyam pa lags pas/
