dpe cha'i lta rtog dgongs pa zhu dgos pa 'dra lags zhes zhus pas/ rje spyan snga ba nyid thugs hur phyung ste gsung shugs mthon po dang bcas khyed ci zer ba yin/ nyid lta bu'i gang zag la da lta nas sgrub pa sngas 'ong / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la sgrub pa bas gzhan phan rlabs che ba yin pas/ cis kyang thugs gnyer mdzad dgos gsung byung bas/ de'i lan du 'o na bdag gis bla ma'i bka' mi gcog pas/ sngar ma song ba'i gzhung bshad sras don ma/ kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun gyi lhag ma rnams dang / dbang chu bde chen rgya mtsho/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam bshad gu ru dang dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa gnyis/ rim lnga'i khrid yig rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ kha skong kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ bde mchog gi rdzogs rim bzhi dang / rim lnga'i yig cha rje btsun gong ma dang / kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od/ bde mchog chos byung / lū hi pa'i rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi rnam bshad/ sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel pa gzhan phan kun khyab/ gzhan phan gnod 'joms/ kye rdor lus dkyil gyi rnam bshad bde chen bcud snying / rje bzang po dpal ba'i bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad/ bde mchog rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka mu tig 'phreng ba/ rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi 'grel pa/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ kun rig gi rnam bshad gung rus mdzad pa/ rje btsun gyi gzhan phan skor gsum/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi lus dkyil rtsod spong gnyis/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi dbang bshad lung dang man ngag gi gter mdzod/ snang gsum dang rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan rnams dus gcig la bzung nas rgyugs 'bul ba lags zhus pas/

rje spyan snga ba nyid/ thugs shin tu dges pa'i gsung las/ de ltar na blo dpang mtho zhing shin tu legs 'dug pa/ nged rang lan gcig phyogs la 'gro dgos 'dug pas/ dbus phyogs dang thub bstan gong 'og sogs su lo gcig tsam 'gor shas che ba/ de bar la slob gnyer gyis la/ nged sleb 'phral la rgyugs sprod rgyu yod pa gyis gsungs byung bas/ de nas rje bla ma 'dis rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bka' bzhin/ bsam gtan phug dang / gling kha dgon pa la sogs su sku mtshams la gtso bor bzhugs nas gong gi phyag dpe rnams kyi gzigs rtog mdzad pa la thugs brtson 'grus chen pos nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'bad pa cher mdzad pas/ de skabs 'tsho chas cung dkon pa'i skabs yin pas/ rje nyid la glo bur du ser ma cher g.yos nas sku shin tu dub pa zhag 'ga' byung pa na/ de bzhin gyi snang tshul rje chos dbang phyug pas thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs nas/ glo bur du thugs dam bka' shog cig gnang byung ba'i nang na/ der slob gnyer smar po yod 'dug pa shin tu legs/ 'di phyogs su khor tsam zhig ces kyang byon gsung ba 'dug pas/ de ma thag thugs dges spro chen po dang bcas bsam gtan phu'i la phyogs la brgyud nas phebs pa/ rje chos dbang pas 'od gsal gyis gzigs nas/ phyag g.yog la/ de ring chos rje shang pa bsam gtan phu'i la brgyud nas byon 'ong pas/ lung pa'i phu ya gi la ltos shig yang yang gsungs byung pa la/ nye gnas kyis/ chos rje pa gzhung lam brgyud nas ka byon yong lags sam zhus pas/ de mi 'ongs la rang la 'ong gyin 'dug go zhes gsungs byung pas/ der yun ring ma lon pa zhabs drung du phyag phebs te mjal ba na/ nye gnas kyis sngar gyi 'phros rnams zhus pas/ rje 'di la la 'byon pa rje btsun chos dbang phyug 'od gsal gyi sgrib med du gzigs pa yin pa rje dpon slob sogs der yod kun yid ches shing /

dad pa bla lhag tu 'phel bar gyur cing / skabs der rje chos dbang pa'i gsung gis/ chos rje shang pa slob gnyer smar po byung yod pa 'dug kyang / 'tsho ba dkon pa tsam byung ba 'dra gsungs byung pa la/ rje nyid kyis thugs gnyer mdzad tshul dang / 'tsho ba cung zad dkon par byung tshul zhus pa na/ rje'i zhal nas/ zhabs drung dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i slob gnyer rang gyis gsungs pa la thugs skyon mi 'dug kyang / bar chad chen po byung nyen yod pas/ nga'i kha la nyan na/ da slob gnyer gyi 'phro bshol la/ thugs dam bsnyen pa zhig byas pa legs/ dper na gyang gtong ba la gyang shing ya gcig med pa dang 'dra ste/ thugs dam slob gnyer gnyis zung 'jug tu ma byas na/ thos pa rkyang pa la bar chad yong nyen che bas/ cis kyang bsnyen pa zhig gyis gsungs byung bas/ de dus rje nyid kyi thugs la thos pa la snying po mi 'dug tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa gcig byed bsam 'dun pa drag po gting nas skyes pa zhig byung gsungs shing / de dus sku zhogs su zhag kha shas shig bzhugs pas/ nyin gcig rje'i gsung las/ khyed la thugs dam slob gnyer byed pa la 'tsho ba'i rten 'brel du dpal sa skya pa'i man ngag nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi gdams pa shin tu zab pa zhig yod pa 'di khyed la ster bas/ rten 'brel gyi tshogs 'khor zhig shoms gsungs byung bas/ rje nyid la ni de dus lug sha rkang pa zhig min pa med pas de'i tshul zhus pa na/ rje chos dbang pa'i zhal nas/ tshogs sha 'dis 'ongs/ chang zhig dgos gsungs la/ ri khrod du song bas chang ma 'byor ba yong ngam ci drag snyam pa la gsol dpon dar chen gyi chung mas gsol dpon la chang bum pa gang khyer byung bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ rten 'brel shin tu legs byung gsungs/ nor lha dbyug gu ma'i gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang ba yin no/ /zhes thos la/ dus phyis rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi gsung pa las/

nged sngon slob gnyer smar zhing 'tsho ba bkren po yod pa'i skabs/ rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug gis 'tsho ba la phan pa'i nor lha dbyug gu ma'i man ngag 'di rnams gnang ba yin zhing / de nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du longs spyod la rtsol ba mi dgos par 'bad med du 'byung ba 'di rje bla ma de nyid kyi bka' drin kho na las byung ba yin zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar gong du bkod pa'i phyag dpe'i gzigs rtog rnams mthar phyin nas/ rje spyan snga ba dpon slob rnams phyogs su lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs pa 'khor nas gling khar phyag phebs byung ba'i nangs par de ka zhabs drung du phebs nas mchod dpon pa brgyud pa'i snga sor phebs sgo gnang ba'i dpe rnams bdag gis zin pa yin pas/ rgyugs 'bul nam tsam byas na 'gab/ bslab ston zhu ba lags gsungs pas/ rje spyan snga ba'i gsung gis/ sngar 'phros byung ba'i dpe thams cad rang bzung ba med dam gsungs pa la/ thams cad thugs la zin pa'i rgyu mtshan zhib tu phul bas/ rje'i gsung las/ des na ngo mtshar shin tu che/ gnang nyin gza' skar bzang ba yod pas rgyugs gnon byed do gsungs ba bzhin/ phyag dpe rnams bsnams nas phebs pa'i tshe/ rje spyan snga ba sku dngos kyis dpe rnams kyi dbu nas shog bu gnyis gsum re gnon par mdzad cing / bying rnams dbu mdzad tshul 'od pa la gnon du 'jug pa'i bka' phebs gnang ba na/ rje nyid kyis dag gsal snyan pa'i gsung gis rdzogs par rgyugs 'bul mdzad pa grub pa'i tshe/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho nyid thugs shin tu dges pa'i gsung las/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug 'di lta bu la/ dpe cha rgyugs sprod kyi mig ltos 'di lta bu nged rang gi re ba las lhag pa byung bas/ da ni rang re'i dgon pa gling kha 'di na khyed las lhag pa'i blo tshogs che ba gzhan med do/ /zhes sogs bstod bkur bsngags gsum gyi gsung mang du byon cing /

rje nyid kyi sku la rgyun par bzhes pa'i sku gzan spus gtsang zhig dang / nas khal bcu gnyis gnang sbyin du stsal te/ da dung yang sems dpa' chen po brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang / gling kha dgon pa bsam pa'i slob gnyer dang / thugs dam la rem ma shor ba mdzod/ ces sogs 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya mtha' yas pa zhig gnang byung ba na/ rje nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ bla ma mnyes na mchod pa'i rab zer ba 'di rang yin pa 'dug snyam thugs la dges spro dpag med 'khrungs shing / rje spyan snga ba la slar yang dad pa stobs su gyur pa dang / bstan pa dang sems can gyi don khur chen po bzhes pa'i thugs bskyed bzang po yang gong 'phel du gyur pa yin no/ /de ltar gong du smos pa de dag gis mtshon pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos dri ma med pa sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams/ skabs der rje 'di'i thugs su chud cing thos bsam gyi sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang dka' tshegs chen po la ma ltos par bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mkhyen pa'i spyan zur lhung ba tsam gyis shes par bya ba'i gnas de dang de dag dpyis phyin pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas legs par dgongs shing thugs su tshud nas/ tshig don thams cad me long dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan rnam par bkra ba ltar/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis thugs la gsal bar smin te brgal zhing brtag pa'i tshul gyis rigs pa dang mi rigs pa rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa'i spobs pa pha rol gyi zil gyis gnon par mi nus pa'i smra ba'i khyu mchog chen por gyur pa yin no/ /ji snyed mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa thams cad kyang 'bad rtsol chen pos nan tan mi dgos par/ lo brgyar sbyangs pa ltar snyel ba med pa'i dran pa dang / gtugs pa med pa'i spobs pa thags thogs med par rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba ni rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid kyi zhabs drung na gnas pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa kun gyi thugs la gsal ba yin zhing /

gzhan yang skabs der 'dul ba dang / mngon pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / dbu ma la sogs te mdo phyogs kyi gsung rab mtha' dag pa rnams la yang sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad pa yin te/ dus phyis gzhung lugs de dag la mkhas par grags pa'i skyes bu du ma zhabs drung du lhags pa'i tshe/ gzhung lugs de dag gi tshig don la dogs gcod zhus pa na/ de'i don ni 'di dang 'di'o zhes rgyas bshad don bsdus dang bcas bka' stsal pa na mkhas pa chen po de dag gi gsung las/ a la la/ rje 'di nyid gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhig yin mod/ gzhung lugs mtha' dag la sbyangs pa'i tshul ma bstan pa zhig yin no snyam yang / bdag nyid chen po 'di ni bstan pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing mkhas par grags pa sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa zhig 'dug go zhes smra'o/ /de ltar gzhung lugs rab 'byams la thos bsam mdzad pa'i gnas skabs de rnams su yang bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin dang skad cig kyang ma bral ba'i ngang nas mdzad par snang ste/ phyis rje 'dis slob gnyer ba rnams la zhal ta gnang ba'i skabs rnams su yang / khyed rang rnams slob gnyer byed pa'i tshe thun mtshams kyi lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas dpe 'dzin pa dang / gzhung skyor ba sogs gang byed kyang sngags bzlas par bsam nas byas na shin tu legs so/ /zhes yang yang du gsung ba sogs las shes so/ /de ltar thos bsam sgom pa mdzad pa'i tshul de dag gang la yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni sku skye ba du ma nas goms pa lhur mdzad pas sku tshe 'di nyid la 'bad rtsol chen po la mi ltos pa zhig yin mod kyang / gzhan ngor thos bsam sgom gsum sogs dam pa'i chos gang byed kyang brtson 'grus dang mi ldan na mi 'grub bo zhes shes pa'i phyir/ thugs dam thugs gnyer sogs gang mdzad pa'i gnas skabs de dag thams cad du/

tshe 'dir snang gi rnyed pa dang / bkur bsti dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / gnyid rmugs la sogs pa'i ro myong ba dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam par rtog pa gang la yang thugs 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad nas/ sku gzhon nu'i tshe yang rje rang gi bzhugs khang gi sgo la 'jim pa'i zhal ba mdzad de/ mthun rkyen rnams dkar khung sogs nas len par mdzad pa dang / rang nyid gcig pur thugs dam sogs la 'jug pa la yang / nyi tshad grib tshod sogs kyi dus tshod nges par mdzad nas de'i dus las nam yang skad cig kyang mi 'da' bar mdzad do zhes dus mtshungs pa'i skye bo du ma'i ngag las thos shing / phyis bdag sogs dad ldan gyi bu slob rnams la'ang khyed rang rnams thugs dam slob gnyer sogs gang byed kyang / brtson 'grus dang ldan pas nyi tshod sogs byas nas bsgrigs la 'khyon pa zhig cis kyang bya dgos so zhes yang yang du bka' stsol bar mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rje 'di dgung lo sum cu so gcig tu son pa aṅgi ra zhes pa chu pho spre'u'i lo shar ba na/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtshos gling kha tshogs chen la nai gu chos drug gi zab chos rnams gnang ba'i tshe de dag dang lhan cig tu rje 'dis kyang gsan par mdzad nas/ man ngag gi dmigs rim rnams nyams skyes khrid kyi tshul du skyong bar mdzad cing / de dus ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang gnang ba'i nub rje rang gi gzim chung gi sgo 'gag na a tsa ra bzhi gar sna tshogs byed pa dngos su gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma mang du brnyes pa yin la/ de nas rje 'di dgung lo so gnyis su phebs pa dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams dam du bcad nas/ sngar gyi nyams rtogs bzang po rnams kyi rgyun skyong ba dang / lhag par lam 'bras nas bshad pa'i bla ma rin 'byung gi nyams len la thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ sngar thugs rgyud la ma 'khrungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sna tshogs pa shar ba dang /

mnal lam khams po che ngo mtshar mchog tu che ba du ma byung ba la brten/ sku mtshams grol 'phral rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa'i drung du phebs te/ sngar gyi nyams rtogs sogs lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ rje'i gsung gis/ khyed kyi thugs la 'khrungs pa'i nyams rtogs dang / mtshan ltas khyad par can de rnams ni 'di dang 'di'o zhes lung bstan dbugs dbyung khyad par can mang du stsal cing / lhag par bla ma rin 'byung gi nyams len la grub pa'i rtags thon 'dug pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i rnam thar dang tshul mthun pa byung 'dug de yang sngon rin 'byung sogs bla ma rigs lnga sgrub pa'i man ngag lam 'bras kyi cha lag 'di nyid rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mus chen sems dpa' chen po la gnang dus/ rje ngor chen gyi zhal nas/ lam 'bras thams cad sngar snyan brgyud yin kyang / da phal cher la yig cha med pa med cing / bla ma rigs lnga sgrub pa 'di rnams la/ rin 'byung la zur tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan la yig cha yang cher med/ dang po bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa'i gsung gis/ lam 'bras kyi man ngag rtsad gcod pa la slob dpon chen po ye shes rgyal mtshan pa bas kyang / slob dpon bud+dha ba ngos mkhas pa zhig 'dug gsungs pa zhig byung 'dug pa/ phyis bud+dha ba dang dngos su gsung gleng byung bas/ man ngag 'di rnams rtsad chod pas bla ma dpal ldan pa dges pa yin gsungs pa thos pas/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa la'ang 'di med tshod du 'dug nged kyis kyang 'di'i man ngag sngar su la yang byin pa med/ 'di nyams su blangs pas la brten nas nged la yang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i yon tan skyes pa yin te/ 'di'i bla ma gzhan bzhi la zla ba re re dang / rin 'byung la zla ba gnyis te zla ba drug nyams su blangs pas/ lus kyi phyi nang gi srin bu thams cad kyang 'gags/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs kyang thob ste/

bka' bstan bcos gang yang da nga la brjed rgyu med gsungs nas/ bla ma sgrub pa'i man ngag rnams gnang ba yin pa 'dug cing /rje sems dpa' chen pos kyang ngor chen la man ngag 'di dgun gsan 'phral bsam gtan phug tu phebs nas dpyid zla gsum ma rdzogs bar sku mtshams bcad nas bla ma rin 'byung la sgrub pa yun ring mdzad pas/ mnal lam du khri mang po 'dug pa su'i yin dris pas/ sa skya pa yab sras khu dbon rnams kyi yin zer/ de rnams las che ba cig 'dug pa dris pas/ khyod kyi yin zer ba rmis/ yang zhwa lu'i sa cha 'dra ba zhig na chos khri chen po gnyis 'dug pa dris pas/ bu ston rin po che dang / sems dpa' chen po gnyis kyi yin zer/ de gnyis las kyang che ba gcig 'dug pa dris pas khyod kyi yin zer ba rmis zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa ni/ rje mus chen nyid la bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phrin las las zhan rgyu med pa'i bstan 'gro'i don 'grub pa'i 'phrin las chen po 'ong ba'i mtshan ltas khyad par can du 'dug cing / chos rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du bzhi sde mkhyen rab pas bla ma rin 'byung 'di zhu dus/ 'bul ba shin tu stobs che ba phul bas/ rje mus chen nyid dges pa'i tshul gyis/ khyed kyi nged la zab byung ste/ zab lan ci drag gam gsungs pa la/ chos rje bzhi sde ba bzhengs nas phyag mang du btsal cing / da bla ma rin 'byung thugs rjes 'dzin dgos zhus pas/ gnang nas/ de dus sems dpa' chen po'i gsung gis/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi man ngag 'di nged la gnang ba'ang 'chi mo rang yin pas/ phyis mang po la yong pa med/ da yod na ngor gdan sa pa chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug dang / bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang gnyis la yod pa a srid/ nged kyis kyang sngar su la yang ma byas/ 'di 'dra'i gdams ngag yod na/ ri phug 'drar bsdad kyang su dang yang mi mnyam rgyu med snyam pa'i blo gdengs yod/

gdams ngag la nyams len dgos pa yin gsungs nas bla ma rin 'byung 'di gnang ba yin pa gda'/ des na chos rje shang pa khyed la rje rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar dang 'dra ba'i yon tan skyes 'dug byas na/ nga bla ma rgan po gcig gis slob ma la bstod ra ha cang btang drags rgan 'chal langs 'dug zer mi tshos lab tu 'ongs nyen yod/ ces gsungs pa sogs gzengs bstod kyi tshig mang po dang / dges dges dpag med stsal zhing / de nas slar yang rje nyid kyis bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams bcad rgya can mdzad nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū dril gnyis kyi bskyed rdzogs la brten/ snying po/ nye snying / go cha rnams la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa mdzad pa dang / de rjes gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad pas/ yi dam gyi lhas rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma mang du brnyes shing / de nas rje 'di dgung gi lo so gsum du son pa dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi lo gsar du shar ba na/ lha mo rig byed ma ku ru kul+le la gsung bsnyen 'bum phrag bcu gsum mdzad pa'i tshe/ nangs shig tshogs bdag glang sna can dngos su byung bas/ ku ru kul+le'i gtor ma'i mgo bo bcad nas khyer song ba gzigs pas/ de'i don la dgongs pa na/ tshogs bdag la gtor ma dgos zer ba'i brda yin par mkhyen nas/ sku mtshams ma grol ring la tshogs bdag la yang gtor ma zur pa re rgyun du gnang ba yin zhes rjes dngos slob 'ga' la gsungs 'dug pa las brgyud de thos shing / de nas sku mtshams kyi 'phros de ka la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang mi bskyod rdo rje gnyis la yang bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa mdzad pas/ rdzogs rim gyi rtags snang khyad par can du ma dang / lhag par dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams sku'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston pa gzigs shing / de nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i tshe sgrub 'byung bzhi gur khang ma'i nyams len la brten nas bsnyen sgrub zla ba gsum gyi bar du mdzad pas/

dus gcig gi tshe gtor tshogs kyi rgyab na bzhugs pa'i rten rdo la bris pa'i bram gzugs kyi sku gcig yod pa des phyag gi mi rkang gi gling bu bus byung pas/ de'i sgra chen pos nam mkha'i khyon thams cad khyab nas/ sa gzhi yang 'dar ling ling byed pa dang / mthar bram gzugs de yang 'od du zhu nas rje rang nyid la thim pa'i gsal snang khyad par can dang bcas thugs rgyud la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo mtshar can 'khrungs nas de la yun ring du gnas pa byung gsungs shing / de nas rje nyid dgung gi lo so bzhi bzhes pa na tshod ldan zhes pa'i shing mo phag gi lo'i 'go nas/ so lnga bzhes pa 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo ma rdzogs bar gyi lo ngo gnyis kyi bar la bka' pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len gyi snying po zab mo bdud kyi spyod yul gyi khrid kyi man ngag rnams la rtse gcig tu mdzad pa'i tshe/ sngon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pas sgom skyong ba'i dus dbu gtsug tu mar me sbar nas bzhag pa de dper mdzad nas/ rje 'dis kyang spyi bor mar me yod snyam pa mdzad nas sku la g.yo 'gul spu tsam med par dbyings rig dbyer med du bsres pa de ka'i lta ba'i rgyun bskyangs nas nyin zhag gnyis gsum tsam sgom de ka'i ngang la 'byams 'gro ba la/ sgrub g.yog pas ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun nas slong dgos pa yang lan mang du byung ba sogs zung 'jug gi lta ba'i nyams len gyi bogs 'don pa la de dus kyi gcod khrid nyams len de rang sleb che ba byung zhes rje nyid yang yang gsung ba dngos su thos shing / de nas rje 'dis zla ba drug gi bar la gur gyi mgon po srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma dang / rtsa gsum 'khor lo la brten pa'i phyi nang gi khrid zab mo'i nyams len dang bcas yi ge bdun ma/ bcu gnyis ma/ sha sa na rnams la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin par mdzad pas/

rje rang gi sku nag po chen por gsal ba la ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i gsal snang shin tu brtan pa dang / gtor ma la me dngos su 'bar ba/ mon pa nag po du ma dngos su sku mdun du 'dus nas dga' ba'i cho 'phrul ston pa sogs chos skyong gi bsnyen rtags rnams gsal zhing brtan pa lan du ma'i bar du byung ba yin no/ /zhes thos la/ de ltar bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa 'dis kha ba'i ljongs kyi shing rta chen por grags pa rnams las mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i tshig don yang dag pa'i lam srol dang bcas yongs su rdzogs par mnos pas ni/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang shing rta chen po rnams kyi bstan bcos mtha' dag gi dka' ba'i gnas kyi mdud pa phra rags thams cad ji lta ba bzhin phyed pas ni bsam byung gi rig pa nor bu'i gling la dbang 'byor/ thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i don nyams su len pa la kun tu 'grus pas nyams dang rtogs pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa ni don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa/ rang gi yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad bsten thabs gsum gyis bsten cing mnyes thabs gsum gyis mnyes par byas pas sras kyi thu bo zla med par dgongs te spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar gces par bskyangs pas ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal tshab tu gyur/ snyan pa'i grags pa dkar pos sa gsum bkang bas ni nag po'i phyogs mtha' dag gi snying la zug rngu'i rma srol gtod/ legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer gyis thub bstan 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal phyogs brgyar 'dzum par nus pa ni lus med dbang po'i khang bzang tog dang bcas pa 'dar zhing rgyal ba thams cad kyis legs pa'i dbugs dbyung / mkhyen rab nam mkha'i khyon las 'ongs pa'i dngos stobs kyi rigs pa gnam lcags kyi 'khor los bsdigs pas ni log par smra ba'i phas rgol mtha' dag gi snying 'dar/

bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog bod ston mkhas pa'i legs bshad dang bcas par dbang phyug ste smin grol gyi gru bo che lhag bsam gyi skya ba dang bcas pa mngon par 'du byas pas ni 'khor ba chu srin 'byung gnas las rgal te thar pa rin po che'i gling 'dod pa rnams kyi ded dpon du gyur/ ded dpon thabs la mkhas pas yid bzhin gyi chu gter las nor bu rin po che blangs te rang yul du 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa ltar skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya ris med pa dag la 'phral dang yun du phan pa dang bde ba'i lam bstan nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i ra ba las 'das te/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyi chos kyi rgyal srid la 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che zla ba yar ngo'i cha shas ltar rim gyis je 'phel du gyur pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ mgon khyed sngon nas shes bya'i yul kun la/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i spyan mnga' yang / /skal bzang rnams kyi dpyad bya 'di yin zhes/ /gdul bya drang phyir thos bsam sgom la brtson/ /khyod ni sngon goms las kyi 'phro sad de/ /mkhas la grags pa'i shes bya'i gnas phal cher/ /thos dang bsam pa'i khong du chud 'dod pa'i/ /dad 'dun dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin je rgyas gyur/ /slob dpon mkhas pa'i chos kyi chu gter rnams/ /rnam dpyod hub kyis legs bshad kun bsdus shing / /gzhung mang 'grel par bcas pa'i tshig don kun/ /'dzin dang sems pas dus kun 'da' bar mdzad/ /de tsam nyid du ma zad zab don gyi/ /gdams pa'i bdud rtsi sgom la chig bsgril bas/ /grangs med gsum gyi dka' spyad ma ltos par/ /tshe gcig 'bras bu sgrub la'ang ngang gis zhugs/ /nyin mtshan med par chos kyis dus 'da' bar/ /'di 'dra dga' ldan na yang srid min snyam/ /dus der brtson 'grus che bar rlom pa yi/ /dregs ldan mang po'i nga rgyal dus cig bcom/ /dpyod ldan 'bum sde'i dbus su smra mkhas pa'i/

/gzhon nu blo gsal des ni legs bshad gtam/ /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i do rar bsgrags pa'i tshe/ /bshes gnyen yongs kyi tshad ma'i dpang gyur te/ /tshul gnas mang thos zhi dul bag yod can/ /'di 'dra sa steng 'di na dkon no zhes/ /dus mtshungs skye bo kun gyis cher bsngags shing / /zang zing yon gyis sbyin gnas mchog tu bkur/ /gzhan yang zab don bsgoms pa las byung ba'i/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i ngo mtshar gtam mang pos/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos rang gi rigs kyi bdag /dges par mdzad 'di mchod pa'i rab dang phul/ /rdo rje 'chang dang bsdu mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ /tha dad min yang tha dad rnam rol ston/ /spangs rtogs mnyam yang slob dpon slob ma yi/ /tshul gyis phan tshun rtogs pa 'gran pa snyam/ /zab gsal bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /grag stong bzlas pa'i sngags kyis rjes bskul bas/ /gang thugs dag pa'i thugs kyi me long la/ /zhi khro rab 'byams zhal dkyil mngon sum shar/ /phar phyin dbu ma'i lta ba'i zab gnad la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i gad rgyangs sgrog mang yang / /de don thugs la 'khrungs nas ting 'dzin gyi/ /mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i skyes chen 'di ngo mtshar/ /u dum wa ra lta bu'i dal 'byor gyi/ /rnyed dka'i rten la bag yod snying po'i don/ /len par mi byed rmongs pa de dag ni/ /rin chen gling nas stong log mgron po bzhin/ /la la sgom med mi tshe thos pas 'byams/ /dregs 'dod nga rgyal gyis khengs gang zag dang / /chos la dag snang dang bral 'di kun kyang / /mkhas pa'i mal du blun po'i ro yis rgyu/ /ding sang phal cher thos pa dang bral yang / /bya btang ming gis blun sgom dud 'gro yi/ /sgrub thabs byed pa'i chos pa'i gzugs brnyan la/ /brtson pa mang mod de la snying po ci/ /des na thos bsam sgom gsum go rim bzhin/ /ma 'khrul sbyor ba gnyis kyi brtson 'grus kyis/ /rgyun chad med par nyams su bzhes pa 'di/

/dus gsum rgyal ba dges pa'i mdzad 'phrin yin/ /thos pa mtha' med de yis thos/ /bsam pas don rnams rtogs par bsam/ /sgom pas rtogs pa skyes zhing sgom/ /mchog gi rnam 'dren 'di de mchog /lnga pa dben par sgom sgrub la rtse gcig tu bzhugs shing mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ de yang gong du bstan pa ltar/ gling kha bde ba can gyi chos grwa chen po dang / yang dben bsam gtan phug la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgon gnas dam pa de dag tu phyi nang gi spros pa thams cad rgyang ring du spangs te/ thos bsam dang gtso bor zab mo sgom sgrub la rtse gcig tu rgyun ma chad par bzhugs par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'dis yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi zhal gyi bum bzang las 'ongs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rnams dang / rang nyid kyis gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshig don la thos bsam ngom med du mdzad pa'i legs bshad snying po'i don rnams rnam dpyod yangs pa'i snyim pas yang yang gsol ba blo gros ro 'dzin dbang pos dges par myangs pas lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi bcud kyis sku gsung thugs kyi dbang po yongs su brtas par gyur nas/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ de yang dang por mkhas pa'i yon tan la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum las/ 'chad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis gdul bya'i blo gros kyi pad+mo rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ dam pa 'di ni mdo sngags la sogs pa'i gsung rab zab mo gang 'chad kyang cher rlom gzhan gyi lugs bzhin gzhung so so'i kun la grags che ba'i thad kyi bkar thig sbrugs nas zem 'bros kyis bshad pa tsam ma yin par/ gsung rab gang yin pa de'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa thugs yul du gsal bar shar ba'i sgo nas gdul bya mchog dman gyi blo gros rim pa dang 'tshams par tshig rna bar snyan cing dal brel dang che chung gi gdangs 'tsham pa/

brjod bya 'brel chags shing gdul bya'i blo yul du 'char bde ba/ dka' ba'i gnas thams cad brgal lan gyi sgo nas gtan la phab ste mngon sum du ston pa/ sku tshe ril por 'di kho na la sbyangs pa 'dra/ de kho na ltar yin par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes gting tshugs pa zhig 'byung bas chos rgyun ji tsam ring yang nyan mi nus pa dang / yun ring ba'i snang ba cung zad kyang med par/ chos de grol 'gro ba na yang da dung re zhig ma grol na snyam pa'i rje'i zhal la yang yang lta 'dod cing / sems la phang bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'gro ba zhig 'byung ba myong bas grub la/ rtsod pa gnam lcags kyi 'khor los log rtog gi brag ri phye mar mdzad pa'i tshul yang / zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs kyi gnas skabs rnams su gzhan lugs kyi mkhas pa chen po rnams kyi bzhed pa bkong par mdzad nas/ de la lung rigs kyis dpyad pa mdzad pa na/ phyi rgol gyi grub mtha' ngan pa'i skyon 'tshang thams cad kun gyi mngon sum du rig pa zhig 'byung zhing / gzhan yang rje 'dis sa skyar bzhugs skabs shig gong ma bdag chen 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po la thugs brel zhig gi dbang las/ kye rdor sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbu la phebs dgos byung bas/ de dus gong dkar rdo rje gdan nas rdzong lugs kyi dge bshes che rags shig gdan sa chen po'i gnas mjal la byon pa dang stabs 'grig nas/ sgrub mchod pa dpon slob rnams gsol ba gdugs tshod kyi skabs/ khong rnams tshogs su byon pa'i sa skya pa'i yab chos kye rdo rje'i rgyud man ngag las brtsams te dka' gnas du ma la dri ba dang / lhag par ngor pa'i grub mtha' la zur gyis bzas pa'i 'bel gtam mang po gleng byung ba na/ rje bla ma 'dis bzhugs khri de ka'i steng nas thugs zhi dul chen po'i ngang nas dri ba dang / rtsod pa'i rigs re re nas lan 'debs kyi legs bshad lung rigs gis sgrub byed mtha' yas pa dang bcas tshig rtsub kyi dri mas ma gos pa dpyis phyin pa gnang bas/

der tshogs kyi dpon slob kun dga' mgu yi rangs par gyur cing / khong gong dkar pa rnams kyang dang ba'i dad pa lhag par skyes te/ sa skya'i sngags dgon gyi bla ma de spyir gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son cing / lhag par ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i gnad rnams thugs la gsal le bzhugs pa'i shin tu 'jigs pa zhig 'dug ces phyogs kun tu snyan pa sgrog par gyur la/ skabs der gong ma 'jam dbyangs bdag chen chos kyi rgyal pos kyang sgrub mchod grol 'phral/ bkras thags/ bzang ja sdum/ bzhugs gding legs pa gcig rnams stsal ba'i kha sang gi rdzong pa'i lan 'debs de rnams bla ma gong ma rnams dang / gdan sa chen po 'di'i zhabs 'degs su che ba byung 'dug pa cis kyang ngo mtshar che'o/ /zhes pa'i legs so byin pa yang gnang bar mdzad cing / yang dus phyis ngam ring du rgyal po'i pho brang du dpon sa mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i nang rten dngul gdung gi rab gnas la rje bla ma 'di dang / mkhan chen byams pa bzang po/ ri bo che pa 'gyur med bde chen/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po grwa tshang so so ba du ma dang bcas spyan drangs pa'i/ bde mchog kye rdor/ dus 'khor rnams la brten pa'i rab gnas legs par mdzad rjes/ rab ston rgyas pa'i skabs su mi dbang sa skyong chen po yang gral dbu la phebs pa'i dpyod ldan gyi gang zag grangs med pa 'dus pa'i sa der/ rje 'gyur med kyi zhal slob mkhas pa zhig gis dus kyi 'khor lo la che ba brjod pa dpag tu med pa dang / rgyud sde gzhan rnams la mi zab pa dang / rab gnas kyi cho ga rnams la yang zur gyis za ba'i dri ba dang rtsod pa mang du byas byung bar/ bdag cag gi rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa 'dis gsung dpang mtho zhing snyan pa dang bcas/ tshig 'bru rnams kyang dag cing gsal ba/ brjod pa gtsang ba'i sgo nas so so'i lan 'debs mtha' dag rgyas bshad don bsdus kyi sgo nas mtha' chod pa dang /

skabs skabs su nyams ldan sun 'byin gyi rigs kyang thor bu dang bcas gsung bshad rgyun ring du mdzad pas/ der tshogs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen sde snod 'dzin pa sogs blo gros dang ldan pa'i skye bo thams cad/ rje 'di'i lung gi yon tan gyi rgya dang rtsod pa'i ngag tshig myur zhing rno la don bzang ba'i tshul sogs la kun kyang ha las par gyur cing / lhag par rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po dpon slob rnams thugs 'phrogs par gyur te/ chos rgyal chen po'i gsung las/ rje bla ma gling kha pa 'di dpal ldan sa skya pa rang gi chos la gsan rgya che zhing thos bsam phul du byung ba dang / spyir gzhung lugs mtha' dag khyad par rgyud sde rin po che dang 'brel ba'i chos skad gang byed kyang tshig don gnyis ka la byang zhing lhong che la phyag len phra mo tshun la'ang 'di 'di yin dang / 'di dus 'di byed nges shes yid ches rang yod cing / lhag par bde mchog rtsa sngags kyis gtsos pa'i lha bsnyen rtags dus grangs gsum las su rung ba thog mnyam gyi dge bshes la rje 'di rang ngo mtshar che ba 'dug ces bstod bkur bsngags gsum du ma mdzad cing / de nas yun ring ma lon par rang gi rigs kyi cod pan dam par bsten par mdzad pa yin no/ /rtsom pa'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul yang / spyir rtsom pa zhes bya ba bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i yon tan brjod pa dang /bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa'i dgongs 'brel dang bcas pa brjod bya'i yul du byas te/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad pa ltar/ sdeb sbyor gyi gtsug lag dang mthun par rtsom shes na/ rtsom pa kho na la brten nas lhag pa'i lha'i zhal mthong ba dang / chos rnams kyi gnas lugs mthong ba'i shes rab skye ba sogs 'byung ba la/ de dang mthun par bdag nyid chen po 'dis mdzad pa'i gsung rtsom rnams kyang /

dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun por/ rang gis brjod par bde zhing gzhan gyis rtogs par sla la/ gnyis ka'i rna bar snyan pa zhig sdeb sbyor gyi gtsug lag shes pa las 'byung bas zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshig don 'brel chags shing kun gyi blo yul du 'jebs pa zhig 'byung pa yin la/ de lta bu'i gsung rtsom ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul phyogs tsam brjod na/ rje rang nyid kyi rigs kyi cod pan dam pa rje btsun bla ma chos dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa tshan pa 'ga'/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad chen mo/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi cho ga'i rnam bshad sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis bkas bskul nas gser mdog dbon po bsod nams rtse mo'i don du mdzad pa/ gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma'i yig rgyas pa ngo mtshar can/ bka' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gcod kyi zab khrid nyams su len tshul dpon lha dbang rgyal mtshan gyi don du mdzad pa'i ye ge sogs/ de thams cad kyang tshig nyung la don rgyas pa mkhas blun skye bo kun gyis 'dzin sla zhing brjod bde ba sogs dpyod ldan mkhas pas legs par brtags na bstan pa gsal bar nus shing / don gnyer rnams la yid kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba sha stag tu yod do/ /gnyis pa btsun pa'i yon tan ni/ thog mar lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin par dgongs nas/ bslab par bya ba'i gnas mtha' dag la phra zhing phra ba nas blang dor gyi dmigs rnam phyed par mdzad cing / rtags dang cha lugs tshun chad kyang rung ba tshad dang ldan pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / kun tu spyod pa thams cad kyang dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang mthun pa kho na sku nyams su bstar bar mdzad la/ khyad par du srid pa'i skye ba mang por rang bzhin gyis dge ba la goms pa'i shugs kyis chung ngu nyid nas rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ci yang mi mdzad na/

sku nar son cing bslab pa rin po che rnams zhal gyis 'ches nas/ de rnams dang 'gal ba'i dri ma tsam gyis kyang gos pa lta ga la zhig ste/ bsten bya 'tsho ba dang / bsrung bya tshul khrims dang / nyams len spyod pa dang / rtogs pa lta ba bzhi ma nyams shing / rnam par dag pa bzhi la brten par mngon sum gyi tshad mas grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de cis mngon zhe na/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang po dul zhing zhi la bag dang ldan pa kho nas bzhugs par kun la mngon du gyur pa dang / spyod lam thams cad kun tu mdzes shing brjid chags la tshul khrims kyi dri bsung khyad par can rdzi phyogs min par yang mnam pa zhig ste/ de yang bdag cag glang lo gling kha dgon par zhabs drung du slebs nas gdan sa bkod bzhag ma mdzad kyi bar la bla brang chen mo'i 'og gi gzim chung du rje bla ma nyid bzhugs shing / kho bo cag steng gi bla ma lha khang na yod skabs/ de dus dgun yin pas/ rje bla ma'i na bza' rnams phyag g.yog rnams kyis snga dro re bzhin 'og gi dbang khang ka drug ma'i nyi ma la rgyang tsam la 'jog pa zhig 'dug pa la/ der skabs nyi ma'i 'od kyis na bza' rnams la reg pa na/ de'i rkyen gyis de dag las tshul khrims kyi dri bsung khyad par can 'thul te bla brang gi steng 'og rnams dang / dgon pa'i gling khrod tshun thams cad dri bzang gis khyab pa zhig dus rgyun du 'ong ba ngos cag dpon slob sogs der yod kyi skye bo kun gyi mthun snang grub pa byung ba na/ gzhan yang rje nyid dbang bskur sogs mdzad pa'i tshe yang dbang rdzas sogs 'grims par phebs byung pa na/ de dang dus mnyam lha dang mi'i spos kyi dri zhim po gang gis mtshan par mi nus pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri bsung ngo mtshar can thul gyis 'byung ba dang dbang gral na yod pa kun gyis lan gcig ma yin pa yang yang du tshor ba bu slob kun gyi thugs la gsal ba ltar yin pas/

de nas 'di lta bu ni/ sngon bram ze mchog sred kyi slob ma nor bu gling pa bde pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba de btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur pa tshul khrims kyi dri gzhu 'dom lnga brgya tsam du tshor ba yod cing chos skyong gi gsung gis/ khyod kyi tshul khrims 'di rnam par dag pas bdag skad cig kyang khyod dang mi 'bral bar bsrung ba dang / dam tshig tu bgyis pa yin gsungs shing / gang bsgo ba de dag thogs pa med par 'grub pas bstan pa la phan du ma btags so/ /zhes grags pa dang tshul mtshungs pa'i shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar par shes par bya zhing / gzhan yang gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs thams cad gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba dang / dri bsung khyad par can dang ldan par 'gyur bar mthong ba dang / skye bo su la'ang zur gyis 'khu ba dang / zhe gcod pa'i tshig ngan dang / pha rol gyi yid du mi 'ong pa'i rnam 'gyur cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing / rnyed pa dang bskur bsti la chags pa'i sgo nas pha rol bslu ba'i bsam sbyor gtan mi mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na bdag nyid chen po 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa dang kun tu spyod pa gang la yang skyon ltar snang ba 'di lta bu zhig go snyam pa zhabs drung na gnas pa'i blo gros can sus kyang yong ye ma mthong ba yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ thugs nges 'byung tshul khrims rnam dag pas/ /dgag sgrub gnas gsum la mkhas shing gzhol/ /tshul khrims dri bsung gis phyogs kun khyab/ /rje 'dul ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bstod pa yin no/ /de tsam kho nar ma zad kyi chos kyi rje 'di nyid ni bdag pas gzhan gces par 'dzin pa'i snying rje chen pos ros thugs rgyud yongs su gang bar gyur pas/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa lta bur kun nas yongs su brtse zhing / khyad par du yang dbul zhing phongs pa dang / mgon med pa dang / nad dang sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa dang /

'jig rten 'di'i bya ba la mngon par zhen pas yid dri ma can du gyur pa rnams la lhag par yang thugs rje chen po g.ye ba zhig pas/ dman par gyur pa'i skye bo gang su yang rung ba de dag la zas dang gos la sogs pa'i yo byad gya nom pa dag sbyor zhing so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gtam gyis dbugs phyung nas/ 'di dang phyi ma bde zhing skyid pa'i thabs khyad par can kho na la 'jug par mdzad la/ lta ba dang grub mtha' tha dad la mngon par zhen pas blo zing zing por gyur pa rnams kyang brtse ba chen po 'dis thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa dang / don zab cing tshig 'bru phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i 'bel ba'i gtam gyi bka' mchid khyad par can gyi sgo nas phyin ci ma log pa'i lam du 'jug pa la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa thogs pa med pas/ gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa'i yid mtsho yongs su rgyas par mdzad pa zhig yin no/ /de ltar yang mgon po byams pas/ snyom pa phan par 'dod pa brtse ba can/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal skye bas shin tu 'jigs/ /sems can 'dul ba la ni legs brtson pa/ /ngag gi nyes rnam gsum las shin tu ring / /zhes gang gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis rgyud btams pas/ gzhan gnod kyi bsam pa dug bzhin spangs/ /phar phyin dang dbu ma'i gzhung kun mkhyen/ /rje bka' gdams pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin no/ /gsang sngags nang gi nyams len gyi rim pa dang kun tu spyod pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams ni skye bo gzhan la 'chab pa nyid gtso bor mdzad pa zhig snang bas zhib tu ma mchis la/ thun mong du grags pa dang rang la snang ba tsam zhig brjod na/ lam gyi rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pa srog gi dbang po ltar gces par 'dzin pa'i sgo nas nyes ltung gi dri mas nam yang ma gos shing / gnyis 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i chos kyi dbyings spros bral nam mkha' lta bu dang /

rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba sgyu ma lta bu'i chos can rang rig pa'i ye shes/ de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med par mkhyen pa'i 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi nyams len gyi gnad zab mo dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ phyi nang gi g.yeng ba gang gis kyang brdzi bar mi nus pa'i gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor ba gzhan las phul du byung bas dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gtso bor gyur pa'i mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi thugs dam gyi rim pa du ma zhig la dus rtag tu brtson pa lhur mdzad pas/ tha mal gyi snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad 'gags nas sku gsum rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba'i 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs nas lha dang ye shes kyi ngo bor kha lo bsgyur nas/ dag pa rab 'byams bde stong zung 'jug 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad pa la the tshom yid gnyis cung zad kyang mi dgos pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ mgon khyod sngon nas mchog gi sar bzhugs kyang / /gdul bya drang phyir rgyal bas cher bsngags pa'i/ /dben gnas rnams su ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /ngom med rol la gcig tu brtson pa snyam/ /gzhung lugs bye ba 'bum sde'i tshig don rnams/ /rdzogs par khyod kyi thugs la rab smin pas/ /'dus pa'i dbus su 'chad pa'i sgra dbyangs ni/ /thos tshe mi mgu'i gzur gnas blo ldan su/ /khyod ni mdo rgyud bstan bcos gang 'chad kyang / /de nyid kho na sbyangs 'dra'i mkhyen yangs kyis/ /gdul bya blo yi dbul ba kun bsal nas/ /yud kyis mkhas pa'i gras su chud par mdzad/ /lta grub gcig dang mi gcig mkhas pa yi/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom ri bo'i spo/ /kun kyang khyod kyi lung rigs rnam dag gi /sra brtan rdo rje'i char gyis phye mar mdzad/ /e ma 'phags yul phyogs glang chos grags dang / /sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs 'jigs med dpa' bo de/ /mya ngan 'das rjes rtsod pa seng ge'i sgras/

/phas rgol 'joms la mgon 'dir 'gran byed su/ /ming rnams mngon brjod kyis spras bying che zhing / /tshig rnams snyan ngag gis brgyan rna bar snyan/ /don rnams brjod bya dang 'brel rtogs par sla/ /gcod mtshams sdeb sbyor dang mthun brjod bde ba/ /de lta'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bstan bcos de/ /mkhas dbang rnams kyis bsngags pa'i yul yin kyang / /blo gros dman la de las bzlog pas na/ /mchog dman kun dga'i bstan bcos du ma'ang spel/ /de ltar zab yangs mkhyen pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /sngon med gsar du bskrun pa'i legs bshad rnams/ /tshig nyung don mang go sla brjod bde ba'i/ /mkhas kun yid kyi 'dod 'jo bla na med/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /thar pa 'dod pa'i rnam grol don gnyer gyis/ /dam chos 'dul ba'i tshigs gsum bslab pa'i tshogs/ /nyes ltung phra mos ma gos khyed kho na/ /rta thul bzhin du spyod lam kun nas dul/ /ka ta ya na'i bu ltar bslab byar gus/ /'od srung bzhin du sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /mar gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gzhom slad du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod blos/ /byang chub sems gnyis zab mo'i nyams len gyis/ /bdag pas gzhan gces sems dpa' khyod gcig bsngags/ /rang nyid smin byed phar phyin rnam drug dang / /gzhan rnams smin byed bsdu dngos rnam bzhi yis/ /rgyal ba'i sras po'i spyod tshul rlabs po ches/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i rnam thar rjes su bsnyegs/ /tha mal snang ba'i snod bcud sna tshogs 'di/ /lha sngags ye shes rol par legs sdom nas/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal 'khor 'das ro gcig par/ /nges par dgongs khyod rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyan/ /mnyam rjes med par bskyed rim gsal snang brtan/ /bzlas brjod grangs med bye ba'i pha mthar son/ /dus kun bde stong ye shes dang bzhugs pa/ /dpal ldan grags pa'i mtshan de slar byon snyam/

/smra mkhas mkhas pa kun gyi rgyan gyur cing / /rje btsun btsun pa'i mchog gyur zhi zhing dul/ /spyod bzang bzang po'i mdzad pa 'gran bral ba'i/ /yongs 'dzin 'dzin ma'i rgyan 'di e ma mtshar/ /khyed dang rgya gar paṇa grub rnams/ /mkhas dang grub par tshul mtshungs kyang / /paṇa grub 'phags yul mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /khyod ni gangs khrod rgyan mchog go /gsum pa bzang po'i yon tan ni/ 'dren pa dam pa 'di nyid nges pa kho nar rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor bzhugs pa gdon mi za ba'i phyir/ de'i bzang po'i yon tan gyi cha bsam pa dang brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa zhig yin mod kyang / 'dir rang re so so skye bo rnams kyi snang ngor snang tshul mdo tsam zhig brjod pa la gnyis/ thun mong ba'i bzang po'i yon tan dpag tu med pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i tshul dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bzang po'i yon tan rmad du byung ba du ma zhig brnyes pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni rang nyid lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing gangs can gyi che dgu kun gyis spyi bor bkur yang / thugs la rgyags pa dang dregs pa nam yang mi mnga' zhing / mngon par khengs pa'i mdud pa thams cad bkrol te rgyun du zhi zhing dul la gsung 'jam zhing snyan pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pas skye bo mchog dman su zhig la yang 'phyas pa dang / 'khang pa'i tshig ngan pa nam yang mi gsungs/ gang zag gzhan la tho 'tshams pa dang phrag dog gis gnod sems cung zad kyang mi mnga'/ khyad par rang dang lta ba dang grub mtha' tha dad cing / chos lugs mi gcig pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i rigs su zhig la'ang dag snang dang dad gus chen po mdzad de/ de dag so so'i rnam par thar pa legs phyogs 'ba' zhig sgrog par mdzad pa las/ gang zag gi skyon nas gsungs pa sus kyang thos ma myong / zhal nas kyang sngon gyi skyes bu chen po rnams kyi gsung las/ gang zag la dag snang sbyongs/

grub mtha' la brtag dpyad gyis zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ dad gus 'di mtha' gnyis su ma lhung pa zhig byed dgos zhes yang yang gsungs/ rje bla ma rang nyid kyi rigs kyi cod pan du gyur pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rnams la bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad gus chen pos nges par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor dgongs shing / zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su brnyed pa dang bkur bsti dang tshigs su bcad pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang gi rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par bsten tshul rnam pa lngas bsten pa dang / mnyes thabs rnam pa bzhis mnyes par mdzad cing / zhi bar gshegs nas kyang dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs dang / dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs par shin tu brtson par mdzad/ yon tan gyi khyad par du byas pa'i sde snod dang rgyud sde 'dzin pa chen po su zhig la'ang bkur bsti dang bdag gnyer gzhan las che ba bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su dgongs nas mdzad/ tha na gang zag phal pa dge bshes su ming btags pa tshun chad la yang skabs su babs pa'i mthong 'jog dang zhe sa mdzad/ dus rtag tu thugs dgyes shing bzhin ras mdangs gsal la zhal kun tu 'dzum zhing bzhad/ skye bo su zhig zhabs drung du lhags na yang / de nyid kho na la dgyes par 'dug snyam pa 'byung zhing / 'grogs na bde/ phyi rol tu sems rtsub rtsub por gyur pa kun kyang / zhabs drung du sleb pa tsam gyis zhi mal 'gro/ bsod nams cha mthun tsam la gnas pa'i tha mal pa zhig yin na yang / rje 'di'i zhabs drung du/ chos 'jig rten gyi bka' mchid cung zad byung ba tsam gyis rang dbang med par dad cing gus par 'gyur/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi brnyed bkur dang che thabs la sogs pa'i/ rtsol sgrub gang yang mi mdzad/ phyag rdzas rnams kyang dgon pa so so'i drung chen dang / sku 'khor rnams kyi gang byed las ched gnyer chung zad kyang mi mdzad cing /

'phral du byung ba rnams rten gsum bzhengs pa/ bla ma'i dus mchod dang / dgon gnas so so'i so tshigs dang / sku rim du btags pa'i sbyin gtong kho na las/ rje rang nyid kyi don du til tsam yang mi 'dzin/ bu slob dang sbyin bdag sogs kyis 'bul ba dang zhabs tog chen po byas pa la ha cang thugs dges dges po mi mdzad cing / ma byas pa la'ang mi dges pa cung zad kyang mi mnga'/ dus rgyun par chos ldan gyi bya ba gang la'ang thugs ngang ring zhing thugs klong dang thugs dkyil che/ gzhi byes kyi dam pa'i chos don gnyer gyi nyam chung rnams la gsung chos dang 'tsho chas kyi bka' drin stsol/ sems can phongs pa dang mgon med pa'i rigs gang na yod kyang de rnams la byams pa dang snying rjes skyong / skye bo ngan pa blo mi srun zhing chos dang mi mthun pa dang / sde dpon chen po sogs 'khor dang longs spyod kyis dregs pa rnams la'ang bstun 'jogs mi mdzad/ rje nyid kyi thugs g.yo sgyu dang zol zog gi dri mas nam yang ma gos pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid rton pa'i gnas su gyur/ tshogs dang dben pa gang du yang rtag tu lus gnad kyis bzhugs shing sku'i cha lugs bag dang ldan/ byang sems 'dzag pa'i nyes pa dang bral zhing rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor gyis rgyun du 'phel zhing brtan pas sku lus gzhon sha che zhing zhal ras bkrag dang ldan/ bskyed rim gyi gsal snang brtan po'i ngang nas bzlas brjod bye ba'i pha mthar son pa sogs zab bzhes kyis thugs rgyud shin tu smin pas rgyun par zhabs drung du bsdad pa zhig yin yang / mjal dus de ma thag zhal dkyil la blta mi nus pa'i byin rlabs kyi zil chen de lta bu gzhan su la yang yod pa ma mthong / sku la sems can dang srin 'bu la sogs pa srog chags kyi rigs gtan med pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub cing / rje rang gis kyang phyogs tsam zhal gyis bzhes/

skye bo'i tshogs ji tsam mang ba zhig 'dus kyang / de kun gyi khrod du thams cad las sku lus gzengs mtho zhing gzi brjid che/ mthong ba tsam gyis skyes bu chen po yin par gdon mi za bar kun gyis 'tshal bar byed/ dman pa nad gdon gyis nyen pa rnams la shin tu brtse ba'i thugs kyi byin rlabs dang ljags chab la sogs pas phan pa sgrub/ dbyar gyi dus su char dbab pa dang / skabs 'gar rims nad bcad pa sogs la de dang de'i thugs 'dun dang bcas pa'i thabs mdzad pa tsam gyis don de thogs med du 'grub/ rgyun du thugs dam la zhugs pa'i thun mtshams rnams su dam pa'i chos 'chad pa nyid la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dbang lung man ngag gi chos thun rigs mi 'dra ba du ma gsungs pa la/ skyo ba dang dub pa'i rnam pa cung zad tsam mi mdzad cing / chos zhu rnams kyis yun ring du sgug sdod byas pa la thugs kyis mi bzod pa'i brtse sems chen pos thugs brel dang snga phyi ci la thug kyang gang 'dod pa'i chos kyi bka' drin stsol/ de lta na'ang thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams la btang 'grus cung zad kyang med pa sogs mdor na bdag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'di'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rmad du byung ba 'di lta bu dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags su bshad de/ bsdud pa tshigs su bcad pa las/ zang zing med par 'gro la chos ni rjes su ston/ /chos la gcig tu dga' zhing rtag tu tshig 'jam ldan/ /'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan/ /gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med/ /gtsang zhing gtsang ma'i gos 'chang gsum po dben zhing dag /snyed 'dod ma yin khyu mchog rtag tu chos 'dod pa/ /bdud kyi g.yul las 'das shing gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog /bsam gtan zhi la bsam gtan bsam gtan der mi gnas/ /dregs pa 'dod pa ma yin khro bos sems dkris med/ /khyim par gyur na rtag tu dngos po kun ma chags/

/'tsho ba'i phyir ni ya ngas longs spyod tshol mi byed/ /drag shugs sbyor sngags mi byed bud med sbyor sngags min/ /'dod pa'i las can pho mor 'gyur zhes ston mi byed/ /rab tu dben pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin mchog brtson/ /'thab dang rtsod dang bral zhing byams pa'i sems dang ldan/ /kun mkhyen 'dod cing rnal 'byor bstan la rtag tu gzhol sems ldan/ /mtha' 'khob kla klo skye bo'i yul mtha' rnam par spangs/ /rang gi lta la dogs med rtag tu ri rab 'dra/ /chos phyir srog kyang 'dor zhing rnam par rab tu brtson/ /mi ldog rtags ni 'di dag yin par shes par bya/ /zhes gang bka' bstsal pa 'di dag bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can 'di la ma tshang ba med par mnga' ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ rnam 'dren mchog khyod rang nyid rang bzhin gyis/ /bgrang yas yon tan kun gyi mdzod 'dzin yang / /rtag tu nga rgyal dregs pa kun spangs nas/ /bla ma la gus 'gro la byams brtser ldan/ /mchog dman skye bo kun la 'grogs bde zhing / /kun gyis bkur yang khengs pa'i dri ma bral/ /chos brgyad nyon mongs go skabs g.yo min pas/ /zhi ba'i thugs kyis gzhan gyi khro ba'ang 'joms/ /mdzes shing zil che nyi 'od 'bar 'dra'i sku/ /snyan zhing brjid chags blang dor ston pa'i gsung / /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /gang gi mdzad pa byis blo'i spyod yul 'das/ /gzhan gyi rnyed dang ma rnyed mgo snyom zhing / /sdug bsngal can rnams sna tshogs thabs kyis skyobs/ /mdzad pa bzang pos ci mdzad bstan 'gro yi/ /don du 'gyur yang rtag tu dman cha 'dzin/ /gang gi mkhyen pa lha yi lam ltar yangs/ /brtse bas nyi zla'i 'od ltar kun la khyab/ /nus pas gzhan gyi nyon mongs sel mdzad pa'i/ /de 'dra'i mdzad pa bzang pos dus kun 'da'/ /lus med lus can kun gyi mchod pa'i yul/ /khyod ni khyod min 'gran zla gzhan med kyang /

/khengs ldan khengs pa'i rlom pa kun spangs pa/ /bsam bzhin bsam pas dad pa lhag par 'phel/ /mgon khyod ma bcos rang bzhin dad pa bzang / /bzang po mthong bas skal bzang kun kyang dad/ /dad pa'i sa bon dge ba'i chu lud tshogs/ /tshogs pas lo tog rang gzhan phan bde'i gzhi/ /e ma khyod ni lung rtogs kyi/ /yon tan lta ci rang bzhin gyi/ /yon tan kho nas gzhan dag las/ /phul du byung de ngo mtshar rmad/ gnyis pa bzang po'i yon tan rmad du byung ba du ma brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ g.yeng med ting 'dzin sgrub la gcig gzhol bas/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i nyams rtogs thugs la 'khrungs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyan gyur mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshon byed dpe dang rtse mo'i ye shes brnyes/ /ma 'ongs mkhyen sogs grub pa'i sar bzhugs pa'i/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar/ de yang zab mo'i yang rtse 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor la brten nas sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing / 'chi 'pho skye ba len pa'i tshul sgrib med du gzigs pa'i bsam gtan bsgoms pa las byung ba'i lha'i mig gi mngon par shes pa thob pa dang lung bstan khyad par can brnyes shing / 'da' kha ma'i rnal 'byor zab mo 'byongs pa rab kyi rtser son pa'i rtags mig ldan kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i tshul ni/ de yang sngon grub chen bud+dha shrī'i drung du rdo rje 'chang gis dbus phyogs kyi gnas skor rnams grub mtshams rje'i drung du byon skabs/ phebs 'phral sku mdun du byon gsungs nas/ dpon slob gnyis ka thugs shin tu dges pa'i ngang nas gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing / lhag par rje rdo rje 'chang gis/ chos rje bud+dha ba la na ning nas thugs dam 'phel po ni byung gda'/

bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa rnams sngar dang khyad ci tsam 'phel/ stong gzugs rnams brtan po bdog gam zhus pas/ stong gzugs khra chil chil de ka sgom khang du bsdad ma bsdad 'dra ba 'dug bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa gzhan de ka la yod gsungs/ cung zad gcig nas zhal 'dzum mdzad nas rdo rje 'chang gi snyan g.yon pa nas phyag gis 'then te gsang gros kyi tshul du gsung chung ngu mdzad nas/ ang ge ang ge na ning ni dge sbyor 'phel po byung bshang gci'i gseb na sems can sogs ye med/ lus la shig med/ dmyal bar song na dga' ste bsam pa yod gsungs/ de dus rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dgongs la ci gsung ba yin nam/ bshang gci'i nang sus kyang g.yeng pa ni med snyam pa byung / sang tho rangs thugs bsam gnang bas/ phar phyin gyi 'grel par/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jig rten las mngon par 'phags pa nyid kyis lus la srin 'bu'i rigs brgya khri mi 'byung ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pas sems gya gyu med pa dang / rnyed pa dang bkur bsti la sogs pa mi lta ba nyid kyi phyag dar khrod pa nyid la sogs pa sbyangs pa'i yon tan yang dag len pa dang / sbyin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par sgrub pas de dag dang 'gal ba/ ser sna dang chags pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa med pa dang / chos thams cad yang dag par sdud pa nyid kyis chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par 'gro ba dang / 'gro ba bdag nyid kyi byas pa nyid kyis gzhan gyi don du dmyal ba 'dod pa zhes bya ba drug dang bcas pa'i gzhung de thugs la dran pas dad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs shing sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes brnyes pa zhal gyis bzhes par go zhing thag chod do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par/ bdag gi bla ma 'di nyid la'ang 'khor lo bde mchog rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen sgrub la bzhugs dus 'di'i yon tan 'khrungs pa yin/ dus phyis ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang chen por chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i skabs shig chos nyan pa mang bas rje'i sku mdun gyi gsol cog na yar chos nyan pas bskyur ba'i shig gcig 'dzegs byung pa gzigs pas/

rje'i gsung las/ shig 'di khyed rnams su'i yin nam/ nged la ni 'khor lo bde mchog rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen pa byas nas bzung lus kyi shig rnams med/ da dung khog pa'i nang na srin 'bu cung zad yod tshod du 'dug ces sgrib g.yogs dang bcas te gsung ngo / /zhes de dus zhabs drung na yod pa'i rnams kyi ngag las thos shing / 'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen pa'i tshul ni bsam gtan phur 'khor lo bde mchog gi rdzogs rim zab mo dpyid thig gi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas de'i dus su rdzogs rim gyi rtags bcu gsal la rdzogs par shar zhing / lhag par gtum mo'i me drod cher skyes nas kha ba chen po babs kyang / rje nyid bzhugs pa'i gzim khang gi thog dang nye 'khor kun la kha ba mi chags pa dang / gsung las kyang / de dus dbyar dgun ston dpyid thams cad mtshan gos gzan rkyang res kyis dros pa yang byas gsungs shing / gzhan yang dus der nyin snang 'dre nus pa'i 'od gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po gong 'phel du song ba'i nyams rtogs kyi bogs bzang po thugs rgyud la 'khrungs gsungs/ lhag par der skabs sbyin bdag ma phyug mo gu rur grags pa zhig 'das nas/ de'i yar 'dren la rje nyid spyan drangs pas/ de dus sbyin bdag ma de gang du skye sogs shes pa tsam byung zhes dad ldan 'ga' zhig la gsungs 'dug cing / yang bsam gtan phu'i bla brang du thugs dam la bzhugs skabs shig khro mo ba zhes pa spyir sdig pa tshabs chen bsags kyang rje nyid la shin tu mos pa'i gang zag cig gling kha dgon pa'i khrod der 'das dus/ snga dro nyi ma shar dros shig gi tshe/ rje'i gzim khang gi sgo mdo phugs gnyis ka 'byed mkhan med pa rang phyer bye nas gzim khang gi nang thams cad sha rul gyi dri 'dra ba zhig gis khengs byung pa zhabs drung na yod pa kun gyi spyod yul du gyur mtshams/ rjes phyag phyi ba rnams la drung du shog cig pa'i phyag dril brda gnang byung 'phral phyin pas/

rje'i zhal nas snying re rje/ khro mo ba 'das 'dug lam ston gyi grabs gyis gsung ba bzhin byas pas/ de ma thag thugs dam 'dogs 'bul mi sleb byung / zhes bden pa'i ngag las thos shing / gang zag de dme kho na byas pa'i sdig can zhig yin yang / 'dren pa dam pa 'di'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis phyis 'brog gseb na mi lus gcig blangs 'dug ces grags so/ /yang mus gnas gsar du spyan drangs nas stong dpon zhal ngo rnams kyi yum byang sems srid 'dren gshegs dus sle lung ya ma rdzong rnams kyi dge 'dun sum brgya tsam gyi dbus su rje 'dis lam ston ngo sprod mdzad pas/ byang rten dngos su 'gul ba la grwa pa yon bdag kun ha las par gyur cing / de skabs kyang byang sems de'i bar srid gzigs par grags shing / gzhan yang rje nyid kyis dbon po rin chen klu dbang la/ khyod nged rang gi nye ba ming 'di zhes bya ba zhig gi skye ba yin gsungs shing / dgon pa'i grwa rigs 'ga' zhig la grwa pa 'di dang 'di rje 'jam dbyangs kyi skabs kyi gang zag 'di zhes bya ba'i skye ba yin gsungs pa dang / zang mkhar sum mdo'i gnas po so nyis rim skyes pa zhig yod pa la/ 'di tshogs bdag gi sprul pa yin las che gsungs shing / ji ltar lung bstan pa bzhin kho rang gi ngo nas bzung grong pa de pa dar rgyas su gyur pa yin la/ dus phyis bdag la bka' drin che ba'i ma cig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo gshegs dus/ rje 'dis lam ston gyi cho ga mdzad skabs kyang bar srid dngos su gzigs pa'i rgyu mtshan yid ches can kho bos mthong zhing / gzhan yang 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du yod do/ /rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams la/ thos bsam nyams len kun mthar phyin pas/ tshe 'das kyi byang bu dngos su 'gul/ /rje yo ga pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin la/

lung bstan khyad par can brnyes pa/ bde mchog rin chen bzhi'i bsnyen sgrub la bzhugs pa'i skabs der mnal lam du mi la ras pa yin zer ba'i mi dkar po zhig byung nas/ khyod lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis na 'chi zer/ de nas gang du skyes gsungs pas/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po zhig gi bur skyes zer byung zhing / de'i sku'i skye ba phyi ma ni rje btsun rin po che dang / chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta sogs kyi rnam thar dang mtshungs pa'i mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa zhig yin mod kyang gsal bar mi gsung ngo / /rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po de yang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig yin par gdon mi za bar snang ste/ de yang sngon rje btsun rin po che dgung lo sum cu so bdun gyi dus slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo bde ba can du gshegs nas ring por ma lon pa'i tshe/ dgung gi tho rangs mnal du song ba la slob dpon rin po che'i gdung gseb nas sbrang po che'i skad lta bu'i sgra bar snang la thon te/ 'di skad ces/ khyod 'di nas byang phyogs su zhing khams dpag tu med pa 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams gser mdog can zhes bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od rnam par brtsen pa zhes bya ba'i bstan pa la da lta 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bsod nams mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ de'i sras 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas zhes bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan khyad par can brnyes pa dang / phyis rje pa nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs par nye ba'i tho rangs kyi cha zhig zhabs drung na rje sa paṇa bzhugs yod pa cung zad mnal ba'i tshe/ mnal lam du bde ba can nas 'ongs zer ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa nam mkha'i ltos khyab pa'i gdung rin po che'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa sna tshogs 'chang bzhin pa kun nas bskor ba/ rin po che dang seng ge'i khri kun nas brjid cing mdzes pa rgya che ba/

rin po che'i rgyan dang / me tog gi chun po du ma nam mkha' la stor zhing 'bab lding ba/ rol mo'i bkod pa dpag tu med pa/ sngon chad blo yul du ma byung ba'i bkod pa chen po dang / gzhan yang dri dang phreng ba dang / rgyal mtshan la sogs pa du ma dang bcas pa chos kyi rje chen po bde ba can du spyan 'dren pa yin zer ba la/ chos rje pas lha'i tshogs de rnams la/ rje pa spyan mi 'dren par gsol ba btab cing bzlogs pa na/ re zhig cang mi smra ba'i tshul gyis de dag 'khod par gyur to/ /de nas chos rje pas rje btsun nyid la bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa na/ rje btsun nyid kyang gshegs pa la spro bar snang ngo / /de la chos rje pas dang po byang phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams gser gyi mdog can du gshegs so zhes gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ de lta mod kyi/ gsar du spyad pa'i las khyad par can 'ga' zhig gis thog mar bde ba can du 'gro zhes gsungs nas/ khyod kyang bde ba can gyi bkod pa la ltos shig ces phyag gis brda sprad pa na/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa dang bai ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la sogs pa bkod pa chen po yid 'phrog pa sogs chos rje pas kyang bde ba can gyi zhing khams rnam par gsal bar gzigs shing / de nas rje pa'i gsung gis re zhig bde ba can du bsdad nas/ de nas byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gser mdog can du sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i cha byad tu byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyong bar byed/ de nas skye ba gsum pa'i lus de la brten nas lus de ma spangs par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob tu re ba yin zhes gsungs par 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi mdzad pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar las 'byung zhing / de bzhin du bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bde bar gshegs khar yang ling chu rtser tho rangs shig dbus su rje btsun chen po/

g.yas su bir+wa pa/ g.yon du nag po pa byon nas gzigs te/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod 'di nas gzhan don la 'gro ba na shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten khams du ma 'das pa'i pha rol tu mkha' la gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa du ma mnyes par byas shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas sa lam rnams phal cher bsgrod de/ de nas rgya gar shar phyogs mu mu ni zhes bya bar rgyal po nyi ma'i stobs 'phel zhes bya ba'i bur skyes nas/ gzhon nu la rtsom pa dang 'chad pa mang po byas mngon par shes pas 'jig rten thams cad la gzigs nas 'khor rigs ldan 'bum phrag du ma grol bar byas nas/ de nas sku tshe 'phos pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal du sangs rgya bar lung bstan/ bir+wa pa dang nag po pa gnyis kyis mthun 'gyur mdzad/ bir+wa pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi la srin lag gi reg ste/ khyod kyi ljags khyong gsungs nas ljags la thig le byas pa'i snang ba byung bas thugs la mi rtog pa'i ye shes khyad par can 'khrungs par bshad pa sogs mdor na rje btsun khu dbon la sku'i skye ba phyi ma 'khor los bsgyur ba dang / de nas ring po ma thogs par mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i lung bstan thob pa dang mthun par bdag gi bla ma 'di yang sku'i skye ba gnyis pa la rig pa 'dzin pa dang 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs par gyur nas/ de nas de ma thag 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa'i lung bstan brnyes par gdon mi za bar shes par bya'o/ /dus phyis rje'i gsung las/ rmi lam du mi la ras pas tshe ha cang mi ring ba dang / de nas rgyal po'i bur skye ba'i lung bstan de bzhin byung tshul rje chos dbang phyug la zhus pas/ rje bla ma'i gsung gis/ sku tshe cung zad thung yang rgyal po'i bur skye ba'i lung bstan gyi mnal lam nan ltar bzang 'dug

'on kyang rgyal po'i bu las da lta'i lus rten 'di snyigs ma'i dus kyi bstan pa dang sems can la phan che bas/ mi rgan gyis sngar su la yang ma byas pa'i bde mchog thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe sgrub 'di 'bul bas tshe sgrub la brtson par mdzod gsungs byung pas/ de dus gnang ba'i tshe sgrub de dang / tshe sgrub gzhan la'ang brtson par byas pas/ phyis lo don gsum dang brgyad cu tsam thub pa'i lung bstan byung ba yin gsung ngo / /gzhan yang na ro mkha' spyod la brten pa'i 'da' kha ma zab mo'i rnal 'byor 'byongs pa'i rtags mtshan kun gyi mngon du gyur pa'i tshul ni/ spyir rje 'di nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i zab bzhes rnams la gtso bor mdzad par grags shing / lhag par mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma la bsam gtan phur lo gcig tsam sku mtshams bcad rgya dam po la bzhugs dus nan tan du mdzad pas/ skabs der 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags rnams rim can du byung nas mthar dbu gtsug nas khrag dang chu ser 'dzag pa sogs kyang byung zhes de dus zhabs drung na yod pa rnams las thos la/ dus de nas bzung ste dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu kha'i thad kyi dbu thod ting phor sgong zhabs chung ba'i tshad tsam pa zhig dbu'i gtsug tor gyi tshul du 'bur du dod cing / de'i thad kyi sku sha'i mdog kyang gzhan las cung dkar ba zhig 'dug pa mig ldan kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa yin la/ dus phyis rje nyid kyi dbu skra bsil ba'i phyag phyi rgyun pa byed pa'i dge slong byams pa dpal zhes pas/ rje'i dbu thod gzhan las 'bur du dod pa 'di sngar med gsar du byung 'dug pa gang gi rtags lags zhus pas/ rje'i gsung las/ 'di 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags yin/ btsun pa la 'di 'dra dgos pa la zhes gsung gi 'dug ces kyang thos la/ yang rje'i dbon po 'ga' zhig la nged kyi thod pa 'bor ba 'di 'pho ba sbyangs nas byung ba yin/

gzhan gyis kyang sbyangs na 'di bzhin yong bas so so nas nyams len la 'bad dgos pa yin zhes gsungs/ mthar gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang 'da' kha ma zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du thogs pa med pa byon pa'i tshul ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /yang snga mo'i dus phyag dpe mang po gzigs rtog sogs thos bsam gtso bor mdzad pa'i skabs shig mnal lam du gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon gnas kyi mdun gyi rje sems dpa' chen po'i rnam rgyal mchod rten chen po de'i steng nas rje nyid kyis nam mkha' la lan gsum 'phur byon pas/ snga ma gnyis la spyan ras gzigs kyi rgya yin zer ba'i dar gyi mdud pa 'dra ba zhig la 'thogs byung pas/ lan rting ma la 'phur byon dus rje sems dpa' chen po la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ sngar gyi rgya de la thogs pa med par nam mkha'i dbyings mthon por byon pas/ 'og min yin zer ba'i baiḍūr+ya las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang rgya khyon blos gzhal bar mi nus pa zhig gi phyi nang steng 'og kun na bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu'i grangs dang tshad med pa bun long long 'dug pa'i khrod na rje rang nyid kyang byon 'dug pa'i thugs kyi gsal snang yun ring po'i bar du byung pas slar sad pa na de'i don la dgongs pas/ sku tshe 'di nyid la zab bzhes la ha cang brtson par ma mdzad na/ da dung mi lus chos ldan gnyis bzhes dgos pa dang / chos dang sems 'dres pa'i rang gi nyams len byung na rang gi lus rten 'di kho nas 'khor ba la phyi phyag byas chog pa'i rtags su go zhes yang yang gsung ba thos pas/ des na rje bla ma 'di ni zab mo'i yang rtse 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam la brten nas sku'i skye ba 'di kho na la spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rnams rdzogs par mthar phyin te/ gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshul ston pa dang mnyam du mchog gi 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa la the tshom dang yid gnyis cung zad kyang mi dgos pa lags/

rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gsal snang bde drod 'bar/ /gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod pha mthar son/ /mkha' spyod du 'pho bas mngon sum gshegs/ /rje bde mchog pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin no/ /gzhan yang dpal kyai rdo rje'i dbang gi chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ma nub par thugs nyams su bzhes pas ngo bo nyid gsum gyi lta ba mthar phyin cing / bskyed rdzogs la brtan pa thob ste snang srid tha mal pa 'di lha dang gzhal yas khang du gzigs pa'i tshul ni/ rje'i zhal nas/ kho bo'i kye rdo rje'i nyams len mdzad pa de dgon pa rdzong du byung bar 'dug ste/ gnas der lam dus nyams su blang pa'i skabs 'gar dag pa dran pa tsam du sleb pa na gnas khang tshoms kyi snang ba de khrig 'gags nas 'gro ba 'dra byung zhes yang yang gsungs shing / nged la nyams rtogs chen po med kyang / lam 'bras nas bshad pa'i ye shes 'jug zlog dum tsam yong gi gda'/ zhes gsungs pas gzhung bshad nas gsungs pa'i nyams rtags rnams rje 'di'i thugs la rdzogs par shar bar mngon no/ /don de nyid kyi phyir/ thun bzhi yi lam la byang chub pas/ /sgrub khang lha sku'i gzhal yas su gzigs/ /ye shes 'jug ldog khor mo yug /rje lam 'bras pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin no/ /gzhan yang zab don nai gu chos drug la brten nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes khyad par can thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa dang / 'od gsal gyis nye ring thams cad sgrib med du gsal bar gzigs tshul ni/ rje'i gsung las/ nged kyis 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i drung du nai gu'i chos skor rnams zhu bzhin pa'i ngang nas bsam gtan phug tu dmigs pa rnams la chig bsgril du byas pa'i skabs shig na/ nam phyed tsam nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ngo mtshar can rgyud la skyes nas sang sgrub khang la nyi ma ma shar gyi bar la ting nge 'dzin de'i ngang la 'byams te/

nyi ma shar 'phral 'jam skol ran par dgongs phyir byon pas/ bsam gtan phu'i ri ra ba khang khyim thams cad za zi ban bun lang long nyams kyi snang ba sna tshogs su gyur nas snang ba bden med du rtogs pa snyam byed pa byung / de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes rtags rung tsam du gda'/ gang zag phyi mar na 'phos bar go /zhes gsungs shing 'di lta bu ni rje sa paṇa gyi man ngag dang sgrub pa'i rgyud 'dzin tshogs grub dbon gsum zhes grags pa'i grub thob yon tan dpal bzang po'i rnam thar dang mtshungs pa ste/ dam pa de nyid kyis chos rje pa'i gzim g.yog lo drug mdzad nas mthar/ kho bo skye ran tsa na skyes/ chos rje pa lta bu dang mjal/ smin ran tsa na smin/ sgrub pa snying por byas/ da 'chi ran tsa na 'chi zhes gsungs shing / 'khor slob rnams la'ang sgrub pa la nan tan gyis/ ma bde ba byung dus nga rang la dris/ sang tsa na za rgyu the tshom las mi yong gsungs ba'i bka' gnang mdzad/ chos rje pa la rtogs pa phul bas/ 'di mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin/ da mtshon bya don gyi ye shes kyang myur du 'char ba gda' gsungs/ 'phags pa rin po che la da bdag gis nyams blang ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ rtag tu lta ba bskyangs shing ting 'dzin gyis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog la yang yang dbang blang zhing / /phyag rgya chen po lam nas 'pho ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu brtson bgyid pa/ /khyed kyi bgyi ba legs pa bdag gis 'khums/ /zhes pa gnang zhing / zab mo mdo lnga'i lung yang 'phags pas gsan no zhes grags pa'i grub thob chen po de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa dang mtshungs par go zhing / gzhan yang bdag gi bla ma 'di'i thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i snod bcud tha mal par zhen pa'i bden 'dzin gyi a 'thas zhig nas nyams snang ting nge 'dzin gyi rol par shar ba 'di lta bu ni sngon chos rje bud+dha shrīs glang lo lam 'bras gsung dus shig man ngag 'di pa'i lugs kyi rjes thob tu ngo bo nyid gsum skyong tshul 'di zab mo rang gcig 'duga'adi ka la dran 'dzin ma chad pa byas tsa na dge sbyor dga' mo zhig yong gin 'dug gsungs/

chos de grol 'phral rje ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis/ rjes thob lam khyer ji ltar mdzad zhus pas/ ngas spros pa tsam ma byas par bsgoms pas/ da rjes thob tu grogs med gcig por bsdad tsa na snang ba thams cad nyams snang 'ba' zhig tu 'char/ de las gzhan du sems g.yo ba gcig mi yong / mi gcig rtsar byung ba'i thug sgra sogs byung tsa na khang khyim la sogs snang ba rang ga ma 'di 'char/ yang cung zad nas nyams snang du 'gro ba zhig byung / de lam 'bras pas ngo bo nyid gsum skyong tshul de ka la nyams len byas pa'i 'bras bur 'dug gsungs/ zhes ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i grub chen bud+dha ba'i rnam thar las 'byung ba dang yang mthun par mngon la/ yang rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa ni/ nai gu chos drug gsan pa'i rmi lam gyi khrid kyi skabs der rje 'dis bsam gtan phu'i sgrub khang du mnal lam bzung nas gling ga dgon pa ma'i bla brang na 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho bzhugs yod pa la mjal bar phebs pas/ bla brang gi sgo mnan 'dug pas/ logs kyi dkar khung la 'dzegs byon pas bla brang gi 'og gzhi rnams me ma mur gyis khengs 'dug pa/ de rnams dkor rdzas su 'dug gsungs shing / de nas rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gzim chung dkar me khra thag ge 'dug pa'i nang du byon nas rje la byin rlabs zhus pas/ rjes bdud rtsi ka pā la gang gnang byung ba gsol ba'i snang ba byung gsungs shing / nang par chos thun zhu bar phebs pas tshogs 'khor la nang mchod cung zad 'dug pa rje btsun spyan snga ba'i bzhes 'phro zhal dkar nas rje nyid la gnang byung bas/ rje 'dis dgongs pa la mdang dgong rmi lam bzung nas yong skabs bdud rtsi gnang byung ba de/ de ring 'di 'ong ba'i rten 'brel du 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs shing / de nas chos zhu ba gzhan rnams gyes pa'i rjes su rje nyid la 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i gsung gis/

mdang nub chos rje shangs pa'i rmi lam sprul bsgyur de bzang byung / da lam gyi nai gu 'di gling kha'i tshogs chen la bshad pa yin kyang / chos rje shangs pa la bshad pa 'dra ba zhig byung gsungs shing thugs dges pa'i gsung gleng du ma zhig gnang byung bas/ rje nyid kyi thugs la nga'i bla ma 'di lkog gyur sgrib med du gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs/ yang rje 'di'i gzim khang dgon pa mar yod pa de'i 'og thog nyen pa na skyon sus kyang ma long pa la/ rje 'dis thog 'di'i skyon 'di na 'dug pas shu 'bub gyis gsungs pas de ji lta ba bzhin 'dug pas/ 'di yang rje 'dis mnal lam bzung nas gzigs par grags pas/ des na dam pa 'dis ni bar do'i gdams pa zab mo la rang dbang thob par the tshom mi dgos pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor ngang nyid nas/ /bla ma dang dag pa'i zhing kun mjal/ /mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes brnyes/ /rje nai gu pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin no/ /yang 'od gsal gyis nye ring med pa sgrib med du gzigs pa'i tshul ni/ spyir rje 'di la yum las 'khrungs tsam nyid nas 'od gsal gyi rgyun bzang po yod par snang ste/ sku gzhon nu'i dus su yang thugs gnyer la brtson par mdzad skabs 'od gsal ngo mtshar can shar ba'i lo rgyus gsungs pa dang / sa skyar phebs skabs dad ldan 'ga' zhig la nged la 'od gsal gyi rgyun cung zad byis pa'i dus na yod kyang / 'dir dkor che bas 'grib 'gro yi 'dug ces gsungs 'dug cing / yang sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying mar gsung ngag gnang ba'i skabs su nyin zhig chos nyan pa bying rnams 'dus mtshams rje nyid gsung shugs chen pos phyag rdeb pa dang g.ya' g.ya' sgrub pa ma de zhes gsung byung bas/ chos nyan pa rnams ci gsung ba yin snyam pa la/ cung zad nas sgrub pa ma rgyal mtshan zer ba de gdong khrag ral nyi le ba dang bcas byung bas/

ci yin dris pas/ chos ma zin dogs rtab rtab tu yong bas sa dkar logs su brdabs pa yin zer byung bas/ chos nyan pa kun na re/ sgrub pa ma brdabs pa rje'i 'od gsal gyis sgrib med du gzigs par 'dug go zhes mgrin gcig tu sgrog cing yid ches pa yin la/ dus phyi'i bsam gtan phur thugs dam la bzhugs skabs gling ga dgon pa mar rje dbon nam bzang dang bsod nams mchog ldan zer ba'i grwa pa zhig 'thab rtsod cung zad byung ba la rje dbon gyis rje'i zhabs drung du phyin pas de ma thag khyed gnyis kyis da rang 'thab rtsod 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba byas a/ zhes gsungs nas de'i tshig rigs rnams kyang ma 'chugs pa gsung byung bas rje dbon shin tu skrag nas gang yang zhu ma nus pa na/ da phyin btsun pa yin pas ngang blo ring dgos zhes sogs gsungs 'dug pa dang / yang dgon pa rdzong du bzhugs dus lam 'bras gnang skabs shig nyin zhig yul shin tu ngan pa byung bas ja khang du gsol tshigs la phebs pa'i skabs shig dge slong sangs rgyam zer ba'i dgon pa'i grwa pa zhig gis phyag dbang zhu bar phyin nas phyag rten la mar ril zhig phul/ byin rlabs zhus pas/ mar ril phyag tu bzhes nas rje'i gsungs las/ mar ril gsum 'dug pa la chung shos 'di khyer yong ba yin ang gsungs byung pas/ dge slong pa phyag 'bul zhing mar ril gsum cis kyang yod la/ 'di chung ba yin/ che ba gnyis kyang rting ma 'bul bsam/ da lam chung ba phul ba lags/ thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs par 'dug zer mchi ma gtong zhing / slar log ste mar ril gnyis po yang khyer byung bas/ rje'i zhal nas/ ngas mngon shes min tshod btab pa mngon shes 'dra ba yong gsung bzhad pa gnang gi 'dug go /zhes thos shing / yang gnas der dus re zhig gi tshe/ dgon par mi shin tu nyung ba'i dben po byung ba'i skabs shig dbu mdzad shes rab lags pa zer ba'i grwa pa zhig gis ja 'debs gnyis btab/

sha brang gcig btsos nas/ ja 'debs gcig bton/ sha btsos pa khyer te sla ye zhig yod par thul pa bting ste gcer bur nyal te ja btung / sha zos/ 'phongs la thal lcag bsnun ngag nas btsun chung shes rab lags pa khyod las skyid pa su yod zer ba sogs bag yangs kyi spyod pa sna tshogs shig byas nas/ de mtshams ja rting ma bton khyer te/ rje'i drung du phyag rten mar gshags zhig dang bcas byin rlabs shig zhu bar phyin pas/ rje bla brang gi yangs steng na zhabs skor gnang gi 'dug par byin rlabs zhus sku gzhogs su bsdad pas/ gsol ja mchod 'phro la dbu mdzad par spyan cer te gzigs nas/ dbu mdzad pad res kyi spyod pa 'di 'dra ma byed gsungs/ dbu mdzad pas ci lags zhus pas/ da ci khyed gcer bur 'dug pa dge slong rgan po zhig gis de ltar byas na dkon mchog thugs khrel 'gro gcig pur sdod na lus la ltos/ /mang po'i khrod du sems la ltos/ /zer ba yin pas de 'dra ma byed gsungs byung bas/ dge slong gi bsam pa la rje'i gzigs pa'i sar de ltar byas pa ni ye rang med/ thugs mkhyen dang 'od gsal sgrib med du mnga' ba la the tshom mi 'dug snyam dge slong shin tu 'jigs/ smra mi shes pa lta bu byung zer ba dus rgyun par rdzun mi zer ba'i gang zag de dag gi ngag las thos so/ /kho bo cag la'ang rje'i gsung las/ nged kyis gling ga'i bla brang der snga mor langs nas nyams len rnams byas pa na/ dar tsam re nas nam ma lang kyang nang 'khor phal cher mthong ba'i 'od gsal skya hod de ba de 'dra rgyun par 'char gyin bdog ces gsungs shing / yang rje chos grwa zur du bzhugs skabs ngos cag dpon slob rnams bla brang chen mor yod pa la/ bya ba spyod lam gang byas thams cad thogs med du mkhyen nas de dang mthun pa'i thugs dam dang slob gnyer byed lugs kyi bka' stsal bslab ston rim pas byung ba mthun snang grub pa yin zhing /

gzhan yang dad ldan 'ga' zhig zhabs drung du 'ong ba na nangs par drung du 'ong ba'i do nub/ rje'i gsung las gang zag 'di 'dra zhes bya ba rta khal sogs 'di lta bu byas rang re'i rtsar 'ong gi 'dug ces 'od gsal gyi ngang nas sgrib med du mkhyen pa na gang bka' bstsal pa bzhin thog tu 'bab pa dang / gzhan yang kho bo cag zhabs drung na yod skabs gang zag 'ga' zhig la 'od gsal yod pa'i gsung gleng byung dus rje'i gsung las/ 'od gsal yod na dag pa'i zhing khams rnams la 'od gsal mched nas lha dang bla ma mang po'i zhal mthong na ngo mtshar chen po yod tshod du gda' zhes gsungs pa sogs gang nas bsams kyang bdag gi bla ma 'di nyin mtshan gyi snang ba 'dre nus pa'i 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad mnga' ba la the tshom cung zad kyang dgos pa ma yin no/ /gzhan yang gzhan sems shes pa dang ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa la sogs pa lkog gyur gyi don sgrib med du gzigs pa'i mngon par shes pa mtha' dag mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs pa'i skabs shig chos rgyal chen po blon 'bangs dang bcas pas nangs shig rje 'di'i sku bstod/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma la 'ga' shig gis bdag bstod yin zhes dang / la la zhig gi gzhan gyi phul ba yin zhes rtsod pa chen po byung bas/ nang par rje'i zhabs drung du chos thun zhu ba la 'tshogs skabs 'phros rkyen gang yang med par rje'i gsung las/ bdag gi bstod pa 'di bdag rang la rje rin chen chos 'phel bas gnang ba lags gsungs byung bas/ mi dbang chen po dpon blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dam pa 'di la thugs mkhyen thogs med du mnga' bar thag chod cing / gzhan yang 'di 'dra'i rigs mang du byung bar grags la/ yang skabs shig byang pa chos rgyal chen po'i yum gyi nang rten la phyag nas mdzad par spyan 'dren mi yong tsam gyi gong du gling ga dgon pa'i grwa pa rags bsdus phyag g.yog 'ga' dang bcas pa la rje'i gsung gis rang re rnams deng sang rab gnas kyi yig cha rnams la lta rtog gyis shig gsungs byung ba la/
