kun gyis gzigs grub mtshams ngam ring nas dpon slob rags bsdus phyag nas la phebs dgos gsung ba'i spyan 'dren pa byung bas/ snga gong de bzhin dgos pa'i snyan 'bul ma byung bas kun gyi mngon mkhyen yin par thag chod cing / yang gser mdog dbon po bsod nams rtse mo dpon slob rnams rje'i zhabs drung du gsung ngag zhu ba la slebs skabs/ rje'i gsung gis/ khyed rnams la 'tshub cha chen po 'dug pas yang na tshe la bar chad byung dogs 'dug yang na nor god chen po yong ba 'dra gsungs shing cung zad thugs 'tshub pa'i rnam pa mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ phyis khams su gser mdog pa dpon slob rnams dgra jag dang thug nas srog thar pa la rab byed dgos pa byung zhes thos shing / yang khams kyi chos rje dgra lha ba la yang zhal gyi rjes gnang gnang dus rten 'brel gyi sgo dang mthun pa'i lung bstan gnang ba de kho na ltar thog tu babs so zhes kyang thos la/ yang sa skya nas chos mdzad nor bu bsam 'phel dang / sku gnyer kun dga' bde legs gnyis kyis rje nyid gling gar bzhugs pa'i zhabs drung du phyin nas slar log 'ongs kar rje'i gsung las/ ding sang dbyar dus yin pas chu shin tu che bas/ khyed rang gnyis mdog chu la zangs kar gyi ko ba la ma 'gro bar nges par bse mkhar chung gi lcags la song zhig ces yang yang gsungs byung bas/ khong gnyis kyis rim pas chu khar slebs pa na/ mi mang po ko ba la 'gro grab byed pa dang thug byung pas/ thog mar de rnams dang lhan gcig tu 'gro bar chas kyang / de 'phral rje'i gsung dran nas lcags skor du phyin pas/ khong rang gnyis kyi mthong sa der sngar gyi ko ba de brdibs nas mi nor thams cad chus khyer song bas/ khong gnyis rje'i gsung la yid ches shing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa yin la/ yang rje 'di nyid dgon pa rdzong gi gdan sar bzhugs skabs sde pa gdong dga' ba'i bla ma mdzad dgos pa'i snyan 'bul dang spyan 'dren yang yang byung ba na/

rje 'di'i zhal bzhes gtan nas gnang ma 'dod pa la phyag phyi ba rnams da lam zhal bzhes gnang na snyam pa tsam byung zhes thos la/ de'i phyis lo gdong dga' ba'i zhal ngo la 'das grong byung ba gsan pa'i tshe/ phyag phyi ba rnams la rje'i gsung gis na ning 'u rang tshos phyin na da lo kha skyengs po mi yong ba 'dug gam zhes gsungs byung bas/ phyag phyi ba rnams kyis shin tu mad lags zhus shing / khong rnams mgrin gcig par rje la thugs mkhyen yod nges shes so zhes sgrog par byed do/ /yang rje 'di ngam ring nas rgyas sder phebs pa'i zhabs drung du bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dpon slob rnams rab byung zhu bar gsang stabs su phebs pa'i nub bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ma chen shin tu na bar byung ba/ nangs par rje 'di la zhu mkhan med par thogs med du mkhyen nas khams bde 'dri bar mdzad byung zhes 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi gsung las thos shing / yang chos rje ka spe bas khong rang gis snga gong byas 'gyur du mtshams rgyun ring byas skabs rmi lam ya mtshan can 'ga' zhig byung ba la/ legs nyes kyi lung bstan rje nyid la zhus pas/ khyed kyi rmi lam byung ba'i go rim rnams nor song / khyed la rmis lam 'di'i rjes su 'di byung 'dug pa ces go rim rnams ma 'khrugs pa gsungs shing legs nyes kyi lung bstan gnang byung bas/ chos rje ka spe ba nyid ha las par gyur to zhes khong rang las dngos su thos la/ yang gling ga chos grwa zur du bdag sogs dad ldan gyi 'gro ba mang po la zab ba dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin stsol ba'i skabs 'khor lo bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid zab mo rnams gnang ba'i dus su nyin zhig gi tshe chos yun thung pa zhig mdzad nas/ rje nyid zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas te chos zhu'i dkyil na gser mdog dbon po zhig yod pa la spyan cher gzigs nas/

de ring gser mdog dbon po ni khams la 'gro ba'i bshom ra kho na byed kyi 'dug gsungs byung pas/ bdag rnams ni de dus ci gsungs pa yin nam snyam pa las ma byung / de rjes chos grwa'i phyir slebs 'phral gser mdog dbon po rang dang 'phros byung pas/ kho na re/ de ring nged la khams la 'gro ba'i rnam rtog kho na 'gyus nas dmigs khrid gang byung yang ma shes pa/ de rje rin po ches mkhyen par 'dug ces zer byung bas thams cad 'jigs shing ha las par gyur to/ /yang de dus 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang gnang skabs de'i phyag len la maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon dkar pos 'khor lo dang yi ge 'bri ba gcig dang / pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'bri ba'i lugs gnyis 'dug pas 'di gnyis gang dag gi dogs dpyod zhu ba'i rtog pa bdag gi blo la shar 'phral/ rje nyid gsung 'phro gzhan zhig bcad nas bdag la spyan cher gzigs te/ 'di'i phyag len 'di la rje spyan snga ba yang 'di bzhin mdzad cing / pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'bri ba 'di dag go zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas gsungs byung bas shin tu dad cing / 'di'i phyag len 'di la dogs dpyod cig zhu dgos snyam pa yod pa la/ zhu ma dgos par gnang ba bka' drin che zhus shing / sems la bla ma sangs rgyas 'di lta bu dang mjal ba re dga' snyam pa byung la/ 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du yod mod/ 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /yang bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'dis dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag zab mo rnams la sgos su thugs dam nyams bzhes gnang ba'i tshul ma bstan kyang sbyor ba yan lag drug nas bshad pa'i nyams rtags rnams rdzogs par thugs la shar ba zhig yin te/ de yang sngon grub thob u rgyan pa la chu bo sin+dhu'i 'gram gnam sa go log 'gyur ba'i nyams shar ba'i lo rgyus 'byung ba de dang 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams rtags ngo mtshar can 'ga' zhig bdag gi bla ma 'di'i thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i tshul sba bsri med par ngos cag la gling ga chos grwa zur du bka' stsol bar mdzad pa de nyid kyis mtshon te shes pa yin la/

'di ni sngon grub chen bud+dha shrīs gsung ngag rin po che lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi de kho na nyid la blo zhog pa la yun ring du chig bsgril du mdzad pas/ sbyor drug nas bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams rtags rnams shar ba'i tshul rje bud+dha ba rang gi rnam thar las bshad pa dang 'dra bar shes nas 'di skad ces bstad do/ /sngon byon gyi grub thob bud+dha bzhin/ /bde kye yi lam la rab gzhol bas/ /sbyor drug gi nyams rtags thams cad rdzogs/ /rje dus 'khor ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang shugs 'byung du gsol ba btab pa lags so/ /gzhan yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i khrid rje spyan snga ba la gsan pa'i tshe yang so so'i dmigs rim rnams la thun du bcad nas nan tan du sgom par mdzad pas/ sgyu lus dang rmi lam 'od gsal sogs kyi nyams rtags rnams gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par nges te/ dus phyis bdag sogs don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor gsang 'dus kyi chos skor rnams gsung pa'i khrid kyi skabs rnams su/ rje'i gsung las/ de bzhin du sgom mdzod dang nyams skye lugs 'di bzhin du 'ong ba yin zhes sogs rang nyid kyi thugs nyams la shar ba rnams thol byung du gsungs nas/ yang de ma thag de sgrib pa'i phyir/ bla ma gong ma rnams la de ltar byung tshod du gda' zhes yang yang gsung ba zhig 'dug pas/ de dag gi don la bsams pas/ rje nyid kyi thugs la gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid kyi nyams rtags rnams rdzogs par shar ba'i yid ches khyad par can rnyed pa yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ rigs brgya dang rigs gcig gi rnal 'byor 'byongs/ /rdor bzlas dang dben gsum mtha' ru phyin/ /sgyu lus dang 'od gsal la zung 'jug brnyes/ /rje gsang 'dus pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod do/ /gzhan yang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bstan cing /

sprul pa dang yang sprul du mas 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'bad med du bsgrubs shing rdo rje 'chang chen po 'di'i bka' las nam yang mi 'da' bar bran bzhin du 'khol ba'i tshul ni/ rje nyid dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis su phebs pa'i glang gi lo kho bo cag zhabs drung du slebs pa yin la/ de yang ngos cag rnams nangs par zhabs drung du slebs rgyu'i do nub rje dam pa 'dis 'od gsal gyi ngang nas kho bo cag dang mjal lo zhes gsungs pa'i tshul rgyas pa ni 'og tu 'chad la/ skabs der dpal rdo rje nag po chen po nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa'i tshul ni/ ngos cag dpon slob rnams zhabs drung du sleb rgyu'i snga char/ gling ga'i byang 'dren dge slong byams pa dpal dang rje dbon klu dbang / rje dbon sangs dar sogs drung na gnas pa rnams la/ rje'i gsung las/ mdang bla brang 'dir nged rang zhabs drung dang yang mjal zhing / lhag par bla ma rab rim gzim mal 'di na gur gyi mgon po yang sngar las gzi brjid bkrag mdangs che zhing na bza' sogs kyang zab pa byas byon 'dug ces gsungs shing dges dges du ma mdzad kyin 'dug ces thos la/ de ltar gong du bkod pa ltar gyi gsung gi tshig rigs la dpags na de gong nas kyang bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du yang yang gzigs pa la the tshom mi dgos par snang zhing / yang bsam gtan phur bzhugs pa'i skabs shig na dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis kyang gzim phug gi nang der gar stabs ling ling byon byung pas/ sku shin tu che bas thog dpangs la mi gshong ngam snyam dgongs pa la/ rtsig pa dang thog sogs la thogs med du thal thal 'byon gyin 'dug gsungs pa dang / yang lan cig sku mdun na a tsa ra mang po gros byed kyin 'dug gsungs/ rje dbon gyis de ci lags zhus pas/ nai gu'i chos skyong ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas rnams kyi sprul pa rnams yin par 'dug gsungs shing /

gzhan yang rje nyid dpal sa skyar phebs pa'i skabs su sgo rum nang so sogs bstan srung mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe na yang rtags mtshan ngo mtshar can du ma byung ba rnams ni 'og tu 'chad la/lhag par kha'u'i brag rdzong du phebs nas nyi ma gsum gyi bar la mchod gtor rgya chen po mdzad pas de'i nyi ma dang po'i nyin gtor tshogs kyi steng gi nam mkha' la ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba zhig 'dug pa mngon sum du gzigs pa dang / nyi ma bar pa'i nyin 'phags pa brag phug na thugs dam la bzhugs dus bar snang la bram ze dkar po zhig phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa mngon sum du gzigs gsungs shing / de ltar chos skyong bram ze'i gzugs can nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa'i skabs der/ gzigs snang khyad par can gzhan yang du ma zhig 'byung bar mngon la/ de ltar zhing skyong dregs pa'i gtso bo gdong bzhi mthu rtsal can 'di ni/ rje nyid la sa skya pa'i chos skyong gzhan rnams las kyang lhag par 'go ba yin te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i bstan dgra bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gis rje'i thugs rgyud dkrugs pa'i tshe yang / gsung shugs chen po dang bcas pas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ dam nyams bstan dgra 'di zhes bya ba zhal du bzhes shig ces pa gsungs shing phyag dang phyag phreng rdeb pa sogs mdzad byung pa na/ dmigs yul de lo zla ma 'gyangs par rtags 'byung bar myong bas grub cing yongs su grags pa yin la/ yang skabs 'gar rje nyid dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i slob bu 'ga' zhig 'das pa na yang / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ nga'i mi chung re re gnyis bdag gnyer yang mi yongs ba zhes gsung shugs chen pos chos skyong nyid la bka' bkyon pa'i tshul du ma mdzad pa yang yin no/ /zhes drung na gnas pa rnams las thos so/ /mdor na rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa 'di nyid bdag gi bla ma 'di dang mi dang mi lab pa'i tshul gyi bran bzhin du 'khol ba'i rnam par thar pa mang du yod kyang 'dir chos skyong gnyan pas 'bri ma nus so/

/gzhan yang sa skya pa'i chos skyong mthu rtsal can rnams bka' las mi 'da' ba bran bzhin 'khol ba'i tshul ni/ rje nyid gling ga bde ba can gyi gdan sar phebs nas ha cang yun mi ring ba zhig na tshogs chen gyis gsol ba btab nas zab don nai gu chos drug gi khrid gnang ba'i tshe/ de'i tshogs 'khor gyi yo byad 'ga' zhig spus dkon tsam byung ba la/ skabs der 'brog gzhon zhig gis sha stobs che ba rje nyid la phul pas shin tu dges shing khrid zhu rnams la'ang tshogs 'khor rgya chen mdzad ces thos la/ de nas 'brog pa de log phyin pa'i lam du ru tsho mi gcig pa'i ngan pa 'ga' zhig gis bcom nas slar 'brog pa de rje'i zhabs drung du log byung nas smre sngags du ma zhu yin 'dug pa la rje nyid thugs khros te gsung shugs chen pos chos skyong rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing / nga'i yon bdag 'di la gang min byed mkhan de tsho la rtags dang mtshan ma da ltar nyid du ston cig ces gsungs shing phyag phreng rdeb pa mdzad byung pas/ zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyang 'jigs shing skrag nas skad mi thon pa tsam byung zhes thos la/ de nas yun ring ma lon par sngar gyi chom po rnams gnas pa'i thod kyi brag don med du zhig nas phyugs ma rnams 'ur zhing brag 'gyel ba dang / chom po byed mi la brag chen po zhig phog ste rtags mtshan drag po de lta bu mngon sum du byung ba dang / yang gling gar mus stong dpon dang dbon po kun dga' lhun grub sogs mched grogs 'ga' zhig la dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur gyi mgon po'i man ngag srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i phyi khrid zhal shes dang bcas pa gnang dus/ ljags lung la sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog gi ljags lung gnang bas/ bran bdud pho mo'i gtor chog gi thad du slebs pa dang rlung 'tshub chen po zhig langs te bla brang yom yom byed pa tsam byung bas/

rje 'di nyid lta stangs kyi ngang la cung zad kyang mi g.yo bar bzhugs 'dug pas/ de ma thag rlung zhi song ba dang / rje nyid kyis rlung drag po gsum 'bud pa gnang rjes/ gsung las/ bran bdud 'di la rjes gnang zhig dgos pas/ de ma byas par 'di'i lung byas pas kho ma dga' zer ba yin pa 'dug gsungs byung bas/ mus stong dpon sogs sku gzhogs na yod pa thams cad la mthun par lus kyi phung byed pa'i zil chen po mi bzod pa lta bu byung zhes pa khong rang rnams las dngos thos pas/ 'di ni las kyi gshin rje nag po yab yum gyi gdug rtsub kyi cho 'phrul/ rje 'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan nas bran du bkol ba la the tshom mi dgos par mngon zhing / yang skabs shig gling ga bla brang du rje dpon slob rnams mi bzhugs pa'i skabs zhig na/ ngan pa gcig gis rkun ma tshabs chen byas pa la rje 'di shin tu thugs khros pa'i tshul gyis chos skyong mthu rtsal can rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing / rkun ma ngan pa de da ltar nyid du rtsad chod cig ces gsung shugs chen pos gsungs shing phyag rdeb pa sogs mdzad byung pa na/ de 'phral bla brang gi tshoms kyi mthong gar bya rog gcig babs byung pa la/ khyod kyang chos skyong gi sprul pa gcig yin yong / rkun ma ngan pa'i rjes la rgyugs shig ces gsung gin 'dug go zhes thos la/ de 'phral rje dbon sogs zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyis rta bzang po dang bcas phyogs bzhir kha bkram nas btsal bas/ rkun ma de rta mo shar phyi phu'i grog phugs su slebs pa na/ kho rang gi bsam pa la da nga do nub mtshan 'gros byas thag ring po zhig tu sleb pa 'gro snyam pa'i tshe/ glo bur du bya rog cig byung nas phyogs gang la phyin kyang gshog lcag kho na brgyab byung pas/ 'dir sdod zer ba yin snyam bsdad pas nam langs mtshams rje dbon rnams der slebs nas dngos po thams cad gyar med du phyag tu 'byor 'dug pa 'di lta bu'i mthu rtsal ni sngon gyi rje btsun sa skya pa'i gong ma rnams dang /

sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras sogs skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig la byung bar grags kyi/ gzhan tshe gang ngan sngags kho na 'dren pa la nan tan du byas pa'i mthu rtsal chen por rlom zhing grags pa phal cher la 'di lta bu byung ba mthong ba'am thos pa med do/ /yang snga gong gi dus shig rje nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bka' bzhin thub bstan rnam rgyal du rje byams pa rab brtan pa'i drung du mgon po'i chos skor rnams gsan par phebs dus bar lam kun la chos skyong gi sprul pa bya nag gnyis kyi bskyel bsu kho na byed pa yang byung pa dang / yang dus der chom po 'ga' zhig gis rje dpon slob rnams bsgugs ra byas pa mkhyen nas/ rje 'dis chos skyong la gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol mdzad nas byon pas/ chom po rnams grog gting du bza' btung bya ba'i bar la rje dpon slob rnams nyes med du phebs pas/ phyis rje'i gsung gis/ nged kyis gtor 'bul tsam byas pas kyang chom po'i 'jigs pa las dngos su bskyabs pa sogs chos skyong 'di rnams byin rlabs dang mthu rtsal gzhan las mchog tu che ba yin no/ /zhes bstod bkur bsngags gsum du ma mdzad pa yin la/ gzhan yang bsam gtan phur bzhugs pa'i dus shig chos skyong gi sprul pa a tsa ra'i cha lugs can gyi mi 'ga' zhig bro byed pa mngon gsum du gzigs nas rje nyid kyang thugs nyams 'ur te de rnams dang lhan gcig tu bro mdzad nas/ slar gzim phug tu byon te/ da res kyi chos skyong gi sprul pa de rnams e 'dug gzigs pas/ de nas kyang gzim phug gi 'gag de ka na 'dug ces gsungs shing / de rnams ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sprul pa'i 'khor du 'dug gsungs/ yang gsung las/ nged la lung bstan phal cher ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis byed kyin 'dug ces dad ldan gyi bu slob 'ga' zhig la gsungs pa las brgyud de thos la/

tshul 'di ni rje bla ma 'di zab lam nai gu chos drug gi yang nyams rtogs kyi mnga' bdag chen por bzhugs pas na/ de'i chos skyong gis 'phrin las bsgrubs par snang ngo / /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir/ snang grags rig gsum gyi chos 'di kun/ /lha sngags ye shes su rtag gzigs pas/ /bka' srung chos skyong rnams bran bzhin 'khol/ /rje mthu rtsal gyi mnga' bdag la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin no/ /gzhan yang dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi man ngag thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrubs pa'i dmar po skor gsum gyi nang tshan ku ru kul+le dang tshogs kyi bdag pos kyang rje nyid la zhal dngos su bstan cing 'phrin las du ma sgrub pa'i lo rgyus yod la/ nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyis kyang bka' las mi 'da' bar rje nyid la gang dgos pa'i mthun rkyen rnams sgrub par snang ste/ rje'i gsung las/ dbyug gu ma'i man ngag 'di shin tu zab pa yin/ nged grwa rkyang gi dus bde mchog gi sgrub pa la yod skabs/ nyin gcig mtshams g.yog pa de la/ khyod gang 'dod kyin 'dug dris pas/ bdag sha mar bzang po 'dra byung na bsam gda' lags zer byung pas/ de'i nub mo nged kyis dbyug gu ma'i sngags bzhi brgya tsam bgrang skabs/ nangs par nged la sha mar ster mi zhig khug shog zer ba byas pas/ de'i sang nyin yon bdag cig gis glo bur du sha mar stobs che ba ster mi byung zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang nor sbyin dzam+bha la dmar pos rje nyid kyi gsol ja'i zhabs tog sgrub pa'i dad ldan gyi bu slob bkug pa'i tshul sogs ni 'og tu 'chad la/ phyis bsam gtan phur nyid kyi gsung las/ dus phyis dzam dmar dang dbyug gu ma sogs la dge sbyor rtse gcig byed pa la so ma sod pa las mi 'dug snyam nan tan cher ma byas/ zhes gsungs shing / mdor na rje btsun sa skya pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrubs pa'i lhag pa'i lha khyad par can rnams kyis rje nyid la 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan pa yin la/

gzhan yang bka' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gcod kyi zab khrid kyi sgo nas gzhi bdag gdug pa can dam la btags shing / stobs ldan gyi 'byung po gnas spar ba dang / gzugs med rnams kyis phyag dang bsu ba dang / mchod pa'i yul dam par gyur pa kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i tshul ni/ de yang rje nyid rdzong dga' ldan rtse'i gdan sa la phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul mus gnas gsar gyi mi dbang dpon blon rnams kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i tshe/ zhal gyis bzhes nas spyir rdzong gi gzhi bdag 'di shin tu 'tshub cing / lhag par gdan sa pa rim pa mang pos dbang khrid sogs chos tshan che ba 'chad pa du ma la chos de mthar mi phyin pa'i bar chad yang yang yong ba zhig yod 'dug pa la dgongs nas/ rje 'di nangs par dgon pa rdzong du phebs pa'i do nub ma cig pa'i lugs kyi sa 'dul gyi dmigs pa zhig mdzad pas mnal lam du ban gzugs ma rungs pa 'ga' byung nas/ de rnams kyis rje'i bzhugs khri bar snang du btegs te bskor ba sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byas byung gsungs shing / de nas rdzong du phebs te thog mar gcod khrid 'dzugs par mdzad pa na/ khrid tshugs nas zhag kha yar song ba'i nub cig mtshan gung gi cha la dgon pa rdzong gi nye skor gyi lung pa thams cad du 'bod kyi sgra chen po lhang lhang gis gang ba dgon par bzhugs pa'i grwa pa rnams dang nye skor gyi skye bo kun gyis thos pas/ nangs par rje nyid kyi drung du mdang nub de bzhin byung ba gang lags zhus pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i gzi brjid gdug 'dre tshos ma bzod tshod du gda' zhes gsungs shing / de nas gnas der gsung ngag lam 'bras gnang bar mdzad pas/ de'i snang gsum gyi khrid ma grol gyi bar du gzhi bdag de'ang chos zhu ba la byung zhing / sngags lam tshugs nas mi yong ba de srung 'khor bsgoms pas yin pa 'dra gsungs/

de phyin chad dgon pa rdzong gi gdan sa pa thams cad la chos gang 'chad kyang bar chad mi 'byung bar mthar phyin pa ni rje 'di'i byin rlabs dang thugs rje rmad du byung ba'i bka' drin las byung ba kun la grags pa yin zhing / yang sa skyar phebs skabs shig lha khang bla brang du kye rdor sgrub mchod cig gi rdo rje slob dpon mdzad pa'i tshe/ lha khang chen mo'i zur spe rig 'dzin pho brang du rje 'di'i bzhugs yul gnang bas/ sa phyogs de gnas reng gi rnam pas shin tu 'tshub pa zhig 'dug pa la/ ma gcig gi sbyin gtong dkar 'gyed cig mdzad pas nangs par de nas 'jam nyal gyis song zhes gsungs shing / stobs ldan gyi 'byung po gnas spar ba'i tshul ni/ rje 'di gdan sa chen por phebs dus bde chen gling gi bla brang du bzhugs skabs/ nub cig mnal lam du nam mkha'i mthong na khra zhig gshog 'gyur ling gi 'dug pas de ma thag rje rang gi dbu thog tu gzhung nas mchu sder brdeg pa'i tshul byas byung 'phral/ rje nyid kyis yi dam gyi nga rgyal bzung pas khra de yal song zhing / mnal sad pa dang nyid kyi thugs la 'di na sngar gyi gdan sa rnying pa rnams la yang bar chad byed pa'i 'byung po zhig yod 'dug kyang / rje rang la glags mi rnyed pa 'dug snyam pa 'khrungs shing / de nas ha cang mi ring ba zhig na bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyi sku 'khor ma chen bkras rtse pa rkang pa na bas rkyen byas/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum sus kyang 'dul bar ma nus pa'i jo bo shar par grags pa'i stobs ldan gyi 'byung po des gnod pas shin tu na ba dos drag po byung ba la/ bla ma lha rje gang gi yang byin rlabs dang bcos khas ma phan pa la/ sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung gis/ rje mus chen nyid la tshe dbang zhig zhus na legs pa'i lung bstan gnang ba la brten nas ma chen ma bu gnyis la rje 'dis tshe dbang zhig stsal/ gdon gyi skyon yin pa mkhyen nas bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs shig mdzad pas/

ma chen nad pa de dran med du brgyal nas 'gyel song bas/ ma des shi song zer nas ngu yi 'dug pa la rje 'dis yon chab kyi chu zhig gdong pa la gtor ba mdzad pas/ kho langs byung nas mchi ma gtong zhing / nga mgo na nas deng sang bar dran pas ma zin 'dug da lta gang byas pa yin zer smre sngags du ma zhig 'don bzhin 'dug go zhes kun la grags so/ /skabs der rje 'dis phyag mdud cig gnang nas/ da nad kyis gcig kyang skyon pa mi yong zhes lung bstan pa bzhin 'phral du nad las grol ba kun gyi mngon sum du gyur cing / de nas rje 'dis lan gcig mus phyogs su byon nas slar gdan sar phebs pa na/ sngar nas rje nyid la shin tu mos pa'i gdan sa chen po'i chos las pa chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal du grags pa de/ der skabs kyang rje 'di yang yang mjal du byung ba la/ chos rje khong sngar bas sku mdangs dang gsung dpang dma' ba sogs 'o brgyal nyams che ba zhig 'dug pa la/ rje 'dis gsung gis/ chos rje las chen pa khyed da lam sngar las sku mdangs sogs lod pa 'dug pa/ snyung ba bzhin ma byung ngam gsungs pa na/ chos rje khong shin tu ngo gnong ba'i rnam pas/ bdag na ba zhig ma byung na'ang / bdag tsho la mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i pho lha zhig yod pa/ na ning bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ma chen la rje rin po ches byin rlabs gnang bas/ skabs der ma chen dran med du brgyal 'dug pa/ de dus bdag tsho'i lha de tshe 'phos nas/ de phyin bdag tsho'i nye 'brel rnams dang gdul bya'i rgyun sogs cung zad lod du song ba yin/ zhes zhus 'dug pa rje'i zhabs drung du yun ring bsdad pa rdzun mi zer ba dag gi ngag las thos so/ /de ltar rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug 'dis gnas spor ma mdzad pa'i sngon du jo bo shar par grags pa'i 'byung po gdug rtsub shin tu che bas gdan sa chen po'i skye bo drag zhan phal cher gyis sku rten 'dzugs pa dang lha mchod sogs la 'bad dgos pa zhig yin na'ang /

deng sang ming tsam mi grags pa 'di ni shin tu yid ches shing ngo mtshar ba'i gnas rmad du byung ba yin no/ /chos rje las chen pa der 'byung po 'dis mthun rkyen bsgrubs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ chos rje de'i yab ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin pa la/ lan gcig sa skya'i phu'i ri ldebs shig la phyin pas mtshan mo'i rigs la yang me 'od khrom khrom yong ba zhig 'dug pa ci yin snyam pa la/ nyin gcig de phyogs su phyin pas sngar mthong ma myong ba'i btsun pa zhig dang 'phrad byung ba/ khyed su yin dris pas/ nged jo bo shar pa zer ba zhig yin/ nged rgyal rtse'i sku gnyer yon tan can zhig yin pa la/ nged la gzhan gyis phra ma bcug ste/ sde srid kyi btsun mo dang gtam cha zhig byung bas/ gong nas bka' bkyon phog pas/ nged kyi rgyal rtse pa'i sde pa rnams la smon lam log pa btab pa'i rkyen byas 'drer skyes te jo bo shar par grags la/ de nas rgyal rtse pa'i sde pa gdung rabs rnams bcad rjes/ sa skyar 'phos nas yong ba yin pas/ da rang re gnyis kha dan byed pas/ nged la 'dir sdod gnas shig bzos/ rten gsol gyis shig khyod kyi mi brgyud la phan thogs chen po yong zer yal song bas/ chos rje las chen pa'i yab khong gis kyang de bzhin byas pas/ khong rang mi brgyud mi nor dang bcas pa la phan thogs chen po byung bar grags so/ /dus phyis rje'i gsung gis/ nga'i bsam pa la gdan sa chen por nad pa ma bu la byin rlabs byas dus der sa skya pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi mthu rtsal dang byin rlabs la brten 'byung po de tshe'i dus byas 'dug pa snying re rje bsam smon lam gang yong rang byas zhes gsungs so/ /'di lta bu'i rnam thar la so skye dag yid gnyis skye ba srid kyang / de ltar dgos pa ma yin te/ de yang ngo bo sar gnas yin yang / rnam pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshul bzung ba rnams ma gtogs/

gzhan smon lam log pa sogs kyi mtshams sbyor las byung ba'i 'byung po rnams ni stobs ji ltar che yang rang rang gi 'phen byed kyi las ji tsam yod pa de rdzogs pa dang / rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs kyi byin rlabs la brten tshe 'phos te mtho ris kyi lus rten sogs su skye ba chos nyid yin pas/ des na jo bo shar par grags pa de yang rje 'di'i byin rlabs dang las 'brel smon lam gyi dbang zhig gis skabs der tshe 'phos par sems la/ ci ste der skabs kyi 'byung po de dngos ma yin yang de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i gdug pa can 'jig rten ma rungs par byed pa'i stobs ldan gyi 'byung po zhig yin par gdon mi za bas/ gang ltar shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang gzugs med rnams kyi phyag dang / bsu ba dang / mchod pa'i yul du gyur pa'i tshul ni/ gling ga'i nub rong chu tshan gyi gzhi bdag ma de sngon rje sems dpa' chen pas bzhugs dus chab la phebs skabs sbrul chen po zhig tu sprul nas yang yang phebs bsu la yong ba zhig yod 'dug pa la/ rje sems dpa' chen pos phyag brkyangs pa na sbrul de 'khril nas chibs thog de kar chab tshan du nam phebs bar dges dges mdzad nas bsnams pa zhig yod pas/ lan cig sbrul gyi 'jug ma chibs pa'i rmig 'og tu shor nas bcad pa na/ de phyin chad gzhi bdag ma de sbrul mjug rdum pa zhig tu sprul nas phebs bsu la 'ong ngo zhes grags pa bzhin/ bdag gi bla ma 'di la'ang nub rong gi chab la phebs re bzhin du chab nas mda' rgyang re tsam gyi bar du sbrul mjug rdum pa de rgyun du phebs bsu la 'ong ba zhabs drung na gnas pa kun gyis snyod med du mthong ba yin zhing / sbrul de byung ba'i tshe rje'i gsung las/ yang gzhi bdag ma de bsu ba la byung ngo zhes kyang gsungs zhes thos la/ yang sa skyar phebs pa'i dus gcig rje btsun rin po che'i sgrub gnas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong mjal ba la phebs dus sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gzim mal gyi shul du rje 'di nyid kyis nub gcig gnas 'brel mdzad nas mtshan gang de la bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin bzang po la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas sa yul de sngon sngags 'chang chen pos bstan dgra lha sa rdzong pa la las sbyor drag po mdzad pa'i gnas yin pas cung zad rtsub 'gyur gyi rnam pas nam stod nas bzung thor mgo ma zin gyi bar la 'ur sgra dang tsheg sgra brag zhig pa lta bu dang /

mi mang po g.yang la bskyur ba lta bu sogs rtsub 'gyur sna tshogs byung bas/ rje nyid kyis ya nga ba dang bag tsha ba cung zad kyang med par ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas/ tho rangs kyi cha zin pa tsam na byas 'gyur gyi gzhi bdag rnams mi dpon gyi cha lugs su byas nas rje nyid la phyag dang / bskor ba dang / 'bul ba rgya chen po byed pa la byung bas/ de ltar gzhi bdag dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ nangs par dgon pa'i gdong gi ru sib nas yon bdag mang po 'bul ba bzang po khyer nas mjal ba la byung gsung ngo / /gzhan yang 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du snang yang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir/ spros bral gyi lta ba'i phu thag chod/ /mi phod thog brdzis kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /'byung po stobs ldan kun dam la btags/ /rje gcod yul ba chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes kyang bstod pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ gang gi thugs rgyud gzhan las rmad byung ngo mtshar yon tan tshogs/ /grangs med bgrangs pa'i yul las 'das mod de lta na'ang / /gzhan ngor kun dang thun mong min pa'i rnam par cha/ /cung zad bshad la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod/ /ches zab yang rtse 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i ting 'dzin g.yul bshams te/ /phyi nang srin 'bu'i dgra sde kun bcom nas/ /rtse mo'i ye shes mchog gi rgyal srid bzung / /'chi 'pho skye ba len pa'i 'khrul 'khor dag /sgrib med gzigs pa'i lha mig mngon shes kyis/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i gar gyi rol rtsed la/ /dman pa'i 'gro ba'ang gcig tu yid rab chags/ /bla ma mchog dang yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dbyer med rab tu dges pa'i zhal gyi lung / /rmad byung sngon gyi dam pas gang brnyes pa'i/ /de lta'i rnam thar rjes su bsnyegs 'di mtshar/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo'i bum bzang las 'ongs pa'i/

/chig brgyud 'pho ba'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /tshim par myang ba'i dga' bde'i lus 'gyur la/ /mig ldan kun kyang mtshar ba'i gtam du gleng / /gzhan yang dges mdzad rdo rje'i zab mo'i lam/ /chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /tha mal rtog pa 'gags pa'i bskyed rim gyis/ /gsal snang yun du brtan pa'i dga' ston thob/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro dpal ldan nai gu ma'i/ /gsang tshig rdo rje'i don la mnyam bzhag pas/ /rgyal dbang mchog gzigs dam pa'i yon tan nyid/ /mtshon pa'i rmad byung yon tan thugs su chud/ /lam de'i zab gnad rmi lam rnal 'byor la/ /gcig tu 'grus pas grub pa'i rtser son cing / /dri med 'od gsal zla ba rab rgyas pa'i/ /snang ba'i chos kun sgrib med gsal bar gzigs/ /gzhan yang gzhan sems shes dang ma 'ong pa'i/ /mngon par mkhyen pa'i yon tan mdzod bzung nas/ /kun kyang mi phyed dad pa'i dpal bskyed pa/ /'di ni skal bzang yongs kyi dga' ston yin/ /rab brjid 'jigs rung du ba stong gis 'khyud pa'i sku ni 'bar ba'i rta gdong me dang 'grogs gyur cing / /hūm̐ phaṭ 'jigs rung gnam lcags sgra las ljags kyi phreng ba dmar 'od glog gi theg pa g.yo ba can/ /drag po khros pa'i mthar byed zhal gyi mche ba'i myu gu zla ba phyed pa stong phrag cher gtsigs shing / /nyi zla'i mdangs 'phrog spyan gsum 'bar bas bgegs rnams 'thag mdzad dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po dang / /'dod khams dbang phyug nam gru ma ste zhing skyong gdong bzhi dregs pa'i tshogs dang rgyun du lhan cig rol/ /'phrin las sgrub pa'i las kyi pho nya pu tra la sogs bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /dngos dang sprul pa yang sprul du mas rje btsun bla ma gang gi bka' las nam yang mi 'da' ba/ /'di ni mthu ldan cher rlom kun gyi 'gran zla bral ba'i rmad du byung ba'i ngo mtshar rnam thar yin/

/gzhan yang pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs chags dpal chen tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /rgyal ba'i thugs kyi ye shes las sprul nor gyi lha mo dbyug gu mched/ /byu ru'i mdangs 'phrog dzam+bha la sogs dpal ster nor lha du ma yang / /rje btsun khyod kyi 'phrin las sgrub la rtag tu brtson pas brel zhes thos/ /gzhan yang phar phyin dbu ma'i lam gyi bcud/ /zab mo gcod kyi nyams len mthar phyin te/ /dregs ldan du mas 'dul bar ma'i nus pa'i/ /stobs ldan 'byung po 'ga' yis srog snying phul/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rnam shes chos dbyings spar/ /la la phyag dang bsu ba rnyed bkur sogs/ /rnam 'gyur du mas rtag tu 'dud par byed/ /e ma ngo mtshar gtam mang brjod mi lang / /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /dus mthar bshes gnyen tshul bzung nas/ /dus na skye bo 'dul dka' la/ /dus dang 'tshams pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gang la gang 'dul thabs du mas/ /kun kyang kun tu chos la spyod/ /bla med bla ma'i mdzad pa 'di/ /shes shing shes nas spro ba 'phel// //drug pa bzang po'i yon tan las 'phros te sa bcu'i byang sems chen po bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul bar gdon mi za ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar bdag gi bla ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi mnga' bdag 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gyi cha shas rags pa tsam yang bskal pa'i bar du rang re so so skye bo dag gis ma lus pa brjod par nus pa ma yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang sems mthong lam pa zhig la'ang yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dang ldan par gsungs na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po nyid kyi rnam par sprul par yang dag pa'i nges pa'i shes pa dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ de yang rje bla ma 'di nyid ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa nyid yin par yid gnyis dang bral ba yin la/

'jam pa'i dbyangs bud+dha rat+na shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas ni sa bcu'i byang sems nyid yin par tshad ldan gyi skyes bu la 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lung bstan pa yin te/ de yang kho bo cag lo gzhon nu'i dus grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar 'ga' zhig mthong bas rkyen byas/ nam 'chi cha med kyi tshe thung 'di la tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa gcig bya snyam pa dang / yang na 'chad nyan dang thugs dam spel mar byas te/ mi tshe stong zad du ma song pa zhig cis kyang bya snyam pa dang / de gang byed kyang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dang ma mjal ba'i thabs mi 'dug snyam pa sogs chos kyi snang ba mi chung tsam yod cing / lhag par rje btsun bslu med dam pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam thos pa'i mod la snying nas mjal 'dod kyi 'dod 'dun kha zhe med pa dung dung pa yang yang du skyes shing / rje 'di la chos thob pa dang sku drung nas 'ong ba yin zer ba'i grwa pa 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad pa na/ khyed rnams re dga'/ bla ma sangs rgyas de lta bu dang mjal 'dug snyam pa dang / lhag par 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug rje 'di'i zhabs drung du rab tu byung ba dang dbang rjes gnang mang po zhus nas phebs byung skabs rje 'di'i rnam thar 'dra gsungs byung pas/ bdag kyang rje de dang mjal nas chos thob pa zhig byung na dga' ba la zhus shing / snying nas kyang mjal 'dod lhang lhang je 'phel du song ba zhig byung la/ yang rje nyid ngam ring du phebs skabs shig sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang gnang grub 'phral der rtsa brgyad pa drung 'tsho lha 'byor gdan sa chen por slebs byung ba'i lag par dpung skud cig 'dug pa la/ khyed kyis nye stabs dbang su la zhus smras pas/ rje mus chen la sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang thob pa yin zer zhing rje'i rnam thar 'ga' zhig 'phros byung bas/ nged kyang bla ma sangs rgyas de dang mjal nas chos thob pa'i dus shig e yong na zhes pa ngag nas kyang shor zhing yid la yang de bzhin byung ba yin la/

de nas skabs shig bdag la bka' drin che ba'i ma cig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo de nyid ngam ring du mi dbang chen po mjal ba la phebs pa'i sgo dod song ba na/ der skabs rje mus chen nyid kyang ngam ring na bzhugs so zhes thos pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la da lta gangs can gyi khrod na dge ba'i bshes gnyen thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur cing / lhag par dad ldan gyi slob bu la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol zhing / mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med du mnga' ba'i skyes bu rje mus chen kho na las gzhan med do zhes dpyod ldan zur gnas mang po'i ngag las thos shing / rang yang snying nas yid ches thob pa la brten/ da ni kho bo cag 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi skyabs gnas dang 'dren pa zhu ba'i blo rtse'i gtad mtshams kyi yul sngar gyi 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis dang rje 'di kho na las gzhan med par rtogs nas bka' drin can gyi ma gcig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo brgyud pa'i rje 'di la bdag gis zhu yig phul ba'i don 'bras la/ bdag tshe ha cang mi ring ba zhig byung na thos bsam rgya cher byas pa la don mi 'dug pas tshe ring thung gang 'ong dang / thog ma mdo sngags gang la sbyang na legs dang / dbu zhwa sogs sku dreg phog nges pa'i na bza' zhig byin rlabs rten du gnang ba dang / sems la phan pa'i gsung mgur bslab ston zhig gnang dgos zhus pas/ de'i lan du thugs dam gsung shog 'di bzhin gnang byung ste/ 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku gsung thugs rab tu dwangs shing dkar phyogs dge ba la mngon par brtson pa'i skabs nas thugs dam bka' shog dam rdzas kyi gnang sbyin dang bcas spyi bor phebs pa bka' drin che lags/ sku phywa btab pas sku tshe ring po yong ba gda'/

thugs sbyong sngon ma gang mdzad pa dga' btab pas mdo mdzad pa dga' ba gda'/ thugs sbyong gnang gong mi g.yo ba dkar po'i bsnyen pa gcig mdzad na legs pa gda' lags/ thugs dam slob gnyer la sogs pa gang mdzad na'ang thugs rtse dkon mchog la gtad/ nges 'byung drag po'i sgos rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi bsam pas mdzad dgos te/ rje sa paṇa gyis mdor na chos kyis ci byed bsam/ /sangs rgyas byed na chos bzhin gyis/ /zhes dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen pos/ nyams su len pa'i chos la/ /glo snying brang gsum gtad nas/ /sems snang chos su sres shig /'di phyi bar do gsum du/ /'di yis bslu ba med pas/ /ma nor lam la 'bungs shig /ces gsungs pa sogs mang dag gda' na'ang yi ge mang dogs ma bris lags/ mdor na snga mu ltar thugs dam thugs sbyong res med bstan pa dgongs nas mkhyen mkhyen/ zhu yig gzigs rten tshe mdud la rgya mdzes phul/ zhwa mo sogs bdag gi dri phog pas 'bul ma nus zhes gsungs pa 'dug pa mthong ba'i mod la rje de nyid la mjal 'dod dang chos thob 'dod kyi blo me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa ltar je 'phel du gyur pa zhig byung la/ gsung shog ltar mi g.yo ba dkar po'i bsnyen pa byed dgos par gsungs pa de ni/ sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis slob ma 'ga' zhig la rten 'brel bsgrig par mdzad pa'i tshe yang mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang 'dug pa dang mtshungs par/ kho bo cag kyang phyis su rje btsun bslu med gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho lta bus shes rgyud btams shing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres nas skye ba gtan legs kyi 'dud ma zin pa'i rten 'brel gyi thog ma de dus nas bsgrigs par mdzad pa la the tshom cung zad kyang dgos pa ma yin no/ /de de'i skabs nas kho bo cag dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi gzim chung mkha' spyod na yod pa'i skabs shig tho rangs kyi tshe zhig rmi lam na byas 'gyur dgon pa'i bla brang nub kyi rje btsun gyi chos khri na rje bla ma mus pa chen po 'di yin zer ba'i bla ma bag dro ba gzi brjid can zhig 'dug pa/

phyag na mi rkang gling bu zhig bsnams nas 'bud bzhin pa dang bcas/ 'di bus pas mgon po mthong yong gin gda' zer ba la/ bdag gis rkang gling de blangs nas bus pas skad kyang ha cang che ba ma byung zhing chos skyong yang mthong rgyu ma byung ba'i mod la/ de ma thag bla ma de'i sku drung nas chu chen po zhig thol gyis brdol byung bas/ bdag gis sa skyor sogs thabs mkhas kyi bskyil bas rdzing bu che ba'i tshod tsam zhig byung ba snyam byed cing / de 'phral nyi ma yang zer gyis bzhud 'gro ba 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa dang gnyid sad byung bas/ de dus ni nyi ma bzhud pa'i rnam pa de lta bu sogs legs pa'i ltas rang zhig ci 'dra yin nam snyam blo theng nge ba zhig byung yang / dus phyis rmi lam gyi don la bsams pas/ nyi ma bzhud pa de yum bka' drin can de ma gshegs pa'i gong du bdag rang rje bla ma dang mi mjal ba'i don dang / rang gis rkang gling bus pa la sgra ha cang che ba ma byung pa sogs ni/ rje dam pa 'di rang chos skyong gi mnga' bdag tu bzhugs kyang rang nyid kyis bla ma 'di'i drung du rjes gnang khrid dang man ngag gi dpe lung gis mtshon pa'i chos skyong gi chos skor rags pa tsam zhig ma gtogs/ dpe lung sogs zhib tu mi thob pa'i brda' dang / sku drung nas chu brdol brdzing bur bskyil ba de ni gzhan bde kye gsang gsum yo ga sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i sa skya'i yab chos mu mtha' med pa zhig gi bka' drin nod pa'i brda' yin par shes pas/ des na de dus ngos cag 'dren pa dam pa 'di dang dngos su ma mjal yang / tshe rabs mang por rjes su bzung ba'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis de dus kyang rmi lam du byon nas ma yongs pas 'byung 'gyur ston par mdzad pa la yid gnyis mi dgos pa lags/ smras pa/ thog med 'khor bar yang yang 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /rgyun chad med par thugs rjes skyong mdzad pa'i/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang mus pa rje/

/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod kyi/ /mtshan gyi yi ge rna bar lhung tsam gyis/ /rab dga'i sa thob pas kyang mi 'gran pa'i/ /dga' spro'i ting 'dzin brtan pos bdag brgyud btams/ /mthong ba med kyang rnam pa blo yul du/ /wal wal dran pa nyin mo'i cha kun dang / /mtshan dus rmi lam du yang brjed ma gyur/ /e ma dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa yis/ /'jigs rung srid mtsho sgrol ba'i ded dpon de'i/ /zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi thob pa zhig /nam zhig 'byung snyam sems pa kho na las/ /yid la bya ba'i skabs gzhan 'phrogs gyur te/ /mgo la me shor bzlog lta'i brtson 'grus kyis/ /de don sgrub pa'i thabs la rab brtson pas/ /shugs ring lam gyi ngal ba ji snyed pa/ /ji mi snyam pa'i dga' spro'i ngang du gnas/ /de nyid tshe na rten 'brel gzhan dbang 'gas/ /lus ni dpal ldan sa skyar gnas mod kyang / /sems ni rigs kyi bdag po mus pa rje'i/ /phyogs su yang yang rgyug la ngal ba med/ /de 'dra'i ngang tshul nyid la re zhig gnas/ /de nas dus ha cang mi ring ba zhig lon pa glang lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub bka' drin 'khor zla med pa'i ma cig lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo glo bur du zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa la brten yid la bzod thabs med pa'i zug rngu drag pos kun tu gzir zhing gang la'ang snying po med par rtogs pa'i nges 'byung drag pos tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa zhig byed 'dod nas/ snga gong zhig dregs pa'i mtha' can gyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun gyi sku dngos dang khyad par ma mchis pa'i sku 'dra mdze thod ma'i drung du mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas gsol ba btab nas lung bstan zhus pa'i rnam grangs la/ 'brel tshad don ldan gyi bla ma rje btsun mus chen nyid dang mjal ba zhig ji ltar 'ong dang / tshe 'di blos btang gi sgrub pa zhig byas na bar snang la 'phur nus pa'i grub thob cig gi las skal yod med/

yang tshe 'dir bshad sgrub spel mar byas na bar dor 'bras bu 'grub pa zhig ci 'dra yong rnams zhus pas/ lung bstan mi bzang ba ma byung zhing de mthun gyi ma cig bka' drin can de zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan ma thag pa'i skabs der/ rje nyid kyi drung du lam ston gyi chas rnams 'bul ba dang bcas zhu yig phul ba'i don 'bras la/ sngar rje btsun gyi sku 'dra'i drung du lung bstan zhus pa'i rnam grangs rnams dang / lhag par bka' drin can gyi yum de gang du 'khrungs yod rnams la lung bstan gsal ga can zhig dgos tshul zhus pa na/ de'i lan du thugs dam gsung shog 'di bzhin gnang byung ste/ 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon par mtho zhing thos bsam sgom gsum la thugs brtson par bzhugs skabs nas gsung shog gos gser ma dang bcas gnang ba thugs la btags/ yum rin po che cho 'phrul gyi tshes bco lnga la sku tshe'i tshad rdzogs pa ltar mdzad nas gshegs pa de bya ba khams chen byung 'dug lags kyang / 'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyi/ /mdun na gnas pa 'chi ba yin/ /zhes dang / mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po med 'dra ba'i/ /chu bur lus la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ltar/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa gda' ba yin lugs kyang kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu dang / don dam par spros bral yin par thugs la bzhugs par zhu lags/ lung bstan byed pa la sa dang po chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong dgos mod/ bdag lta bu la de'i phyed dang po tsam gyi yon tan gang yang med pas lung bstan ga la yong lags/ yum de mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags tshang ba dang / grong rkyen dang / grong dus zhal ngo rnams kyi byin rlabs la brten nas/ gnas mthon por 'khrungs pa gzhir bcas su 'dug lags/ zhabs drung rin po che rang la bshad sgrub gnyis ka la mo bzang ba rang 'dug lags/

rang re mjal ba gcis yong zer ba babs lags/ da phyin thugs dam dang thugs gnyer spel mar gnang mdzod lags/ nyams len gang mdzad dang bya ba gang mdzad thams cad dkon mchog gsum la mgo bcad pang skyur gyis tshul du thog khel gyi rtse gcig tu thugs gtod par zhu lags/ slar sku tshe ring zhing bkris la thugs bsam chos bzhin du 'grub par smon lags/ sku rim srung 'khor yang cher gtad bsgrubs lags pas/ bde kye yo ga gsum gyi rgyud man ngag gzhung phran dang bcas pa rnams la gzigs rtog phul phyin rang sa ngor gyi bstan pa thugs la bzhag pa mkhyen mkhyen/ cis kyang dgos gsungs pa nas zhu yig spyan zur g.yo rten bo dhi tsit+tī phreng ba la rgya mdzes phul/ zhes gsungs pa 'dug pa mthong bas sems dga' ba dang spro ba tshad las 'das pa rab dga'i sa thob pa lta bur gyur cing / de lta bu'i rje bla ma'i thugs dam gsung shog de spyi bor phebs ma thag nem nem dal po'i lag gis khyogs su blangs/ /reg reg lus kyi phyag rgyas dam mdud bkrol/ /zim zim mig gis yig zur mthong ba'i don/ /sim sim snying gi khong bur brtan par bzhugs/ /de ltar bka' drin can gyi ma gcig lha sras de nyid zhing gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas ha cang mi ring ba zhig 'das pa'i tho rangs kyi cha zhig na/ bdag gi rmi lam du yum bka' drin can de nyid gsal bar byon byung pa la/ zhing brjes pa'i snang ba ma 'gags bzhin du bdag gis deng sang a ma lags mngal sgo mi rnyed pa'i 'o brgyal chen po mi 'dug lags sam zhes sogs zhus pas/ ma'i gsung las/ de tsam gyi sdug bsngal rang mi 'dug cing / lhag par nged la 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi lung bstan byung nas byang khog tu mi'i skye ba zhig len rgyu yin/ de'i nang nas kyang bla ma zhig yong rgyu yin gsungs byung pas/ de ma thag bdag gis ma cig bka' drin can khyed rang gi mchod gzhis sogs kyang bdag gis ma 'thor ba byed sogs zhu ba snyam byed pa na gnyid sad byung bas dga' ba dang skyo ba zung 'brel gyi ngang nas/

slar de'i don la bsams pas/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi lung bstan byung nas/ mi lus thob rgyu yin gsungs pa de ni bdag gi bla ma 'brel tshad don ldan 'di nyid kyis bka' drin 'khor med kyi ma cig nyid la lam ston mdzad dus/ spyir mi lus thob pa dang / lhag par bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'gyur ba'i tshul gyi lung bstan gnang bar the tshom dang yid gnyis mi dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i kho bo'i sems la nges shes khyad par can shar zhing / rgyu mtshan des na rje bla ma mus pa chen po bud+dha'i mtshan can 'di nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid/ slar yang sems can gyi don du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gzugs su bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa la yid gnyis dang bral ba'i nges pa'i shes pa yang dag pa rnyed nas/ bdud las kyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po bcos ma ma yin pa thob pa yin no/ /de ltar kho bo cag gis nges shes rnyed pa tsam du'ang ma zad/ rje dam pa rang nyid kyis kyang de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes pa gnang ste/ ngos cag rje nyid kyi zhabs drung du slebs nas gling ga bde ba can gyi gdan sar bkod pa gnang ba'i nyin tshogs dbur phyin pa 'khor nas zhabs drung du slebs pa na/ rje'i gsung las/ da lam tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel yod pas khyed bla ma na rim gyi gzim mal du sdod/ nged gdan srab pa 'di la bsdod pa yin gsungs byung ba la/ bdag shin tu sems 'dzangs pas ma nus pa na/ rje nyid kyi phyag gis bdag gi lag pa nas bsdus par mdzad de bskyel ba gnang byung zhing / gzhan yang der skabs dad ldan gyi slob ma mang po dang bcas shin tu dges pa'i ngang nas gsung gleng rgyun ring byung ba'i skabs der rje'i gsung las/ da lam 'dir tshogs pa'i rang re dpon slob rnams sngon rje sems dpa' chen po la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi bka' drin thob pa'i gang zag kyang yin no gsungs byung pas/

bdag gi bsam pa la sngon 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis rje sems dpa' chen po'i drung du bde kye gsang gsum sogs kyi dbang khrid man ngag mang du gsan 'dug pas/ nged rang gi rmi lam dang mthun par rje bla ma 'di nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rnam par sprul par zhal gyis bzhes par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes dung dung pa blo la shar zhing / gzhan yang rje 'di nyid phyis kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab kyi nang nas rje 'jam dbyangs sangs rin de nyid kyi gsung rab rnams la mchog tu bstod bkur bsngags gsum mdzad pa zhig 'dug pa dang / der yang ma zad bdag gi brtsams pa'i gling ga bde ba can gyi dgon pa'i bca' yig na/ mgon khyod dang por kun mkhyen rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bar du sa bcu'i byang sems bud+dha'i mtshan/ /dus 'dir dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /kun gyi 'gran zla gral la kun nas dad/ /ces dang / yang bca' yig de nyid kyi sbyar byang du/ zhes gling ga bde ba can gyi chos grwa chen po'i bca' yig mdor bsdus 'di ni/ sa bcu'i byang sems chen po bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul pa rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes sogs bris pa dang / yang gsung ngag rin po che'i chos 'byung don gnyer dga' ba skyed byed ces bya bar/ de ltar rje btsun sa bcu'i byang sems che/ /bud+dha rat+na'i mtshan gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs de las/ /zhes bris pa'i yi ge rnams rje nyid kyi spyan lam du phab pa na/ spyir bdag cag gi bla ma 'di nyid yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad sba bar mdzad pas/ zhabs drung du bstod bkur dang bsngags pa brjod pa la shin tu mi mnyes pa zhig yin na'ang /

gong du bkod pa'i yi ge'i tshul de dag la gzigs pa'i tshe/ kho bo ni de lta bu'i sa bcu'i byang sems kyi sprul pa ma yin zhes bka' mi stsol ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid sa bcu'i byang sems chen po bud+dha rat+na'i rnam par sprul par gdon mi za bar grub pa yin zhing / rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas nyid sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin pa'i tshul ni/ sngon gang bu le'i dgon pa na mkhan chen gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i drung du/ rje byams pa chos 'od bzhugs pa'i skabs/ mkhan chen pa'i gsung las/ nged kyi gdan sa 'di byang chub kyi sems rgyud la yod pa zhig gis bya dgos pa las/ da res byams pa chos 'od la babs zhes gsungs byung pas/ rje byams pa chos 'od kyi thugs dgongs la/ nged 'dir gdan sa byas na ni 'du 'dzi'i g.yengs pas mi tshe stong zad du 'gro ba 'dug cing / ma byas na bla ma'i dgongs pa ma sgrub par 'gro ba 'dug pas/ de bas na da lta mus gling ga na rje sems dpa' chen por grags pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can zhig bzhugs yod 'dug pas/ de'i drung du 'gro dgos par 'dug dgongs 'byon par bzhed nas glo bur du gshegs te/ rje sems dpa' chen po dang mjal nas bdag la bde kye gsang gsum sogs sa skya pa'i yab chos rnams gnang dgos tshul zhus pas/ khyod la las 'brel bzhag pa'i lha yin pas chos gzhan las smyung gnas rang zab pa 'ong bas/ des na dben gnas yo mor song la smyung gnas kho na gyis gsungs byung pa bzhin/ thugs dam gyi mthil smyung gnas la mdzad pas ring por ma thogs par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du zhal gzigs te/ de nas bzung ste 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung gleng rgyun mi 'chad du mdzad pa la sogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba la brten/ spyan ras gzigs byams pa chos 'od ces grags pa yin zhing /

de lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa de la 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen nyid kyis smyung gnas kyi chos skor rnams dang / don zhags rgyud chung gi lung sogs gsan nas bla mar bsten par mdzad pa las/ skabs gcig gi tshe na sngar 'phros snyan 'bul sogs med par rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis gsang stabs su mjal bar 'byon par mdzad pa na/ de'i tho rangs rje byams pa chos 'od pa'i drung du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyid 'od dang 'od zer 'phro bzhin pa dang bcas byon byung nas/ khyod kyi drung du de ring sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig 'byon pa yod pas phyag dang sna len bzang po gyis gsung ba'i lung bstan byung bas/ rje byams pa chos 'od pas snga mor bzhengs nas dgon pa'i rgya lam la yong mi ci 'dra yod kyi gzigs rtog yang yang mdzad pas/ 'byon mkhan gang yang ma byung zhing / de nas phyi dro'i cha la babs pa na thugs the tshom du gyur nas dgon pa'i mdo na man star zhig yod pa der byon nas cung zad bzhugs pas/ de ma thag rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpon slob rnams byon byung ba la/ sngar rje nyid phyag lan sogs mi mdzad yod pa la/ der skabs rje 'jam dbyangs kyis phyag 'bul ma gnang gong / rje nyid kyis phyag mdzad pas/ chos rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid thugs bag tsha ba'i rnam pas/ de ltar mi mdzad pa zhu zhus pas/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ 'di bzhin byed dgos pa nged rang la yi dam lha'i lung bstan zhig byung bas cang mi to ba lags zhes gsungs par grags so/ /rgyu mtshan des na 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang po nyid sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen por gdon mi za ba'i gtan tshigs yang dag pa dang ldan par go bar bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 'gro 'di rnams la lus sems bskyed pa'i ma/ /rang rang bu la brtse ba chos nyid de/ /lhag par snying gi dum bu phyir lhung bzhin/

/'bral thabs med 'drar byams pas skyong mdzad pa'i/ /bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa'i ma gcig de/ /blo bur gshegs pa'i lus sems sdug bsngal mes/ /drag tu gzir yang thabs gzhan ma rnyed nas/ /drin can ma de'i lam sna 'dren pa'i mgon/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i bla ma der/ /gsol ba btab pas mkhyen brtse 'phrin las kyis/ /ngan song skye sgo bskyabs nas mtho ris kyi/ /lus rten thob pa'i lung bstan dbugs dbyung stsal/ /zab gsal chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i skur bzhengs nas/ /dus gsum 'gro la rnam grol lam ston pa'i/ /mnyam med bka' drin can 'di bsngags par 'os/ /rigs can gsum gyi snang ngor zas gtsang sras/ /sa bcu'i byang sems dbus su longs spyod rdzogs/ /gzhan ngor bshes gnyen chen po'i skur bstan pa'i/ /rnam thar tshul 'di rmad byung bla na med/ /mgon khyod dang por rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid bar du sa bcu'i byang sems kyi/ /tshul du sprul nas gzhan gyi don mdzad de tshe sangs rgyas rin chen mtshan/ /dus 'dir dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen rgyal ba mus pa chen po zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng khyab 'di cher rlom kun gyi 'gran zla bral/ /'di ni mchog gzigs dam pa'i thugs rje dang / /rang gis legs byas skal ba mi dman pas/ /phan tshun rten 'brel bslu med byin rlabs kyis/ /nges shes rnyed pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo mthong / /de phyir sar gnas dam pa'i yon tan gyi/ /cha shas tsam yang so skye'i gang zag gis/ /brjod pa'i yul las 'das mod de lta na'ang / /dad pas cung zad spel 'di'ang skal ba bzang / /e ma 'brel tshad don ldan gyi/ /bslu med bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /zab rgyas chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa/ /'di 'dra bsam bzhin dad pa 'phel/ /mkhas mkhas tshig rkyang tsam la gtsor 'dzin tha snyad mkhan/ /btsun btsun gzhan gyi mig sngar mdzes bsgyur tshul chos mkhan/

/bzang bzang tshul gyi zhig por 'chos pa'i smyon dor mkhan/ /rang rang phyogs 'dzin slob mas bteg pa'i brdzun zog mkhan/ /bdag 'dra'i snyigs ma'i yar 'dren gzugs brnyan kun/ /kun kyang skyes chen 'di yi rnam thar cha/ /cha shas tsam re sgrub la brtson pa'i yid/ /yid gnyis spangs te rtag tu 'bad par rigs/ /dang por rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /bar du bud+dha rat+na'i mtshan/ /dus 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa yi/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad kun gyi rgyan/ /'di ni 'gyur med rdo rje'i sku/ /'di ni 'gag med rdo rje'i gsung / /'di ni mi rtog rdo rje'i thugs/ /'di ni rdo rje gsum ldan dngos// //bdun pa 'dren pa dam pa'i bka' bzhin bstan pa dang sems can gyi don ci rigs su mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid dgung gi lo nyi shur son pa blo ngan zhes pa lcags mo bya'i lo gsar du shar ba na rje 'di la 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba'i gsung gis/ rang re'i gling dga' bde ba can gyi dgon gnas 'di mus chen sems dpa' chen po 'debs par mdzad pa nas bzung / chos khrims byed mi rnam dag re byung na/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di'i lugs gnyis ka'i dge legs kyi rgyun la phan che ba zhig yod kyang / dus phyis chos khrims ci rigs kyi byed pa ngan pas mig ltos la gnod pa zhig byung bas/ da lo khyed kyis bstan pa dang dgon gnas pa'i chos khrims kyi khur len cis kyang byed dgos gsungs nas sku 'gag legs pa zhig gnang byung ba la rje 'dis lo gzhon pas myong ba chung ba sogs nas chos khrims rnam dag cig mi yong tshul zhus pas/ rje spyan snga ba'i gsung gis/ nged kyis yong ngam snyam nas lab pa la ma byas pas mi 'thus tshul phebs byung bas bka' bzhin dang len mdzad nas dam pa 'dis bla ma dang dkon mchog dpang du bzhugs pa'i las 'bras la khyad gsod spangs pa'i sgo nas mus lung gang skya ser thams cad la phyogs lhung med pa'i khrims snyom pa dang /

dgon pa'i spyi thes su tshogs khro chen po gsar du btsugs shing / grwa ba blo gsal rnams la dag ljon spyi gsum/ kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun sogs la thos bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad dgos pa'i bskul ma do dam rkang len mdzad nas dgon par slob gnyer gyi rgyun bzang po tshugs pa dang / gzhan yang rgyun pa'i bsgrigs bkod sogs la yang mtha' dbus med pa tshun gyi bla ma'i zhabs tog dang / bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du 'gyur nges pa'i mdzad pa phul du byung ba la brten/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho yang thugs shin tu dges pa'i stobs kyis zhabs drung du yang yang byon gsungs nas/ thugs mnyes pa'i gsung du ma dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin dpag med stsal cing / rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pas kyang rje 'di la khyod kyi chos khrims de shin tu legs byung / chos 'chad las kyang chos khrims dka'/ /zer ba yin yang / khyed rang lo gzhon nu la bsam mno rdzogs shing lhag bsam dag pa'i rten 'brel gyis dgon pa 'dis bstan pa la phan pa mthar thug pa zhig byung song bas/ phyis chos khrims rnams la mig ltos bzang po bzhag song ngo / /zhes sogs thugs gting nas dgyes pa'i bka' lung mang po dang bcas gsum tshan bzang po zhig gnang bar mdzad la/ gzhan yang mus nang gi skya ser thams cad kyang sku na gzhon nu 'di lta bu la 'di bas lhag pa'i chos khrims dgon gnas 'dir sngar su yang ma byung ba yin no zhes mgrin gcig tu sgrog cing kun gyi smon gnas kyi yul du gyur to/ /de nas gong du bstan pa ltar rje 'di dgung lo nyer gcig pa nas nyer dgu'i bar 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i rjes nas lo ngo gsum du slebs pa dpal gdong zhes bya ba chu mo bya'i lo rje nyid dgung lo so gnyis su son pa na/ yon bdag pre pa g.yung 'brug gi bu blo bur du 'das nas de'i rjes sgrub kyi cho ga la rje 'dis gtsos pa'i gling ga dgon pa'i dge slong bcu phrag gcig tsam spyan drangs pa'i tshe/

de dus 'brog pa rnams kyis sha ba gcig gsod pa gzigs pas rkyen byas thugs la skyo shas dang snying rje drag po bzod glags med pa 'khrungs nas spyan chab kyang mang po shor zhing / de nas bzung ste lo grangs du ma zhig gi bar du dmar gyi rigs gtan nas spangs te/ tha na 'jam rdor gyi skam po'i dri tshun yang zhal la ma reg pa mdzad pa na/ skabs shig rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa'i zhabs drung du byon gsungs nas rje'i zhal nas/ khyed sha mi bzhes pa ci yin gsungs pa la/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan rnams zhu bar mdzad pas/ de ltar yin na ngo mtshar che 'dug kyang / da dung sku na gzhon nu la thos bsam bsnyen sgrub sogs la 'bad rtsol mdzad dgos pas/ de la sku lus kyis lcogs pa zhig gal che zhing / phugs yul de las kyang khyed rang 'phrin las che ba 'ong bas de dus 'chad nyan la rem dgos shing / de la da lta nas lus zungs shor na gegs su 'gro bas/ khyed lta bu'i gang zag yas babs kyi sha tsam bzhes pa la de tsam gyi nyes par mi 'gyur ba'i steng sems can la phan thogs pa yang yin mod/ gang ltar dgag bya dang dgos pa gnyis gtso gang che gzigs dgos zhes gsungs byung pas/ de nas bzung ste rje 'dis kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin sku lus kyi 'phrod rten du cung zad bzhes pa de byung ba yin pa 'dug de de'i skabs nas rje 'di dgung lo so bzhir phebs pa na tshod ldan zhes pa phag gi lo shar ba tsam na/ der skabs gling ga dgon pa'i grwa ba 'ga' zhig 'phral gyi bza' btung dang / yon rdzong la mig nye thal ba'i rung mi rung sogs brtag dpyad med par sbyin bdag gi rus bzhu mang po dus gcig la byas pas yon mchod kun la dge mtshan gyi rtags chung ba tsam byung ba na/ de dus rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho nyid tshogs su phebs pa'i bka' las/ deng sang dgon pa 'di'i grwa pa kha cig gzhan phan du mi btags pa'i don la mig nye kha thal gyi mi'i rus pa bsreg chog sogs byung tshad byed pa zhig 'dug pa/

'di 'dra khe bas nyen che ba yin/ nged kyi bla ma chos rje ngor pa lha mchog seng ge bas kyang mnal lam gyi brdas bskul ba bzhin ngor dgon pa'i khams tshan sogs grwa rgyun gyi rus pa bdag med mang po dus gcig la bzhu ba'i zhal bkod gnang ba la/ rje 'jam dbyangs chen po de nyid thugs ha cang dgyes rgyu rang ma byung ba yin te/ de yang rje lha mchog seng ge nyid kyis ngor bla brang du sku mtshams lhag par dam pa'i thugs dam bcad rgya ma zhig gnang ba'i tho rang ka zhig gi mnal lam du ri rong chen po zhig gi gcong ga'i gad sle'i sne zhig la rje nyid bzhugs pa'i sku'i dpung zur tsam na sa stegs gcig gi steng na bzhugs lding la rje yongs 'dzin bzhugs 'dug gcong g.yang de'i 'og na grwa pa mang po rdzi ding ding pa'i sgra 'dug pa'i skabs/ rje yongs 'dzin gyi bka' lung la lha mchog seng ge khyod kyis grwa pa de rnams yar drongs dang gsungs byung pas/ rje nyid kyi phyag phreng pad+ma'i phreng ba ring po zhig phyag la rgyun du rgyus pa de'i sne g.yang kha la bskyangs pas/ 'og gi grwa pa de rnams kyis lag pas 'jus nas byung bas rim can du dka' tshegs gang yang med par yar drangs pas/ yar byung res rje yongs 'dzin gyis phyag 'then gnang nas gyen de la rim bzhin dga' theg ga song / bar skabs su khams pa'i grwa pa gcig gis lag pas phyag phreng ma zin par g.yang la shor zer ba la thugs skrag tsam byung ba'i rkyen byas mnal sad rjes/ dgongs pa btang pas stod mnga' ris nas smad mdo khams bar gyi grwa pa mos gdung can rnams bla ma'i gdan sa 'dir gangs dkar po la sna gtad/ sprin dkar po la tshad btsugs grwa pa sa 'dir 'ongs pa'i sku gdung sa 'og tu yod pa 'di rnams sa 'og tu bzhag na mi 'os/ bsreg sbyangs gyis kyi brdar 'dug dgongs nas sku mtshams grol nyin dbon chen rin chen seng ge pa la/

nged kyis da lan mtshams ring la dkon mchog gsum dngos ma la gcig tu kha don dang gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab rin chog pa byung / khyod kyis nangs par ja skol nyan khal bzhi dang / zhib rkyal bzhi dang / mar thud de mthun rnams dang tsha ba zab pa gcig shoms/ nangs par zur 'chad bzhi po 'bod pa yin bka' zhal steng du slob dpon zur 'chad bzhi po la/ rje nyid kyis sku bzan re'i gnang sbyin yang rtsal nas/ khyed rnam pas de ring nas gzung rdor dkar gtsang sbra'i thon pa'i kun rig gi bsnyen rgyab dang 'brel ba'i durka 'bum phrag drug pa re'i bsnyen pa dag gsal 'gro nges re mdzod gsungs ba'i bka' lung ltar du drung nas tshos kyang de bzhin gnang nas dgongs pa bzhin bar chad med par legs par mthar phyin mtshams rang rje nyid kyi drung du drung nas so so la bka' bkod 'them pa gnang nas/ me thab ches che ba bzhi brtsigs pa'i mdun du drung nas rang rang gi bzhugs gdan bkod do/ /sngon nas da bar gyi ngor rang du gshegs pa'i grwa pa 'das grongs byung ba'i pur gang yod zhib len byas pa'i nyis brgyar long nges tsam me thab so sor bgos nas kun rig gi sreg sbyong gnang nyin tshogs su yang tsha ra mang ja nyis 'thud bzang ba 'gyed bcas sgrub par mdzad dus nam mkha' gzha' sprin gyis gang ba dang / me tog gi char sil ma sil mar babs pas kun mos gus dang dge sems sngon med la bkod cing / sreg rdzas phra mo tshun yang gcig tsam la yang chad lhag med pa'i bka' bkod 'them pa gnang nas legs par grub rjes su sku gdung rnams ja rkyal che ba bzhir mi shong ba tsam byung rjes/ de thams cad la rje nyid tshogs dbur phebs pa'i kun rig bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i bdag bskyed dang 'brel bar rus chog zhag bdun pa zhig tshogs su gnang nas kun la tsha tsha 'bum gter dri med kyi gzung bzhugs can la phyag nas kyi mtha' brten pa yang gnang nyin tshogs su da blo bde/

rmi ltas bzang tsam zhig la brten nas u tshugs spyod byas pa tshab su song byung gsung ba yang byung / de dus khams pa'i dbon po drag pa sngar sde dkrug mang po byas pa gcig gi ro khong rang khams tshan rnam pas gces pa'i lugs byas/ 'di mang mtha' la mi bsreg zer nas gcig pu la drung nas byams bkras pas me chog gnang ba mtshan yal bsregs kyang ma tshig par thab nas bton te/ slar sa la bskung dgos byung zer bas mnal lam gyi g.yang la gcig shor gsung pa de 'di la lta bar 'dug kyang sgrog pa byung zhing / de rjes rje 'jam dbyangs chen po nyid 'jad du chos 'khor la phebs pa la/ sa skya nas bdag chen sa lo chen po yang mjal bar phebs/ gzhan yang snar thang pa'i bdag mo chen mo sogs dpon skya tha dad mang po yang tshogs pa'i skabs der rje nyid kyis mjal ba dang / sngar bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub dus nan gyis dbang rdor 'phreng gis gsol btab mdzad nas gnang skabs/ dbang yon rgya dril/ rten kheb/ gser srang / dngul skyogs sogs phul dus/ 'an bu la dbang yon gzhan gang byung yang dga' tshor med/ ngor gyi tshogs chen la rdo rje 'phreng ba gnang zer ba zhig dgos lags gsungs pa thugs la bzhag ngos/ ngor du 'phreng ba'i dbang rgyas la mtha' chod pa'i phyag bzhes gnang ba'i tshul 'bul ba dang sreg sbyang gi grangs rnam pa'i bsngo zhus kho na la zhabs gtad phebs/ yab sras mjal ma khad phyag len stsol bar mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang nas rdo rje 'phreng ba bod du byung phyin la mchod bshoms dbang rdzas de las lhag pa ma srid gda'/ 'an bu'i dbang bskur ba la mdo byung nas gda'i gsungs dges dges rang gnang zhing / slar bzhugs gdan la 'khod rjes ja zhu'i steng du 'bul ba ja bsigs sbrel gos phyi nang / rgya spos/ rgya dril/ rten khebs/ dngul skyogs/ bkra shis kha thags sogs phul bas/ ja mi dgos ngor pa'i ja rnams mang ja'i dmigs su bzhag pas/

ja 'bru gcig kyang 'ju ba dka' gsungs ma bsnams pa la/ rje nyid kyis da res phul ba'i ja 'di rnams nged rang sgos thad kyi yin pas cis kyang grwa pa rnams kyi ched du bzhes dgos nan gyis zhus pas bzhes tsam byung / der bsngo ba mdzad dus/ 'o 'di 'dra gzhan phan yin yang thugs rtog rtsing 'dug mi tsho ni ro re re bsreg pa la yang rtsis dang rim gro mang dag dgos kyin gda' bo bka' lung phebs pa la/ mnal lam gyi tshul 'bus tsam snyan du btab pas/ 'o na bla mas lung bstan par 'dug pa de kar 'dug gzhan de 'dra dbu thon pa mi srid gsungs nas bsngo ba zab rgyas rang dgos bzhin du mdzad pa yin/ gang ltar de 'dra gtso dkon mchog gi lung bstan par 'dug kyang / pha rol po gang zag kun gyis chos rje ngor pa thugs rtog rtsing pa rang du ma 'dzin pa zhig byung ba/ rgyu mtshan des na deng sang dgon pa 'di'i khyed dge slong kha cig gis mig nye 'dod gdungs kha thal ba'i gzhan don du mig g.yar ba'i spyod rtsing tshod med 'di bzhin byas na rang gzhan kun la gnod par 'gyur ba/ da phyin bag yod kyi blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa so so nas go dgos pa yin no/ /zhes sogs bslab bya rgyas par stsal cing / de dus kyang rje 'di 'phral gyi mdzad pa rnams shin tu legs pas/ spyan snga 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyang thugs lhag par 'phrogs nas/ de'i gsung gis byung na chos rje gshang pa 'dra ba'i rgyun du sgal tshigs bzang ba/ dgos pa byung na dka' blo bde ba/ rang la dgos pa'i thugs dam slob gnyer rem pa/ gzhan la 'dzer 'jug chung ba sogs btsun pa dge bshes zer na 'di 'dra ba zhig dgos pa yin zhes sogs bstod bkur bsngags gsum yang yang du mdzad cing / lhag par lan cig rje de nyid rang gi zhal dkar gsol jas bkang pa nas spyan snga chos rje rang gis cung zad gsol nas/ byin rnams rje 'di la stsal te/ 'di gzhan la ma ster bar rdzogs par bzhes ma 'ongs pa na mus stong dpon gnas gsar zhal ngo rnams kyi dbu bla byed pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa yin gsungs byung pas/

dam pa 'dis thugs dgongs la rang la chen po'i bla ma sogs ming stong dgos med de 'dra la re 'dod zhe nas med kyang / bla mas thugs rtsa la sbyar bar 'dug dgongs thugs la dges spro dpag med byung gsungs shing / de nas yongs 'dzin zhes pa me pho byi ba'i lo rje 'di dgung lo so lngar son pa'i tshe thugs dam la brtson par bzhugs pa'i skabs shig mnal lam du gling kha'i bla brang chen mo'i mgon khang na rje nyid dang / gling ga'i dge slong drag bsdus shig thugs dam bzlas pa mdzad kyin bzhugs 'dug pa la/ dgon pa'i grwa pa dbu mdzad tshul 'od 'dra ba'i ban+dhe zhig byung nas/ dge slong gzhan rnams la bltas rjes/ rje 'di la dbyug pa phra ring zhig yun ring btsugs te log song pa na mnal sad byung pas/ de dus ni ci yin nam snyam du dgongs shing / slar brtags pas skabs der mus gnas gsar gyi sde pa stong dpon zhal ngo rnams kyi dbu bla rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa de nyid sku na mthon por gson pa'i bzhugs yul slas rdzong chung nas gnas gsar sogs su yang yang 'byon bzhud gnang ba la cung zad dka' ba sogs kyi stabs ka'i stong dpon zhal ngo rnams la dbu bla gsar pa zhig dgos skabs shar ba na gling ga dgon pa'i dge bshes rags bsdus kyi khrod nas 'os rigs rnams gang 'thad kyi gsung brtag dang lung bstan rje chos dbang phyug nyid kyi drung du zhus pa la bdag nyid chen po 'di kho na 'os shing 'thad pa'i gsung brtag kyang bzang chug dang / lung bstan kyang rgyas par gnang ba'i skabs yin pa 'dug pas/ sngar gyi mnal lam de la lta ba yin pa 'dug gsungs/ de nas yun ring ma lon pa'i dus zhig na rje spyan snga rin po che'i sku rim du rje nyid dang gling ga'i grwa pa rags bsdus zhig gis bla brang mgon khang du bskang gso zhag sbrel 'ga' mdzad pa'i tshe/ nangs gcig mnal lam du rang nyid bzhugs yul dgon pa'i grwa khang de'i sgo 'gram na grwa pa dpon g.yog gnyis rta dkar po gcig dang bcas 'dug pa la/

nged rnams khyed spyan 'dren pa yin zer ba zhig byung pas/ sang nyin bla brang mgon khang gi thugs dam bskang gso grol nas log byon pa na/ mdang nub mnal lam la ji ltar shar ba bzhin gyi mus gnas gsar nas chos mdzad kun chos pa dpon g.yog gnyis chibs pa dkar po gcig dang bcas 'byor pa'i rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa'i thugs dam dang / gnas gsar zhal ngo so so'i phyag rtags dang bcas stong dpon sku ngo rnams kyi bla ma la 'byon dgos tshul 'dug pa la/ rje chos dbang phyug pa'i thugs dam la gzigs pas/ spyir bslab bya mang po zhig dang / don gyi snying por nged na so smin pa nas/ gnas gsar phyogs su yang yang 'gro 'dug dgos pa 'di la zhe nas 'tsher zhing dge sbyor la gnod po zhig 'dug pas/ da lam mi rgan bdag gi ngo la dgongs nas cis kyang 'byon dgos gsung ba 'dug pas/ rje 'di'i thugs dgongs la/ 'di 'dra'i rigs can blo la gting nas med pa de bla ma'i thugs la ni mnga'/ da res phebs sgo 'di bzhin gnang ba bzhin ma bsgrubs na ni dam sel du song dogs/ da ni ci rang drag snyam pa'i thugs tsab tsob tu gyur nas/ de nub mnal yang ye med pa zhig byung zhing / nangs par nyi ma shar 'phral bla brang du spyan snga rin po che'i zhabs drung du byon gsungs nas bka' las/ sngar nged kyis rten 'brel bsgrigs pa bzhin/ da lam khyed stong dpon zhal ngo rnams kyi bla ma la rdzong dgos tshul nged la yang nan chags byung ba dang / spyir yang khong tsho 'di pa g.yas ru byang pa'i dpon rigs go che sa rang zhig yin pas/ nam phugs bstan pa la yang sleb rgya chen po yong nges pas cis kyang 'byon dgos shing / de la yang lugs gnyis kyi blang dor 'di bzhin mdzad dgos pa'i bslab bya zhib mo zhig gnang ba dang bcas zhal dkar hor dkar shub bcas gcig gis thog drangs pa'i zang zing gnang sbyin rgya dpangs chen po stsol bar mdzad cing /

de nas rje 'dis kyang thugs la med bzhin du bla ma rnam gnyis kyi bka' gcog ma bde bas zhal gyis bzhes nas rim gyis gnas gsar phyogs su phyag phebs pa na/ stong dpon zhal ngo rnams kyi bzhugs yul gnas gsar gyi rgyal khang gzigs pa tsam nas bzung / nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang / lhag par me tog gi char chen po kun gyi mngon gyur du babs pas/ spyan 'dren byed mi chos mdzad kun chos pa na re/ chos bzhin byas na char bzhin 'bab zer ba de 'di 'dra zhig 'ong ba yin zer ro/ /de nas rje 'dis gnas gsar du zla ba kha shas kyi bar du bzhugs te/ de dus nang so dpal len rdo rje snyung gzhi thu mo zhig gi zin nas gshegs la nye ba yod pa na/ tshe dbang rjes gnang / bka' bsgo sogs rkyen sel gang la gang 'tshams yang yang du mdzad pa'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ nang so yang yun ring ma 'gor bar sku khams gzhi med du dwangs te sde pa gnas gsar ba dpon blon chab 'bangs dang bcas pa dga' mgu yid rangs par gyur cing / de nas rje 'dis re zhig gling ga phyogs su phebs pa'i yar lam slas pa rdzong chung du rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa bzhugs pa'i drung du cher gtad mjal ba la byon nas/ nang so dpal chen sku khams dwangs tshul sogs gnas tshul rnams zhu bar mdzad pa na/ rje chos dbang pa shin tu dges pa'i gsung gis/ dpal chen rdo rje khong spyi gces sgos gces rang du bdog pas/ de cis kyang legs gda'/ sa skya pa'i dge bshes tshad ldan la byin rlabs dang nus pa de 'dra rang zhig yong ba yin/ da nga mi rgan 'chi yang bsam pa de kas rdzogs gsungs pa sogs thugs bla lhag tu dges pa'i bka' lung du ma phebs par mdzad/ de nas rim gyis gling gar phebs te rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i drung du sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ rje nyid kyang thugs dges nas/ nang so sku khams dwangs pa de ngo mtshar che/

khyed rang yang da lam gzhan phan mdzad pa'i thog ma la 'go non 'dug pas/ da phyin ci mdzad thams cad legs pa kho nar 'ong ba yin no/ /zhes sogs kyi lung bstan yang stsal cing / de nas rje 'di dgung lo so drug tu phebs pa dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang gi lo shar ba na rje 'di dang / gling ga'i dbu mdzad nam mkha' chos skyong gnyis la 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bka' las/ khyed gnyis kyis gling ga tshogs chen la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang gang dgos re gyis/ de nas nged kyis rim lnga'i khrid 'chad pa yin gsungs pa la dbu mdzad nam chos glo bur du bsnyung nas dbang gnang ma thub cing / rje 'dis bka' phebs gnang ba'i gnang dus rang nas dbu bzung / gling ga tshogs chen ma rdzogs kyi bar la dbang rnams smin rgyas su stsal pas/ spyan snga rin po che thugs dges pas/ re che sa nas ma bslus pas bzang ngo gsungs shing / dus der dbang bskur thog ma'i sta gon gyi nub mo rje nyid kyi mnal lam du dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du zan ril brtag pa zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ ril bu gcig phyir thon pa la me 'bar nas je mtho je mthor song ste/ mthar nam mkha'i dbyings su thim pa'i mtshan ltas gsal bar byung gsungs pa ni/ rje btsun bla ma nyid kyi 'phrin las nam mkha' dang gdul bya rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 'dren nus kyi mtshan ma yang dag pa yin par nges so/ /de nas 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo rje 'di dgung lo so bdun du son pa na mus gnas gsar gyi stong dpon zhal ngo rnams dang dgon pa dga' ldan rtse'i dge 'dun rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa la brten/ rje 'dis dgon gnas de nyid kyi zhal bdag re zhig mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ de nub mnal lam du 'brog pa zhig dang / bud med sma ra ser po byas pa zhig byung nas snod mar gyi bkang pa zhig dang /

snam dkar ras yug sne tshang gcig rnams phul nas/ da lam 'byon pa zhal gyi bzhes pa de cis kyang bka' drin che zer dga' dga' du ma byed pa zhig byung pa de rnams dgon pa'i gzhi bdag srin ya ma dang / rdzong rgyal po rnams yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas dgon gnas der phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ thog mar sa 'dul gyi dmigs pa zhig mdzad pas gzhi bdag rnams kyi rtsub 'gyur cung zad byung ba la/ de'i gnyen por thog mar 'dus pa'i tshogs la ma cig gi gcod khrid cig smin rgyas su stsal pas/ gzhi bdag gdug pa can dam la thogs pa'i rtags mtshan mngon gyur du byung ba'i tshul ni gong du brjod pa ltar yin la/ de nas dgon pa rdzong gi dge 'dun rags bsdus nyer lnga skor zhig la rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi gtso bo gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar du rgyas par gnang ste/ de dang 'brel ba'i sems bskyed rgyu lam gyi dbang / bla ma tshad ma'i skabs su bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar nas bzung / rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho rnams kyi rnam thar gyi bar dang / rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ zhib mo rnam dag sogs dang / nyams myong tshad ma'i skabs su gzhung shing chen mo bzhi/ rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga/ gegs sel gyi yi ge bzhi/ dam tshig gi skabs su rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi bshad pa/ lta ba'i skabs su 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su/ kye rdo rje'i rnam bshad/ bstan bcos tshad ma la yang gzhung bshad snyag ma gsal byed dang bcas pa/ lung tshad ma la lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dang / lung 'di nyid dang zhib tu sbyar ba sogs ma tshang ba med pa dang / gzhan yang lam zab phyi nang / bir srung phyi nang / rnam 'joms bir lugs/ brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang / sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi bar du zhib tu stsal nas gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po rab tu rgyas par mdzad pa yin la/

de nas bzung ste lo ngo bcu gcig lhag tsam gyi bar du dgon gnas de nyid du gtso bor bzhugs te gsung ngag rin po che cha lag rags rim dang bcas pa so so'i lung gi brgyan pa tshar bzhi dang / de dag gi skabs mtshams rnams su rjes gnang gi rigs la sgrub thabs kun las btus pa brgya rtsa dang / rgya mtshor grags pa gnyis/ gzhan yang rjes gnang zur bka'i rigs mang po dang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang / kun rig cho ga'i bshad pa rgyas pa phyag chen rnams kyi brda' sprod dang bcas pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro bas lū nag dril gsum gyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid kyis brgyan pa/ rim bzhi/ rim lnga/ dpyid thig sogs so so'i rdzogs rim zab mo rnams dang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ de dag gi rgyab rten du rgyud dang rgya bod kyi bka' dang bstan bcos mang po'i bshad pa dang lung la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun ma chad par bskor bar mdzad pas dus der sa phyogs de nyid du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye yo ga gsum gyi bstan pa shin tu gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de de'i skabs nas rje nyid dgung lo zhe gsum du phebs pa sgrol byed ces pa shing pho spre'u'i lo la rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i sgrub gnas sha rkyang ri khrod du phyag phebs nas dbyar thog lhag tsam zhig thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nyams rtogs kyi bogs rnams gzhan las ches che ba byung nas/ rje'i gsung gis/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i sha rkyang ri khrod 'di na chos srung khyad par can zhig yod 'dug pas/ nged la nangs re bzhin nyams rtogs mi gcig pa re skye yin 'dug gsung ba dang / yang lan cig tho rangs kyi skabs shig na sku 'khor ba rnams la khyed rnams myur du longs/

gnas gsar nas zhabs drung dpon g.yog rnams rang re'i sar 'byon gyin 'dug go gsungs pa byung ba la/ khong rnams kyis bag yangs su lus pas/ nyi ma ri rtse la shar ba tsam la nang so lha dbang dpon g.yog rnams shar stabs su byon byung pas/ thams cad rje'i 'od gsal gyis sgrib med du gzigs par thag chod cing ngo mtshar du gyur pa dang / gzhan yang yon bdag bzhi dar/ dpon a sog rnal 'byor ri pa/ chos mdzad sangs rin sogs kyis sha rtsam mar thud sogs kyi 'bul ba dang bcas zhabs drung du nangs par 'ong ba'i de nub rje'i 'od gsal gyis gsal bar gzigs nas sku 'khor ba rnams la/ gang zag 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba dngos po 'di 'dra khyer nas rang re'i sar 'ong kyin 'dug go zhes gsungs byung ba na/ gang bka' bstsal pa bzhin thog tu babs pa'i lo rgyus mang po yod kyang yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la/ yang skabs gcig da rang tho rangs 'brog gzhon khyi khrid pa zhig nged kyi rtsar byung / bar srid du ni 'dug su shi ba yin nam gsungs pa la/ de'i nyin mo mus phyug pa tshe rdor zer ba zhig khyi ra la phyin pa brag la 'dril nas shi ba'i byang rten khyi dang bcas pa 'bul du byung ba dang / yang lan cig srod chil ba zhig la rje nyid gsung shugs chen pos/ a ā gsungs byung pa la sku'i nye 'khor na yod pa'i dge slong byams pa dpal gyis ci 'dug lags zhus pa na/ nged kyi a ma de ru khrod na g.yag la bskyon nas yong gin 'dug pa la/ da lta brdabs nas rkang pa chag song gsungs byung bas/ dge slong pas de 'dra mi srid lags sam zhus pa'i tshe/ mi srid na dang legs gda' ste/ gang ltar myur du go 'ong bar 'dug da ri khrod 'dir lan cig 'dug bsams kyang / 'dug dbang mi yong shas 'dug pas/ rang re rnams sang nyin rang dgon pa rdzong du 'gro ba yin no gsungs nas rje dpon slob rnams phyag phebs nas zhag gsum lon pa na/

rje rang gi gcen po zhabs drung du 'byor pas yum ru skyas kyi dus g.yag gis bskyur nas da lta grong la thug pa yod pas rje nyid 'brog sib tu phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul nan gyis zhu bar 'dug pa la/ rje'i gsung gis/ nged ru khrod du yong yang dge sbyor la gnod pa las med/ de bas khyed rang rnams kyis a ma gling kha dgon par skyol cig nged 'di nas 'ong ba yin gsungs te dpon slob rnams kyis myur du gling gar phebs nas yum sras mjal ma thag sman pa mkhas pa rnams la bstan pas/ zhag bdun tsam las mi thub zer ba la/ rje 'dis kun rig gi dbang brgya rtsa dang / tshe dbang stong rtsas thog drangs pa'i byin rlabs rkyen sel gyi rigs rgyun ma chad pa mdzad pas yum gyi sku khams nyin re bzhin yang zla ba yar ngo'i 'phel cha ltar ji dang ji rgyas su gyur te zla phyed lhag tsam na yum snyung gzhi las grol te/ sku khams sngar rgyun bzhin sor chud pas sman pa sogs thams cad ha las shing / mus nang gi skye bo thams cad mgrin gcig pas yum sku na dang snyung babs lci mo de tsam la nyes skyon las grol ba 'di ni sras grub thob dang mjal ba'i byin rlabs kho na las gzhan du ma 'das so/ /zhes mgrin gcig tu sgrog par gyur cing / de de'i skabs nas slar yang rje bla ma 'di nyid stong dpon zhal ngo rnams kyis gnas gsar du spyan drangs te re zhig bzhugs/ de nas dgon par phebs te thugs dam dang 'chad nyan spel mar mdzad pa'i ring nas/ nyid kyi dgung gi lo zhes lnga bzhes pa mi zad zhes pa mes po khyi'i lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba tsam nas spyan snga 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho de nyid gzhan snang du sku snyung ba'i tshul bstan te/ lo de la zla ba gsum pa gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma'i nyer gcig gi nyin gling ga bde ba can gyi bla brang du gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa na/ de'i gnas tshul gsan pa'i rjes thog nyid la bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rags bsdus shig gis gling gar phebs te/
