de ma thag sku gdung rin po che'i drung du byin rlabs zhu ba la phebs nas shing sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa lta bu'i sku lus brdabs pa'i phyag bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / ldog tu med pa'i spyan chab kyi phung po chu bo'i rgyun lta bu mdzad cing / snyan dar/ dkar me gdung 'bul sogs stobs che bar phul/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i steng du mang ja bzang ba'i rnyed bkur dge 'dun stong phrag tu nye ba tshogs pa rnams la zang zing gi gral 'gyed dang / che 'bul rnam gzhag bsngo rten sogs dngos po bzang zhing stobs che ba bsgrubs shing / lhag par sku gdung rin po che bzhu la 'bul ba dang / gdung rus rnams tsha tshar 'debs pa sogs zhabs tog rje 'di nyid kyis phyag len mthar phyin par mdzad/ de nas brtsams te gang du bzhugs sar lo dus dang zla dus kyi mchod pa ma chag pa gnang ba sogs dam pa gong ma'i dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rje 'dis slar yang rdzong dga' ldan rtser phyag phebs te dge 'dun che rags shig la 'dod chos 'dra gnang ba'i skabs/ stong dpon nang so lha dbang gi zhabs la klu nad la brten pa'i snyung gzhi drag po zhig gis zin pa la/ sman pa mkhas pa gsum tsam gyis gros mthun gyi sman spyad dang / sku rim spongs 'degs sogs ci mdzad kyang bde khyed du mngon pa ma byung ba la/ rje bla ma 'di spyan drangs nas nyi ma bcu gsum gyi bar du gcod kyi spyan dmigs ched du gtad nas gnang bas/ nang so'i zhabs la bde bskyed 'phral du blangs te zhag bdun gyi khongs su snyung gzhi nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa bzhin song bas/ gnas gsar sde pa zhal ngo rnams kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pa la bkod cing / chab 'bangs thams cad kyang yid bde'i dpal thob par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags pho stag gi lo rje nyid dgung lo zhe dgur son pa na/ rdzong dga' ldan rtse'i dgon gnas de nyid du rje nyid kyis mkhan po dang /

gzhan 'os su gyur pas las slob/ gsang ston/ grib tshod/ grogs dan pa sogs 'dul ba'i las gra sgrig par mdzad de/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi nang nas 'os su gyur pa rnams la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa dang / gzhan mang po zhig la rab tu byung ba dge tshul gyi bslab 'bogs sogs la zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar du thugs skyo bsun med par mdzad nas/ de nas re zhig shin tu dben pa'i sku mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam pa zhig la rgyang tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs tho rangs kyi cha zhig na rje nyid kyi mnal lam du spras pa ring mo nam mkha'i mthong la ye le ba gcig 'dug pa la mi nag po 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dzegs song nas/ des rje nyid la phyir mig bltas nas 'di la byon zer byung ba la/ thugs la spras pa 'di dkyus ma na mi 'dug pas ma thar ba 'ong ngam snyam bag tsha ba tsam byung ba na/ de ma thag ban chung lus la rus rgyan yod pa'i rtse mo la dril bu g.yer kha mang pa btags pa'i sil chom gyi sgra sgrog pa zhig byung nas/ spras ring de la yar rgyug mar rgyug mang du byed cing / 'di tsam la ma thar ba ci srid/ da lta byon zer te phyag nas 'then sku nas phul byung bas/ rje nyid kyis kyang dbang med kyi tshul du byon pas skas 'gor phebs ma thag sngar gyi mi nag po des phyag 'then btang byung bas/ de nas sa phyogs mthon po nyams dga' mo zhig tu phebs pa snyam byed pa na mnal sad byung bas/ de'i tshul rnams sku 'khor rnams la bka' bstsal nas/ rmi lam ni ya mtshan che/ de ring ci 'ong ba yin nam gsungs pa la/ nyi ma phyi dro'i cha la babs pa tsam na/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi thugs dam bka' ngag dang bcas sprul sku mgon po tshe dbang dpon g.yog rnams 'byor pa'i/ rje 'di sa skya'i sngags dgon bde chen gling gi mkhan po la 'byon dgos pa'i bka' phebs nan chen 'dug pa la/

nyid kyi gsung las/ sa skya bdag chen rnams kyis chos skyong bran du 'khol zer ba cis kyang bden par 'dug mdang rmi lam du byung ba'i mi nag po de gur gyi mgon po dang / ban chung de zhal bzhi pa'i sprul pa yin tshod du gda'/ des na sa skya gong ma'i bka' bcag na chos skyong yang mi mnyes rgyur 'dug 'on kyang nged rang bas mtha'i btsun pa ri khrod kyi bsgom chen gang yang mi shes pa zhig gi dgon pa'i 'dzin skyongs dang / chen po'i mchod gnas la sogs pa blos gtan nas mi lcogs pa zhig yod pas/ 'bul rten gang drag zhig sgrub na dgongs pa bde grol yod pa zhig e 'char gsungs pa la/ sprul sku mgon tshe bas/ da lam rje rin po che mi phebs na/ bdag kyang log nas 'gro sa med pas/ 'dir zhabs drung du 'dug chog pa mkhyen zhus byung pa na/ dam pa 'dis thugs dgongs la snga mor 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i drung du gdan sa chen po'i gnas mjal la byon chog pa zhus pa'i skabs su/ da lam ma 'gro/ slar cher gtad 'byon mi dgos zhar la 'khor ba zhig 'ong gsungs byung ba de/ 'di nyid mkhyen cing dgongs pa'i lung bstan rang du 'dug snyam pa'i thugs la dad pa dang nges shes lhag par 'khrungs bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ slar rje'i gsung gis/ sprul sku ba khyed gtan nas mi gsan na/ spyir 'gro ba las 'os mi 'dug kyang gang ltar nged rang mos pa'i bla ma zhig da lta slas pa rdzong chung na bzhugs yod pa'i de'i drung du bslab bya zhu ba la phyin chog pa dgos gsungs nas dpon slob nyung shas zhig gi shar stabs su phyag phebs te/ rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa nyid la sngar gyi gnas tshul rnams 'bul bar mdzad pa na/ rje de nyid kyis kyang thugs dges pa'i gsung las/ rang re chos pa rnams 'jig rten gyi dpon la ltos mi dgos pa yin na'ang / zhabs drung rgyan mchog rin po che'i bka' bzhin ma sgrub na/

rang re btsun pa'i lugs 'di sa skya pa gong ma'i chos kyi bka' drin yin pa dang / khong gdung brgyud gzhan dang mi 'dra ba de ka'i bka' la ma brtsis na dam sel du yang 'gro nyen yod pas/ da lam cis kyang 'byon pa legs shing / nged rgan po gom pa gnyis gsum re 'gro mi nus pa 'di pa la'ang sa skya gong ma tsam gyi bka' byung na 'gro ba las 'os ci yod gsungs pa sogs zhal kur dang 'dres pa'i gsung mang po byon cing / phyag dpe mang po dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin dpag med dang bcas 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya mtha' dag lhug stsol du stsal ba'i mod la/ da ni khyed rang 'phrin las rim gyis nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhig 'ong pas/ de la gzhan gyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi gnod pa 'dra byung nyen yod pas thugs dam srung 'khor la nan tan mdzad dgos shing / deng sang ngor tshor ni 'jigs byed drug bcu pa rang la 'chol ba zhig yod 'dug ste/ sngon chos rje lha mchog pa ngor gyi gdan sa la bzhugs skabs/ gzhan phyogs na grub mtha'i kun slong gi dbang las byad ka'i mnal ltas 'ga' re byung pa la dgongs/ thog mar uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bsrung bzlog dang / 'phags pa'i khro bcu'i bskul sogs gnang rjes/ gshed dmar bsnyen song 'ga' res 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog 'phrin las char 'bebs nang ltar thog mar gnang bas mnal lam 'gyur ches che ba'i thugs nges shes lhag par 'khrungs shing / tshogs su bka' lung byon pa la yang / na ning sde pa seng ge rtse nas 'di tshor dgos med kyi snyad 'dogs mon pa'i rgyab skyor byung dus dbang khang du gtor sgrub zhag sbrel dang 'brel bar gsang ba'i mchod gtor nub gcig ma rang gis don mthong byung yang / da res kyi byad ka bod stong 'di la thog mar zhi bas e bzlog snyam/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen/ seng gdong ma'i phyir bzlog uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i sbyar bzlog uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i bzlog pa rnams rim can byas kyang /

rmi ltas 'gyur ba zhig ma byung pa la/ kha gtsang gi 'jigs byed drug cu pa lan gcig po de rang gis cho phya~Xd byung bas/ da 'dir sku rim la drug cu pa rgyun ldan zhig 'dzugs dgos pa snang bas/ khyed bsnyen pa nus pa su 'dug rang la bla brang nas mthun rkyen sgrub gsungs pa dang rjes 'brel/ dbang khang du 'jigs byed ra lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang cha gcig gnang nas bsnyen sgrub pa 'ga' re byung / bsnyen pa bar chad med par 'grub rjes/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen drung gin nā len+d+ra/ mus rta mo gling ga thub bstan rnams su phyag bzhes 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i rgyun steng nas phyag len sogs bkod 'brel mdzad/ 'di la byung na rdo rje 'chang chen po rang gi dbus gong ma'i sku rim la sne gdong rtser dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan sogs phyag phyir bkra shis pa'i drug cu pa mdzad dus kyi tho dang phyag bzhes mthong brgyud gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta la mnga' bar 'dug pa nas glo bo mkhan chen drung du rtsad gcod zhus pas/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i drung du gu ge tshor dge ldan pa'i mig sngar 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i phyag bzhes kyang gnang ba'i lo rgyus 'dug cing / de mthun chos rje na mo sku mched pas kyang yang yang bzhi sder gnang ba'i mchod g.yog pa bla ma brag la ba zer ba zhig ding sang 'di rang na yod pas rtsad gcod gnang bas khyab/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos glo bor gdan chags ring ni gtan nas ma gnang / sku rim byad bzlog khag chen gang dgos la gdugs dkar can rang gi phyir bzlog kho na mdzad pas nged rang gi rim gro khag che ba kun la yang 'di ka sgrub kyin yod/ lar zhal dang las gshin rwa gnyan 'gras pa'i stabs kas mi mthun par grags shing / e wam̐ gyi dgon pa'i bka' gtad dpal mgon zhal la gnang ba'i phyag g.yog rang rje paṇ+ḍi tas gnang / gtsug lag khang gtod pa'i cho ga sogs mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang /

de dus 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho ba la khyed kyi dgon gnas 'dis 'gram bting ba man nas dka' ba dang len la phug gi rgya ri tsam la brten nas gnang zhing / snar thang pa'i snyad rtser kun gyi ngo len yang thugs la btags pas drin gsob 'di 'bul gsungs sku rkyang la dpal mgon gyi rjes gnang lung zhal shes ma lus pa rdzogs pa rang zhig gnang / de dus paṇ+ḍi tas bdag la yang gnang dgos zhus pas/ khyed rang gis sngar bla ma zla ri ba sangs rgyas shes rab pa la thob pa des chog gsungs nas gnang du ma gsan pa la yang yang snyan gtser bas/ a tsa ra 'dis gso mi gsod du 'jug par gnang gsungs nas sngags kyi bzlas lung tsam mdzad pa gsan yig tu yang bkod yod lags pas/ rje rdo rje 'chang rang mya ngan 'das zhing gi gnas mchog ka drug ma der rgyu rlon lda ldi sogs kyi gtor bshoms 'jigs 'jigs gnang ba yang blos mi dpogs gsung ba byung zhing / sngar gsungs pa'i bla ma brag la ba bos nas dbyangs 'dra'i zhus dag byas kyang khong bzhed pa 'dra ba'i khung chod pa zhig ma byung / da lta'i dbyangs skad 'di la las gshin la ya brgyad tshang ba sogs shes byed bag tsam las yid ches thub pa rang gi tig dan khel ba mi 'dug kyang 'di ka las 'os mi 'dug gsung zer ba thos/ phyis ni 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa dang drug cu pa dar rgyas rang la song yod pa gda'/ gang ltar rang re mus pa rnams sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gnyis kyi srung 'khor dang / gur gyi mgon po'i srung zlog sogs las zab pa'i man ngag gzhan la blo ltos 'chol mi dgos nges pa yin pas/ de bzhin thugs la zhog mdzod gsungs pa sogs phyi nang gi gnas tshul zhib mo blang dor gyi snying po'i gnad sogs mtha' rgyas su gnang zhing / bdag cag gi bla ma 'dis kyang rje chos dbang phyug nyid kyi zhabs gnyis dbu gtsug tu bkod pa'i dpal ldan bla ma sku tshe brtan pa dang /

rang nyid thugs bsam thams cad chos dang mthun par mthar phyin te bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa sogs kyi smon lam thugs yid tshim par mdzad nas/ de nas ring por ma lon par gdan sa chen po'i phyogs su phyag bteg ste/ rim gyis dpal ldan sa skyar phebs pa na/ dpon slob rnams lha khang chen mo'i nub byang g.yul thang gi mgo der 'byor pa'i tshe/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyis sku'i nye 'khor ba zhig gnang byung nas/ do nub sgo rum du bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes zhar la rten mjal gnang ba'i tal mar bde chen gling gi bla brang du phebs pa dang / sang nyin rang re mjal ba yin no gsungs byung ba bzhin rje nyid kyis de 'phral gzim spyil dkar por phebs pa'i bse mgon chen po'i drung du phyag mdzad pa na/ ye shes mgon po'i sku de nyid kyi snyan dar gyi khrod nas bkras thags bzang ba spus gtsang zhig mi'i lag gis 'phangs pa ltar bdag nyid chen po'i sku mdun du rgyang gis byung pa la/ zhabs drung na yod pa kun ngo mtshar du gyur cing / de dus sprul sku mgon tshe ba yang phyag phyi la yod pas/ sku las snyan dar babs pa 'di 'dra re re tsam ma gtogs mi 'byung bas rten 'brel bzang / snyan dar de rje rin po che rang bsnam pa zhu/ gong ma'i zhabs drung du snyan 'bul nged rang gis phul bas chog ces zhus pa bzhin de bzhin du mdzad do zhes thos la/ 'di lta bu ni rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs zhi khro rab 'byams rnams dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa la bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi gtso bo nyid kyis kyang gus 'dud mdzad par gdon mi za ba snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so/ /de nas gsang sngags bde chen gling gi bla brang du de nub bzhugs pa'i sang nyin lha chen phun tshogs gling na dpal sa skya'i chos kyi mngon par mtho ba'i khri thog na bzhugs pa'i sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs grags pa'i mtshan can mjal bar mdzad pas/

dpon slob de snga nas yun ring 'dris pa lta bu'i phan tshun nang gtsang zhing thugs 'gol ba'i bka' lung bag phebs pa gnang ba dang / 'phral yang sku mdzes shing brjid chags pa/ gsung dal zhing 'phrod par smra ba/ thugs 'jam zhing des pa'i ngang tshul can de gzigs pa na rje 'di'i thugs la/ 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba'i snang tshul 'ong nges par rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul yin zer ba de don la gnas par 'dug snyam pa'i dad mos dang / sa skya pa'i thugs zhen gyis thugs bde ba tshad med pa byung gsungs shing / de nas sras yum gzhan rnams dang dges par mjal te/ re zhig gi bar la thugs dam bcad rgya dam pa zhig la bzhugs pa'i ring nas/ de phyogs kyi skye bo blo ldan rnams kyis rje 'di'i rnam thar bzang po rnams mthong zhing thos pa'i rkyen byas gdan sa chen po'i skya ser drag zhan thams cad mgrin gcig tu dad cing 'dun par gyur te phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu gyur pa yin la/ de nas bdag nyid chen po 'di dgung gi lo lnga bcur son pa khong bu'am rtsub mo zhes pa lcags mo yos kyi lo gsar du shar ba na/ gtso bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos bka' phebs gnang ba dang / gzhan yang don gnyer gyi skye bo mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor gdan sa chen po'i chos rje brgya dpon/ las chen rnam gnyis/ chos sde lho byang / rin chen sgang pa chos 'khor lhun po ba sogs kyi chos nyan rags bsdus sum brgya lhag tsam zhig la dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse rnying mar rje btsun sa skya pa chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi 'khrul pa med pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel bcas pa dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dge legs su mdzad pa'i rgyun ding sang gi bar du gnas pa rnams kyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa stobs bcu'i dbang phyug dpal mgon bi ru pa'i bzhed gzhung gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang ste/

de yang man ngag rnams kyi bshad pa mtha' chod cing rgyas la nyams len 'khyer bde zhing 'dril ba/ cha lag phra mo tshun dang bcas pa gdul bya so so'i 'dod pa dang 'tshams par stsal cing / gsung ngag grol nas rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa brgya phrag lhag tsam mdzad do/ /gzhan yang dbang dang rjes gnang lung la sogs pa don gnyer su byung dus khor yug tu stsol ba'i ngang nas/ skabs mtshams rnams su rje 'dis yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang dang / 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi dbang / dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang sogs zab chos 'ga' zhig nod par mdzad cing / lo de'i dbyar char shin tu dkon pa la/ de phyogs chos sde so so man ngag pa du ma dang bcas pas thabs gang byas kyang ma phebs pa na/ gong ma rin po che'i bka' gnang ba la brten nas rje 'dis char 'bebs mdzad pas nyin zhag bzhi'i bar du char chen po babs pas/ de phyogs kyi skye bo thams cad dga' spro dpag tu med pa dang bcas da res kyi char 'di mus chen pas byin rlabs las byung ba yin yang dag go zhes sgrog par gyur cing / dgun gyi dus su snyung gnas kyi tshogs dbur phyag phebs nas de'i chos skor rnams rdzogs par gnang bas skye bo thams cad dad pa cher g.yos te 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba rnams phyed gong ma zhabs drung du dkar me'i cha rkyen la phul/ phyed dge 'dun rnams la stsal te/ de nas dga' ba zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lo rje nyid dgung lo nga gcig tu phebs pa na/ mus kyi dgon pa dga' ldan rtser khor tsam byon te/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams la yang ja dang gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad nas/ de 'phral slas pa rdzong na rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug bzhugs pa mjal pa la phebs pa'i sa skya phyogs su byung ba'i dngos po che phra thams cad phyag tu phul nas 'khor gsum yongs dag gi gsungs bsngo'i rgyas 'debs zhu bar mdzad ces thos la/

de nas rdzong dga' ldan rtser rgyang tsam bzhugs pa'i der yod kyi dge 'dun 'dus pa rnams la 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i de'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid dang bcas pa/ na ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ de'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ do pa lugs kyi gcod skor gsum gyi khrid rgyas pa/ de dag so so'i rgyab chos kyi lung cha tshang ba dang bcas pa smin rgyas su stsal nas/ slar gdan sa chen po'i phyogs su phyag phebs te/ gong ma rin po che yab rje chos kyi rgyal po sogs zhal ngo rnams dang mjal 'phrad dgos par mdzad nas/ dam pa 'di nyid dgung lo nga gnyis su son pa rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sbrul gyi lo'i dbyar zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar la gdan sa chen po'i brgya dpon/ las chen/ chos sde lho byang nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rags bsdus dang bcas pa'i chos nyan pa nyis brgya lhag tsam la 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs rnams thog mar stsal ba'i/ de nas bde mchog nag po pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa rdzogs rim dpyid thig gi khrid dang bcas pa/ na ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid zab mo/ de dag so so'i rgyab rten gyi yig cha so so'i lung yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa gnang nas/ lo de'i dgun gyi tshe/ sngar gyi chos zhu rnams kyi steng du slar yang don gnyer mang du 'dus pa'i tshogs pa bzhi brgyar nye ba la dpal sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying mar gsung ngag rin po che'i gzhung khrid rgyas pa so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa rdzogs pa dang / dge bshes rags bsdus rnams la cha lag rnams tshang bar stsal cing / gzhan yang grwa btsun brgya skor tsam la snyung gnas kyi chos skor rdzogs pa dang / kun rig gi dbang cha mang du gnang ba'i rjes 'brel kun rig cho ga'i bshad pa/

rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa'i steng nas bshad pa rgyas shing mtha' chod pa phyag rgya rnams kyi brda' sprod dang bcas pa zhib tu gnang zhing / gzhan yang rje btsun gyi gzhan phan bskor gsum dang / kun mkhyen gyi gzhan phan rnam gnyis sogs dang sbyar ba'i sbyong rgyud kyi bshad pa rgyas pa zhig stsal nas re zhig sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gong ma rin po che nas phebs sgo la rgyal rtse nas 'ongs pa'i grwa pa 'di rnams dam tshig gtsang ba sha stag yin pas/ khong rnams la zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang zhig do nub tshes brgyad sogs min yang gnang ba mdzod gsungs pa la/ rje nyid kyis kyang de bzhin phyag len mdzad pas/ de'i srod la sngar mus su mnal lam la byung ba'i ban chung rus pa'i rgyan dang dril bu g.yer kha btags pa de 'dra ba gnyis byung nas gar stabs ling ling dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mang po bstan nas yal song bas/ rje'i thugs la bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang / slob ma dam tshig gtsang na dus min la rjes gnang byas kyang 'gal ba mi 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs shing / yang lan cig nyer dgu zhig la gdan sa'i brgya dpon/ las chen sogs drag bsdus 'ga' la zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang 'ga' zhig mdzad pas/ de nub gzigs snang la bya nag che zhing snum pa gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig zhabs pus g.yon pa'i steng du babs nas na bza'i spu 'thog mchus gsol ba sogs byed cing yug cig 'dug nas mthar zhabs 'og tu mgo bo btsugs byung pas/ bdag nyid chen pos kyang gur gyi mgon po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i bka' bsgo zhig mdzad pas de 'phral bya nag de yal song zhing / dus phyis gsung las/ de dus kyi mthong snang de dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa shin tu dges pa'i rtags tsam du 'dug gsungs kyang / don la rje 'di la zhing skyong chen po nyid shin tu 'ches pa'i sgo nas gus shing 'dud pa bran g.yog gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa las gzhan du ma 'das so/

/de nas myos byed ces pa shing mo lug gi lo rje nyid dgung lo nga bzhir phebs pa la mus phyogs su phebs nas rdzong dga' ldan rtser re zhig bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pa de nyid dag pa'i zhing du gshegs nas de'i kha skad gsan ma thag rje nyid kyis myur bar phyag phebs te/ sku gdung rin po che'i chas zhugs zhabs tog bzhu la 'bul ba/ gdung rus tsha tshar 'debs pa sogs rkang len do dam cher mdzad cing / rang nyid kyi phyag rdzas dngos po yod do cog thams cad rje de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs su dmigs te/ mus nang gi dgon che chung rnams su mang ja bsnyen bkur rgya dpangs shin tu che ba bsgrubs pa dang / dbon po rnams la gnang sbyin bzang po stsal nas nang rten sku 'dra bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod sogs mdzad cing / de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du rang nyid mgon dang bral ba'i thugs las kyi rnam pa dpag med dang / spyan chab kyang chu bo'i rgyun ltar bsil ba sogs mdzad cing / sku gdung la yang dar chen kha brgya phrag longs pa'i snyan dar dang / dkar ma'i rgyun yang mar khal brgya tsam 'bul bar mdzad pa sogs dad gus kyi srid zhu ches che ba'i ngang nas rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa bsgrubs nas/ de nas brtsams te gang du bzhugs sar lo dus dang zla dus kyi mchod pa bla ma gzhan rnams las lhag tsam dang bcas pa ma chag pa mdzad do/ /de nas slar yang gdan sa chen por phyags phebs te/ gong bzhugs rnams dang dges par mjal nas/ skabs shig sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung du bskang gso zhag sbrel zhig gnang ba'i dus sgam nag gi rtsa bar bzhugs gdan mdzad nas thugs dam la zhugs pas bzlas pa mdzad pa'i bar la bse mgon gyi drung nas bya rgod kyi sgro phod la kha thags nag khra dang ser khra nyis sbrel btags pa zhig sku pang du babs byung bas/ de'i tshul yab rje chos kyi rgyal por 'bul bar mdzad pa na/

de nyid kyi gsung las/ sngon ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub la yang gos chen kha gang babs pa bsnams nas ngor gyi g.yab dar la yod pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pas/ da res kyang rje rin po che rang yang snyan dar de rnams bsnams nas g.yab dar mdzad na legs gsung ba byung bas dges spro chen po dang bcas de bzhin du mdzad pa yin gsungs shing / de lo yang dbyar gyi dus gdan sa'i bla ma slob dpon rnams kyis thog drangs de phyogs kyi grwa btsun skya ser rags bsdus shig la thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid gnang ba dang bstun chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gsung rab ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi lung stsal pas/ sngon gyi chos rgyal gyi mdzad pa rnams la rje nyid thugs dad lhag par g.yos te/ chos thun gnang re bzhin spyan chab bsil ba zhig byung zer la/ de dus sgrub pa ma rgyal mtshan gyis dmigs pa rnams snying rus chen pos bsgoms pas 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags mngon gyur du byung pa la rje nyid mnyes par grags shing / skabs shig nang so pu tra khang du thugs dam la phebs pas/ las mgon gyi sku las gos chen sngon po kha ma nyams pa cig babs byung ba/ gong ma rin po cher zhus pas/ de yang pu tra chen po'i dngos grub yin pas bsnams pa zhu gsungs pa bzhin de bzhin mdzad nas g.yab dar gyi khrod la 'dug pa dus phyis kho bos kyang mthong zhing / yang lan cig kha'u skyed lhas kyi dgon gnas dang lha khang mgon khang rnams mjal bar phebs pa'i tshe/ nangs par dpon slob rnams phebs pa'i do nub dgon pa'i dkon gnyer dge slong grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rmi lam du a tsa ra dpon g.yog bzhi byung nas mgon khang gi rten dang mchod rdzas/ phyi nang gi spyan gzigs thams cad nged la rtsis dgos zer blangs song ba rmis pa'i sang nyin rje rin po che 'khor bcas byon pa na/ dge slong pa na re/ nged la rmi lam de bzhin byung pas khyed dpon slob rnams 'jigs so zer ba la/

rje'i gsung gis/ de la 'jigs rgyu med/ nged rnams kyis kyang chos skyong la gtor ma re tsam phul ba'i rtags su gda' ba gsungs/ de nas thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i re zhig na mgon po bzhugs pa'i brag sgo nas phreng ba 'dra ba zhig rje nyid kyi sku pang du babs byung pa la gzigs pas/ mu men las byas pa'i phreng ba legs po zhig 'dug pa la/ gsung las/ 'di ni btsun rgan tshe mjug la kha don smar po zhig yong ba'i lung bstan du gda' gsungs shing dgyes tshor chen po mdzad kyin 'dug zer/ dus de nyid kyi tshe zhing skyong chen po bram ze'i gzugs can gyi sku dngos dang / de'i phyag mtshan ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba dngos su gzigs pa sogs rmad du byung ba'i gzigs snang khyad par can mang du byung bar gnang yang zur tsam ni gong du brjod pa ltar yin pas/ de ltar bdag cag gi bla ma 'dis gdan sa chen por snga phyir lan mang du byon pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du dam pa'i chos 'chad pa dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbu la phebs pa/ gzhan yang chos ldan gyi bya ba phran tshegs gnang ba'i skabs ma gtogs/ dus skabs thams cad du gsang sngags bde chen gi bla brang de nyid du thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs te phyag phyi ba rnams kyang gdan sa'i phyi skor la rdzong bar mdzad nas/ zhabs drung du g.yeng rkyen gang yang med par nyin mtshan khor yug tu bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la mnyam par 'jog pa mdzad pa na/ snod bcud tha mal pa 'di dag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs shing / de yang bde stong zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin du 'char ba sogs nyams rtogs ngo mtshar can mang po'i mtsho brdol nas/ thugs dam gyi bogs gzhan las ches che ba zhig byung bar mngon te/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ nged kyis sa skya'i bde chen gling gi bla brang der bsdad dus nyams len 'phel po byung bas/

lha khang chen mor dge 'dun gyi tshogs dbu sogs la 'gro ba'i dus snang ba sems yin snyam pa byas phyin pas/ de ma thag snang ba thams cad nyams snang du bun long 'char zhing / yang rlung po'i reg bya tsha mo lus la phog pa dang / dge 'dun gyi chos spyod kyi 'ur sgra chen po thos pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis da lta'i snang ba rang ga ba 'di dum re 'char/ yang nyams snang du 'gro sogs dge sbyor la bogs chen po byung ba de/ gdan sa chen po bla ma gong ma'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi gdung brgyud rgyun ma chad par bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs su gda' gsungs shing / de ltar bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i skabs der/ dam pa 'di nyid byang phyogs kyi 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon dang / gling ga chos kyis mtho ba'i pho brang gi rje btsun gong ma'i bzhugs gdan seng ge'i khri la rje nyid kyi zhabs zung myur du 'khod pa'i rten 'brel gyis dbang las/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po chos skyong rnams kyis bskul bas nyin gcig gsang sngags bde chen gling gi bla brang na thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i skabs/ gdan sa dan gyi khyi sgra rnams 'ur chems byed pa dang bcas sku mdun du mi nag 'jigs su rung ba zhig byung nas/ khyed bsam gtan phur thugs dam la mi 'byon pa 'di kho nar bzhugs pa yin nam zer byung bas/ rje nyid kyi thugs dgongs la/ sngar kha'u mgon khang du 'phreng ba 'bab lugs dang / da res kyi lung bstan gnyis ka mthun pa byung bas/ da ni sgom sgrub la bsgril ba zhig cis kyang legs rgyur 'dug pas/ de bzhin bya dgos rgyur 'dug dgongs nas gong ma sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid la thabs mkhas kyis dgongs pa 'grol bar mdzad pas/ re zhig zhu dka' se ba tsam la/ slad nas bde grol byung ste/

de nas mus la 'byon khar rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi drung du phyi phyag gi byin rlabs zhu ba sogs la phebs pas/ sngags 'chang nyid thugs shin tu 'phreng pa'i gsung gis/ rje rin po che khyed la gdan sa'i skya ser thams cad shin tu mos par 'dug pas/ lha 'phreng mi 'phreng gi 'tshub cha cung zad byung dogs pas phar lam chibs drel sogs la thugs rtog zhib pa mdzad dgos gsung ba sogs thugs nas mi phod pa'i gsung gleng du ma zhig gnang byung ba na/ rje nyid shin tu dges pa'i stobs kyis bzhad bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ bdag la sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur zhal sogs 'phreng nas 'tshub cha tsam byung na yang / lhas bsad na mtho ris thob kyi dper 'dug lags shing / gzhan ma gzugs med 'dra rjes 'brang byas byung na bdag gis bskyed rim zhig bsgoms pas lha 'dre rnams kyis 'ong ga la nus zhes zhus pas/ sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyang mchog tu dges pa'i ngang nas bzhad sgra du ma stsol bzhin pa dang bcas yang gsung las/ rje rin po che khyed zab chos rnams gnang ba la dam dog ran po zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pa de ngo mtshar che/ gzhan deng sang ci rigs shig la la chos gcig kyang mi 'chad la la bag chol du ston pa sogs sna tshogs shig yong gin 'dug spyir chos 'chad mang na sku tshe sogs la gnod pa'i kha skad 'dra yong gin 'dug pas ji ltar yin nam gsungs pa la/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ sngon ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la dkyil 'khor mi gcig pa zur bka' bdun bcu don bgrang tsam bzhugs shing / de rnams gang gi dbang bskur mdzad kyang dpe la ye gzigs mi dgos par de ma khad rang la mdzad pas chog pa sha stag yod 'dug cing / gzhan ma la la bya spyod la dkyil 'khor gcig yo ga la gcig pha rgyud ma rgyud la re re mngon dkyil tsam re blo la yod pa'i rigs 'gre ba gzhan la 'geb pa'am/

rdo rje 'phreng ba'i nang gi dbang bskur gyi zur bka' go chod pa byed pa lta bu ma yin pa dkyil 'khor gcig la yang brgyud pa'i bka' srol mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis phyag len la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du ma yod pa thams cad pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar ma 'dres pa mdzad pa gcig dgos rgyur 'dug pa la/ grags 'dod kyi dbang gis dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bskur grangs mang ba tsam la bzang por rlom pa la dgos pa chung zhing / bar chad kyi rgyur yang 'gro nyen che ba dang / yang snying nas chos don du gnyer ba la rang gi gang shes mi shod pa dang / gzhan mi 'dod bzhin du nan gyis chos ston pa la yang snying po mi 'dug lags mod/ sngon ngor gyi gdan sa mkhas grub dpal rdor ba'i gsung gis/ ding sang kha cig rang nyid kyi dbang bskur mang po byed ma thub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ dbang bskur tshe yi sag rdar yin zer ba mun sprul yin/ de 'dra ba gang nas kyang bshad pa med/ dus phyis bod gangs ri'i khrod na sa bzang 'phags pa las dbang bskur ba grangs mang ba med de/ dgung lo brgyad bcu rgya bgrang bzhugs pa yin no/ /nged rang yang lo bdun bcu don grangs tsam sdod pa'i rtsis yin gsungs shing / ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin dgung lo bdun bcu don gnyis tsam bzhugs 'dug pas/ gang ltar bsam sbyor rnam dag gis bla ma gong ma'i zhabs tog dang sems can gyi don/ bstan pa'i rgyun la phan du re ba'i sems bskyed chen po sogs kyi sgo nas chos 'chad nyan mang po byas kyang gegs chung zhing / rang gi dregs 'dod mkhas 'dod sogs kyi sgo nas byas na gegs che ba 'ong ba 'dra lags/ zhes zhu ba mdzad pas/ bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyang zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas nas ji ltar gsungs pa de bzhin rang du gda'o/ /zhes sogs dpon slob thugs nang shin tu dag pa'i gsung gleng mang po zhig dang / rje nyid la 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya du ma mdzad pa yin zhes thos la/

spyir yang sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid rje 'di la mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan du ma'i mdzod 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dri mas ma gos pa'i yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig 'dug go zhes bstod bkur bsngags gsum kho na gnang zhing dad gus dang thugs mthong shin tu che bar mdzad la/ dus phyis sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/ da ni nged kyi bla ma sngags 'chang chen po dang / spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje thar rtse ba rnams ni zhing brjes nas mi bzhugs pas/ tshe mjug 'di la nged rang la blo gtad thub pa'i bla ma zhal bzhugs pa gcig cis kyang dgos pa 'dug pas/ de la mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa 'di las 'os gzhan mi 'dug pas/ khong gis mdzad rogs byas na bla ma 'tshol ba la brtag pa sogs dgos rgyu mi 'dug ces yang yang gsung ba ni zhabs drung na gnas pa phal cher gyi thugs la gsal ba yin no/ /de nas rje nyid kyis gdan sa chen po nas chibs kyi kha lo rim gyis bsgyur te pho brang lha rtser phebs pa na/ de dus byang khri skor gsum gyi bdag po dpon sa mnga' bdag rgyal mo bzhugs 'dug pa la mjal bar byon skabs/ rje 'dis gsung gis rang re la yon tan gang yang med kyang gsang sngags bde chen gling gi gdan sa'i dbang gis dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal ngo rnams kyis bzhengs pa dang dbu thug sogs mdzad phyin/ nged kyis mnga' bdag rgyal mo la phyag dkyus ma sogs byas na/ sa skya pa'i sku'i che ba la gnod pa 'dug pas gsungs nas/ sku 'dud pa tsam lan gsum gnang ba'i ldem mjal 'dra ba zhig mdzad pas/ de dus mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i phyag phyir yod pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang / dpon rigs sogs blo gros dang ldan pa dag na re/ sngon ngor pa rdo rje 'chang sgal tshigs shin tu bzang bar grags shing sde dpon sogs la bstun 'jog gang yang mi mdzad/

chos don gnyer gyi snyom chung rnams la thugs rtsis shin tu che bar grags pa bzhin/ da lta'i gling ga'i chos rje shang pa 'di yang sgal tshigs bzang zhing chos dang mthun pa'i tshad du 'dug go zhes sgrog par gyur to/ /de nas rim pas mus kyi dgon pa dga' ldan rtser phebs te bzhugs pa na/ rje nyid kyi mnal lam du zla gcig tsam gyi bar la sa skya nas spyan 'dren pa brdzangs pa yin zer ba'i ban+dhe gzi brjid can 'khor du ma dang bcas pa zhig yang yang zhabs drung du byung pa na/ nyid kyi thugs la snga mor sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi gsung gis/ lha 'phreng mi 'phreng 'ong gsungs ba de yin par mkhyen nas/ sngags 'chang bla ma nyid rang dbu skra lcang lo nyil le ba dang bcas dbu gtsug tu bsgoms nas gsol 'debs drag tu mdzad pas/ rjes 'brang gi mtshan ma rnams rim gyis sang ba zhig byung bas/ sa skya bdag chen gyi thugs la gang yod pa de chos skyong rnams kyis sgrub pa'i rtags su 'dug gsungs shing / de nas rdzong dga' ldan rtse'i dgon pa'i grwa pa sogs phyogs kyi don gnyer du ma 'dus pa la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid smin rgyas su stsal te/ de dang 'brel ba'i sems bskyed/ rgyu lam gyi dbang sogs dang / lam zab/ bir bsrung sogs cha lag du ma dang / bla ma'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs/ lam 'bras glegs bam phyi nang gi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ lung la sogs te mdor na gsung ngag dang 'brel ba'i dbang khrid lung man ngag sogs ma tshang ba med pa stsal te/ der 'dus kyi gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i rgyal dbang khyod/ /gzhan ngor rang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i bka'/ /tshul bzhin sgrub phyir gzhan don sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /skal bzang 'dod dgu'i gter gyis dbul ba bsal/ /phun tshogs yongs 'du'i pho brang nyams dga' bar/

/rang srid chos bzhin skyong ba'i mi'i dbang po/ /'khor bcas mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ /dri med lam du 'jug pa'i dga' ston stsal/ /gzhan yang mkhas grub du ma'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /dga' ldan chos kyis mtho ba'i seng ge'i khrir/ /'dren pa mchog gi zhabs zung ngal gsos te/ /don gnyer lha bu'i tshogs la chos char phab/ /de tshe gang gi snyan grags lha yi rnga/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir yongs su bsgrags pa las/ /gangs can ri bo'i khong 'dir ma ga ta/ /chu shel 'dzin ma'i spo la rdo rje'i gdan/ /byang phyogs skye dgu'i dpal du 'phos 'dra ba'i/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i pho brang gtsug lag khang / /gang der rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /gos dkar lcang lo'i tshul gyis gsang chen skyong / /la la ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar gyis rol/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan srid mthar 'dzin pa la/ /sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i rnga gsang ni/ /khor yug ri bo'i bar du lhang nge ba/ /zhes sogs tshad ldan mkhas pas rab bsngags pa'i/ /gnas dang gang zag gzhan las phul byung ba/ /de lta'i gnas mchog dam par phyis dus su/ /sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi mas legs bskyed pa'i/ /gsang chen pad tshal bde ba chen po'i gling / /gang gi khyab bdag mgon por 'dren pa khyod/ /'jam dpal khyim pa'i zol gyis sgyu 'phrul mkhan/ /gang de'i thugs rje'i zer gyis nyer drangs te/ /de tshe don gnyer skal bzang rgya mtsho la/ /dges mdzad rdo rje'i smin grol lam bzang dang / /mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam/ /gzhan yang dbang khrid man ngag lung gi tshogs/ /bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa'i chos sbyin gyis/ /bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa che/ /dus der ming don ldan pa'i dge mtshan spel/ /gzhan gyi snang ngor 'jam pa'i dpal nyid gos dkar lcang los nyer mdzes shing / /he ru ka dpal rdo rje 'chang nyid ngur smrig gos kyi lhab lhub gsol/

/rnam gnyis sgyu ma'i sprul pas rol rtsed skal bzang mig gi dga' ston gyis/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gang gi bstan pa'i nyi ma gsar du shar/ /sprul pa sprul pa'i mchog khyed gnyis/ /srid 'dir srid mtha'i bar nyid du/ /gang la gang 'dul skur bstan pas/ /kun kyang kun tu drang du gsol// //brgyad pa slar yang zab mo sgom sgrub la g.yel med du bzhugs pa'i tshul ni/ rje nyid dgung lo nga bzhi bzhes pa'i dbu tsam nas gsang sngags bde chen gling gi gdan sa 'jog par mdzad de/ mus phyogs su phebs nas stong dpon zhal ngo rnams dang dgon pa'i grwa rigs sogs la rdzong dga' ldan rtse'i zhal 'dzin mi gnang ba'i bka' stsal nan chen phebs te/ sngar gdan sa chen por bzhugs skabs chos skyong gi lung bstan byung ba sogs thugs la bzhag nas/ yang dben dam pa bsam gtan phug gi gnas mchog tu phyi nang gi spros pa thams cad bcad de zab mo sgom sgrub la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ su dag nags khrod mngon par dga' ba yi/ /dge sbyong de yis shin tu bde ba myong / /zhes dang / tshul khrims yongs su dag par rab gnas te/ /bsam gtan bsam mi khyab la rtag gnas shing / /su dag nags khrod zhi bar dga' ba ni/ /de dag nam yang yid gnyis yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma gong mas byin gyis rlabs pa'i dben pa'i ri khrod ngo mtshar can de nyid du zab mo'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs can rnams la gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gong na med pa'i sgo nas nyams len la brtson par mdzad nas/ de la brten nas 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin me 'obs lta bu bde ba'i skabs med pa dang mi rtag cing g.yo ba'i rang bzhin nges pa med pa rmi lam gyi snang ba ltar gzigs pas 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rtog pa mtha' dag mkha' la sprin dwangs pa ltar song zhing /

de'i stobs kyis/ bung bas me tog sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /chos kyi don tsam blangs nas ni/ /kun la sngon chad ma mthong bzhin/ /'dris pa med par 'dug par bya/ /zhes dang / 'phrad na dga' bas mgu bya ste/ /'dres chen nyid du mi 'gyur ba/ /tha mal pa tsam nges par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thugs dam bug sgo can la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i skabs der/ sbyin bdag chen po mus stong dpon zhal ngo sogs 'jig rten na grags pa'i sde dpon gyi rigs dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs che btsun su gang la yang phar mthun 'jug dang ngo bsrung la sogs pa gtan nas mi mdzad cing / tshur zhabs kyi pad+mo la 'dud cing gus pas mchod pa na/ chos kyi bka' drin ci rigs pa stsal nas/ slar yang ngang pa pad+mo'i tshal du 'jug pa ltar thugs dam gyi rim pa nges pa can la rang dbang du 'jug pa las/ sus kyang cung zad tsam yang g.yo bar nus pa ma yin no/ /zhes de dus zhabs drung na yod pa kun gleng la/ rje'i gsung las kyang / nged kyis sa skya'i bde chen gling dang / rdzong dga' ldan rtse'i gdan sa bzhag nas bsam gtan phur sgrub pa la bzhugs dus thun mtshams tshun chad mi tshig gi bar ma chod pa yong du re ba'i nyams len la brtson par byas pas/ sngar nas yod pa'i nyams myong rnams zhan du ma song tsam dang / lhag par 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang / mi rtag pa drag po skyes nas blo khul che ba dang / 'jig rten chos brgyad la rang gis ngang gi blo log pa sogs la sngar dang ye mi 'dra ba'i bogs che ba rang zhig byung gsungs shing / de ltar rje nyid dgung lo nga bzhi pa bzhes pa'i lo sked tsam nas bzung / dgung gi lo nga drug tu son pa gser 'phyangs zhes pa me mo bya'i lo tshun gyi lo bzhi'i bar du g.yeng ba thams cad rgyang ring du spangs te/ zab yangs man ngag rgya mtsho'i bcud len la nan tan snying por mdzad pa la brten/ shing rta'i srol du ma las byung ba'i gdams pa mang po'i so so'i nyams myong mtha' yas pa zhig thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing /

lhag par zab mo'i yang rtse 'khor lo bde mchog gi lam gyi nying khu sa skya pa'i mchog sgrub pa'i dmar mo skor gsum gyi nang tshan nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor dang / khyad par 'pho ba'i man ngag la lo gcig tsam gyi ring la nyams len chig bsgril gyi tshul du rtag 'grus su mdzad pas/ thog mar zla ba gcig tsam gyi bar du dbu'i spyi gtsug za ba dang / de nas dbu gtsug ting phor sgong zhabs kyi tshad tsam 'phar ba de yang cung zad skrang nyams dang bcas phyag dang na bza' sogs kyis reg pa'i rkyen gyis gtsug tor gyi dbus su nang na yar bu ga yod pa'i rtags cung zad skyong ba yod pa'i sa nas sku'i pags mo brdol te mtshal khrag dang chab ser 'dres ma rgyun du 'dzags yong ba zhig zla ba lnga tsam gyi bar la byung ba na/ der skabs dbu la zangs kyi gtor snod chung ngu zhig yod pa de bkab nas dbu zhwa bzhes pa zhig rgyun du mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ de dus zhabs drung na rje'i dbon po chung ngu zhig yod pa des/ zhabs drung gi dbu snyung ba 'di gang gi skyon yin/ phan pa'i thabs 'dra med pa lags sam zhus pa na/ rje nyid bzhad pa dang bcas/ snying re rje/ nged kyi mgo bo'i 'di 'pho ba sbyangs pas cung zad 'byongs pa'i rtags su 'dug ngas dgon pa rdzong gi gdan sa dang / gnas gsar nang pa'i bla ma de ma dgos pa yin na/ mi la ras pa dang cha 'dra ba tsam zhig 'ong ba yod de/ gzhan gyis kyang bsgoms na 'di ltar 'ong ba yin/ gzhan la ma zer cig gsungs byung pa la/ yang dbon pos/ da 'o na ji ltar mdzad lags zhus pas/ da lan cig 'pho ba sbyong ba glod nas dmigs pa ma chag tsam byas pas nam dgos dus gang 'dod 'pho thub pa'i don 'grub pa yin/ zhes gsung gi 'dug go zhes de skabs kyi dbon chung de da lta mus kyi sle lung dgon pa'i mkhan po'i khri thog na yod pa'i chos rje sangs rgyas rab brtan 'di yin pas khong rang gi ngag las dngos su thos pa bzhin bris pa yin/

'dir smras pa/ mgon khyod thos bsam sgom pa mthar son pas/ /dpag med yon tan mdzod la dbang bsgyur yang / /skal bzang rnams kyi spyad bya 'di yin zhes/ /kun gyis rtogs phyir slar yang sgrub la bzhol/ /mkhas grub zhal gyi bum bzang las 'ongs pa'i/ /yang zab gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /tshim par rol bas zab gsal ting 'dzin gyis/ /kun tu myos pas bde stong dpal la spyad/ /de ltar rab zab gsang chen rgya mtsho'i yon tan kun la dbang 'byor pa/ /khyod 'dra sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul na te lo na ro bir+wa'i zhabs/ /gangs can khrod 'dir sa skya'i rje btsun kun dga' snying po yab sras nas/ /chos rje khu dbon tshogs grub la sogs brgyud 'dzin rim par byon rnams dang / snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog gyur sngags 'chang chos rje yab sras tsam/ e ma ho/ mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan khyod dang khyod 'dra de dag kun/ /sku gsum go 'phang mngon du mdzad kyang gzhan ngor rtag tu sgrub la brtson/ /de phyir rjes 'jug skal bzang rnams kyang dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba spangs nas rtag tu nyams len brtson par rigs/ /rab tu mi zad 'khor ba'i gnas la yid 'byung nas/ /rab tu dben pa'i nags tshal ri khrod nyams dga' bar/ /rab tu brtson pas gcig tu sgrub la gzhol ba 'di/ /rab tu rmad byung dam pa kun gyi rnam par yin/ /gang sku lhag pa'i lha yi 'khor lor gsal/ /gsal ba de gsung grag stong rang bzhin sngags/ /sngags kyi myur lam 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags/ /rtags mtshan ngo mtshar kun gyi mngon du gyur/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i rtsa ba rab brtan zhing / /bsam byung rig pa'i lo 'dab rnam par rgyas/ /sgom pa ting 'dzin 'bras bu'i khur gyis brjid/ /bstan 'dzin dpag bsam dbang po 'di ngo mtshar/ /'ching grol 'ching ba'i 'jigs pa las/ /thar kyang thar 'dod zol gyi gar/

/mig ldan mig gi dga' ston 'di/ /gzhan ngor gzhan la ston par mdzad// //dgu pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa kun gyi rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba'i tshul ni/ de yang rje nyid dgung gi lo lnga bcu nga bdun du son pa rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi'i lo gsar du shar ba na/ sngon 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtshos gling gar lam 'bras gsung dus shig ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan gyi tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di 'dzin mkhan la rag las pa yin pas/ nged kyi dgon pa gling ga 'di las gzhan gyi ci 'dra yong mi shes pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su chos rje shangs pas skyaga~X re bskyed dgos so zhes gsungs pa dang / yang zab don nai gu chos drug gi khrid gnang ba'i skabs shig nyin zhig chos nyan pa gzhan rnams 'tshogs pa'i rjes su rje 'di cung zad lus pas thugs 'tshab pa dang bcas byin rlabs myur bar zhus pa na/ de kar sdod gsungs pa la/ rje 'dis bzhugs khri'i 'og gi sa stan bsal nas bzhugs pas/ rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho sku 'phar ba dang bcas gsung shugs drag pos/ der bsdad pas ci to/ nam phugs gdan 'di'i steng du yang yong dgos pa yin zhes gsungs byung pa na/ bdag gi bla ma 'di thugs shin tu 'jigs shing sku zil che bas sku la blta mi nus pa de nyin chos ma grol gyi bar tal mar byung gsungs pa dang / rje btsun dam pa chos dbang phyug pas kyang / nged las chos rje khyed rang gdul bya dang 'gro don 'phrin las rgya che ba yong bas sha ma bzhes na 'chad nyan sogs bstan pa'i khur mi theg pas bzhes dgos gsung ba sogs dang / rje rin chen chos 'phel gyi gsungs las kyang / rje 'di ma 'ongs pa na sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag che btsun kun gyis zhabs la gtugs nas sems dpa' chen po'i 'phrin las la phan nges pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug ces gsungs shing thugs dges spro dang bcas/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun chos kyi rje/

/zhes sogs kyi sku bstod 'di yang gnang bar grags pa dang / yang lan cig spyan snga 'jam dbyangs chen po'i gsung las/ chos rje shangs pa khyed rang sle lung chos sde'i mkhan po byas na/ gling ga'i gdan sa 'di mi yong ba zhig rten 'brel gyi dbang gis 'dug pas/ de bzhin gyi spang blang go ma log pa mdzad dgos zhes gsungs pa sogs bla ma dam pa rnams kyis rje nyid ma 'ongs par rgyal tshab bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur ba'i lung bstan gnang ba rnams mngon du gyur par nye ba na/ rje 'di bsam gtan phur thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig tho rangs kyi char mnal lam gyi tshul du rje rang nyid gling kha'i 'du khang chen mo'i bla ma gong ma'i bzhugs khri'i steng du na bza' bzang po dang bcas phebs kyin 'dug pa la/ dbu mdzad byang 'dren pa sogs dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig par rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi dbang gi le'u'i gzhung / dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gur gum gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs kyi tshig rnams 'ur chems chems 'don pa zhig byung bas/ de nas zhag gsum lon pa'i nyin/ byang phyogs lugs gnyis kyis mtho ba'i rgyal khab chen po dpal ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang nas lha sras mnga' bdag phun tshogs rgyal mo dang / de'i sras sprul pa'i chos rgyal nam mkha' tshe dbang phun tshogs dbang gi rgyal po sras yum gnyis kyi phyag rtags/ bkod ja/ gnang skyes rgya dpangs che ba mi sna zung sbrel dang bcas 'byor pa'i phebs don la/ snyigs dus kyi skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la dgongs nas 'debs par mdzad pa'i gling dga' bde ba can gyi chos grwa chen po'i dgon ma bu rnams kyi gdan sa bkod pa'i 'os chos kyi rje rin po che khyed kho na yin pa/

de phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon grwa rigs sbyin bdag rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gleng byung ba ltar/ nged rnams kyi bsam pa dang yang mthun byung ba bzhin/ da lam gdan sa'i bkod bzhag la ngos ma 'di pa ched gtad brdzangs pa/ chos rje pas kyang dgon ma bu rnams kyi 'dzin skyong dang / lhag par chos 'chad nyan gyi khur bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus las gzhan du ma song ba dgos tshul sogs kyi phyag rtags zhib pa dang / sku tshab ngos ma rnams kyis bka' ngag rgyas pa rnams rje nyid kyi snyan du phul bas/ dam pa 'dis gsung gis/ spyir nged la lugs gnyis kyi shes rgya gang yang med pas dgon gnas kyi 'dzin skyong sogs nus pa'i re ba med kyang / 'on kyang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' drin bsab pa dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po'i bka' mi bzlog pa'i phyir bstan pa la phan du re nas lo kha cig gi bar gdan sa'i ming btags tsam zhig byed pa las 'os ma 'das pa lags sam/ zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin/ khyi lo zla ba dgu pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad gza' dang / skar ma dang / sbyor ba dang / byed pa bzang po 'dzom pa'i nyin sa gsum gyi skye dgu ma lus pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po/ kha ba'i ljongs kyi mkhas pa dang grub pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i mkhyen rab dang / 'gro ba kun la rgyu med par mnyes bzhin pa'i dmigs med kyi thugs rje zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas skal bzang gi 'gro ba nor 'dzin gyi rdul grangs las rgal ba thar pa mchog gi gling du bkri ba'i ded dpon rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na mngon par mtho ba de nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu rgyal sras sa bcu'i byang sems 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi bzhugs gdan seng ge'i khri dpangs yangs par zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo can mngon par bkod de/

der bzhugs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen kha ba'i ljongs kyi chen po mtha' dag gi ral pa'i nags klung du/ zhabs sen zla dbang gsar pa'i zlos gar gyis brtsen par 'os pa'i mkhas btsun du mas thog drangs gnyug mar gnas pa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag lnga tsam dang bcas pas lhan cig tu shis brjod kyi phreng ba ched du brjod cing / dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha mi kun gyis me tog sil ma'i char phab ste lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa kun gyi mgon skyabs dam par bstan 'dzin sa skyong yon bdag dang bcas pas mnga' gsol nas/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi rgyud kyi skye dgu thams cad mgon dang bcas pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar rje 'di khri thog tu phebs pa'i nyin de kho na la/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas sngags 'chang 'jam pa'i dbyangs grags pa'i mtshan can gyis dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu gsar sgrub kyi gnang sbyin gya nom pa phyag tu 'byor pas rje 'di shin tu dges pa'i gsung gis mdang nged kyi rmi lam du bsam gtan phu'i brag cig gi srub nas rje btsun grags pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu yin zer ba mang po nas phung tsam du ma thon nas/ de thams cad nas nged rang gis bzos shing tshags byas pa zhig byung bas/ de ring 'di 'ong ba la lta ba 'dug gsungs shing / 'di lta bu ni rje nyid 'chi med kyi rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i tshul gyis sku tshe mthar phyin zhing / gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu gyur pa'i dge mtshan gyi ltas bla na med pa yin par mngon la/ gzhan yang khri thog tu phebs kar bar lam du grwa pa zhig gis rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i rab gnas bkra shis rgya mtsho'i dpe zhig phul bas/ rten 'brel shin tu bzang gsungs nas de ma thag bstan bcos de nyid kyi lung tshogs pa rnams la gnang bar mdzad/ gzhan yang rje 'di la chos skyong gis 'phrin las sgrub pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas snga gong rje 'di bsam gtan phur bzhugs skabs/

gling kha dgon pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i bla brang gzim chung gi dkar khung smin mar gtan du sdod pa'i bya rog gnyis yod pa/ rje spyan snga ba gshegs rjes rje 'di'i bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug gi sgrub khang gi dkar khung steng du sdod pa zhig byung ba/ phyis rje 'di gling ga'i gdan sar phebs nas/ slar sngar bzhin bla brang gi dkar khung smin mar sdod pa de phyogs kyi skya ser mang pos mthun snang grub par mthong 'dug pas/ kun kyang ha las shing ngo mtshar ba zhig gtam du gleng ba yin no/ /de ltar rje bla ma 'di nyid skyes chen gong ma rnams kyi rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba nas bzung / byang phyogs kyi rgyud thams cad du char chu dus su 'bab pa/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs shing / mi nad phyugs nad kyi rgyun chad cing slar mi 'byung ba dang / dus kyi 'khrugs long thams cad zhi zhing / 'jig rten gyi mi dge ba thams cad rang zhir gyur nas/ kun kyang rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes thos la/ rje'i gsung las kyang / nged kyis gdan sa byas pa nas bzung / zla ba ngo re bzhin bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i gsang yig rgyas pa de sa skya gong ma'i phyag len dang mthun par ma chag par byas pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ rta mo lung pa 'dir lo re bzhin mi bsad re yong gin yod pa'i rgyun de chad song bas de tsam phan yon che ba byung zhes gsungs so/ /'dir smras pa/ sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yab/ /dpal ldan he ru ka dpal ngur smrig gi /bla gos 'dzin pa gang gi rgyal tshab tu/ /ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyi lung bstan bzhin/ /mi dbang 'khor lo bsgyur bas mnga' gsol te/ /'dzin ma'i khyon la spyod pa'i skye bo kun/ /dus der mgon dang ldan pa byas so zhes/ /snyan grags lha yi rnga sgra phyogs bcur g.yo/ /de tshe char chu dus babs lo phyugs legs/

/rims nad rgyun chad 'khyug long mu ge bral/ /kun kyang rdzogs ldan bde ba'i dpal la spyod/ /rje btsun nus pa'i gter 'di e ma mtshar/ /sngon tshe bstan pa'i gsal byed du ma'i zhabs zung bkod pa'i seng ge'i khrir/ /gang sku lhag pa'i lha yi rang bzhin nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'bar zhing / /'gag med gsung gis chos tshul sgo brgya'i bdud rtsi'i zil char rtag par phab/ /gang thugs bde gsal mi rtog ngang nas bstan 'gro'i don la lhag par gzhol/ /de tshe rgyal ba zas gtsang sras de slar yang zhing 'dir byon pa'am/ /yang na dga' ldan lha yi grong du byams pa mgon po'i dbu gtsug la/ /'o skol rnams kyi ston pa mchog 'dis cod pan bcings nas rgyal tshab tu/ /dbang bskur ji bzhin skal bzang lha dbang 'bum sde'i tshogs kyi mchod gnas gyur/ /lha yi lhar gyur sngon byon gong ma yi/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab nyi ma 'di shar bas/ /yongs 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung bzhed srol pad tshal rgyas par gyur/ /mus chen sems dpa' nor bu'i cod pan mchog /rnam 'dren khyod kyi dbu gtsug la 'phos pas/ /gling ga chos kyis mtho ba'i rgyal srid la/ /dbang bsgyur gzhan kun snying las chung ngur 'dug /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i srid chen por/ /mnga' mdzad 'khor los bsgyur dbang khyod/ /thub pa'i bstan la thub dbang ltar/ /ljongs 'dir kun kyang gtam du gleng // //bcu pa bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar bdag cag gis yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di nyid gling ga chos kyi mtho ba'i pho brang gi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhugs gdan mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i khri la rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol ba'i lo de'i dgun/ chos rje 'gar pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang / mus kyi stong dpon zhal ngo nang so rnam rgyal sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen byas/

gling ga'i tshogs chen dge 'dun 'dus pa bzhi brgya lhag tsam la rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi gtso bo gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag smin grol yongs su rdzogs pa/ cha lag rags rim/ so so'i skabs su babs pa'i lung gi brgyan pa dang bcas zhib cing mtha' chod par stsal pas/ de dus dge 'dun blo gsal mang pos/ bskyar chos dang zin thun mdzad pa du ma byung bas thugs dam mdzad pa dang slob gnyer ba kun la thugs bskyed rmad du byung byung ba yin no/ /zhes thos la/ gsung ngag gnang ba'i bar la dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag mang pos rje rin po cher ja gos dar sogs 'bul nod rgya dpangs che ba dang / dge 'dun bying la mang ja bsnyen bkur grangs mang zhing bzang ba sogs dpal 'byor longs spyod shin tu rgyas par byung zhing / gsung chos grol nas slas pa mdo'i zam chen 'dzugs pa'i zhal bkod sogs sems can la phan pa'i 'phrin las ci rigs pa mdzad cing / de nas rje 'di dgung lo nga brgyad du phebs pa sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag gi lo shar ba'i dgun chos su gling ga tshogs chen la/ tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i cung zad brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa rje btsun gong ma'i spyi rnam/ ljon shing / shar chen gyi dag ldan go sla rnams kyi steng nas bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa dka' gnad kyi dogs dpyod dang bcas pa zla ba kha shas kyi bar du gnang ste/ sa skya pa'i pha chos rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi bstan pa'i me ro rmangs nas bslong bar mdzad cing / de dus kyang dge 'dun blo gsal mang pos bskyar chos dang zin thun mdzad pa du ma byung bas skal bzang rnams kyi rnam dpyod kyi spobs pa rab tu rgyas par gyur pa yin la/ lo de'i dbyar rje nyid sku mtshams dam po la yun ring bzhugs shing / de'i bar la dbyar chos su bdag nyid chen pos bka' gnang ste/ chos rje zur 'chad pa bsod nams lhun grub kyis rje rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'bum pod bzhi ma'i lung gling ga'i grwa pa rags rim zhig la chos grwa zur du gnang bar mdzad cing /

de nas kun ldan zhes pa lcags pho byi ba'i lo rje 'di dgung lo nga dgur byon pa'i dgun chos la/ sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang bskur ba gling ga tshogs chen ma rdzogs kyi bar du dbang cha mang du bcad nas stsal cing / de nas kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i kun rig cho ga'i bshad pa rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa'i steng nas shin tu rgyas shing / ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i shan 'byed dgag sgrub zhib mo/ zhar byung phyag rgya 'cha' lugs kyi brda sbyor tshun chad 'dzoms par gnang nas/ de dag gi rgyab rten du sbyong rgyud kyi lung dang / de'i bshad pa gnang dus rje btsun gyi gzhan phan skor gsum dang / kun mkhyen gyi gzhan phan rnam gnyis sbyar ba'i bshad pa rlabs che zhing dka' gnad kyi phu thag chod par stsal nas/ gsung chos grol ba'i nyin rje'i gsung las/ da khyed rang rnams sa skya pa'i yab chos yo ga skor gyi rgyud man ngag la lag chung skyer bas chog pa yod do zhes gsungs byung bas dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams bzhad cha theg pa byung zer/ lo de'i dbyar zla ba lnga pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len gyi snying po skye med do pa chos shes nas brgyud pa'i gcod skor gsum gyi khrid gling ga tshogs chen la rgyas par stsal/ de rgyab brten du bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar nas bzung / gcod skor gyi pod chung yongs rdzogs/ dol pa legs rgyal gyi khrid yig chen mo'i lung sogs gnang zhing / de rjes gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang cha lan 'ga' stsal te/ grwa pa rags bsdus nyi shu rtsa lnga la gsang 'dus cho ga 'dzin pa'i zhal bkod kyang gnang ba'i dus de tsam nas bzung ste gling ga dgon pa'i gsang 'dus sgrub mchod kyi cho ga grwa je bzang du song ba yin no/ /zhes kyang thos la/ de nas rje 'di dgung gi lo drug cur son pa 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo gsar du shar ba'i dgun chos la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa'i lugs kyi dbang cha lan drug tsam stsal nas/

de nas blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid gnang ba'i rjes su lū hi pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa shin tu smin pa bskyar chos su stsal cing / de'i rgyab chos lung gi skor la/ grub chen gyi mngon par rtogs pa/ de'i 'grel pa/ phyi rol mchod chog gtor ma'i cho ga lag pa'i mchod pa ste lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ rje btsun gyi don 'grel chen mo/ gnyan gyi 'bru 'bum/ kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i lū nag gi sgrub thabs/ rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa/ rje btsun gyi nag po dkyil chog nag po bshad sbyar/ kha che rin chen rdo rje'i bkris la sogs te lung gi tshogs rab tu mang po gnang zhing / de nas don gnyer ba 'ga' zhig gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung stsal rjes/ lo de'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu la ya ma bde ldan gyi dgon gnas dam par dpon slob rags bsdus shig phyag phebs te/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams la kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang sngon du 'gro bas/ kun rig cho ga'i bshad pa dpag bsam ljon pa'i steng nas dang / de dang 'brel ba rje btsun gyi gzhan phan skor gsum/ kun mkhyen gyi gzhan phan rnam gnyis sogs sbyong rgyud dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa mthil phyin pa cho ga'i cha lag phyag rgya'i brda sbyor tshun chad zhib par stsal te/ slar zla ba dgu pa la gling ga bde ba can gyi dgon par phebs nas/ chu pho stag gi lo bdag nyid chen po dgung lo re gcig tu phebs pa shu bha kṛ tra ste dge byed kyi lo gsar du shar ba'i dgun chos la gling ga tshogs chen gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ gsung ngag rin po che shin tu rgyas pa sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i khrid/ de dag gi skabs su dgos pa'i dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed/ slob ma rjes bzung gi cho ga

yab yum gyi rgyu lam gyi dbang / lam zab dang bir srung phyi nang / bla ma rin 'byung / bla ma rgya bod kyi rnam thar so so/ gsung ngag glegs bam/ pu ti dmar chung gi lung la sogs te mdor na gsung ngag dang 'brel ba'i chos skor rnams phal cher rdzogs par zla ba gsum lhag tsam gyi bar du gnang nas/ lam 'bras kyi bka' chos grol 'phral rje nyid kyis mkhan po dang / chos rje sangs rgyas 'od zer/ dbon po rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas grags pa sogs kyi las slob/ gsang ston/ grib tshod/ grogs dan pa sogs mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang bas gling ga gzhir bzhugs dang phyogs nas 'dus pa'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs don du gnyer ba brgya phrag lhag long pa la bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i sdom pa tshigs gsum rim pa can du gang la gang 'dod kyi tshul du stsal te/ sdom brtson ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshogs mang du skrun par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas bdag nyid chen po dgung lo re gnyis su son pa sho bha naḥste mdzes byed ces pa chu mo yos kyi lo shar tsam na rje nyid sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ tho rangs zhig 'od gsal gyi gzigs snang la mon pa dung long can gcig gis ban chung gnyis g.yog gnyis dang bcas rta drel mang po khrid byung nas/ mtshal gyis dam kha byas pa'i yi ge rgya ma zhig rje nyid kyi phyag tu gtad gnang byung bas/ de nas zhag gnyis 'das pa'i gsum pa'i nyin gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya nas sngags 'chang bla ma grags pa'i mtshan can gyi thugs dam gsung shog dang bcas gser mdog dbon po bsod nams rtse mo sku mched gnyis rdzong rta gnang ba'i khong spun 'di pa khams la 'gro ba'i ring ba 'dug pas lam 'bras bsdus tsam zhig gnang ba zhu/ zhes gsungs pa 'dug pa bzhin/ gser mdog pa sku mched kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun rags bsdus shig la gsung gzhung khrid/ cha lag cha tshang / so so'i skabs su dgos pa'i lung dang bcas pa zla ba gnyis tsam gyi bar la mgyogs bshad du gnang bas/

gser mdog dbon po rnams la ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan mang po sgrib med du stsal rjes/ khong dpon g.yog rnams gdan sa phyogs su thegs grub mtshams/ lo de'i dpyid chos su gling ga tshogs chen la sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang rjes gnang zur bka' mang po so so'i yig lung gis brgyan pa gnang zhing / de nas rje nyid dgung lo re gsum du phebs pa kro dhi ste khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug lo'i dgun zhig nyid kyi gsung las/ da lo gling ga tshogs su bde mchog dril bu pa dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub mchod 'dzugs dgos 'dug pas grwa pa rnams kyis so so'i sgrub dkyil la gzigs rtog mthar phyin pa mdzad dgos so gsungs nas/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang dang / tshe dpag med dze ta ri'i dbang cha lan mang du stsal nas/ lo de nyid kyi cho 'phrul zla ba la snga dro tshe dpag med dang / dgong mo bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub mchod zhag grangs du mar 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i tshogs dbu la rje rang nyid kyang phyag phebs te/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la mang ja gdan non/ bsnyen bkur 'bul nod sogs shin tu rgya dpangs che ba stsal cing / gzhan yang lo de nyid la gling ga dgon pa'i bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod bar skabs su cung zad nyams pa rnams la/ rje rang gi phyag rdzas kyi steng nas dge rgyun gyi theb gnang ste thams cad sor chug par mdzad cing / lhag par de dus gsung las/ gling ga dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang so so'i dkar me'i rgyun 'di rnams gzhan las bzang zhing / dkon mchog gi mchod pa'i nang nas kyang mchog tu 'dug pa la/ bar skabs su dkon gnyer ngan pa 'dra dang / dkar me'i las tshan ngan pa gras sdebs byas nas nyams chag chen po byung 'dug pa/ da phyin bla brang rang nas mi sna blo khel re dang / lha khang so so'i sku gnyer/ dkar me'i las tshan rnams gsum 'dzom gyi thog nas mar 'degs gcod bzhu ba/

lha khang so sor 'bul ba/ mar rdzogs nas mchod ong rnying pa len pa/ gsar pa sbar nas 'bul ba sogs bsgrigs la 'khyon pa bya dgos pa 'dug go zhes gsungs nas de bzhin du phyag len la thebs par mdzad pas/ rje bla ma 'di'i sku ring las dkar me'i rgyun bzang ba ma byung zhes dus mtshungs pa'i skye bo rnams mgrin gcig tu gleng ba thos shing / de nyid kyi rgyun da lta'i bar du ma nyams pa yod pa 'di yin la/ dus der gdan sa chen po nas chos las pa phun tshogs rin chen dpon slob 'ga' yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam dang bcas 'byor pa'i phebs don bzhin/ khong dpon slob rnams la gsung ngag lam 'bras cha lag rags bsdus dang bcas pa/ chos skyong so so'i rjes gnang / gur gyi mgon po'i phyi nang gi khrid sogs smin rgyas su stsol bar mdzad pa yin la/ de de'i skabs nas rje nyid sku mtshams dam pa zhig la bzhugs par dgongs pa gtad mtshams/ de nub mnal lam gyi tshul du rje nyid bsam gtan pha'i sgrub phug na bzhugs 'dug pa la mi dmar smug chen po zhig gis ban chung gzhon nu zhig khrid nas 'di la bka' chos mang po gnang dgos zhu ba la/ rje nyid kyis nged mtshams dam pa zhig bya rgyu yin pas/ chos 'chad mi thub gsungs pa na/ yang mi dmar smug de na re/ btsun chung 'di khyed kyi gsol ja sbyong ba'i sbyin bdag tu nged kyis yun ring mo nas bkug pa yin pas cis kyang mjal kha dang / 'dod chos gnang dgos zer byung bas/ de'i nangs par glo bur du thub bstan rnam rgyal nas rgya dar rtse mdo'i sa yang rgyal po'i zhal ngo chos rje kun dga' lhun grub zhabs drung du 'byor pas nai gu sogs 'dod chos mang po gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ chos rje de dang mus nas nang so rnam rgyal dpon g.yog mang ba/ gling ga'i grwa pa rags bsdus dang bcas pa la grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor nas brgyud pa'i nai gu chos drug gi byin rlabs so so sngon du 'gro ba'i khrid rnams nyams khrid kyi tshul du stsal zhing /

lung gi skor la brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun gyi rnam thar sogs bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar tshang ma dang / khrid yig zhal gdams man ngag gi skor sogs nai gu'i chos skor gyi glegs bam yongs rdzogs kyi lung / gzhan yang dbang dang byin rlabs rjes gnang gi rigs mang po sogs 'dod chos rnams blo kha tshim par stsal rjes/ rgya dar rtse mdo pa chos rje kun dga' lhun grub nyid khams phyogs la 'byon par chas te/ khong gi gsung las/ bdag 'brug lo 'di la bla ma sangs rgyas khyed lta bu dang mjal/ 'dod chos rnams rdzogs par thob/ da lan gcig yul du phyin te/ slar 'brug lo la zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba la cis kyang yong 'dod pa lags pas/ de bzhin don 'grub pa'i srung 'khor cis kyang mkhyen zhu ba la/ rje bla ma 'dis gsung gis/ chos rje khyed rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin slar dbus gtsang du 'byon thub pa zhig yong ba 'dug cing / de bar la'ang mi rgan yang ma shi tsam dang / khyed rang la yang gzhi byes gang du yang bar chad kyi rigs gtan nas mi 'ong zhes pa'i lung bstan lhug par gnang ba bzhin/ de nas chos rje khams phyogs su byon te/ lo re bzhin yang rje bla ma'i mchod ja'i rgyu nag po g.yang 'dzin khor drug re tsam rgyun ma chad par phul cing / de nas sngar gyi lung bstan bzhin dpon slob dngos su gling ga chos grwa zur du mjal ba'i skabs/ rtse ja bar khag bco brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul ba kho bo cag zhabs drung na yod pas dngos su mthong la/ des na gong du bkod pa'i rje bla ma'i mnal lam gyi mi dmar smug de sa skya ba'i dbang bsdud kyi lha nor sbyin dzam bha la dmar po nyid yin par mngon no/ /de ltar chos rje kun dga' lhun grub kyis gsol ba btab pa'i 'dod chos rnams gnang grub mtshams/ ngor nas ched gtad 'ongs pa'i grwa pa mang pos zhus pas rkyen byas gling ga tshogs chen la gshed dmar lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te dbang cha lan mang du stsal cing /

de nas lo de'i sa ga zla ba la byang nas yum chen mo dpon sa lha gcig mnga' bdag phun tshogs rgyal mo glo bur du zhing gshegs nas/ de'i dgongs rdzogs chen mo'i skabs/ gling ga nas dpon slob bdun bcu/ ya ma bde ldan dgon pa nas sum cu dang bcas pa'i yongs sdom brgya phrag gcig ngam ring rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs pa dgos pa'i chos rgyal chen pos phyag rtags byung ba bzhin dpon slob rnams kyis mgyogs par bshar stabs kyi tshul du phyag phebs pa na/ de dus mi dbang chen po'i phyag nas yum gyi mtshan byang rgya shog sngon po'i logs la gser yig gis mtshan pa dang / rigs drug gi sa bon/ pad+ma/ 'phan gdugs sogs bris pa re re/ dgon pa so so nas byon pa'i dpon slob rnams la tha dad du gnang nas yum sku gshegs de nyid kyi lam ston dmigs su 'gro ba mdzad dgos tshul gsungs byung pa la/ rje bla ma 'di'i gsung las/ spyir chos rgyal chen po'i gsungs bzhin sgrub pa gzhir bcas shing / 'on kyang byang 'bru la 'das po rang gi ming byang 'dri ba bshad tshod kun dang mthun zhing / 'phan gdugs pad+ma sogs 'dri ba rgyud nas ma bshad kyang / 'on kyang gshin po de lhar bskyed dgos pas 'phan gdugs pad+ma sogs mchod pa'i bye brag tu 'gyur bas bris kyang 'gal ba med par sems la/ rigs drug gi sa bon byang bu la bri ba ngan song sbyong rgyud dang / khyad par sa skya pa'i gsung rab gang nas kyang bshad pa ma mthong bas ma dag pa lags zhes sogs kyi lung rigs kyi zhu 'phrin rgyas pa dang bcas sngar gyi rigs drug gi sa bon rnams bsubs nas phul bas sde bdag chen po yang thugs shin tu dges pa'i gsung gis/ thar pa'i lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen zol zog dang bral ba de gling ga mkhan chen 'di kho nar 'dug go zhes zhabs 'bring pa rnams la yang yang gsungs par grags shing / de nas mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i dgongs rdzogs grol nas zla ba drug pa la gling ga phyogs su phyag phebs pa'i tshur lam slas pa mdo'i zam pa la phyag nas mdzad de dgon par phebs pa na/

der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams la mang ja dang / sku 'gyed kyi gnang sbyin rgya dpang che ba gnang zhing / de nas rje 'di dgung lo re bzhir phebs pa bi shwa ra suḥste sna tshogs dbyig ces pa shing mo sbrul gyi lo gsar du shar ba na/ gling ga dgon pa'i grwa pa skyes stobs kyi shes rab che ba rnams la dag ljon spyi gsum/ kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun/ sdom gsum rab dbye sogs la thos bsam bya dgos pa'i bka' stsal dang bcas so sor phogs rgyag sogs gnang sbyin gya nom par gnang nas slob gnyer gyi grwa bzang po 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i rgyun da lta'i bar du yang ma nyam pa yod pa 'di yin la/ de nas lo de'i dbyar chos la rje nyid chos grwa zur du gdan chags nas gling ga tshogs chen la 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa bskyar chos su gnang zhing / rgyab chos kyi lung gi skor la nag po gzhung drug sa skya pa chen po'i nag 'bum/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod dang bcas pa'i bshad lung / rje bzang po dpal pa dang / rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi mdzad pa'i bde mchog phyogs kyi yig skor mang po'i lung rnams stsal cing / lo de nyid kyi ston ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang nas mi dbang chen pos spyan 'dren gyi phyag dam byung pa bzhin/ rje nyid dpon slob nyi shu rtsa grangs shig phyag phebs te/ mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i dgongs rdzogs su gsar du bzhengs pa'i dngul gdung khyad par can la 'khor lo bde mchog la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dngos sta 'brel ba'i sgo nas smin rgyas su mdzad cing / de dus rab ston chen mo'i skabs grub mtha' mi gcig pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su bdag cag gi rje bla ma 'dis/

spyir rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rgyud dang rgya gzhung tshad ldan las bshad tshul/ khyad par sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams dang mkhas pa gzhan gyi bzhed pa'i srol so so ma 'dres pa gsungs nas/ de la mkhas rlom gzhan dag gi log par rtog pa mtha' dag lung rigs rnam dag gis sun dbyung ba dang bcas sngon chad mkhas pa dag gi blo ngor ma shar ba'i legs bshad kyi tshogs mu mtha' med pa rnams dpal gyi mgul nas 'phrul gyi ljags brkyangs te yun ring po'i bar 'doms par mdzad pa na/ sbyin bdag chos rgyal chen po dpon blon rnams dang dgon gnas so so nas byon pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs sogs der yod kyi skye bo blo ldan thams cad dga' zhing mgu nas dang 'dod kyi dad pa lhag par 'phel te gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang zhig 'dzin par gyur to/ /zhes thos la/ de nas ba ra bha baḥste zil gnon zhes grags pa me pho rta'i lo rje nyid dgung gi lo drug cu rtsa lngar son pa na/ ngam ring rgyal khab chen po nas gling ga phyogs su phyag phebs te/ tshur lam rdzong dga' ldan rtser 'gyang tsam bzhugs nas/ der 'dus kyi dge 'dun rnams la nai gu chos drug gi byin rlabs khrid rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa cha tshang bar bstsal te/ de nas gling ga dgon par phebs 'phral tshogs chos la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid gnang nas de dang 'brel ba'i lung la jo bos rgyal srid spangs nas thar pa bsgrubs pa'i rnam thar jo bo rang gis mdzad pa/ lam yig chos kyi 'byung gnas 'brom ston pas mdzad pa sogs dang / gzhan yang mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos sogs rgyas par stsal nas/ lo de'i dbyar bde mchog dril bu rim lnga'i khrid cig gnang bar bzhed pa la/ de mtshams ngam ring nas chos rgyal chen pos dbu zhwa paṇa zhwa legs pa/ rtse ja khor gsum sogs gnang skyes bzang po dang bcas dbyar 'dir sku rim srung 'khor ched gtad gnang dgos pa'i snyan 'bul byung ba bzhin rje 'dis kyang zla ba gsum gyi ring la sku 'tshams dam par bcad de gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor la rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/

mi dbang dpon blon chab 'bangs dang bcas pa dus kyi sku chag las bskyabs pa'i mtshan ma mngon gyur du shar zhing / de nas ston gyi dus la babs pa na rje bla ma nyid chos rgyal chen pos ngam ring du spyan drangs te yum phun tshogs rgyal mo'i sku gdung la bzhu 'bul gnang dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ rje dpon slob rags bsdus shig gis gtsang rgya sder phyag phebs nas mnga' bdag rgyal mo'i spur bzhu ba/ gdung rus tsha tshar 'debs pa sogs sa bdag chen po'i dgongs pa'i re ba yongs su khengs par mdzad de gling ga phyogs su phebs par bzhed pa na/ de dus sku grib la brten pa'i zhabs la snyung gzhi thu mo zhig byung pa la/ rje rang nyid ni snang ba thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul las gzhan du ma 'das par mkhyen pas/ snyung zug sogs gang la yang der 'dzin med pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang du rgyun du 'jog pa zhig mdzad kyin 'dug go zhes de dus zhabs drung na yod pa'i rgyus can thams cad mgrin gcig tu gleng la/ 'on kyang gdul bya dman mos rnams kyi snang ngor spyi sger gyi sku rim rgya dpangs che ba bsgrubs pas rkyen byas skye dgu rnams kyi bsod nams kyi mthu la brten sku khams myur du gzhi med du dwangs te/ ngam ring nas sde srid lcam sring / dgon so so'i bla ma slob dpon/ sbyin bdag grwa rigs sogs kyis zhal dkar gyi 'bul snod rgya cher bsgrubs shing / de nas pra baṅga ste spre'u zhes grags pa me mo lug gi lo rje nyid dgung lo re drug tu phebs pa na/ gzhan ngor snyung gzhi las grol bas grwa bu slob rnams kyis dga' spro dpag tu med pas/ so so nas dga' ston gyi nom par zhu bzhin pa dang bcas gling gar phyag phebs nas 'gyang tsam sku mtshams dam pa zhig la bzhugs shing / de nas lo de'i ston thub bstan yangs can nas bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa dpon slob rags bsdus shig bde mchog sogs kyi gsung chos don gnyer gyis zhabs drung du phyag phebs nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/

thog mar 'khor lo bde mchog lū hi pa lugs kyi dbang gnang nas/ de'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum dang bcas pa'i khrid/ rgyab chos lū hi pa'i smad lnga sogs kyi lung dang / bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas de'i khrid yongs rdzogs yig cha so so'i lung dang bcas pa/ bde mchog gi rdzogs rim rim bzhi'i khrid/ de'i yig cha gsar rnying gi lung sogs gnang nas/ de nas rje nyid bde mchog nag po lugs kyi gsung bsnyen kha gso la bzhugs pa'i bar la/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas gling ga dgon pa'i grwa pa rags bsdus shig la sgrol dkar tshe sbyin dpal mo/ gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad dang khro bcu'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas/ rje tshar pa nas brgyud pa'i srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i phyi nang gsang ba'i khrid rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang zhing / de nas rje bla ma'i sku mtshams grol 'phral 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ de'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa/ sems 'dzin gyi khrid/ rdzogs rim dpyid thig dang bcas pa la zab bshad rgyas pa bskyar chos su gnang nas/ de dus mkhan chen nyid kyis rje bla ma'i gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i bde mchog spyi bshad chen mo/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad rgyas bsdus gnyis sogs yig cha khyad par can de rnams kyang mdzad pa yin la/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i lung gi skor la/ nag po gzhung drug dril bu gzhung gsum sogs rgya gzhung mang po dang / sa skya pa'i nag 'bum yongs rdzogs/ rim bzhi lam slong / rdo rje 'chang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen rin po che rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi yig skor mang po'i lung / bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang bshad rgyud/ kun spyod gnyis kyi lung bshad sogs mtha' chod par stsal cing /

gzhan yang gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang / kye rdo rje'i rgyu dbang / lam dbang / tshe dpag med lugs gnyis kyi dbang sogs mkhan chen dpon slob rnams kyi thugs bzhed ltar gyi bka' chos rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ de nas skabs der rje bla ma nyid kyis mkhan po dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas las kyi slob dpon mdzad de/ gzhan gsang ston/ grib tshod/ grogs dan sogs gling ga dgon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'os su gyur pa rnams kyi kha skong dang bcas mus nang gi dgon yas mar gyi grwa rigs phal cher zhig 'dus pa la/ 'os su gyur pa rnams la bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang / gzhan rnams la dge tshul gyi sdom pa 'bogs pa sogs lan grangs mang du mdzad de/ mkhan slob nyi zla zung 'brel 'di gnyis kyis thub pa bka' drin can gyi bstan pa'i gzhi ma rmangs nas bslangs pa lta bu'i rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa zhig dus de nyid du bskrun pa yin no/ /de nas rje 'di nyid dgung gi lo re bdun du son pa kī la ka ste phur bu zhes pa sa pho sprel lo shar ba na rje nyid gling ga bla brang du sku mtshams dam pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe tho rangs kyi cha zhig mnal lam gyi tshul du rje btsun rin po che gsal bar byon nas/ sngon 'bras phul gang sbyin par btang ba'i rgyal po zhig gis khyed spyan 'dren du 'ong bas the tshom med par song zhig sems can mang po la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yod do zhes gsungs byung pas/ mnal sad pa na thugs la dges spro dpag med 'khrungs shing / ci yin nam snyam du dgongs pa'i tshe de nas zhag bco lnga lon pa na/ byang phyogs sham+bha la'i chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi bsti gnas pho brang chen po ka la pa dang chos mtshungs pa'i dpal ngam ring gi rgyal khab chen po nas mi'i dbang phyug dam pas mus smad pa nang so tshe brtan dpon g.yog rnams zhu yig zhu ngag nan chen dang bcas zhabs drung du 'byor pas sde srid zhal ngo rnams kyi dbu bla mdzad dgos pa'i snyan 'bul byung pa na/

rje'i gsung las/ khong gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i chos rgyal yin pas/ de'i bla ma yong ba'i gdeng nged la med kyang / 'on kyang rmi ltas bzang po zhig byung bas/ 'dod chos phran bu 'dra 'bul dgos pa yin nam zhes zhu dka' se ba zhig la zhal gyis bzhes tsam byung bar brten/ de nas yun ring ma lon par nang so phun tshogs dpon g.yog mang po ched gtad kyis spyan 'dren du 'byor byung pa dang bstun/ rje bla ma dpon slob rags bsdus shig gis rim gyis chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur nas ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du phyag phebs pa na/ chos rgyal chen po lcam sring rnams kyis gtso mdzad bka' blon chen po rnams dang / dmag dpon ru bzhi'i rta pa'i tshogs gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa dbyar dus ne'u gsing gi thang la me tog sna tshogs bkra ba ltar grangs dang tshad med pa dag gi bsu ba dang / ngam ring chos sde chen po'i slob dpon rnam pa dge 'dun rags bsdus dang bcas pas nyi zer gyi rdul la 'gran bzod pa lta bu'i mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa thogs pa'i ser 'phreng rgyas pa dang bcas pa'i spyan drangs te/ rgyal khab chen po'i yang rtse rigs ldan pho brang du gdan chags nas gza' skar bzang po 'dzom pa'i tshes la chos rgyal lcam sring rnams la thog mar tshe 'phel dkar po 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ slob dpon dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / grub pa'i rgyal mo lugs kyi tshe dbang sogs kyis thog drangs pa'i dgongs bzhed dang bstun pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi bdud ci yang zhig stsol bar mdzad nas/ de dus ngam ring na rje 'gyur med bde chen bzhugs pa'i skabs shig yin pas/ bdag cag gi bla ma 'di dam pa'i skyes bu su zhig la yang dag snang dang dad gus phyogs med du mnga' ba zhig yin pas/ rje 'gyur med drung du shang chos kyi bde mchog gi skor 'dra gsan par mdzad de phan tshun thugs nang shin tu dag pa'i ngang nas/

gsung gleng du ma zhig byung ba'i tshe bdag gi rje bla mas sngon mkhan chen chos dbang phyug pa de sa skya pa'i gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar gsung pa'i tshe spyan chab rang dbang med par gnang ba'i dad gus gzhan las che ba zhig yod tshul zhu bar mdzad pa na/ rje 'gyur med kyi zhal nas/ rang re'i bla ma gong ma rnams de 'dra mdzad pa zhig cis kyang yong ba yin pa gda' ste/ bdag gi bla ma rje grol mchog zhabs la bka' drin che shos kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa de/ sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams la mchog tu thugs dad che zhing gong ma'i gsung rab la yang gzhan las thugs rtog chug pa zhig yod 'dug pa/ rje mkhan chen pa de sa skyar phebs pa'i dus gcig sgo rum gyi rje btsun rin po che'i phyag dpe phal che ba la dkon gnyer dag la gnang sbyin yang dag pa stsal te gzigs rtog gnang bas/ sngon dus kyi ljon shing lcags smyug gi bris pa rtsom gdan rang yin nam snyam pa zhig gi nang na/ kun mkhyen rin po che la/ chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas da lta'i mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing rnams kyi nang na thun mong lta ba rim can gyi skabs na phreng chad yig 'phreng gcig tsam byung 'dug pa de ji ltar yin dris pa'i lan du/ kun mkhyen rin po ches/ de ltar 'phreng chad byung ba'i nges shes kho bo la yang skyes mod kyis/ tshig dngos su ma mthong ngo gsungs pa'i phreng chad de nyid legs par 'dod pa'i khams kyi sdug bsngal gyi chos nyid shes pa ni/ chos shes pa'i bzod pa yin la/ de nyid yid la nges par 'dzin pa ni chos shes pa'o/ /de bzhin du khams gong ma gnyis kyi yang de bzhin du shes pa ni rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang rjes su shes pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bden pa bzhi la bcu drug tu phye bas bco lnga ni mthong lam/ bcu drug pa dngos ni de las gong du bskyed du med pas bsgom lam mo/
