/zhes pa 'di nyid yin zhing / ljon shing gi lam gyi bcu drug ni bsgom lam byang chub kyi yan lag bdun po yin no/ /zhes pa dang / de la dang po kho nar 'dod pa na spyod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi chos nyid mthong ba'i zag med kyi shes pa de/ mthong spang gyi nyon mongs pa spongs bas/ chos shes pa'i bzod pa de rnam par grol ba mngon du byas/ zhes pa'i bar du 'jug rgyu yin no/ /rnyed pas dges pa chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su gtams par gyur cing / mkhas pa snga ma'i som nyi'i gnas su gyur pa mtha' dag sel ba'i sngon med kyi dga' ston nye bar spel bar mdzad cing / bstan pa la rjes su dgongs pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams ni 'di lta bu'i dam pa'i chos kyi lhag chad cung zad la yang thugs kyi zug rngur mdzad nas ji tsam pa'i dka' ba'i gnad la dring mi 'jog pa'i khur chen pos yongs su gsob par mdzad pa nyid yin te/ sngon gyi dus na rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis/ rgyal ba'i yum gyi 'dres rkang cung zad ma tshang ba de kho na gsob pa'i phyir du bal yul du phebs pa lta bu cha phra ba'i chos kyi phyir yang / shin tu dka' ba'i khur khyer bar bzod pa'i sngon byon gyi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams yongs su 'das pa'i dus kyi mtha'/ ding sang ni tshig 'bru phra mo lta zhog gi tshig don ma lus pa na bun bzhin du yal ba na yang / yid skyo ba zur tsam yang med pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bur rjes su rlom pa dag gi bgyi ba la mtshon pa na/ phreng chad kyi gnas phra mo gcig tsam gyi gnad dgongs pa la yang rab dga' thob pa'i rgyal sras bzhin du thugs rang pa dang / rgyal bu thams cad sgrol ltar dngos po thams cad la ma chags pa'i thugs kyis sgo rum gyi dkon gnyer dag la rnam par dag pa'i yid mgu ba bskyed pa'i sgo du mas bsam pa yongs su bskangs par mdzad pa dang / spyir yang rje glo bo mkhan chen pa 'di sa skya'i bla ma gong ma dag la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i phul ches che ba'i rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo'i stobs kyis gong ma phal gyi phyag bris dngos kyi phyag dpe yang grangs las 'das pa phyag tu yang bab cing /

rje grol mchog zhabs kyi gzigs pa la yang gcig pus na la rtser bris zer ba'i sa chen gyi phyag bris dngos kyi rtog bdun mchan sbyar zhig dang / sa paṇa gyi phyag bris yin gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi zin tho shin tu mang ba zhig gzigs 'dug cing / rgyun par zhabs drung na yod pa'i sku 'khor rnams la dgong ja'i skabs 'gar gsung bgros la/ e wam̐ chos ldan na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bris dngos kyi lam 'bras glegs bam gyi phyag dpe de dang / rang re'i lag na yod pa'i rje sa chen gyi phyag bris rtog bdun ma la 'gyur mchan bcas 'di gnyis shin tu 'dra ba 'dug cing / zhib tu dpyad na rje btsun so so'i phyag bris kyi babs yig 'bru'i tshugs re re nas en mi gcig par 'dug pas mig lam du byung na so sor ngo shes pa yod gsungs pa dang / yang de'i 'phros la e wam̐ na bzhugs pa'i glegs bam de nyid kyi ya glegs ma glegs phyi nang gi ri mo kun kyang rje btsun nyid kyi phyag bris dngos yin/ de yang ya glegs la bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti pa rnams yod pa'i/ bdag med ma la dbu skra ser po bum lto'i rnam pa can gtsug tu bcings pa/ gri gug thugs khar bzung zhing / thod khrag bzung ba'i phyag mdun ngos su brkyangs pa/ zhabs gnyis rol stabs su bzhugs shing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ thod skam lnga'i cod pan dang lnga bcu'i do shal yod pa/ bir+wa pa'i phyag g.yas na rwa gshor du chang bzung nas de'i rgyun zhal du gsol ba/ dbu skra thor tshugs sogs med pa'i co reg de'i 'og na gaṅgā gyen bzlog gi mtshon don gyi chu bo dang / lha rten bkas pa'i ling ga'i gzugs dang / lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i sku dang / slob ma'i mchog ḍom+bhi he ru ka stag la zhon pa tshon gang pa gcig zhal gyi thad na 'bu dang phye ma leb sogs srog chags phra mo'i gzugs brnyan kha re yang bris 'dug ste/

rnam thar zhing bkod du byas par 'dug gsungs/ bir+wa pa dang nag po pa gnyis ka sku mdog dud kha nag po ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rnam pa en kyang yod/ ḍā ma ru pa sku mdog mi sha kha dmar ba/ co reg las ral pa'i thor cog sogs med pa/ ḍā ma ru pa thod pa bsnams shing kha ṭ+wam̐ ga yang mchan khung na yod/ a wa dhu ti pa sku mdog dkar po rnam thar na yod pa'i byis pa dang rtsed mo rtse ba'i mtshon don yin pa 'dra/ sku 'khris na byis pa gcig kyang bris 'dug 'di yang dbu co reg la gtsug na ltag lhas lta bu'i dbu skra 'bur bar 'dug rgya gar gyi grub thob 'di rnams la stod g.yogs/ smad g.yogs sogs med pa'i sku gcer bu/ brang spu ring po o ko nas gsang sgo'i bar du son pa/ thad thad na mtshan rnams dbu can du btab yod/ ma glegs la ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ bse ston/ zhang ston/ sa chen rnams yod pa las/ ga ya dha ra paṇa zhwa dmar po/ na bza' dkar po/ sku mdog shin tu dkar ba/ zhal rgyan ag tshom nag po/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad mdzad pa/ 'brog mi dbu skra dang zhal rgyan dkar po la/ dbu la ga~X dkyil 'khor gyi mgu na ha ri lta bu/ sha 'gag chos gos sogs dge slong gi rnam pa zhabs lham sre bo zhig 'dug pa spu zon yin par snang gsungs/ bse ston nang la na bza' phu dung ma dmar po zhig dang / phyi lcam se dmar po gsol ba/ dbu skra ag tshom rnams nag po/ zhang ston dbu skra'i mtshams shin tu dma' zhing / dbu lo dkar ba/ phyag g.yas thugs kar chos 'chad dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag pang par mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos/ phyi la lcam se ser po/ de'i nang la spu'i ri mo 'dug pa ra thul yin nam gsungs/ sa chen nang la gos mchin kha/ phyi la lcam se dkar po gsol ba/ spu zon bsnams shing rol stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon thugs khar skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ bzhugs gdan grum se zhig snang zhing / mtshan rnams tha dad dbu can du btab yod cing /

mjug na bla ma rje btsun gyis dge bsnyen rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la byin gyis rlobs shig ces pa yang yod/ glegs shing gi phyi'i ri mo la pa tra dmar po'i dbus na ya glegs la rdo rje dang / ma glegs la rin po che bris yod pa'i mtshon don/ gsung ngag rin po che 'di nyid rdo rje ltar rtogs dka'/ rtogs na dgos 'dod stsol ba nor bu dang mtshungs pa'i dpe brjod yin pa 'dra/ rje btsun phyag bris dngos kyi glegs bam 'di'i mjug na/ rnal 'byor chen po mchog gi lam/ /yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa 'di/ /grags pas kun tu rnam khyab pa/ /sa skya'i mtshan dang ldan des mdzad/ /thams cad mkhyen pa yi ni rten gyur cing / /yon tan ma lus bskyed pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i/ /sa skya zhes bya'i gtsug lag khang chen du/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis gus pas blangs/ /sbyin par bya ba'i chos 'di rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi'o/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di glegs bam bying na mi snang / snga gong rtse gdong du dkar shākya grags kyi phyag dpe phyag bris ma gcig mthong ba de'i mjug na/ kun mkhyen brtse chen brtse ldan las 'ongs shing / /thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa'i lam/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'bras bu mchog ster ba'i/ /sa mchog rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang / /skya rengs lta bur yid du 'ong ba der/ /brjid ldan grags pa'i gsung gi rin chen gter/ /mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan rab thob rnal 'byor pa/ /zhabs pad la gus shākya grags kyis blangs/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di 'dug 'di gnyis dang e wam̐ na yod pa'i sa paṇa gyi yig mkhan rnal 'byor pa rdo rje grags kyis bris pa gsum ka yang tshig rigs en re mi mthun pa yang 'dug go gsungs shing / gzhan yang dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nyid na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun nyid kyi phyag bris dngos yin thang du grags pa la zhib tu gzigs nas bkod pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin du phra mo re re nas 'dri bar mdzad pa'i bri yig de yang rtsom par mdzad cing /

de'i mjug tu 'di skad du/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtse chen gang de'i sku/ /grub pa mchog gi bkod pa las 'ongs pa/ /shin tu dag par bya phyir tshul 'di yang / /ji bzhin mthong ba'i mod la ngas bkod do/ / ces 'byung zhing / mdor na dpal sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gnad zab mo la nan tan tu gzhan ngor shin tu zhib mo'i blo gros kyis spyod par mdzad pa lta zhog gi rje btsun gong ma de dag gi sku'i bkod pa cha shas re re la yang rjes su dgongs pa'i rnam grangs ri mo mkhan mkhas pa sku gzugs kyi tshad la rjes su rtog pa ltar mdzad do/ /gsung las kyang / bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni 'jig rten gyi tha snyad lug gdong du grags pa de nyid yin zhing / dbu skra ha cang dkar ba yang ma yin/ dbu skra'i spu ru 'khyil ba'i bar gyi cha la yang / dbu skra shin tu srab pa'i rgyun ma chad pa zhig yin thang la snang / slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo sku sha shin tu srab pa la zhal sgo dkyus ring ba cung zhig skyong ba'i rnam pa/ dbu skra 'then na snyan zhal tsam du sleb pa la/ da lta lug ru'i rnam pas snyan gong mi 'da' ba rang sor gnas pa/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan spyi babs zhal dkyus ring zhing shin tu bgres pa'i rnam pa can dbu lo dkar po gser mdangs bcas pa/ zhal rgya nyis sbrags 'ongs gsungs shing / zhang ston gyi bzhengs pa'i rje btsun gyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma lam skor dgu'i brgyud pas bskor ba e wam̐ na bzhugs pa/ de nyid la phyi mo byas pa'i bris thang zhig phyag bzhengs su mdzad pa da lta yang bzhugs/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen zhal dkyus ring zhing shangs rgyud bzang ba/ shangs dbus gzengs mtho ba/ dbu'i gtsug tor/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu sogs rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe'i spras pa zhig yin gsungs/ 'di nyid kyi gser sku/ blug ma/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/

sman ldig ras bris/ gyang ris sogs bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa/ gser gyi bris thang la sku brgya rtsa tshang ba'i sku sgrub pa/ yang dus nyin re la tshar re grub pa mdzad pa nyid yin la/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa ni sku'i dpal che zhing / sku 'gram dang snyan gong rgyas pa/ dbu skra'i mtshams shin tu dma' zhing / spyan dkyus ring la yangs pa/ zhal sgo thung ba/ rang bzhin gyi 'dzum nyams dang ldan pa zhig yin no gsungs shing / 'di nyid kyi sku yang chos rje sa paṇa dang zhal sprod du mdzad pa dang / logs su mdzad pa sogs bris thang gi bkod pa'i khyad par du ma dang ldan pa rjes su sgrub par mdzad cing / 'khrul zad kyi rje btsun yab sras khu dbon sangs rgyas dang gnyis su ma mchis pa de dag gis bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag pa'i sgo rum gyi rdo rje nag po chen po ghaṃ li mahā kā la nyid kyi spyan sngar mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor rgya chen po bshams nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' srol las byung ba'i lta grub khyad par can srid mtha'i bar du mi nub pa'i mkhyen gsol brgyud pa gong ma'i bka'i dam tshig rjes su bskul ba'i 'dod don gsol gdab kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i yi ge sgo rum gyi logs la btab ste/ de lta'i sgo nas chos srung rnams skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las la rjes su bskul ba'i tshul ston pa zhig yod 'dug pa sogs gang ltar rang re'i bla ma brgyud pa de rnams sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma'i rnam 'phrul lam rjes su bzung nges re yin 'dug pas bla ma la dad gus sogs gzhan las phul du byung ba'i rnam thar 'dzin pa rkyang byung bas/ rje chos dbang phyug pa rje btsun gong ma la gzhan las thugs dad che ba de yang de 'dra'i rigs su gda' bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su mchis lags mod/ ces rje 'gyur med kyis gsungs byung ba na/ bdag gi bla ma 'di'i thugs la rje rin po che 'di mkhyen rab shin tu zab pas/

bla ma gong ma'i zhal rgyun phra mo tshun thugs la nges shing / rang gzhan gyis chos kyi gnad mtha' dag gsal le gzigs pa'i mkhas pa phul du phyin pa zhig 'dug snyam du dgongs shing / gzhan yang rang bzhin gyi thugs dul ba dang / sgra snyan sogs rig gnas la sbyangs pa mthar phyin cing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug gi nyams len la byang chub pas nyams rtogs bzang po'i mnga' bdag tu bzhugs pa tshun nas nged kyang dus 'khor gyi chos skor cha tshang ba zhig rje 'di la zhu dgos pa 'dug snyam pa thugs la shar zhing / dus phyis kho bo cag zhabs drung na yod pa'i tshe yang / rje'i gsung las/ khyed rang sgra snyan sogs la gsan sbyong mdzad pa dang / dus 'khor sbyor drug nai gu sogs la gsan pa rgya che ba zhig mdzad par bzhed na/ ri bo che pa rje 'gyur med bde chen 'di kho na gsan yul gyi 'os rang na yod do zhes yang yang gsungs pa thos shing / de de'i skabs nas slar zla ba lnga pa'i nang du gling ga chos kyis mtho ba'i pho brang du phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ der bzhugs kyis dge 'dun rnams kyi ser phreng rgyas pas spyan drangs te re zhig sku mtshams la bzhugs shing / lo de'i dbyar sa nag pa sprul sku chos dpal ldan la zhal bkod mdzad nas 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang / mkhan chen chos dbang phyug gnyis kyi nang rten du bla ma de gnyis kyi sku mda' tshad lhag tsam re gsar du bzhengs nas/ de dag la stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs cha tshang ba/ gzhan byin rlabs kyi rten mang po/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bar gyi gzungs rdzong rnams phul nas gling ga bla brang gi lha khang steng ma'i lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong du bzhugs su gsol nas kye rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'khrigs shing me tog gi char kha ba ltar babs pas der yod kyi skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing /

de lo mus nang du sngar las kyang lo legs shing skya rgyal ba byung pas/ rten gsar bzhengs rnams kyi byin rlabs yin par thams cad mthun grub cing / de'i snyan grags phyogs kun tu grags par gyur cing / lo de'i ston gzhug tsam la ngam ring nas sde bdag chen pos spyan 'dren gyi mi sna byung nas rje dpon slob rags bsdus shig phyag phebs te/ chos kyi rgyal po lcam sring blon 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams la so so'i thugs 'dod dang bstun pa'i tshe bka' rigs du ma dang / rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon/ khyung khra/ khyung nag gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos mtha' dag rim bzhin stsal te/ de nas rje 'di dgung lo re brgyad bzhes pa so so myaḥste zhi ba zhes pa sa mo bya'i lo shar ba'i tshe/ rgyal khab de nyid du 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i gsung bsnyen kha gso mdzad pa grol ma thag sde srid zhal ngo rnams kyi gtso mdzad/ dpon drung tshe dbang sogs rig gnas dang gsung rab mang po la sbyangs pa'i khyim pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i rigs du ma dang / gzhan yang rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i drung 'khor nang so rnam pa mang po dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rigs la mtshal gung pa'i slob dpon chos rgyal mtshan/ rdzong dga' ldan rtse'i gdan sa 'jam dbyangs chos bzang / lo phu nas gdan sa pa kun dga' dpal 'byor/ gtsang 'bras spung gi slob dpon dbon po byams pa bkra shis/ bo dong rta mang pa'i chos rje rab 'byams pa sogs chos nyan pa bzang la mang ba 'dus pa rnams la 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod byin rlabs dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas bde mchog nag po lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid bshad pa shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod pa dang bcas pa gnang ste/ gsung chos grol ba'i nyin sde srid zhal ngo rnams kyis thog drangs der 'dus kun gyis chos yon gyi 'bul ba rgya dpangs che ba dang /

lhag par chos rgyal chen pos mus dge lung gi chos gzhis 'di yang de dus bde mchog gi chos yon du 'bul bar mdzad pa'i tshul gzhis dga' de rang gi phul yig tu gsal ba de yin la/ de nas rgyun mi ring ba zhig na dpal sa skya nas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis thugs dam gsung shog gnang ba'i phebs don la/ khams nas bdag chen kun legs pa'i drung gi phebs sgo la sa dkar 'dab 'dob gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i dgon mchod gzhis bdag chen rang gis 'dzin skyong mdzad bzhin pa yang nyin lam du ma'i bar yod pas 'di rnams kyi zhal bdag mdzad par sa skya nas gdung brgyud cig cis kyang 'byon dgos tshul yang yang byung pa bzhin/ khri thog pa rgan pa 'di 'gro ba'i 'os su mi 'dug kyang / khong rang gi thugs 'dod dang bstun da lo rang thon rtsis yin pas/ de gong du rab byung bsnyen rdzogs dang / 'dod chos 'dra zhu bar zhabs drung de kar yong rgyur 'dug pa/ ngam ring du byon na 'gor ches pas 'gyang dogs des na dpon slob phan tshun gnyis ka gtsang rgyas sder rtse 'joms gnang ba'i bzhed don rnams sgrub dgos tshul phebs 'dug par brten/ rje 'di'i gsung gis/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na rten 'brel 'chug pas/ cis kyang 'gro gsungs nas dpon slob rags bsdus shig gis shar stabs su gtsang rgyas sder byon pa na/ de 'phral sa skya nas bdag chen dpon slob rnams kyang phyags phebs te phan tshun mjal 'phrad phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang nas/ thog mar tshe bka' brgya tshar lan du ma dang / kye rdo rje'i rgyu dbang / lam dbang / bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad sogs rjes gnang gi rigs du ma zhig stsal nas/ rje bla ma 'di'i gsung las/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba la snga khyad gtan nas med pas/ lan cig khams la byon nas slar dbus gtsang du phebs dang bstun nas mdzad pas chog pa gda' zhes gsungs pa la/

'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug nyid kyis gsol ba nan cher btab pas/ rje'i gsung las/ da lam bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba ni gtan nas mi zab cing / thugs bzhed ltar gsol ba lhung bzed du bzhes pa dang / chos gos gra drug bzhes chog pa tsam la bar ma rab byung zhig phul kyang chog par 'dug ste/ lar mi gsan na dge tshul du sgrub pa zhig 'bul ba las 'os ci yod gsungs nas de bzhin du stsal cing / de dus ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan mang po dang / zang zing gi gnang skyes tshad med pa dang bcas 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya du ma nan tan du mdzad nas/ 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dpon slob rnams gdan sa phyogs su phyag phebs cing / de nas rje bla ma 'di slar yang sde bdag chen pos ngam ring du spyan drangs nas/ chos rgyal chen po yab yum dang / mus lung chung gi gdan sa pa dge 'dun dbang phyug sogs kyis thog drangs/ don gnyer rags bsdus shig la/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi khrid/ de'i lus dkyil gyi man ngag zab mo dang bcas pa/ yum la sbyar ba'i rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid rnams rgyas par gnang nas/ rgyab rten du nā ro pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung / rje btsun gong ma rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig cha du ma'i bshad lung sogs smin par gnang zhing / gzhan yang dge bshes do pa nas brgyud pa'i gcod skor gsum gyi khrid nyams khrid du stsal nas de dang 'brel ba la gcod skor pod chung gi lung yongs rdzogs/ khrid yig chen po do pa legs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas mtha' chod kyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang zhing / thugs rje chen po rigs mi 'dra ba du ma'i rjes gnang / mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi khrid/ de'i rgyab chos man ngag gi yi ge du ma'i lung dang bcas pa sogs mdor na mi dbang chen pos thog drangs de phyogs kyi don gnyer rnams la so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i skabs/

bzang ldan chos sde'i che bgres slob dpon rnams zhabs drung du byon nas/ sngon 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen dang / spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bzang ldan chos sde chen por gsung ngag rin po che'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bzhin/ rje rin po ches kyang de bzhin du gnang dgos pa'i gsol ba btab cing / sde srid zhabs drung nas kyang de dang mthun pa'i snyan 'bul nan chen byung pa na/ rje'i gsung las do nub bdag gi brtag pa zhig byas nas/ bzang chug byung na cis kyang byas pas yong 'dug pa'i phebs sgo gnang zhing / de'i nub mo mnal lam gyi brtag pa zhig mdzad pas ha cang bzang rgyu ma byung bar brten/ sang nyin sde srid mchod yon rnams drung du byon pa la gsung las/ bdag la dgon pa'i 'dzin bdag byed pa sogs gang la yang rmi lam bzang ngan gyi rtags re zhib par yong ba re yod kyang / mdang nub cung zad ngan pas da lam bzang ldan du lam 'bras byas na/ chos kyi ring la bar chad kyi rnam pas bdag rang la ngan pa mi 'dug kyang / grwa pa rnams la cung zad dog pa'i ltas shig byung pas/ da lan lam 'bras de grol cha zhu dgos pa 'dug ces bka' phebs pa bzhin mchod yon nas kyang dgongs sbyar zhus shing / lo de la bzang ldan chos sder jo nang sprul sku rin po ches lam 'bras gnang ba'i bar la rgya nad mig ser du grags pa'i nad ngan pas de phyogs phal cher khyab par byung nas/ chos nyan pa'i grwa pa mang po la yang shi chad byung bas/ slar rje nyid kyi mnal ltas la sde srid zhabs drung nas kyang thugs yid lhag par 'khrungs pa byung zhes chos kyi rgyal po de nyid rang gi gsung las dngos su thos shing / de nas slar gling ga chos kyis mtho ba'i pho brang du phebs pa na/ de 'phral tshogs chen la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid rgyas par gnang nas lung gi skor la/ blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus/

blo sbyong gi khrid yig dpal ye ma/ bka' gdams pha chos bu chos rnams stsal cing / slar dge 'dun rags bsdus shig la bde mchog dril bu rim lnga'i rdzogs rim gyi khrid dang / rgya gzhung dril bu gzhung gsum gyi lung sogs gnang nas lo de'i ston thub bstan yangs pa can nas bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ mus dga' ldan rtse nas chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs chos bzang / lung chung rdo rje gling nas rje dge 'dun dbang phyug rnams zhabs drung du 'dod chos zhu bar phebs pa 'dzom pa'i tshe rje bla ma 'di mkhan po dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas las slob/ gzhan chos rje gnyis kyis gsang ston grib tshod sogs mdzad cing / gzhan grogs dan kha skong gling ga'i chos rje sangs rgyas 'od zer sogs kyis mdzad de/ gling ga ya ma/ sle lung / rdzong dga' ldan rtse sogs nas 'dus pa'i don gnyer rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'os su gyur pa rnams la bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa dang / gzhan thams cad la dge tshul gyi sdom pa bskyar nas gnang zhing / de dus rab byung gsar du zhu ba yang shin tu mang ba byung bas mus nang gi dgon pa thams cad rab tu byung ba'i gang zag gis go mtshams med par gang ba'i tshul gyis kun mkhyen bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas rje dge 'dun dbang phyug pas thog drangs gling ga'i dge bshes rags bsdus shig la tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa dang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang / gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid/ de dang 'brel ba'i rgya bod kyi yig cha mang po'i lung sogs rgyas par stsal nas/ de nas rje 'di dgung lo re dgur phebs pa thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo hril por dben gnas bsam gtan phug tu g.yeng ba thams cad rgyang ring du spangs te thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pas/

sngar gyi nyams rtogs kyi rgyun bzang po la me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa ltar je gsal dang je rgyas su gyur pas rje nyid kyang thugs shin tu rangs par gyur pa yin zhes de dus zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams mgrin gcig pa'i ngag las thos so/ /de nas 'gal byed kyi lo gsar du shar ba'i rje 'di dgung gi lo bdun cur son pa lcags mo phag gi lo la slar yang chos rgyal chen pos dpal ngam ring gi pho brang chen por spyan drangs pa bzhin phyag phebs te sde srid zhal ngo dpon blon 'khor bcas rnams la tshe bka' rjes gnang sogs rkyen sel gyi bka' chos ci rigs pa zhig stsal nas/ de nas rgyun mi ring ba zhig rigs ldan pho brang du chos rgyal chen po'i sku rim srung 'khor gyi slad du sku mtshams dam pa zhig la rgyangs tsam bzhugs nas de grol 'phral sde srid zhal ngo lcam sring yum sras/ chos sde spyi khang pa/ dge slong mchog grub/ ya ga chos sding bla ma chos rje dkon rgyal ba/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phrin las pa sogs ngam ring chos sde chen po'i slob dpon rags bsdus shig dang bcas pa la sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang sogs zab rgyas gsung gi bdud rtsi 'ga' zhig stsal nas/ de mtshams mi dbang chen po nyid dpal ldan lha rtse'i pho brang chen por thub bstan yangs pa can nas bla tshogs rnams chos dbar la byon pa'i zhabs tog sogs la phyags phebs nas/ de'i ring la rje bla ma 'dis ngam ring du rje btsun ngag dbang drung / dpon sa yum sras/ gling ga nas byon pa'i dge 'dun nyer gcig brag dkar chu bzang pa dge slong pang don sogs der 'dus mang po la dpal kyai rdo rje bka' babs bzhi'i dbang dang don gnyer 'ga' zhig la lam dbang yang gnang nas/ de rjes gling ga'i grwa pa sum cu skor la gzhung bshad sras don ma'i bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa zin thun bskyar chos su gnang nas/ de dang rjes 'brel gzhung bshad smar ma'i lung sogs zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo mu mtha' med pa zhig bskor bar mdzad cing /

de nas zla ba drug pa tsam la sde srid chen po lha rtse nas slar ngam ring du phebs pa'i tshe/ gling ga dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis bde mchog rtsa rgyud la bsgrigs 'don mdzad pa na/ mi dbang chen po'i gsung gis/ sngar yan ngam ring du bde mchog rtsa rgyud la bsgrigs 'don mdzad mkhan ma byung bas shin tu ngo mtshar che gsungs pa sogs dges dges dpag med dang bcas zhabs tog rgya chen po stsal zhing / de nas slar yang rje 'dis sde srid zhal ngo rnams la tshe bka' rjes gnang sogs gang la gang 'tshams gnang nas/ zla ba dgu pa tsam la chibs kyi kha lo mus phyogs su bsgyur te/ rim gyis ya ma bde ldan gyi dgon par phyag phebs cing / de dang dus mtshungs par dus zing gi dbang gis sde srid chen po yang lha dbang rtse sogs su phebs par mdzad pa yin la/ de dus bdag gi bla ma 'di ya ma spang chung gi la la phebs pa'i skabs su chibs thog de kar mnal dang 'od gsal 'dres pa'i gzigs snang la/ sde srid zhabs drung dbu skra nyil zhing mi rkyang rta rkyang gi rnam pas thugs nyam thag pa'i tshul gyis/ bdag gzhan phyogs kyi mchod yon gras sdebs kyis bton byung pas/ rje bla ma khyed la mgon skyabs zhu ba la 'ong ba yin gsungs byung pas/ rje 'di'i thugs la mi bzod pa cher 'khrungs shing / de nub kho na la mnal ltas dang bstun pa'i sku rim rgya dpangs che ba zhig mdzad dgos pa'i snyan 'bul gyi thugs dam zhib rgyas dang bcas rkang mgyogs shig chos rgyal chen po'i zhabs drung du cher gtad rdzong rta gnang ba yin no/ /zhes thos la/ 'di lta bu ni byi glang gnyis kyi lo shar ba na/ gtsang byang / nyang stod dbus sogs 'khrugs pa'i sde gzar khyon chen po langs pa la brten/ gung thang rgyal po/ yar rgyab dpon chen/ rgyal rtse ba/ rin spungs ba/ g.yas ru byang pa sogs rgyal srid dang bral ba'i dus kyi 'gyur ba ma zad pa de lta bu myur du 'char ba rje 'dis 'od gsal gyi ngang nas sgrib med du gzigs pas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du snang la/

de nas dpon slob rnams kyis ya ma bde ldan nas phyag bteg ste gling ga chos kyis mtho ba'i pho brang du phebs pa'i tshe/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gser phreng rgyas pas spyan drangs shing / de de'i skabs nas rgyal mkhar rtse nas ched gtad 'byor pa'i chos ram pa dpon slob rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ khong rnams dang gzhan yang chos don gnyer gyi grwa pa mang ba zhig la 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ gur mgon lha brgyad dang khro bcu'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas/ srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i khrid rgyas pa/ rgyab chos kyi lung la sogs pa so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa ci yang zhig stsol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ e ma mchog gzigs gong ma'i chos kyi grwar/ /e ma don gnyer 'dus pa'i skal bzang la/ /e ma gang la gang 'dul gzhan phan gyi/ /e ma 'phrin las yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gsung / /mtha' yas zab rgyas chos tshul las 'ongs pa'i/ /dpag yas 'gro blo'i dbul ba sel ba yi/ /bsam yas chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher spel/ /byang phyogs gsang chen theg pa'i mdzod chen po/ /dbang lung man ngag dpal 'byor 'bum 'khyil ba'i/ /gling ga mkhas grub 'du ba'i do ra der/ /chos kyi nyi ma brgya phrag dus gcig shar/ /dus der 'jig rten 'di na yon tan dang / /dpal 'byor rigs kyis che ba'i mi'i dbang phyug /mkhas btsun yongs 'du'i chos grwa du ma nas/ /mang thos blo gsal dad ldan 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /kun kyang ma bsdus rang bzhin ngang gis 'dus/ /'dus pa kun kyang rnam grol lam la bkod/ /bkod pa dang 'grogs bstan pa ches cher 'phel/ /'phel bas kun kyang thar pa'i lam sna zin/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /dbang gi las bsgrub nor sbyin dzam+bha la/ /des kyang rje btsun khyed la btung ba'i mchog

/snyed pa'i mchod pas bu slob ring nas bkug /skye dgu kun dang khyad par byang khri zhabs/ /brtse bas skyong ba'i nus ldan dbang mo de/ /zhing gzhan gshegs tshe sgrib sbyong cho ga brgyas/ /mtho ris thar pa'i bde la 'god par mdzad/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog gi rigs kyi bdag /yongs 'dzin dam pa zung gi sku'i snang brnyan/ /gsar du sgrub la bkris rab gnas kyis/ /'gro la bde skyid dpal yon ci yang stsal/ /byang phyogs rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po che/ /lcam sring blon 'bangs bcas pas mgon khyod zhabs/ /spyi bor blangs nas gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gsol bas kun kyang mi phyed dad la bkod/ /sa skyong bsod nams stobs ldan pho brang cher/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan khyod byon pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa dus gcig tu/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs rgyud 'di dar ba snyam/ /'khon gyi gdung rigs 'od dkar ma nyams pa'i/ /mthu stobs bsam yas 'phrin las dbang phyug mchog /zhabs 'bring bcas pa'ang ji ltar bzhed pa'i don/ /mtshams par stsal pas snyan pas phyogs kun khyab/ /zas gtsang sras dang nyan thos mchog zung ltar/ /rje btsun bla ma mkhan slob mtshan ldan gyis/ /sdom phrug sdom brtson dam pa ngur smrig gi /bla gos 'dzin pa nyi zer rdul tsam bskrun/ /ma 'ong mkhyen pa'i ye shes spyan gsal pos/ /dus ngan 'gyur ba'i snang tshul ston pa'i cha/ /gsal bar gzigs nas de nyid bzlog pa'i thabs/ /mdzod ces mi dbang mchog la bskul bar mdzad/ /de lta mod kyis rgyal ba'i gsung rab las/ /rang gi sngon bsags las ngan 'bras bu de/ /myong bas 'dzad kyis thabs gzhan gyis ma yin/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i don de mngon sum bzhin/ /kye ma snyigs ma'i 'gro ba kun/ /kun kyang bde ba'i go skabs bral/ /bral kyang dge la spro ba dkon/ /dkon pa 'di kun snying rje'i yul// //bcu gcig pa spros pa thams cad bcad de gcig tu dben pa la gzhol ba'i tshul ni/

de de'i skabs nas rje 'di dgung lo don gcig tu son pa yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo shar ba na/ dbus gtsang gi khyon 'dir mi zad pa'i sde 'khrug chen po glo bur du langs te/ thog mar gtsang dpung lha rtser bteg pa'i rkyen gyis/ chos rgyal chen po g.yas ru byang pa'i mtshan byus kyi rkang ma zin pa'i dbang las/ de nas rim gyis bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal mkhar rtse pa/ rin spungs pa/ dbus nas yar rgyab dpon chen/ stod mnga' ris kyi gung thang rgyal po sogs dang / de dag gi chab 'bangs su gtogs pa'i rgyal phran mang po dang bcas par yul nas don bud/ chab srid la bcad 'bras sogs byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di'i 'gro ba mtha' dag mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal drag pos dus gcig la mnar bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis dmigs med kyi thugs rje'i rlabs chen po drag tu g.yos pa'i ngang nas bstan pa bstan 'dzin dgon gnas dang bcas pa'i sku rim du dmigs nas gling ga tshogs chen gyis rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog chos skyong rnams la bskang gso gtor sgrub/ gzhan yang mdo sgrub/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong can gyi bzlog pa sogs bung bskyed nas bsgrubs shing / dus 'khrugs kyi dbang gis sems can nyes med mang po shi ba de dag gi don du rje nyid kyis kun rig gi cho ga stong tshar lhag tsam phyag bzhes dang / dge 'dun rnams la yang dkar chos sgrog pa/ gtor ma gtong ba sogs kyi phebs sgo nan chen du bka' stsol bar mdzad cing / de nas rje 'di'i thugs dgongs la/ gling ga bde ba can gyis thog drangs pa'i mus phyogs kyi dgon ma bu 'di rnams sa skya pa'i phyag tu phul na 'phral dang yun du bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du 'gyur che ba thugs mkhyen gyis dgongs nas/ de dus 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dpon slob rnams khams nas phebs 'phral gyis rje bla ma nyid mjal bar bzhed pa'i snga 'phros 'bul ba'i rkang mgyogs la dpal sa skya nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos thugs dam gsung shog gnang ba'i lan du/

zhu yig 'di bzhin 'bul bar mdzad pa yin te/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rin po che'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i drung du/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mngon par mtho zhing rnam dkar gyi mdzad 'phrin gong 'phel du bzhugs pa'i skabs nas gsung shog dam rdzas kyi gnang sbyin zhabs drung sgar chen 'di phyogs su phebs pa'i bslab ston dang bcas pa spyi bor phebs pa bka' drin che lags/ phul don/ bdag khyer 'khos med pa dang / 'di phyogs mtha' 'khob tu song bas zhabs drung sgar chen dpon slob nyung shas shig gi zhal bkod gnang nas zla ba 'di dang bcu pa'i bar mtshams la 'dir phebs thub pa tsam gnang na legs pa gda'/ ched gtad phul don/ bdag na so mthar phyin pa dang / snga mo nas 'dun pa yod pa dang / gling ga gdan sa yang lo mang rab song ba nas cis kyang khams kyis ma lcogs pa lags pas/ 'di ka'i mkhan po'i 'os rigs zhabs drung du sku gzhon pa 'os su shar ba lags pas/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa sku mched kyis kyang na len dra la sogs pa'i zhal bdag mdzad nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sems can gyi bde skyid la shin tu phan pa zhig byung 'dug pa ltar dpal sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi dam tshig la dgongs nas 'di ka'i mkhan po la zhabs drung sgar chen dang stabs gcig tu gnang ba thugs rje che ba mkhyen mkhyen lags/ bdag rang gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i zhal ngo gong ma rnams kyi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ram snyam pa'i 'dod 'dun rtse gcig pa legs pas dgongs pa mi 'gal ba'i ngos nas cis kyang gnang ba thugs rje che ba mkhyen mkhyen lags/ 'di'i rtsis bzhes gnang nas gdan sar phebs dgos pa shar kyang thag ring mi 'dug pas phar 'byon tshur 'byon mdzad pas 'thus pa 'dug pa/ gang spyi'i bslab ston mig phye ba 'dra ba thugs rtsa la sbyar ba dang bcas gnang ba mkhyen mkhyen/

gtsang sar dpon drung 'khyud nas bkod yig zhu mkhan bdag tsho rang gis brdzangs yod pas/ zhabs drung rin po che de kar dbu snyung mdzad dka' log lta la sogs pa gtan nas yong ba med mchis pas dgongs pa rin po cher bzhugs pa zhu zhu lags/ zhu yig spyan zur g.yo rten gser zho do la rgya ldan phul/ ces bla ma gong ma'i zhabs tog dang bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs po ches nye bar drangs shing / dus gsum sgrib med du gsal ler gzigs pa'i ngang tshul can gyis gong bzhugs chen por zhu yig nan bskyed de bzhin du 'bul bar mdzad pa dang dus mnyam par/ kho bo cag la'ang thugs dam gsung shog 'di bzhin gnang byung ba yin te/ 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ da lam phul don/ bdag na so rgas pa dang / khams kyis cis kyang ma lcogs par brten/ khyed gling ga bde ba can gyi mkhan po la 'os ris su shar ba lags pas/ sngon yang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa sku mched/ bdag chen kun bkras pa rnams kyis na len+d+ra dang / gling ga la sogs pa'i zhal bdag mdzad mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la shin tu phan par byung 'dug pa ltar/ khyed kyis kyang dpal ldan sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa yi dam bka' srung rnams kyi dam tshig la dgongs nas/ 'di ka'i mkhan por zhabs drung sgar chen dang lhan cig pa mdzad nas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i dus chen lags pas 'di thog phebs thub pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen mkhyen lags/ yab rin po cher rgyu mtshan nan che ba rang phul yod cing / gtsang sar bkod yig zhu mkhan yang 'di ka nas btang yod pas dgongs bzhugs mkhyen mkhyen/ 'dir 'byon gong sngags 'chang chen po'i dngul gdung la snyan dar dang / sgo rum skyed lhas su bskang gso brgya tshar zhig cis kyang mdzad nas phebs pa zhu/

zhu yig gzigs rten bkra shis kha thags la rgya mdzes phul/ ces pa'i thugs dam gnang ba mthong ba'i tshe/ gong du bkod pa ltar bdag rang lo gzhon nu nas rje 'di'i mtshan tsam thos pa nas bzung mjal 'dod dang / chos thob 'dod kyi dad 'dun bla lhag tu yod pa dang / slar yang rnam thar ngo mtshar can 'ga' zhig thos pa'i rkyen byas zhal dkyil mthong ba snga phyi la rgyas pa lta bu'i gdung shugs chen po yod pa'i dbang gis char 'dod kyi bye'u dbyar skyes kyi sgra thos pa ltar dga' zhing mgu la yid spro ba mchog dang ldan par gyur cing / de nas dus mi ring bar sde 'khrugs kyi nyer len gyis dus ngan gyi 'gyur ba chen po shar te/ byang nas sde srid zhabs drung du gdan sa chen por phebs dgos pa byung ba'i skabs der/ slar yang rje bla mas yab rje chos kyi rgyal por rting bskul gyi zhu yig rgyas pa dang / dngos cag la yang thugs dam 'di bzhin gnang byung ba yin te/ 'jam dbyangs rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku'i dkyil 'khor mngon par mtho zhing / thos bsam la mi g.yel ba bka' drin bskyangs pa'i skabs nas phyag dam gong snam gyi rten dang bcas gnang ba thugs la btags/ snga mor zhabs drung yab rin po che la rgyu mtshan phul ba ltar/ da lan bskyar bskul nan zhus rang phul yod lags pa/ zhabs drung sgar pa phebs na de mthun dang / mi phebs na yang hor zla bcu gcig bcu gnyis khongs su phebs thub pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen mkhyen/ sku zhang rin po che la zhal ngo bgres gzhon tshang ma'i bka' drin bskyangs pa thugs rjes bzung lags shing / da dung yang snga mu ltar mkhyen mkhyen/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa spyi sgos dang / sems can gyi bde skyid la dgongs nas sngar gyi dus steng tsam du phebs pa zhig mkhyen mkhyen/ zhu yig spyan 'bebs rten bkra shis pa kha thags la rgya mdzes su phul ba'i zhu yig ces pa'i thugs dam gsung shog dang bcas dbon chen rin chen klu dbang dpon g.yog mang po cher gtad kyis 'bod mir gnang byung ba bzhin/

de dang mthun par gong bzhugs sku mched zhabs drung chen mo gnyis kyis kyang de bzhin gyi phebs sgo gnang byung ba ltar/ thog mar byas 'gyur du grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i drung du byin rlabs bka' bsgo/ bslab ston sogs zhu bar phyin pa 'khor ba'i sang nyin de ka bzhi thog bla brang du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po la gang spyi'i bslab ston mtha' dag zhib par zhus shing byin rlabs zhabs dbang sogs yid tshim par thob par byas te/ de ltar sprul pa'i skyes mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched zhal rnam pa gnyis kas zang zing gi gnang sbyin rgya dpangs chen po dang / 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya du ma zhig stsol bar mdzad cing / de nas 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dang sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal mched kyis kyang gnang skyes bzang po dang bcas thugs 'phreng pa'i gsung du ma 'byon gyin 'dug pa la/ myur du zhabs drung du 'khor yong ba'i khas len zhus nas/ glang lo zla ba dgu pa'i mjug tsam la gdan sa chen po nas bteg ste rim gyis gdong bkra shis rtse/ dpal ldan lha rtse/ gtsang chos ma/ mdog lho rnams brgyud de mus gnas gsar du slebs pa'i tshe/ de dus sde gzar gyi 'gros kyis yar rgyab dpon chen rjes 'brang gi drung 'khor rags bsdus dang bcas pa phyogs der byon 'dug pas/ khong rnams kyis thog mar chibs bsu zab ma mdzad cing / de nas pho brang gi rtser zhabs tog snyed bkur rgya dpangs shin tu che ba dang / zang zing gi 'bul nod dpe bral mdzad cing / zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang / rjes gnang sogs thugs la gang yod phul bas/ sde bdag chen po shin tu mnyes pa'i gsung gis/ rang re mchod yon mjal ba 'phyis byung / nged dbus na yod dus khyed byon pa shar na/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan nges shig bya nus pa yod de/ gang ltar da lam rang re mjal bas blo bde zhing / slar yang mchod yon thugs nang dag pa nyi ma sprin med kyi rnam pa zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos so/

/zhes sogs thugs dag snang dang bcas pa'i gsung du ma zhig stsal cing / bag phebs pa'i rnam pa ci yang zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pas nged kyi bsam pa la/ dus ngan gyi 'gyur ba 'di tsam shar yang / sde srid chen po'i spyan ltos kyi lugs gnyis kyi gnang bkod rgya dpangs blos mi 'khyud pa tsam 'di lta bu dang / rang la yang dag snang dpe med mdzad pa de bzhin la rjes su yid rang ba'i dga' spro dang / 'gyur ba'i snang tshul la bsam pas skyo ba zung 'brel du byung zhing de nas ya ma rgyab sral sogs brgyud de sang nyin gling ga chos kyi pho brang du rje bla ma dang mjal ba'i nyin snga char rab 'byams chos rje sogs rang gi nye 'khor 'ga' zhig rje bla ma'i zhabs drung du brdzangs pa'i zhu don la/ rje rin po che khyed bdag rang gi skye ba mang po'i bla ma yin snyam pa'i nges shes lhang lhang de ka yod pa dang / 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gi dbu bla yin pa sogs gang sa nas bsu ma la phebs pa dang / phyag lan mdzad pa sogs gtan nas mi gnang ba dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin/ khong rnams kyis myur bar phyin nas gling gar 'byor dus bla brang gi dbang khang ka drug ma na dpon slob nyung shas shig bzhugs 'dug pa la mjal nas gong gi gnas tshul rnams phul bas/ rje'i gsung la a pha de 'dra ci gsungs ba yin/ kar 'brug dge ldan pa sogs kyi grwa pa bu chen rnams ni/ khong rang tshos sprul skur mtshan gsol ba re byon pa la/ la lung mang po brgal nas mjal du 'gro zhing / lag gi dngos po gang yod phyag tu 'bul thub pa la dga' spro byed pa'i srol bzang po gcig 'dug kyang / rang re sa skya pa'i grwa bu slob rnams dad gus dag snang pho rus sogs shin tu chung ba'i skyes bu dam pa gser gyi pha bong sgo 'grim gyi tshul du byung yang ji snyam du yang mi sems pa zhig 'dug mod/ gang ltar sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa byon pa la rang re rnams phyag mi 'tshal na/

gzhan su la 'tshal ba yin/ phyag ma byas pas mi 'thus shing / sngar gyi bsam pa la nga rgas kyang gru gu 'phrang gi bar du phebs bsu la yong snyam pa yod kyang / zhabs drung gi thugs la gtan nas med phyin/ da cha bla brang gi nub kyi 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyi chos khri chos ra dang bcas pa yod sa 'dir phebs bsu la yong ba yod tshul zhus shig gsungs shing / yang de ma thag gsung las/ de ring gza' skar bzang ngan ci yod kyang de la ltos pa med/ mdang nub mo nged rang sa skya zhabs drung dang gnyid dang 'od gsal 'dres ba'i ngang nas gsal bar mjal byung ste/ sku bong che chung ran pa/ zhal dkyil zlum zhing dkar la dmar shas che ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ spyan gnyis zlum zhing che ba/ shangs gzengs mtho zhing mchu sgros legs pa/ zhal sma ra dang zhal rgyan khyug ge yod pa/ sku gzan smug cing sku chos cung ser ba bzhes pa zhig gsal bar mthong byung pas/ de nas slar yang gzhigs nas blta snyam pa la gti mug tu song nas ma byung zhes gsungs pa sogs de dus bdag gi gzugs dbyibs/ bzhin ras/ gzan chos gos kyi kha dog tshun chad ji ltar yod pa ji lta ba bzhin 'od gsal gyi ngang nas sgrib med du gzigs pa zhal gyis bzhes 'dug cing / gzhan yang gsung las/ sa skya pa'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams sngar las kyang rgyan cha lugs zab cing gzi brjid che ba dang bcas bla ma na rim gyi gzim mal gyi thad kyi nam mkha' na byon 'dug gsungs pa sogs dges dges kyi gsung du ma 'byon gyin 'dug zer la/ de nas ngos cag dpon slob rnams gling ga dgon pa'i shar phyogs kyi zhing steng tsam du 'byor pa na/ der bzhugs kyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas ser 'phrang zab mas bsu bar mdzad de/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi chos rar slebs pa'i tshe/ bla brang gi sgo nas rje bla ma de nyid sku gzengs mtho zhing /

khyon che ba/ zhal dkyil rgyas shing pad+ma ra ga ltar dmar la gzi 'od 'phro ba lta bu dang bcas spyan nyi zla 'dra ba des bdag la gzigs pa mthong byung ba'i mod la/ 'dir snang gi rtog pa phra rags thams cad 'gags nas lhan skyes spros bral gyi ngang la had de lus pa la/ 'khor gyis brda' sbyar byung 'phral rje rin po che phyag gsum mdzad pa'i ring la/ bdag gis phyag lan dgu tsam zhig btud mar btsal nas/ rje'i phyag nas bkras thags shig gnang ba zhus nas/ mjal dar du lha rdzas gangs ri'i mdog can zung 'brel zhig phul te/ byin rlabs zhu dus rang gi mgo bo bla ma'i dbu'i 'og tu chug par byas pas yid tshim par byung zhing / de nas bla brang gi dbang khang du dpon slob rags bsdus shig la bzhugs gral rgyun mi thung tsam zhig gnang byung ba'i skabs/ rje'i gsung las/ sa skya nas tshes grangs gang la byon dang / bar lam gyi gnas tshul rnams dri rtog gnang byung ba'i lan rnams rim pas phul rjes/ bdag gis snga mor lo gzhon nu nas rje rin po che'i rnam thar thos pa'i rkyen byas mjal 'dod dang chos thob 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa yod pa'i steng / da lo tsho zhabs drung 'di ka nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal por zhu yig dang / bdag rang la thugs dam bka' shog yang yang gnang ba'i gling ga dgon pa'i gdan sa la yong dgos tshul phebs byung pa bzhin/ rang ngos la lugs gnyis kyi shes sgo med pas bla ma gong ma'i dgon gnas kyi 'dzin skyong yong ba dka' ba 'dug kyang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'grig byung snyam dga' spro chen po dang bcas rje'i zhabs drung du 'ongs ba lags pas/ sa skya pa'i yab chos 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i chos skor sogs 'dod chos mang po zhu dgos yod pa 'di rnams thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ rje'i gsung las/ de bzhin ngo mtshar che/

rang re'i gling ga bde ba can gyi dgon ma bu 'di rnams sngon mus chen sems dpa' chen pos 'di phyogs kyi bya ri dwags/ nya sgo nga sogs sems can mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon dang / skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs su dmigs te 'debs par mdzad pa nas bzung da lta'i bar du sa skya pa'i sngags phyogs kyi bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i rgyun gzhan las khyad par 'phags ngos shes pa ma nyams pa gong 'phel du yod pa 'di lags shing / da ni nged kha rgas/ lus gog pa la brten 'dzin bkod de 'dra nus pa'i re ba mi 'dug pas/ dgon gnas 'di rnams khyed sa skya pa'i phyag tu ma 'phrod na/ dus kyi dbang gis gzhan su yin gyis zin pa med pas/ des na zhabs drung nas sa skya pa'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la khur chen po bzhes te dgon ma bu 'di rnams kyi zhal bdag gnang ngos lugs gnyis kyi skyong dar tshul bzhin du mdzad na/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa yang de kas rdzogs/ khyed rang gi 'di phyi'i don yang de kas 'grub/ nged rgan po'i bsam pa yang de kas rdzogs pa yin zhing / 'dod chos 'dra dgos gsungs pa/ spyir yang chos don du gnyer mkhan byung na rang gis gang yong byed pa'i lugs de ka yod cing / khyad par khyed dgung lo bcu bdun pa sku na phra mo 'di lta bu la/ nged rgan po bsams nas 'di phyogs phebs pa bka' drin tshad med pa bskyangs pas/ chos nged rang la yod pa rnams 'bul gang thub rang cis kyang zhu ba lags zhes sogs gsungs shing / gsung 'phros gnang ba'i skabs de dag su yang mtshams mtshams su spyan 'bras shangs kyi rtse mor zim bur gzigs shing / thugs dam ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun la yug re 'byams 'gro ba mthong bas/ bdag gi sems la snyan grags dang mthun pa'i bla ma khyad par can 'di lta bu dang mjal ba re dga' snyam pa'i yid la dga' spro dung dung pa yang yang du skyes par gyur to/

/smras pa/ byang phyogs rdo rje theg pa'i shing rta che/ /sems dpa' chen po'i chos kyi 'dun pa der/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /rang gi tshe rabs mang po'i dge ba'i bshes/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po mus pa rje'i/ /zhal mthong gsung gi gsang ba thos pa'i tshe/ /'di ci rmi lam yin nam mngon sum zhes/ /dga' spro'i ngang nas yid gnyis phyogs la 'phyang / /dpon slob ltar snang dad 'dun bral ba dag /dag snang gsal ba'i mig dang mi ldan tshe/ /tshe rabs du ma'i rjes 'brel ji ltar rtogs/ /rtogs pa'i tshul rnams ngo mtshar gnas min nam/ /e ma mthu chen stobs kyi mgon po dang / /sa skya'i bla chen gnyis kyis mngon sum du/ /rjes su bzung ba'i mus chen sems dpa' che'i/ /dgon gnas che 'di 'phags yul rdo rje gdan/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug sprul pas sprul pa'i sku/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i gzigs pa mchog /gang la mnga' ba'i 'dren mchog 'dren pa de/ /bdag gi mgon du rnyed 'di rnyed pa'i mchog /brtse bas pha mas bu tsha bzhin/ /yid bzhin yid kyi re ba bskangs/ /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma rje'i/ /rnam thar bsam bzhin dad pa 'phel/ /rnyed dka'i lus rten thob dus 'dir/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma 'di mjal bas/ /dal 'byor don med ma gyur snyam/ /dga' spro yid bde'i ting 'dzin thob/ /de nas lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum sngon paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug pa nyid zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin/ dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i gza' skar bzang po'i tshe/ gling ga'i 'du khang chen mo'i rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen gyi zhabs stegs seng ge'i khri la kho bo cag gdan sar bkod par mdzad pa'i de nyin mang ja nyis sbrel gyi snga ma'i steng du rje bla ma nyid tshogs dbur phebs pa'i drung du gsung bsngo'i rten zang zing gi 'bul ba'i rnam grangs rgya che ba dang /

tshogs chen la yang gos ber/ rta sogs spyi 'gyed bzang ba/ dpon slob kun la dam rdzas 'chi med ril bu'i gral 'gyed dang bcas pa bdag cag gis gus pas bsgrubs cing / de dus gsung bsngo gnang ba'i tshe/ spyir bsngo ba'i yon bshad rgya che ba gnang ba'i 'phro la gsung las/ rnam dkar gyi dge ba rlabs po che 'di'i mtshon pa'i bdag gzhan 'gro ba yongs kyi rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba dus gsum du ji snyed bsags pa rnams bdag gi blos gcig tu sdom ste/ tshad med pa'i 'gro ba mtha' klas pa'i don du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir/ paṇa chen bud+dha shrīs/ dam pa gsum gyi bsod nams bsags/ /rgya chen thabs kyis yang dag spel/ /zung 'jug bsngo bas rgyas btab bya/ /zhes pa ltar shes rab spros bral gyis rgyas btab ste zung 'jug bsngo ba zab mos 'bras bu 'grub par nges pa'i tshul gyi yongs su bsngo bar bya dgos pa yin te/ 'di ltar 'grub nges pa ni chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ bsngo ba de yang mdor bsdu na/ /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa gnyis/ /gnas kyi bsngo ba 'grub par gsungs/ /zhes dang / gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par gsungs/ /zhes dang / byams pas/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /zhes pa'i 'dus byas kyi dge ba bsngo ba'i rgyu dang / de'i byed pa mchog ni sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa dang / dmigs med kyi rnam pa ni shes rab spros bral gyis rgyas btab pa dang / phyin ci ma log pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir bsngo ba la bshad pa yin no/ /zhes sogs mkhas pa rnams kyi snying la 'bab pa'i legs bshad du ma stsol bar mdzad cing / gsung bsngo grub mtshams dge 'dun tshogs pa rnams la gang spyi'i bslab bya zhib rgyas gnang ba'i mthar/ gang ltar rang re'i gling ga dgon ma bu 'di rnams sa skya zhabs drung gi phyag tu ma 'phrod na/

da dus ngan gyi 'gyur ba'i dbang gis/ gzhan sus kyang zin pa med pas/ na ning dgun hril por nged kyis sems dpa' chen po la gsol ba btab/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la 'phrin las bcol ba la brten/ sa skya nas zhabs drung gdung brgyud sku gzhon pa 'di gling ga'i gdan sa la spyan 'drongs pa yin pas/ mus nang gi lha sde mi sde kun la nged drin che ba yod cing / da ni rje sa paṇa gyi/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas bzhugs bzhin du/ /ston pa gzhan la phyag byed pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho 'grams du/ /ba tsha'i khron pa brko ba bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ nyi ma de ring nas bzung khyed lha mi kun gyis phyag dang mchod pa 'bul ba/ lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya zhu ba sogs thams cad sa skya zhabs drung kho na la gyis shig ces sogs gsung dpangs mtho zhing sbom la zil che ba des rgyas par bka' stsal nas/ slar bla brang du phebs par mdzad cing / mang ja gnyis pa'i tshe ngos cag 'du khang gi bzhugs khri'i steng du 'jog par mdzad nas/ rje bla ma nyid kyang tshogs su phebs pa'i gnang sbyin gyi thog mar bkra shis kha thags dngul mdog ma zhig dang / mgon po tshe dpag med kyi gser sku legs pa phra rgyan du mas brgyan pa zhig rje rang gi phyag nas/ bdag gi lag tu khri thog de kar gnang byung ba/ tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel du dgongs par go zhing / gzhan ja gos dar/ dbu zhwa/ gos ber/ pang kheb/ rgya dril/ gos phrug gi bzhugs gding / gser dngul/ khro zangs/ nas khal sum brgya/ dkar yol dang ra 'gag bcu khres re re/ chibs chibs rol/ dre'u zung 'brel/ 'bri g.yag stobs che ba sogs mkho dgu'i gnang sbyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa pha nor bu la 'phrod pa lta bu'i dges spro chen po dang bcas stsal nas/ phyag nas 'thor bzhin pas bkra shis mnga' gsol rgyas par mdzad nas/ slar bla brang du phebs pa'i rjes su dge 'dun tshogs pas kyang 'bul nod rgya che ba byung zhing /

de nas bdag gis bsngo ba dang / tshogs pa la 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang zhig bgyis nas/ de 'phral zhabs drung du phyin pas/ rje nyid zhal 'dzum dpag tu med pa dang bcas gsung las/ gling ga dgon pa'i gdan sa 'di sa skya bdag chen la 'phrod pas/ da nga blo bde ba yin/ da res khyed sku tshe ring ba'i rten 'brel zhig yod pas/ bla ma gong ma na rim gyi gzim mal der bzhugs/ nged gdan srab pa 'di la sdod pa yin gsungs byung ba la/ bdag sems shin tu mdzangs nas ma nus pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi phyag gi bdag gi lag pa nas khrid de bskyal bar mdzad cing / de nas gsol ja gnyis tsam gyi bar la dad ldan gyi slob ma mang po dang bcas shin tu dges pa'i ngang nas gsung gleng rgyun ring du mdzad nas bdag la spyan cher gzigs te/ zhabs drung khyed rang gling ga'i gdan sa mdzad pas sku tshe ring zhing thugs bsam chos bzhin du 'grub la 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa sogs 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba yin/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun dang / sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin gzhan gyi 'phrin las kyi rgyun bzang lod mi 'dra/ sa skya pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun gyis khyab tshad du/ sems dpa' chen po'i 'phrin las kyis kyang khyab pa lta bu yin/ de 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / sngon rje rdo rje 'chang gi mnal lam du rje mus chen gyi dbu thog na gdugs chen po gcig 'khor gyin 'dug pa/ de las de 'dra ba mang po chad de dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad khyab pa'i mtshan ltas byung ba dang / rje sems dpa' chen po rang gi mnal lam du yang / rje rang nyid sa skya'i lung pa yin snyam pa zhig na bzhugs 'dug pa la/ de'i bar snang nas bzung ste mtha' chod rgyu med pa lta bu'i nam mkha'i khyon thams cad bla bre legs po gcig gis khyab nas 'dug pa la 'di'i 'og thams cad nga dbang ba yin snyam pa thugs la 'khrungs 'dug pa de dag gi rten 'brel gyi gnad las byung ba yin/

zhes sogs ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan gyi tshogs ci yang zhig stsal nas/ de nyin nas gzung nyi ma gnyis gsum gyi bar la bla brang gi phyi nang gi rdzas rnams rtsis sprod kyi zhal bkod gnang ste/ de nas rje nyid dpon slob nyung shas shig sems dpa' chen po'i chos ra zur du phyag phebs nas bzhugs par mdzad cing / dus de tsam nas bzung don gnyer can gyi slob ma la 'dod chos gnang ba'i skabs cung zad tsam ma gtogs/ dus khor mo yug tu phyi nang gi spros pa thams cad bcad de gcig tu dben pa la thugs gzhol ba'i tshul gyi thugs dam nyams bzhes rnams la sngar las kyang brtson pa ches che ba'i nyin mtshan kun tu rtag 'grus su mdzad pa yin la/ der skabs zhal slob 'ga' zhig gis zhabs drung du mjal bar phyin pa na/ rje nyid shin tu dges pa'i gsung gis/ dang po legs par thos bsam byas/ /bar du legs par 'chad nyan byas/ /tha ma legs par gdan sa 'phrod/ /ces paṇa chen legs pa'i blo gros kyis gsungs nas dges dges dpag med mdzad 'dug pa de/ da ni sgra ji bzhin du nged la yang byung ba 'di/ bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje yin snyam pa yod/ sa skyar rin chen klu dbang zhabs drung spyan 'dren la btang dus/ gdan sa'i skya ser bsam blo che ba rnams mgrin gcig pas/ da ni yab rgyan mchog rin po che 'di sku na ha cang bgres pa min yang / sa skya'i thugs 'gan 'di brjid drags pas bgres nyams chen por phebs 'dug cing / gdung brgyud sku mched gsum gyi sku gzhon pa 'di rang thugs kyi sdod dang / 'phral gyi mdzad spyod/ lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen rab sogs gang sa nas nged gdan sa pa rnams re che ba rang zhig yod pa yin te/ 'di ni khyed mus pa tshos rkus ma stabs su spyan 'dren rgyur 'dug 'on kyang bla ma de yag po zhig yod pas phebs sa ma nor snyam pa yod/ gang ltar phar phebs tshur phebs mdzad pa zhig ma byung na khyed rnams thugs rje chung bar yang 'gro bas/

de bzhin dpon slob rnams kyi thugs la 'jog dgos so zhes yang yang zer ba zhig yod 'dug pa/ don la yang khong tsho ji ltar zer ba bzhin bden gyi yod pa 'dug pas/ rang re rnams kyis thob pa 'di skal ba bzang por shes pa dang / nged la yang drin chen por go dgos rgyur gda' ste/ de 'dra rtogs mkhan re re tsam las yod pa dka'/ 'on kyang phugs su thams cad kyis go ba zhig 'ong bar nges/ /zhes sogs dus gsum gsal le mkhyen pa'i gsung mang po stsol bar mdzad 'dug cing / de ltar kho bo cag gdan sar bkod pa gnang ba'i rjes de ma thag par bdag gis dge 'dun tshogs pa la rdo rje phur pa stod las kyi dbang dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang cha lan mang po dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang rgya bod kyi yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis sogs bka' bstan bcos 'ga' zhig gis lung gi mtshon pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa ci rigs shig bgyis nas/ de dus rje bla ma 'brel tshad don ldan 'di nyid kyi drung du dam pa'i chos kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi nos pa la/ thog mar slob dpon mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i tshe 'phel dkar po'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ma/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ yang thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ seng ge sgra/ khyung nag seng gdong ma/ phyag na rdo rje a tsar+ya/ yang u tsa me dbang ma/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ lha brgyad/ gur mgon khro bcu/ 'khor rkyang pu tra ming sring / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ rta mgrin lcags ral can dang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po la sogs pas mtshon pa'i lhag pa'i lha yi dam zhi khro du ma'i rjes gnang / zur bka' dkon zhing zab pa'i rigs du ma dang / de dag gi rgya bod kyi yi ge man ngag rnam grangs mang po dang bcas pa/ gur gyi mgon po zhal bzhi pa/

nor lha dbyu gu ma mched gsum sogs kyi tshe sgrub dang nor sgrub kyi man ngag gi rigs du ma/ rje sa chen gyi bka' 'bum po sti gcig lhag tsam dang / rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs sogs bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab kyi tshogs mang po/ gzhan yang bzang spyod/ mtshan brjod la sogs te bka' dang bstan bcos bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gi dag gsal lung gi bka' drin mu mtha' med pa zhig stsal cing / de nas sa skya pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid dang / de'i yig cha gsar rnying rnams kyi lung gnang nas/ de mtshams rje nyid gsung bsnyen kha gso la bzhugs pa grub ma thag 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs rnams smin rgyas su stsal nas/ thog mar bde mchog nag po pa lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad khrid rje bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i rnam bshad chen mo'i steng nas rgyas shing zhib la mtha' chod pa dang / de dang 'brel ba rdzogs rim gyi khrid la dpyid kyi thig le dang rim bzhi gnyis ka gnang nas/ thams cad kyi rgyab rten du nag po gzhung drug rje sa skya pa chen po'i nag 'bum/ rim bzhi lam slong / rje btsun gyi nag po dkyil chog nag po bshad sbyar gyi lung la sogs pa mang du stsal de dus gsung las/ gzhung drug gi mchan rnams mal lo nas sa chen yab sras kyi bar gyi gsung mchan kho na dang / rje sa chen gyi gsung rab nag 'bum gyi mchan rnams rje btsun grags pa'i yin zhing / rim bzhi lam slong gi mchan rnams/ brag phug pa'i gsung bgros/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa yin par bshad gsungs/ cing / bde mchog lū hi pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad khrid/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum pa/ bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim zab mo rim pa lnga'i khrid/

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma yum la sbyar ba'i khrid rnams/ kun mkhyen rin po che/ rje bzang po dpal ba/ bla ma gong ma dang bcas pa'i yig cha'i steng nas shin tu smin pa dang / de dag dang 'brel ba'i lung la rgya gzhung lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ dril bu skor gsum sogs dang / rje btsun sku mched dang rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa dag gis mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig cha mang po'i lung / de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ 'grel pa mu tig 'phreng ba gnyan phul byung pas mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ bshad rgyud rnal 'byor ma kun spyod rje btsun gyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i steng nas lung bshad zhib tu gnang zhing / de ltar zhen pa bzhi bral dang bde mchog chos skor 'di rnams gnang ba'i tshe/ rje bla mas bka' nan chen po phebs par brten/ rang gis gang zin bskyar chos kho na rgyun du byas pas/ thos blo tsam du ma song ba'i slar 'chad bsgom sogs gang byed kyang the tshom mi za ba tsam byung ba 'di yang rje bla ma de nyid kyi bka' drin kho na las byung ba yin la/ de dus mu tig 'phreng ba gnang ba'i tshe/ rje'i gsung las/ 'di'i skabs su dgos pa'i sngags btu'i byin rlabs sogs kyi rgyun sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa dang / paṇa chen nam dbang pa nas brgyud pa de deng sang bzhugs pa chos rje sman gur ba kho na las med pas/ khyed rang don gnyer chen po 'dug pas chos rje khong la byin rlabs rnams bzhes thub pa mdzod la/ phugs bde mchog gi rgyud bshad 'di ma chad pa zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos so/ /zhes pa gsungs byung ba bzhin bdag gis sems la bzhag ste dus phyis thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas byin rlabs kyi rgyun de rnams spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan gyis bzhes thub pa bzhin/ de'i drung du bdag cag gis thob par byas pa lags shing /

de ltar sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab chos de rnams gnang ba'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ bde mchog gi chos skor 'di rnams ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis sems dpa' chen po dang / gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis la rdzogs par gnang ba las/ rje mus chen gyis gling ga dgon pa ma bu rnams btab nas 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas dar rgyas su spel bas/ da lta'i bar du mus phyogs 'dir bde mchog gi chos skor la bshad sgrub grwa bzang zhing mkhas grags thon pa rgyun ma chad pa byung ba de yin la/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi tas bde mchog gi chos skor rnams glo bo mkhan chen pa la rdzogs par gnang ba las/ bdag chen sa lo sku mched rnams kyis sems dpa' chen po nas brgyud pa de 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen la gsan cing / gu ge paṇa chen nas brgyud pa de glo bo mkhan chen drung du gsan par gda' ste/ de yang chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa de dbus gtsang phyogs su lan 'ga' yar byon 'dug pa'i snga ma zhig phebs lam mus la mdzad/ chos rje sems dpa' chen po'i bzhugs gnas kun la mjal nas thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi chos grwar phebs/ re zhig skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la chos kyi sgo du ma'i bka' drin stsal/ slar e wam̐ chos ldan yon tan rin po che'i du ma'i 'byung gnas nyid du phebs te/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la mngon par bzhugs pa/ e wam̐ gdan sa drug pa rje btsun dkon mchog 'phel ba gdan chags pa dang legs par mjal te/ rje nyid de la snga phyir chos gsan pa la rdo rje 'jigs byed sa lugs kyi dbang / thugs rje chen po'i rigs gtad rkyer sgang lugs/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis bsgrigs pa'i blo sbyong glegs bam gyi lung / man ngag rnam bshad kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi thad de lung zur du bkol ba dang /

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i nang nas rjes gnang smar bsdus 'ga' zhig sogs gsan cing / bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyis kyang chos kyi rje kun mkhyen gyi rnam thar ngo mtshar phul du byung ba de la sogs pa'i thugs rtsom du ma dang / rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dam thang ga lam 'bras brgyud pa sogs mtha' dag la gzigs nas bkod pa rnams kyang re re nas yi ger 'god par mdzad cing / khyad par e wam̐ dpe khang gi rje rdo rje 'chang gi phyag dpe ma lus pa la dgongs pa'i cha rmad du byung pa'i legs par mtha' chod pa'i gzigs yul la nan tan du 'grus par mdzad de/ phyis dgung gi lo mthon por son pa na yang yig phreng phra mo tshun 'di na 'di yod kyi tshul ma bsnyel ba gsung rgyu yod 'dug cing / de ltar mdzad pa'i sgo de dag dngos su gyur pa'i gdul bya 'ga' la yang chos tshul mang po spel bar mdzad pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i bgyi ba du ma sgrub par mdzad pa'i skabs nas/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gzim chung du sku mtshams shin tu dam pa'i thugs dam zhig gnang ba'i dus kyi mnal ltas la sa skya'i dpon po ri yin zer ba mnga' ris tshun mthong ba zhig gi rtser phebs pa na/ de na 'chams sku'i mgon po shin tu che ba zhig kyang bzhugs 'dug la/ btsun pa zhwa dmar ba mang pos phyag 'tshal ba dang gsol ja zhu ba sogs kyi mtshan ltas byung ba la/ re zhig nas 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che rnams kyi spyan 'dren byung pa na/ mnal ltas dang mthun par dgongs shing / mnal ltas kyi mgon po'i sku sogs kyi mtshan ltas la rten gdung brgyud dri ma med pa'i thugs nges shes khyad par can dang bcas bstan pa spyi sgos la dgongs nas thugs dgyes pa chen pos dpal rtse gdong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi gnas mchog dam par phyag phebs te/ gdung brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched rnams dang mjal/

de'i tshe chos kyi sgo thog mar bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes su gnang ba de nyid chos kyi sgo 'byed du stsal cing / de nas rim pa bzhin du rnam grangs du ma'i chos kyi 'khor lo rmad du byung ba rkang gnyis gtso bos wa ra ni sir rjes su bskor ba bzhin du mdzad de/ dbang bka' bshad bka' lung gi tshogs rab tu spel bar mdzad nas/ slar smon thang nas spyan 'dren pa byung ste stod phyogs su phyag phebs par mdzad cing / yang lan rting ma dbus gtsang du byon pa zhig la phebs lam gdan sa chen po phyogs su mdzad pa las/ zhabs 'bring pa 'brum bu ma thar ba du ma yod pa dang / de dus dpal ldan sa skya na 'brum pa sdug po yod pa dus mtshungs nas zla ba gcig tsam las ma bzhugs par bla ma'i gdan sa e wam̐ chos ldan du phebs te/ rje gong ma'i rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun dkon mchog 'phel la chos kyi sgo 'ga' zhig nos mtshams/ zla ba gnyis sku mtshams kyi bcad cha shin tu dam pa la gdan chags/ de mtshams slar yang gdung brgyud rin po che 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyis spyan 'dren nyer bskul yang yang mdzad nas rtse gdong phyogs las rnam rgyal du phebs/ yos lo zla ba dang po la gdung brgyud rin po che rnams kyis yab bdag chen chos kyi rgyal po nam mkha' bkra shis pa'i nang rten thub pa chen po byin rlabs 'od 'phro la zla ba de nyid kyi yar ngo'i cha la rab tu gnas par mdzad/ de nas bzung ste 'brug lo tshang ma/ sbrul lo'i zla ba gsum pa yan tsam rtse gdong kho nar gdan phab nas/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gdung brgyud rin po che 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa lo tsā ba gnyis pa kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de'i gcung ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / sku mched chung ba a tshe ba dang / 'jam dpal ba ste dri ma med pa'i gdung brgyud rin po che mched bzhi po gtso bor gyur pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la mdo rgyud rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i nying khu/

brtson ldan la tshe gcig gis grol ba ster ba'i lam mchog rma med pa/ sangs rgyas nas da lta'i bar du snyan rgyud bzhi'i chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du ma chad ma nyams pa'i gdams pa/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i smin grol gyi lam po che nyid dang / de las gzhan du rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i zur bka' rnam par dag pa mtha' dag gi dkyil 'khor du dbang gi bya ba so so'i cho ga las ji ltar 'byung ba/ de rang gi 'grel byed du gyur pa'i rgya bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma dag gi phyag bzhes las byung ba'i rgyun ma nyams shing / phan tshun bsre bslad med pa'i sgo nyid kyi rjes su sgrub par mdzad de/ de yang rgyud sde bzhi la dbang gi babs mi 'dra bzhi 'byung ba las chu dang cod pan gyi ni dbang / /bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs pa yin/ /rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang / /spyod pa'i rgyud la zhugs pa yin/ /phyir mi bzlog pa slob dpon dbang / /rnal 'byor rgyud la zhugs pa yin/ /bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa bla na med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya ba'i rgyud la chu cod paṇa tsam dang / spyod pa'i rgyud la de'i steng du rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang tsam dang / rnal 'byor rgyud la phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon gyi dbang tsam dang / rnal 'byor bla na med par rgyud sde 'og ma dag la ma grags pa'i bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang / bzhi pa bla na med pa'i dbang gi bar du 'byung ba de dag gi spyi babs rnams phan tshun du ma 'dres shing / nang sel rnams cung zad kyang ma 'khrugs pa'i phyag len rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas rje nyid la bzhugs pa'i zur bka' rnam par dag pa'i dbang bka' mtha' dag dang / bla med nang la grags pa'i dbang bzhi ba byin rlabs kyi tshul can ji snyed pa'i chos kyi tshul mtha' yas pa dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtsho'i nang nas byung ba ma yin pa'i rjes gnang zur bka' rnam par dag pa bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa/

don yod zhags pa la sogs pa rig pa gtad pa tsam gyi sgo nas sgrub par nus pa'i rnam grangs du ma dang / klu dbang gi rgyal po/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ khro bo rme brtsegs/ 'jam dpal nag po/ bde gshegs mkha' lding / mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sogs sgom lung nyid kyis 'grub pa'i rnam grangs ming tsam 'dzin pa la yang ngal ba bskyed par 'gyur ba'i dbang byin rlabs rigs gtad sgom lung rnams dang / bshad bka'i gtso bor rje btsun sa skya pa rang gi pha chos su gyur pa kye rdor rgyud gsum la mtha' chod pa'i 'chad nyan bskyar chos dang bcas pa mdzad cing / de'i dus kyi gsung rgyun la slar zhu dag mgo mjug gi tshigs su bcad pas brgyan pa/ tshul dang po gnyis kyi gsal byed du gyur pa'i bstan bcos spyi rnam zur 'debs zab don nyin mor byed pa'i snang ba dang / ljon shing zur 'debs zab don bcud kyi snying po gnyis kyang mdzad/ snga phyir bstan bcos du ma'i gsum rtsom yang mang du mdzad cing bde mchog 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u nga gcig pa'i bshad bka' 'grel pa mu tig phreng ba'i steng nas gsungs shing / de'i tshe rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gang la gang ston byed kyi thad kyi dbang rnams kyang de dang de ru sbyar nas mdzad cing / 'khor lo bde mchog nag po zhabs lugs kyi dbang la chos kyi rje rin po che paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dang por gcig dang / de nas gsum dang / de nas lnga sogs bka' rgya mdzad pa'i lugs ltar 'jam dbyangs lo tsā ba chen po nyid la stsal ces grags shing / de'i lam gyi rim pa yang thog mar dbang gi sngon 'gro jo bo na ro ta pa las dpal pha na phing gu pa la brgyud/ bla chen mal las rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i phyag bzhes kyi rgyun de nyid kyi cho ga rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga la brten nas de gnang zhing /

'di nyid gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba gsum la sogs pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi sgos rgyud sbyangs te/ gdod rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bkri ba ltar 'dir yang sems bskyed kyi sgo nas lam gyi rgyud sbyangs nas/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs la slob pa yin gsungs/ de nas sdom pa nyi shu pa rje btsun rin po che'i 'grel pa'i steng nas bshad pa mthil phyin pa mdzad cing / 'di chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyi thub pa dgongs gsal du/ spyod pa rgya chen shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo/ /lta ba de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin/ /mi 'gal gsal bar ston pa kho bo'i gzhung / /zhes pa'i dgongs pa ltar yin gsungs/ de'i rjes su bla ma lnga bcu pa la jo bo ga ya dha ra'i gsung bgros su gyur pa 'brog mi lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i 'chad tshul dpal dges pa rdo rje la sbyor rgyu zhig dang / jo bo na ro pa'i gsung mal las byung ba bde mchog chos skor 'chad dus sbyor rgyu gnyis don thob la yod pa las/ phyogs phyi ma'i ngag bgros ltar mdzad cing / dper mtshon na bla ma lnga bcu pa'i gzhung 'di 'chad pa'i dus nam yin zhe na/ bla chen 'brog mi'i bzhed pas slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba tshar/ dngos gzhi dang gnyis kyi bar du yin te/ 'di nyid las/ bsam pa dag pa'i slob ma ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song ste/ /bla ma'i rjes su 'jug par ni/ /kha ton bya ba sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa 'byung bas so gsungs/ jo bo na ro pa'i gsung bgros 'dzin pa'i mal lo tsā ba ni/ 'di dpon slob gnyis phan tshun 'brel brtags pa'i dus su yin te/ gzhung nyid las/ bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams 'gyur bas/ /dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang / /slob ma'i 'brel pa brtags par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /zhes bzhed srol so sor 'byung ba las/ 'dir mal ltar gyi bgros rnams blangs nas mdzad cing /

sngon 'gro rnams bsgrubs pa'i rjes su bla mas bsnyen pa kha skong gi sgo nas lhag pa'i lha'i thugs rgyud bskul zhing / slob ma bsag sbyang gi rnal 'byor la 'jug par mdzad/ de nas dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang ldan pa'i byed chos thams cad legs par tshang ba'i mngon par dbang bskur te bskyed rim sems 'dzin dang bcas pa/ rdzogs rim la rim pa bzhi spyir bstan pa/ dpyid kyi thig le bye brag tu bshad pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad kyi gdams pa mkhas rlom gyi skyes bu gzhan dag gi spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i sgo nas legs par 'doms pa'i lam srol rmad du byung ba de nyid/ dus de'i tshe chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa nyid kyis sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mched rnams la gnang bar mdzad 'dug cing / de bzhin du sa lo chen pos kyang / bdag chen kun dga' bsam 'grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje lcags thang pa sogs mang po la gnang tshod du gda'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / bde mchog gi bka' chos rnams grol ba'i nyin bdag cag chos zhu rnams kyis chos yon du so so nas zang zing gi 'bul ba'i rnam grangs ci yang zhig bgyis pa yin la/ de dus skabs shig bdag gi rmi lam du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyis sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i snyan dar rnams rang nyid la rtsis sprod gnang ba zhig byung pa nangs par rje nyid la zhus pas/ gsung las/ rmi lam shin tu bzang / rigs kyi bu la brgyud kyi lha 'go zer ba der gda'/ byed pa mis byed kyang 'dun ma lhas bsgyur ba zhig dgos pa yin/ khyed rang bsod nams chen pos kun kyang dbang du 'du zhing / dpal 'byor longs spyod kyang blos mi 'khyud pa tsam dang / sa skya pa kun gyis re ltos 'chol ba zhig 'ong bas/ de dus 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud 'di rnams gsang sngags bde chen gling du rgyud 'don thabs rgyas pa re rtsom la tshugs mdzod cig gsungs byung pa/

'di ni ma 'ongs pa na gdan sa chen po'i lugs gnyis kyi khur len 'di bzhin byed dgos pa sgrib med du mkhyen pa'i gsung du snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so/ /de ltar bde mchog gi gsung chos rnams grol nas bdag cag don gnyer rags bsdus shig la sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang sngon du 'gro bas/ de'i cho ga gzhan phan mtha' yas la rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa'i steng nas gsung bshad shin tu rgyas pa dka' gnad kyi dogs gcod du mas brgyan pa dang / phyag rgya bca' lugs kyi brda sprod tshun chad smin par stsal rjes/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gnang ste/ de dag gi cho ga thun mong pa rnams mi 'gal zhing / thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'dres pa'i tshul las brtsams te/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la dgag sgrub kyi rnam dbye ci yang zhig ston par mdzad nas de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du sbyong rgyud mchan bu dang bcas pa/ rje btsun gyi gzhan phan skor gsum/ kun mkhyen gyi gzhan phan rnam gnyis/ gzhan yang 'di skor gyi mkhas pa du ma'i gsung rab dang bcas pa la bka' drin dpyis phyin par stsal te/ der 'dus kun kyang rnal 'byor yo ga'i bstan pa la blo gros kyi snang ba shin tu rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /lo de nyid la phyogs kun na 'brum pa mched skyen pa yod pa bzhin/ gling ga phyogs su yang mang du mched nas byung tshad 'chi ba lta bu'i dgon par yang grwa pa mang po 'das grongs byung par brten/ rje bla ma dam pa'i bka' bzhin bdag gis tshogs chen la gur mgon dpa' gcig sna tshogs yum/ ri khrod ma gsum gyi rjes gnang dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i na bzas dge 'dun thams cad la byin rlabs byas pas dgon pa'i 'brum pa chad cing / der skabs snyung ba rnams kyang srog skyon med pas rkyen byas slar chos gzhis rta mo lung pa dang /

skyer pa sogs su yang yang khrom dbang la 'gro dgos byung zhing / de rnams grub nas rje'i zhabs drung du phyin pas/ gsung las/ da lo'i 'brum nag 'di 'dra la khyed sa skya zhabs drung gi bka' chos rnams kyang byin rlabs rtags mtshan can byung pas bka' drin che zhing / nged kyis kyang bir+wa pa bsgoms nas nad bdag rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs byung pas/ de dus mus nang gi 'brum pa myur du chad cing / re re tsam mched pa la yang nyes skyon ma byung pa de ni rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs nus mthu kho na las byung ba yin gyi/ gzhan du go bar mi bya'o/ /de'i skabs shig na bdag la bka' drin che ba'i rgyal yum dam pa lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo de nyid kyi sku gdung byings rnams la yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyis phyag tsha gnang grub kyang / sku gdung btul ma mtshon tsam zhig rje 'di la phyag tsha zhu 'dod kyis bdag gis mus su khyer ba de nyin gcig 'jim pa bung che ba dang bsres nas rje'i zhabs drung du khyer de 'di la phyag tsha gnang dgos tshul zhus pas/ cis kyang 'ong gsungs nas 'jim pa byin rlabs dang / phyag tsha mchod dgu ma che ba brgyad gnang song bas/ bsam pa la rang gi mos dad kyi sku gdung ched gtad khyer nas 'jim pa bung che ba byas pa de la phyag tsha yang grangs mang tsam zhig gnang na blo kha rdzogs pa zhig yong ba 'dug pa la snyam pa shar ba'i tshe/ de ma thag bdag la spyan cher gzigs nas tsha tsha brgyad po 'di las grangs mang nyung med pa rang legs pa 'ong bas/ da lta nged kyis rab gnas shig byed/ de nas bla brang gi mchod khang gang rigs shig tu sgrig pa zhu gsungs byung pas/ de dus bka' phebs dang mthun par bla brang gi lha khang bar mar re zhig bzhugs su gsol nas/ dus phyis dpal sa skyar bdag gi bla ma grub mchog dbang po'i mtshan can dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi nang rten dngul gdung che ba gnyis bzhengs pa dang stabs gcig par rgyal yum de nyid kyi nang rten dngul gdung bzhengs pa de la gzungs gzhug 'bul ba'i tshe/

thog mar stod gzungs/ bar gzungs/ ring bsrel sogs bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs kyi rten/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag tsha rnams phul nas/ de nas rje bla mas phyag tsha brgyad po phul bas/ gdung tsha de las gcig gis mang na mi shong zhing / nyung na mi kheng pa'i skyon 'byung ba mngon sum du grub pa byung bas/ des na phyag tsha brgyad kho na mdzad pa de yang ma 'ongs pa lkog gyur gyi don mtha' dag ye shes kyi spyan gyis gsal bar gzigs pa'i the tshom dang yid gnyis mi dgos pa yin no/ /de nas su bā di zhes pa bag yod kyi lo gsar du shar ba'i rje 'di dgung lo don gnyis su son pa chu mo glang gi lo la 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las/ byang nas chos rgyal chen po slar ngam ring gi rgyal khab tu phyags phebs pa'i dge mtshan rmad du byung ba'i legs lam la brten nas/ chos rgyal de nyid kyi sku tshab mi sna zhu yig nan bskyed dang bcas pa yang yang gnang bas rje bla ma nyid dang / de'i phyag phyir bdag kyang dkris pa'i yab sras lhan gcig par ngam ring phyogs su phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul yang yang byung ba na/ rje bla ma 'di'i gsung gis/ kho bo ni tshe mjug 'dir sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa 'di bzhag nas/ rgyal po rnam thos sras kyis spyan 'dren byung yang mi 'gro ba'i blo thag bcad pa yin pas/ da ni sde srid kyi dgongs pa bzhin sa skya zhabs drung dpon slob rnams ngam ring phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur bas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad dgos zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ ngos cag rnams ngam ring phyogs su 'gro ba'i rje bla ma la phyi phyag zhu bar chos grwa zur du phyin pas/ de dus sems dpa' chen po'i bzhugs khri'i steng der khro bo'i rgyal po rme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang khrus gsol rgyas pa dang bcas pa zhig gnang rjes/ ling ser po la gnang ba'i phyag mdud sogs byin rlabs kyi rten 'ga' zhig stsal nas/

slar gzim chung du phyag phebs te yun ring po'i bar du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len gyi snying po mtha' dag la dri ba dri lan gyi tshul du gsung gi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa zhig stsal te/ mthar gsung las/ 'o de lta bu'i nyams len gyis 'chi khar mtshams sbyor thub pa'am/ de min yang da lta rmi lam zin pa zhig yin na/ de'i gnad kas bar do'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ de nyams len dang bsre thub pa zhig byung na/ de phyin chad mgo bo la thod pa len mi dgos rgyu der gda'/ yang bar dor da lta'i rmi lam bzhin 'khrul 'byams su ka song na/ 'khor ba 'dir yang dang yang du khyi ri ri/ khor ro ro bzhugs chog pa las ma 'das pas/ da lta yar 'gro mar 'gro'i gyes mtshams 'di la bag chags brtan po 'jog thub pa'i nyams len la brtson par mdzad dgos so zhes gsungs byung pas/ bdag gi sems la e ma mi lus lan cig tsam thob pa'i nam 'chi cha med 'di la/ dgos med kyi tshe 'di'i bya ba rnams rgyab tu bskyur nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba sogs grub rtags ston thub pa zhig gi ma byung bar/ bug sgo las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' lta bu byas nas/ rje bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi zab mo la nyams len chig sgril du bya dgos rgyur 'dug de las gal che ba'i sgrub rgyu'i don gzhan ci yang mi 'dug snyam pa blo la dung dung pa shar zhing / de nas rje'i zhabs pus la mgo bo btsugs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa mang po'i byin rlabs dang / chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo rgyas pa sogs mdzad nas/ gzhan yang 'di phyir phan pa'i bslab bya du ma dang bcas dpon slob phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i ngang nas rim gyis lam du zhugs te/ thog mar ya ma bde ldan dang / dgon pa dga' ldan rtse gnyis su zhag gnyis gsum re 'dug pa'i so sor dge 'dun rnams la 'dod chos 'gro gang che bgyis shing mus gnas gsar du yar rgyab dbon chen dang mdog lhun sding du sku zhang gdong dga' bas cher gtad yong dgos tshul gnang byung pa ltar so sor phyin pa'i tshe dbang rjes gnang sogs dgongs 'dod ltar phul cing /

khong gnyis kyis kyang phebs bsu bsnyen bkur 'bul nod sogs rgya dpangs che ba mdzad nas/ de nas mdog gzhung gi sa skya pa'i dgon pa lu phu/ dge bcu/ zhe dgon/ ya ga chos sding rnams su so so nas ser 'phreng rgyas pa/ zang zing gi 'bul ba bsnyen bkur sogs bzang 'gran lta bu'i shin tu gya nom pa byung pa bzhin/ dgon pa gzhan rnams su zhag re tsam dang / zhe dgon du bcags mal zhig bsdad pa'i so so'i bla ma grwa rigs sogs kyi thugs 'dod dang bstun/ dbang bka' rjes gnang zur bka'i rigs mang po lung gi rigs mang po sogs chos kyi sbyin pa ci yang zhig bgyis nas/ de nas dpal ngam ring gi rgyal khab chen por 'byor pa'i tshe/ de dus chos rgyal chen po sku 'brum la 'dzems pa'i slad du sku 'bum rnam rgyal na gdan chags pa'i skabs yin pas/ bdag gis ngam ring rtser bags bsang gi tshul du zhag bzhi lnga zhig bsdad pa'i de'i bar la/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos 'byor dpon g.yog rags bsdus sogs der bzhugs kun la chos bka' ci rigs pa phul cing / de nas skya bo kha gdangs su sde srid zhabs drung dang mjal ba'i thugs dge spro chen po dang bcas bsu ba bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa mdzad cing / zla ba gnyis tsam gyi ring la bsdad pa'i tshe dbang rigs mi 'dra ba brgya tshar du ma dang / rjes gnang zur bka' bcu phrag lhag tsam phul rjes/ sku 'bum gyi shar phyogs na chos rje sa paṇa gyi bzhugs khri zhig 'dug pa de'i steng nas thub pa dgongs gsal dang / rje sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams nyin re bzhin chos thun ma chag par gsan par mdzad cing / spyir yang chos rgyal chen po 'di nged rang la thugs lhag par brtse ba zhig yod pa'i steng / de dus mchog tu dges pa'i gsung gis/ khyed sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud la grub tshul ston pa zam ma chad pa zhig byung 'dug kyang /
