mkhas tshul gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por gyur pa gong ma dkar po rnam gsum/ chos rje khu dbon/ bla ma dam pa sku mched/ theg chen pa/ sa lo chen po sogs thor tsam las ma byung 'dug pas/ khyed kyang skyes stobs kyi mkhyen rab dang / thos bsam la thugs kyi dang 'dod/ bstan pa'i khur sogs gzhan las phul du byung nges 'dug pas/ da ni mdo sngags dang sgra snyan sogs rig gnas mtha' dag gis bsdus pa'i shes bya'i gnas thams cad la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa dang / rje mus chen/ sa skya nas khri chen sku mched sogs bla ma mang po las gsan pa rgya che ba zhig mdzad nas/ bdag kyang phugs yul bla ma mang po 'tshol mi dgos pa zhig dang / khyad par da lta'ang rang gi lag na rdzong gzhis dgon gnas sogs rgya dpangs mi chung tsam yod pas/ rgyal brgyud yong ba ni dka' ba 'dug 'di rnams zhal bdag kyang phugs yul khyed kyis mdzad pa zhig byung na/ byang khog 'di sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar sa yin pas bla ma gong ma'i zhabs tog dang / bstan pa la yang phan sleb shin tu che zhing / bdag gi bsam pa yang de kas rdzogs rgyu yin pas/ de ltar thugs la bzhag nas thos bsam dang / chos gsan pa sogs la thugs rtsol gyis brgyan pa mdzad dgos zhes sogs gsungs shing / zang zing gi gnang skyes yang tshan grangs mang po bsgrigs pa'i zol sbyor lta bu ma yin pa'i dpe cha/ sku rten/ bris thang / dbang chas sogs mkho dgu bsgrigs pa dus gcig ma yin pa rim gyis gnang ba'i rgya dpangs shin tu che ba blos mi 'khyud pa stsal pa sogs lugs gnyis gang gi sgo nas kyang rang nyid kho na la gcig tu dgongs pa'i pha gcig bu gcig lta bu'i 'du shes kyi thugs brtse ba'i rgyun gzhan las ches che ba zhig 'phral yun du mdzad pa yin la/ de ltar mi dbang chen po'i thugs bzhed rnams rdzogs par bgyis nas rim gyis gdan sa chen por yong ba'i lam bar rnams su/

seng ge lung / dpal ldan lha rtse/ sgro smon lung rnams su zhag re bsdad pa'i so so'i skya ser rnams chos dang zang zing gis tshim par bgyis te/ rang gi bsti gnas bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skyar 'byor pa'i nyin snga cher yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid thugs shin tu dges pa'i thugs dam gsung shog cig gnang byung ba'i nang na/ da lam khyed rang phyogs nas yong ba thog ma yin pa nas rten 'brel la bsam/ ser 'phreng rta bsu sogs rgyas pa'i grabs bshom byas yod cing / ser ja yang 'di ka nas snga mor sbyar zin pas/ da ni shad rtsol gyis yong dgos tshul gnang 'dug pa mthong bas rkyen byas yid la dga' spro dpag tu med pa thob pa'i ngang nas/ de 'phral rta thog khel ba'i rim gyis 'ongs pa na/ thog mar gong bzhugs zhabs drung sgar chen dpon slob rnams kyi chibs bsu zab mo dang / de nas gdan sa gzhung gis chibs bsu rgyas pa ser 'phreng dang bcas pas bsu bar mdzad de/ bzhi thog bla brang du 'byor pa'i tshe/ tshoms dmar gyi 'gag gi spras thung gi mgor rang gi gcen 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gnyis dang mjal zhing / thugs dges dges du ma mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ rang nyid kyang dga' spro tshad med byung zhing / de nas gzim chung rab gsal du snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon dam pa bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pa'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid dang mjal ba'i tshe/ gzigs ma thag zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bsus te/ byin rlabs zhu bar phyin pa na/ sku brtse ba'i slad du bdag gi mgo bo 'then par mdzad cing bzhad sgra sgrog bzhin pa dang bcas dgyes pa'i mdangs du ma zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pas yid la bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing / de nas gsol ja gnyis tsam gyi ring la mus phyogs dang / bar lam sogs kyi snyan 'bul rnams zhib par phul bas/

yab rje nyid kyang thugs spro ba chen po'i gsung gis/ da lam khyed rang phyogs 'grul thog ma 'di la gzhis byes gang du yang nyes pa med pa sogs 'grul mgo non par byung bas shin tu legs byung zhes sogs gsung gleng rgyun ring po'i bar du mdzad cing / de'i nangs par rang nyid la byang phyogs su byung ba'i zang zing gi dngos po ci yod thams cad yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid la phul nas re zhig gi bar la bzhi thog bla brang gi cham dmar gyi shar sbug gzim chung mkha' spyod nyid du thos bsam dang kha ton sogs la rtag 'grus su gnas pa'i skabs phyi nang gi snang tshul sna tshogs shig la thugs lhag par 'byung bas rkyen byas lan cig gi tshe kho bo cag la/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi gsung gis/ do nub lab rgyu khag che ba zhig yod pas/ nged kyi sar kha ton grub mtshams khor tsam zhig yong lugs gyis shig gsungs byung ba bzhin bdag gis zhabs drung du phyin pas/ yab rje thugs rje can de nyid kyi phyag nas/ bkras thags zung gcig gos chen lu hang sprin chen gyi ri mo can yug gcig kar yug spus gtsang rnams gnang nas/ nyid kyi gsung las/ 'o da lab rgyu'i snying po/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi 'dzin skyong las gal che ba mi 'dug cing / 'di'i 'dzin skyong yang zhal ngo na rim bzhin gyi gzhon pa la bka' babs pa zhig yod pa dang / lhag par bsam yas chos skyong chen pos kyang / rdo rje gdan gyi 'dzin skyong rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam 'phrul gyi gzhon pa de la bka' bab yod do zer ba thengs gnyis rang nged la yi ge byung ba sogs gang nas bsams kyang khyod kyis gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pa'i rab byung gi brtul zhugs 'di dor nas nged rang bzhin bgyis na/ nga yang bsam pa de kas rdzogs shing /

nged rang gi gzugs pos nam lcogs bar khur yang len pa dang / de ltar byas na rang re la dgra gnyen grogs gsum sus kyang bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyis mi tshugs shing / nged kyis kyang sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' chems snying la bcangs nas gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong gi ched du phyi nang gsang gsum nas yid chad gtong ba mang du byung yang bzod rang bsam bsran bskyed pas/ sa skya ming ma stong tsam byung pa yin/ da cha khyod kyis nged la mi nyan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum mi byed na/ nga yang su la bsams nas sdod du 'dug gang na'ang nged kyis sngags 'chang chen po'i bka' chems blos ma thong ba bzhin/ nged kyi ngag kyang khyed kyis mi gcog pa byed dgos/ de bzhin ma byas na gong ma ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyang thugs khrel 'gro/ da lta blo thag chod chod ltar byas gdung spel ma byas kyang / nga yang gzugs shis ngan pa dang yun ring e sdod mi shes pas/ bzhi thog bla brang gi gtsug lag khang rten gsar bzhengs nged kyi blo la ji ltar yod pa 'di rnams kyi mjug khyed la bsgril dgos pa yong zhes sogs gsungs byung pas/ bdag gi sems la bcos ma ma yin pa'i yid 'byung drag po zhig skyes byung pa'i dbang gis dar tsam zhig gang yang zhu ma thub cing / de nas mig mchi mas gang zhing skad 'dar ba dang bcas bdag gi sa nas gong bzhugs zhabs drung gi bka' gang phebs zhu ba las ma 'das 'dug kyang / spyir 'jig rten dang 'brel ba'i 'dzin skyong sogs bdag gis mi shes shing / lhag par khyim thab dang lhan gcig tu gnas pa 'di bdag gi blo la zhe thag pa nas med nges yin pa sngar dgongs par mnga' ba ltar yin pas bdag rang gi cha nas chos mthun gyi kha ton gang 'phel dang / ci nus kyi 'chad nyan bgyid pa sogs kyi sgo nas zhabs tog sgrub chog pa zhig dgongs pa yangs pa dang / ding sang zhal bkod gnang ba'i bzhi thog gi lha khang rten bzhengs rnams kyang mthar phyin pa zhig los yong du 'dug pa/

gong bzhugs rang da dung lo brgyar spyi sgos kyi sa dang sems can gyi don du zhabs pad brtan pa'i thugs 'dun sogs dgos tshul rgyas par zhus shing / de nas ngos cag gis gdan sa chen po'i hor zla drug pa dang bdun pa'i kye rdor dang rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod kyi tshogs dbu la yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bzhin phyin pa'i so so'i dbang bskur rnams bgyis pa'i tshe/ rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi skabs dbang yon du rgyal ba byams pa'i sku li ma dngos gtsang zhig 'bul mkhan byung ba yab rje chos kyi rgyal po nyid la spyan lam phab pas/ yab rje nyid kyi gsung las/ 'di rten 'brel bzang / byams pa'i bstan pa ma shar bar gdung spel byas nas sdod zer ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs pa sogs dgyes pa'i gsung gis ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan mang du stsal pa yin no/ /de nas lo de'i ston gling ga dgon pa'i dus chos 'chad pa dang / lhag par rje bla ma'i drung du 'dod chos mang po zhu ba'i slad du byang phyogs su rta kha bsgyur ba'i tshe/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du phyi phyag zhu ba dang bstun 'phral phugs kyi bslab bya mtha' dag mthil phyin zhus shing / zhabs dbang bka' bsgo rgyas par stsal nas yab rje'i zhal dkyil la yang yang lta bzhin pa'i ngang nas rim gyis rta thog khel ba'i gdong dga' bkra shis rtse/ dpal ldan lha rtse sogs brgyud pa'i mi dbang chen pos cher gtad kyis 'bod mi gnang byung pa bzhin ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du chibs bsu ser 'phreng dang bcas 'byor pa'i tshe/ der bzhugs kyi sde srid lcam sring / chos sde chen po'i slob dpon rags bsdus/ drung 'khor 'ga' yar dang bcas pa la so so'i bzhed don dang mthun pa'i dbang / rjes gnang / lung gi skor sogs gang la ci 'tshams su bgyis te gnas pa'i skabs/ dpal sa skya nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos thugs dam phyag bris ma zhig gnang byung ba'i nang na/

nged ni nyer dgu'i zla bar 'dug bstan pa la gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong las khag che ba mi 'dug pa sogs zhib cha mtha' dag ngos kyis gleng ba ltar yin pas/ sa skya zer ba'i ming yong mong la rgyas byung bas/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum la blo khur bskyed pa rang gal chai gsung ba 'dug pa/ de dus ni rang blun pas ma go yang / phyis bsam pas sngags 'chang nyid rang dag pa'i zhing du myur du phebs pa'i dgongs pa de dus nas gtad pa'i gsung du 'dug cing / de nas ngam ring phyogs kyi brel ba rnams mgyogs spyod kyis mus phyogs su 'gro ba na sde srid zhabs drung nas kyang rgyang ring po'i bar du bskyel mar phebs pa mdzad cing / de nas mngog dang mus nang gi dgon so so'i grwa rigs sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams la chos dang zang zing gi phan pa ci rigs pa bgyis te/ gling ga chos kyi pho brang du 'byor pa na der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis ser 'phreng rgyas pas bsus nas/ de'i nangs par khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rje bla ma nyid chos ra zur na bzhugs pa'i drung du dgyes bzhin du mjal te/ phan tshun thugs kyi spro ba mchog dang ldan pa'i ngang nas gdan sa chen po dang / bar lam gyi gnas tshul rnams las brtsams te gsung gleng du ma gnang ba'i rjes su/ bdag gis sngar grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i drung du lam 'bras cha lag rags rim dang bcas pa lan gcig thob kyang / da dung gsung ngag cha lag yongs rdzogs kyis brgyan pa zhig rje rin po che'i drung nas kyang gnang dgos tshul gsol ba btab pas/ gsung las/ gser ga bdag po'i dper 'dug pas/ lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa cis kyang 'bul spro zhing / de gong du sa skya zhabs drung nas tshogs chen la bka' chos shig gnang ba zhu gsungs byung ba ltar/ bdag gis gling ga'i dge 'dun gang yod kyi steng du dgon pa gzhan nas byon pa'i don gnyer gyi rigs sogs chos nyan pa grangs shin tu mang ba zhig la tshe 'phel dkar po/

'jam dkar/ mi g.yo ba dkar po sogs kyis mtshon pa'i rjes gnang zur bka' sum cu lhag tsam so so'i yig lung dang bcas pa dang / rje sems dpa' chen po dang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung / rdo rje phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang tshar du ma dang / sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rab phal cher gyi lung dang bcas pa bgyis shing / de nas bdag sogs gzhis byes kyi don gnyer rags bsdus shig la rje bla mas gsung ngag rin po che cha lag dang bcas pa shin tu smin pa gnang ba'i tshe/ de yang snang gsum gyi khrid kyi bar la bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi lung dang / gsung ngag gi byung tshul spyi bshad rnams gsungs shing / lta ba'i skabs su dam tshig dang lam gyi khog phub/ phyi bskyed rim la rnal 'byor bcu'i bshad pa rgyas pa/ nang bskyed rim gyi skabs su lus dkyil gyi zab bshad rnams kha bskangs te/ khrid kyi dngos gzhi snang gsum mdzes rgyan dang / rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi tshig don ji lta ba bzhin la gsal byed kyi tshogs du ma dang bcas te gdul bya'i yid la 'bab pa thugs thog nas tshig gcig kyang ma lus pa gsungs shing / de dag gi skabs mtshams rnams su thugs dam sgrig rim bya tshul/ lus kyi 'dug stangs/ ngag 'don dal brel/ tshig gi khyad par gcod mtshams la sogs pa dang / lus sbyong / rlung 'bud tshul/ 'khrul 'khor sogs kyang rje nyid kyis dngos su ston par mdzad pa sogs sla bcos mi mdzad la/ dmigs khrid rnams gnang ba'i dus rang rang gi rtags dang yon tan la sogs pa'i skabs su/ nyams su longs dang 'di bzhin yong nges zhes yang yang 'doms par mdzad pas byin rlabs kyi drod rtags la mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba yin nges par 'dug snyam pa'i nges shes skye ba la sogs te/ 'phral gyi lag len shes pa dang chos thob stabs gcig tu 'ong ba zhig yod la/ de dus lam zab phyi nang /

bir srung phyi nang / bla ma rin 'byung / lam sbas bshad/ rnam 'joms bir lugs/ tshar gsum khug pa/ brda don gsal ba/ brda chig brgyud/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang gi bar gyi gsung ngag dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs lung man ngag gi rigs su gyur pa thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs spro ba chen po dang bcas bka' drin chen pos rjes su 'dzin par mdzad cing / 'on kyang brda chig brgyud thun mong ma yin pa ni slar bsam gtan phur bdag kho na la gnang ba yin la/ de ltar gsung ngag gnang ba mthar phyin nas sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi nyin rje'i gsung las sngon dpal ldan sa skyar rje ngor pa dang sems dpa' chen po mjal dus chos rje rdo rje 'chang la mnal ltas khyad par can byung ba la brten nas snga rting du chos thams cad gang 'phrod 'phrod du gnang ba dang / sgom sde'i bka' bcu pa chen po khra ral pa'i rmi lam du rje ngor pas bdud rtsi ka pā la gang khong la gnang ba rje 'dis blangs nas gsol ba rmis pa la khong gis mkhon 'dzin byed par 'dug zer khong khams su 'gro don chen po byung yang sku tshe thung bar byung / bdud rtsi rje 'dis thob pa de bla ma'i gdams ngag gi bcud 'dzin pa'i rtags su 'dug cing / sa skyar sgrub pa lung sbyin gnang dus rje pa'i zhal nas/ gzhan mtshan ltas ma byung / rje 'gos la slob ma rgyud kyi ka chen tshugs pa brgyad/ gdams ngag gi gdung chen theg pa'i slob ma bzhi/ las tshogs dang 'phrin las la mkhas pa chams dang dral ma gshibs pa tsam byung zhes pa'i rnam pa tsho yid la gsal ba gcig rang byung gsungs te/ rje dpon slob la yang gsung ngag sogs kyi brgyud 'dzin gyi bu slob de tsam 'phel zhes pa'i lung bstan du gdon mi za zhing / yang rje ngor pa'i mnal lam du rje nyid kyi dbang gi chu bo yin zer ba'i chu mig gcig 'dug pa'i nye 'khor na slob dpon dkon rgyal ba la sogs pa nged rang gi grwa pa mang po 'dug pa las dkon rgyal ba'i chos gos kyi ling de chu mig de la bkab nas 'di ni bdag gi 'o zhes bdag tu bzung ba rmis pas nged rang gi dbang gi chu bo'i bka' babs slob dpon dkon rgyal ba la yong ba yin tshod du 'dug gsungs pa bka' bcu pa gsang grub kyis gsan par grags pa dang /

rje sems dpa' chen po rang ngor du bzhugs pa'i dus gcig mnal lam du gling skya'i rgyab ri nas paṇa chen ga ya dha ra'i bum chu yin zer ba'i chu dkar po chen po gcig brdol byung pas/ de rgya ji che la song ste mthar rgyal khams thams cad khyab pa'i mtshan ltas byung ba sogs kyi rten 'brel gyis/ sa skya'i lam 'bras kyi chos rgyun la sems dpa' chen po nas brgyud pa 'di las 'gro phan dang 'phrin las che ba gzhan med pas/ da res kyang mgron gyi gtso bo a pho mthu chen gyi dpes/ khyed sa skya zhabs drung gis gtsos pa'i lam 'bras pa rnams kyis gsung ngag gi bshad sgrub la 'bad pa thon la/ lam 'bras nya dar chu dar du 'ong pa zhig cis kyang mdzod cig gsungs byung pas/ bdag gi sems la/ sngon ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gis gsung ngag brgyad bcu gya gsum tsam gnang 'dug pa dang / de bzhin du rje sems dpa' chen pos kyang nyi shu rtsa drug lhag tsam dang / rje 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyis lnga bcu rtsa gcig gnang 'dug pa sogs sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa de lta bu ni ci la yong 'dug 'on kyang rje bla ma 'di bzhugs pa'i ring la gsung ngag tshar gcig gnyis shig ci la thug kyang 'chad thub pa bya dgos snyam pa'i sems la go cha lhang lhang du byung zhing / de nyin gsung chos kyi yon du zang zing gi 'bul ba rgya dpang che ba bdag dang chos nyan kun gyis bsgrubs pas/ rje'i gsung las/ nged dgon pa 'dzin dus kyang nor la dga' tshor med pa la/ da sgom chen byas nas sdod pa la dgos pa med pas cis kyang mi len gsungs bzhes su ma 'dod pa la/ ngos cag rnams kyis snyan 'bul nan chags phul bas mthar bzhes tsam byung yang / sang nyin de kar gling ga tshogs chen la gnang bar mdzad song la/ de nas slar yang grub chen shangs pa nas brgyud pa'i nai gu'i skor gyi chos bka' rdzogs pa zhig gnang dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/

rje'i gsungs las/ nai gu'i khrid rgyas par 'chad na/ sngar smin bka' thob zin la sgyu lus dbang mo che sngon la btang nas/ de nas chos drug so so rnams so so'i sgos bka' sngon la btang nas khrid rnams 'chad pa yin/ 'bring du 'chad na dbang gis smin zin la sgyu lus dbang mo che sngon la btang nas/ de nas chos drug gi khrid rnams sgos bka' so so bzhag nas 'chad/ bsdus par 'chad na rab bde mchog dang / de ma byung na yang kye rdor/ gsang 'dus/ mahā ma ya/ 'jigs byed de rgyud sde lnga gang rung gi dbang thob pa'i slob ma la chos drug khrid rkyang du 'chad pa yin pas/ khyed rang chos thob che ba zhig thugs 'dun la 'dug pa bzhin slar nai gu'i chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa zhig mdzad na dbang byin rlabs/ khrid bka' dpe lung sogs tshang ba zhig rje 'gyur med bde chen sogs shangs chos bzhugs che ba zhig la gsan pa'i thugs 'dun mdzad par zhu zhing / da lam 'di skor gyi zab chos snying po dril ba tsam zhig 'bul dgos par gda'o gsungs nas/ 'jag bsam gnyis kyi nai gu chos drug gi khrid yig so so'i lung khrid shin tu smin pa zhig gnang nas/ de'i rgyab rten du bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ gser chos rnams kyi rtsa 'grel so so/ de dag las 'phros pa'i man ngag gi yi ge gsar rnying du ma dang bcas pa'i nai gu'i chos skor pu sti gcig tsam gyi lung gi bka' drin stsol bar mdzad cing / de nas rje 'di dgung gi lo don gsum du phebs pa a nan+da zhes grags pa kun dga' ste shing pho stag gi lo shar tsam na dpal sa skya nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam phebs pa'i ngos cag rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod chen mo'i dus thog tu sleb pa dgos tshul gnang 'dug pa bzhin/ rje bla ma'i dgongs pa'i dbyings bkrol nas lam du 'jug kar byin rlabs bka' bsgo bslab ston sogs zhu bar phyin skabs/

rje'i gsung las/ da lo nged lo don gsum yin zhing / de bar nyes skyon med pa'i lung bstan gdeng khel zhig yod kyang / da dung lo re lo gnyis ma shi na khyed rang la chos 'phro 'di rnams 'bul thub pa zhig byung na snyam pa yin pas/ sa skya'i mgon khang gong 'og rnams su zhabs drung rang byon la snyan dar 'di rnams phul nas thugs bsam chos bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin bcol rgyas pa re mdzad pa zhu zhes gsungs byung pas/ bdag gis da dung bdag sogs ltos bcas dang / bstan 'gro'i don du zhabs pad lo brgyar brtan par bzhugs dgos tshul zhus nas/ de dus brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs tshigs bcad kha yar zhig dang / bzhugs gdan legs pa/ 'bul ba'i dngos po zang zing grangs mang ba dang bcas pa phul nas rim gyis lam du zhugs mgyogs spyod ngos dpal sa skya pa'i yab rje chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyi drung du gegs med du 'byor zhing / de nas stag yos kyi lo ngo gnyis la bzhi thog bla brang dang / phun tshogs gling sogs su bde kye gsang gsum yo ga bya spyod dang bcas pa'i rgyud man ngag mtha' dag gi tshig don la thos bsam rtse gcig tu bgyid pa'i lugs su gnas shing bdag cag sa skyar 'ong ba dang stabs gcig par rje bla ma nyid bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug tu phyag phebs te/ de'i nyin kho na la gling ga'i dgon ma bu rta mo shar sogs chos gzhis char gtogs dang bcas pa rnams la mang ja nas 'gyed/ zang zing gi gnang byin rgya dpangs shin tu che ba sogs phyag na yod pa'i dngos po yod do cog thams cad sbyin gtong du mdzad nas/ slar yang dben pa la thugs mchog tu gzhol ba'i tshul gyis gzim phug tu phyag phyi la yang dbon po sangs rgyas dar po gcig pu ma gtogs gzhan su yang 'dug mi dgos pa'i bka' stsal gnang nas/ stag lo'i ngo hril po sku mtshams bcad rgya shin tu dam pa la bzhugs nas zab bzhes rnams la rtse gcig tu mdzad pas nyams dang rtogs pa'i tshogs mtha' dag yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel rgyas su gyur pa yin te/

rje'i gsung las/ nged kyis sa skyar dbang gi dus su dam bca' zhig phul bar brten/ stag lo 'di'i 'og la rdo rje phur pa la bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum zhig byas pas/ phur pa 'di 'phrin las kyi lha yin pas byin rlabs gzhan las myur zer ba bden par 'dug nged la yang rtags mtshan phran bu 'phral du byung zhes de dus zhabs drung du phyin pa dag la gsungs 'dug pa sogs las mtshon te shes par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 'gro 'dis skyabs gcig phyag na pad+ma can/ /rang gi zhing khams kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa mchog gi zlos gar mkhan/ /sems dpa' chen por grags pa'i skyes chen des/ /legs par btab pa'i dgon gnas chos grwa che/ /gling ga bde ba can zhes snyan pa'i gtam/ /phyogs gcig ma yin 'dzam gling kun tu gsal/ /gang de'i rgyal ba gong ma'i seng ge'i khrir/ /sa skya'i gdung rigs zhabs kyi pad+mo zung / /sa skya'i bstan la phan phyir 'khod na snyam/ /sa skya'i yongs 'dzin mchog gis dgongs pa'i tshe/ /sa skya'i bka' srung rnams kyis don de bsgrubs/ /dus der sngon bsags bzang po'i las 'phro can/ /bdag ni rnam 'dren bslu med zhabs kyi drung / /myur du bgrod nas gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'thung 'dod kho nas nyin mtshan 'da' bar gyur/ /de tshe dad dang 'dun pa'i cang shes rta/ /yongs 'dzin thugs rje'i lcag gis nyer bskul nas/ /bgrod dka'i lam la zhum pa med pa'i blos/ /'brel tshad don ldan bla ma'i drung du mjal/ /de de'i skabs der nangs par mngon sum du/ /mjal ba'i nub mo bdag cag bla ma rjes/ /'od gsal ngang nas gsal bar gzigs pa'i tshul/ /ngo mtshar gtam 'di dus der yongs la grags/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'bar sku'i dkyil 'khor/ /bag dro gsung gi gdangs snyan dang bcas pa/ /mthong zhing thos pas 'dir snang a 'thas kun/ /hrul por zhig nas re zhig had de lus/ /tshe rabs du ma'i mgon gyi zhal dkyil mthong /

/mthong ma thag tu yun ring mdza' bo ltar/ /ltar snang min pa thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /'dres pas sangs rgyas nyid du nges shes rnyed/ /e ma yun ring dus nas bsam pa'i don/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin 'grub pa'i tshul/ /'di 'dra rmi lam yin par ma gyur snyam/ /sems la rab dga'i sa thob spro ba skyes/ /de tshe rgyal ba gong ma'i seng ge'i khrir/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas mchog gi bkas/ /bdag la rje btsun gang gi sras thu bo'i/ /ming btags mnga' gsol rab gnas lhan cig mdzad/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul skyes chen bgrang yas pa/ /rim par byon pa'i zhabs stegs mthon po'i khrir/ /'ching ba kun ldan so skye bdag lta bu/ /'khod 'di gzhan min bla ma'i drin kho na/ /dus der mchog dang thun mong dngos grub tshogs/ /bde blag stsol ba'i yi dam zhi khro yi/ /rjes gnang bka' gtad man ngag du mar bcas/ /chos kyi bka' drin thog ma'i sgo 'byed stsal/ /de nas bla med rgyud sde kun gyi bcud/ /paṇa grub grangs med mkha' spyod gshegs pa'i lam/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i zab chos rgya mtsho yis/ /bdag blo'i bum pa yongs su gang bar mdzad/ /myur lam rmad byung mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can/ /tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub 'grub nges pa'i/ /bde mchog man ngag bdud rtsi 'di 'thungs pas/ /chos gzhan 'tshol ba'i 'dun pa lhod par gyur/ /de tshe he ru ka dpal mus pa rje/ /rigs bdag grags pa'i mtshan can dang bcas pas/ /ma 'ongs sa skya'i chos srid bdag po ru/ /'gyur zhes bdag la lung bstan dbugs dbyung stsal/ /gzhan yang ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag med ma'i/ /snyan brgyud bir+wa'i man ngag chos tshul brgya/ /rdzogs shing smin pa'i gsung gi gsang ba che/ /dus der skal ba bzang po'i dpal du thob/ /nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes dpal 'byor che/ /byang phyogs skye dgu rnams la sbyin mdzad nas/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i yang dben bsam gtan gyi/

/bdud rtsi 'phel ba'i phug par yud kyis gshegs/ /zab mo'i ting 'dzin ting 'dzin la gzhol bas/ /'phrin las lha mchog lha mchog kī la yas/ /myur du rjes bzung rjes bzung mtshan ma sogs/ /nyams rtogs yar ngo yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan kun/ /kun ldan mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /gter chen mgon dang mjal ba'i tshe/ /tshe rabs gtan legs mdun ma zin/ /de nas rak+ṣa saḥste srin po zhes pa me mo yos kyi lo rje 'di dgung lo don bzhir phebs pa na bdag gi bla ma 'di dang sku tshe du mar dpon slob tu 'brel ba'i skyes chen dam pa rje nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pas snga mo nas bde mchog gi chos skor rnams gsan 'dod kyi thugs dad 'dun chen po yod pa dang / gsan yul yang rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i snyan grags gsan pa la brten mjal ba snga phyi la rgyas pa lta bu yod 'dug kyang / sa yul gyis bskal bas yun ring po'i bar du 'gyangs pa la/ da lo shar stabs kyis 'byon pa thag bcad nas rje'i drung du snga 'phar gyi zhu yig 'byor byung pa na/ bdag gi bla ma 'di'i thugs dam lan 'debs su 'dir spros pa thams cad bcad nas dge sbyor la rtse gcig tu yod pas/ da res byon kyang thugs bsam 'grub pa zhig mi yong tshul sogs mdzad nas/ nangs par rkang mgyogs phyir slog gnang rgyu'i nub mo rje bla ma'i gzim phug gi phyi rol tu gzugs mthong rgyu med pa'i gshog sgra chen pos bskor ba byed pa'i rnam pa sogs rtsub 'gyur sna tshogs byung ba'i tshe/ de'i nangs par rje'i gsung las/ rin po che nags dgon pa khong la chos skyong 'go mo zhig yod 'dug pas/ da lam chos 'dra ma phul na chos skyong yang mi mnyes tshod du gda' bas/ da byon zer ba las 'os mi 'dug pa de bzhin gyis yi ge sogs bgyis zhes gsungs pa bzhin gyi bka' shog 'byor ma thag rje dpon slob nags dgon nas rim par byon te gling ga dgon par lo de'i zla ba lnga pa la phyag phebs pa'i tshe/

de'i nangs par bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug tu rje bla ma dang mjal ba'i nyin nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la me tog gi char dang / 'ja' 'od kyi gur 'khrigs pa sogs kun gyi mthun grub tu byung zhing / dpon slob gnyis kyang mjal ma thag nas thugs dad dag snang phan tshun 'gran pa lta bu gong 'phel du gyur pa yin no/ /zhes thos la/ de nas rje nags dgon pas chos yon du gser zho nyi shu rtsa gsum/ chibs pa gser chas dang bcas pa/ 'bri g.yag lnga bcu bskor gyis gtsos pa'i zang zing gi 'bul ba rgya chen po phul nas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ bdag cag gi bla mas thog mar spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang / thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid/ de'i yig cha rnams kyi lung / seng gdong sngon mo'i rjes gnang man ngag gi lung la sogs te zab cing dkon pa'i chos tshul ci rigs pa zhig stsal nas/ de mtshams 'khor lo bde mchog nag po pa'i gsung bsnyen kha gso la zhugs par mdzad cing / de'i ring la chos kyi rje sbyin pa grags pas gling ga tshogs chen rta mo shar nub dang bcas pa'i skya ser rnams la dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ ma gcig khros ma nag mo zab don lugs dang rgyal ldang pa bsam gtan 'od zer nas brgyud pa'i gcod khrid rnams smin rgyas su gnang bar mdzad pa yin zhes thos la/ de nas rje bla ma'i sku mtshams grol 'phral 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ de dag so so'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa/ rdzogs rim la rim bzhi/ rim lnga/ dpyid thig rtsa dbu ma yum la sbyar ba rnams nyams khrid du stsal nas/ de rnams kyi rgyab rten du nag po gzhung drug lū hi pa'i smad lnga/ dril bu gzhung gsum/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs chung ngu sogs rgya gzhung gi skor dang / rje btsun gong ma rjes 'brang dang bcas pas mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig cha mang po'i lung /

bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod gnyis so so'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bshad lung zhib pa/ gzhan yang tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i kye rdo rje rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi bshad bka' bskyar chos su stsal nas/ de'i rgyab rten du spyi rnams/ ljon shing / dag ldan ma bu rnams kyi lung / kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang / de'i cho ga'i bshad pa/ rnam bshad dpag bsam ljon pa'i steng nas shin tu rgyas pa gnang zhing / sa skya pa'i blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral nyams khrid du stsal nas/ de dang 'brel ba blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus/ blo sbyong gi khrid yig dpal ya ma'i lung / gzhan yang bde mchog dkar po'i khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo ci yang zhig bskor bar mdzad nas/ sngar rje nags dgon pas chos yon du phul ba'i dngos po rnams kyang / nged sgom chen la rta sogs kyi dgos pa med gsungs nas chibs pa gser chas dang bcas pa phyir slog mdzad cing / gser rnams kyi khrod nas sa skyar zhabs drung gong ma rnams la gser phud du zho re zho do tsam 'bul bar mdzad nas/ lhag ma thams cad mus nang gi dgon che chung rnams su gser 'gyed du stsal cing / 'bri g.yag rnams kyang gling ga dang ya ma dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi zho tshugs dang dkar spro'i dmigs su 'bul bar mdzad nas/ de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo bas rgyas 'debs par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rje nags dgon pa dpon slob slar stod phyogs su phyag phebs par nye ba na/ rje 'di'i zhabs drung du zab mo'i nyams len gyi gnad mang po'i dogs dpyod zhu ba dang bcas gsung gleng mang du mdzad pa'i mthar/ rje bla ma sbyin pa grags pas bdag nags dgon pa dpon slob rnams 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du bla ma rin po che khyod kyis thugs dam gyi skyabs 'og nas mi 'bral ba zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos so/

/zhes zhu bar mdzad pa na/ bdag nyid chen po'i gsung gis de bzhin cis kyang zhu zhing / chos rje khyed la sku bad kyi snyung gzhi thu mo zhig 'dug pa 'di yang rim gyis je dwangs la 'gro ba 'dug cing / khyed rang gang bzhugs kyi sa der sku la mi 'phog pa'i sgrub chu khyad par can zhig kyang 'ong ba'i rten 'brel zhig gda'o zhes lung bstan pa bzhin rje nags dgon pa dpon slob 'khor bcas mus nang brgyud nas ngam ring tshor chos rgyal chen po dang mjal 'phrad phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas stod phyogs kyi rang gi bsti gnas nags dgon du gegs med du byon pa na/ bar lam gyi mus kyi dgon pa ya mar phyag phebs pa'i tshe chos rje nyid la zhal skyugs bung che ba zhig byung ba'i rkyen byas sngar gyi sku bad kyi snyung gzhi rtsa ba nas thon te/ de phyin chad sku khams bzang ba'i mthar thug pa zhig 'byung 'dug cing / de nas nags dgon du 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsung bsnyen zla ba drug pa zhig mdzad pa'i tshe/ de'i ring ma dgon pa'i nye skor du yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu mig cig gsar du brdol nas der yod kyi skye bo kun la lus kyi nad rnying pa 'byongs shing / gsar pa mi bskyed pa sogs phan yon phun sum tshogs pa byung bas/ rje nags dgon pa dpon slob rnams kyis chu mig gsar pa 'di bla ma khong rang gis lung bstan pa bzhin rje mus chen gyis gnang ba yin zhes mgrin gcig tu gleng bas/ de'i snyan grags kyis phyogs kun tu khyab cing / chu mig de yang da lta'i bar du nyams med du yod ces de phyogs kyi rgyus can rnams kyi ngag las thos shing / de nas rje 'di dgung lo don lngar son pa a na la zhes pa me pho 'brug gi lo gsar du shar ba na/ lo de'i dbyar smad kyi zla ba brgyad pa tsam la ngos cag gis dpal sa skyar yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du byin rlabs bka' bsgo bslab bya sogs rgyas par zhus nas mus phyogs su rta thog khel ba'i dpal ldan lha rtse sogs brgyud pa'i bar lam rnams la shad rtsol gyi ngang nas gling ga bde ba can gyi dgon par ser 'phreng rgyas pa dang bcas gegs med du 'byor pa'i/

de'i nangs par rje bla ma nyid bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug na bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal ba la phyin pas/ spyir shin tu dgyes pa'i gsung du ma dang / lhag par gsung ngag lam 'bras las brtsams te khrid dang gzhung bshad/ phyi nang gi bskyed rim/ man ngag gi phyag len gyi gnad mang po/ ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i rnam dbye sogs la dri ba'i bka' mchid mang du gnang byung ba rnams la/ de dus rang gi blo la snang gsum/ rgyud gsum gnyis kyi khrid yig mdzes rgyan gnyis dang / gzhung bshad smar ma/ gsung glegs bam gyi snyeg ma gsal byed dang bcas pa/ yab kyi bskyed rim yan lag drug pa dang / lus dkyil bshad pa/ cha lag rnams kyi phyag len/ ngor rdzong gi grub mtha'i skyong lugs sogs la 'phral 'phral du blta rtog byas pas yid la nges pa brtan po yod pa bzhin dri ba'i gsung gi lan rnams rang gi blo la gang shar tsham tshom med par phul bas/ rje bla ma nyid mchog tu dgyes pa chen po'i gsung gis/ a la la sa skya pa'i yab chos gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi khrid/ gzhung bshad/ man ngag gi gnad zab mo rnams dang / phyag len phra mo tshun chad khyed kyi thugs la spar btab pa bzhin byung 'dug pa shin tu ngo mtshar che/ na ning nged kyis chos ra zur du lam 'bras cha lag dang bcas pa phul ba'i dus nas brtsams te de ka lag len gyi gnad phra mo tshun la zin bris gnang ba sogs thugs kyi don gnyer de lta bu la nged btsun rgan yang bsam pa tshim pa byung / khyed lta bu'i dbang po rnon po rnams kyis chos la 'dun pa mdzad na/ rta bzang pos rtswa bza' ba'i tshe/ rtswa gcod pa/ blod pa/ mid pa gsum dus la 'byung ba bzhin/ shes rab rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis bla ma la chos thos pa/ rang gi don go ba/ nyams su long pa sogs lhan cig la 'ong ba yin/ shes rab med pa'i dbang brtul rnams kyis chos brgya thob kyang / ko skam gyi steng du thigs pa phog pa'i sgra lta bu zhig las gzhan 'ong rgyu med tshod du gda'/

zhes sogs nyams ldan gyi gsung mang po dang bcas/ zhabs drung du yun ring du song ba na/ bdag gis rje rin po ches rgyun par mi su dang yang ma mjal ba la/ de ring bdag dpon g.yog mang zhing gsung gleng rgyun ring bas sku khams ldog pa sogs mi 'byung lags sam zhus pas/ rje'i gsung las/ de 'dra mi 'ong / de ring rang re dpon slob mjal ba 'di sngon ngor pa rdo rje 'chang dbus kyi gnas mjal 'khor nas zhe dgon du grub chen bud+dha shrī dang mjal 'dug pa de dang 'dra ba yin te/ de yang sngon rje ngor pas grub chen bud+dha ba la rta lo zhig shar ba'i tshe/ bdag gis lo gcig tsam dbus la phyin na 'chi'am zhus pas/ khyod na ning nas yang yang 'gro zer gyin 'dug na'ang / nged la chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis gnang ba'i gdams ngag 'di rnams khyod la rdzogs pa zhig 'phrod na snyam pa nged sngar ma tshar ba dang chos rje sa bzang 'phags pa ba'i sku tshe ji 'dra yong mi shes pa 'dug pas sdod byas pa yin/ da lan song dbus su lo bzhi 'gor bar 'dug rten 'brel dga' mo gcig byung bas bar chad mi 'ong / nga yang ma shi tsam dang 'phrad par 'dug gsungs nas sku mtshams sngar bas dam du btang / thugs dam la dril bas rdzogs rim gyis rtogs pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ bya lo zla ba lnga pa la rje ngor chen gyis sa skyar phebs dus rje bud+dha ba sku khams snyel po yod zer ba gsan nas/ de 'phral mjal du byon pas dgon pa'i rtsar phebs pa dang nyer gnas nam mkha' mgon bsu ba la byung bas/ rje ngor chen gyis nga yong ba su las tshor gsungs pas/ gzhan su la'ang ma tshor kha sang zla ba snga ma nas bla ma sa skyar phebs yod/ grabs gyis yang yang gsungs/ khyad par kha sang de ring gnyis bya ra gyis gsungs nas bya ra byas pa lags zer/ slebs 'phral sku mdun du mjal bar bas/ sku bsnyel po rang las mi 'dug na'ang shin tu mnyes/

ja mang du gsol/ gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ sang tsha ba'i dus kha sang zla ba snga ma'i tshes bco lnga'i nub/ rmi lam bzhin za zi gcig la 'gro mgon chos rje byon nas/ khyod rang gi slob ma de tshes brgyad la sleb yong ba yod/ khos gsol ba btab na da dung lo bzhi mi 'chi gsungs pa zhig byung / de don gyi khyod sleb bam snyam pa da slebs pa de legs/ do nub tshes brgyad yin pa 'dra bas/ khyod kyis mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i bskang gso zhig gyis/ zhing skyong 'dis na ning nas ngas lam sgrub pa'i grogs khyad 'phags gcig byas gsungs/ spyir phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'di ngo mtshar che ba zhig 'dug kha sang ja 'thungs pa dang / lab mang pas khams ldog gam snyam pa byung / nam mgon yang de skad zer gyin 'dug na'ang / da nga ni phan 'dug gsungs nas/ de nyin yang ja dang gsung gleng mang du zhus gsungs pa/ bud+dha ba'i rnam thar ngor chen gyis mdzad pa na 'dug pa dang khyad par med pa'i steng / nged rang ni da lo tsho khams kyang shin tu bzang ba yod pas/ de ring rang re gsung gleng mang ba tsam gyis khams ldog dogs mdzad mi dgos/ zhes gsungs byung pas blo bde bar byung zhing / de nas rje bla ma'i gsung las/ khyed kyis sa skyar bzhugs pa'i ring la gsung ngag skor la thos bsam ni mthar phyin par mdzad 'dug da ni nga rang mi rgan yod thog 'dir gling ga tshogs chen la sa skya zhabs drung gis lam 'bras gnang ba zhig byung na de las ngo mtshar ba gzhan 'ong rgyu med pa lta bu yin pas/ da ni 'phral rang du dge 'dun rnams la chos rim du mang ja/ nas kyi bre 'gyed cig sngon du 'gro bas/ gza' skar bzang ba zhig la gsung ngag tshugs pa cis kyang mdzad dgos gsungs byung ba bzhin/ kho bo cag gis rje'i drung du nyams len gyi kha gso rnams zhus nas/ gling ga dgon pa'i dge 'dun gzhir bzhugs kyi steng du phyogs nas byon pa dang bcas pa'i chos nyan pa brgya phrag du ma longs pa la/

rang lo nyer gcig pa'i dus bsgoms pa'i nyams myong gi steng nas 'chad rgyu kho bo la ma mchis kyang / kha bshad tsam gyis gsung ngag rin po che'i gdams pa zla ba kha shas kyi bar la rang gis gang shes 'chad blo bgyis pas/ rje bla ma nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i thugs kyi chos nyan pa rnams la gsung ngag 'chad lugs ji ltar 'dug ces yang yang dri rtog mdzad cing / chos nyan pa rnams kyi de'i tshul zhus pas rje'i gsung gis/ pha la bu skyes 'dug ge gsungs pa sogs ngos cag la mgo 'dren du dgongs pa'i bstod bkur bsngags gsum du ma mdzad cing / lam 'bras grol nas rang nyid kyis bsam gtan phur zhabs drung du mjal bar phyin pa'i skabs/ snga mor rang gis nan zhus byas pa ltar rgyun par mjal ba'i tshe bzhengs pa sogs mi mdzad pa/ ngos cag phyag 'bul ba'i bar la phyag thal mo sbyar nas spyan lta stangs kyi ngang la bzhugs pa zhig 'dug pa la/ de dus ci zhus kyang ma gsan par bzhugs gdan gyi steng bzhengs nas phyag lan gyi tshul mdzad cing / rje'i phyag nas gser zho gsum la dar sna lnga kha mang po 'brel ba btags pa zhig bdag la stsal nas/ 'di khyed kyi gsung ngag gegs med du grol ba'i sgom chen gyi gtang rag brda mtshon yin no zhes gsungs shing / bzhugs gdan la bzhugs nas thugs bde nyams dpag tu med pa dang bcas bka' las nged kyis snga mo nas bsam pa la/ mus nang gi dgon ma bu 'di rnams sa skya pa'i phyag tu 'phrod cing / gling gar sa skya bdag chen gyi lam 'bras sogs gnang ba zhig byung na snyam pa yod pa/ rmi lam la bsgugs pa mngon sum gyi dpe de da lo byung pas/ nged kyang bsam pa de kas rdzogs shing / der ma zad sems dpa' chen po dpon slob nas bzung / khyed rang gi yab nas sa skya pa chen po'i bar sogs kyi rje btsun gong ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs yod pas/ khyed rang yang las 'phro dang skal ba shin tu bzang ba yin/

lhag par da res lam 'bras thog mar gnang ba de la bar chad ma byung bas/ da lam 'bras gang 'chad kyang bar chad mi 'ong / de nged kyi lung bstan yang yin zhes gsungs shing / de'i skabs shig na snga mo nas dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas nan tan du gsol ba btab pa de nyid thugs la bzhag par 'dug pas/ lan cig kho bo cag zhabs drung na yod pa zhig gi tshe/ rje nyid dar gcig ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du dgongs pa la bzhugs te/ de nas rang nyid la spyan cher te gzigs nas/ rang re dpon slob byang chub bar du mi 'bral lo mi 'bral lo/ /khyed 'jam dbyangs kyi gdung brgyud yin pas sngon la sangs rgyas na nged drongs shig gsungs byung bas/ bdag gi sems la rdo rje 'chang mi'i sku gzugs can 'di lta bu dang byang chub bar du mi 'bral ba'i zhal bzhes rjen par gnang ba 'di 'dra rmi lam yin nam mngon sum yin nam snyam pa'i yid la dga' bde tshad bzung las 'das pa dang / lus kyang 'tsho mi thub pa lta bu byung zhing / rjes su de dus zhabs drung na yod pa'i grogs dag la'ang de skabs rjes 'di ltar gsung gi e 'dug ces yang yang du dri ba yang shor ba yin la/ yang de dus bsam gtan phu'i gzim phug tu nged rang zhabs drung na yod pa'i skabs shig bdag la snga mor sa skyar yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i de gong nas kyang yang yang du gsungs pa dang / lhag par 'di phyogs yong ba'i snga dro zhabs drung du ched gtad 'bod pa mdzad nas bka' las/ sngon yang gdan sa chen po'i 'dzin skyong gdung spel sogs kyi bka' 'di zhal ngo gzhon pa rkyang la babs pa zhig byung 'dug pa dang / lhag par bsam yas nas chos skyong gis kyang / gdan sa 'dzin skyong gi bka' rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul gyi gzhon pa de la babs yod do zer ba'i lung bstan yang thengs gnyis rang byung zhing / khyed rang gi da lta'i byed spyod gang nas bsams kyang /

nged kyi 'dzin skyong 'di tsam zhig gang byas kyang yong nges su 'dug bsam nged kyang blo gdengs khel ba yin pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams dang / sa skya'i sde bstan pa bsam pa'i blo khur bskyed dgos/ de bzhin mi byed na phyi nang gi gnas tshul gang la bltas kyang skyo ba skye ba'i rgyu las mi 'dug pa khyed rang gi blo la mnga' ba ltar yin pas/ nga ni bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i rten bzhengs sogs 'di rnams grub 'phral/ sa skya'i gnas tshul bzang ngan gang yang rna bas mi thos pa'i sbas lung zhig tu tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa la 'gro rgyu 'di ka yin par slar go yong zhing / yang khyed kyis gdung spel dang gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong gi khur byed pa tsam shar na/ nged kyang gzugs gzhi ngan pas yun ring sdod rang snyam pa med kyang / nam lcogs bar khur 'di byed pa las 'os mi 'dug da lta khyed kyi bsam pa la 'chad rtsod rtsom sogs kyi sgo nas mkhas grags thon pa zhig bya snyam pa 'dug ste/ sngon gyi dus kyang gtam dpe la/ chos rje sa paṇa byon lags sam/ /chos 'khor smar po byung lags sam/ /dam nyams kyi sa bon thebs lags sam/ /zhes zhu mkhan byung ba'i lo rgyus 'dug pa bzhin/ da ni ding sang gi dus skal 'di 'dra la chos 'chad sogs la snying po ci yod/ des na khyed kyi 'chad nyan sogs sa paṇa 'dra ba zhig byung pa las/ sa skya'i gdung spel byas nas gdan sa chen po'i sde 'di khra lam me ma nyams pa zhig byung na/ de snga ma las bstan pa la mi phan re zhes dbu snyung bzhes byung bas/ bdag ni de 'dra'i zhe 'dod gtan nas med pa dang / bka' nan lhug stsol lci bas/ lus sbrid nas 'tsho mi thub pa lta bu dang / sems kyang skyo la dga' che ba'i rnam pas mid pa 'khyil ba'i gong gi gsung rnams la lan yang gang yang zhu ma thub pa zhig byung lags pa/ don la ji ltar byas na legs pa 'ong lags sam zhus pas/ rje bla ma nyid kyi gsung las/

yab sras gnyis ka thugs bden pa'i rang bzhin du ni gda'/ zhabs drung rgyan mchog rin po che'i gsung de rnams la yang zhu rgyu gtan nas mi 'dug cing / 'on kyang sku mched mang bas khong rnam pas yab kyi zhal la 'khri ba tsam byung na/ khyed da lta'i rten 'di ka'i thog nas gzhan don mdzad na zhal ngo gong ma rnams la yang zhabs tog tu de ka 'gyur che zhing / bstan pa dang sems can la yang phan sleb de ka che ba yong snyam pa ni 'dug 'on kyang rim gyis dbyibs tshul la gzigs kyin dgag dgos rtsis pa'i gnang lugs gnang ba zab pas de bzhin thugs la zhog mdzod gsungs byung pas/ 'di yang ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i lung bstan ngo mtshar can du snang zhing / de nas siṅga la ste dmar ser can zhes pa me pho sbrul gyi lo/ rje nyid dgung lo bdun cu rtsa drug tu son pa'i zla ba gnyis pa shar ma thag pa'i skabs der thub bstan rnam rgyal nas mkhan chen bzod pa rgya mtsho ba dpon slob mang ba zhig dang / rdzong dga' ldan rtse nas chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos bzang pa sogs phyogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po zhig bla ma 'di'i zhal dkyil mjal ba dang / 'dod chos 'dra gsol ba 'debs pa la byon pa 'dzoms byung pa la brten/ rje bla ma'i gsung gis/ mus phyogs 'dir bsnyen rdzogs kyi las grwa ma byung bar 'gyangs tsam song 'dug da lam phyogs nas dge bshes du ma zhig 'dus pa'i skabs 'dir las gral zhig bsgrigs na bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug gsungs nas/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'dis mkhan po dang / thub bstan mkhan chen gyis las kyi slob dpon/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos bzang pas gsang ste ston pa/ gling kha'i zur 'chad chos rje chos skyong rdo rje bas grib tshod pa/ chos rje kun dga' lhun grub kyis grogs dan bgyi ba'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dbus su/ ngos cag dang / gling ga gzhir bzhugs kyi grwa rigs phyogs nas byon pa dang bcas pa'i bsnyen rdzogs don gnyer gyi gang zag grangs med pa zhig la yang dben bsam gtan phu'i rje sems dpa' chen po'i gzim phug gi steng /

grub chen dkon mchog blo gros kyis gzim khang zhal ser ma'i mdo/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas sku mtshams lo mtshams gnang ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can chos kyi pho brang ga la ba der bstan pa la zhugs la yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa tshang la ma nyams pa'i bka' drin tshad med pa stsal te/ kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi sde chen pos byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'di phal cher khyab par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas bdag cag 'ga' zhig gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ dpal gsang pa 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi rim lnga'i khrid la sogs pa de skor gyi chos tshul rgya che ba zhig stsol bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang thog mar bskyed rim gyi bshad pa gnang ba'i tshe/ paṇa chen gu ru/ rje nyi zla seng ge sogs kyi rnam bshad kyi steng nas rgyas shing zhib la mtha' chod pa mdzad cing / de nas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga'i yi ge rje blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris dang bcas pa la gzhan mkhas pa mang po'i gsung gi legs bshad kyis brgyan pa'i rim lnga'i khrid shin tu smin pa nyams khrid du stsol bar mdzad nas/ de dag gi rgyab rten du rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po'i lung bshad rgyas par gnang ba'i tshe/ nyid kyi gsung las/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi rgya gzhung 'di rnams gang zag gcig gis nyams su len pa na/ gzhung so so'i brjod bya'i don rnams lam rim du bsgrig tshul 'di ltar du shes dgos pa yin te/ de yang thog mar rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i rgyu dbang rdul tshon du bskur tshul/ klu byang gis mdzad pa'i cho ga nyi shu pa pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ smin nas rgyu dbang lam du byed pa ras bris la brten nas bskur tshul sgra gcan 'dzin bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i zung 'jug gsal ba sa paṇa gyi 'gyur te dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro'o/

/dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa la gnyis/ dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa dang po dang / de'i cha lag go /dang po la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mdor byas lo chen gyi 'gyur/ de nyid rtsa rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba mdo dang bsre ba lo chen gyi 'gyur/ mdor byas kyi skabs skabs su mi gsal ba gsal byed kyi kha skong klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ gnyis pa de'i cha lag la/ mdor byas kyi sngon 'gro tshogs bsag ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ sgrub dkyil thams cad kyi kha skong mngon shes can gyis mdzad pa'i gtor chog 'gyur byang med pa/ rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg lo chen gyi 'gyur/ zla grags gnyis pas mdzad pa'i rdor sems sgrub thabs 'gyur byang med pa/ 'di sgron gsal mdzad pa po dang mi mthun te/ mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rnam gzhag rim pa sgron gsal rnams dang 'gal ba mang po snang bas so/ /rdzogs rim la 'phags pas mdzad pa'i rim lnga lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'di'i rim pa gnyis pa'i/ 'khor ba'i gzeb las rnam par grol/ /zhes pa yan chad kyis sems bsgom pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa yar bcad 'phags pa'i gsung yin la/ de las 'phros pa'i gsung 'phros mang po byung ba shākya bshes gnyen gyis chad dogs nas 'phags pa'i gsung rab la mthud nas bris pa ni/ shes rab ngo bo 'di nyid ni/ /zhes pa man chad do/ /'di sems dben gyi kha skong du ar+ya de was sems kyi sgrib sbyong mdzad pa nag tsho tshul rgyal gyi 'gyur/ klu byang gis las mtha' rnam 'byed mdzad pa chag lo chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgyu lus kyi kha skong du ar+ya de wa'i bdag byin rlabs pa 'gos 'gyur/ 'od gsal gyi chos can bde ba chen po'i kha skong du ar+ya de was mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/

chos nyid spros bral du ston pa'i kha skong 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems 'grel lo chen gyi 'gyur/ rim lnga'i rim pa re re la yang rim pa lnga re tshang bar bstan pa klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rim pa khong du bsdus pa pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis 'gyur/ de rnams kyi rim pa lnga rgyas par bstan pa'i don bsgom pas nyams myong skye ba ngo sprod pa ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus sgron ma lo chen gyi 'gyur la 'gos kyis bcos pa/ rim lnga sbyor ba yan lag drug tu sbyar ba'i sbyar drug sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'gos kyi mdzad pa'i shog ril gsum/ nyi ma seng ges mdzad pa'i btsun mo can gyi shog ril gyi 'grel pa sogs kyang de dag gi zhabs 'degs su sbyar nas 'chad cing nyams su len pa'i gnad shes dgos pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / yang de dus rje'i gsung las/ ding sang dus ngan gyi dbang gis gsang 'dus skor la yang dbang rgyun re tsam ma gtogs/ chos skor gzhan rnams rtsad chod mkhan dang don gnyer byed mi yang re re tsam yang med pa la thug pa'i tshod du song gda' ba/ sngon ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi skabs su gsang 'dus 'phags skor kho na la 'chad nyan mdzad tshul yang chos rje srad pa kun blos zin bris su btab pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpal gyi chos grwa chen po e wam̐ chos ldan du rje thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang pos dgung lo bdun bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa/ srad pa kun blo rang dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa chu mo bya'i lo gsar du shar ba nas dgun dpyid zla ba bzhi'i bar du rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor gsung ba la/ sngon du zla ba gcig tsam gyi ring spyi'i byung tshul rgyas pa gcig gnang ste/ de la yang zin bris srad pa kun blos mdzad pa shin tu legs pa zhig byung zhing / de nas snga chos la bskyed rdzogs gzhung phran dang bcas pa gnang zhing /

dgong chos la rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa rgyas par gsung / tshar rting ma'i gsol ja'i thog tu bskyed rim gyi bshad pa gsungs dus bu ston rin po che'i mdor byas kyi ṭīk+ka la snga gzigs re mdzad nas/ ja grol ma thag snga chos gsung du 'byon pas ngor dgon pa'i tshogs khang du rje rdo rje 'chang nyid sgo nang du phebs tsam nas yig brgya'i mgo 'dren mdzad de khrir bzhugs nas/ chos rim la dpon slob kun gyis rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya nyer gcig re dang / sku rkyang gis gsang 'dus nyid kyi gtor chog ltar 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngo mdzad nas chos gsungs te/ bskyed rim gyi bshad pa 'gos rdog gi bzhed pa gtso cher rang lugs su bzhag nas/ bu ston gyi bzhed pa res 'thad pa dang / skabs su sun 'byin dgos pa yang snang zhing / phyis kyi 'dus pa la sbyangs shing mkhas par rlom pa dag gi rtog btags la dgag sgrub cher mdzad/ rang lugs kyi sgrub byed du sngon 'gro dang / lhag mos lta bu'i don tshan re song / rim gyis nyid kyi rang lugs 'phags pa'i bzhed pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i phyir mdor byas/ de yang rgyud kyi lung gi bsgrub pa dang / mdor byas su cung zad kha skong dgos pa yang yod pas mdo bsre/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyung ba'i dkyil 'khor/ sbyang gzhi snod bcud kyi srid pa'i rim pa ltar sbyong byed ston pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa rnams kyi 'bru snon/ rgyas bshad dka' gnad rnams lung rig man ngag gi sgo nas zhib par ston cing / zla grags kyis mdzad zer ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyang bshad pa dang bcas pa gnang / rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslabs nas bden gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi bar du spyod bsdus las 'byung ba'i bslab tshigs ring mo rgyas par gsungs/ de dus snga gzigs la rje 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo/

shog ril gsum/ 'gos kyi gsung bgros yig sna dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ rim lnga 'gos lugs de las kyang paṇ+ḍi ta btsun mo can gyi shog ril la thugs rtsis su mdzad de/ gzhan mar lugs la dmigs pa'i byed lugs 'di ltar yod do zhes dmigs rkang tshang bar gnang ste/ bu ston gyi khrid yig dben pa gsum 'gos lugs gtso la/ bden pa gnyis mar lugs rang du yod cing / zung 'jug gnyis ka ltar yod ces gsungs pa las dgag sgrub cher mi mdzad/ ding sang gi 'dus pa bar grags pa rnams kyi gsung la yi ger bris pa la nor ba 'di 'dra yod cing / nged kyis gsung gleng gi sgo nas rtsad bcad pa la 'di 'dra yod do zhes sogs phyogs snga rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa long ba'i dgag sgrub cher mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga dang / 'phags pa'i spyod bsdus la bshad pa rgyas pa mdzad/ gzhan gzhung rnams la lung bshad pa thor re ba gnang / de'i tshe bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa zhib rgyas che la 'gag don 'gril ba/ sun 'byin sgrub byed nus pa che la tshig rigs gtsang ba/ nyams len sems thog tu 'khyer bde ba gnang bas/ srad pa kun blo'i slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po/ don yod dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ snga chos de gsan rjes byams chos gsungs pa'i chos grwar nyin re bzhin chos rje rin po ches de ring gi chos thun de gcig po'i mkhas pa'i khyad par dgag sgrub rnams kyi rnam gzhag nyams len la sbyor tshul nged rang tsho'i yon tan phyogs gcig tu dril ba la med gsungs/ chos thun yang 'tshams par byung bas dgyes par mdzad/ gung ja'i bar la rje 'gos kyi mchan chen po la snga gzigs mdzad cing / res 'ga' rdog pa'i 'grel bshad kyang gzigs nas/ dgong chos la sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod rgyan bdun gyi stong thun rnams la sngon la gzhung thog tu mi gzigs par skam bshad rgyas pa re mdzad/ de nas bu ston rin po che'i mtha' drug rab gsal gyi steng nas bshad pa dang 'bru snon lung tshun chad yi ge gcig kyang ma lus par mdzad rjes/

mang ra'i dka' mchan dang / rdog dang rlan gyi ṭīk+kar de 'dra'i nyag nyog mang po mi byed par/ go rgyu che la tshig nyung ba'i hril pa 'di 'dra byed pa yin gsungs nas/ snga rabs pa'i lugs kyi bshad pa rno thag chod pa re mdzad/ dper mtshon na sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod bshad par dam bca' la/ bu ṭīka na 'bru snon dang / bshad yams rgyas la/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la spyi sbas mthar thug sogs skyar gyin mang po bris pa de gsungs rjes su/ snga rabs pa rnams 'di 'dra'i go rgyu chung la zer rgyu mang ba mi byed/ rgyud tshig la bzhi bshad dges pa du ma byung yang / bstan bcos kyi 'bru snon la bzhi bshad byed pa ci 'dra yin ma shes/ 'di la mang ra seng rgyal 'di ltar gsungs te bshad do zhes sbyar/ gang bshad na/ dpal ldan rgyud rgyal zhes dang / rgyal ba'i 'dus gang yin pa bshad/ gang gis bshad na zla ba grags pas bshad/ sngon du bya ba ci byas nas bshad na/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la btud de bshad/ tshul ji ltar bshad na/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi shin tu gsal bar rnam phye legs bshad pa mtha' drug gis ni 'ching pas bcings te bshad/ snod gang la bshad na/ rgyal sras yul gyur te dbang rnon skal ldan la bshad/ slob dpon su'i man ngag la brten nas bshad na/ de ni klu sgrub las rnyed pa/ de lta bu'i man ngag la ma brten na bshad par mi nus te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas kyi rgyas btab ces sbyar/ tshogs gnyis dpal dang ldan pas na dpal ldan no/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po ni gsang 'dus so/ /gang 'dus na rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pas rgyal ba'i 'dus gang yin pa'o/ /khyab pa ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis so/ /bdag ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i bdag nyid du gyur pas so/ /dpal ldan zung 'jug rdo rje don dam/

sems dpa' kun rdzob/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi ni bshad rgyud bzhis so/ /shin tu ni mi shes pa dang bral te ma nor bar ro/ /gsal ba ni the tshom dang bral te sgra zur ma chag pa'o/ /rnam phye ni log rtog dang bral te rgyud kyi don tshig re re nas legs bshad pa ni tshig rang yang sdebs legs par ro/ /'chad lugs kyi chings sgra ji bzhin pa dang / ma yin pa dang / dgongs/ dgongs min/ drang don/ nges don te/ tshig dang / don dang / tshig don gnyis ka'i mtha' drug gi chings kyis bcings nas so/ /de lta bu'i bshad tshul dka' zhing zab pa ni rgyal sras te/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gi yul du gyur pas de la bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas ni/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa thugs kyi nying khu bskyed rdzogs gnyis sogs/ rgyas btab ni mtshan pa'i rgya'o/ /zhes pa'i don dka' mchan las 'byung bas/ mdor na dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa zla grags bdag gis bshad pa'i rgyud bzhi'i mtha' drug gi chings dang ldan par klu sgrub kyi gdams ngag la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs don rim gnyis kyi rgya dang ldan pa de/ slob ma dang brgyud 'dzin rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyi don du bshad ces pa'o/ /gsungs te/ de lta bu'i mtshon don gling gzhi'i bshad pa'i skabs su rim lnga'i bshad pa rgyas par snang ste yun ring po song / de man chad la sngon la rgyud kyi steng du 'bru snon dang bshad pa go sla ba re/ de nas 'grel pa'i 'bru snon rgya che ba re/ de nas bu ṭika ltar 'bru dang bshad pa sbyar ba re/ de nas ṭīk+ka 'dir de bzhin bshad kyang / mchan chen dang / rdog dang / rlan gyis go bde la don bzang ba 'di ltar mdzad gsungs pa dang / skabs mang por ni mchan chen gyi yin tshod du 'dug ste/ mngon shes can gzhung 'di la 'di ltar 'chad/

btsun mo can 'di 'dra byed/ nag po pas 'di skad gsungs te/ khong kun gyi bshad lugs ya mtshan che ba/ rje 'gos kyang gsung bgros 'di tsam yang so sor ma 'dres par bkod pa thugs bsam dge ba bstan pa la bsam pa a tshi ba a tshi ba/ 'di lta bu sngon gyi sa skya pa rnying pa tsho la kye rdor bir+wa'i lugs dang gzhan mi bsre/ man ngag lugs dang 'grel pa lugs mi bsre/ man ngag lugs kyi yang thun mong du gsungs pa dang lam 'bras kyi lung sbyor mi bsre ba yod/ ding sang yin na rgyal khams kyi lung 'khyams kun yo bsres tshar/ bslad tshar/ rje 'gos kyis de bzhin mdzad pa sku drin che gsungs/ dus phyis kyi gsang 'dus kyang gsar pa rnams ni sgron gsal gyi mchan dang mtha' spyad zer ba'i rigs lam nas drangs zer/ spyir bla med kyi grub mtha' dang mi mthun/ sgos su mar 'gos sogs la ye med pa'i/ sol ba bsdar bas dkar po mi 'byung ba ltar rang lus 'dis sangs rgyas mi 'grub/ rnam smin gyi lus dor te rang bzhin gnyug ma'i yid lus gcig gis zung 'jug sgrub bya ba sogs gsung rab la dbang chen po mang po byas yod de/ bla med kyi rgyud rgya gzhung gi go ba rnal ma re chags na yig cha de kun bklags pa tsam gyis rang skyon rjen cher te rig rgyu gcig yong bya ba sogs dgag sgrub kyang mang du mdzad pas chos thun shin tu che/ rjes na mar la mkhas mchog don yod dpal ba'i drung nas chos grol nas rang gi gnas su phebs nas 'di skad gsungs te/ gsang sngags pa'i chos kyi 'chad lugs bu ṭika yig tshogs can de phyag tu bsnams/ de'i yi ge gcig kyang ma lus pa la 'bru bsnan/ der rting des go chod mod/ yang de bkag nas snga rabs pa'i bzhed pa re/ yang na snga rabs pa la thugs rtsis mdzad rting bu ṭika gi gang mdzad/ bshad lugs de rno la bzang ba/ nyung ba 'dug pa de ka gnang bas chog mod/ phyogs snga la yang kha cig na re zhes mi chen gyi tshig sbram po mdzad pas chog pa la/

chos rje dge ldan pa chen pos 'di ru 'di skad bris/ 'di dus 'di skad gsungs/ de 'dras ga na 'ong / a pha pha zhes gsungs pa sogs de 'dra gsung ga la dgos/ bla ma chen po 'di tsam du song nas mi chos gru bzhi lam pa byas pas chog pa yin gsungs te/ drung nas rang spyir dga' ba gdong la 'byon dgos pas rgyud myur bar grol na dgongs pa dang / khyad par mtshan nyid kyi chos mang po 'chad dgos pas chos thun chung tsam la chos 'gro che ba byung na dgongs par 'dug go /de dus srad pa kun blo rang gi thugs bsam la ni/ sngon la rgyud kyang la 'bru bsnan te/ ting nge 'dzin 'dis nyams len 'di ston gsungs pa des brda chad lam pa re chags/ de nas sgron gsal la 'bru bsnan te tshul bzhi sogs bshad tshul 'grel pa rang skad gsal sing ste 'ongs/ bu ṭika phyag tu bsnams nas 'chad cing tshig re re bzhin 'bru mnan te gsungs pa ni/ chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pa de bu ston la shin tu mos pas bu ston bka' 'bum bzhengs/ cung zad ma grub pa la chos rje nyid la gsob gsung gnang ste bsab kyang yod/ rjes kyang bu ṭika steng nas tshar gsum gsan pas de'i 'brel dang zhen par gda'/ rjes su yig cha rnying pa rnams kyi lugs de man ngag thon che ba dang go sla ba sogs dgos pa mang po gzigs pa yin te/ de tsho'i gsung skyor tsa na khong kun gsang 'dus la mi tshe phyi zhing gril ba rnams zhes gsungs pa sogs che brjod mdzad pa/ yig cha bzang po de rnams kyi bshad sgrub dar la re bar 'dug bu ston gzigs rgya che yang / rdog dang rlan gyi yig cha rnams las 'gos kyi stong thun dang / mchan chen/ shog ril gsum dang ma mjal tshod du 'dug ste/ khong pa nan tan ltar bshad yams mang pa la rdog pas 'di ltar gsungs pa las/ 'gos kyi yig cha na 'di yod ces ma bkod do/ /'dus pa phyi ma ba rnams la dgag sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe yang rje'i zhal la lta snying 'dod cing /

da dung sun 'byin dang tshig nyams 'dra byung na bsam dga' ru tshor ba dang / chos thun 'di da rung ma grol na snyam pa dang / 'di lta bu'i rgyud sde khyad par can rje 'gos lta bu'i lo tsā ba rang bzo mi mdzad pa la man ngag che ba'i gsung la gtug rgyu yod pa chos rje srad pa rang yang bsod nams che bsam pa byung zhing / zhwa lu pa'i drin las kyang gsang 'dus kyi bshad srol bzang po da lta'i bar du byung bar 'dug snyam pa dang / dge ldan pas kyang gsang 'dus la go la ma go'i yig cha mdzad/ ding sang dar bas rjes kyang dge ldan du sku mdun du yang khong tsho'i lugs dpyis phyin par zhus/ yig cha rnams kyang bzhengs/ bshad pa mdzad pas khong tshos rigs lam nas 'dren zhes smras pas de'i gnyen por rje snga rabs pa'i lung man ngag thabs mkhas kyi khyad par mang po'i mdzod brtol te lhug par gnang ba 'di khong tshos 'ben bzang po btsugs pa'i drin yin par dgongs pas/ chos rje srad pa rang la ni dge ldan pa la log lta'i rnam pa dus thams cad du nam yang ma byung zhes sogs khong rang gi zin bris de nyid du gsungs 'dug cing / de ltar zla ba gsum gyi bar du snga chos dgong chos gnyis ka 'dus pa la gril te/ rgyud 'grel/ bshad srol gsar rnying phyogs snga'i tshul gyis dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i gnad la dgag sgrub sogs dpyis phyin par gnang bas/ de dus chos grwar 'dus pa'i don gnyer can rnams zla ba gsum po de'i ring la gsang ba 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa re byung yod pa gda' zhes sogs gsungs shing / de lta bu'i gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi chos skor rnams zla ba phyed gnyis kyi bar tsam du smin rgyas su stsal pa grol ba'i nyin/ bdag cag rnams kyis so so nas ci 'byor gyi chos yon gyi rnam grangs rgya dpangs mi chung tsam phul nas/ slar yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa nas brgyud pa'i blo sbyong gi khrid sogs chos skor cha tshang ba zhig gnang dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa bzhin zhal gyis bzhes nas/

thog mar bka' gdams lha bzhir grags pa'i thub pa'i lha khrid/ seng ldeng nags sgrol rjes dran gyi khrid/ mi g.yo ba chos drug gi khrid/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi khrid rnams dang / de nas blo sbyong don bdun ma nyams khrid du gnang ste/ de dag gi rgyab rten du jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar che chung / blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ 'gro mgon dpal ye/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig rgyas bsdus rnams kyi lung bshad sogs smin rgyas su stsol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de dus rje bla ma'i gsung gi tshig zur zin pa rnams cung zad brjod na/ sngon dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyis 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba mang du mdzad kyang / 'dir dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa 'chad ka ba'i lugs kyi don bdun nyid gzhir bzhag nas/ de'i steng du jo bo nyid kyi bla ma gser gling pa nas brgyud pa'i rtsa ba lus lta bu sems pa'i rim pa/ 'phros don yan lag lta bu lam khyer gyi chos bco brgyad/ dharma rak+ṣi ta nas brgyud pa'i mtshon cha 'khor lo dang rma bya dug 'joms gnyis/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor nas brgyud pa'i gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu/ de gsum don 'dus pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu/ 'brom gyis mdzad pa'i shan brgyad ma/ dpal glang ri thang pas mdzad pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma ste/ dri ma med pa'i gzhung chung 'di rnams sngar gyi sa bcad bdun po'i steng du bsdus nas 'chad na/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos ston pa'i skabs su/ jo bos rgyal srid spangs pa'i rnam thar dang / gser gling du byon pa'i rnam thar gnyis/ yang gser gling du byon pa nas brtsams te yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyi bar lam yig nyid du gsal bar ston pas/ mdor na jo bo'i sku 'di nyid kyi rnam thar ma chad pa bstan la/

sku skye snga ma'i skye brgyud rnams nor bu phreng ba'i nang na gsal bar bstan pas/ de dag long skabs dang bstun nas lung rgyas par gnad bsdus pa re 'chad de/ lam srol 'byed pa po a ti sha'i rnam thar ma tshang ba med par bstan la/ de ni yid ches par byed pa'i lo rgyus so zhes gsungs nas/ thog mar jo bo'i rnam thar gyi skabs su shin tu rgyas shing sems la 'bab pa gsungs pa rnams yi ge tshegs bskyung pa'i phyir 'dir tshigs bcad du spel na/ jo bo lha gcig zhes grags a ti shas/ /dgung lo bcu gnyis lon nas bco brgyad bar/ /rig pa'i khu byug a wa dhu tī pa/ /ra hū la sogs bla ma mang bsten nas/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dgongs don phal chen rnyed/ /ting 'dzin mu mtha' med pa thugs la 'khrungs/ /khyad par skyes mchog a wa dhū ti las/ /chags pa med pa dbu ma'i chos lugs gsan/ /de la brten nas bden pa mthong bzhed na'ang / /rang bzhin dbyings nas byon pa'i rnal 'byor mas/ /de las bzlog ste rab tu byung zhes gsungs/ /yang ni a ti sha yi dgongs pa la/ /da ni dur khrod bas mthar gnas bcas nas/ /tshe 'dir gsang sngags 'bras bus sngon sgrub snyam/ /dgongs ma thag tu bla ma ra hū la/ /ri nag bya rkang can nas 'phur te byon/ /mdun du bzhugs te lung bstan 'di ltar mdzad/ /khyod kyi bsam yul des ni cir mi phyin/ /ngur smrig gos gyon thub pa'i brtul zhugs zungs/ /spyan ras gzigs sgoms byang chub sems gnyis sbyongs/ /'bras bre phyed btang 'bras bu smin pa yi/ /rgyal po la brten gzhan phan 'byung gsungs kyang / /zla ba'i snying po sngar las thugs ma 'gyur/ /de nub mnal lam dga' ldan gnas su byon/ /thub dbang 'khor bcas gdugs tshod gsol ba ni/ /thams cad mthun pa spyan gzigs mgrin gcig tu/ /khyod nyid ci la chags te 'khor bar gnas/ /zhes gsungs mod la gdung ba'i mchi ma blags/

/thugs sad gyur tshe rdo rje gdan byon te/ /phal chen sde las rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs/ /dus shig byang chub chen por bzhugs pa na/ /lha chung rnams kyis myur du sangs rgya ba'i/ /thabs mchog gang lags zhus tshe lha chen rnams/ /byang chub sems gnyis sbyongs zhes mgrin gcig gsungs/ /de nas phyi skor mdzad tshe nam mkha' la/ /gar bsgyur res 'ga' sa la gom pa 'dor/ /mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa'i bud med gnyis/ /sngar bzhin 'dri tshe sngar bzhin lan 'debs skad/ /dus gcig ku su lu yi rnal 'byor pa/ /gcig la paṇa chen rnams kyis sngar bzhin dris/ /de tshe sngar bzhin lan btab yid ma ches/ /de tshe yid ches sgrub phyir pra phab ste/ /byis pa gzhon nu snying la lha mo ni/ /tsun di gnas la'ang sngar gyi don rnams dris/ /de tshe paṇa grub rnams kyis me long la/ /thub dbang ting nge 'dzin gyis spyan drangs nas/ /me long dwangs pa'i nang na ci zhig snang / /shākya mu ne mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od can/ /de la sngar bzhin zhus tshe sngar bzhin gsungs/ /da dung yid ma ches nas phyogs bcu yi/ /rgyal sras rnams dang byams mgon spyan drangs te/ /byams pas de don rgyas par gsungs pa na/ /paṇa grub kun gyi the tshom mun pa sangs/ /de nas gser gling bla ma byang sems kyi/ /bstan pa'i bdag por dgongs nas zhabs drung bsnyegs/ /dka' ba brgya phrag du ma nyer spyad de/ /byang chub sems kyi nor bu blang pa'i phyir/ /gzings chen nang du 'khor bcas zhugs zhes thos/ /'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan a ti shas rab tu byung zhing byang chub kyi sems gnyis btsal ba'i lo rgyus cung zad zin pa bzhin bkod pa'o/ /de nas bla ma dam pa gser gling pas/ /byams pa thogs med rjes su 'brang ba yi/ /bsam pa sems bskyed gdams pa du mas bskyangs/ /mdor na theg pa che chung ma lus pa'i/ /rnam par thar pa thams cad bstan rjes su/ /bla mas dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan gsung byon pa/

/sa yi bdag po rgyal srid rnam spangs nas/ /'bangs kyi tshul du bla ma brgya phrag bsten/ /chags pa med par bka' spyad go gyon nas/ /shes bya 'di la phyogs ris med par slobs/ /da ni re zhig rgya gar dbus su song / /gnas la nges med gtsug lag yongs su 'grims/ /phyi nang shags phye bstan pa'i dpang po mdzod/ /gsungs nas bla ma rgya mtsho'i 'gram du byon/ /de nas gzings btang zla ba dgu tsam du/ /mthun pa'i rlung dang sbyar te yul dbus byon/ /gtsug lag khang chen brgya rtsa'i bdag po mdzad/ /chos rgyal chen po kun gyis mnga' dbang bskur/ /slar yang dpon g.yog lnga bcu tshong par bcas/ /nyes skyon med par gser gyi gling du byon/ /lo gnyis nye bar bla ma mchog la bsten/ /gdams pa'i lhag ma kun kyang rdzogs par zhus/ /e ma bla ma de ni snying rje che/ /chos rnams tig tig nan tan lhur len cing / /lta ba'ang snang ba tsam gyi dbu ma 'dzin/ /phal cher sems tsam lta bur gsungs pa la/ /jo bos mtha' bral dbu ma'i don gleng pas/ /bla ma'i zhal nas mkhas pa legs soms dang / /bya khyung chen po nam mkha'i mtha' spyod kyang / /rgyu 'bras sa yi steng du rtsi ba yin/ /da dung stong pa'i rbad khams ches gyur na/ /rgyu 'bras lam la bskur pa btab pa srid/ /ces gsungs da dung jo bos thabs mkhas kyis/ /lta ba dbu ma chen por drangs gyur kyang / /cung zad 'gyur yang gting nas ma 'gyur bas/ /jo bos sgrol ma yum la gsol ba btab/ /sgro skur dri ma'i skyon gyis ma bslad pa'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyi gshegs shul gang / /chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' bral dbu ma'i don/ /bdag gi bla ma'i thugs la bskyed du gsol/ /slar yang jo bos rgya gar gnas su byon/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rnam par rgyas par mdzad/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyi char pa phabs/ /ngan song sgo bcad thar pa'i lam srol phyed/ /lan cig bla ma dam pa gser gling pas/

/sgrol ma yum la gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ /dī pam̐ kā ras bstan pa'i lta ba 'di/ /sgro bskur med pa'i lta ba yin lags sam/ /sgrol mas yang dag lta bar lung bstan pas/ /bla ma dgyes shing de nub dgongs pa na/ /lta ba'i mthar thug dbu ma chen por go /nangs pa'i dus su rang gi sras gyur pa'i/ /lha dbang blo gros bos nas khyed song la/ /bdag gi gtam 'di dben par snyan du zhus/ /dī pam̐ khyod kyis bstan pa'i lta ba yis/ /bdag ni 'ching ba'i mdud pa kun las grol/ /ngo mtshar tshul la da dung dpyad dgos pas/ /da dung shog ces bsgo ba'i gsung gi 'phrin/ /dge slong des ni jo bo nyid la springs/ /gsan ma thag tu dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan nas/ /gser dang ldan pa'i gnas su slar yang byon/ /gser gling zhabs pad chu skyes zung ldan pa/ /spyi bo'i cod paṇa gtsug tu bsti gnas mdzad/ /e ma ho stong nyid mdzes pa'i rtse dga' yis/ /khyod thugs dgyes pa bskyed par gyur ces thos/ /de la ngo mtshar yid rang dpag med kyis/ /dga' ston mchog gis snying gi spu long g.yos/ /slar yang khyed zhabs pad ma bung ba bzhin/ /dga' dang dad pa'i sems kyis 'dir mchis lags/ /zhes zhus bla ma'i dgyes pa yar ngo'i dpal/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis btams par byas pa bzhin/ /bla ma'i gsung nas dī pam̐ bod yul du/ /ma rig mun pa sel phyir myur du song / /bdag kyang dngos grub brnyes nas gangs can der/ /khyod kyis 'phrin las lta phyir yong bar 'khums/ /de nas smon lam brgya phrag du ma yis/ /bla ma mnyes pa gang yin sgrub mdzad nas/ /paṇa chen lnga bcu rtsa gnyis cod pan rtser/ /zhabs sen chu skyes 'od dkar spro bar mdzad/ /ces 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan a ti shas gser gling chos kyi grags pa'i dgongs don mtha' bral dbu mar bsdus tshul cung zad zin pa bzhin bkod pa lags/ dī pam̐ kā ra'i snyan pa'i ba dan ni/

/srid gsum skye ba'i rna ba'i rgyan du byas/ /khyad par spu rgyal bod kyi rgyal po de'i/ /rna bar lhung pas snying gi pad+mo rgyas/ /gtsug lag khang grum ra ba bcos pa na/ /'dre srin rnams kyis rnam par 'tshe bar byed/ /lta ngan bon dang sbyor sgrol log pa'i tshogs/ /thar pa'i srog gcod ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'khrid/ /da ni rgya gar mkhan po a ti sha/ /lus srog bya dga' gang la'ang ma ltos par/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i me ro gso snyam pa'i/ /lhag bsam zla ba tshes 'dras bskul gyur nas/ /blo ldan skyes bu zung gyur bcu drug la/ /gser dang 'phrin bskul yang yang mgon po de'i/ /phyogs su brdzangs kyang sngon gyi las dbang gis/ /de dag sbrul dug tshad nad dag gis bkums/ /da dung snying stobs go cha rab brtan pa/ /ye shes 'od des gser 'tshol phyir byon pas/ /gar log gis bzung chos spong yang na ni/ /rang mnyam gser gyis slus zhes 'phrin du springs/ /de dus byang chub 'od kyis gser dang bcas/ /gar log yul byon srang gzhal da dung yang / /chos rgyal dbu yi tshad tsam ma 'khor bas/ /de tshol don du rang yul 'byon par brtsams/ /de dus khu bo khri mun bzhugs pa'i sgor/ /byon nas skad gzengs mthon pas 'di skad gsol/ /sngon las dbang gis bskyod pa'i ma li ka'i/ /phreng mdzes ngan skyugs khron par 'di ltar dor/ /rab 'jigs dmag dang chos spongs bdag cag gis/ /khyod thugs 'gal snyam bgyi ba cung ma nus/ /gser btsal bslu phyir 'bad kyang da dung yang / /bag tsam ma 'khor myur du rtsol ba bskyed/ /de bar sngon las dgongs shing 'gro kun gyi/ /sdug bsngal khur du 'khur zhing bzhugs 'tshal lo/ /zhes zhus rten med thugs ni blong blong po/ /rtsol med mchi mas bzhin ras pad mtsho bkab/ /de nas ye shes 'od kyis slar gsungs pa/ /tsha bo bu las lhag pa'i snying stobs can/ /thog med dus nas da lan tsam zhi las/

/chos phyir srog ni nam yang gtong ma myong / /da lan kho bos rnyed pa'i mchog rnyed pa/ /'di la dpogs la dam chos dka' bas tshol/ /sdig rgyal 'di la nga phyir ra ti yi/ /gser tsam zhig kyang sbyin par mi 'os kyis/ /gang yod gser gyis da dung a ti sha/ /bod yul mun pa sel phyir spyan drongs shig /mgon po de la kho bo'i 'phrin 'di 'ang gsol/ /khyod phyir bdag gis srog kyang ltos med btang / /'on kyang tshe 'dir mjal ba'i skal bas dben/ /phyi ma rjes su 'dzin cing bdag nyid kyi/ /bsam pa'i gtso bo bod yul 'byon pa mkhyen/ /thub pa'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku/ /ye shes 'od kyi de skad bka' stsal pas/ /byang chub 'od ni yid rang rgyal sras kyi/ /rlabs chen mdzad pas snying gi spu long g.yos/ /spyi bor thal sbyar e ma'o sems dpa' che/ /de ltar bgyis la skye ba thams cad du'ang / /byang chub sems dpa' blo chung bsam pa yis/ /thar pa'i bar chad gang du'ang mi bgyid 'tshal/ /zhes brjod mthing sngon ral pa'i ge sar rtser/ /zhabs sen zla ba'i thig le ngal gsos nas/ /snang tshul skyo yang bsam yul theg chen gyi/ /snying stobs chen po'i go cha bgos par gyur/ /de ma thag tu log lta'i rgyal ngan gyis/ /chos rgyal sku nongs med la 'ja' 'od dang / /me tog bsil ma yid 'ong dri bzang gis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di bkang nas lha yul gshegs/ /byang chub 'od kyis nag tsho lo tsā ba/ /dpon g.yog bdun la gser srang bdun brgya bskur/ /khu bo'i dgongs pa bskang phyir a ti sha/ /spyan 'dren zhu phyir slar yang rgya gar brdzangs/ /bshul ring lam la dub pas smyug sbubs su/ /mnal bar mdzad tshe gzhon nu shel mdog can/ /gcig gis bslangs nas myur du song zhes gsungs/ /su yin dris pas myur du shes 'gyur skad/ /gaṅgā'i 'gram du mnyan pas gru ma sbyin/ /sems zhum gser rnams bye 'og sbas te nyal/

/mtshan phyed tsam na mnyan pa dkar po zhig /yig drug glu dbyangs len cing mtsho mthar brgal/ /de nas bi kra ma yi gtsug lag tu/ /paṇa chen gnam gyi skar ma tsam dang mjal/ /'on kyang mkhyen brtse'i nyi zlas brgyan pa'i sku/ /jo bo gang yin ma shes yid skyo bsten/ /'brom ston thugs rje'i rnam sprul bgrang yas kyis/ /gnas brtan nor bcol byis pa de la snyan pa'i tshig dang bcas nas drang srong rgan po'i gzugs kyis/ sprang phrug gi gzugs kyis/ byis pa dang bu mo'i gzugs kyis/ mi dkar gyi gzugs kyi/ rgya brtson seng bod du jo bo 'byon par nges kyi bar sprul/ bi kra ma la'i sgo drung du mtshan phyed tsam gyi rol ba na/ sgo khung nas bod brtson seng gi skad 'dra ba zhig gis/ da lta nam gyi gung du snang / skya rengs dang po tsam la sgo 'byed/ de bar sgo drung gi byis pa de la nor bcol bde bar nyol gsungs/ lam bshad gsang bar gdams/ /jo bo ngo sprod 'byon par gsol ba btab/ /dka' ba'i gnas dkrol brtson seng 'brog chung sprul/ /de nas nor dang byang chub 'od kyi 'phrin/ /ma lus rdzogs par jo bo'i snyan du phul/ /khyad par ye shes 'od kyis 'phrin springs pas/ /jo bo'ang brtse ba'i spyan chab nyil mdzad nas/ /bod kyi mi nor mang po bdag phyir nong / /de phyir sems la khur po ri bas lci/ /rgyal po ye shes 'od khong 'o re rgyal/ /gar log sdig can ngan pa snying rje'i gnas/ /zhes gsung sgrol ma 'bar ba'i gtsug lag tu/ /gser rnams maṇ+ḍal tshul bshams rtse gcig pas/ /sgrol mdzad rgyal ba'i yum la gsol btab mdzad/ /'phags mas ngo mtshar sku yi bkod pa bstan/ /tshangs dbyangs gsung gis lung bstan 'di ltar mdzad/ /dī pam̐ khyod kyi gdul bya bod na 'dug /khyad par u pa si ka gcig la phan/ /tshe lo nyi shu 'bri gyur de lta na'ang / /'gro ba'i don ni mu mtha' med par 'byung /

/bdun bcu gnyis la byams pa'i zhabs drung du/ /pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khrir 'dug pa'i/ /nam mkha' dri med snying po zhes bya ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i sras su gyur bar gdon mi za/ /zhes gsungs snga phyir bla ma yi dam gyis/ /lung bstan mdzad pa dang mthun thugs rang ste/ /a ti sha yi phan dgongs ldan pa'i thugs/ /bod yul gangs ri'i phyogs su mngon par phyogs/ /lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad kyi lde mig rnams/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa brgya rtsa brgyad la gtad/ /rang gi bdog pa'i dngos kun phongs pa yi/ /bza' btung phyir du ltos med sbyin gtong mdzad/ /rang rang sa yi bdag po rnams bskul nas/ /gtsug lag khang chen rnams kyi zhig ral gsos/ /dze ta ri dang byang chub bzang po dang / /rigs pa'i khu byug a wa dhu ti pa/ /ra hu la dang ḍom+bhi ba la sogs/ /chos kyis 'brel ba'i bla ma thams cad la/ /phyag mchod bsnyen bkur smon lam brgya phrag mdzad/ /de nas bal po jo bo'i mnal lam bal por li yul gyi rgyal po dge ba'i blo gros la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i rten khyad par gzhi rang gi blangs pa sogs nas brgyud bod yul byon/ /lta ba mtho zhing spyod pa zhib pa yis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo yul phyogs kun tu bskor/ /khyad par byang chub 'od kyi dgongs pa'i don/ /thams cad chos dang mthun par mdzad pa'i mthar/ /khu rngog 'brom gsum dad brtson shing rta yis/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i nyi ma a ti sha/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i mkha' la legs drangs pas/ /skal ldan mang po'i blo yi pad tshal phye/ /shul lam kun tu'ang thar pa'i sa bon bzhag /lkog gyur chos 'ga' ma 'ongs lung bstan mdzad/ /mthong thos dran reg thar pa'i lam la bkod/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dgyes pa'i gdong bsus nas/ /a ti sha la bsu ba mdzad ces gleng / /rgyal blon dus kyi gter rnams sgo phye nas/ /sngon dus bzhengs pa'i lha khang dkar chag dang / /ma 'ongs 'byung tshul du ma gsal bar bstan/

/'gro ba'i don dang chos kyi bya ba rnams/ /dus rnam kun tu rgyun chad med par bsgrubs/ /de slad a ti sha yi bka' drin ni/ /cha tsam dran pas dad pa'i spu long g.yos/ /zhes 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan a ti sha bod yul du byon pa'i rnam par thar pa cung zad zin pa bkod pa yin la/ mkhas grub dpal gyi mar me mdzad pa de/ /rgya gar yul du bstan pa'i sgron me mdzad/ /thugs rje chen pos bod yul mun pa bsal/ /mdzad pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs rjes su/ /gdul bya'i don du snyung ba'i tshul bstan tshe/ /chos dbyings nam mkha'i bu mo sngo sangs ma/ /rnam bkra'i chu 'dzin gsar pa'i gos gyon zhing / /yid 'ong 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i rgyan ldan ma/ /lha rdzas me tog char pa 'bebs par snang / /ljon shing du ma mya ngan 'khyog yid can/ /skra yi lo 'dab rlung gis phyogs bcur gtor/ /sdug bsngal shugs glu snying gi tsher ma ni/ /ser bu'i dbyangs la bskyon nas len par byed/ /'dzam gling nyi ma gling gzhan shing rta yis/ /nyer drangs rang gling nub ri'i rtser son tshe/ /bstan la dga' ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ /mchi mas phyogs der phyag chag chag btab ba bzhin/ /snying rje'i gter gyur a ti sha yi thugs/ /dga' ldan chos kyi mdun sar nyer dgongs tshe/ /'brom rjes rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ /gus pas thal sbyar gdung ba'i tshig 'di zhus/ /kye ma 'dod dgu'i dpag bsam a ti sha/ /phan dgongs ldan pa'i lha gcig bdag la gson/ /srid mtha'i bar du khyod zhabs brtan gyur ces/ /'brom rjes nyin mtshan kun tu gsol ba 'debs/ /'dab gshog ma rdzogs bye'u tshang bor nas/ /ma ni mkha' la skyod par byed dam ci/ /de lta na ni thugs rje'i gter chen zhes/ /lhar bcas kun gyis mtshan gsol ji ltar lags/ /mgon pos mgon med bdag cag ding bor nas/ /grangs med zhing du smon lam mdzad pa yi/ /dgos pa mchog dang dbang bcu mnga' ba'i mthu/

/ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul de ni gang du thal/ /khyod nyid zhi ba'i dbyings su rab bzhud nas/ /nyan rang dman pa'i lam du ji ltar gshegs/ /'gro drug thams cad mya ngan khang bu ru/ /zhugs 'di khyed kyi thugs rjes cis mi bskul/ /de ltar lags pas dī pam̐ kā ra khyed/ /sku tshe brtan pa'i bkra shis rab 'bar ba/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba rang gis legs dgongs nas/ /nyam thag re ba'i 'bras bu mthu ldan zhu/ /de skad 'brom rje snying rje chen po yis/ /rab zhus ut+pal 'dab 'dra'i spyan yangs las/ /gdung shugs drag pos bskyod pa'i spyan chab kyi/ /mu tig phreng ba 'thor ldan a ti sha/ /zur gyis gzigs nas brtse ba'i gsung byon pa/ /u pa si ka de tsam gdung bas ci/ /kho bos tshe mthar phyin cing 'gro ba'i don/ /bgyi bar 'os pa'i tshogs kun yongs su zin/ /da ni nam mkha' dri med snying po zhes/ /rgyal sras gzugs bzung byams mgon mnyes pa bsgrub/ /khyod kyang skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /de drung bsnyegs nas gsung gleng bgyid par smon/ /de ltar legs so bstan pa skyongs ba dang / /slob dpon mdo sde dag la bsten par gyis/ /de sogs brtse ba'i sems kyis dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /rnal 'byor pa sogs zhabs drung 'khod rnams la'ang / /tshe 'di blos thongs bsam pa bzang po bsten/ /e ma 'dus shing 'bral ba mi rtag chos/ /ngang tshul nyid du shes par gyis shig gsungs/ /de nas bco brgyad nyin phyed a ti sha /bstan pa'i nyi ma dga' ldan lha yul gshegs/ /tsan+dan phye mas bsgos pa'i lha rdzas kyi/ /me tog 'phreng bas mkha' dbyings kun bkang nas/ /sku gdung rin chen 'dzin ma'i sa gzhi khyab/ /sgrol mas kyi hud 'jig rten stongs so zhes/ /'dzam gling yongs thos sgra chen lan gsum bsgrags/ /de dus 'phags yul paṇa grub dad can rnams/ /mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur nas bod yul byon/ /legs sbyar skad du gdung bas gsol ba btab/
