/slar yang rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis rgya gar bzhud/ /de tshe tsan+dan shing la me sbar nas/ /sku gdung rin chen legs sbyangs gdul bya yis/ /don du sku gdung ring bsrel sha rī ram/ /gang gi thugs rjes ding 'dir sprul pa snyam/ /dad mos rten du lhung bzed mkhar gsil dang / /chos gos gsum dang nyid kyi sku 'bag sogs/ /sprul pa'i 'brom rjes nye bar bskrun pa gang / /ding sang dus na'ang 'gro ba'i mig gi dpal/ /dug la bdud rtsi ji bzhin 'gro ba'i blo/ /chos min chos la bsgyur ba'i sku drin can/ /a ti sha zhes srid gsum yongs grags pa'i/ /zhabs la spyi bos lan brgyar phyag bgyi'o/ /rmongs pa'i khang bur yun ring mi shes pa'i/ /mun pas khyab pa'i gangs khrod kla klo 'dir/ /khyod thugs chos kyi nyi mas legs bskyangs pas/ /ding sang bstan pa'i nyi ma cung zad snang / /zhes 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan a ti sha'i mya ngan 'das byung cung zad zin pa yi ger spel ba lags/ de ltar jo bo rje la sogs pa bka' gdams bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rnams gsungs pa'i rjes su/ rje bla ma nyid 'di skad gsungs pa thos te/ de ltar chos 'di gang las 'ongs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la yid ches par byas nas/ de nas sems dpa' chen po mus chen gyis mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs rgyas par dmigs khrid bstan nas/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos rdzogs par byed do/ /de nas sems dpa'i rim pa dang thun brgyad ma gnyis kyi sgo nas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bdag gzhan brje ba'i gsang tshig rgyas par bstan nas/ rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu ltar stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ dpe du ma'i sgo nas zhib tu ngo sprod par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgoms pa'i tshul bstan zin to/ /'dir 'chad dka' bas dang por don dam byang chub sems dang /

de nas kun rdzob byang chub sems bsgom par bzhed kyang / 'dir jo bo nyid kyi bzhed pa bzhin/ dang por kun rdzob byang sems dang / de nas don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bstan to/ /de nas gong gi sems pa'i rim pas mjug gi sha khrag sbyin gtong gi skabs dang / mtshon bya 'khor lo rma bya dug 'joms gnyis kyi rang gi rgyu dge mi dge las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung tshul dang / de ltar 'byung ba'i le lan thams cad kyang bdag gces par 'dzin pa'i blo gcig pus bskyed tshul dang / gnas skabs sha khrag lus 'bul gyis tshogs rdzogs shing / mthar thug bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bud shing bsregs nas/ stong nyid ye shes kyi don rtogs par 'gyur tshul rnams kyi khog phub nas/ lam khyer gyi chos bco brgyad nyid zhib tu 'chad do/ /rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba bstan zin to/ /de nas blo sbyong thun brgyad ma ltar zas kyi rnal 'byor sogs nyin zhag phrugs gcig gis bya lam sogs thams cad phan sems dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa la bslab po/ /tshe gcig gi nyams len bstan zin to/ /de nas slar mtshon cha 'khor lo dang rma bya dug 'joms nas bshad pa ltar rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i rang don yid byed kyi blo'i 'khris med par/ lus srog longs spyod kun gyis gzhan don rjes su sgrub pa'o/ /blo 'byongs pa'i tshad bstan zin to/ /de nas spyod lam kun tu lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu dril nas/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la len cing / bdag gi bde dge gzhan la 'bul ba'i bsam bsgom rtse gcig pa'i blos/ ngag tu byams pa'i rnal 'byor pas gyer sgom rdo rje'i mgur nyid dus rgyun du kha ton du bya ba ni dam tshig mtshon la/ dpal glang ri thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma nyid kyi nang ltar la nan tan du byed pa ni blo sbyong gi bslab pa bya mtshon la/ gzhan yang skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong gi yig cha rnams kyang gong gi rim pas/

thad so thad sor sbyar de nyams su len pa yang man ngag go /zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang dus der sum pa lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i man ngag gi khrid dang / kha che paṇa chen nas khro phu lo tsā ba la brgyud pa'i skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid sogs bka' drin du bstsal cing / rje'i bka' chos rnams grol mtshams/ bdag gis kyang thub bstan mkhan chen dang / chos rje 'jam dbyangs pas thog drangs gling ga tshogs chen la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang cha lan mang du bgyis shing / rags bsdus shig la mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi lung byed pa'i skabs na yod pa'i tshe/ gdan sa chen po nas yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid chab gzhi la brten pa'i sku snyel po yod pa'i kha skad thos pa la brten/ 'phral du rta thog khel ba'i sgo dod pa la/ ngam ring nas chos rgyal chen pos khor tsam yong dgos pa'i phyag rtags dang bcas mi sna ched gtad 'byor byung pa'i tshe/ rje bla ma nyid kyi zhabs drung du bdag 'phral du 'bod mi gnang byung ba bzhin phyin pas/ nyid kyi gsung las sa skyar zhabs drung yab rin po che sku khams ma bde ba de shin tu ma legs/ kha sing nas nged kyi rmi lam du zhabs drung rang gi rgyun bzhes kyi dbu zhwa de yang yang nged kyi lag tu gnang ba zhig byung ba/ de khyed rang la mi lta/ zhal ngo che mos shig la sku dog yod pa'i rtags su 'dug pas/ da res ngam ring phyogs su phebs 'gor gang chung mdzad nas gdan sar myur du 'byor pa mdzad dgos so/ /zhes sogs ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i gsung du ma 'byon gyin 'dug pas/ de'i sang nyin de ka rje bla ma'i zhabs drung du byin rlabs bka' bsgo bslab bya sogs rgyas par zhu ba dang bcas da dung bstan 'gro'i don du zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa'i snyan 'bul nan zhus ngos/ lam la mgyogs skyod kyis ngam ring chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang du 'byor pa'i nyin/

mi dbang chen pos thag ring po'i bar du phyag phebs pa'i chibs bsu zab rgyas dang / ngam ring mtsho skor gyi dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i ser phreng rgya dpangs shin tu che ba dang bcas pas bsu bar mdzad nas thog mar theg mchog yang rtse'i klu gding gsar pa der sde bdag chen pos dbu mdzad skya ser gyi tshogs stong phrag tu long pa la brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed smin rgyas su phul cing / de nas ngam ring rtse'i rigs ldan pho brang du zhag shas 'dug pa'i ring la/ sde srid lcam sring / chos sde chen po'i slob dpon rags rim gyis thog drangs/ lo phu dgon pa'i dge 'dun grangs mang dang bcas pa rnams la gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang cha lan kha yar dang mi dbang dpon blon rags bsdus shig la tshe bka' rjes gnang sogs ci rigs shig phul nas/ rje bla ma'i bka' bzhin de 'phral dpal sa skyar bshad rtsol gyis phyin pa yin yang / rang gi sngon bsags las ngan gyi dbang las/ yab rje bka' drin can de nyid lo de'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim nas/ bcu dgu'i tshe thugs dam grol ba'i nyin 'byor pa las ma byung ba'i dbang gis/ shin tu mi bzod pa'i sems yed yed po dang bcas slebs 'phral bzhi thog bla brang gi sku gdung rin po che'i mjal ba la phyin pas/ gzim chung rab gsal ka bzhi ma'i dbus na zhal byang gzigs kyi/ dbu nub phyogs su cung zad yo ba dang bcas bzhugs 'dug pa mthong ba'i mod la/ de ma thag lus thams cad sbrid cing / ngag gis smra brjod gang yang mi nus pa dang / sems la nga 'dra ba'i slob bu'i tha shal zhig yong ba/ yab rje thugs rje can de nyid gzhan snang du sku snyel ba'i skabs su nyin gcig tsam yang zhabs tog byed pa'i skal ba med cing / tha ma mjal lugs 'di 'dra ba zhig 'ong ba tshe rabs snga mar las ngan khams po che ci 'dra rang zhig bgyis pa yin nam snyam pa'i sems la sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu bzod blag med pa dang bcas phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas sku gdung la mgo bo btud pa'i smon lam yid tshims pa tsam zhig 'debs pa las/

gzhan thabs gang yang ma brnyed pas yid mya ngan gyi khang bur zhugs par gyur to/ /smras pa/ de tshe sa gzhi rdul gyi 'tshub ma bral/ /nam mkha'i khyon kun 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang / /nyin bzhin me tog char chen rtag par babs/ /de sogs ngo mtshar ltas kyis kun bkang nas/ /yab rje thugs rje can de zhing gzhan gshegs/ /mgon khyod bzhugs dus bdag la thugs brtse bas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i sde dang bstan pa'i khur/ /nges par khyod kyi phrag par longs shig gsungs/ /blo dman zhum pa'i sems kyi re zhig 'gyangs/ /dus der kho bo byang gi mthar gnas pa'i/ /mod la 'dzam gling rgyan khyod gshegs pa'i gtam/ /thos pas yid gdung lus stabs gom pa 'khyor/ /mchi mas brnang zhing sku gdung rin po che/ /mjal ba'i rkyen gyis yab rje lhag par dran/ /sngar bzhin gsung gleng 'dod kyang skabs ma rnyed/ /yongs ye 'di 'dra'i gnas skabs mthong gyur pa/ /gzhan min rang gi las ngan 'bras bur zad/ /mgon khyod bde nas bde bar gshegs pas na/ /de phyir nyid bde bdag kyang bde mod kyi/ /'on kyang mdzad spyod phyag bzhes dran pa'i tshe/ /kye ma mjal 'dod sems kyi lhag mar lus/ /de ltar thun mong snang ba'i gzugs kyi sku/ /chos dbyings bsdus kyang rjes 'jug snyom las can/ /sras kyi tha chung bdag la thugs brtse ba'i/ /rmi lam ngang du zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mchog /yang yang mthong bas spro ba ngang gis 'phel/ /da dung bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas grub pa'i gtsug rgyan 'jam dpal dbang po'i mtshan can dang rgyal ba'i sras po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal gyis zhal bkod kyi mthil bzhugs mdzad nas/ yab rje de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs thabs su dges pa rdo rje'i sgrub mchod kyi thugs dam gsal 'debs yun ring du 'bul ba/ sku gdung gi zhu 'bul/ gdung tsha 'debs pa/

dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos gzhi rgya dpangs shin tu che ba rnams bsgrubs rjes/ nang rten du lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gser sku khyad par can gsar du bzhengs pa dang / lo dang zla ba'i dus dran gyi mchod pa bla ma mchod chog rgyud sde zab mo'i zhal 'don/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod sogs rgyas par 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i rgyun deng sang gi bar du ma nyams shing yar ldan du yod pa 'di legs shing / slar yang bdag gis yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i dgongs rdzogs su dngul gdung rin po che rgyu dang bzo khyad gzhan las phul du byung ba bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa 'di dang / gzhan yang rgyu tshogs rmad du byung ba las grub pa'i bris thang gtso bsdus chen mo/ sngags thang thog tshad ma gras gcig mang ba/ rdo rje phreng ba/ sbyong dkyil sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dkyil thang gi gra mang ba sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung 'bum glegs bam sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsar pa du ma bzhengs pa dang / rnying pa mang po'i nyams gso/ yab rje nyid kyi dus dran gyi mchod 'bul gyis thog drangs gdan sa chen po'i dge rgyun mtha' dag yar ldan du spar ba sogs mdor na sgo gsum gyi rnam dkar gyi las ci bgyis pa thams cad sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su dmigs nas rgyun ma chad pa sgrub pa 'di lags so/ /'dir smras pa/ yod med phyogs lhung bral ba'i lta ba dang / /'dzin med zung du 'jug pa sgom pa'i gnad/ /zhen med sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod pa gsum/ /mtha' ru phyin pa kho bo'i mgon 'di lags/ /dam pa khyod dang tshe rabs du ma'i bar/ /las dkar bzang pos 'brel ba'i sras thu bo/ /gang de rtag tu ngu dang chos 'phags bzhin/ /lam gyi dka' ba spyad nas drung du byon/ /de tshe rnal 'byor rgyud dang gsang mtha'i lam/ /dges mdzad rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rgyal po sogs/

/thun mong thun mong min pa'i chos sgo brgya/ /dus gcig nyid la phye ba'i dga' ston stsal/ /gzhan yang rgyal sras sdom brtson che de yi/ /rdo rje'i sku la gzhan snang bro nad kyis/ /cung zad gtses pa drungs nas phyung mdzad cing / /skal bzang khyod kyi sgrub pa'i gnas gang der/ /sngon med yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo'i rgyun/ /'byung zhes ma 'ongs lung bstan gang stsal ba/ /ji bzhin skye bo kun gyi mngon gyur pa'i/ /snyan grags lha yi rnga chen phyogs bcur gsal/ /dus der yongs 'dzin mchog gis nyer bzung bas/ /gsung ngag rin chen smin grol bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rnam dpyod bum par 'khyil ba'i rigs sngags 'chang / /ā nan+da zhes bod pa gang de yis/ /rje btsun bla ma'i dgongs pa sgrub pa'i slad/ /gling ga chos kyis mtho ba'i seng ge'i khrir/ /'khod nas don gnyer 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bdag med lha mo yis/ /snyan brgyud bir+wa'i snod du chags pa'i bcud/ /sa skya'i bla chen thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi dbang bzhi'i cho ga yis/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan du btab nas/ /lam dang dbang las byung ba'i ye shes bzhi/ /yang yang goms shing spel bar byas pa las/ /zung 'jug lta ba rnam bzhi mngon gyur te/ /zag bcas rten dang brten pa zag med du/ /gnas yongs gyur pa'i grub mtha' bzhi bgrod nas/ /'gros bzhi gtsug tor mchog tu thim pa las/ /'phrin las bzhi ldan sku bzhi'i rgyal srid mchog /mngon du byed pa'i gsung ngag gdams pa'i srol/ /yongs 'dzin mchog las ji ltar thob pa bzhin/ /rgya chen lung gi rgyab rten dang bcas nas/ /rgyas par phye ba'i lam dang 'bras bu'i chos/ /thog mar spel ba'i dga' ston de grol nas/ /yang dben dam pa bsam gtan 'phel ba'i phug /gnas mchog gang der rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mchog /mjal bar phyin tshe dgyes pa'i 'jum zhal gyis/

/bsus nas bzang bstod dbugs dbyung 'di ltar stsal/ /khyed kyi na tshod phra mo 'di tsam la/ /sa skya'i yab chos kun gyi rgyal po mchog /bstan pa yongs rdzogs glegs bam gsung ngag gi /'chad tshul sngon med legs bshad de lta bu/ /'phags yul grub pa'i gtsug rgyan bi ru pa/ /swa ba na tha'i gnas nas 'dir 'ongs sam/ /yang na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mkhyen rab dang / /khyod kyi blo gros gnyis su med par go /zhes sogs dgyes pa'i gsung snyan du ma dang / /gzhan yang chos sgo dang por phye 'di la/ /bar chad bdud kyi 'jug pas ma gos pas/ /da ni chos tshul ji snyed ston na yang / /nam yang bar chad g.yul las rgyal lo gsungs/ /khyad par dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs che/ /'brel tshad don ldan nyid dang slob bu bdag /byang chub bar du 'bral ba med pa'i tshul/ /zhal bzhes thob tshe ngo mtshar gnas 'di 'dra/ /bden nam brdzun snyam yid gnyis khyogs la 'phyangs/ /dus der bstan la zhugs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /dge slong mchog gi sdom rgyun dri med kyis/ /bdag sogs ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i las 'phro can/ /mang po'i yid la 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzad/ /gzhan yang chags can chags pa ma spangs pa/ /lam du byas te byang chub thob pa'i thabs/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i man ngag gi /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul mtha' yas dang / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /byang chub sems gnyis sbyong ba'i thabs kyi mchog /bka' gdams chos kyi sgo 'phar brgya phye nas/ /dus der 'dus pa'i don gnyer slob bu kun/ /dug gsum rtog pa ngang gis zhi gyur nas/ /rgyal sras spyod tshul dag la sbyor bar mdzad/ /e ma bstan rtsa sdom gsum bka' drin stsal/ /zab rgyas chos kyi gter kha grangs med phye/ /phan pa'i bslab bya zang zing bskyangs pa sogs/ /mgon de'i bka' drin bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /spros bral ye shes mngon gyur kyang /

/spros pa bcad pa'i zol sbyor gyis/ /spros med ting 'dzin gzhol ba 'di/ /spros pa can rnams drang phyir ro/ /bcu gnyis pa bgrang ba las 'das pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi slob bu'i tshogs bskrun te 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i legs lam la mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams bkod pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ gang la gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo che/ /rtag par bskor ba'i bstan 'dzin slob bu yis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab pa'i mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya'i gnas ma lus gsal bar dgongs shing / brtse ba'i thugs rjes 'gro ba rnams bu gcig pa lta bur skyong la/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i snyan pa'i grags pas rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di yongs su khyab par gyur pa la brten nas skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams mnyes gshin pa'i bus ma bsnyegs pa ltar ma bsdus par yang rang gi ngang gis 'du zhing / khyad par du yang bdag nyid chen po 'di'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ngom par gsol ba dang / chos kyi 'brel pa ci rigs pa thob pas kyang dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po yongs su rgyas par gyur pas 'khor gyi thog mar mkhas che ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu yang mang du bskrun par mdzad pa yin te/ de yang rje bla ma rang nyid kyis mkhas grub kyi yongs 'dzin rnams las/ ji ltar gsan pa'i zab rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos ji snyed pa de rnams/ slar yang 'gro ba rnams 'chi ba med pa'i gnas su phyin par byed pa'i bstan pa'i bdud rtsi de nyid yun ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig snyam du dgongs pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa kho nas dbang byas nas/ phyogs dang ris med pa'i gdul bya blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i dad 'dun can rnams la dam pa'i chos 'chad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam la gsum gyis nyin mtshan khor mo yug 'da' bar mdzad pa las/

de'i tshul yang snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can dmu long dmigs bu stor ba lta bur gyur pa rnams la thugs brtse ba'i shugs drag pos gzigs te/ rjes su 'dzin par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa bzang pos nye bar bshams pa'i chos kyi khri ga la bar zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo can rnam par bkod nas/ sku'i dkyil 'khor drang por bsrangs te/ bzhin ras bzang po zla ba rgyas pa lta bu la 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis rnam par bkra zhing gzhan la phan par gzhol ba'i mdzes pa'i spyan ut+pal lta bus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la dal bus gzigs nas zab cing yangs pa'i shes bya'i gnas thams cad la gsal zhing ma nor bar dpyod pa'i mkhyen rab kyi 'jug pa rnon pos smin byed dbang gi chu rgyun 'bebs pa'am/ grol byed khrid kyi gdams ngag ston pa'am/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i rgyud don 'byed pa'am/ snyan rgyud zab mos byin rlabs stsol ba'am/ rnam dag cho gas sdom pa 'bog pa la sogs pa bstan pa'i bya ba gang mdzad kyang de kho na la sbyangs pa ltar/ tshig gi tshogs gzhan gyis gzung sla zhing rna bar snyan pa dang / don gyi dngos po zab cing nges pa'i don la bab pa dang / tshig don gnyis ka 'brel legs shing rtogs par sla ba la sogs pa 'chad pa po'i yon tan thams cad tshang zhing / mi 'chad pa dang / legs par mi 'chad pa dang / the tshom gyi 'chad pa dang / yid chags sdang gi dri ma can dang / brjod pa mtho dman can la sogs pa 'chad pa'i skyon thams cad spangs te/ sgo gsum kun spyod rnam dag pa'i/ /blo chen rnams la zab rgya che/ /blo chung gzung bde go sla ba/ /phyi nas tshig don 'brel chags pa/ /don phra 'gal 'brel dpyod cing bshad/ /ces pa ltar bshad bya'i chos gang dang gang yin pa de dang de'i tshig don thams cad rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas zhib tu bshad nas/ mthar de thams cad kyi snying po bsdus pa ni 'di yin no/ /zhes slob ma mkhas rmongs thams cad kyis blo la 'char bde zhing lag par bzung du yod pa lta bu'i don gyi 'bras bu zhig ston par mdzad pas na/

'chad pa'i tshul gang la yang bdag nyid chen po 'di lta bu gzhan la yod pa ma mthong zhing / gzhung dang don gyi cha gang 'chad kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung gi rnam par thar pa 'dzin pa zhig yin pa/ lhag par thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab mo'i khrid kyi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig ston par mdzad pa de dag kun la sla chos dang / rigs 'dra rung mthun sbyor ba rang bzo la sogs pa'i dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba/ de rang gi skabs su babs pa'i spyi dang khyad par gyi 'chad par 'os pa rnams cung zad kyang ma lus pa/ ma lhag pa/ ma nor ba/ ma 'chol ba/ ma gab par gsungs/ gsal zhing go bde la dal brel mnyam pa/ 'brel chags shing gdangs snyan pa'i sgo nas lhug par 'dom par mdzad cing / tha na rjes gnang ngam bzlas lung chung ngu zhig gnang na'ang / de'i rtsa ba'i khungs kyi yi ge 'di yin/ de la rgya bod du bshad srol mi 'dra ba dang / de dag gi bzhed srol so so'i 'di ltar bzhed/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyis nyams bzhes mdzad pas ngo mtshar gyi ltas byung ba'i lo rgyus 'di ltar yod/ spyir 'di la yig sna 'di tsam mchis/ da lta lag len yi ge 'di dang 'di thog nas byed/ bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i khyad par gyi zhal shes 'di lta bu yod gsungs pa sogs/ dpyod ldan rnams kyi blo'i yul du 'di kho nas don thams cad 'grub pa 'dug snyam pa'i bla ma dang / lha dang gdams ngag la dus de nyid du mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa zhig 'byung la de bzhin du dbang bskur mdzad pa rnams kyang dkyil chog gi ngag 'don/ shar sbyang gi lung nyan tsam ma yin par/ gdan gsum tshang zhing yongs dag bzhi'i sgo nas 'dag bya dag byed mtha' dag legs par zhib tu ngo sprod cing / lhag par ye shes chen po ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyun byin gyis brlabs pas/ lus ngag yid gsum la nyams kyi 'gyur ba mnan gyis mi thub pa dang / dbang de grol ba dang /

da lan nga'i rgyud la sngags kyi sdom pa rnam par dag pa nges par skyes byung snyam pa'i nges pa'i shes pa gting tshugs pa byung / chos gang gnang ba'i tshe yang gsung gi gdangs thos pa tsam gyis tha mal gyi rtog pa rags pa rnams nyal gyis 'gro/ dmigs pa'i mtshams mtshams su 'di ltar byed ces rje nyid kyang lta stangs dang bcas pa'i sgo nas cung zad re mnyam par 'jog pa mdzad pa na dus de nyid du ji skad gsungs pa bzhin rgyud la skyes byung snyam pa dang / de ka las ma 'das pa thag chod du 'dug snyam pa the tshom dang bral ba'i nges shes skye ba ma gtogs/ ji ltar yin nam snyam pa'i blo sbram thang nge sdod pa mi srid pa nyams su myong bas/ gzhan du lo zlar bsgom pa bas/ dam pa 'di'i gsung thos pa tsam yang don che bar mthong la/ de lta bu'i dam pa'i chos gsungs pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du yang / zhum la gzengs bstod rgod pa la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs par bshad/ /rmongs pa rnams la ngo mtshar gyi/ /gtam bshad nas ni mnyan du bcug /ces pa ltar shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus du ma dang / ku re dang bzhad gad nyams mtshar ba dag gi sgo nas kyang spro ba bskyed par mdzad la/ gnas skabs thams cad du 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang / tshul khrims kyi bsngags pa dang / thos bsam gyi phan yon dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang / khyad par du yang rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams dang / rdo rje 'chang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma so so sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / bstan pa'i srol ji ltar btod pa dang / de dag la 'dzin skyong bya dgos pa'i tshul la sogs pa shin tu snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i gsung gis rgyun chags su gsungs te/ gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po kun nas yongs su rgyas par mdzad pas brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i tshogs du mas nor 'dzin gyi khyon ma lus pa yongs su khyab par mdzad pa las/

'dir de dag gi khrod nas rags pa tsam zhig gi mtshan brjod na/ thog mar gangs ri'i khrod kyi skye dgu thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu'i khri la zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor lo mngon par rtsen pa'i dpal sa skya pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i kha ba'i ljongs 'di na 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i gdung gi rigs su 'khrungs shing grub pa mchog gi sa la bzhugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi a 'thas hrul por zhig pas ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa kho nas dus 'da' ba bdag cag gi 'dren pa dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang / mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung lugs mu mtha' med pa rnams la mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu yangs pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan ma lus pa'i thugs rgyud phyug pa bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa dang / gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol ta son cing rig grol gyi yon tan du ma la dbang 'byor pa bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob pas 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsung bsnyen dus sngon med kyi sgrub chu gsar du 'don par mdzad pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes shing rje bla ma nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus mnga' ba rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa dang / sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed kun gyi gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i bzhugs gdan seng ge'i khri la mngon par mtho ba dngos stobs kyi rigs pa'i khyu mchog chen po thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi mkhan chen bzod pa rgya mtsho ba dang / mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po mus rab 'byams pa thugs rje dpal ba'i gdan sa pa thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan chen shes bya kun la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes pa chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs chos bzang pa dang /

mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos sde chen po thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan rab brgyad pa chos kyi rje ngag dbang grags pa dang / yang chos sde de nyid kyi mkhan rabs dgu pa rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa la bslab sbyang mthar phyin pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa phun tshogs rin chen pa dang / shes bya kun la mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan sa pa sde snod 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan dam pa mnyan yod bya gshong gi mkhan chen chos kyi rje 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor ba dang / yang chos sde de nyid kyi mkhan chen gsung rabs mang pos mgrin pa mdzes pa chos kyi rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa dang / gdan sa chen po'i thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan rab bcu pa sngon sngags 'chang chen po byas 'gyur du sku mtshams lo gsum la bzhugs pa'i skabs shig gsol chu 'dren pa'i dre'u rgyun du thugs rtsis mo mdzad pa zhig yod pa de lan cig chu rong du lhung nas shi ba'i tshe/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/ nged kyi chu drel de'i skye ba kha'u ru khrod kyi khu yo 'di pa tshang gi bur 'ong ba yod pas/ de nges par chos sgor chug cig bstan pa la phan pa zhig 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan ji ltar gnang ba bzhin mngon du gyur pas chos rje dre'u sku skyes su grags pa skyes bu dam pas rjes su bzung ba'i byin rlabs kyi legs byas kyis mngon par mtho zhing / mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la mkhyen pa rgyas pas blo gsal mang po'i re 'dod yongs su skong ba chos kyi rje rin chen rgyal mtshan pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod la blo gros kyi snang ba phyogs med du rgyas shing gsang sngags bye ba'i pha mthar son pa rdzong dga' ldan rtse'i gdan sa pa chos rje ngag dbang dpal ldan pa dang / lugs gnyis kyi bya ba gang la yang mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas shing /

dam pa gang gi gsung gi bdud rtsis blo gros kyi bum pa yongs su gang ba sle lung chos sde'i mkhan chen rje nyid kyi rus dbon chos kyi rje sangs rgyas rab brtan pa dang / zab mo'i lam gyis rang rgyud smin par byas nas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa la mkhas pa gling ga zur 'chad chos rje chos dpal 'byor ba dang / tshul khrims kyi phung po la nyes ltung gi dri mas dben zhing / bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam la gcig tu gzhol bas ting nge 'dzin du ma la dbang 'byor pa bsam gtan phur sku tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i grub pa'i gtsug rgyan chos kyi rje dkon mchog lha dbang pa dang / zab mo'i bsnyen sgrub la lhag par brtson pas yi dam lhas rjes su bzung zhing tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa gling ga zur 'chad pa chos kyi rje chos 'od zer ba dang / rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i grub chen gyi dbon rgyud ri bo che pa chos kyi rje ngag dbang pa dang / gzhung lugs du ma'i don la mkhas shing rje nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang ldan pa rgya dar rtse mdo'i sa yangs chos rje ka bzhi dgon gyi mkhan po kun dga' lhun grub pa dang / rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa la blo gros rab tu rgyas pa gling ga bde ba can gyi zur 'chad pa chos kyi rje sangs rgyas 'od zer pa dang / chos dang srid kyi bya ba la mkhyen pa'i spyan rab tu gsal ba gser mdog pa chos rje bsod nams rtse mo/ kun dga' rnam rgyal/ bsod nams rin chen pa dang gsum/ gzhung lugs mang po'i thos pas phyug cing dpal 'byor longs spyod rgya chen pos dam pa'i thugs zin gsang sngags bde chen gling gi mkhan chen blo gros rgya mtsho ba dang / rgyud sde kun gyi de nyid rig pa'i ya ma bde ldan gyi gdan sa pa chos rje rnam pa gnyis dang / gsung rab rgya mtsho'i don rtogs nas smin grol dga' ston gyis 'gro ba skyong ba lung chung gdan sa pa chos rje byams dkon pa dang /

bde kye'i zab don la mkhyen pa rgyas shing blo gros nam mkha' ltar yangs pa zhe dgon gdan sa pa rin chen bsam 'grub pa dang / yongs 'dzin mkhas pas rjes su bzung zhing legs byas kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba thub bstan yangs pa can gyi mkhan chen sangs rgyas rin chen pa gdan sa pa dang bcas pa dang / gzhung lugs rgya mtsho thugs su chug cing blo gsal mang po'i 'dren par gyur pa dbus dwags po grwa tshang gi mkhan po chos kyi rje bsod nams rab brtan pa dang / bshes gnyen mchog gi rigs las 'ong ba'i sdom brtson dam pa lu pa chos sde'i bla ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa dang / gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod dang ldan zhing rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gsang sngags bye ba'i pha mthar son pa gdong dga' chos sde'i bla ma kun dga' bkra shis pa dang / skyes stobs kyi blo gros shin tu gsal bas gsung rab mang po'i don rig pa chos 'khor gling gi gdan sa pa chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang / gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la shin tu brtson pas nus mthu'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa mtsho sgo bla ma grags pa mtha' yas pa dang / zab mo'i nyams len gyi gnad la mkhas pas gdul bya dbang du 'du ba skya skya rdzong chung gi bla ma 'phrin las phun tshogs pa dang / zab mo gcod kyi nyams len mthar phyin pas gzhi bdag mang po bran du 'khol ba chos rje dgra lha ba dang / gzhan phan gyi sems rlabs po che dang ldan pas 'gro ba mang po'i mgon du gyur pa rgya khag nor bu gling gi bla ma bzod pa mchog ldan pa dang / rim gnyis kyi nyams len la rtag tu 'grus shing bla ma'i zhabs tog la rtse gcig brtson pa ri 'jo dgon gyi bla ma dam chos dpal 'byor ba dang / zhing skyong gi dbang po yab yum gyis rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma thob pas dpal 'byor longs spyod nam mkha' mnyam pa lha 'dri dgon gyi bla ma kun dga' bsod nams pa dang /

rje bla ma 'di'i byin rlabs zhugs pas chos skyong gis 'phrin las sgrub pa khams kyi chos rje dgra lha ba dang / 'dren pa dam pa'i bka' bzhin gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las bskyangs pas gdul bya dbang du 'du ba shug thang bla ma chos kyi bshes gnyen pa dang / gzhan gnod kyi bsam pa dug bzhin spangs nas gcig tu dge ba la brtson pa'i skye dgu mang po'i 'dren par gyur pa btso mdo dpal 'bar gyi bla ma sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa dang / sa skya'i mdo phyogs kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed g.yag gzhon gnyis kyi gdan sa 'dzin pa gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mkhyen pa rgyas pa gdan sa chen po'i chos las pa chos kyi rje kun dga' rnam rgyal pa dang / rje kun dga' shes rab/ chos rje ste ra ba ste rim pa gsum/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde la sbyangs pa mthar phyin cing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros can mus rdo rje gling gi gdan sa pa chos kyi rje dge 'dun dbang phyug pa dang / 'bras bu'i thig pa la thos bsam mthar phyin zhing bsnyen sgrub las su rung ba gdan sa chen po'i brgya dpon gyi go sa 'dzin pa grang mo che pa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang / chos rje sgo rum pa gnyis/ mdo sngags kyi lus yongs su rdzogs shing rigs lam smra ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan dpal sa skya'i brgya tsho dpon chos kyi rje dge 'dun 'od zer ba dang / mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba can thub bstan yangs can gyi dkar khra gnyis kyi slob dpon sangs rgyas bsod nams pa dang / bsod nams mtha' yas pa gnyis gdan sa pa dang bcas pa/ shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa mtshal lung pa chos sde'i slob dpon chos rgyal mtshan pa dang / sde snod kyi gzhung la legs par sbyangs pa'i mig rab tu gsal ba lha sding chos sde'i slob dpon shes rab rgya mtsho ba dang /

sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan du ma la dbang 'byor pa ya ga chos sding gi slob dpon chos kyi rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa dang / dpal ldan bkra shis pa gnyis/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshig don la mkhyen pa rgyas pa gtsang 'bras spungs chos sde'i slob dpon byams pa bkra shis pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba ngan skyugs kyi phung po ltar rtogs nas gcig tu sgrub pa la brtson pa ngag dbang chos rgyal ba dang / rje bla ma'i thugs sras sdom brtson dam pa chos kyi rje sbyin pa grags pa'i rgyal tshab nags dgon gyi gdan sa pa chos kyi rje bsod nams lhun grub pa dang / rgyal ba'i bka' rab 'byams la rnam dpyod kyi mig dang ldan pa chos rje rab 'byams pa chos rgyal mtshan pa dang / gsang sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag gi tshig don la sbyangs shing nyams len zab mo la gcig tu brtson pa bsam yas rab byung chos sde'i bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang / dge 'dun 'phel ba la sogs te mtshan nas bgrang du btub pa brgya phrag du ma bzhugs shing / gzhan yang rigs rus cho 'brangs ldan zhing stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin la phu dud du mdzad pa'i sa skyong gi dbang phyug byang pa chos rgyal nam mkha' tshe dbang phun tshogs dbang gi rgyal po la sogs te gangs can gyi khrod na che zhing che bar grags pa'i stobs ldan gyi rgyal po du ma dang / de dag gi chab 'bangs su gtogs pa'i lugs gnyis la mkhyen pa rgyas shing rje nyid la sangs rgyas dang mi gnyis pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i rgyal phran du gyur pa'i mi chen gyi sbyin bdag kyang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i khyim pa paṇ+ḍi ta rje dam pa'i dbon brgyud smon dro nas nang so'i drung dang / gdong dga' pa sku zhang tshe brtan sku mched/ mdar nas mi dbang dgra 'dul khu dbon/

mtsho sgo ba sde ba grags pa sku mched/ mus nas nang so rnam rgyal khu dbon/ spyi lung sde ba bya btang ba/ yol gdong nas sde pa sku mched/ stag rtse sa'i mi dbang yab sras la sogs te lugs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor rgya mtsho lta bu la dbang 'byor pa'i 'jig rten na che dgu'i rigs su gyur pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing bkur ba dang rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par gsung gi bdud rtsi thob par byas nas dad pa'i dbang po rnam par rgyas pas rigs kyi cod pan dam par 'dzin pa yin no/ /de ltar gong du smos pa'i slob ma'i tshogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag gi gtso bor chos sde chen po'i mkhan po dang go sa mthon po na bzhugs pa rnams yin la/ gzhan yul nges med du blo gsal gyi 'khor bsdus nas rang dbang du bshad nyan skyong ba dang / dgon pa so sor dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag ston pa/ gangs ri'i mgul dang / mthon po'i nags khrod dang / dur khrod dang / bas mtha' la sogs par tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byed pa la sogs pa ni mtha' yas shing / gzhan yang rgya chen rgyud sde'i gnad rig pa/ zab mo bskyed rim gyi gsal snang thob pa/ rig pa sngags kyi bden tshig 'grub pa/ sgyu lus rmi lam gyi sprul bsgyur la dbang thob pa/ 'pho ba dang bar do 'byongs pas mkha' spyod la yud kyis chas pa/ bla ma'i mos gus kho nas sems phrogs te sa lam chig chod du song ba dang / tha na bdag lta bu'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan gzhan chen po ma mchis kyang / rje bla ma'i bka' drin 'khor thabs med pa rjes su dran pas gar gnas su gsol ba 'debs pa kho na lhur byed pa'i bu slob nam mkha'i skar phran tsam gyis rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di yang ngal bar byas pa yin te/ mdor na yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di nyid dang yul dus kyi bskal ba dang / grub mtha' gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa re re tsam ma gtogs dus de tsam gyi sa skya pa'i zhal 'dzin pa rnams rje 'di'i dngos slob dang /

nying slob dang / yang slob tu ma gyur pa ni med cing / de dag gis kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i skye dgu thams cad skal ba bzang por byas pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ chos tshul kun mkhyen nyin byed dbang po de/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i rta ljang gis drangs nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i gnya' shing 'dzin ri'i rtser/ /legs bshad 'od zer dra ba phyogs bcur bkyes/ /de tshe thub bstan pad+ma'i tshal chen po/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i 'dab brgya'i yong gang zhing / /lung dang rigs pa'i ze'u 'bru cher rgyas pas/ 'gro ba'i bung bar phan bde'i sbrang rtsi byin/ /mgon po khyod kyi zhabs sen rin chen phreng / /spyi bo'i rgyan du mi len chen po gang / /khyod kyi legs bshad gsung gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rna ba'i bcud du mi len mkhas pa su/ /mkhas rlom kha cig rtsod bral gong ma'i gsung / /bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin bor nas sngon med kyi/ /gsar byung chos la mchog tu ngo mtshar du/ /'dzin par snang yang mkhas rnams gad mo'i gnas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi rigs bdag rdo rje 'chang / /gzhan ngor ngur smrig 'dzin pa mgon khyed kyi/ /gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i slob ma'i tshogs/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul snyed grangs ldan pas/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i byang phyogs rgyud thams cad/ /rtswa ljang myu gu bzhin du khyab pa 'di/ /tshangs dang brgya byin sogs kyi sprul pa'am/ /yang na khyed nyid sgyu ma'i mkhan por dgos/ /ding sang kha cig rang gi sngon bsags kyi/ /sbyin 'bras smin pas ser gzugs 'dzin pa'i 'khor/ /bcu phrag tsam gyis bskor la blo dman 'gas/ /grangs kyis 'phongs pa bgrangs dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /rnam 'dren gang gis zab rgyas chos tshul rnams/ /don gnyer 'dus pa'i tshogs la zang zing gi /bsam sbyor dang bral lhag bsam gyis spel bas/ /bstan 'dzin mkhas grub mang pos sa steng khyab/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i/

/mkhas dbang smra ba'i nyi ma mang po ni/ /skal bzang 'dab brgya ldan pa'i do ra ru/ /'chad dang rtsom pa'i tsha zer bye ba 'gyed/ /gsang chen 'o ma'i rgya mtshor rtag gnas pa'i/ /grub brnyes ngang pa'i ded dpon la la dag /snang srid dpe char shar bas nges don gyi/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'tsher la dogs med gyur/ /kha cig dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' bar/ /rang gi sgo gsum lha sngags ye shes su/ /gsal ba'i ngang nas bzlas brjod bye ba brgyas/ /lha mchog zhi khro du ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ /gzhan dag chos brgyad rnam rtog chu 'dzin tshogs/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i 'thor rlung gis gtor nas/ /rang sems nam mkha'i pha mtha' yun ring du/ /btsal bas ma brnyed brjod bral ngang du nyal/ /'ga' dag rnam dpyod blo ldan mang po'i dbus/ /legs bshad ngo mtshar can gyi dbyings gsar pa/ /snyan par sgrogs la lo zla med mthong nas/ /de la dpyod ldan bsngags brjod 'gran pa bzhin/ /sdom brtson khyod las tshangs spyod nges 'byung khrims/ /legs par nos pa'i rab byung ngur smrig 'dzin/ /bskrun pa'i 'khor tshogs sngon gyi dgra bcom pa/ /nyer sbas dang mtshungs 'di ni bstan pa'i rgyan/ /yongs 'dzin khyod kyi zhabs sen rgyu skar bdag /shis pa'i mtshan ma mang pos rnam bkra ba/ /yangs pa'i sa la dbang bsgyur mi'i dbang phyug /rgyal phran bye bar bcas pa'i gtsug na mdzes/ /mdor na dar 'thag mahā tsi na'i yul gru chen po nas/ /stod phyogs gur gum dbug gu'i bsnun pa kasmi ra yi bar/ rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhi la spyod pa'i dus mtshungs skye dgu kun/ /yongs 'dzin khyod kyi brgyud 'dzin slob mar ma gyur med pa snyam/ /bdag cag rnams la lam bzang dag /rang rang skal ba dang 'tshams pa/ /brtag par bstan la rab mkhas pas/ /tha mal pa dag skal bzang mdzad/ /ko long tho co nyon mongs spongs/ /gzhung lugs ku mud 'dzum nus sgyur/ /dge legs nyer len bshes gnyen bsten/

/sid+dhi chil chil snying dkyil bstim/ /long long skye bo 'dus pa'i khrod/ /chol chol gtam la ma dga' bar/ zab zab chos tshul rgya mtsho'i don/ /dben dben dgon par bsam na legs/ /tshe 'di'i don la ches ring ring / /dal 'byor stong log byed mang mang / /phyi ma'i don bsam de mkhas mkhas/ /spang blang ma nor skal bzang bzang / /yongs 'dzin yongs kyi skyabs kyi drung / /las dkar las 'phro ldan pa kun/ /ma bsdus ma lus 'dus pa 'di/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin phyogs bcur 'phel// //bcu gsum pa thun mong du snang ba'i gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul gyi 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ ji skad du/ gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshe yang mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /mkha' spyod dbang mos mngon sum spyan drangs nas/ /rtags bzang kun la ston mdzad mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ste/ de yang bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po rdo rje slob dpon 'gran zla dang bral ba de nyid dgung lo 'dul ba pa lugs kyi don brgyad dang yongs su grags pa ltar na don bdun du son pa ka la du tī dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa pho rta'i lo gsar du shar ba na/ zhing 'di'i sku tshe dang bstan 'gro'i don gyi mdzad pa 'phrin las rnams mthar phyin par mdzad nas/ re zhig gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshul gyis 'bras bu mngon du mdzad par bzhed pa'i tshe/ de'i snga ltas su sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di yang khol bur g.yo zhing / nam mkha' las kyang lha rnams kyis spyan 'dren pa'i ltas su rol mo'i sgra yang yang du sgrog pa dang / gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i bde skyed nyams par 'gyur ba'i mtshan mar du ba mjug ring lta bu'i skar ma mjug phod can gsum yang dus gcig la shar ba sogs rtags dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung bas skye bo thams cad sems yed yed por gyur cing /

der skabs bdag nyid chen pos bka' gnang ste/ sngon 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mtha' mi'i kha gnon du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten rnams la nyams gso mdzad de/ gzung gzhug la yang rje nyid kyi dbu lo dang phyag sen las btab pa'i slob dpon pad+ma dang / gur gyi mgon po'i sku re 'jug par mdzad cing gling ga dgon pa nas dge slong bzhi sde re rab gnas byed par gnang 'dug pa/ 'di yang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dgongs pa'i rnam thar du go zhing / lo de'i gso~Xs po~X zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la bdag gis zhabs drung du slebs pa na/ nyid kyi gsung las/ da lam bzhugs sa bsam gtan phu'i bla brang du mdzod gsungs pa ltar/ gnas der gzhi phab nas rje bla ma'i gzim phug dang 'dabs nye bar brten/ rje bla ma'i thugs dam gyi thun 'tshams la yang yang zhabs drung du phyin nas sngar ma thob pa'i zab chos gur gyi mgon po'i nang khrid 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyi yig cha'i steng nas stsal cing / de las 'phros pa'i srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i khrid/ so so'i rgyab chos yig cha mang po'i lung dang bcas pa shin tu smin pa nos shing / de nas gcod skor gyi man ngag gi yig cha mus chen sems dpa' chen po dang / dol pa legs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig che chung rnams dang / rje rang gis mdzad pa'i yig sna'i steng nas lung ma khrid shin tu rgyas pa zhig gnang zhing / lan gcig gsol ba ma btab kyang rje'i gsung las/ gdams ngag 'di sa skya pa'i bla ma brgyud pa gong ma mang po mkha' spyod du gshegs nges pa'i nye lam yin gsungs nas/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag de dang / mkha' spyod ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma gnyis dgyes par stsal cing / gzhan yang rjes gnang zur bka'i rigs 'ga' zhig dang / khyad par zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi smar khrid/

de'i rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa sogs chos 'phro rnams phal cher rdzogs par zhus shing / de lta bu'i skabs shig nged rang zhabs drung na yod dus gsung 'phros shig la rje'i gsung las/ kha sang nas sde srid gtsang pa'i mus kyi mi dpon de byung nas nged la cis kyang 'phrad dgos zer byung pa la/ lo gsum su dang mi 'phrad pa'i dam bca' byas yod/ de nas 'phrad pa yin no byas pas/ khong gis bden par bzung nas log tsam byung zhes gsungs byung pas/ shin tu 'jigs pa zhig byung nas/ lo gsum nas mi dpon dang yang los mjal/ gang ltar bdag sogs ltos bcas rnams la dgongs nas yun ring du zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs dgos tshul zhus pas/ rje btsun nyid gang yang mi gsung ba yun ring du bzhad kyin 'dug pas blo shin tu ma bde ba zhig byung ste/ de'i nangs par brtan bzhugs kyi 'bul ba bzang ba dang bzhugs gdan sogs phul nas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ glo bur du nam mkha' la 'ja' sna tshogs pa'i ri mo ngo mtshar can du mas rje'i gzim phug gi thad kyi nam mkha' sogs bsam gtan phu'i nye skor rnams khrig gis khengs byung bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la/ brtan bzhugs 'bul ba la nam mkha'i 'ja' sprin 'di yang dga' rgyu med dam snyam pa shar zhing de dag dang dus mtshungs par bdag gi rje bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa nyid rtse lnga'i bla brang rdzong dang mang mkhar gyi dgon pa bde ba can sogs su shin tu dben pa'i thugs dam bcad rgya la yun ring du bzhugs pa'i dus gcig gi tshe/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po dang mjal 'dod kyi thugs 'dun lhag par g.yos nas/ de nub mnal lam bzung nas byang phyogs nam mkhar rgyang ring po la 'phur nas byon pas/ gling ga bla brang du phebs byung pa na/ de'i tshoms kyi bzhugs khri la rje mus chen bzhugs 'dug pa dang mjal bas thugs dges spro dpag med 'khrungs shing /

rje'i gsung las/ sa skya nas zhabs drung bla brang gi yang rtse na bzhugs pas/ de la mjal ba mdzod ces gsungs pa bzhin de ltar mdzad nas/ mnal lam zin pa de ka'i ngang nas gling ga'i mgon khang der phebs pas/ dgon pa'i chos skyong gnas par grags pa'i gur mgon gyi zhal 'bag rje 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi phyag nas zhugs pa zhig yod pa de sku mdun du bub pa'i tshul du 'dug pa 'di cis lan gsungs pas/ de na yod pa'i mi 'ga' zhig na re/ mgon khang gi zhal 'bag 'gyel ba 'di ka da lo grub chen te lo pa gnas gzhan du gshegs pa'i snga ltas su 'dug zer byung bas/ mnal sad ma thag thugs ma bde zhing myur du sku mtshams sang nas rje bla ma mjal bar mus phyogs su phebs par bzhed kyang / de nas yun ring ma lon par rje btsun rdo rje 'chang de nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i kha skad gsan pa na/ phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi bla ma de dang mjal 'dod thugs kyi lhag mar lus bzhin du/ de ma thag 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste bdag 'jug brgya rtsa bzhes pa sogs kyi sgo nas dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs par mdzad do zhes thos la/ mtshan ltas ngo mtshar can de lta bu 'byung ba ni/ bdag cag gi bla ma rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid dus kyi dbang gis gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung ba tsam ma gtogs/ don la 'phags yul gyi grub chen te lo pa dang spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mnyam pa'i rnam par sprul pa yin nges pa'i mtshan ma yang dag par snang zhing / de nas bdag sa skyar yong khar rje'i zhabs drung du gang spyi'i bslab bya mtha' dag zhus pa na/ 'di phyir phan pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ci yang zhig stsal cing / lhag par sku bems kyi sbubs nas sku stod gzings mdzad de bdag gi gdong la cher gzigs nas/ 'o tshe 'di glog dang 'dra bas skyems tsam gcig ka yin pas/

gzhi sdom gsum rnam par dag pa la gnas nas/ thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad rtsol mdzad de/ ci mdzad bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur ba zhig cis kyang mdzad dgos so/ /'di nas sa skyar phebs 'phral bde mchog gi bsnyen pa zla ba drug pa zhig gnang ba dang / bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i sde srid g.yas ru byang pa ni de bzhin du gyur song / dgon pa 'di rnams thugs kyis btang na mi yong zhing / gzhan sus gang byas kyang rang re dpon slob la dam sel gtan nas mi yongs/ gtan nas mi yong / zhes nyis btud du gsungs byung bas sems la dga' spro rab dga'i sa thob pa tsam byung zhing / de nas zhabs dbang bka' bsgo zhus pa na/ phyag gnyis dbu dang bcas pa bdag gi mgo thog tu 'jog pa mdzad nas bla ma brgyud pa mang po'i mtshan nas brjod de bka' bsgo byin rlabs rgyas par stsal cing de nas kho bo cag gis bdag byang chub bar du thugs rje'i skyabs 'og tu chug pa zhig dgos tshul zhus pas/ rje'i gsung las/ a ci gsungs pa yin/ nged la sde pa byang pa dang zhabs drung gnyis las gces pa med/ de'i nang nas kyang khyed kho na gces pas/ snying ga'i nang skor du zhabs drung rang sgom/ de'i mtha' skor du sde pa byang pa sogs sgom gyin bdog ces sogs thugs gting nas brtse ba'i gsung da lta yang dran pa tsam gyi mig chu dbang med du 'chor ba du ma zhig stsal cing / de nas rje'i gzim phug gi gnam sgo'i rdo skas kyi 'og nas phyir mig cig bltas pas rje'i zhal 'dzum sngar gyi rnams las kyang ches ngo mtshar ba zhig mdzad nas gzigs byung bas/ yid 'phreng ba la tshad med pa zhig byung zhing / de nas rim pas sa skyar slebs nas chu mig rdzing kha'i bde mchog pho brang du 'khor lo bde mchog gi bsnyen pa la zhugs nas rgyang tsam song ba'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga drug tsam gyi rmi lam du rje bla ma nyid gsal bar byon nas lam dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa'i byin rlabs 'dra ba zhig gnang byung ba'i tshe/

bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgya mtsho rnams kyi mtshan gsal bar thos pa'i mod la gnyid sad byung bas sems la dga' bde dpag tu med pa byung zhing / yang snga dro zhig cung zad gnyid pa'i tshe/ rje'i sku ni ma mthong / gsung sbom la zil che ba de'i sgra lhang pa dang bcas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma zhes tshig gsal du 'jug dgos lags zhes gsungs byung bas/ gnyid sad ma thag rje 'di nyid na bzhugs yod do snyam pa'i 'jigs pa dang dga' spro zung 'brel du byung zhing / de nas dus mi ring ba zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu'i nyi ma shar dros la gling ga bsam gtan phug gi rje'i gzim phug gi mdo'i brag g.yab na dbon po nam mkha' sangs rgyas yod pa'i tshe/ rje bla ma'i zhabs drung na su yang med pa la gsung gleng di ri ri mdzad byung pas/ rje dbon gyi sems la dogs pa zos nas zhabs drung du 'gro bar brtsams pa na/ gzim phug gi gnam sgo sogs sgo rnams khrig ge 'dug pas/ shin tu 'jigs pa zhig byung nas tab tob tu zhabs drung du phyin pas/ rje'i gsung las/ mkha' 'gro ma tsho rang byon mdzad cig /ces gsungs pa'i mod la dbon po drung du sleb ste sgo yol phye bas/ khyod yong ba sngas byung gsungs pa sogs bka' skyon pa'i rnam pa mdzad kyin 'dug ces thos la/ de'i nangs par tshes bco lnga la sku grib la brten pa'i cung zad snyel ba'i tshul bstan nas/ de dang dus mnyam rje'i gzim phug la 'ja' dkar po zhig zug pa kun gyis mthong ba byung zhing / de nas tshes bcu drug nas nyi shu'i bar la sku shed chung ba tsam las sku la snyung zug sogs gtan nas med pa byung ste/ de ni snga mor bdag sogs bu slob mang po 'dus pa zhig la 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor rnams gnang ba'i skabs su rje nyid kyi gsung las/ nged bde mchog pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams 'chi ba'i tshe/

rtsa rgyud las/ rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho ba'i tshe/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs mkha' 'gro/ /lag na me tog sna tshogs thogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /rnal 'byor glu yi mchod pas mchod/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i rnam rtog ni/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i gnas su 'khyer/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi rtags dang bcas te na rgyu med pa'i 'chi ba zhig 'ongs ba yin/ nged kyi bla ma chos dbang pa dang rin chen chos 'phel sogs la yang de bzhin byung la/ nged la yang de ltar du 'ong gsungs pa'i thog tu gnas par mdzad pa yin la/ de dus zhabs drung na yod pa'i dbon po rnams kyis/ kha sang zla ba 'di'i tshes brgyad dang / bcu sogs la me tog gi char chen po dang / lha'i sgra rol mo sogs kun gyis mthong zhing thos pa byung 'dug cing / sku khams 'di yang dwangs po mi 'dug pas/ sman pa mkhas pa zhig bos pa legs pa 'dra zhus pas/ rje'i gsung las/ khyod tsho ci zer nga na ba rang mi 'dug sman pa la ston pa'i nad min gsungs/ 'o na sku rim zhig mdzad pa cis kyang legs pa 'dra zhus pas/ yang gsung la/ sngar yang nged rang gi lag tu gang byung thams cad dge phyogs su btang ba yin zhing / de thams cad tshe 'di'i don du dmigs nas byed ma myong bas/ sngon 'gro yang de kas chog pa yod/ nged la ni na ning dgun dus nas bzung / gling skya dang bsam gtan phu'i rgyab ri rnams du ba dang smug pa sogs kyis gang ba'i sa chu la thim pa sogs kyi rtags rnams rim par byung / 'on kyang sku rim du ming btags pa'i sngon 'gro 'dra byed par 'dod na yang gyis gsungs byung pas/ rje dbon rnams kyis do dam byas nas mus nang gi dgon che chung rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i chos sde mang por sku rim rgya chen po bsgrubs shing / yang skabs shig rje'i gsung las/ sngon rje chos dbang phyug pa gshegs dus gdung la chas zhugs phul tshul/

spur khang rtsig pa dang / bzhu 'bul ba mdzad tshul sogs 'di ltar byas pa yin zhes 'phros ma'i tshul du gsungs byung pa la/ zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyi sems la ma bzod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi cho nge chen po byas pas/ nyid kyi gsung las/ khyed rnams ci zer ba yin/ nga btsun rgan zhig 'chi ba la sems las byed don med/ btsun pa shi ba'i rjes su mya ngan byed pa chos dang mi mthun pas ma byed/ skyes phyin chad 'chi ba kun la yong / don dam par 'chi rgyu yang med/ kun rdzob tu lus 'bor ba la nga brod pa med/ dang po dgos pa'i slob gnyer dang sgrub pa yang byas/ bar du dgos pa'i 'chad nyan yang lam 'bras tshar bco brgyad tsam gyis thog drangs/ bde mchog dang yo ga nai gu/ gcod khrid sogs kyi bshad pa dang khrid rnams tshar bcu skor sogs dang / rjes gnang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtsho/ gzhan zur bka'i rigs mang po dang bcas pa'i mdor na bla ma so so las thob pa'i chos rnams kyi nang nas/ grub thob brgyad bcu'i byin rlabs de dpe zhig ma rnyed pas ma thub/ gzhan thams cad tshar gnyis su ma byas pa med cing / tha mar yang nged rang mnos pa bzhin gdan sa sa skya pa la 'phrod cing / dge sbyor bzang po dang 'brel bas bag chags shin tu bzang ba'i ngang nas 'gro ba 'di shes ldan kun yid smon gyi gnas yin mod/ nga shi ba'i rjes su sgrub khang 'di dog pas mang po shong par yang mi 'dug cing / sgom chen 'das pa'i shul du mang po'i 'du 'tshog skabs su yang mi che bas/ dge slong sangs rgyas rab brtan dang / chos rje kun dga' lhun grub gnyis kyis rus pa'i chas gzhug dang / bzhu ba sogs gyis la rus pa gcig kyang ma 'thor ba dang / thab kyi sa tshun chad ma 'khyar ba tsha tshar btab pa'i bsam gtan phu'i rje sems dpa' chen po'i bzhugs khri'i mdun du mchod rten khang brtsegs shig gyis la der chug lhag ma rnams bsam gtan phu'i ri rtser skyol/

/gzhan nang rten sogs kyi spros pa chen po ma byed/ phugs yul sems can las la sbyor ba las med/ ces sogs gsungs 'dug cing / dus de dag gi skabs su thugs dam la sngar las kyang brtson par mdzad pa'i ngang nas/ skabs 'gar sku mdar shig shig mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyis sku mi bde ba mi 'dug lags sam zhus pas/ mi bde ba mi 'dug nang gi rtsa mdud rnams grol ba'i rtags su gda' gsung ba dang bcas thugs bde nyams dpag tu med pa mdzad kyin 'dug ces thos te/ 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pas mdzad pa las/ rgyud dang man ngag thams cad mthun par/ dbang po rab tshe 'di la zung 'jug gi bde ba thob ste grub mtha' snyog go /'bring tshe 'dir kun rdzob dang don dam bden pa gnyis skyes bu'i gom pa 'dor ba bzhin res 'jog tu rgyud la skyes nas spyod pa gsum gyi mtshams ma sbyar na zung 'jug mi thob pa la/ 'chi ba'i rkyen gyis rlung sems kyi mdud pa 'grol zhing / des spyod pa'i tshab byas nas sngar gyi bden pa gnyis so so'i ting nge 'dzin gcig tu 'dres te zung 'jug gi bden pa mthong ste grub mtha' bsnyogs par bshad ces gsungs pa ltar/ rje bla ma 'dis kyang de lta bu'i 'bras bu mngon du mdzad par nges te/ rtsa mdud rnams grol bar 'dug gsungs shing / thugs bde nyams chen po mdzad pa ni dus der lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zung 'jug bde ba chen po thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i rtags las gzhan du ma 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /yang skabs shig gsung las/ kho bo lo brgyad cu gya gnyis tsam sdod snyam pa yod kyang / rten 'brel zhig gis da lan 'gro zer ba yin nam/ sngon rje 'jam dbyangs la yang sems dpa' chen po'i lung bstan las lo gsum gyis 'grib pa dang / spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho la yang sku tshe lo gsum 'grib pa byung nges yin zhing /

nged rang gi pha rgan la zla bshol rnams brtsis pa'i lo brgya dang lnga thub 'dug zer ba byung zhing / nged la yang de bzhin du rtsis na lo brgyad cu gya grangs lon nyen yang 'dug sngon rong ston gyi tshe sgrub dang / rdo rje lha mo'i man ngag nyams su blang dus kyi rtags la dpags na tshe lo brgyad cu brgal ba zhig yong ba'i lugs yin kyang / bla ma gong ma rnams la yang de 'dra ba mang du byung 'dug gang ltar nged rang gi bsam pa ltar na 'chi kha 'dir sa skya nas zhabs drung dang mjal ba'i lam dbang zhig gis gsal 'debs bgyid snyam pa yod kyang / da sa skya nas spyan 'dren byas pas bde mchog gi gsung bsnyen gyi gegs su 'gro ba 'dug pas 'di cung zad sems 'phrang ba 'dug gzhan sems la 'phrang ba spu tsam med cing / nged rang gi nye 'khor rnams la yang kho bo'i drin las so sor 'tshos tsam re yongs ba yod pas/ rgan zer la gzhon nyan pa'i so so nas chos dang mthun pa gyis/ thams cad kyis sa skya zhabs drung du blo gtod/ gling ga dgon pa ma bu rnams sa skya pa bdag po la 'phrod pas nga rang gi bsam pa thams cad 'grub/ khyed rnams la shul du gang yang mi dgos pa 'di nged drin che ba yod do zhes gsungs shing / de nas tshes bco brgyad/ bcu dgu/ nyi shu'i nyin rnams bde nyams dpag tu med pa dang bcas yang yang nam mkha' la gzigs nas zhal 'dzum pa sogs dgyes pa'i nyams du ma mdzad cing / mkha' 'gro ma lā ma ni lta ba rang la dga' zer bar 'dug de de ka yin gsungs pa sogs dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang gsung gleng mdzad pa'i tshig go min mi go min mang du gsung gin 'dug ces de dus zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams mgrin gcig pa'i ngag las thos shing / yang lan cig spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas/ phyag nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas zhal 'dzum mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ rje dpon gyis ci 'dug lags zhus pas/

dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma mang po gar byed kyin 'dug khyed kyis mthong ngam gsungs/ de la rje dbon gyis nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon kha dog dang dbyibs ri mo sna tshogs ya mtshan can du mas gang ba ni 'dug lags/ gzhan ci yang mi mthong ba 'dug lags zhus pas/ hai/ 'di rnams stong gzugs kyi nyams yin pas mi rtag rnam kun mchog ldan gyi lta ba 'di rang zab pa 'dug gsungs/ yang lan cig nam mkha' la gzigs nas ḍā ki ni ḍā ki ni zhes gsung chen po gnang byung bas/ ci 'dug lags zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes dang / lha mo te nu gnyis kyang lta ba rang dga' zer te/ de de ka rang du gda' gsungs pa sogs dag pa'i gzigs snang 'ba' zhig gi dus 'da' ba byung 'dug cing / de nas tshes nyi shu'i mtshan gang thugs dam 'ba' zhig la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i ngang nas/ skabs shig zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams la/ rje nyid kyi gsung las zla ba shar bar 'dug gam thams cad 'od dkar pos gang 'dug gsungs ba dang / mi 'dug lags zhus pas/ yang cung zad gcig nas gsungs las/ da ni nyi ma yang shar byung zhes sogs gsungs shing thugs bde nyams chen po mdzad pa dang / yang cung zad nas ḍā ki ma 'od gsal ma bu ngo 'phrod byung gsungs shing dgyes spro dpag tu med pa'i thugs nyams mdzad kyin 'dug ces thos la/ 'di dag ni rje btsun nyid kyi nang gi thugs dam zab mo'i nyams len gyi nus pa'i rten 'brel gyi dbang las spang bya mtha' dag skad cig gis spangs nas sa lam rnams yud tsam gcig la bsgrod de/ de ma thag 'bras bu mngon du mdzad par nye ba na/ lha dang lha mo dang / dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams kyis 'od kyi kha dog sna tshogs pas bsu ba dang / rol mo'i sgra rgya cher sgrog pa sogs/ mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa dang bcas rje nyid kyi drung du lhags shing 'khod pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel rmad du byung ba'i mtshan ma yang dag par shes par bya ste/

tshul de dag ni chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar dang mtshungs par mngon te/ de yang chos rje de nyid kyi rnam thar bla ma byams chos pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mya ngan 'das byung las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de nas nyi ma nub tu cha ba na babs pa'i tshe/ bskyed rdzogs kyi thun mong ma yin pa sems rgyud la 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa khyad par can rnams ni 'da' kha ma la babs pa na/ 'chi kha'i 'od gsal sna tshogs 'char bas gsos btab pas dran blangs nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang rig cing 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba'i ye shes khyad par can/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes gang du'ang mi rnyed pa'i rang rig pa'i bde chen ye shes lha dang mi'i bde bas bcu drug gi char yang mi phod pa'i bde ba chen po rnam par mi rtog pa sems rgyud du 'khrungs na/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa ltar 'od gsal ma bu ngo 'phrod de ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / mar la mar bzhag pa bzhin dngos po kun dbyer med bde ba chen po ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi skur mngon par byang chub par mdo rgyud mang po nas gsungs pa de nyid bdag cag gi 'dren mchog dam pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi thugs rgyud la mngon sum du 'khrungs nas drung na gnas pa kun gyis gzim mal cung zhig 'chos par rtsom pa na/ 'di ka rang la bzhag pas 'di 'dra'i bde ba/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba/ stong pa'i bde ba/ 'dzag med kyi bde ba zhes sogs mang po gsungs/ gzhan yang de'i tshe thig le'i sgras gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug /dbu ma'i thig le/ stong pa nyid kyi thig le zhes sogs brda'i tshig mang po gsungs zhes sogs rgyas par bshad pa de rnams dang / bdag gi bla ma sangs rgyas mi gzugs can de nyid kyi gong du bkod pa ltar ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rnams la rgyud dang man ngag zab mo'i don la mkhas pa'i dpyod ldan dag gis legs par brtags na rnam thar de gnyis ka sku mya ngan las 'da' khar 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa mngon du mdzad nges pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags su mtshungs par rtogs nus pa yin no/

/de nas tho rangs kyi cha zin pa na dbon chung gis gsol 'jam zhus pas/ rje'i gsung gis/ yi dwags la su ru pa'i gtor ma ma sbyin par tshod ma 'thung pas yong pa e yin/ zhes sogs gsungs shing thugs cung ma mnyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ de 'phral dbon pos thugs dam gtor ma la chab btang pas dkar cha bzhi sogs mdzad nas/ yang thugs dam ngang la bzhugs par mdzad/ de nas nam langs par nye ba na rje'i gsung las/ gsol ja me tog dbyangs 'dzin zhig bsus las khyer shog gsungs pa'i tshe/ dbon po ma chen gyis gsol ja rje'i zhal dkar kog tsam las zhu ma nus pa la/ nyid kyi gsung las/ da rang nged khag che bas ja dkar yol gang lhug cig gsungs shing / dpon slob rnams kyis gsol ja gsol grub mtshams nam langs byung pa na/ de ring nyi shu gcig yin nam gsungs/ yin lags zhus pas des yong ba 'dug khyed rang gcig ma gtogs rang gnas su song gsungs nas/ dbon po rgan pa zhabs drung na yod pa la/ rje'i phyag phreng ring ba phud nas sku 'khris kyi bang khar 'jog pa mdzad cing / phyag skor phyag g.yon pas bsnams bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ rje'i gsung las/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyi bdud rtsi ril bu la/ sa skya pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu cung zad bsres pa zhig khyer shog gsungs nas de bzhes te cung zad cig thugs dam lta ba la bzhugs nas/ de nas phaṭ che ba gnyis gsung ba gzim phug gi mdo na yod pa kun gyis thos shing / de nas gsung chung ngus phaṭ kyang gsung ba 'dra ba la/ hig kyang gsung ba lta bu zhig gis mod la sku stod phrug tsam dang ltag pa bsgyod tsam mdzad pa'i ngos/ tsheg sgra che ba dang bcas dbu las chu skol ba lta bu'i rlangs pa skya bun pa byung ba dang dus mnyam du dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan song bas/ de 'phral zhabs drung na yod pa'i dbon po des grogs gzhan rnams bos nas/ rje bla ma'i sku gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i dbu la bltas pa na/

sngar dbu'i spyi gtsug gi thad na dbu thod gzhan las 'bor ba'i gting sgong zhabs ma'i tshad tsam zhig yod pa'i dbus der bug pa zang thal du gyur pa nas rtsa dbu ma lta bu'i sbom phra smyug ma 'bring pa tsam gyi sku'i rtsa sbubs stong zhig rgyangs kyis thon pa las byang sems kyi zil pa nyil le bar gyur cing / de dus kyang dbu byin la yang drod tsha tshil le ba rlangs pa dang bcas 'dug go zhes thos la/ de ltar gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa'i skad cig de nyid la 'da' kha ma zab mos mtshams sbyar te mkha' spyod chen po 'og min du thogs pa med pa gshegs pa'i tshul mig yod kun gyi mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pa 'di lta bu ni sngon chad kyang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir byon pa'i paṇa grub kyi dbang po ga ya dha ra sogs 'gran bral gyi skyes bu re re tsam ma gtogs 'ga' yang byung ba ma thos na/ phyin chad ni dus kyi dbang gis lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ des na rje btsun 'brel tshad don ldan gang gis thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung nas zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin thob pa rnams smos ci dgos/ sku mthong ba dang gsung thos pa tsam gyis kyang skal ba mchog tu bzang bar shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa de dang dus mnyam du rta mo shar nas las dag pa 'ga' zhig gi mthong snang la/ 'ja' dkar po ras yug brkyangs pa 'dra ba zhig gi mtha' la 'ja' sngon pos brgyan pa zhig rje bla mas gzim phug gi thad nas bar snang la yal song ba mthong ngo zhes kyang thos so/ /'di ni sngon paṇa chen ga ya dha ra kha rag thod bur gshegs dus 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor mdzad pa'i tshe/ dbu gtsug nas thon pa'i 'od dkar po ril ma tsam zhig bar snang la song ba/ kha rag phyogs kyi mi mang pos mthong ba dang mthun par snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar yin no/ /dus de nas bzung ste dgung zhag ma rdzogs kyi bar dang /

de nas kyang lo dang zla ba'i dus dran rnams kyi skabs/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pa ri mo ngo mtshar can du ma dang bcas pas phyogs kun tu khyab pa dang / me tog gi char rgyun ma chad par babs shing / khyad par gzugs sku bsdu ba'i tshul bstan pa'i nyin rang por me tog gi char shin tu che bas/ la la sa la babs te grwa pa 'ga' zhig gis za ma tog sogs su tshags byar yod pa mang du byung zhing / me tog phal cher ni sa la mi 'bab par/ bar snang la kha ba chen po 'bab pa ltar lding ba dang / 'ga' zhig nyi ma'i 'od zer la thug la nye ba na skar ma'i rgya khyon tsam du mngon pa yun ring po'i bar du gnas pa la sogs pa phal pa rnams kyi blo'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan te/ nyid kyi rjes su slob pa'i gdul bya sogs skye bo kun gyi dad pa'i dbyar mtsho yongs su rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ kye ma kyi hud kho bo'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchog de dus der stor/ /de phyir mgon dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyis/ /lus sems mnar bas ci bya gtol med gyur/ /rje btsun zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i yid skyo'i gtam/ /bdag gi rna ba'i khong bur lhung ba'i tshe/ /'di 'dra mngon sum bden par ma gyur cig /snyam pa'i yid gnyis khyogs la yun ring 'phyang / /yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa khyod gshegs pas/ /sde snod gsum gyi gzhung don su yis 'byed/ /bde kye gsang gsum zab chos gang nas btsal/ /yo ga bya spyod rgyud don su la 'dri/ /kye ma bdag la gcig tu dgongs pa yi/ /rje btsun thugs rje can des skyabs med bdag /bor nas zhing gzhan gshegs 'di kho bo cag /skal ba dman pa las kyang dman no snyam/ /de tshe lus kyi spu ldang mchi ma g.yo/ /mya ngan 'dar ba'i skad kyis mtshan nas bos/ /gdung ba'i sems kyis nyin mtshan khor yug tu/

/bla ma'i zhal dkyil dran pa brjed ma gyur/ /kye ma dus der bstan pa'i nyi ma bzhud/ /kyi hud chos kyi sgron me mnal bar gyur/ /kye ma dus der byang phyogs 'gro ba kun/ /kyi hud mgon dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyur/ /chos min spyod pas nam yang ma gos pa/ /'di ni bdag cag lha yi bla ma zhes/ /yid 'ong lha bu mang po'i zhabs 'bring dang / /bcas te snum gtsang lha lam yangs par gshegs/ /bstan pa nyams shing bstan pa bsam pa yi/ /gang zag phyogs brgyar btsal yang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /dus ngan 'di la 'ja' 'od la chibs nas/ /gshegs 'di 'di bas don chen gzhan gzigs bsam/ /mdzes shing brjid chags mthong na dga' ba'i sku/ /thos pas 'khor ba hrul por mdzad pa'i gsung / /bsam na dad pa 'phel ba'i thugs mnga' de/ /da ni dran pa tsam gyi yul du gyur/ /sngon chad khyod kyi drung du yun ring bar/ /gnas pa'i 'dzum zhal yang yang mthong mod kyang / /tshim par ma gyur da ni yud tsam yang / /mthong ba'i skabs med 'di 'dra bsam bzhin skyo/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo mkha' 'gro bye bar bcas/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshor bcas pas mdun bsus nas/ /'gro ba'i mgon de mkha' spyod spyan 'dren pa/ /snang ba mtha' yas zhing gzhan gshegs min nam/ /yang na rdo rje btsun mos lam bstan nas/ /thub pas bsngags pa'i chos gos gsum dor te/ /'od dpag med drung chu skyes 'dab ma'i sbubs/ /gcer bu'i tshul du bzhugs la yid gnyis ci/ /de 'dra'i snang tshul ston pa mi 'gal yang / /don la sku tshe nyid la sa lam rnams/ /mthar phyin longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su/ /mchog gi 'bras bu brnyes par gdon mi za/ /khyed ni mkha' mnyam 'gro la bu gcig pa'i/ /ma bzhin dmigs med brtse ba'i thugs mnga' na/ /bdag cag re blo gtad pa'i slob bu'i grangs/ /nyi zer rdul dang mnyam 'di 'dor phod dam/ /khyod drung yun du bsten pa'i skye bo rnams/

/bzod glags med pa'i mya ngan me 'bar bas/ /snying brtse'i gangs ri bzhus ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bzhin gyi nor 'dzin gang 'di gzigs lags sam/ /de tshe mgon 'di chos sku brnyes pa na/ /kun kyang btang snyoms 'dug pa mi 'os zhes/ /mtho ris bu mos lag pad ring brkyangs nas/ /puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i me tog lan brgyar 'thor/ /de bzhin dri za'i dbang po slob mar bcas/ /yid 'ong rol pa'i sbyor ba la zhugs nas/ /sna tshogs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bye ba brgyas/ /sa gsum 'gro 'di'i rna ba bdud rtsis bkang / /mtho ris bdag po tshangs pas bai ḍūr+ya'i/ /bla bre kun gsal khyab par bkrams pa'i ngos/ /sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ris rin chen gyi/ /phra tshom dra bas sbrel nas rgyun du mchod/ /yid 'phrog dri zhim phyogs bcur 'thul ba yis/ /nor 'dzin yangs pa'i mtha' gru 'jal ba sogs/ /bstan la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /nyin re bzhin yang mchod pa'i sprin sna 'dzings/ /sngon byon rgyal bas ma thul 'gro rnams kyi/ /sna tshogs spyod pa ngan pas thugs gdungs nas/ /'gro ba'i skyabs mgon gang de zhing gzhan du/ /gshegs pa'i snang tshul gang bsam skyo ba 'phel/ /de lta na yang dad ldan slob bu bdag /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i mgon khyod kyis/ /byang chub bar du skyongs bar zhal bzhes phyir/ /yang cig bsam pas yid bde'i dga' ston thob/ /de phyir thun mong snang ba'i gzugs kyi sku/ /chos dbyings thim tshul bstan kyang skal ldan bdag /gdul byar bcas rnams mgon khyod thugs rje yis/ /mi mngon dbyings nas 'bral med bskyang du gsol/ /de lta bu'i skabs der zhabs drung na 'dus pa'i skye bo rnams dang / bdag sogs dad ldan gyi bu slob grangs med pa zhig gis thog drangs thar 'dod kyi gang zag phal mo che zhig dam pa'i mgon dang bral bas nyam thag cing / bzod par dka' ba'i snying gi chu gter chen po phyur bur lud nas/

bzhin gyi nor 'dzin gyi khyon mtha' dag shel dkar bzhus pa'i rgyun lta bu'i mchi ma'i chu klung gis ci yang khyab kyang / mig gi pad+mo nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' 'od kyi ri mo ngo mtshar can gyis phyogs kun tu gang ba dang / me tog gi char chen po rtag par 'bab pa sogs ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i cho 'phrul rnams la zim mer lta bzhin pa'i ngang du gnas par gyur pa yin no/ /de yang rgyud las/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma 'das pa'i tshe/ /gdung ba'i sems kyis mchi ma phyung gyur na/ /phra rab rdul dang mnyam pa'i grangs snyed kyi/ /bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib byang gyur te/ /ma 'ongs dus su zhabs drung skye bar 'gyur/ /gdan khri legs gsham steng du spur bzhag nas/ /chu gtsang argas sku khrus legs gsol na/ /bskal pa bye bar bsags pa'i sdig byang nas/ /zag med chos sku dri bral thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de nas drung na gnas pa rnams kyis rgyud sde zab mo nas bshad pa'i cho gas sku gdung rin po che la chas gzhug gi zhabs tog phul te/ spos dang dar zab la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang / na bza'i tshogs du mas bkur bsti chen po dang bcas gsol ba btab cing / de de'i skabs nas ring por ma lon par sku gdung la sbyin sreg gi cho ga phul ba'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung zhing gdung khang zhal phye ba na sku gdung phal cher ring bsrel gyis yongs su gang bar gyur cing / lhag par tshangs bug zang thal du gyur pa'i dbu thod kyi bug pa'i tha ma la/ sngon grub thob chen po khyung po rnal 'byor la byung pa ltar a yig shin tu gsal ba mang pos bskor ba dang / gzhan yang lha sku dang / yig 'bru dang / phyag mtshan gyi rigs sogs mang du byon cing / de rjes gdung rus phal cher bla ma yi dam gyi sku dang mchod rten sogs kyi spar mang du btab nas gling ga bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i rje bla ma nyid kyi phyi rten nang rten rnams kyi gzungs gzhug la gtso bor bzhugs shing /

'ga' tsam ni gzhis byes kyi dad ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du yang phul la/ de dag gi skabs su gling ga bde ba can gyi dgon pa ma bus thog drangs/ mus nang gi dgon pa thams cad dang / gzhan yang phyogs kyi dgon pa che chung du mar dgongs rdzogs rgya chen po bsgrubs shing / kho bo cag gis kyang dpal sa skya'i bde mchog pho brang du rje bla ma bka' drin can de nyid kyi dbu thod kyi dum bu la mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas gsol ba yun ring du btab cing / de dang dus mtshungs par dge 'dun rags bsdus shig gis dges pa rdo rje'i sgrub mchod dang / bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zla ba lhag tsam bsgrubs shing / gzhan yang sa skya'i tshogs chen la mang ja'i thog 'bul 'gyed tshan che ba btang pa sogs rang gi lag na gang yod kyi dgongs rdzogs ci nus su sgrub cing / gzhan yang ji skad du/ bla ma 'das pa'i lo zla tshes grangs dag /nges par bzung ste mchod pa byas gyur na/ /bskal pa bye bar bsags pa'i sdig bcom nas/ /shin tu mi zad gshin rje'i grong las thar/ /zhes dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo 'phan la sogs/ /dung dang rnga chen dril bu sogs kyis mchod/ /mchod pa bcu dang bkra shis tshig bsgrags na/ /bskal pa ther 'bum bsags pa'i las dag na/ /zag med chos sku thob nas gzugs sku yi/ /snang ba skyes nas srid gsum sdug bsngal sgrol/ /zhes dang / sngar bshad phyag 'tshal la sogs bcu byas nas/ /de dang mtshungs pa'i dge ba 'ga' mi rnyed/ /mchod na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sa thob nas/ /skye bo mang po thar pa'i lam la 'god/ /ces dang / de tshe bla ma'i yon tan dran pa dang / /bka' drin dran pa rnam thar byin rlabs dang / /rnam pa cha lugs rjes su dran byas nas/ /dad mos gus shing shin tu gdung ba yis/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa'i blos/ /yang dang yang du gsol ba drag tu btab/ /des ni ma 'ongs 'khor gyi gtso bor 'gyur/

/zhes dang / khyad par du yang / bla ma dam pa mnyes par bya/ /bla ma'i drin gyis thob pa yi/ /rgyud lung man ngag sbyin par bya/ /chos 'chad ma gtogs sems can la/ /phan 'dogs mchog gyur gang yang med/ /ji ltar 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ /rgyal sras brgya stong yod mod kyang / /mtshan dang mi ldan rgyal po yi/ /gdung brgyud gsob par mi nus na/ /sras kyi 'du shes ga la 'byung / /mtshan ldan gdung gsob nus pa la/ /yid rang shin tu dgyes pa ltar/ /slob mas sems can don sgrub na/ /bla ma'i bzhed pa cis mi sgrub/ /bla ma mnyes par byed 'dod na/ /sems can don la rab brtson bya/ /de phyir gcig tu sems can gyi/ /don sgrub bya'o mi bdag kye/ /zhes dang / bla ma nyin gcig mnyes byas na/ /bskal pa bye ba ther 'bum du/ /byas dang byed bcug yid rang ba'i/ /sdig chen bcom nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dang / grub pa brgyad dang 'phrin las bzhi/ /mngon shes spyan lnga rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /gzhan don 'phrin las byed pa yang / /bla ma'i bzhed pa sgrub las byung / /zhes pa ltar/ de nas brtsams te zla dus lo dus kyi dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul bar kye rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi rgyud 'don dang / bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga sogs chag med du btsugs shing / lhag par bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por rje bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi nang rten du yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dang thun mong ba'i dngul gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba zhig dang / gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po'i sku 'dra sku tshad ma sku dngos dang khyad par med pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba dang / rje nyid kyi dngul sku mtho gang lhag tsam sogs dang / bris thang gi rigs mang du bzhengs shing / dus phyis lo dus kyi dus dran gyi mchod par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod gsar du btsugs pa sogs dang /

gzhan yang bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don ci nus su sgrub pa sogs mdor na rang nyid kyi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngos po ci mchis pa thams cad rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i thabs kho nar dmigs pa las/ gzhan du bsam pa cung zad kyang med pa lags te/ kho bo cag ltos bcas dang bcas pa'i deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar gyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa ni/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun bslu med bla ma de nyid las gzhan du ma 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar bdag cag gi bla ma rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po de nyid gzhan snang du sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdu ba'i tshul gyis rgyal ba thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dang tha mi dad pa'i rnam par rol pas bzhugs shing / rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha' ji srid pa de srid du sems can rnams kyi don 'bad med lhun grub kyi tshul du 'byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i go 'phang dam pa mngon du mdzad pa gdon mi za ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ phun tshogs yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /dngos grub gter chen rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i nor bu rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rje/ /rje btsun mtshungs med bud+dha'i mtshan 'di lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs kyi mchog /khams gsum 'gro ba srid las bsgral phyir dus gsum rgyal ba mi yi gzugs/ /theg gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen che/ /mchog gsum ngo bo dpal ldan bla mar dus gsum rgyun du gsol 'debs kyi/

/sku gsum bdag nyid yongs 'dzin khyed kyis dus gsum 'bral med bskyang du gsol/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen pa'i dbang po rab rgyas rab brtse brtse ba'i bdag nyid mchog /mthu stobs stobs ldan gsang ba'i bdag mtshungs 'dren mchog mchog gsum bdag nyid can/ /gang gis gang la gsol ba btab na dngos grub grub gnyis kun stsol ba'i/ /bla med bla ma'i ngo mtshar rnam thar rab dran dran pas snying nas 'dud/ /de lta'i rmad byung yon tan mdzod mnga' ba/ /gang gi bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa rlabs po che/ /'di ni skal bzang yid kyi dga' ston yin/ /gang gi bka' drin cha shas phra bas kyang / /srid pa nyam nga'i gdung ba 'phrog byed na/ /ji snyed bskal par 'bad kyang de yi lan/ /lon pa'i go skabs med snyam bdag yid zhum/ /stong gsum khyon 'di yid bzhin rin chen gyis/ /bkang ste phul yang rje btsun bla ma'i drin/ /nam yang 'khor ba'i nus pa ma rnyed nas/ /thabs kyis 'phongs shing rang sems had de lus/ /'on kyang bla mar yid gtad dge ba'i 'phrul/ /dus gsum ci bgyis mchod sprin brgyar sprul nas/ /bslu med rje btsun khyed la 'bul lags kyi/ /dgongs pa chos dbyings ngang nas rdzogs gyur cig /nyam chung bdag 'dras bstan dang 'gro ba'i don/ /rlabs chen sgrub pa'i skal ba 'di 'dra ba/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyod kyi thugs rje las/ /gzhan du bsam pa bdag la cung zad med/ /da dung bdag dang bdag la ltos bcas rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa rgyas shing phyi ma lhan cig tu/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /rje btsun bla ma bla ma'i mchog /mdzad pa rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i mdzod/ /de phyir brjod pa brjod yul 'das/ /e ma ngo mtshar ngo mtshar gter/ /gter 'di kho bo'i skal bas rnyed/ /rnyed pa legs byas mthu las byung / /byung ba 'di la kun kyang smon/

/ces mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i spyi gzugs dam pa dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par thar pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs ngo mtshar sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba las/ tha mar bdag sogs 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs mgon dam par slar yang bzlas te byon pa'i tshul gyi rnam par thar pa legs par bshad pa ngo mtshar rin po che'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //'o na rnam par thar pa 'di brtsams pa'i tshe/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo du zhig lon zhing / gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya dang / sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo btab nas lo du 'das pa dang / rje bla ma nyid dgongs pa chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag nas lo du song zhe na/ de'i tshul nyung ngur bsdus nas tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas brjod pa ni 'di ltar te/ bdag gi ston pa thugs rje can/ /rnam 'byung rab byung me yos la lhums su bzhugs sa 'brug la bltams nas/ /brgyad cu bzhes pa me phag thams cad 'dul la/ /gshegs nas bzhi brgya 'das pa yi/ /sa pho 'brug la klu sgrub ston pa 'das nas lo bzhi brgya nas klu sgrub 'byon pa mdo du ma nas lung bstan bltams/ /de nas lnga brgya 'das pa yi/ /sa byi lo la ston pa 'das nas lo dgu brgya nas thogs med 'byon par rgya'i mkhan po wan tsheg bshad thogs med 'khrungs/ /de nas go dgu 'das pa yi/ /me mo yos la klu sgrub gshegs te dgung lo drug brgya thub/ /de nas nga gcig 'das pa yis/ /me mo sbrul la lo ni brgya dang lnga bcu 'tsho/ /zhes 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas lung bstan/ thogs med gshegs/ de nas de'i tshe rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis dgung lo re gcig bzhes zer stong dang bzhi brgya dang / /lnga bcu 'das pa me yos la/

/bod du gnyen pa gsang ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya nas gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ babs/ /de nas brgya dang dgu bcu ni/ /'das pa me mo dbang phyug ces pa glang gi lo/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs/ /de nas nyer bzhi 'das pa yi/ /lcags mo glang la 'phar ba 'phrul snang gi /shākya mu ne bod du phebs/ /de nas brgya dang zhe dgu ni/ /'das pa lcags pho rta rab myos lo la/ /khri srong lde'u btsan legs par 'khrungs/ /de nas nyi shu 'das pa yi/ /lcags pho stag rnam 'gyur la bsam yas bzhengs/ /lo lnga nas tshar shing lug myos byed la/ /bod kyi sad mi mi bdun byung / /de nas nga gcig 'das pa yi/ /me pho khyi mi zad la ral pa can/ /'khrungs nas bcu drug 'das pa yi/ /chu pho stag dge byed la brtsis pa'i tshe/ /ston pa gshegs nas nyis stong dang / /dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga 'das/ /de nas gya gsum 'das pa yi/ /shing mo glang khro bo la lha rtse ru/ /dpal 'khor btsan gyis brtsis pa'i tshe/ /sum stong sum cu so brgyad 'das/ /de nas brgya dang bcu gcig ni/ /'das pa me pho 'brug gi lo/ /lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis brtsis pa'i tshe/ /sum stong chig brgya zhe dgu 'das/ /de nas nga bdun 'das pa yi/ /chu mo glang bag yod ces pa la dpal sa skya/ /btab nas bcu dgu 'das pa yi/ /chu sprel am̐ gi ra lo la rje sa chen/ /'khrungs tshe sum stong nyis brgya dang / /nyi shu rtsa lnga sa chen dgung lo bco brgyad pa sa glang la rngog lo gshegs nas bcu dgu pa lcags stag la gsang phur 'du pa chen po legs par 'das/ /de nas bdun cu rtsa lnga ni/ /'das pa me mo phag thams cad 'dul gi lo/ /rje btsun dgung lo nyer drug pa'i tshe rtse mos na la rtser/ /brtsis tshe sum stong sum brgya 'das/
